Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

54275.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54275.description: A Berukyurosu seems to have appeared in the canyon during the cold season. This could be a chance. Genprey are said to be wandering nearby, but they shouldn't be much trouble. Still, there's no harm in being careful!
54275.descriptionEn:
≪Belkuros≫ has apparently
appeared in the Canyon in
the cold season.
This could be a chance.
≪Genprey≫ are said to roam
the area, but they shouldn't
be much trouble.
Still, caution never hurts!

61101.objectiveJp: 奇面王の悪戯４枚の納品
61101.description: I want to punish the mischievous Chachabu lot. Will you help me collect fragments of the books they dislike? I am searching here too, so drive off the monsters in the Forest while you are at it. Please!
61101.descriptionEn:
I want to teach those mischief-
loving Shakalaka a lesson.
Would you help me collect the
tome fragments they can't stand?
We're searching on our end too,
so while you're at it, chase off
the Great Forest monsters too.
Please!

26450.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time we have prepared the volcano field, but the Volcano depths, the lava pool area, are still unexplored and not open. Please note.
26450.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time we have prepared
a Volcano field, but the Volcano
Depths and the lava pool area
are still unexplored and have not
been released. Please be aware.

26490.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
26490.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke! They say its appearance makes onlookers tremble! But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? What do you suppose happens if the armor is broken?
26490.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of ≪Gravios≫
seems to have appeared amid the
Volcano's smoke!
They say its looks send shivers
through all who see it!
But it's called the Armor Wyvern
for its armor, so what if you break it?

26535.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26535.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26535.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

26379.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
26379.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Low Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26379.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
low rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!

56089.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Fury-Faced Wyvern. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56089.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Rage-Faced Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will specially
add developed part materials to
your Another rewards. Note that
slaying alone grants no such
materials, so take care.

23613.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Giaorugu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23613.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Giaorugu≫
seems to have reached a strength
that puts it at the very top of
all Giaorugu. Its power is
beyond measure. Hunters sure of
their skill to challenge the
summit, please take on the
survey.

21468.objectiveJp: 氷狐竜の上鱗３個の納品
21468.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Ice Fox Wyvern's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21468.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon but
I'm short on materials! At this
rate I can't go hunting. Trade
me the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern Fine
Scale≫ you have for this
≪Paw Pad Medal≫! Please!

62153.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62153.description: The other day, while gathering in the Forest and Hills, I was set upon by 2 Rathalos. I escaped with my life, but I cannot leave that place to them as their territory. Will you not rid us of them? For your trouble, take this Sturdy Jawbone.
62153.descriptionEn:
The other day, while gathering in
the Forest and Hills, two
≪Rathalos≫ attacked me.
I somehow kept my life, but I
cannot leave the Forest and Hills
to those beasts' territory.
Won't you rid us of them?
In thanks, I'll give you this
≪Sturdy Jawbone≫.

54783.description: Reports say powerful Brachydios are appearing in various regions. The Guild wants them hunted at once, but study of the Brachydios ecology has not progressed. For research, hunt it after severing its tail. Your reward will be increased accordingly.
54783.descriptionEn:
There are reports of powerful
Brachydios appearing all over.
The Guild wants them hunted at
once, but the ecology of this
Brute Wyvern is still unstudied.
For research, sever its tail
before you hunt it.
Your reward will be bumped up
accordingly.

23350.description: Residents nearby report that the Gogomoa of Tide Island are causing serious damage. They say the beasts were caught in thread snares the likes of which they had never seen. To put a stop to this, we ask you to hunt the Gogomoa.
23350.descriptionEn:
We have reports from residents
living nearby that they suffer
serious damage from the Gogomoa
on the Tidal Island.
According to them, they were
caught in thread traps never
seen before.
To stop this damage, we ask you
to hunt the Gogomoa.

60704.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60704.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! It's a weaker individual, so the carving contents are a special arrangement! The rewards are the familiar Genki Drinks and coins!
60704.descriptionEn:
Yes! Today I shall hold a
special exercise limited by
weapon, on my own judgment!
Meet the conditions and your
gear and items are up to you!
It's a weaker individual, so the
carves are a special selection!
Rewards are the familiar Energy
Drink and coins!

26509.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

21992.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21992.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Tigrex, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21992.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Palico doing well, meow?
Time to treat your partner right, meow!
Now, to business, meow. This
request is to hunt one Tigrex,
meow.
The reward is crafting materials
for Palico gear, meow!
I'm counting on you, meow!

61304.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61304.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

22028.description: Congratulations on reaching HR6! Deliver a Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
22028.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR6! Deliver a Map on your
own, clear the quest, and
claim your reward!

62796.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62796.description: You have come into your own, hunter. Is it not time to replace that armor? You will receive the materials for 1 of 5 kinds of armor. Do give it a try! Note that it cannot be taken on consecutively, so be warned.
62796.descriptionEn:
You've become quite a skilled
hunter. Isn't it about time you
got yourself new armor?
You will obtain one of five
types of armor materials.
Please do give it a try!
However, you cannot accept it
consecutively, so please be
careful.

61413.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

62847.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・四章１個の納品

40230.description: Hum hum hmm! Become the cute Hatsune Miku and dance with a cute Erupe! Clear this quest and get a Guild Card background! Oops! Do not attack the Erupe by mistake! Put your weapon away! Now then! Let's! Dance!
40230.descriptionEn:
Hm hm hm-hm♪
Become the cute Hatsune Miku and
dance with the cute Elpe!
Clear this quest and you'll get
a Guild Card background!
Whoa! Don't go attacking the
Elpe by mistake!
Keep your weapon put away!
Now then! Let's! Dance!

54462.objectiveJp: イカリオオマグロ５０匹の納品
54462.description: A giant fish living in the freezing sea, the Anchor Tuna. I heard a rumor that a mysterious creature called Johnny, which loves that Anchor Tuna, has appeared. To investigate Johnny, we need Anchor Tuna in great quantity! Help with the investigation!
54462.descriptionEn:
A giant fish called “Ikario
Tuna” lives in the freezing sea.
I heard a rumor that “Johnny”,
a mysterious creature that
loves to eat Ikario Tuna, has
appeared.
To investigate “Johnny”, we need
a large amount of Ikario Tuna!
Help us with the survey!

21904.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
21904.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Berukyurosu at the Old Tower. Clear this request and you can obtain the Artisan's Soul needed to upgrade weapons, so do take it on and see it done.
21904.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's daily life,
we've prepared a request to hunt
a Berukyurosu at the Ancient
Tower. Clear this request and
you can obtain the Weaponsmith
Souls needed to upgrade your
weapons, so be sure to take it
and finish the job.

53038.description: The other day a female hunter asked me about womanliness. A hunter must be refined enough to learn grace even from a monster's bearing! Hunt a Rathian and learn its elegant movements.
53038.descriptionEn:
The other day a female hunter
came to me for advice about
femininity as a hunter.
A hunter needs the awareness to
learn grace even from how a
monster carries itself!
Hunt a Rathian and come back
having learned its elegant
bearing.

54146.description: We continue the investigation of Pokaradon, lord of the extreme cold sea. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54146.descriptionEn:
The survey of Pokaradon, lord of
the Polar Sea, continues.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd be delighted
if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
continued support!

63273.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
63273.description: Happy New Year! This year we have prepared bamboo, a plant from the East that serves as the production material for a peculiar gunlance of Eastern origin! To hand it over, we ask you to hunt a carapaceon said to be indispensable at Eastern celebrations. We also have the New Year gifts from past years ready!
63273.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
This year we've prepared bamboo,
the plant that becomes the
crafting material for a bizarre
Gunlance from the east!
To hand it over, we ask you to
hunt a Carapaceon said to be
essential to eastern celebrations.
We also have last year's New
Year gifts ready!

26287.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

23558.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23558.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

26203.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26203.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

63223.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63223.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee! I wish you good fortune!
63223.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Use all of your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
Complete this request splendidly
and you will earn an exceptional
reward! I wish you good fortune!

62114.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62114.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a two-handed weapon of outstanding destructive power. Take the armor and Hammer prepared for you and hunt the Ice Fox Wyvern Dyuragaua in the New Grand Arena! Watch for your opening and land heavy damage!
62114.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor! This
time you'll hunt with a two-
handed weapon of superb
destructive power.
Take the armor and Hammer
provided and hunt the Ice Fox
Wyvern Duramboros in the New
Great Arena! Watch for your
chances and land huge damage!

21002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21002.description: Velocidrome flees to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there! It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are many Velociprey minions about, so be careful!
21002.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ flees to
another area when worn down
and recovers health there!
It's a fine test of a
hunter's skill, but this
season its Velociprey
underlings are many. Careful!

61574.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
61574.description: A request from a certain beastman. He has a friend he wants to see, who is traveling. On the way the friend must pass through the swamp, but two monsters frighten him too much to go on. They're a rough sort, so hunt them carefully!
61574.descriptionEn:
A request from a beastman.
There's a friend he longs to see,
and that friend is traveling.
The road took him through the
Swamp, but two monsters scare
him too much to go on.
They're said to be a rough sort,
so hunt them carefully!

55953.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Gravios through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword, Lance, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55953.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade one Supremacy
Gravios weapon from creation to
stage one, plus Polta Card
Sakura worth Gz. The weapon
types available are Sword and
Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword,
Lance, Gunlance or Switch Axe.
Please make good use of this.

55307.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
55307.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Vojan, the Crimson Lotus Lion. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55307.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Crimson
Lotus Lion ≪Vojan≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

21657.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
21657.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Niobe Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21657.descriptionEn:
Notes recording the lost secret
of forging weapons and armor
are being found on monsters
slain across the land, they say!
Once you get the ≪Niobe Memo≫,
come straight to this workshop
head like a man!
I'll show you some good work!

55896.description: We have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket exclusive to the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55896.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a quest where you
can obtain a special
≪Outerwear Release Ticket≫.
Please bring ≪Festival Excitement≫
when accepting or joining.

50983.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50983.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

11037.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
11037.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern! It doesn't just spit poison; it can also release a strong flash that blinds you. If you can destroy its crest, it seems you can stop the flash!
11037.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: the Poison
Bird! Besides poison, it
can loose a bright flash
that blinds you. If you
break its crest, the flash
should stop, it seems!

62105.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
62105.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62105.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.

50864.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50864.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
50864.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Lance, show me the skill you
have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.

55317.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
55317.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55317.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

58138.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58138.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58138.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

21440.objectiveJp: さびた板状の塊１個の納品
21440.description: Now for Part Two. From the five kinds including Rusted Fragments, turn in two different kinds than in Part One. The reward is something the alchemy shop master wants so badly his throat aches, for an experiment. What he will do with it, I do not know.
21440.descriptionEn:
Now, Part 2.
From the five kinds such as
rusted chunks, deliver the two
kinds that differ from Part 1.
The reward is an item the
apothecary's master wants so
badly his throat aches for it,
for some experiment of his.
What he'll do with it, I don't know.

62719.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

28081.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
28081.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28081.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!

56062.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Baruragaru through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Hammer, Tonfa, Switch Axe, Light Bowgun, or Heavy Bowgun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56062.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade one Supremacy
Baruragaru weapon from creation
to stage two, plus Polta Card
Sakura worth Gz. The weapon
types available are Great Sword,
Hammer, Tonfa, Switch Axe,
Light Bowgun or Heavy Bowgun.
Please make good use of this.

63254.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63254.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63254.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

20003.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
20003.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and drive the elder dragon off, we beg of you!
20003.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
Teostra the Flame King Dragon
has invaded Dundorma's lands!
Dundorma now enters its Elder
Dragon interception stance!
Please use the interception gear
set up in the sector to repel
the Elder Dragon!

55808.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Bonne D Series, the layered armor of the Bonne G Series. Bonne Release Ticket D x5.
55808.descriptionEn:
By clearing this request, you
can obtain the layered armor
release tickets for the Bonne D
Series, the layered version of
the Bonne G Series.
- Bonne Release Ticket D x5

54880.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
54880.description: Please cooperate with the investigation of the Valsaburos lurking in the decisive battlefield! If you not only slay it but also break its horns and sever its tail, we will add to the reward. Please lend us your strength in our research!
54880.descriptionEn:
We request your aid in a survey
of the Varusaburosu lurking in
the Battlefield!
Break its horns and sever its
tail as well as slaying it, and
we will add a bonus to your
reward. Please lend your
strength to our research!

23603.objectiveJp: ディスフィロア１体の討伐
23603.description: A report has come from an investigator that the moon over the farthest land has turned a ghastly deep crimson. The Guild takes this abnormal phenomenon as an unprecedented omen and has decided to send battle-hardened hunters. Depart for the site at once and ascertain the mystery of the crimson moon.
23603.descriptionEn:
A report has arrived from our
researchers that the moon over
the farthest land has turned a
horrifying deep crimson.
The Guild takes this anomaly as
an omen like no other, and has
decided to send veteran hunters.
Depart for the site at once and
uncover the mystery of the
crimson moon.

55149.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
55149.description: The survey team that went to the desert has sighted Odibatorasu. It is smaller than any individual observed so far, but reports also say it possesses power equal to or greater than the usual. Watch the monster's behaviour when you head out to slay it.
55149.descriptionEn:
The survey team sent to the
Desert has sighted an
Odibatorasu. It is smaller than
any individual observed so far,
but reports say it holds power
equal to or greater than normal.
When you set out to slay it,
watch its behavior carefully.

54206.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54206.client: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang
54206.clientEn: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang

21458.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Plesioth. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21458.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest to slay
a ≪Plesioth≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
fellow hunters?

58093.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58093.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58093.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

53135.description: Everyone! You are in burning love! Gentlemen and ladies alike, use blazing hot weapons and make the Conga yelp! There seems to be a big monster too, but with your hearts you will be fine!
53135.descriptionEn:
Everyone! You're burning with
passionate love!!
Boys and girls alike, take your
blazing, heated weapons and make
those Conga scream! ow ow ow!
Seems there's a big monster
around too, but with hearts like
yours, you'll be just fine!

54897.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
54897.description: We continue the investigation of the Yian Kut-Ku Subspecies. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54897.descriptionEn:
The survey of the Yian Kut-Ku
Subspecies continues.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd be delighted
if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
continued support!

60806.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60806.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50527.description: So you strengthened it into the Absurou Blade. They say that one nests with the fire wyverns of the Old Tower. And just now I heard talk of a monster that fits. No proof yet. Sorry to put you to the trouble, but I want you to go and investigate.
50527.descriptionEn:
So you upgraded it into the
≪Abyssal Blade≫, I see.
They say it's a fire wyvern
that dens in the Old Tower.
And just now I caught word
of a monster fitting that
description. Nothing certain
yet. Sorry for the trouble,
but go and investigate.

55560.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55560.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55560.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, face the Tigrex in
the Desert and show me the skill
you have forged!
If you can hunt it splendidly,
you shall earn a reward far
beyond what your daily efforts
would bring.

23384.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
23384.description: A black-bodied subspecies of Diablos was sighted during the survey of White Lake. We ask you to hunt the creature before the surveyors come to harm. Beware the ferocious strike from underground delivered with those two horns.
23384.descriptionEn:
During a survey of White Lake,
a black-bodied subspecies of
≪Diablos≫ was sighted.
Before the surveyors come to
harm, please hunt the target.
Take great care against the
ferocious strike from underground
by its two horns.

23515.description: There has been a sighting of Zenaserisu at Prismatic Falls at night. Encounters are still few and it is a valuable subject for study. Head there at once and begin the survey.
23515.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Zenaserisu≫ at the nighttime
Waterfall of Colors.
Encounters are still few, making
it a precious subject of study.
Head there at once and begin.

26551.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
26551.description: The Gurenzeburu confirmed on the highlands, which is the target of this request, has been given the name Gurenzeburu by the Hunters Guild. It is an extremely fierce and powerful flying wyvern suited to the peculiar environment of the highlands, so face it fully prepared!
26551.descriptionEn:
The target of this request is
the ≪Barbarian Wyvern≫ found in
the Highlands, which the Hunters
Guild has named ≪Gurenzeburu≫.
It is an extremely wild and
powerful flying wyvern suited to
the Highlands' unique climate,
so challenge it fully prepared!

23403.description: I have received a report that a Doragyurosu was found in the highlands. However, it apparently performs special behavior not recorded in any report to date. Please do investigate the Doragyurosu.
23403.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Dark Thunder Wyvern≫ was
found in the Highlands.
However, it apparently behaves
in special ways not recorded in
any report so far. We would very
much like you to survey ≪Diorex≫.

26506.objectiveJp: エールナッツ５０個の納品
26506.description: Are you gathering today as well? You do not need tools, but you do want to mind your equipment. Now then, a new gathering request. Hmm, it may be a little tough this time too, but do your best. Of course I will give you a reward.
26506.descriptionEn:
Are you gathering today as well?
Since you don't need tools, you
want to be careful with equipment.
Now then, a new gathering request.
Hmm, this one may be a bit hard
again, but please do your best.
Of course, I will hand over your
reward.

62788.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
62788.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62788.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

26487.description: If you're going after Basarios, it's best to search the rocky areas! It often hides by blending in with the rocks! If you plan to do some mining, by all means deliver Coal! It's a prized energy source!
26487.descriptionEn:
If you're going after a
≪Basarios≫, try searching the
rocky areas! It often hides
among the rocks, you see.
If you plan to mine, then by
all means deliver ≪Coal≫!
It's a prized energy source,
that stuff!

58013.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58013.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58013.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

26706.description: An urgent report has come from a surveyor. In the highlands, a monster no one has ever seen has been found. It has a long neck and tail, sturdy limbs, and no wings. Its back is hardened and appears to sprout crystals. Much remains unexplained, so investigate with care.
26706.descriptionEn:
An urgent report came from a
surveyor. A monster no one has
ever seen was found in the Highlands.
It has a long neck and tail,
sturdy limbs, and no wings.
Its back is hardened, and looks
as if crystals grow from it.
Much is still unexplained, so
survey it with care.

21218.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21218.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50308.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
50308.description: To the male hunter who received a woman's feelings. Eat that Porta Chocolate, take on this request, and show your manly form! Note that this quest can only be accepted by men who hold Porta Chocolate. Your understanding is appreciated.
50308.descriptionEn:
Male hunter who has received a
woman's feelings.
Eat that Polta Chocolate, take
on this request, and show us
your manly form!
Note that this quest can only be
taken by a man holding Polta
Chocolate. Please understand.

23420.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
23420.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gureadomosu, the Water Fortress Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23420.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Water
Fortress Wyvern ≪Gureadomosu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

51114.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退

55108.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
55108.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Rohok GF Series. Hunt Lavasioth and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
55108.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest for
upgrading the Rohokku GF Series.
By hunting a Volganos, you can
obtain the upgrade materials for
one piece.
Please make good use of it!

62042.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

21099.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21099.description: A Rathian with a vivid cherry-blossom color seems to have appeared in the desert. A rare subspecies of high scarcity. Those with the courage to hunt the cherry blossoms blooming across the desert, please come to the quest counter.
21099.descriptionEn:
A ≪Rathian≫ with vivid cherry
blossom coloring seems to have
appeared in the Desert.
It is a highly rare subspecies.
Those with the courage to hunt
the cherry blossoms that bloom
wild in the Desert, come to the counter.

56073.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56073.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

51014.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
51014.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
51014.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

55190.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の討伐
55190.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the White Monoblos while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55190.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest where
slaying a Monoblos Subspecies
raises your standing while
letting you obtain, at a bargain,
the materials needed for G Rank
decorations.
Please make good use of it.

21842.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21842.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

60094.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. Thanks to an adaptability that shrugs off harsh environments, elemental attacks seem to be of almost no use against it, so be careful.
60094.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species and has no fixed habitat;
because its numbers are so small it
is a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
Its adaptability shrugs off even harsh
environments, so elemental attacks
seem to hardly work on it.
Be careful.

22128.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22128.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
22128.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.

61314.description: Before we knew it, an Espinas had taken up residence in the Great Arena. And a Hypnocatrice too. Won't you take on slaying those troublemakers? Just dealing with the Espinas is enough. Oh, and the reward goes to the first to finish!
61314.descriptionEn:
Before we knew it, an Espinas had
planted itself in the Great Arena.
And on top of that, a Hypnocatrice
has moved in too. Won't you take
on slaying that rampaging brute?
Just deal with the Espinas and
that is enough. Oops, the reward
goes to whoever gets here first!

23225.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
23225.description: I am making warm clothes, so could you gather materials for me? What I want is Blangonga fur. It is hard and not pleasant to the touch, but it is warm and perfect as a material. If you just hunt it, I will do the skinning myself. I am counting on you.
23225.descriptionEn:
I'm making warm clothes—could
you gather the materials?
What I need is Blangonga fur.
It's stiff and not pleasant to
touch, but it's warm and perfect
as a material. If you'll just do
the hunting, I'll handle the
carving. I'm counting on you.

50596.description: Say, would you go and sunbathe in front of Erpe and the others? I hear they react in the cutest way, and I want to find out if it's true! Do it on the way to fetching some Candy Leaf! As thanks, I'll give you feathers that make a very cute bow!
50596.descriptionEn:
Hey, would you go bask in the sun
in front of the Elpe for me?
I heard they react in the cutest
way, and I want to find out if
that's true!
Do it while you're out fetching
Candy Leaves, okay!
As thanks, I'll give you wings
that make a very cute Bow!

11010.description: The Congalala is a greedy fanged beast, and word is it has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course its minions the Conga love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, it might come out.
11010.descriptionEn:
The ≪Congalala≫ is a stubborn,
greedy fanged beast, and I hear
it can't resist anything made of
mushrooms! Of course its minions
the Conga love mushrooms too!
If you carry plenty of specialty
mushrooms, it may show up.

23235.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23235.description: The Tigrex that appeared in the Snowy Mountains is attacking herbivore monsters one after another! We must secure food ourselves too, and at this rate we will starve. Could you do something about it?
23235.descriptionEn:
A Tigrex that appeared in the
Snowy Mountains is attacking
the herbivores one after another!
We have to secure food too, and
at this rate we'll starve.
Could you do something about it?

54938.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Hunting Horn Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Hunting Horn Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54938.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hunting Horn Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Hunting Horn Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Hunting Horn Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.

62646.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
62646.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62646.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

50510.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Dyuragaua. I am counting on you!
50510.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Word is you've hit HR22.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay's a full set of
weapon materials.
Easy job, really—just run
out there and slay a Duramboros
for me and we're square.
I'm counting on you!

26439.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Even if you are ringed by a swarm of poison that leaps along the ground and poison that dances in the air, masters who cut through the crisis with a struggle like a tornado, prove your strength in the arena!
26439.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
their skill! Though surrounded
by poison leaping from the
ground and poison dancing in
the air, masters who cut
through peril like a tornado—prove your worth!

61193.description: Apparently it is the custom of the Hunting Friends Festival for men and women each to overcome a trial befitting them. This one is for male hunters, so female hunters should take the other quest.
61193.descriptionEn:
It seems the custom of the
Hunting Friends Festival is for
men and women each to clear a
trial of their own first.
This one is for male hunters,
so you ladies take the other
quest, all right?

54101.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54101.description: We will thoroughly investigate the sturdy shell of Daimyo Hermitaur. This time it is a shell survey, so besides destroying the shell, you must not get hurt by mistake during the survey, so breaking the claws is also required. Thank you.
54101.descriptionEn:
We will thoroughly survey the
sturdy shell of a Daimyo
Hermitaur. This time it's the
shell we're studying, so breaking
it goes without saying, but we
can't have injuries during the
survey, so breaking the claws is
also required. Please see to it.

62882.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62882.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62882.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

54262.description: We ask you to hunt the Plesioth that appeared in the Jungle. Other creatures are active in the Jungle at this time of year too. If you focus too much on the Plesioth alone, you may take an unexpected serious injury. Investigate with care for your surroundings.
54262.descriptionEn:
We ask you to hunt the Plesioth
that appeared in the Jungle.
Around this time, other creatures
in the Jungle grow active too.
If you focus too much on the
Plesioth alone, you may suffer an
unexpected serious injury.
Keep watch of your surroundings
as you proceed.

58091.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58091.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58091.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

54889.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54889.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

62396.description: Lately great numbers of beetles have flown in from the direction of the sea of trees and are damaging the crops. At this rate, even when the fruitful season comes, the harvest will hardly be possible. Please, I beg you. Could you slay a few of the insects in the sea of trees?
62396.descriptionEn:
Lately, swarms of beetles have
been flying in from the direction
of the Great Forest and damaging
our crops. At this rate, even
with the harvest season here,
we won't be able to bring it in.
Please, I beg you. Could you
thin out the bugs in the Great
Forest a little?

55541.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55541.description: We present a request that lets you obtain materials from the Scorching Zero Wyvern, including rare materials, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Do not miss this chance, and make use of it for crafting and upgrading your gear.
55541.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on how
often you may take it, but I
present a request that yields
Eruzerion materials, rare ones
included. Don't let this chance
slip by; use it to craft and
upgrade your gear.

55279.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
55279.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55279.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

15001.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
15001.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! First is the hunt for the jungle monsters, beginning with the Yian Kut-Ku. I am looking forward to it!
15001.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
four parts in all! To confirm
your skill once more, you'll
hunt every monster we specify!
First up is hunting the Jungle
monsters, starting with the
Yian Kut-Ku. I have high
expectations for you!

54205.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
54205.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54205.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

21596.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
21596.description: Have you heard of the Tanuki Belly Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21596.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the gem
known as the Tanuki Belly Gem?
Its materials are indispensable
for crafting a certain costly
decoration.
If you would clear this request,
I shall give you those precious
decoration materials.

62692.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62692.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!

26740.description: I saw it! Fireballs raining down from the sky! And not one or two but a tremendous number. If you go to the jungle you should find some trace. However, there have been many Yian Garuga sightings in the jungle lately. Take great care!
26740.descriptionEn:
I saw it! Fireballs raining down
from the sky! And not just one or
two, but a huge number of them.
If you go to the Jungle you should
find some trace of it. However,
there have been many sightings of
Yian Garuga in the Jungle lately.
Be on your guard!

26056.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26056.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

60649.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Pokaradon. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Transcendent weapons only!
60649.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill! Today's
target is Pokaradon!
Achieve the goal together with
your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go and take a top placing!
This time it's Transcendent
weapons only!

61138.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
61138.description: This is terrible! The things I was going to give everyone as presents have been stolen by Blangonga! Hey, you. I will prepare the equipment, so would you get them back?
61138.descriptionEn:
This is bad!
The things I meant to give
everyone as presents were taken
by a pack of Blangonga!
Hey, you.
We'll supply the equipment, so
could you go get them back?

54238.description: Zerureusu has appeared at the summit of the Tower. It is a monster of many mysteries, with few reports, but because legends of it as sacred or as an ill omen differ by region, it is a most valuable subject for study. Which legend this radiant dragon belongs to is unknown, but please investigate at once.
54238.descriptionEn:
≪Zerureusu≫ has appeared atop
the Tower. Reports are few and
the monster is full of mystery,
but since legends differ by
region, sacred here and an ill
omen there, it is a most valuable
subject of survey. Which legend
the Radiant Wyvern belongs to is
unclear, so please survey it at once.

55304.description: The Variant Species Rathalos has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55304.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Rathalos≫ has
grown fiercely strong and keeps
rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as
things stand. Prepare fully and
carry out the survey.

22061.description: The depths of the Highlands are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22061.descriptionEn:
The depths of the
≪Highlands≫ are still under
Guild survey, but hunters
too might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

55392.description: A report has arrived that the shadow of a wyvern bearing needles was sighted. At the sign of a new Variant Species, the guild has prepared a new gunlance for promising hunters, to stand against Variant Species. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare for the hunt!
55392.descriptionEn:
A report has arrived of a
needle-bearing wyvern's shadow
being sighted.
Seeing signs of a new Supremacy
species, the Guild has prepared a
new Gunlance for promising
hunters to stand against them.
Obtain the materials and prepare
to slay a Supremacy monster!

54970.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟

50084.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62128.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62128.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55580.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55580.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55580.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

22102.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22102.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

21717.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Soul (Beginning) x８５, Sword and Shield Soul (Middle) x１９５, Sword and Shield Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Sword and Shield Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21717.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.

62274.objectiveJp: 秘密のポーチ５個の納品
62274.description: You want my clan's secret treasure, meow? Then gather the Melynx pouches, meow! I will negotiate so you can trade for it, meow! A single tail as payment is fine, meow.
62274.descriptionEn:
So you want our clan's secret
treasure, nya? Then go gather
the Melynx pouches, nya!
I'll go negotiate so you can
trade them for the treasure, nya!
As for payment, one tail will
do, nya.

60715.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60715.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60715.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50054.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
50054.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Tigrex of the desert. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply! This time, as a bonus, I will add ingredients I prepared myself!
50054.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Tigrex≫ of the Desert
and prove what you can do.
Clear this quest in fine style and
your standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!
On top of that, this time I've
added ingredients I prepared myself!

21701.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟

60937.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60937.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

62920.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62920.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

62428.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62428.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the lava wyvern Lavasioth together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62428.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, how about hunting the
lava wyvern ≪Volganos≫ together
with a hunter who has climbed high
enough to hold a Secret Tome?
Follow their distinctive footwork,
and clear the request together for
an extra reward I have prepared!

63042.description: There! There it is! A magnificent Monoblos is in the desert! Hunt that one alone and you're a first-rate hunter! Hurry there and hunt it! Right now you can apparently get rare materials too, so just go hunt it!
63042.descriptionEn:
There it is! There it is!
A fine ≪Monoblos≫ is in the
Desert!
Hunting that one alone is what
makes a first-rate hunter!
Hurry off and hunt it!
Right now you can get rare
materials too, so go on,
hunt it!

63394.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
63394.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Kuarusepusu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63394.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are seeking someone to
exterminate an extremely
powerful ≪Kuarlusepusu≫.
Hunt it well, and we shall issue
more proofs of slay than usual!

26011.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26011.description: Lavasioth live in the sea of lava that spreads through the volcano. Their molten breath and attacks that use their massive bodies turn a moment of carelessness into death! The charge of that great body especially demands caution!
26011.descriptionEn:
In the sea of lava that spreads
through the Volcano lives the
lava wyvern ≪Volganos≫.
Its spewed lava and its huge
body's attacks turn a moment's
carelessness into death!
Especially its charge, watch out!

54274.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54274.description: According to the people who live in the Canyon, many legends remain that deep in the Canyon lives a dragon that commands lightning. The truth of the stories is uncertain, but we cannot expose the survey team to danger. Accompany the survey and ensure their safety.
54274.descriptionEn:
According to the people who
live in the Canyon, many tales
remain of a dragon that wields
lightning deep in the Canyon.
Whether the tales are true is
unclear, but we cannot expose
the survey team to danger.
Please accompany the survey and
ensure their safety.

23286.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
23286.description: There is a report that a large dragon was seen deep in the Canyon, in an untrodden land where the survey team rarely goes. There is also a report that just before the monster vanished, thunder rang out violently. Please determine the identity of this monster at once.
23286.descriptionEn:
Deep in the Canyon, in an
untrodden land the survey team
has rarely reached, there was a
report of a great dragon seen.
There is also a report that
thunder rang out violently just
before the monster vanished.
At once,
uncover the identity of
this monster.

55010.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
55010.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55010.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

61516.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61516.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

62573.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
62573.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62573.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

60499.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Baruragaru. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60499.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! The target this
time is ≪Baruragaru≫!
To hunt a monster all on your own -
that spirit is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take a place
among the top ranks!
Also, this time is SP weapons only!
Choose your weapon with care!

26266.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26266.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26266.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

6002.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
6002.description: Lao-Shan Lung is approaching the Fortress, the gateway to this region. Make the fullest use of the fortress's interception equipment and drive Lao-Shan Lung back. If driving it off is impossible, ride on Lao-Shan Lung's back, obtain Dragon Medicine Stone and deliver it.
6002.descriptionEn:
Lao-Shan Lung is closing in on the
≪Fort≫ that serves as the gateway
to this region.
Make full use of the fort's
interception gear to repel it.
If repelling it is impossible,
climb onto Lao-Shan Lung's back,
take a ≪Dragonite Ore≫ and deliver it.

56043.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Plesioth through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Great Sword, Long Sword, Hammer, Lance, or Gunlance. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56043.descriptionEn:
From a Supremacy Plesioth you can
get the materials needed to forge
one Supremacy weapon and upgrade
it two stages, plus Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura. The weapon types
you can forge are Sword and Shield,
Great Sword, Long Sword, Hammer,
Lance and Gunlance.
Please use this to forge and
upgrade the weapon of your choice.

55426.description: A Divergent Giaorugu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. Many hunters have failed to slay it because of the attacks peculiar to Divergent species. In response, the Guild will provide solid support for the hunt. Head out to investigate with care.
55426.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Giaorugu with a hugely
developed tail has appeared.
Its Supremacy-specific attacks have
made many hunters fail in the hunt.
In response, the Guild has decided
to provide strong hunt support.
Please take care as you head out
for the survey.

50882.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50882.description: To everyone who has reached SR100: we have prepared a quest to upgrade the "Rukeze FY Series" into the "Rukeze HS Series". By hunting a Yian Kut-Ku Rare, you can get some of the materials needed to upgrade one piece into Hunt Guard Armor and raise its level.
50882.descriptionEn:
To everyone who has reached SR100:
we have prepared a quest to upgrade
the "Rukeze FY Series" into the
"Rukeze HS Series".
By hunting a Yian Kut-Ku Rare, you
can get some of the materials needed
to upgrade one piece into Hunt Guard
Armor and raise its level.

53264.description: Lately you have noticed the hunters around you are lacking spirit, have you not? Word is they are gloomy about summer ending. I have prepared a summery request and reward to blow such feelings away! This time the clear condition is a secret! The memo in your supply items is the hint!
53264.descriptionEn:
Don't you think the hunters around
you have been looking down lately?
Word is they're gloomy about
summer coming to an end.
So I prepared a summery request and
reward to blow those blues away
and get you fired up!
The clear condition is a secret!
The note in your supplies is the hint!

23196.description: While surveying the extreme cold sea, the presence of Genprey was confirmed. We do not know where they came from, but I think they are worth investigating. To study their ecology, please slay the Genprey.
23196.descriptionEn:
While surveying the Polar Sea, we
confirmed that Giaprey are living
there. We don't know where they
came from, but it is surely worth
looking into.
Please slay the Giaprey so we can
study their ecology.

50969.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
50969.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50969.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

55846.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a dorsal fin break in slaying Gasurabazura, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55846.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Gasurabazura≫ and break
its head and dorsal fin, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

62398.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Deep Forest. The thorn wyvern Espinas has also been confirmed in the depths, it seems. Hunt that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62398.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time I want you all to explore
the Great Forest. An Espinas
has been confirmed in the
depths as well. Hunt that one
while you're at it! I even
prepared armor for you in advance!
Now go and do your best!

26520.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

63074.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期２頭の討伐
63074.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63074.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

50389.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55493.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55493.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

21917.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21917.description: Have you heard of the Verdigris Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21917.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the sphere known
as the Verdigris Sphere?
That material is essential for
crafting a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request, I
will give you a precious decoration
material.

62007.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
62007.description: Good news for the hunter who cannot decide whether to eat the Porta Chocolate a female hunter gave him or put it in the storeroom! If you give me chocolate, I will let you hear a story about a certain female hunter. It is not at all because I want something sweet that I am asking, you know!
62007.descriptionEn:
Good news for the hunter who can't
decide whether to eat the
≪Porta Chocolate≫ from a female
hunter or stash it in the warehouse!
If you give me chocolate, I'll let
you hear a story about a certain
female hunter.
It's not like I'm asking because
I want to eat something sweet,
all right!

26643.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

62561.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
62561.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62561.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

28073.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28073.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!

63316.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Hypnocatrice, then slay the Hypnocatrice here in this arena!
63316.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show off
their skill! If you are confident
you can handle a sleeping bird,
step into this arena and slay
the ≪Hypnocatrice≫!

56022.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Rathalos. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56022.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Rathalos for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.

61025.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

55574.description: The Variant Species Inagami has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55574.descriptionEn:
Supremacy Inagami
has grown fiercely strong and
continues to rampage.
As things stand it is highly dangerous.
Please make full preparations before
you begin the survey.

60627.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60627.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60627.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

55376.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55376.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Stygian Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55376.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want to
craft Stygian Zinogre
≪Zinogre Subspecies≫ armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transcendence Armor, so
please give it a try!

22110.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
22110.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
22110.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's hunting life,
we have prepared a request to hunt
≪Bulldrome≫ in the New Great Arena.
If you complete this request you
will earn more reward money than
usual, so please take it on and
complete it.

26440.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
26440.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can slay a band of Chachabu, whose fighting strength stands far above the rest of the Lynian tribes and who trouble even seasoned hunters, then display that skill!
26440.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show off
their skill! Among the Wyverians, the
Chachabu pack boasts outstanding
combat strength, enough to trouble
even seasoned hunters. If you are
confident you can slay them with
grace, then come and prove your worth!

15023.description: This official hunting exam has 3 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! The Mist Dragon Chameleos has an ability unusual even among the Elder Dragons! I believe in your strength!
15023.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
three parts! To reassess your
skill, you will hunt every
monster we have designated!
Chameleos's abilities are
special even among Elder Dragons!
I believe in your strength!

61813.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
61813.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the newly discovered Highlands. At the summit, no less than the savage wyvern Gurenzeburu has been confirmed. Slaying it will be difficult, but go and experience the ecology and environment of this new land together!
61813.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
I want you all to explore the newly
discovered Highlands.
At the summit, would you believe it,
that Barbarian Wyvern, Gurenzeburu,
has been confirmed as well. Slaying it
will be difficult, but go and experience
the life and land of this new world!

61185.description: A mighty flame thought to belong to an Elder Dragon has been observed in the swamp. Please investigate at once. It is too dangerous to supply items, but please come back safely somehow.
61185.descriptionEn:
A powerful flame, believed to
belong to an Elder Dragon, has
been observed in the Swamp.
Please carry out an urgent survey.
It is so dangerous that we cannot
even supply items, but please,
come back safely no matter what.

62370.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62370.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

54373.description: The survey team that set out for the flower field reports hearing cries that appear to belong to a Forokururu. Sightings are still few, which makes it a precious subject of study. Head for the site at once and begin the investigation.
54373.descriptionEn:
We have a report from the survey team
that set out for the Flower Field: they
heard what sounded like the cry of
Forokururu.
Sightings are still few, which makes it
a precious subject for study.
