55935.description: A black-bodied scorching-zero dragon that reigns over the ancient ruins. The Guild has decided to call it Elzelion that Burns and Freezes to the Extreme. Hunter of courage, drive it off and I will surely grant you materials for armor the Guild keeps in secret.
55935.descriptionEn:
The black-fleshed Scorching Zero
Dragon that reigns over the Ruins.
The Guild has decided to call it
"the Acme Burning-Freezing
Eruzerion".
Brave hunter.
Once you drive the thing off, you
shall surely receive materials for
Guild-treasured armor.

60432.description: Hunting is not only about slaying monsters. Hunting is a broad-hearted thing that brings light even to a mere courier. Come, will you not sweat over a delivery too?
60432.descriptionEn:
Hunting is not just about slaying
monsters.
Hunting is broad-minded enough to
bring light even to a mere courier.
Come now, why not sweat a little
over some transport work
yourself?

62507.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62507.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62507.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

21841.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟

62373.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
62373.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Yian Garuga. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62373.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the Hunting
Technique Quest: ≪Yian Garuga≫
Slaying.
The reward is slightly lower than a
normal hunt, but how about honing
your skills together with fellow
hunters!

26055.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26055.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

58038.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58038.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58038.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

61905.description: There is aesthetics in the sub target. Put the specialty mushroom you took into a Maca Pickling Jar and aim for more rewards, or deliver it as is: follow your aesthetics. Cannot find the specialty mushroom at all? Then retire. I accept nothing but a sub clear.
61905.descriptionEn:
There is aesthetics in sub-targets alone.
Whether you put the Specialty Mushrooms
you gather into the Maca Pickling Jar
to aim for more rewards, or simply
deliver them as they are, is up to
your own aesthetics.
You cannot find the Specialty
Mushrooms at all?
Then you retire.
Nothing but a sub-clear will I accept.

54629.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54629.description: Hunter who would master the light gun, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54629.descriptionEn:
Hunters who seek to master the Light
Bowgun, show the skill you have honed
against the ≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you shall
obtain even more rewards than
what your daily efforts
would bring.
Now, display your technique!

55669.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! The Super Golden Experience, a further boost to the rewards of the Golden Experience, which lets you build experience efficiently and obtain large amounts of Ｇｚ! A request has appeared that triples the rewards again from there. Do take the chance to try it!
55669.descriptionEn:
Emergency notice to all hunters!
We have a request that triples the
rewards of "Super Golden Trial",
which itself boosted the rewards of
"Golden Trial", where you can gain
lots of experience efficiently and
obtain masses of Gz!
Please take on the challenge while
you have the chance!
We look forward to seeing you!

55862.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55862.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

53183.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
53183.description: It is I! The Instructor! The newly discovered monster is called Zenaserisu. What a lively name! Rumor says Zenaserisu has many parts that can be broken, so in preparation for Zenaserisu, polish your skill so you can sever its tail! Gahaha!
53183.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
The newly discovered monster
is called "Zenaserisu".
What a lively name, eh!
Rumor has it Zenaserisu has many
spots that can be broken, so
hone your skill at tail cutting
in preparation for it!
Gahaha!

60547.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
60547.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Guanzorumu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60547.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time's
target is the ≪Guanzorumu≫!
You'll clear the objective together
with your Guildmates.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest — go and take a splendid
top placement!
Also, this time it's Origin weapons
only! Choose your weapon carefully!

63018.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
63018.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63018.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

62209.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
62209.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62209.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.

53247.description: Lately the plaza is awfully lively, and that is a happy thing! I will make you a commemorative great sword, so I want help gathering materials and, while you are at it, an odd good luck custom handed down from long ago. I will send what is needed and the instructions as we go! What, it is nothing strange! I will show you a wholehearted stroke that absolutely meets expectations!
53247.descriptionEn:
The plaza's been awful lively
lately, and that's a fine thing!
I'll forge you a memorial great
sword, so I want materials and an
odd old luck charm passed down
since ancient times. I'll send what's
needed and instructions as we go!
Nothing strange at all! I'll show
you a wholehearted strike!

26124.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
26124.description: Now, into live combat! Go into the jungle, find a Velocidrome, and hunt it! A wild Velocidrome that tires may flee to the next area and recover health, so take care.
26124.descriptionEn:
Now then, on to real combat!
Let's search the Jungle for a
≪Velocidrome≫ and hunt it!
A wild ≪Velocidrome≫, when its
stamina runs low, may flee to the
next area and recover health, so
please be careful out there,
all right?

58040.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58040.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58040.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50310.description: Love may be a small spark now. But one day it will awaken into a giant flame of love! So, I have prepared materials to upgrade weapons filled with burning feelings into G-rank weapons. Getting them now for that day to come is no loss!
50310.descriptionEn:
Love may be but a small spark
now. But someday it will awaken
into a giant flame of love!
And so, we have prepared the
materials to upgrade weapons filled
with burning passion into G Rank
weapons.
Getting them now for that day
will do you no harm at all!
Do consider it!

26434.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
26434.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.

53227.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐

63217.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63217.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

55170.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
55170.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Berukyurosu while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55170.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Berukyurosu raises your
own standing while letting you
get the materials needed for a
G Rank decoration at a good deal.
Please make good use of it, and
best of luck out there.

21723.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Soul (Beginning) x８５, Lance Soul (Middle) x１９５, Lance Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Lance Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21723.descriptionEn:
In this quest, the following materials
can be obtained.
≪Lance Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Lance Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Lance Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Lance Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a ≪Secret Art
Soul Crystal≫ is required, so please
be aware of this.

50205.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
50205.description: Do you want to craft the Yupuke Series, armor that is easy to move in, improves your circulation and gives you longer breath? If you want it, show me your strength! Show me your courage! Surpass the fury of the giant Shen Gaoren!
50205.descriptionEn:
Want to craft the Yupuke Series,
my special armor that's easy to
move in, improves circulation, and
lasts even longer!?
If you want it, show me strength!
Show me courage!
Go beyond the fury of the giant
Shen Gaoren!

55583.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55583.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the black-bodied one the Extreme Scorching Frozen Elzelion. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55583.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it comes
fluttering back again. The Guild
has decided to call that black
form "Eruzerion, the Acme that
Burns and Freezes". To hunters who
slay it, we shall present the
materials for a full set of Guild
secret armor and a title!

15002.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ５頭の討伐
15002.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! This time it is the hunt for the monsters that race across the swamp! Take it on with care and no slip-ups!
15002.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam is four
in total! To confirm your skill once
again, you shall hunt every monster
we designate!
This time it's the hunt for monsters
that run the Swamp! Don't slip up,
face it with a steady heart and
show me what you've got!

62249.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

61060.description: Before we knew it, an Espinas had taken up residence in the Great Arena. And a Hypnocatrice too. Won't you take on slaying those troublemakers? Just dealing with the Espinas is enough. Oh, and the reward goes to the first to finish!
61060.descriptionEn:
Before we knew it, an Espinas had
planted itself in the Great Arena.
And on top of that, a Hypnocatrice
has moved in too. Won't you take
on slaying that rampaging brute?
Just deal with the Espinas and
that is enough. Oops, the reward
goes to whoever gets here first!

55281.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for one material, and break the specified part for one more!
55281.descriptionEn:
A chance to get the Supremacy
weapon the Guild prepared!
Entry requirement is GR200!
Deal a set amount of damage to the
target for one material, and break
the designated parts for one more
of each as a gift!

50997.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50997.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50997.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Dual
Blades, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

23239.description: It has been learned that Lavasioth inhabits the volcano in an unsurveyed region. Lavasioth swims freely through the lava, so left alone there is a danger it will cause an eruption. Could you head out at once to hunt the Lavasioth?
23239.descriptionEn:
We have learned that a Volganos
lives in the Volcano in an
unexplored region.
Because Volganos swims freely
through the lava, if left alone
there is a danger it will cause an
eruption.
Could you head out at once to
hunt the Volganos?

61218.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種の狩猟
61218.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61218.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

50702.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50702.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the dorsal fin of a Lavasioth will also grant a special ingredient.
50702.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Volganos's dorsal fin,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.

50603.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50603.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

55595.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
55595.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Dyuragaua and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
55595.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Duramboros≫
and prove what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
right up!

61741.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
61741.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
61741.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

26555.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
26555.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.

62766.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

23197.description: In the extreme cold sea there are white, fluffy, ever so cute baby Pokara, apparently. They dance in response to your movements, and are said to be incredibly cute! Gathering materials is fine, but why not play with them a little. But you must not bully them, all right?
23197.descriptionEn:
In the Polar Sea there are white,
fluffy, reeeally cute baby Pokara,
or so they say.
They react to your movements and
dance for you, and it's just
so adorable!
Gathering materials is fine, but
why not play with them a little?
Just don't bully them, okay?

21919.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21919.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Gamboge Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21919.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Gamboge Orb?
Its material is essential to
the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
Complete this request and I
shall give you a valuable
decoration material.

54542.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Disufiroa, the Blazing Frozen Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54542.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the blazing
frozen wyvern ≪Disufiroa≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.

55858.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐

63121.objectiveJp: コナマキダケ２個の納品
63121.description: Would you go to Taikun Zamuza and fetch a few Konamaki Mushrooms? It is a delicate material, so do not thrash about too much and take only what is needed. I have prepared a Farcaster, but you can also climb the wall and come back. Well then, thanks.
63121.descriptionEn:
Could you go where the Taikun Zamuza
is and fetch a few Konamakidake?
It's a delicate material, so don't
thrash about too wildly, just bring
back what we need.
I've prepared a Farcaster, but you
can also climb walls to get back.
Well then, I'm counting on you.

12017.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

55394.description: 2 enraged beasts have appeared in the volcanic arena, and their fire and lightning are spreading damage around them. Hunters, slay them at once. On success, you will receive Sigil materials the guild has hoarded since ancient times.
55394.descriptionEn:
Two enraged beasts have appeared
at the Volcano Battlefield, and the
damage from their fierce flame and
lightning is spreading.
Hunters, we ask you to slay them
at once.
On success, we will grant Sigil
materials kept in the Guild's vaults.

58039.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58039.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58039.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

28017.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
28017.description: I made the item someone requested, but honestly I haven't tested it yet. So, would you use it and tell me what you think? It's in the supplies, but the contents are the same as the real thing. I'm counting on you.
28017.descriptionEn:
I made an item someone requested,
but honestly I haven't tested it
yet. So, you lot, won't you use it
and tell me your thoughts? It's
supplied gear, but what's inside is
the same as the real thing.
I'm counting on you.

55921.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55921.description: A white swift wyvern that races like the wind howling through the ancient ruins and gives off light. The Guild has decided to call it the Nargacuga that Runs to the Extreme. Hunter of courage, slay it and I will surely grant you materials for armor the Guild keeps in secret.
55921.descriptionEn:
A white Nargacuga that races like
the wind howling through the
Ruins, radiating light.
The Guild has decided to call it
"the Acme Racing Nargacuga".
Brave hunter.
Once you slay the thing, you shall
surely receive materials for
Guild-treasured armor, as
promised.

22002.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
22002.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.

50006.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
50006.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with monsters in Hardcore quests! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. Use them to enrich your equipment further. I wish you good fortune!
50006.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
with Hardcore Quest monsters!
Clear this request and I'll
hand over more monster
materials than usual.
Put them to good use in
beefing up your equipment.
I wish you a fine hunt!

61923.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
61923.client: Old Man with a Black-and-White Beard
61923.description: Is lying evil? At times a lie told in kindness saves people. You must not fear falsehood more than is necessary. I hope that through hunting monsters, you yourself will change.
61923.clientEn: Old Man with a Black-and-White Beard
61923.descriptionEn:
Is lying evil?
Sometimes a lie of good intent
saves a person. You must not fear
falsehood more than is needed.
Through hunting monsters, I hope
that you yourself will change,
if only a little.

60911.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60911.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60911.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62727.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Jungle, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Blazing Sky, the Voice of Nature: Shore, or the Voice of Nature: Ocean. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62727.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request
set in the ≪Jungle≫,
you may come by
≪Voice of Nature: Blazing Sky≫,
≪Voice of Nature: Shoreline≫,
and ≪Voice of Nature: Open Sea≫.
I pray that your hunting life
becomes all the richer for it.

50512.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
50512.description: Red armor? People asked me all sorts of things about that a few years back as well. Apparently you take some strange material obtained from a quest in the warm season to the weapon workshop. Be careful. Some who did turned strangely, madly cheerful.
50512.descriptionEn:
Red armor?
Years back I was asked all sorts
of things about that too.
Apparently you just take the odd
material you get from warm season
quests to the weapon shop.
Watch yourself. Some folk went
and got awfully happy about it,
you know.

60428.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60428.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

62409.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
62409.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62409.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

54579.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟

61069.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
61069.description: This is the final quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from carving or clear rewards.
61069.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Target monster materials
cannot be obtained from
carving or clear rewards.

50655.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
50655.description: Congratulations on reaching HR22! In this quest you can obtain weapon crafting materials for the Gurenzeburu and upgrade materials for the original Corude Series armor. Both are well worth having. Please give it a try, and good luck!
50655.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching HR22!
In this quest you can obtain
weapon crafting materials for the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ and upgrade
materials for the original
≪Corude Series≫ armor.
Both are well worth having.
Please give it a try,
and good luck!

62538.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62538.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62538.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

62596.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

23347.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
23347.description: Hey, you there. Help me out. I was spending an elegant night in the desert as usual when a Pink Rathian showed up. My lovely night is ruined. Please deal with it.
23347.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there. Won't you help
me out? I was passing an elegant
night in the Desert as usual,
when that Pink Rathian showed
up and ruined it.
At this rate my lovely night is
in ruins. Please, just get rid
of that thing for me.

60214.description: The hair and feathers taken from breeding-season Hypnocatrice are said to be of a color so vivid it captivates the eye. That is exactly the clothing material I seek. First, go and hunt 1. Your thanks will be generous.
60214.descriptionEn:
The fur and feathers of a
mating-season Hypnocatrice
are said to be so vivid in
hue they captivate the eye.
That is exactly the garment
material I have been seeking.
First, hunt one for me, dear.
Your reward will be generous.

61650.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
61650.description: I have a request, trusting in the sturdy bodies and spirits of you hunters. It is my firm belief that people begin to decline the moment they are satisfied. Hunger is what gives people vigor and makes them grow, I believe. Would you prove it for me?
61650.descriptionEn:
I have a request for you hunters,
whose tough bodies and wills
I have taken a liking to.
This is only my own theory, but
people begin to weaken the very
moment they grow satisfied.
I believe hunger is what gives
people vitality and growth.
Could you prove that for me?

53073.description: Sorry, but would you help with preparations for the summer festival? The materials just will not come together, and I have other hunters helping too. It is nothing grand, sorry, but there is a proper reward too!
53073.descriptionEn:
Sorry, but could you help me
out with the summer festival?
The materials just will not
come together, so I have been
asking other hunters too.
It is nothing too demanding,
I know it is a pain, but
there is a proper reward, yeah!

55646.description: A Wrathful Wyvern with greatly developed arms has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Wrathful Wyvern seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55646.descriptionEn:
A ≪Doragyurosu≫ with greatly
developed arms has appeared.
The Guild classifies this one
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
overgrown parts, and surveys it.
Reports say it is more dangerous
than any Doragyurosu so far.
Please take care in your
survey.

60597.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blangonga. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin and Transcendent weapons only!
60597.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
This time the target is
Blangonga!
Team up with your Guild mates
and complete the objective.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time it is Origin and
Transcendent weapons only!

50907.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50907.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Toridokuresu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50907.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are
seeking hunters to slay an
exceptionally powerful
Toridokuresu.
Should you hunt it with skill,
we shall issue more Proofs of
Slay than usual!

15007.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! This time you will hunt the monsters that dwell in the cold lands, beginning with the Khezu in the Snowy Mountains!
15007.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam
has four parts in all!
To gauge your skill once more,
hunt every monster we set!
This time, in the Snowy
Mountains, hunt Khezu and
the other monsters that dwell
in the cold lands!

61633.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟

56010.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
56010.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the beak of Hypnocatrice, we will also grant a special item.
56010.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
UL Guild Priority Requests,
we have prepared this quest
to raise awareness and
promote them further.
Break the Hypnocatrice Rare's
beak and we shall grant you
a special item as well.

55786.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55786.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

61768.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61768.description: One of the important things for a hunter is to know a monster's traits well and bring the right equipment and skills. This time we are lending out gear that speeds up the charge attacks of certain weapons. Land powerful blows quickly and hunt that hard-shelled Daimyo Hermitaur!
61768.descriptionEn:
One thing that matters to
a hunter is knowing a
monster's traits and readying
the right gear and skills.
This time we lend you gear
that speeds up charge attacks
on some weapons. Land heavy
blows fast and hunt the hard-
shelled Daimyo Hermitaur!

61536.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61536.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

54973.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Siluk GF Series. Hunt Kuarusepusu and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
54973.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
for upgrading the Siluk GF
Series.
Hunt Kuarlusepusu and you
will obtain the materials
needed for one piece.
Please make good use of it!

55366.description: The Variant Species Hyujikiki has appeared once more. Its needles have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55366.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Hyujikiki≫ has
appeared once again. Its needles
are stronger now, and it seems
to have grown even mightier.
Please take every care in your
survey.

26237.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ１００ and above.
26237.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass discovered in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain regions,
we offer guidance only to those
of HR 100 or above.

62386.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Dyuragaua. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62386.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Duramboros≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!

60319.objectiveJp: ホワイトレバー４個の納品

55112.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55112.description: The survey team that was separated still has not returned! I saw them being chased by a Stygian Zinogre toward the secret region of the tower, and red-black lightning was coiling high into the sky and resounding! Please! Go and save them quickly!
55112.descriptionEn:
The separated survey team has
still not returned! I saw them
being chased by a Stygian Zinogre
toward the hidden area of the
Tower, and red-black lightning
was coiling high into the sky and
roaring!
Please! Go and save them, quickly!

22133.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22133.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
22133.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

26681.objectiveJp: ハーフチケット白１枚の納品
26681.description: A quest reserved for hunters who have earned excellent results in official hunting tournaments! You can get your hands on a Hardcore Ticket. Once you have made your mark in an official tournament and obtained a Half Ticket White, come and see me!
26681.descriptionEn:
This quest is only for hunters
who earned excellent results
in official hunting contests!
You can get a
"Hardcore Ticket."
Once you've done well there
and obtained a
"Half Ticket White," come see us!

55340.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
55340.description: Lately in the highlands there have been incidents of attacks by Gurenzeburu and the Ice Fox Wyvern. At this rate the merchants cannot pass and trade will stagnate. Please eliminate the threat at once.
55340.descriptionEn:
Lately, in the Highlands,
there have been incidents
of attacks by Gurenzeburu
and Duramboros.
If this goes on, merchants
cannot pass and trade will
grind to a halt.
We ask you to remove
the threat at once.

54269.description: We ask you to hunt the Diablos that appeared in the desert. At this time of year other creatures are active in the desert too. Pay too much attention to the Diablos alone and you may be badly hurt. Keep watch around you as you work.
54269.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the Diablos that
has appeared in the Desert.
Around this time, other
creatures are active too.
Focus only on Diablos and
you may take an unexpected
serious wound.
Keep watch around you as
you proceed with the survey.

21907.description: This request is recommended for hunters who reached HR100: a Hardcore Weapon of Zerureusu can be forged. Slay Zerureusu and you will obtain the materials needed to forge one Hardcore Weapon.
21907.descriptionEn:
This request is recommended
for hunters who reached
HR100: a Hardcore Weapon of
Zerureusu can be forged.
Slay Zerureusu and you will
obtain the materials needed
to forge one Hardcore Weapon.

11011.objectiveJp: なわばりのフン２個の納品

62693.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62693.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!

60104.description: Just when I thought those noisy ones were gone, now there is a swarm of Cantaro thick enough to cover the ground! I left my important baggage behind! Someone drive them off!
60104.descriptionEn:
Just when those noisy pests were
gone, now there is a swarm of
Hornetaurs that looks ready to
cover the ground!
I left my important cargo behind!
Someone go and drive them off!

21905.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21905.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to slay the Akura Vashimu in the Desert. Clear this request and you can obtain the Secret Certificate needed to upgrade armor, so do take it on and see it done.
21905.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's life,
we have prepared a request
to slay Akura Jebia in the
Desert.
Clear it and you obtain the
Secret Art proof needed for
armor upgrades. Take it up!

21456.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Hypnocatrice. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21456.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Hypnocatrice≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!

62914.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62914.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

23711.description: The Variant Species Gravios has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23711.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gravios≫ has
become ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
As it stands this is very dangerous.
Make thorough preparations
before you survey it.

60821.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60821.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60821.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.

50529.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の捕獲
50529.description: My son says he wants to keep an observation diary on Daimyo Hermitaur. His ambitions are high, and as his mother I am proud. So, could you capture a Daimyo Hermitaur? I will give you a curious species obtained from afar as a reward.
50529.descriptionEn:
My son says he wants to keep
an observation diary of the
Daimyo Hermitaur, and, well,
his ambition makes me proud
as a father.
So, could I ask you to
capture a Daimyo Hermitaur?
I shall reward you with a
curious seed from far away.

54231.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
54231.description: We ask you to survey the pack of Genprey that lives in the desert. The pack appears to have 2 bosses, and they seem to be fighting over territory. Would you go and see this for yourself for our survey? Hunters, we thank you in advance.
54231.descriptionEn:
We ask you to survey the pack
of Ioprey living in the Desert.
The pack seems to have two
leaders, and they appear to
be fighting over territory.
Would you go and see it for
yourself, for the survey?
Hunters, we thank you in
advance for your help.

50921.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50921.description: Here is a request that lets you efficiently obtain the materials needed to upgrade the Toa FX Series, Supremacy Armor of Toa Tesukatora. It is a generous quest, so please give it a try!
50921.descriptionEn:
We present a request that
efficiently yields the
materials needed to upgrade
Toa Tesukatora's Zenith Armor,
the Toa FX Series.
A bargain quest, so try it!

21676.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
21676.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over six at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21676.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
If you want a ≪Pawprint Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand over six of them at once.
Bring exactly 3 ≪Quest
Completion Certificates≫ and
come alone, got it? Well then,
I'll be waiting in the Canyon.

62582.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62582.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62582.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

55502.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
55502.description: The storm dragon Amatsu, by its nature of stirring up tempests, is dangerous even to approach, and its ecology is wrapped in mystery. To clarify its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its head or left foreleg in addition to slaying it, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
55502.descriptionEn:
The Storm Dragon Amatsu
stirs up tempests, so even
approaching is dangerous and
its ecology is wrapped in
mystery.
For the survey, extra rewards
await if you also break its
head or left foreleg.
We await the challenge of
brave hunters.

26213.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26213.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Yian Kut-Ku will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
26213.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Great Hall
Guild, we recommend trying a new
sub-target. The "set damage"
dealt to the ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ will
be judged by our Guild, so you
need only focus on clearing the
main target!

55796.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55796.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55796.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

53167.description: This is Miyashita! Still hot out! Stay properly hydrated. [Question 4] The only monster belonging to the fanged wyvern class is the Zinogre (subspecies included). If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53167.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here! Still hot!
Remember to drink water.
[Question 4]
The only monster that
belongs to the Fanged
Wyvern group is Zinogre
(subspecies included).
Think the answer is x (B)?
Then hunters, accept
this quest here!

26485.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26485.description: Blangonga rules the Snowy Mountains! It shows no mercy to those who trespass on its territory! Ah, and this season a rare species of Velociprey seems to come to raise its eggs. You'd best not touch the Carnivore Eggs!
26485.descriptionEn:
≪Blangonga≫ is the lord of
the Snowy Mountains! It has
no mercy for trespassers!
Oh, and rare Velociprey
seem to come raise eggs
this season. Better not
touch their ≪Carnivore Eggs≫!

26640.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

55593.description: An Inagami with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Inagami known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55593.descriptionEn:
A ≪Elegant Sire Wyvern≫ whose
tail has grown greatly has
appeared. The Guild classifies
this individual as a Supremacy
with developed parts and will
survey it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.

55487.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55487.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55487.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

26208.description: Traps, you see, are the fruit of quiet, unglamorous work. So first you cannot neglect steady gathering. The Forest is a good place where you can procure traps on site, so start with gathering.
26208.descriptionEn:
Y'see, traps are the fruit of
quiet, unglamorous work.
So first off, a hunter can't
neglect plain old gathering.
The Great Forest is a fine spot
where traps can be sourced on
site, so start out by going
gathering, you hear.

26479.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Startle it with a Sonic Bomb, or hook it with a Fishing Frog and bring the fight onto land!
26479.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Startle it with a Sonic
Bomb, or hook it with a
≪Frog≫ and fight on land!

21760.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

50319.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50319.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Dyuragaua and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50319.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Duramboros≫
and prove what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
right up!

60517.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

56059.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
56059.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Anorupatisu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Long Sword, Lance, Gunlance, Hunting Horn, Tonfa, or Magnet Spike. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56059.descriptionEn:
From forging one Supremacy
weapon of Supremacy
Anorupatisu, you can obtain
the materials for its second
upgrade plus Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura. The weapon
types are Dual Blades, Long
Sword, Lance, Gunlance,
Hunting Horn, Tonfa or
Magnet Spike. Use it well!

60724.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60724.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60724.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

26676.description: This is a hunting request for Gogomoa, a Fanged Beast newly discovered on Tide Island. The tropical island will be an unfamiliar hunting ground, but this is exactly the moment for hunters to show their skill. Do your best out there!
26676.descriptionEn:
This is a hunt request for the
Fanged Beast ≪Gogomoa≫,
newly discovered on the Tidal
Island. The tropics may be an
unfamiliar place to hunt,
but times like this are where
hunters show what they're made
of. Best of luck out there!

61262.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
61262.descriptionEn:
I got my hands on an ancient tome
said to record how to make armor
that no one knows anymore,
but I was attacked by monsters
and dropped it.
As long as the writing can still
be read, it needn't be intact.
Please, go and find it for me!

61360.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61360.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

23447.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23447.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪H Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪H Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪H Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or higher,
so please keep that in mind.

23702.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (arms), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23702.descriptionEn:
This quest discharges
materials for upgrading
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(arms), excluding weapon
ribbons and weapon merits.
The yield is one type.
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫,
so please keep that
in mind.

61009.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
61009.description: A mighty flame was sighted in the swamp. Please investigate at once. Because it is unsurveyed, we cannot supply items. Head out with every preparation!
61009.descriptionEn:
A mighty flame was sighted
in the Swamp. We ask for an
urgent survey.
As it is unsurveyed, no items
can be supplied. Go in with
every precaution!

50749.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
50749.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to slay an extremely powerful Harudomerugu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50749.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are
seeking those who will slay
an exceptionally powerful
Dahren Mohran.
Slay it with skill and we
shall issue more Proofs of
Slay than usual!

62070.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
62070.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Red Khezu in the Snowy Mountains. Clear the quest without mishap and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
62070.descriptionEn:
The time has come for
hunters to show their skill!
Hunt the Red Khezu in the
Snowy Mountains.
Clear the quest safely and
your reputation as a
hunter will rise
in a hurry!

62456.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62456.description: What, you just want a hard Hunting Horn? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62456.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really stiff
Hunting Horn?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to come by, and nasty
monsters are prowling around
the area to boot.
Go find it with all your spirit!

55141.description: Slaying an Espinas raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55141.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying Espinas raises
your standing while letting
you cheaply obtain the
materials needed for a
G Rank decoration.
Please make good use of it.

54319.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐

60033.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
60033.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!

21656.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
21656.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Garum Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21656.descriptionEn:
Those notes on the lost secret
art of forging gear have been
found on monsters slain all
over the place, or so I hear!
Once you get a ≪Garm Memo≫,
man to man, bring it to this
workshop head right here!
I'll show you fine work!

63410.client: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang
63410.clientEn: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang

50770.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
50770.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a limited time request to slay the Greadmos. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Aim for it! G-rank hunter!
50770.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have prepared a limited-time
request to slay Gureadomosu.
Clear this request and you
earn higher standing than
usual.
Aim for it! G Rank hunter!

21006.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! Hunt one and your skill is quite something! They say a sound burst by its ear can make it weep?
21006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
If you can hunt a Yian Kut-Ku,
your skill is quite something!
They say making a sound by its
ear can even make it shed tears?

63087.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
63087.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63087.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

61065.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
61065.description: This is the final quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from carving or clear rewards.
61065.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Target monster materials
cannot be obtained from
carving or clear rewards.

26314.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26314.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26314.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

63276.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Pariapuria. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63276.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are
seeking hunters to slay an
exceptionally powerful
Pariapuria.
Should you hunt it with skill,
we shall issue more Proofs of
Slay than usual!

23549.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23549.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

55662.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55662.descriptionEn:
Hunters who would master
the Gunlance, face the
Baruragaru of the New Great
Arena and show the skill
you have tempered!
Hunt it well and you shall
earn a reward far beyond
what your daily efforts
bring you.

60644.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
60644.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kamu Orgaron! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60644.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Kam Orugaron!
To hunt a monster all alone,
what spirit! Bravo! Overcome
yourself and take a top rank!
This time it is Origin weapons
only!

54997.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
54997.description: There has been a sighting of Teostra in the volcano. It appears to unleash attacks unlike those confirmed before. We have decided to entrust the survey only to G-rank hunters of proven skill, so G-rank hunters, please take on the investigation.
54997.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a Teostra
sighted in the Volcano.
It seems to unleash attacks
different from those confirmed
before.
The survey will be entrusted
only to G Rank hunters of
proven skill, so G Rank hunters
are asked to take it on.

1010.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
1010.description: The Gypceros seems to have appeared in the jungle!? And word is it is a purplish subspecies! In the jungle this season the small monsters should be less of a nuisance, so it should be a chance! Do not forget antidote items!
1010.descriptionEn:
A Gypceros, the Poison Bird,
has shown up in the Jungle!?
And they say it is the purple-
tinted subspecies! In this
season the Jungle has few
small monsters, so it is your
chance! Do not forget antidotes!

50381.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50381.description: Lately, when transporting goods in the jungle, we have often been attacked by monsters. I want it dealt with before great damage is done. The goods being transported are armor materials for rookie hunters like you. If you complete the request, I will share a little with you.
50381.descriptionEn:
Lately, whenever we haul supplies
through the Jungle, monsters
attack us so often.
Before real damage is done,
I want it dealt with.
What we carry is equipment
material for rookie hunters
like you. If you clear this
request, I'll share a little
with you.

61846.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. Deliver a precious pot and, in return, I will draw up blueprints for a new reel and present them to you. Not an ordinary reel, of course.
61846.descriptionEn:
"Fishing".
It is a solitary hunt, facing the
fish in silence.
If you deliver a valuable pot to
me, I will make you a blueprint
for a new reel as thanks. Of
course, it is no ordinary reel.

61343.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61343.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62313.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Hi-Metal L blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62313.descriptionEn:
If you listen to nature's
voice, you may gain ideas
beyond human wit.
This request will help you
upgrade Hi-Metal L blademaster
armor. May your hunting life
remain rich and full
forever.

63085.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63085.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
63085.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

50122.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト１匹の納品
50122.description: I wish to tell a friend far away that summer has come. So, if I may ask, would you gather the items that colour the summer? It is a sudden request, so I have arranged the clothing on this side. Please, I ask your help.
50122.descriptionEn:
I wish to tell a friend far
away that summer has come.
So, if I may ask a favor,
would you gather items that
color the summer?
It is a sudden request, so we
have prepared your outfit.
Please, I ask for your help.

63380.description: So you're the hunter taking my request. That's a help. First, I want you to gather eggs, which go into every kind of sweet. For the sake of everyone trying to convey their feelings through my sweets, I want to make them with care from the ingredients up. Fresh eggs, please!
63380.descriptionEn:
So you are the hunter taking
the job. That helps a lot.
First, I want you to gather
eggs, which every sweet uses.
For everyone trying to convey
their feelings with my sweets,
I want to make candy that is
picky about its ingredients.
Fresh eggs, please!

62315.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
62315.description: Lately boars have been multiplying in great numbers in the Snowy Mountains, and injuries keep piling up. The Hunters Guild is seeking people to wipe out this herd led by a Bulldrome. The situation is serious, so the reward includes a rare material some hunters drool over.
62315.descriptionEn:
Lately boars have swarmed the
Snowy Mountains and injuries
keep piling up. The Hunters
Guild is seeking people to wipe
out the herd led by this
≪Bulldrome≫. The situation is
grave, so the reward is rare
material that some hunters
would drool over.

55169.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55169.description: Slaying a Tigrex raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55169.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying Tigrex raises
your standing while letting
you cheaply obtain the
materials needed for a
G Rank decoration.
Please make good use of it.

21076.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21076.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
21076.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!

50478.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50478.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!

50022.description: For hunters who carelessly obtained a Haku Interception Contribution Certificate Yellow from the Harisen Neko. In this request we exchange the certificate for the following materials. Odibatorasu crumbling scale x40, Wyvern shattered claw x40, Pariapuria rotting stone x40.
50022.descriptionEn:
For hunters who happened to
get a ≪Supremacy Yellow
Certificate≫ from Harisen
Neko. This request trades
it for the materials below.
≪Odibatorasu Ruined Scale≫ x40
≪Wyvern Broken Claw≫ x40
≪Devourer Wyvern Rotten Ore≫ x40

40162.description: The Pokaradon of the polar sea is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to slay one. We split the reward.
40162.descriptionEn:
The Frozen Sea Beast Pokara
that lives in this Polar Sea
sometimes carries incredible
treasure, or so they say.
If it is true, I would love
for you to slay it for us.
We split the reward.

50352.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50352.description: This is sudden, but I want your help with an ecological survey of Nono Orugaron. If possible I would also like parts broken during this survey. I am sorry for the many requests, but for the sake of future research I would be most grateful.
50352.descriptionEn:
This is sudden, but I want
your help surveying the
ecology of Non Orugaron.
For this survey, I would like
part breaks too if possible.
Sorry for all the requests,
but for future research,
please lend a hand.

63027.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
63027.description: This is the practice qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
63027.descriptionEn:
This is the practice qualifying quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from the clear reward.

26103.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

22071.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
22071.description: The survey team sent to the volcano reports seeing a gigantic shadow. The shadow had great horns and a silhouette like an oni, they say. We continue to ask hunters to investigate.
22071.descriptionEn:
The survey team sent to the
Volcano reports sighting a
giant shadow.
The shadow had great horns
and a silhouette like an
ogre, they say.
Once again, we ask you
hunters to investigate.

54352.description: We will continue the investigation of the Hyujikiki that appeared in the highlands. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54352.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of the
Hyujikiki that appeared in
the Highlands. Breaking its
parts is not required, but
we'd be glad if you did!
Hunters, please lend us your
aid!

53013.description: This year too I believe many loves were fulfilled, and there were loves that went unanswered. For all of you I have prepared a quest into which you can throw every one of those feelings: hope, expectation, jealousy, despair. Slay the Gypceros and take your next step!
53013.descriptionEn:
This year many loves were
fulfilled, and some were not.
For all of you, we have made
a quest where you can hurl
every feeling you hold:
expectation, hope, envy,
despair, all of it.
Slay the Gypceros and take
your next step!

62429.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62429.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the devouring wyvern Pariapuria together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62429.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, why not hunt the
Devouring Wyvern Pariapuria
alongside a hunter who has
risen to hold a Secret Art
tome? Learn its unorthodox
moves, and clear the request
together for extra rewards!

61201.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

62263.description: It was supposed to end with the last request, but there seems to have been a little more to it. Long ago I found a stone of extreme heat, but I could not carry the ore. Yet I learned that cooling it with that water makes it transportable. So would you deliver a large quantity once more?
62263.descriptionEn:
I thought the last request ended
it, but there seems to be a
little more. Long ago we found
a stone of extreme heat, but we
could not carry that ore.
Yet once cooled by that water,
we learned it could be moved.
So would you deliver a large
amount just one more time?

22021.description: A request recommended for hunters who have come into their own, allowing the production and upgrading of the Stroma Series, Hardcore Armor. Hunt the Baruragaru and you will obtain the materials to craft or upgrade 1 piece of the Stroma Series.
22021.descriptionEn:
This request is recommended
for hunters who have grown
truly skilled.
It lets you forge and upgrade
the Stroma Series, Hardcore
Armor.
Hunt Baruragaru to obtain the
materials to forge and upgrade
one piece of the Stroma Series.

61572.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61572.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

55835.description: The Variant Species Gravios has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55835.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gravios≫ has
become ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
As it stands this is very dangerous.
Make thorough preparations
before you survey it.

61770.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61770.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

202.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
202.description: In this arena, monster and hunter face off one on one! This time your opponent is a Yian Kut-Ku. Kut-Ku or not, it is still a wyvern! Do not let your guard down!
202.descriptionEn:
In this Arena you will face
a monster one on one, fair
and square!
This time your opponent is
Yian Kut-Ku. Kut-Ku or not,
it is a wyvern! Do not relax!

60131.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60131.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60131.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.

55701.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Hypnocatrice through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Great Sword, Hammer, Hunting Horn, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55701.descriptionEn:
From forging one Supremacy
weapon of Supremacy
Hypnocatrice, you obtain the
materials for its first
upgrade and Gz worth of Porta
Card Sakura. Weapon types:
Sword and Shield, Great Sword,
Hammer, Hunting Horn, Gunlance
or Switch Axe. Use it well!

54459.description: The golden dragon we encountered before has, as a result of the survey, been identified as the Gold Dust Dragon, Garuba Daora. Sightings are extremely few, and it is uncertain whether we will meet it on this voyage, but to ensure safety we ask a G-rank hunter to accompany us.
54459.descriptionEn:
It is the golden dragon we met
before. Our survey showed it to
be the Gold Dust Dragon,
≪Garuba Daora≫.
Sightings are extremely few, so
we may not meet it on this
route, but to ensure safety we
ask G Rank hunters to
accompany us.

26340.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26340.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26340.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54604.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Rathian and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54604.descriptionEn:
The time to show your skill
as a hunter has come!
Hunt the Rathian
with style.
Clear the quest and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!

60574.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
60574.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Anorupatisu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60574.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Anorupatisu!
Team up with your Guild mates
and complete the objective.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so aim for the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only
this time! Choose with care!

23405.description: Two Lavasioth have appeared in the G Rank Volcano! I'd love to survey their ecology, so while you slay them, bring back something we can use as a sample. If by chance you get any rare material, it is yours.
23405.descriptionEn:
Two ≪Volganos≫ have appeared
in the G Rank Volcano!
I'd love to survey their
ecology, so while you slay them,
bring back something we can
use as a sample.
If by chance you get any rare
material, it is yours.

62531.description: You love Gunlance, right? Of course you do? Let me tell you something good. No need to hold back! A rare Rathalos has been sighted at the tower, and my hunch says its materials can make an amazing Gunlance. Go once with a Gunlance!
62531.descriptionEn:
You love the Gunlance,
right? Of course you do!
Want me to tell you something
good? No need to hold back!
See, a rare Rathalos was
sighted at the Tower, and my
gut says its parts can forge
a killer Gunlance. Come on,
take your Gunlance out once!

61347.description: 1 pair of Rathalos was sighted in the Canyon. For an ecological survey, please hunt both. We will take most of the Rathalos materials, but we will pay out some unneeded parts and Canyon specialties as a reward.
61347.descriptionEn:
A pair of Rathalos was sighted
in the Canyon. To survey their
ecology, please hunt both.
