We will take most of the
Rathalos materials, but we'll
offer some unneeded parts and
Canyon specialties as
your reward.

21184.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21184.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21184.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50826.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50826.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

55875.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55875.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55875.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

26617.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26617.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

50975.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50975.description: Teostra has been confirmed rampaging in the swamp. It will be dangerous in various ways, but please investigate. The reward is precious decoration materials.
50975.descriptionEn:
Teostra has been confirmed to be
running wild in the Swamp.
It will be dangerous in many ways,
but please carry out a survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55901.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55901.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55901.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

61864.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
61864.description: Do you know the Wedding Icicle? It is an icicle full of romance, formed over a time so long that a man and woman could be joined, have children, and a whole generation pass. Few know of it and it is precious, but if you complete my request I can share a little with you.
61864.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Wedding
Icicle? A man and woman wed,
a child is born, and over the
long years of a generation
it forms, a truly romantic
icicle. Few know of it and
it is precious, but do my
request and I will share some.

26033.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26033.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26033.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

55375.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
55375.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who wish to craft Nargacuga armor! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade Transcendent armor, so please take it on!
55375.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special quest
for hunters who want armor from
the Swift Wyvern ≪Nargacuga≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain
the materials needed to upgrade
Transcendence Armor, so please
give it a try!

21942.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
21942.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Dyuragaua. I am counting on you!
21942.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Word is you've hit HR22.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay's a full set of
weapon materials.
Easy job, really—just run
out there and slay a Duramboros
for me and we're square.
I'm counting on you!

21959.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Hypnocatrice in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21959.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have prepared a request to
hunt a Hypnocatrice in the
New Great Arena.
Clear it and you gain higher
standing than usual.
Train efficiently and aim
for even greater heights.

28066.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
28066.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28066.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!

54201.description: The survey of the extreme cold sea is progressing smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of the materials found can be used for producing and upgrading arms, they say. Many G-rank hunters, who often go to dangerous lands, may be interested.
54201.descriptionEn:
The Polar Sea survey proceeds
well, and many new materials
have been found. Most of them
can be used to forge and
upgrade gear, they say.
Among G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
many may well be
interested.

40213.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
40213.description: A monster has appeared at the interception base! I need you to hunt it at once. Let me explain the plan. This time we have prepared more supplies than usual. Use them in the hunt. The basis for this plan? A woman's intuition!
40213.descriptionEn:
A monster has appeared at the
Base! I need you to slay it
right away.
Let me explain the operation.
This time we've prepared
extra supplies.
Use them in the hunt.

My basis for this plan?
A woman's intuition!

62866.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62866.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!

21719.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Soul (Beginning) x８５, Great Sword Soul (Middle) x１９５, Great Sword Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Great Sword Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21719.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Great Sword Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Great Sword Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Great Sword Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

53007.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
53007.description: While tidying the warehouse I found a book on making gear written in letters I cannot read, and I made a trial piece to see. Please use it and tell me what you think. In return I will share a little of the materials for the trial piece, so do me the favour.
53007.descriptionEn:
While tidying the warehouse I
found a book on forging gear
written in unreadable script,
and made a trial piece.
I'd love you to use it and tell
me what you think. In return
I'll share some of the trial's
forging materials, so please.

63332.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an Armorer's Soul: Wild. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63332.descriptionEn:
For members of a winning
Hunter Festival Guild only, we
have prepared a quest that is
guaranteed to yield the Smith's
Soul [Rough]. When accepting
or joining, bring a Festival Proof.

55766.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55766.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55766.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

63009.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63009.description: The Secret Certificate [Swift] is proof that a hunter holding a Secret Scroll has reached a certain level of skill. This time's examiner is the Guild's foremost authority, renowned for his eye, so if you meet his standards you can be sure of receiving a large number of Secret Certificates [Swift]. Do not miss this rare chance.
63009.descriptionEn:
≪Secret Proof [Swift]≫
is proof that a scroll-
holding hunter has reached
a certain level of skill.
Our examiner this time is
the Guild's foremost eye,
so if you satisfy him, he
will surely issue many
≪Secret Proof [Swift]≫.
Do not miss this rare chance.

58101.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58101.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58101.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

63252.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
63252.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

54886.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54886.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

21251.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21251.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

23461.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Bow Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Bow Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23461.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Bow Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Bow Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Bow Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

26184.description: It seems a great many Gabras have gathered at the tower. They are said to be an omen of calamity, so the Guild cannot ignore it either. Slay 8 Gabras and confirm the situation.
26184.descriptionEn:
It seems a great many Remobra
have gathered at the tower.
They are said to herald disaster,
so the Guild cannot simply
ignore them.
Slay 8 Remobra and check on
the situation for us.

63010.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63010.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63010.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

21910.description: A request recommended for hunters who reached HR100, letting you forge and upgrade the Hardcore Armor "Stroma Series." Hunt a Baruragaru to obtain forge and upgrade materials for one "Stroma Series" piece.
21910.descriptionEn:
A request recommended for
hunters who reached HR100,
letting you forge and upgrade
the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
"Stroma Series."
Hunt a Baruragaru to obtain
forge and upgrade materials
for one "Stroma Series"
piece.

51097.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51097.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
51097.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the horns of the
Black Diablos also grants
you special ingredients.

21611.description: Do you know the orb called Moonwhite Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21611.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere called
Moonwhite Sphere?
Its material is essential to
forging a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I shall give you a precious
decoration material.

62005.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Plesioth. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62005.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest to slay
a ≪Plesioth≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
fellow hunters?

23422.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
23422.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Toa Tesukatora, the Frozen King Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23422.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from Toa Tesukatora,
the Freezing King Wyvern.
To accept the quest,
a Superia Ticket is
required.
If the quest fails, the
Superia Ticket is consumed,
so please take care.

26170.description: I ask you to procure materials for the medicine I am researching now. Once you complete every last must-order, I will give you the Potion materials I have spare! Combine as much as you like!
26170.descriptionEn:
Please gather materials for the
medicine I'm researching now.
Once you clear every Must
Order, I'll give you the
≪Potion≫ materials I have
left over!
Mix as much as you
like!

26018.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
26018.description: So a subspecies of the already rare Monoblos has appeared, has it. To go beyond proving yourself first-rate and make your name ring out, you must hunt it alone! Prepare yourself and take up the hunt!
26018.descriptionEn:
A white one-horned wyvern, no
less: a Monoblos subspecies, a
truly rare sight, has appeared.
To go beyond proving yourself
first-rate and make your name
resound, you must "hunt it
alone". Steel yourself and go!

55982.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の討伐
55982.description: So you mean to take on a job from a Dark Cat Pack executive? An executive's job is a cut above the rest. Slack off and you will be crying. Complete it and I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Seal, Blue.
55982.descriptionEn:
You feel like taking on a request
from a Dark Cat Gang exec, nya?
An exec's request is a cut or
two above the rest, nya.
Slack off and you'll be crying, nya.
Clear it and I might even give
you a ≪Dark Cat Gang Seal: Blue≫,
nya.

54296.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
54296.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54296.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

26556.description: Hunting in an untrodden land, that is surely the true thrill of the hunter. You understand? So, a hunting request in the Highlands. The purpose is an ecological survey, so finish it quickly while no big game is about.
26556.descriptionEn:
Hunting in untrodden lands, that is
the true thrill of being a hunter.
You know what I mean?
So, here is a hunting request for
the ≪Highlands≫. The goal is an
ecology survey, so finish it quickly
while nothing big is around.

62427.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the snow lion Blangonga together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62427.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, why not hunt the
Snow Lion Blangonga alongside
a hunter who has risen to
hold a Secret Art tome?
Learn its unorthodox moves,
and clear the request with
them for extra rewards!

54784.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54784.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

63146.description: I want to see a new side of Guku. To that end I am making an original pattern, and could you model for it? If you help, I will share some of the finished pattern.
63146.descriptionEn:
I want to see a new side
of the Gook. So I plan to
make an original pattern,
and I was wondering if you
could model for it.
If you help me, I will
share a little of the
finished pattern with you.

60065.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61254.description: In celebration of the reborn Mezepolta Plaza, feasts are being held all over. I understand the festive mood, but at this rate the plaza will run out of food in no time. Before that happens, hurry and gather ingredients! There is no time left!
61254.descriptionEn:
To celebrate the reborn
Mezepolta Plaza, there are
feasts everywhere.
I get the festive mood, but
at this rate the food will
vanish from the plaza in no
time. Before that happens,
hurry and gather ingredients!
There is no time left!

61324.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
61324.description: A suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress at tremendous speed! At once, make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon! If our strength is not enough, breaking that giant leg alone will do.
61324.descriptionEn:
A suspicious dragon is approaching
the Fortress at tremendous speed!
At once, make use of the Fortress's
interceptor weapons and repel the
mysterious giant dragon!
If your strength is not enough, then
at least break those giant legs
for us.

60326.objectiveJp: 銀火竜の尻尾１個の納品
60326.description: To set foot in the closed secret region, a qualification is required. That qualification is none other than the Secret Area Set. He who opens the gates of heaven and takes that qualification in hand will surely find fortune deep within the closed secret region...
60326.descriptionEn:
To set foot in the closed hidden
area, one needs a qualification.
That qualification is none other
than the ≪Secret Area Set≫.
Those who open the gates of
heaven and gain that right shall
find fortune deep in the closed
hidden area...

26014.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
26014.description: The king of the skies, Rathalos, is said to make its lair in the mysterious hunting ground, the Ancient Tower. We are seeking brave hunters to confirm whether that is true! Your opponent this time is the Azure King. Do not let your guard down until he bows to the ground!
26014.descriptionEn:
The King of the Skies ≪Rathalos≫
is said to nest in the enigmatic
hunting ground ≪Ancient Tower≫.
We seek brave hunters to prove
whether that is true!
Your foe this time is the
≪Azure King≫. Never let your
guard down until he kneels!

50994.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50994.descriptionEn:
In this quest we yield the
materials needed to FX-upgrade
Secret Art Armor (blademaster),
excluding weapon souls.
The yield covers five pieces.
To accept the quest, a
10th Anniversary Ticket is
required, so please note.

23250.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

54418.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54418.description: A surveyor on site reports that Akura Jebia suddenly emerged from underground. The area is said to be calm land where herbivores graze, but if this continues the guild's survey work cannot proceed. We ask you to slay the Akura Jebia!
54418.descriptionEn:
Local surveyors report that
Akura Jebia suddenly
emerged from underground.
The area is said to be calm
land where herbivores graze,
but as things stand the
Guild's survey work cannot
proceed.
Please, we ask you to slay
the Akura Vashimu!

60645.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Plesioth. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60645.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Plesioth!
Team up with your Guild mates
and complete the objective.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time it is Origin weapons
only!

60234.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gasurabazura! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60234.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Gasurabazura!
To hunt a monster all alone,
what spirit! Bravo! Overcome
yourself and take a top rank!

62108.description: As for the Great Hunt on Solitude Island, that gigantic monster called Raviente seems to lie silent on one of the islands. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so the survey will be brief, but please join.
62108.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Great Hunt on
the ≪Isolated Island≫: the
colossal monster known as
the ≪Raviente≫ appears to
lie silent on one island.
We are forming a survey
team open only to hunters
who took part, so please do
join us for a short survey.

21539.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21539.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21539.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

62990.description: Reports are coming one after another that an unidentified monster is on the rampage around Mezeporta. The situation is still tense, with even skilled hunters who set out being caught up in it. To save us from this crisis we are recruiting hunters confident in their skill.
62990.descriptionEn:
Reports keep coming in of an
unidentified monster on a rampage
around Mezeporta.
Ace hunters who went out to hunt
have been caught up in it, and
the situation is still tense.
To save us from this crisis we
seek hunters sure of
their skill.

26461.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

26220.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

26514.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
26514.description: Monsters vary as individuals. The Khezu is a particularly special case among them, so this sort of individual is comparatively easy to come across... Hunters who cannot quite follow all this, well, hunt one anyway and you will have something to talk about.
26514.descriptionEn:
Monsters differ one from another.
Khezu are an especially peculiar
lot even among them, so
individuals like this turn up
rather often...
Hunters who can't follow all
this talk, well, just hunt one
for the sake of a story.

21348.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21348.description: The other day, while gathering in the Forest and Hills, I was set upon by 2 Rathalos. I escaped with my life, but I cannot leave that place to them as their territory. Will you not rid us of them? For your trouble, take this Sturdy Jawbone.
21348.descriptionEn:
The other day, while gathering in
the Forest and Hills, two
≪Rathalos≫ attacked me.
I somehow kept my life, but I
cannot leave the Forest and Hills
to those beasts' territory.
Won't you rid us of them?
In thanks, I'll give you this
≪Sturdy Jawbone≫.

61853.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
61853.description: The Barbarian Wyvern newly confirmed in the highlands. It is a dangerous flying wyvern to begin with, but among them an individual of outstanding strength was confirmed the other day. It will be a very dangerous request requiring proof of skill, but please investigate and hunt it!
61853.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gurenzeburu≫ has been newly
confirmed in the Highlands.
Flying wyverns are dangerous
already, but an exceptionally
powerful individual was sighted
the other day. This is a very
dangerous request that proves
your skill, but please take on
the survey and the hunt!

62703.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐

21077.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21077.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
21077.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!

26623.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26623.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

11006.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
11006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! Hunt one and your skill is quite something! They say a sound burst by its ear can make it weep?
11006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
If you can hunt a Yian Kut-Ku,
your skill is quite something!
They say making a sound by its
ear can even make it shed tears?

40135.description: The Rathian of this forest is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40135.descriptionEn:
The Rathian living in this
Great Forest sometimes carries
incredible treasure, or so
they say.
If it is true, I would love
for you to hunt it for us.
We split the reward.

55066.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55066.description: It seems you could not fully upgrade the Kushala Daora gear. I have prepared a fine quest for a hunter like you. The number you can accept per day is limited, but it should help. I wish you success.
55066.descriptionEn:
It seems you could not fully
upgrade your Kushala Daora
gear. For a hunter like you,
I have prepared a fine quest.
There is a daily limit on
how often you can take it,
but it will help. Good luck!

54554.description: A Pink Rathian has appeared in the Jungle. It unleashes attacks unlike any before and is said to be giving hunters a great deal of trouble. To keep the damage from spreading further, we ask for your help in hunting it.
54554.descriptionEn:
A Pink Rathian has appeared in
the Jungle. It reportedly unleashes
attacks unlike anything seen before,
and is causing great trouble.
To keep the damage from spreading
any further, we ask for your help
in hunting it.

55538.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
55538.description: The Storm Dragon, Amatsu, has appeared in the mountain range called the sacred peaks. The storm is so powerful it defies imagination, and the surveyors cannot even approach. Considering the damage to the surroundings, a response is needed as soon as possible. Head out to hunt it at once.
55538.descriptionEn:
In the mountain range called the
Sacred Peak, the Storm Dragon
≪Amatsu≫ has appeared.
Its storms are beyond imagining,
and our surveyors cannot even
approach. Given the harm to
surroundings, a response is
needed at once.
Head out to slay it immediately.

50340.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50340.description: The season of love ends again this year. How about polishing yourself in preparation for what comes next? A hunter who masters G-rank weapons looks truly splendid.
50340.descriptionEn:
The season of love ends
again this year.
Why not polish yourself
for what comes next?
A hunter who wields G Rank
weapons with mastery looks
ever so wonderful, you know.

53035.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
53035.description: Rumor says that to pray for a boy's success in life, one should hunt a Lavasioth at this time of year! I asked the Guild, and there happens to be a weak Lavasioth in the Volcano! Hunter, hunt one for my child's sake!
53035.descriptionEn:
Word has it that to pray for
a boy's success in life,
hunting a Volganos this time
of year is the thing to do!
I asked the Guild, and sure
enough there is a weak
Volganos in the Volcano!
Hunter, go hunt one for
my boy's sake!

23277.description: A researcher who was exploring the swamp has been carried back to the guild in critical condition. According to the observation notes he left behind, Iodrome and Ioprey have been on the decline in the swamp lately. We would like a confident hunter to investigate and confirm whether this is true.
23277.descriptionEn:
A surveyor exploring the Swamp
was carried to the Guild in
critical condition. From the
notes left by the others, the
Gendrome and Genprey there
seem to be dwindling.
So we ask skilled hunters to
survey and confirm the truth
of it.

50766.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Tenran armor. By repeatedly driving off Arganos and Golganos, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
50766.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly repelling
Arganos and Gorganos, you
can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade
"Stroma FX Series"
≪Supremacy≫ armor to Lv7.

55245.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55245.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

60208.description: In the Guild's history there was a hunter said to have the strongest arm. This Guild gives an incentive award to hunters who slay one on one the fish wyvern that drove that hunter into retirement, the Plesioth. Please join us.
60208.descriptionEn:
In the history of the Guild there was
a hunter praised as the strongest of
all, a mighty arm.
Our Guild awards a prize to any
hunter who slays one on one the
Plesioth, the fish wyvern species that
drove that hunter into retirement.
Please join us enthusiastically.

53205.description: I have been thinking and thinking about what to give back for White Day, and I really do think candy is best! She will surely be pleased! Hunt properly, get the candy, and give it to that cute girl!
53205.descriptionEn:
I kept thinking about what
to give for White Day,
and I really think candy
is the way to go!
She will be happy, I am sure!
Hunt hard,
get the candy,
and give it to that
cute girl!

26464.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
26464.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
26464.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!

61848.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
61848.description: I give you a trial! Hunt the Kut-Ku that has been appearing in the swamp lately! There may be more than one, so do not be careless! If you have strength left, gathering raw Grey Crystal would be good too. I wish you success!
61848.descriptionEn:
I hereby give you a trial!
Lately a Yian Kut-Ku has been
prowling the Swamp. Hunt it!
There may be more than one,
so do not let your guard down!
If you have strength to spare,
gather Ash Crystals too.
I wish you good fortune!

23392.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
23392.description: Please hunt the Shining Thunder Bird that appeared in the highlands. It was long thought harmless, but having expanded its territory near human settlements it has become very aggressive. According to the last sighting, it seems to prefer moving through sunlit places.
23392.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the
≪Shining Thunder Bird≫
that appeared in the Highlands.
It was long thought harmless,
but as it spread its territory
near settlements it has grown
very aggressive.
The last sighting suggests
it prefers sunny spots.

56072.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56072.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

55914.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55914.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Anorupatisu through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Lance, Gunlance, Tonfa, or Magnet Spike. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55914.descriptionEn:
From forging one Supremacy
weapon of Supremacy
Anorupatisu, you obtain the
materials for its first
upgrade and Gz worth of Porta
Card Sakura. Weapon types:
Dual Blades, Long Sword,
Hunting Horn, Lance, Gunlance,
Tonfa or Magnet Spike.
Use it on any weapon you like!

23207.description: Lately a Congalala has taken up residence near the house I serve, and a terrible stench now drifts from it. It would be serious if it harmed the young lady resting in her room. Could you drive off that source of the stench?
23207.descriptionEn:
Lately a Congalala has taken
up residence near the house I
serve, and a dreadful stench
has begun to drift over.
It would be terrible if it
harmed the young lady resting
in her room. Could you drive
off that source of the
stench for us?

50193.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
50193.description: It is I! The Instructor!! A survey request for you hunters, and the target is the Baruragaru! But throwing you at it suddenly would be harsh, so I have prepared a quest perfect for understanding its behavior. First, accept this one! Now go, hunters!
50193.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!!
A survey request for you
hunters: the target is
Baruragaru!
But suddenly facing it would
be harsh, so I prepared a
quest perfect for learning
how it moves. Take this first!
Now go, hunters!

54909.description: This quest yields upgrade materials and the like for 1 part of the Vulcan series, G-rank Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54909.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one part of
the ≪G Rank Armor≫
Vulcan Series, and more.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
Note that if the quest fails,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will
be consumed, so please
keep that in mind.

26364.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26364.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

26080.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26080.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26080.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

21067.description: The insects that live in the hunting grounds are used in a wide range of ways: crafting and upgrading weapons and armor, mixing items, and more. When you find a place where insects are flitting about, try catching them with a Bug Net!
21067.descriptionEn:
The bugs living in hunting grounds
are used for many things: forging
and upgrading weapons and armor,
and mixing items.
When you find a spot where bugs
flutter about, try catching them
with a ≪Bug Net≫!

21181.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
21181.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
21181.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

56131.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is the Zinogre that Roars to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin, needed to accept the next request!
56131.descriptionEn:
Reports keep coming in of
sightings of the monsters
named Acme, a great threat.
Deeming it an emergency, we
ask for swift slaying of each.
This time: Acme Roaring Zinogre.
As proof of the slay, I give
you the special coin needed
to accept the next request!

50605.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１０匹の討伐
50605.description: This season has come again this year. The season when the Shakalaka run wild wherever they please! Cunning as they are, lately they have taken to hiding. I have supplied the cookies they love. Eat these at the oasis, lure them out and set about slaying them!
50605.descriptionEn:
This time of year has come
again. The season when the
Grimalkyne run wild everywhere!
Crafty as they are, lately
they have taken to hiding.
So I have supplied cookies,
their favorite food. Eat them
at the Oasis to lure them out,
then set about slaying them!

54474.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54474.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

21718.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Soul (Beginning) x８５, Dual Blades Soul (Middle) x１９５, Dual Blades Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Dual Blades Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21718.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Dual Blades Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Dual Blades Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Dual Blades Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Dual Blades Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

21608.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Iron Black Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21608.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere called
Ironblack Sphere?
Its material is essential to
forging a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I shall give you a precious
decoration material.

22003.description: We are looking for people to slay 8 Ioprey! Compared with Velociprey and Genprey, Ioprey has a higher attack per hit, so please be careful!
22003.descriptionEn:
Looking for hunters to slay
8 ≪Ioprey≫!
Compared to Velociprey or
Genprey, each hit from an
Ioprey hurts more. Beware!

60108.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟

62062.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62062.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
62062.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

26597.description: In the confusion of running into a monster, I left behind some cute eggs, flying wyvern eggs and Gook eggs among them! Please hurry and retrieve them. If a Basarios has them, I think it will let the egg go if you startle it while it is mimicking or sleeping.
26597.descriptionEn:
When I ran into a monster,
I left behind the cute eggs
of wyverns and Gooks and
the like! Please hurry and
fetch them back.
If a Basarios has one,
startle it while it mimics
or sleeps, and it should
let go of the egg.

54974.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54974.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Siluk GX Series. Slay Akura Jebia and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
54974.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
for upgrading the Siluk GX
Series.
Slay Akura Jebia and you
obtain the upgrade materials
for one piece.
Please make good use of it!

50835.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50835.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

55509.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55509.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

55254.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟

55975.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55975.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55975.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

62364.description: Variant Gypceros and Variant Congalala seem to be on a rampage in the Jungle. The Guild has prepared a special emblem as a reward, so please hunt them at once.
62364.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, Variants of both
Gypceros and Congalala seem to
be on the rampage.
The Guild has prepared a special
emblem as a reward.
Please hunt them at once, and
without any delay.

62875.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
62875.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62875.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

62305.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

60921.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐

62526.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62526.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62526.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

61236.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61236.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

61123.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61123.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61123.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

22163.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
22163.description: This is a request limited to those who hold a Secret Scroll. You can reliably obtain 10 each of 8 kinds of SR Ingredients. It is recommended for those who want to try the effect once, or who want to steadily collect them in preparation for a crucial hunt.
22163.descriptionEn:
This request is limited to
holders of a Secret Art tome.
You are guaranteed to obtain
10 SR Ingredients of 8 kinds.
Recommended for those who
want to try their effect, or
to quietly stock up for the
hunt that matters most.

23429.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
23429.description: A surveyor who went to the Jungle reported sighting the steel dragon. Its attacks, delivered with the power of wind, are reported to be very dangerous. Prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23429.descriptionEn:
Surveyors who went to the Jungle
reported a sighting of the
≪Kushala Daora≫.
Its attacks, unleashed with the
power of wind, are said to be
very dangerous.
Prepare well before you
survey it.

55537.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章５個の納品
55537.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Tangus D Series, the layered armor of the Tangus G Series. Tangus Release Ticket D x5.
55537.descriptionEn:
By clearing this request you can
obtain the layered unlock tickets
for the ≪Tangus D Series≫,
the layered look of the
≪Tangus G Series≫.
- Tangus Unlock Ticket D x5

23194.description: I was surveying the materials that can be gathered on Tide Island when I ran into a pack of Velociprey. I got away somehow, but I dropped my baggage on the way. Drive the beasts off and recover my luggage. If you have the room, I would also like the ore I was surveying delivered.
23194.descriptionEn:
I was surveying the materials
that can be gathered on Tidal
Island, and I ran into a pack
of Velociprey. I escaped,
barely, but I dropped my
luggage. Drive them off and
recover my bags.
If you have time, I would also
like the ore I am studying.

54152.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54152.description: We are recruiting hunters to take on the monster whose roar echoes across the desert! If the hunt proves too difficult, you may slay Apceros instead and return.
54152.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters
to hunt the owner of the roar
that echoes across the Desert!
If hunting it is too hard,
you may slay Apceros and
return home instead.

21197.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21197.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21197.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

51089.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51089.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the dorsal fin of a Lavasioth will also grant a special ingredient.
51089.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Volganos's dorsal fin,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.

21487.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
21487.description: We have now identified the monster approaching the desert. It is Rukodiora, an Elder Dragon with shining wings. It is closing on the desert at tremendous speed. Head for the desert at once and slay it!
21487.descriptionEn:
We have determined what the monster
that is currently flying toward the
Desert actually is.
It is the Elder Dragon species with
shining wings, ≪Rukodiora≫.
It is closing on the Desert at
fierce speed.
Head for the Desert at once
and slay it!

61524.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・１を１０個納品

62706.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
62706.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62706.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

61573.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
61573.description: A job from a certain Wyverian. A friend they miss is traveling, and the route passes through the swamp, but two monsters frighten them too much to go on. They are said to be very savage, so hunt them carefully!
61573.descriptionEn:
This is a request from one of
the beastmen. He misses a
friend and is on a journey.
The road takes him through
the Swamp, but two monsters
terrify him and block the way.
They are said to be vicious,
so hunt them with care!

26585.description: Congratulations on reaching HR800! Deliver the Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26585.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR800! Deliver the Map
on your own, clear the quest,
and claim
your reward!

54438.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the horns of Espinas, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54438.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest to raise awareness
and promote them further.
Break the Espinas' horn and
we shall grant you a special
ingredient as well.

25001.objectiveJp: 相手モンスターの討伐
25001.description: You can win by slaying the opposing team's monster! In the Great Arena of this Great Tournament, various items that could turn the tables lie sleeping in the ground. Aim for the opposing monster or aim for the items, it is up to you!
25001.descriptionEn:
Slay the opposing team's
monster and you win!
In the Great Arena of this
tournament, all sorts of items
that can turn the tide lie on
the ground. Go for the enemy
monster or go for the items -
the choice is yours!

55355.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55355.description: A Tigrex with greatly developed claws has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Tigrex seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55355.descriptionEn:
A ≪Tigrex≫ with greatly
developed claws has appeared.
The Guild classifies this one
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
overgrown parts, and surveys it.
Reports say it is more dangerous
than any Tigrex so far.
Please take care in your
survey.

21677.objectiveJp: 氷狐竜の上鱗３個の納品
21677.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Ice Fox Wyvern's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21677.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon but
I'm short on materials! At this
rate I can't go hunting. Trade
me the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern Fine
Scale≫ you have for this
≪Paw Pad Medal≫! Please!

50517.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
50517.description: During a test flight over Mezeporuta, we encountered a golden dragon. Gold dust swirled on deck and visibility was poor, so we could not observe it. What may happen is impossible to predict, but please investigate.
50517.descriptionEn:
During a trial flight of a
large exploration ship over
Mezeporta, we encountered a
golden dragon. Gold dust
swirled over the deck, so
visibility was poor and we
could not observe the target.
We cannot predict what will
happen, but please survey it.

23564.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23564.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

61902.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
61902.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61902.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

61966.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Shogun Ceanataur. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
61966.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!

62271.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62271.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62271.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55064.description: It seems you could not fully upgrade the Chameleos gear. I have prepared a fine quest for a hunter like you. The number you can accept per day is limited, but it should help. I wish you success.
55064.descriptionEn:
It seems you could not fully
upgrade your Chameleos gear.
For a hunter like you, I have
prepared a fine quest.
There is a daily limit on
how often you can take it,
but it will help. Good luck!

21659.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
21659.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21659.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

55250.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55250.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Blitz GX Vest' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55250.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the F Photo
Contest 2016, we have prepared
a quest where you can obtain
the materials to forge and
upgrade the armor worn in it,
the Blitz GX Vest.
Please make use of it.

61862.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟

55870.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward that allow you to craft armor from past festivals. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55870.descriptionEn:
For members of a winning
Hunter Festival Guild only,
we have prepared a special
request and rewards to forge
past festival armor. Bring
Festival Fever when joining.

54410.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54410.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

21265.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
21265.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, at the request of the Guild of the Elder Hall, a superb Diablos has been loosed into the arena! Now, who is the strong one who will wrestle this Diablos down and claim the grand purse of honour?
21265.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
off their skill!
This time, at the request of the
Grand Hall Guild, we've released
a superb Diablos into the Arena!
Now, who among you is strong
enough to pin this Diablos and
claim the glorious fortune!?

54776.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の討伐
54776.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54776.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

26534.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26534.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26534.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

53164.description: It is Miyashita! Play lots of MHF this weekend! [Question 3] The regular event that began with G10.1 is the Songstress Defense Battle. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53164.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here!
Play lots of MHF
this weekend!
[Question 3]
The regular event that began
in G10.1 is
"Songstress Guard Battle."
Think the answer is o (A)?
Then hunters, accept this
quest here!

60116.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１０匹の討伐

21160.description: Among the Violent Wyverns, Abiorugu, confirmed in the swamp, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual seems to have appeared. Because it is very dangerous, this is an investigation and hunting request limited to hunters we approve. Face it fully prepared.
21160.descriptionEn:
Among the Violent Wyverns
≪Abiorugu≫ confirmed in the
Swamp, an extremely ferocious and
powerful individual has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey and hunt is limited to
hunters we approve of. Please
face it fully prepared.

21795.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種２頭の狩猟
21795.description: A black Diablos with a terrifying appearance has been sighted. The sight of it cutting down its prey with a single powerful blow is feared as like the grim reaper. Is there no hunter to stand against this threat to the Desert?
21795.descriptionEn:
A black Diablos with a terrifying
appearance has been sighted.
It cuts down its prey with a
single mighty blow, and is feared
as "the Grim Reaper" itself.
Is there no hunter to face this
threat to the Desert?

21083.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku. The pink hide is its trademark, but this one is reported to be blue. A subspecies, no doubt.
21083.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫.
Speaking of Yian Kut-Ku, pink is
its signature color, but this one
is reported to have a blue body?
It must be a subspecies.

21931.description: Have you heard of the Crabapple Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21931.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere called
Begonia Sphere?
Its material is essential to
forging a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I shall give you a precious
decoration material.

62708.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62708.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

60018.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１頭の討伐
60018.description: The black dragon that was said to be a legend seems to have shown itself at Castle Schrade! In the tale of the Black Dragon legend it is told that the black dragon will bring calamity to the world! Repel it with all your might so that the legend does not become reality!
60018.descriptionEn:
The black dragon that was thought
a legend seems to have shown
itself at ≪Schrade Castle≫! In
the tales of the Black Dragon
legend, it is said to bring
disaster to the world! Repel it
with all your might so that the
legend does not come true!

26497.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Fanged Beast Hardclaw! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26497.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who break many parts of
Variants and rare species. The
main reward is Fanged Beast hard
claws! Deliver the guarantee when
you accept or join, then hunt the
specified monster. Note that the
guarantee cannot be returned once
you depart.

21118.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
21118.description: A red shadow crawling across the snowfield, it seems. It must certainly be a Khezu subspecies. In the Snowy Mountains this season, the Blango gather in herds seeking food. Do not face the Khezu and the Blango at the same time.
21118.descriptionEn:
A red shadow crawling over the snow
has been sighted, it seems. There is
no doubt it is a Khezu Subspecies.
This season, Blango herds swarm the
Snowy Mountains in search of food.
Be careful not to face Khezu and
Blango at the same time.

58075.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58075.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58075.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

63201.description: There is a report of a great bolt of lightning seen in one corner of a volcanic region. As it is far too dangerous, we request a survey limited to skilled hunters. Supplies cannot be provided either, so investigate with the utmost care.
63201.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a massive
lightning strike witnessed
in a corner of a volcanic
region. It is too dangerous,
so we ask only ace hunters
to survey it. No items can
be supplied either, so take
the utmost care in your
survey.

21958.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21958.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１００. So I have a request: how about a full set of materials to produce one piece of SP armor as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Espinas Variant. I am counting on you!
21958.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR100.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay is a full set of
materials for one SP Armor piece.
Easy job, really, just a quick
run out to slay an
Espinas Variant.
I'm counting on you!

61407.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
61407.description: Huh? That thing was red. Everything was red. It is the cold season, the cold season! That was definitely not a dream. You go and prove it! Then I will at least pay for your drinks.
61407.descriptionEn:
Huh?
That thing was red, I tell you.
Everything about it was red.
It's the Cold Season, the Cold Season!
That was absolutely no dream.
Go and prove it for me, will you!
Do that, and I'll at least cover
your drinks.

22091.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
22091.description: Thanks for playing MHF for three whole years! Equip Akam Passway and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude L as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude L you can forge Vol Impact (Hammer).
22091.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for three whole years!
Equip ≪Akam Passway≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude L≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude L≫ you can forge
≪Vol Impact≫ (Hammer).

40062.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
40062.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, the notorious Bulldrome that have raided many villages have been loosed into the arena! Their fury-filled tusks bear down on the hunters!
40062.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show off
their skill!
This time, the infamous great
boars that have raided many
villages have been released into
the Arena!
Fangs full of rage assail the
hunters!

50925.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50925.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50925.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

60037.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, please plant our Guild Flag at the summit.
60037.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species, has no fixed habitat, and
because its numbers are so small is
a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
please plant our ≪Guild Flag≫
at the summit♪

63321.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63321.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63321.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

21158.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
21158.description: An urgent message has arrived from the survey team on Tide Island. They report that an exceptionally powerful Taikun Zamuza has appeared and is raging in the caves. We fear for the team's safety. Head for Tide Island at once and hunt the Taikun Zamuza.
21158.descriptionEn:
An urgent message has come in
from the survey team on Tidal
Island. According to the report,
an extremely powerful Taikun
Zamuza has appeared and is
rampaging in the caves. We fear
for the team's safety. Please
head to Tidal Island at once and
hunt the Taikun Zamuza.

60928.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60928.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21052.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ４頭の討伐
21052.description: We ask you to slay the Jungle's troublemaker, the Bullfango. In the cold season like now they are hungry and short-tempered, so take particular care.
21052.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Jungle
brute, Bullfango. In the
cold season like now they
are hungry and on edge,
so do be especially
careful.

55887.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55887.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

1026.description: The watersides of the desert are highly likely to hide the ancient Piscine Wyvern, Plesioth, lying in wait for prey! You cannot fight it in the water, but there is no problem if you use a Frog to fish it out! Bring the fight onto land!
1026.descriptionEn:
By the waters of the Desert,
the ancient Plesioth is likely
lurking, stalking its prey!
You cannot fight it in water,
but with a Frog Bait you can
reel it in, no problem!
Take the fight onto land!

62750.description: Hunters who always cooperate with the Hunters Guild! Thank you! To express that gratitude, the Guild will present tickets it issues. Naturally, they aren't free. I'll hand them over when you clear this request.
62750.descriptionEn:
Hunters who always lend the
Hunters Guild a hand!
Thank you!
With our gratitude, we shall
present a ticket issued by
the Guild.
Of course, it is not free.
Clear this request and it is yours.

61854.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
61854.description: A wyvern newly discovered in the Snowy Mountains. We have decided to call it the Doragyurosu, and among this already powerful wyvern a particularly sturdy individual has been confirmed. It is a dangerous request and supplies cannot be sent, so only hunters who can prove their skill are asked to hunt it!
61854.descriptionEn:
A Flying Wyvern newly found in
the Snowy Mountains.
We have chosen to call it the
≪Nether Thunder Wyvern≫, but
even among this mighty species,
an especially robust individual
has been confirmed.
It is dangerous and no supplies
can be sent, so prove your skill!

54427.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
54427.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
54427.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.

50651.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50651.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

28065.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
28065.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28065.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

23340.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Baruragaru, the Blood Devouring Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23340.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Blood
Eating Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫. Accepting
the quest requires a
≪Superior Ticket≫. Note
that if the quest fails,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will
be consumed.

21916.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21916.description: Have you heard of the Gentian Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21916.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere called
Gentian Sphere?
Its material is essential to
forging a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I shall give you a precious
decoration material.
