62451.description: All right, all right! Really, the potential of monsters is infinite. They say my favorite Berukyurosu is flying around the canyon field. Would you catch that one for me too? From the field.
62451.descriptionEn:
Mmh~ mmh~ good, good, good!
You know~ the possibilities of
monsters really are infinite.
In the field called Canyon, my
favorite Berukyurosu is flying
around, isn't it.
Could you go and catch that one
for me too~?
                    From Hata

63341.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
63341.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63341.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

61118.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61118.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61118.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

60548.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
60548.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Guanzorumu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60548.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Guanzorumu≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and claim
a splendid top rank!
Also, Origin Species weapons only
this time! Choose your weapon well!

61068.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

26669.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26669.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Plesioth Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26669.descriptionEn:
This time, the Hunting Skill quest
is to slay a
≪Plesioth Variant≫.
Why not sharpen your skills
against one another, hunters!

26507.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・１を１０個納品

61868.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

62119.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

63035.description: A monster that looks different from the usual, extremely powerful and acting in ways normally unthinkable, appears to have shown up. An examiner for hunters holding the Secret Scroll is staying here now, so prove your ability, and if you catch his eye, you can be sure to be issued many Secret Proof [Break].
63035.descriptionEn:
A monster with a different look,
very powerful and acting in ways
beyond all reason, seems to have
appeared.
Right now an examiner for Secret
Art holders is staying here, so
if you prove your skill and
meet his eye, you can be sure
he will issue you many
≪Secret Art Proof [Break]≫.

60913.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書３０枚の納品
60913.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. This time the reward is a Fanged Beast Claw L! Bring the specified number of Part Break Certificates yourself.
60913.descriptionEn:
The Hunting Guild offers rewards
to hunters who break many
parts of Variants and Kishu.
This time: Fanged Beast Claw L!
Bring the required number of
Part Break Certificates alone.

26195.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26195.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

12041.description: If you can hunt a Rathian, it means you're a hunter who can hunt well enough even in the Elder Hall. It's a famous saying among hunters, isn't it? But making the queen cry would be even more impressive. I wonder if she cries if she drinks a lot of water?
12041.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means a hunter who can
hunt even in the Great Hall.
A famous saying among
hunters, isn't it? But if
you could make the queen
cry, that'd be even better.
Would lots of water do it?

55516.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55516.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

23249.description: It happened as I passed near the highlands, where they say surveys have not progressed. Suddenly a roar came that made the very air tremble. Everyone is frightened and refuses to go near the highlands, and I am at a loss. Hunt it a little and set our minds at ease.
23249.descriptionEn:
It happened when I passed near
the Highlands, where they say
survey work has stalled.
Suddenly a roar came that made
the very air around me tremble.
Everyone's terrified and refuses
to go near the Highlands, so
we're stuck. Do a little hunting
and put our minds at ease.

54926.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
54926.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

55024.description: Please cooperate with the investigation of the Chameleos inhabiting the Forest and Hills! If you not only slay it but also break its horns and sever its tail, we will add to the reward. For the safety of Mezepolta too, lend us your strength in our research!
55024.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help surveying
the ≪Chameleos≫ that inhabits
Forest and Hills!
If you not only slay it but also
break its horns and sever its
tail, we'll add to your reward.
For Mezeporta's safety, please
lend us your strength!

62237.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62237.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62237.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.

22097.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22097.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

54135.description: I cannot resist rare things. Monster materials, ore, anything rare I want! This time I want you to slay a few Pokara to gather Pokara materials. Succeed and I will share a little of the rare materials I hold. Not a bad deal, is it?
54135.descriptionEn:
I just can't resist rare things.
Monster materials, ore, anything
rare — I want it all!
This time I want you to slay a few
Pokara to gather their materials.
If you pull it off,
I'll share a little of the rare
materials I have with you.
Not a bad deal, is it?

21935.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
21935.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 3.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay a Gogomoa
for me.
I'm counting on you!

54179.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54179.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.

55060.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55060.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪H Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪H Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪H Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or higher,
so please keep that in mind.

55385.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55385.description: The nostalgic Variety Soul quest is back again! This time the subject is the Water Fortress Wyvern. Clear it quickly and earn plenty of souls! Rare materials also seem a little easier to obtain than usual.
55385.descriptionEn:
Everyone's nostalgic Variety Soul
is back once again! This time
the task is slaying the Water
Fortress Wyvern ≪Gureadomosu≫.
Let's clear it briskly and rake
in lots of Souls! Rare materials
seem a bit easier to get too.

21078.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21078.description: Velocidrome runs off to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there. It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are lots of Velociprey minions, so be careful.
21078.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ runs off to
the next area when worn
down and heals up.
A good measure of a
hunter's skill, but this
season the Velociprey
are many. So be careful.

53166.description: This is Miyashita! Still hot out! Stay properly hydrated. [Question 4] The only monster belonging to the fanged wyvern class is the Zinogre (subspecies included). If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53166.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here! It's still hot!
Let's drink water properly.
[Question 4]
The only monsters belonging
to the "Fanged Wyvern" class
are "Zinogre (including
subspecies)".
If you think the answer is O (A),
accept this quest
over here!

62477.objectiveJp: きれいな貝殻１０個の納品
62477.description: One request, a hunt. I love it. Not hunting beasts, but shell gathering! My dream is to spend my future buried in shells. Would you gather lots of shells for me? Of course the reward is generous.
62477.descriptionEn:
One hunt, if you please.
I absolutely love it.
Not just any hunt — shell gathering!
My dream is to spend my future
buried in shells.
Would you gather a whole lot of
shells for me?
Of course, the reward will be good.

26753.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

28059.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
28059.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28059.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!

50202.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
50202.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50202.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

54436.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
54436.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.

55925.description: The Variant Species Taikun Zamuza has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55925.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Taikun Zamuza≫
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
As things stand it is extremely
dangerous. Please prepare fully
before heading out to survey it.

50625.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt an Espinas beautifully. Clear the quest and I will give you more rewards than usual!
50625.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Espinas≫ and
show me what you can do.
Clear the quest, and I'll give
you a bigger reward than
usual!

55606.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55606.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!

55645.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55645.description: An Anomalous Species Gasurabazura with greatly developed arms has appeared. Many hunters have abandoned the hunt in the face of its deadly poison. The guild will expand the supply items and, when 4 hunters set out together, provide further support. Head out with care.
55645.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Gasurabazura with
greatly developed arms has
appeared. Its deadly venom has
made many hunters give up on
slaying it.
The Guild is expanding supplies
and will give further support
only to parties of 4.
Please go to the survey with care.

53060.description: This is Miyashita! It is summer! Watch out for heat stroke! [Question 4] In Mezeporuta there is a saying that even Gogomoa falls from a tree. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53060.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here! It's summer!
Watch out for heatstroke!
[Question 4]
In Mezeporta, the saying
"Even a Gogomoa falls from
a tree" has been passed down.
If you think the answer is X (B),
accept this quest
over here!

22075.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
22075.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

50030.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
50030.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Taikun Zamuza of Shiojima. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50030.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Taikun Zamuza≫
on the Tidal Island.
Clear the quest splendidly, and
your standing as hunters will
shoot right up!

50190.description: Hunting and capturing are not everything! You agree that breaking parts is the true thrill of the hunt, do you not? Your quarry this time is a Leaping Scarlet Beast. Break the specified parts in style and show off your skill.
50190.descriptionEn:
Slaying and capturing aren't
everything! Part breaking is the
real thrill of hunting — you
agree, don't you? Your foe this
time is the ≪Leaping Crimson Beast≫.
Break the specified parts with
flair and show off your skill.

26312.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26312.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

11501.description: It is I, the Instructor! Today I have come on a special trip from Jumbo Village! If you are still uneasy after finishing this quest, come to the village! In the village I have prepared many more basic quests!
11501.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Today I have come all the way
from Jumbo Village on business!
If you are still uneasy after
finishing this quest, come to the village!
In the village I have far more basic
quests prepared for you!

61608.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

55563.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55563.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55563.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Gunlance,
show me the skill you have honed
against the Tigrex in the Desert!
If you can hunt it splendidly,
you shall receive a reward far
beyond what your daily efforts
would ever bring you.

56124.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56124.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

55964.description: We have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket exclusive to the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55964.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a quest where you
can obtain a special
≪Outerwear Release Ticket≫.
Please bring ≪Festival Excitement≫
when accepting or joining.

54265.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54265.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

54134.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54134.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

12042.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon also called the Sickle Crab. If the Shield Crab is defense, the Sickle Crab is offense. Those sharp claws swung down with force will cut through almost anything. If the hunt fails, break the claws and withdraw.
12042.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon called the Scythe
Crab. Shield Crab defends;
Scythe Crab attacks. Those
claws slash through almost
anything. If hunting fails,
break the claws and leave.

28024.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟

55833.description: A Basarios with a greatly developed body has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Basarios known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55833.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gravios≫ with a greatly
developed body has appeared.
The Guild classifies this individual
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Gravios so far.
Please take care during the survey.

54876.description: We ask for your help in the survey of the Zerureusu that inhabits the Tower! Not only slay it: if you break its head and wings, we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54876.descriptionEn:
We request your aid in surveying
the Zerureusu that dwells in the Tower!
Not only slaying it, if you break
its head and wings we shall add
extra to your reward.
Please lend your strength
to our research!

55302.description: A Rathalos with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Rathalos seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55302.descriptionEn:
A ≪Rathalos≫ with greatly
developed wings has appeared.
The Guild classifies this individual
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Rathalos so far.
Please take care during the survey.

55572.description: An Inagami with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Inagami known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55572.descriptionEn:
A ≪Elegant Sire Wyvern≫ whose
tail has grown greatly has
appeared. The Guild classifies
this individual as a Supremacy
with developed parts and will
survey it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.

21010.description: The Congalala is a greedy fanged beast, and word is it has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course its minions the Conga love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, it might come out.
21010.descriptionEn:
The ≪Congalala≫ is a stubborn,
greedy fanged beast, and I hear
it can't resist anything made of
mushrooms! Of course its minions
the Conga love mushrooms too!
If you carry plenty of specialty
mushrooms, it may show up.

63175.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63175.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Fermi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
63175.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secret
art of forging equipment have been
found on monsters slain all over
the land, or so I hear!
Once you get the "Fermi Memo",
come alone, like a man! Bring it
to this workshop master!
I'll show you some good work!

21259.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21259.description: A powerful Velocidrome has appeared. The Guild will pay a large reward to the hunter who slays it! In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware!
21259.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Velocidrome≫
has appeared.
The Guild will pay a large
sum to the hunter who slays
it. Other rewards are
modest in return, so do
take note!

63011.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
63011.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63011.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

54136.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54136.description: Good news for all you G Rank hunters! A training method to efficiently build up experience has been developed. You cannot accept it consecutively, but the effect of a single run is immense! May your daily training become great strength for you!
54136.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you G Rank
hunters!
A training method to efficiently
build up experience has been
developed.
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
immense!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!

60133.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60133.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60133.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.

60025.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61777.description: This is a practice quest for the preliminaries of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is five minutes or less. Except for a few cases, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards.
61777.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
preliminaries of the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament. In the
real event the time limit is
five minutes or less. Except for
a few cases, the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained by
carving or from clear rewards.

62479.objectiveJp: 橙晶石の欠片４個の納品
62479.description: It seems you have gathered quite a lot. One step closer to my dream. A little more. I want you to stay with me just a little longer. Of course, when it is done I will give you wonderful treasure.
62479.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered quite a
lot. One step closer to my dream.
Just a little more.
I want you to keep me company
just a little longer.
Of course, once it's done I'll
give you splendid treasure.

55771.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
55771.description: Hey there, hunter. Do you like counterattacks? I love them. A monster fighting back sets my heart racing. This time I want to see an Orugaron's counterattack. Slay it within 20 minutes and I will pay a large bounty, so do your best.
55771.descriptionEn:
Hey there, hunter. Do you like
counterattacks?
I simply loooove them.
A beast burning for revenge just
thrills me. This time I want to see
an Orugaron's counterattack.
Slay it within twenty minutes
and I'll give you a hefty bonus,
so do your best, okay?

55290.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for one material, and break the specified part for one more!
55290.descriptionEn:
A chance to get a Supremacy
weapon prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal fixed damage to the target
for 1 material, and break the
specified part for one more
as a gift!

54853.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
54853.description: Do you have enough Ｇｚ? Complete this request and you can earn a great many Porta Cards (Sakura). However, note that it cannot be taken more than the set number of times.
54853.descriptionEn:
Are you short on ≪Gz≫?
Clear this request and you
will earn plenty of Porta
Card Sakura.
Note that it cannot be
accepted beyond the set
number of times.

21423.objectiveJp: パルサント鉱石９９個の納品
21423.description: It began as a small seed, but tended with care it came to harvest, and in time it brought abundance as well. Yet this is not the end. A hunter who holds a Secret Arts Scroll will be able to encourage further prosperity.
21423.descriptionEn:
It began as a tiny seed, but by
tending it with care it came to
bear fruit, and in time it brought
forth abundance as well.
Yet this is not the end, not by
any means. If you are a hunter
who holds a Secret Art Tome,
you should be able to encourage
even greater prosperity.

61192.description: Apparently it is the custom of the Hunting Friends Festival for men and women each to overcome a trial befitting them. This one is for female hunters, so male hunters should take the other quest.
61192.descriptionEn:
First, it seems the custom of the
Hunting Buddy Festival is for men and
women each to clear their own trial.
This one is for female hunters, so
male hunters should take the other
quest, alright?

21128.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ２匹の狩猟
21128.description: The Shogun Ceanataur is a creature that uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling. If the hunt proves difficult, hunting the Gabras that flit about the crater this season and then heading home is not a bad idea either.
21128.descriptionEn:
The Sickle Crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
is a creature that uses its strange
leg joints to climb all the way to
the ceiling.
If hunting it proves difficult,
slaying the ≪Gabras≫ that flit
around the Volcano crater this
season and heading home is not a
bad option either.

62471.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62471.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

60125.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟

61778.description: This is a practice quest for the preliminaries of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is five minutes or less. Except for a few cases, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards.
61778.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
preliminaries of the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament. In the
real event the time limit is
five minutes or less. Except for
a few cases, the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained by
carving or from clear rewards.

23472.description: A White Shadow with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the White Shadow known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23472.descriptionEn:
A Khezu with a greatly developed
head has appeared.
The Guild classifies this specimen
as a Supremacy species with an
enlarged part, and will survey it.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Khezu so far.
Please conduct the survey with
care.

21776.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21776.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

54420.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

54348.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54348.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

62176.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival. But you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. One person only, and nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
62176.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival.
But you just have to have a
memory of the festivities!
Yes, you there! Why not take
this quest? Mind you, the terms
are strict, so I do not recommend
it to the winning side.
One person only, and if you fail
the goods are not returned, so
be careful!

62214.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62214.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62392.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62392.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a one-handed weapon that can guard with a shield. Take the armor and sword and shield set prepared for you and hunt the Roaring Wolf Nono Orugaron somewhere in the Swamp! Make good use of the weapon's strengths!
62392.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
you shall hunt with a one-handed
weapon that can guard with a shield.
With the armor and Sword and Shield
set prepared for you, go hunt the
Orugaron known as Non Orugaron
somewhere in the Swamp! Make good
use of the weapon's strengths!

55854.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55854.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

51009.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51009.description: Hunter who would master the heavy bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
51009.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.

50908.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50908.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Toa Tesukatora. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50908.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are seeking
someone to dispose of an extremely
powerful Toa Tesukatora specimen.
If you slay it splendidly, we shall
issue you more slaying certificates
than usual!

62432.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐
62432.description: What, you just want a hard Hammer? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62432.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Hammer
that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!

62142.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62142.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62142.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

26620.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26620.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

50216.description: The Guku clothes I ordered for the Guku Gallery have not arrived on time. Could you go and check on things nearby for me? If you help, I will give you my secret Guku collection.
50216.descriptionEn:
I ordered a Gook outfit for
the Gook Gallery opening,
but it still hasn't arrived.
Could you go and check on
things nearby for me?
If you help me out, I'll
give you a piece of my
treasured Gook collection.

26605.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
26605.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Garum Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26605.descriptionEn:
Those notes on the lost secret
art of forging gear have been
found on monsters slain all
over the place, or so I hear!
Once you get a ≪Garm Memo≫,
man to man, bring it to this
workshop head right here!
I'll show you fine work!

50565.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の捕獲

61720.description: Hey hey! I was invited by a Guild person to come to Mezeporta plaza, but monsters are in the way and I cannot get through! You skilled hunter there, do something! I will give you my treasure as thanks.
61720.descriptionEn:
Hey, hey!
A Guild fellow invited me to come
to Mezeporta Square, but a monster
is in the way and I can't get through!
You skilled hunter over there,
do something about it!
I'll give you my treasure as
a thank-you, so come on!

50112.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
50112.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50112.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.

62681.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62681.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62681.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!

62178.description: I've developed a new hammer, but the structure has become a bit complicated, so would you test its strength for me? I've chosen armor to match the weapon, so no worries! Full of skills, and it looks good too! Wear it without hesitation!
62178.descriptionEn:
I developed a new Hammer, but
the structure came out a bit
complex, so would you go test
its strength for me? I picked
armor to match the weapon, so
no worries!
Full of skills and good looking!
Wear it without holding back!

50397.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

53026.description: We are recruiting hunters to procure food for the Guild's cherry blossom viewing. Procure the Golden Potato Sake for the toast, and if you have time, fresh Hoppy Sake and well-done meat too.
53026.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters to procure
ingredients to be served at the
Guild-sponsored flower viewing.
Besides providing the Golden Yam Sake
for the toast that day, if you have
spare room, we also ask for fresh
Hopi Wine and well-done steak.

50341.description: We have received reports from the researchers surveying the sea of trees that they are too afraid of Espinas to proceed! Please hunt it at once! However, Espinas itself is very interesting, so they said they would like you to break its horns too if possible! That is all!!
50341.descriptionEn:
Researchers surveying the Great Forest
report that they are too afraid of the
Espinas to make any progress!
Please go and hunt it at once!
However, the Espinas itself is very
interesting, so they also want you
to break its horns if you can!
That is all!!

55651.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (chest), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
55651.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(chest piece), excluding
weapon ribbons and weapon
merits. The yield is one
type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please take note.

62966.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
62966.description: Can the shell covering a Monoblos' body withstand simultaneous attacks from many directions? Since one can only set out on a Monoblos quest alone, this is the only way to know the answer. You, hunter, will play the part of the Monoblos!
62966.descriptionEn:
Can the shell covering a Monoblos'
body withstand simultaneous attacks
from many directions?
Since Monoblos quests can only be
departed on alone, this is the only
way to learn the answer.
You, hunter, will play the part of
the Monoblos!

40205.description: A surveyor reported sighting a gigantic creature. When it charged and nearly trampled him, he was saved by a person called the Unwavering Seeker, who wears battered training garb. He apparently trains here often, so why not test your own skill as well?
40205.descriptionEn:
A surveyor reported sighting a
gigantic creature.
When it charged and nearly crushed
him, he was saved by a person in
tattered training garb called the
'Relentless Seeker.'
He apparently trains here often,
so why not test your own skill
against him?

21174.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの狩猟
21174.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21174.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or hunt a sub-target
21174.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

50458.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

18.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
18.description: It is I, the Instructor! The battle with the Velocidrome begins! Make full use of the items supplied and hunt with all your strength! Once you are used to slaying, practice capturing too. Knowing capture widens your range of hunts!
18.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Your fight with ≪Velocidrome≫
begins! Use your supply
items and hunt at full power!
Once you're used to slaying,
practice ≪Capture≫ too. It
broadens your hunting range!

62417.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62417.description: Gazing at the blue sky, I find I have come to a place with a fine view. The place beyond reach is the sky, so then, is there a hunter who can break the back of a Barbarian Wyvern? If you break it splendidly, I will give you the materials of the armor I wear.
62417.descriptionEn:
Gazing at the blue sky, I've come
to quite a fine vantage point.
They say the sky is out of reach,
but then, is there a hunter who
can break a Taikun Zamuza's back?
If you break it splendidly, I'll
give you the materials for the
armor I'm wearing.

60621.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60621.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60621.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

26355.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26355.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

21770.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
21770.description: To the hunters of Dundorma, information about the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga. In my estimation, it will come at you with resolve to die this time. Slaying it is the only way to answer that resolve.
21770.descriptionEn:
To the hunters of Dundorma,
here is information on the proud
lone wolf, the Black Wolf Bird
≪Yian Garuga≫. My guess is
that in this hunt he will come
at us ready to die.
Slaying him is the only way to
answer that resolve, I say.

50990.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50990.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed to FX-upgrade Secret Art
Armor (Gunner), excluding Weapon
Souls.
The yield covers five pieces.
Please note that accepting the
quest requires a 10th Anniversary
Ticket.

50919.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50919.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to craft and upgrade 1 piece of the Toa Series, Hardcore Armor of Toa Tesukatora. It is a generous quest, so please give it a try!
50919.descriptionEn:
I present a request that
nets you the materials to
craft and upgrade one piece
of the Frozen King Dragon's
≪Hardcore Armor≫, the
"Toa Series." It's a great
deal, so do take the challenge!

21192.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21192.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50660.description: This is a quest for the HR Trial used to rise to HR 100. Do not forget to accept the trial from the Price/HR Trial Board. It is a quest to slay one Rathian by yourself, so please set out after preparing yourself sufficiently.
50660.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the HR Trial
used to rise to HR 100.
Do not forget to accept the
trial from the Price/HR
Trial Board.
It is a quest to slay one Rathian
by yourself, so please set out
after preparing yourself
sufficiently.

63301.objectiveJp: よく磨かれた鏡石１個の納品

26575.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26575.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26575.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

62560.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62560.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62560.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

22050.description: The Sea of Trees is a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22050.descriptionEn:
The ≪Sea of Trees≫ is a
land still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

61816.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
61816.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 5 minutes. With some exceptions, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
61816.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 5 minutes.
With some exceptions, the target
monster's materials cannot be
obtained by carving or from the
clear reward.

60678.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Giaorugu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60678.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is the Giaorugu!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest, so
try to place among the top!
This time it is held with
Supremacy weapons only!

40233.description: The Black Caster appears to have built a golem modelled on a dragon and is testing it. Its power is immense, and at this rate even uninvolved people may come to harm. Join with the Black Saber, who agreed to cooperate, and stop the damage!
40233.descriptionEn:
It seems the Black Caster has built
a dragon-shaped golem and is
testing it.
Its power is immense, and at this
rate harm may reach innocent
bystanders.
Together with the Black Saber, who
has agreed to help, stop the damage
from spreading!

23660.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
23660.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu has appeared once more. Its developed horns seem able to command a more powerful dark thunder. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23660.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Doragyurosu≫
has appeared once more.
Its developed horns seem able
to command a more powerful
dark thunder than before.
Please take great care in
your survey.

50023.description: For hunters who carelessly obtained a Haku Interception Contribution Certificate Green from the Harisen Neko. In this request we exchange the certificate for the following materials. Doragyurosu scorched scale x40, Gold and Silver Fish Wyvern torn shell x40, Teostra scorched wing x40.
50023.descriptionEn:
For hunters who happened to
get a ≪Supremacy Green
Certificate≫ from Harisen
Neko. This request trades
it for the materials below.
≪Doragyurosu Charred Scale≫ x40
≪Arganos Riot Shell≫ x40
≪Teostra Burning Wing≫ x40

50737.description: I found a Flame Horn Wyvern in the decisive battlefield. But it seems it is no ordinary Flame Horn Wyvern. From what I hear, it is a highly renowned Flame Horn Wyvern. Word is you get a huge amount of rewards when you slay it! Look, it will be gone soon! Hurry!
50737.descriptionEn:
I found a Varusaburosu in the
Battlefield, you see. But it seems
it's no ordinary Varusaburosu.
Word has it this one is a highly
renowned Varusaburosu. Slaying it
brings a simply huge reward,
or so the rumor goes!
Look, it'll be gone soon!
Get going!

53057.description: It is Miyashita! The fun weekend is finally here! [Question 3] In the Supremacy Continuous Interception Battle, the one with the lowest slay rate was UNKNOWN. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53057.descriptionEn:
It's Miyashita!
The fun weekend is finally here!
[Question 3]
In the 'Zenith Continuous Interception
Battle,' the one with the lowest
slay success rate is UNKNOWN.
Hunters who think the answer is
True (A), accept this quest
right here!

26664.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26664.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Rajang Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26664.descriptionEn:
This hunting skill quest is for
slaying a Rajang Variant.
Why not sharpen your skills
together with fellow hunters!

63002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟

61148.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50396.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55696.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Inagami. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55696.descriptionEn:
This quest allows you to obtain
the materials of the Supremacy
Inagami.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
Please be aware that if you
should fail the quest, the
Superior Ticket will be
consumed.

26689.objectiveJp: 銀火竜の尻尾１個の納品
26689.description: To set foot in the closed secret region, a qualification is required. That qualification is none other than the Secret Area Set. He who opens the gates of heaven and takes that qualification in hand will surely find fortune deep within the closed secret region...
26689.descriptionEn:
To set foot in the closed hidden
area, one needs a qualification.
That qualification is none other
than the ≪Secret Area Set≫.
Those who open the gates of
heaven and gain that right shall
find fortune deep in the closed
hidden area...

55314.description: An Anomalous Species Rathalos with greatly developed wings has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to the Anomalous Species, have defeated many hunters. In response the guild will provide strong support for the hunt. Head out with care.
55314.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Rathalos with greatly
developed wings has appeared.
Its Supremacy-specific attacks have
caused many hunters to fail.
In response, the Guild will provide
strong slaying support.
Please proceed to the survey with
caution.

62679.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

21758.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Daimyo Hermitaur will be judged by our Guild, so please concentrate on completing the main target!
21758.descriptionEn:
At the Elder Hall Guild's
request, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
We will judge the 'fixed
damage' dealt to
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ here, so
everyone please focus on
clearing the main target!

60056.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21177.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21177.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21177.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or complete the sub-target
21177.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

26716.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
26716.description: What, you just want a hard Long Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26716.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Long Sword
that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!

28079.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28079.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!

26115.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
26115.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!

55675.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
55675.description: So you mean to take on a job from a Dark Cat Pack executive? An executive's job is a cut above the rest. Slack off and you will be crying. Complete it and I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Seal, Blue.
55675.descriptionEn:
You feel like taking on a request
from a Dark Cat Gang exec, nya?
An exec's request is a cut or
two above the rest, nya.
Slack off and you'll be crying, nya.
Clear it and I might even give
you a ≪Dark Cat Gang Seal: Blue≫,
nya.

62637.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
62637.description: I cannot forget the memory of wearing fluffy clothes and throwing snowballs for fun. Will you not try it too? If you are short of tools, gathering them on site is important too. If it goes well, I will give you a pattern for a Gook.
62637.descriptionEn:
I can't forget the memory of wearing
fluffy clothes and throwing snowballs
for fun.
Won't you give it a try too?
If you're short on tools, gathering
them on site is important as well.
If it goes well, I'll give you a
paper pattern for a Gook outfit.

55732.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の捕獲
55732.description: Please become my favorite Brachydios and go punch each other with a Brachydios. Please do not slay it, it would be sad. I will give you my treasure as a thank you.
55732.descriptionEn:
Please pretend to be my favorite
Brachydios and go have a punch-for-punch
match with a Brachydios.
It'd be too sad, so please don't
slay it.
As a reward,
I'll give you my treasure.

22106.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22106.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

62361.description: My wife says to me: you are always dreaming, do you never tire of it? Indeed I do not! By looking ever forward, work that was once finished can advance one more step! That joy is what keeps me alive!
62361.descriptionEn:
My wife keeps telling me,
'Always chasing dreams like that,
how do you never get bored?'
That's right, I never do!
By keeping your eyes forward, work
you once thought finished can take
one more step ahead!
That joy is what keeps me alive!

50451.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55019.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55019.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!

23664.description: I have received a report that the Lightning Extreme Dragon will soon appear at the interception base. Go at once to hunt Revidiora. Do not forget to report to that one once you complete the quest.
23664.descriptionEn:
I have received a report that
a Thunder Extreme Dragon will soon
appear at the Base.
Go at once to slay Rebidiora.

When you have cleared the quest,
do not forget to report to
that fellow.

62381.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62381.description: The season of beautiful moons has come. Do you know the branch of the Yugen Tree? It is said to harbor mysterious power when bathed in moonlight. I want to go and fetch that branch. If you hunt the monsters in the way, I will share the branch with you.
62381.descriptionEn:
The season of the beautiful moon is here.
Do you know the branch of the
Profound Tree?
They say it holds mysterious power
when bathed in moonlight.
I want to go and get that branch.
Hunt the monsters in the way, and
I'll share a branch with you.

21013.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21013.description: Rathian is said to have a subspecies! The queen clad in sakura pink is a troublesome queen with a fiercer temper than the original! Whether to slay or capture, it's important to judge the monster's state and your own situation!
21013.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ apparently has a
Subspecies, you know! This
queen wrapped in cherry
pink is a real handful,
wilder than the original!
Slay or capture, it's key
to judge both sides well!

26416.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26416.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!

62610.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62610.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62610.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

55016.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
55016.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

55421.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章１０個の納品
55421.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Azure D Series, the layered armor of the Azure G Series. Azure Release Ticket D x5.
55421.descriptionEn:
By completing this request, you can
obtain the layered armor unlock ticket
for the ≪Azure D Series≫, the layered
version of the ≪Azure G Series≫.
-Azure Unlock Ticket D x5
Do not miss this chance.

63057.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Purple Yian Kut-Ku in the arena. Clear the quest without mishap and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
63057.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Hunt the Purple Yian Kut-Ku in
the Arena. If you clear the quest
safely, your standing as hunters
will shoot right up!

56076.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for five materials, and break the specified part for five more!
56076.descriptionEn:
A chance to obtain Supremacy
weapons prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal a set amount of damage to
the target for 5 materials, and
break the specified parts for
5 more of each!

21619.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Light Green Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21619.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb known as
the Yellow-Green Origin Orb?
Its material is essential to the
production of a certain expensive
decoration.
If you can complete this request,
I shall give you precious decoration
materials.

21363.objectiveJp:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡの狩猟
21363.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Desert, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Fallen Tree or the Voice of Nature: Snowstorm. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21363.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target
or sub-target A
21363.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. This request is set
in the ≪Desert≫, and by
clearing it you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Fallen Tree≫
or ≪Voice of Nature: Blizzard≫.
I pray your hunting life grows
ever more fulfilling.

54281.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Basarios beautifully. Clear the quest and I will give you more rewards than usual!
54281.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Go and hunt ≪Basarios≫
for all to see.
Clear the quest and I'll
give you rewards more
generous than usual!

50025.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト４匹の納品

62576.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62576.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62576.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.

62737.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62737.description: If I told you Hardcore weapons could be made even stronger, would you believe me? Word is the material comes from a Teostra, but this one seems unlike the usual sort, and a nasty piece of work besides. Wave it off as an old man's rambling if you like, but if you are curious, go and see.
62737.descriptionEn:
If I told you a Hardcore weapon could
be made even stronger, would you
believe me?
Word is the material for it comes
from a Teostra, but it seems this
one is not the usual sort,
and quite a handful.
Well, you may laugh it off as an
old man's rambling, but if you're
interested, go and see for yourself.

62799.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62799.description: We have prepared a request that issues the tickets needed for Gou quests. A comparatively weak monster appears, so why not join? However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
62799.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a request
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Relatively weak monsters
will appear, so why not come
along and take part?
However, it cannot be taken
in succession, so please
keep that in mind.

55109.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
55109.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Rohok GX Series. Hunt Forokururu and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
55109.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest to upgrade
the 'Rohokku GX Series.'
By hunting a Forokururu, you can
obtain upgrade materials for one
piece of the set.
Please make good use of it!

55430.description: The Variant Species Midogaron has appeared once more. Its legs have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55430.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ has
appeared once more.
Its legs have grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
even more power. Please take
great care in your survey.

60304.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60304.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time your opponent is a new species of flying wyvern, the Tigrex! In a closed space with nowhere to run, we await the challenge of any with the courage to face it!
60304.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
their skill!
The next opponent is a new species
of Flying Wyvern, the Tigrex!
In a closed space with nowhere to
flee, we await the challenge of
those with courage!

55810.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55810.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55810.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

60601.description: Hypnocatrice are breeding in great numbers! We have asked hunters from every region for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt with 2 hunters at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
60601.descriptionEn:
The Hypnocatrice are breeding wildly!
We have asked hunters everywhere
for their help, but the truth is
there are simply too many.
So we seek those who can set out
on this hunt in pairs at most.
I especially recommend it to those
aiming for a fast rank-up.

56008.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
56008.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the ears of Yian Kut-Ku, we will also grant a special item.
56008.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun UL
Guild Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to spread
awareness and promote them.
By breaking a Yian Kut-Ku's ear,
we will also grant you a
special item.

55415.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55415.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

26384.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a High Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26384.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
high rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!

62458.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
62458.description: What, you just want a hard Heavy Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62458.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Heavy
Bowgun that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!

54507.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
54507.description: We are seeking hunters to help investigate the Khezu subspecies living in the Snowy Mountains. The Khezu subspecies is relatively docile if you do not approach, but beware the ferocity it shows when it senses your presence. Depart after thorough preparation.
54507.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters to help
survey the Red Khezu that inhabits
the Snowy Mountains.
It is fairly docile if you keep
your distance, but its ferocity
once it senses you demands caution.
Please set out only after
preparing sufficiently.

54123.description: We are recruiting hunters to help investigate the Shogun Ceanataur that appeared in the swamp! While you are at it, could you also slay Aptonoth? For future surveys, please help!
54123.descriptionEn:
We seek hunters to help survey the
Shogun Ceanataur that appeared in
the Swamp!
It may sound like an afterthought,
but could you also slay some
Aptonoth for us?
Please lend your aid for our
future research!

61641.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61641.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

62863.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62863.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!

62958.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62958.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62958.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

61164.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61164.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61164.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

21065.description: We're recruiting hunters to slay 8 Ioprey! Ioprey hits harder in a single blow than Velociprey or Genprey, so mind yourself out there!
21065.descriptionEn:
Seeking hunters to slay 8
≪Ioprey≫!
Compared to Velociprey or
Genprey, a single Ioprey hit
hits harder. Watch out!

50569.description: Clear this quest once a day and you'll get lots of Hunter Festival souls, meow. Clear it every day without fail and by the time the Soul-Pouring Festival ends you should have quite a pile, meow. You should tell all your Guild members too, meow.
50569.descriptionEn:
Clear this quest once a day and
you'll get lots of Hunter Festival
souls, meow. Clear it every day
without fail and by the time the
Soul-Pouring Festival ends you
should have quite a pile, meow.
You should tell all your Guild
members too, meow.

26262.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26262.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54702.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
54702.description: To those aiming for GR 500: we have prepared a quest where hunting a Velocidrome greatly raises your standing as a hunter and also lets you obtain 'Velocidrome Bone,' a material recommended for making elemental Seals. Please make good use of it.
54702.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for GR 500:
we have prepared a quest where
hunting a Velocidrome greatly raises
your standing as a hunter and also
lets you obtain 'Velocidrome Bone,'
a material recommended for making
elemental Seals.
Please make good use of it.

58074.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58074.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58074.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

55361.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55361.description: The Silver Sovereign Wyvern has appeared at the interception base. The guild will pay a handsome reward to any hunter who intercepts this Silver Sovereign Wyvern within 20 minutes. Hunt it at once, before damage is done!
55361.descriptionEn:
A Harudomerugu has appeared at
the Base.
The Guild will pay a large reward to
any hunter who repels this
Harudomerugu within twenty minutes.
Slay it urgently, before damage
spreads!
