55231.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Glear GX Leggings' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55231.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the "F Photo
Contest 2016", we have
prepared a quest that yields
the materials to craft and
upgrade the armor worn in it,
the "Glare GX Leggings".
Please make use of it.

62043.description: Man, that was a scare! I never heard of that thing being in the tower. And on top of that, it's different from the usual sort. I got spooked and ended up dropping my precious merchandise and running. I'll make it worth your while, so go hunt it!
62043.descriptionEn:
Man, that was rough!
I never heard of that thing
being in the Tower.
And it looks different from
the usual ones, too.
I got scared and ended up
dropping my precious goods and
running for it.
I will pay you, so
go hunt it for me!

50820.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50820.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

54395.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the chest of Basarios, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54395.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared this
quest to raise awareness and
promotion further.
By breaking the Basarios's
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

26720.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26720.description: What, you just want a hard Gunlance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26720.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Gunlance, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!

50372.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟

61252.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
61252.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!

60706.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
60706.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60706.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

63371.description: Herbivore hunters of the world! This is no time to be eating grass. Every year! At this time of year! Whether you do it or not, your fate changes greatly! I want you to take on the challenge boldly! By the way, breaking a Congalala's claws will surely bring something good!
63371.descriptionEn:
All you herbivore hunters out
there! This is no time to be
eating plants. Every year!
This season! Your fate changes
greatly on whether you do it
or not! I want you to take it
on boldly! By the way, break a
Congalala's claws for good luck!

55072.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
55072.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55072.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

53273.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
53273.description: The lord of the sea that has long threatened the coastal folk has shown itself in the jungle. The nuisance is that the beach has become territory for a troop of monkeys. Drive the meddlesome apes off first, or slip past them and strike at the sea lord. Do not miss your chance: pierce it with countless blades and lightning like a sudden downpour, and bring the sea lord down!
53273.descriptionEn:
The lord of the sea that threatens
the coastal folk has appeared
in the Jungle. Trouble is, the
beach is the monkeys' territory.
Drive off the bothersome monkeys,
or seize the moment and aim
for the lord. Do not miss your
chance: pierce him with
countless knives and thunder!

50149.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50149.description: Word in your ear, hunter! Apparently a legendary Rajang has appeared in the Snowy Mountains! What? Rajang are nothing rare? Then go and try your luck. That one is no ordinary Rajang, it is something special.
50149.descriptionEn:
Here is some useful news for
you, hunter! A legendary Rajang
seems to have appeared in the
Snowy Mountains!
What? Rajang are nothing rare?
Then try taking it on.
That one is not just any Rajang.
It is something special.

21441.description: It seems you gathered splendidly the materials the miner requested. According to the owner of the mixing shop, if you mix a large amount of Amber Rare Water and Jade Rare Water with Blast Rock, you get a rare ore that burns as if it were exploding. Won't you try it too?
21441.descriptionEn:
You've gathered all the
materials the miner asked for.
According to the owner of the
mixing shop, blending blasting
rocks into lots of Amber Fluid
and Jade Fluid makes a rare ore
that burns like an explosion.
Won't you try it too?

21817.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21817.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21817.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

62064.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Swamp, hunt Congalala and a flock of bird wyverns, and to finish, bring back 2 pieces of Grey Crystal Ore from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
62064.descriptionEn:
This time, special training for
you hunters with little skill!
Hunt Congalala and a flock of
Bird Wyverns in the Swamp, then
finish by bringing back 2 Raw
Gravierite from the Cave.
It is harsh training, but if you
pull it off, your standing as
hunters will rise sharply!

23459.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Light Bowgun Ribbon (Middle) x165, Light Bowgun Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23459.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept it you need a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.

58104.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58104.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58104.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

55483.description: A Divergent Hypnocatrice with a greatly developed beak has appeared. It strikes hunters with overwhelming drowsiness, and many have given up the hunt. The Guild recommends a large party and will add to the supplies when you depart with 4. Head out to investigate with care.
55483.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Hypnocatrice with
a greatly developed beak has
appeared.
Assailed by terrible drowsiness,
many hunters have given up on
slaying it.
The Guild recommends joining in
numbers, and will add supplies
when you depart as four.
Please head out with care.

54519.description: This is a qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament in Thanksgiving Festival 2014. The time limit is 10 minutes.
54519.descriptionEn:
This is a qualifier quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
in Thanksgiving Festival 2014.
The time limit is 10 minutes.

62446.description: An exceptionally powerful individual of the Tide Island Gogomoa has been found. The hunt will be harsh on an island we still know little about, so we ask that only hunters able to prove their skill take on the survey and hunt!
62446.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful individual
of the Tidal Island's leaping
beast ≪Gogomoa≫ has been found.
Info on the Tidal Island is
still scarce and the hunt is
harsh, so this is limited to
Hunters who can prove their skill!

40134.description: The albino Khezu of these snowy mountains is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40134.descriptionEn:
The Albino ≪Khezu≫ that lives
in these Snowy Mountains is
said to sometimes carry
incredible treasure.
If that is true, I would love
for you to hunt one for us.
We will split the reward.

50712.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50712.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
50712.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Kushala Daora's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

50338.description: Have returns arrived from the male hunters? A present should have come from whoever answered your feelings. This may be a good chance to reconsider the relationships you have day to day.
50338.descriptionEn:
Have the men among you hunters
received anything in return?
A present should have arrived
from whoever answered your
feelings.
Take this chance to reconsider
your everyday relationships; it
might be a good idea.

23389.objectiveJp: タワラサボテン５０個の納品
23389.description: Greetings. Are you still gathering now that you are G rank? My job is plant collection. Gather the plants I name. Thank you.
23389.descriptionEn:
Greetings.
Even at G Rank, are you still
gathering?
My request is plant collecting.
Please gather the plants I am
about to describe and bring
them to me.
Thank you.

21054.description: If you're hit by a Conga's flatulence you won't be able to use healing items! If you get smelly, use a Deodorant to take the stench off your body!
21054.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Conga≫ fart
and you can't use healing
items! If you get smelly,
use a ≪Deodorant≫ to clear
the stink off yourself!

63322.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63322.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63322.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

51016.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
51016.description: This request yields the decoration Master Guard Jewel G, an all in one offense and defense jewel that raises weapon sharpness while preventing monster roars, wind pressure and tremors. Please make use of it in your hunting life hereafter.
51016.descriptionEn:
This request yields the
offense-and-defense decoration
≪Artisan Guard Orb G≫, which
raises a weapon's sharpness
while blocking monster roars,
wind pressure and tremors.
Please use it in your future hunts.

40226.objectiveJp: チャチャブー３４匹の討伐
40226.description: We have information that a monster wearing the mask of a machine life form is running wild in the desert. According to the report, there are many monsters beyond the blue rock. The clue to solving the rock's mechanism is in the supply box. Use it and slay them.
40226.descriptionEn:
We have word that a monster
wearing the mask of a machine
lifeform is on a rampage in the
Desert.
According to reports, a great
many monsters await beyond the
blue rock.
The clue to solving the rock's
trap lies inside the supply box.
Use it and slay them.

50371.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
50371.description: When I went exploring the volcano the other day, I thought I saw an unfamiliar monster, and it was a Lavasioth! 'Lavasioth are nothing new,' you say? That is what you would think. Just go and look. You will be shocked.
50371.descriptionEn:
The other day I went exploring
the Volcano, and when I
thought there was an unfamiliar
monster, it was a ≪Volganos≫!
"Volganos are nothing new"?
That is what you think, right?
Just go and take a look.
You are in for a surprise!

26663.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26663.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Blangonga Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26663.descriptionEn:
For this Hunting Technique
quest, you will slay a
≪Blangonga Variant≫.
Why not sharpen your skills
against other hunters!

62449.description: Tide Island in the tropics. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
62449.descriptionEn:
The tropical ≪Tidal Island≫.
It is an uncharted land the Guild
is still surveying, but hunter,
why not go and see it once
for gathering and survey
work yourself?
When you feel like coming back,
just deliver a map!

1044.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石１個の納品
1044.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern! It doesn't just spit poison; it can also release a blinding flash! If you break its crest it shouldn't be able to flash anymore! Aim for the crest!
1044.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ goes by another
name: the Poison Bird!
It doesn't just spit poison;
it can fire a bright flash
that blinds hunters too!
Break its crest and the
flash should stop. Aim for it!

53012.description: Male hunters carrying Porta Chocolate! Please lend your aid in slaying Congalala! We cannot let its foul stench ruin this season of sweet scents and sweeter romance! Protect the girls' feelings!
53012.descriptionEn:
All you male hunters
holding a ≪Porta Choco≫!
We ask for your help in
slaying the Pink Fur Beast!
We can't let that beast's
awful stink ruin this
season of sweet scents and
sweeter love! Please,
protect the girls' feelings!

21285.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. I believe I gave you blueprints before and you had the workshop master make a hammer, but it can actually be strengthened further! If you want it improved, bring me 33 Silver Secret Pots.
21285.descriptionEn:
"Fishing"
It is a lonely hunt, one that
faces the fish in silence.
I believe you took the blueprints
I gave you to the workshop master
and made a Hammer, but the truth
is it can be strengthened even
further!
If you wish to improve it, bring
me 33 Silver Secret Pots.

21979.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の撃退
21979.description: A Supremacy Pariapuria has appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monster. Act with your own safety first.
21979.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Pariapuria has
appeared. This request aims
to prevent the damage from
spreading until the slaying
party arrives.
Therefore, please complete it
by repelling.
Put your own safety first.

21474.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21474.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21474.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

56056.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
56056.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Toridokuresu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Great Sword, Lance, Gunlance, Hunting Horn, Magnet Spike, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56056.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
to craft one Supremacy weapon
from the Supremacy Toridcless
and upgrade it twice, plus
Porta Card Sakura worth Gz.
The weapon types available are
Sword and Shield, Great Sword,
Lance, Gunlance, Hunting Horn,
Magnet Spike or Bow. Please use
it to craft and upgrade your favorite.

23465.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス２頭の狩猟
23465.description: While surveying an undiscovered monster in the volcano, we were set upon by a pair of vicious Iodrome and forced to withdraw. Hunters who put those brothers down will receive the materials to craft the Hellfire Quelling Switch Axe.
23465.descriptionEn:
While surveying an undiscovered
monster in the Volcano, we were
attacked by fierce Gendrome
brothers and forced to retreat.
To the hunter who thrashes the
brothers, we will hand over the
crafting materials for the
"Conflagration-Quenching Axe".

103.description: The purpose of this exercise is to slay the Cephalos running wild through the desert! How well you can drag a Cephalos out of the sand is the key to a high score!
103.descriptionEn:
Slaying the Cephalos that rampage
through the Desert is this drill's aim!
How well you can drag the sand-
burrowing Cephalos out into the open
is the key to a high score!

26243.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

26015.description: For cold weather gear, decorations, and weapons, Hypnocatrice materials are in constant demand, and the guild regularly encourages hunters to hunt them. Head for the forest and hunt one Hypnocatrice.
26015.descriptionEn:
For cold weather gear, trinkets
and weapons alike, Hypnocatrice
materials are in constant demand,
and the Guild encourages all
hunters to hunt them regularly.
Head for the Great Forest and
hunt 1 Hypnocatrice, please.

55915.objectiveJp: 誰かの落し物１０個の納品
55915.description: This is terrible, meow! A hunter asked me to carry a big load, and there was a hole in the bag, so everything inside was gone, meow! I would feel awful about it, so I am looking for people to search with me, meow! Please help, meow!
55915.descriptionEn:
Big trouble, nya!
I was carrying a big load for a
hunter when a hole opened in the
bag and everything inside was
gone, nya!
I cannot face that hunter like
this, so I am looking for people
to search with me, nya!
Please lend a paw, nya!

63256.objectiveJp: フルフルベビー１匹の納品
63256.description: First, a warm-up before training. Run to the summit of the snowy mountains and return to camp and the warm-up is done! As proof you went, plant a Guild Flag at the summit.
63256.descriptionEn:
First, a warm-up before
the training begins.
Run all the way to the summit
of the Snowy Mountains, then
return to camp and the
warm-up is complete!
As proof you truly went,
plant a Guild Flag at the summit.

53061.description: This is Miyashita. I love curry and rice. [Question 5] Miyamoa has FRONTIER written on its forehead. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53061.descriptionEn:
Hi, Miyashita here!
I just love curry and rice!
[Question 5]
On Miyamoa's forehead,
the word "FRONTIER"
is written.
Hunters who think the answer
is ○ (A), go ahead and
accept this quest!

21631.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
21631.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Orchid Brown Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21631.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Rancha Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.

61074.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
61074.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Pink Rathian, then slay the Pink Rathian here in this arena!
61074.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters display
their prowess! Against the Pink
Rathian, any who believe they can
fight with style should come to
this Arena and slay
≪Pink Rathian≫!

60690.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
60690.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Bogabadorumu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60690.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Bogabadorumu≫!
Achieve the goal together with
your Guild companions.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest, so try to win a
place in the top ranks!
This time it is held with
Supremacy weapons only!

50830.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50830.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50830.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.

63107.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
63107.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63107.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

61011.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

23388.objectiveJp: マーブル鉱石５０個の納品
23388.description: Ossu! Long time no see! Are you enjoying mining even at G rank? My job is ore collection! Gather the ore I name. Counting on you!
23388.descriptionEn:
Hey! Long time no see!
Are you still enjoying mining
now that you are G Rank?
My request is ore collecting!
Gather the ores I am about to
tell you about and bring them
here.
I am counting on you!

56020.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Akura Jebia. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56020.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Supremacy
Taikun Zamuza.
If you break its developed
parts during this quest, I will
add the developed part
materials to your bonus
rewards as a special extra.
Note that slaying it alone
will not yield those materials.

26166.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
26166.description: To the hunters based in Dundorma, I who continue the supreme hunt will give you valuable information. The whereabouts of the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga, just like me!! An ultra savage foe! Will you try?
26166.descriptionEn:
To the Hunters based in the
city of Dundorma, I who have
kept up the finest hunting
will give you some precious
info. It's the whereabouts of
the proud lone wolf ≪Yian
Garuga≫! A savage foe!
Will you take it on?

28083.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
28083.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
28083.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.

53108.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
53108.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Tigrex and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
53108.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Tigrex≫ and prove
what you can do.
Clear this quest and your
standing as a hunter will rise
in a great leap!

21202.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
21202.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21202.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

55325.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a back break and a tail cut in slaying Espinas, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55325.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Espinas≫ and break its back
and sever its tail, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

21924.description: A request to repel a Supremacy species has arrived. If you complete it, you can obtain Supremacy materials. Repel it though you may, a Supremacy is still a Supremacy. Please take care never to let your guard down.
21924.descriptionEn:
A Zenith repel request has arrived.
Complete it splendidly and you
can obtain Zenith materials.
Even for a repel, a Zenith is
still a Zenith.
Please be absolutely sure
not to let your guard down.

62769.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

23382.description: Abiorugu. Its savagery, attacking anything that moves, threatens the swamp's ecosystem. At this rate the swamp will become a land without life. Skilled hunter, please hunt it and restore peace.
23382.descriptionEn:
Abiorugu. Because it attacks
anything that moves, its ferocity
threatens the Swamp's ecosystem.
At this rate, the Swamp will
become a land with no living
things left.
Skilled hunters, please hunt it
somehow and bring peace back.

60532.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟

21923.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の撃退
21923.description: A request to repel a Supremacy species has arrived. If you complete it, you can obtain Supremacy materials. Repel it though you may, a Supremacy is still a Supremacy. Please take care never to let your guard down.
21923.descriptionEn:
A Zenith repel request has arrived.
Complete it splendidly and you
can obtain Zenith materials.
Even for a repel, a Zenith is
still a Zenith.
Please be absolutely sure
not to let your guard down.

63315.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63315.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

63106.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
63106.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63106.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

26274.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Wyvern Eggs. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
26274.descriptionEn:
From the popular tavern Guild comes
a large order for Flying Wyvern
Eggs. Eight is more than one
person can carry and deliver
alone, so we recommend at least
two people take this on.
Note that there are no supply
items for clearing sub-quests.

21250.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
21250.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21250.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

55998.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55998.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Doragyurosu through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Long Sword, Hammer, Gunlance, Switch Axe, or Light Gun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55998.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to craft one Supremacy
Doragyurosu weapon and upgrade
it once, plus Porta Card Sakura
worth Gz. The weapon types you
can craft are Sword and Shield,
Long Sword, Hammer, Gunlance,
Switch Axe, or Light Bowgun.
Please put them to good use!

26458.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time we have prepared the canyon field, but part of the depths and the high ground are still unexplored and not open. Please note.
26458.descriptionEn:
Thank you for waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Public Bar Guild.
This time we have prepared the
Canyon field, but part of the
inner depths and the high ground
remain unexplored and have not
been unlocked. Please take care.

50147.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
50147.description: I drank a bit too much. Brother, would you take care of this for me, quick? I need to get drunker or I cannot go on. Ha, another night howling at the moon alone. KASHIRAAAAAA!
50147.descriptionEn:
Guess I drank a bit too much.
Brother, would you go and wrap
this one up for me, quick?
I need to get a lot drunker
before I can keep going.
Sigh, another lonely night,
howling at the moon.
KASHIRAAAAAAAAA!

26677.description: Tide Island in the tropics. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
26677.descriptionEn:
The tropical ≪Tidal Island≫.
It is an uncharted land the Guild
is still surveying, but hunter,
why not go and see it once
for gathering and survey
work yourself?
When you feel like coming back,
just deliver a map!

53257.objectiveJp: イャンクック２頭の狩猟
53257.description: Hello, how are you? I am sure you are wearing fine armor and carrying your favorite weapon. I want you to remember when you were a novice hunter. You are sure to gain something.
53257.descriptionEn:
Hey there, how are you?
I'm sure right now you're
wearing fine armor and
carrying your favorite weapon.
I want you to remember
the days when you were
a rookie Hunter.
I'm sure you'll find
something to gain from it.

50657.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
50657.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 51! In this quest you can obtain weapon crafting materials from Akura Vashimu and upgrade materials for the original armor Korude F Series. Please give it a try!
50657.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 51!
In this quest you can obtain
weapon crafting materials from
the Tail Crystal Scorpion
≪Akura Vashimu≫ and upgrade
materials for the original armor
≪Korude F Series≫.
Please give it a try!

55328.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a torso break and a leg break in slaying the White Shadow, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55328.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Khezu≫ and break its body
and legs, we will grant an
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

62994.description: Won't you launch the bombs I carefully made into the night sky? Of course I will pay. A Rathalos seems to be flying nearby, but launch them anyway. If you hit it well, the Guild will give an extra reward, they say.
62994.descriptionEn:
Would you set off the bombs I
crafted with such care into the
night sky? You will be rewarded.
A Rathalos seems to be flying
nearby, but fire away anyway.
If you hit it well, the Guild
will apparently pay out an
extra reward, so I hear.

60071.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23291.description: The survey of the extreme cold sea is progressing smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of the materials found can be used for producing and upgrading arms, they say. Many G-rank hunters, who often go to dangerous lands, may be interested.
23291.descriptionEn:
The Polar Sea survey proceeds
well, and many new materials
have been found. Most of them
can be used to forge and
upgrade gear, they say.
Among G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
many may well be
interested.

26710.description: The season is the breeding season! The stage is the Desert at midday! Gather eggs and deliver them, and if you obtain gold or silver eggs as a reward, they can be sold for a high price! Hunters aiming to make a fortune at one stroke, do join us!
26710.descriptionEn:
The season is the breeding
season! The stage is the Desert
at high noon!
Gather eggs and deliver them;
if you get Gold or Silver Eggs
as rewards, they sell high!
Hunters after quick money, join!

50633.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50633.description: This is the PC version High Grade Edition trial quest. The time limit is 10 minutes.
50633.descriptionEn:
PC Version
High Grade Edition
Trial Quest.
The time limit is set
at 10 minutes.

55517.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55517.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

62146.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62146.description: Even after restoring the lost map, many mysteries remain. For instance, have you never heard of the powerful weapon sleeping beyond the ancient Dragon Sluice? Obtaining the Key of the Dragon Sluice should solve that mystery. The chance is now or never. Hurry!
62146.descriptionEn:
Even with the lost map restored,
many mysteries still remain.
For instance, have you never heard
of the mighty weapon sleeping
beyond the ancient Dragon Water Gate?
Obtaining the ≪Dragon Water Gate Key≫
should solve that mystery for you.
This chance comes only now.
Hurry!

61242.description: Locking the Rajang in the arena was fine, but it is rampaging so wildly I cannot handle it! Hey, you. Can you do something about it? I will prepare the equipment, so please!
61242.descriptionEn:
Locking the ≪Rajang≫ up in the
Arena went just fine,
but now it is rampaging so hard
nobody can lay a hand on it!
Hey, you. Think you could
do something about that thing?
We will supply the equipment,
so I am counting on you!

61430.objectiveJp: イベント補助券１枚の納品
61430.description: A big eater living in the Canyon is causing trouble for my friends, meow. I want you to get rid of him, meow! As thanks I will give you what you need to make a rare Hunting Party Poogie outfit, meow. I am counting on you, meow!
61430.descriptionEn:
A glutton living in the Canyon is
causing trouble for its fellows,
ya!
I want you to get rid of it, nya!
As thanks I will give you what
you need to make a rare Guild
Poogie outfit, nya. Please do it,
yaa!

55617.objectiveJp: マーブル鉱石１０個の納品
55617.description: You gathered a great deal of material for me before, but as more materials are now needed I am issuing the request again. Since the amount is large, I recommend gathering the materials first and taking this request afterwards.
55617.descriptionEn:
You gathered a great many materials
for us before, but since more
materials have become necessary,
we are issuing this request again.
As the amount is large, we suggest
gathering the materials first and
then accepting this request.

21009.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21009.description: At the waterside this season, the Shield Crab Daimyo Hermitaur may show itself! Dealing damage to a body protected by a hard shell is not easy! It is also OK to carve Crab Miso from Zamite and deliver that!
21009.descriptionEn:
At the waterside this season,
the shield crab ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫
may appear! Its body is guarded
by a hard shell, so dealing
damage is no easy task! You can
also carve ≪Ceanataur Paste≫
from Hermitaurs and deliver it!

23478.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
23478.description: The Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23478.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫
has become fiercely powerful and
continues to rampage.
As things stand it is very dangerous.
Please prepare thoroughly before
you set out on the survey.

55137.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
55137.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Forokururu while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55137.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Forokururu raises your
standing while letting you obtain
the materials needed to get
G Rank decorations at a good
value.
Please make the most of it.

61073.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
61073.description: This is the quest used for the final round of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The materials of the target monster cannot be obtained from carving or from the clear reward.
61073.descriptionEn:
This is the quest used for the
final round of the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament.
The materials of the target
monster cannot be obtained
from carving or from the
clear reward.

62320.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62320.description: It is I, the Instructor! This is a quest for the Refined Monster trial! Today's target is the Variant Velocidrome! I wish to hear how the feel of the fight changed before and after refining!
62320.descriptionEn:
It is I. The Instructor!
This is a quest for the Refine
Monster trial event!
This time the target is
≪Velocidrome Variant≫!
I wish to hear how the challenge
changed between before and
after the refinement!

63017.description: Dreams of men swirl in the arms workshop, and in particular the thunder element great sword and dragon element great sword made by applying a machine saw are things everyone admires! It was lost once at the prototype stage, but a hot dream revives any number of times!
63017.descriptionEn:
Dreams of men swirl around the
smithy, and above all the Thunder
and Dragon element Great Swords
made by applying a machine saw
are things everyone longs for!
We lost one at the prototype stage,
but a burning dream like that
comes back again and again!

26285.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26285.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?

23383.description: The survey team that headed for the Snowy Mountains reports finding the carcasses of many monsters near the summit. From their pitiful state, it is assumed to be the work of a very ferocious monster. Hunter confident in your skill, restore peace to the Snowy Mountains.
23383.descriptionEn:
The survey team that went to the
Snowy Mountains reports that many
monster carcasses were found near
the summit.
From that gruesome sight, it is
thought to be the work of a very
ferocious monster.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please restore peace to the
Snowy Mountains.

21351.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21351.description: It seems rare blue Hypnocatrice have been found in the sea of trees. Those things cry out during the day and are unbearably noisy. So, may I ask, would you go and slay them? My thanks will be blue feathers. If you break the beaks too, it will be even more refreshing.
21351.descriptionEn:
Rare azure Hypnocatrice have been
found in the Great Forest, it
seems.
Those things screech all through
the day and are unbearable.
So here is my proposal: would you
slay them for me?
My thanks will be "Blue Feathers".
Break their beaks as well and it
will feel even better.

60584.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Congalala. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60584.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! The target this
time is ≪Congalala≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and try to
win a place in the top ranks!
Also, this time it is Origin
weapons only! Choose with care!

21323.description: What, you just want a hard Sword and Shield? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21323.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Sword and Shield?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!

55305.description: The Variant Species Rathalos appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Rathalos. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55305.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rathalos≫ seems
to have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Rathalos.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.

62952.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
62952.description: Thanks for playing MHF for five whole years! Equip Akra Tsinie and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude N as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude N you can forge Dancing Thunder Claw (Long Sword).
62952.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for five whole years!
Equip ≪Akra Tsinie≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude N≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
N≫ you can forge ≪Dancing
Thunder Claw≫ (Long Sword).

62485.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62485.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

23622.description: A Plesioth with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Plesioth known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23622.descriptionEn:
A Water Wyvern with a greatly
developed head has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts, and will
conduct a survey. Reports say
it is more dangerous than
Water Wyvern seen before.
Please survey it with care.

21809.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

23220.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
23220.description: I want help exploring an unsurveyed area of the swamp. That said, I do not want you to gather anything. There is information that a Shogun Ceanataur is at the destination. It is a somewhat dangerous place for me to go alone. Won't you take it on?
23220.descriptionEn:
I would like your help exploring
an unsurveyed part of the Swamp.
That said, it is not that I want
you to gather anything.
Word has it a Sickle Crab is
somewhere along the way.
It is a bit too dangerous a place
for me to head into alone.
Would you take it on for me?

1007.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! The Kut-Ku is normally pink, but this one is blue! That has to be a subspecies!
1007.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange birdlike cry
in this Jungle, it is without a doubt
the Bird Wyvern ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
Normally a Yian Kut-Ku has a
pink body color, but this time
its color is blue! This has to be
a Subspecies, no question!

50214.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ４匹の捕獲
50214.description: Brought together by a chain of coincidences, you hunters met here in Mezepolta Plaza. In hunting, the most important thing is the spirit of helping one another. Do not forget your bonds, and complete this request too!
50214.descriptionEn:
Hunters who met here in this
Mezeporuta Square through so
many chances overlapping.
The most important thing when
hunting is the spirit of helping
each other.
Without forgetting your bond,
please clear this request too!

55754.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55754.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

26425.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
26425.description: The legendary black dragon, Fatalis, seems to be doing something sinister in the deepest reaches of the untrodden volcano! At this rate calamity may rain down on the world! Hurry to the volcano and repel the enraged Fatalis!
26425.descriptionEn:
The legendary Black Dragon, Fatalis,
appears to be up to something
sinister in the deepest reaches of
an untouched volcano!! If this
continues, calamity may rain down
upon the world! Hurry to the
Volcano and repel the angry Black Dragon!

62476.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
62476.description: Is it not fun to dodge a Bulldrome's charge by a hair's breadth? The thrill of a paper-thin dodge! I want everyone to know this joy! Now, will you try it too?
62476.descriptionEn:
Isn't it fun to dodge a Bulldrome's
charge at the very last second?
That thrill when you slip past
by a hair's breadth!
I want everyone to know
this joy for themselves!
Come on, won't you try it too?

53280.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
53280.description: A Shogun of utter cruelty who cuts down the people night after night has taken up position in the Volcano with armored warriors and henchmen. The guard is strict, but there must be a gap. There is no map, but make use of a secret medicine that senses presences and slay the Shogun under cover of darkness!
53280.descriptionEn:
A cruel Shogun Ceanataur that
carves up the people night
after night has taken position
in the Volcano with armored
warriors and underlings.
Its guard is strict, but there
must be a gap. With no map,
use a potion that senses
presence and strike from
the dark!

60248.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
60248.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toa Tesukatora. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60248.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! The target this
time is ≪Toa Tesukatora≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and try to
win a place in the top ranks!
Also, this time it is SP
weapons only! Choose with care!

61613.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61613.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61613.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

28072.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
28072.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Break the designated parts of a monster and slay it together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28072.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between you all,
I have prepared a difficult request
for you. You are to break the
specified parts of a monster and slay it
together with your Guild companions.
No supply items will be provided at all,
so discuss it with your companions
beforehand and then depart.
Your reward shall be a special ore!

61344.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
61344.description: Have you heard about the Kinos Secret Stone! It was a special ore not seen around here, and now that it's been found, artisans and hunters are in an uproar. If you bring it to me now, I'll churn out fine armor of distant origin, so bring it here!
61344.descriptionEn:
Hey, have you heard about the
Kinos Secret Stone?
It is a special ore never seen
around here, and now that it has
been found, smiths and hunters
alike are in an uproar. Right now
I will churn out fine armor from
far lands, so bring it
to my place!

26708.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
26708.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!

62809.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62809.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

60814.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲

53149.description: KYOGUWAAAAA! TEEG! GUWAWA NGUWAWAWA DEEG UAGUWAWA HAWAA UWAWAWA NAGGA GAAAGOO BYUUWAWAWA GAA!
53149.descriptionEn:
Kyogwaaaa!
Teeg! Gwawa
Ngu gwawawa
Deeg aguwawa
Hawaa uwwawa
Naagagwaagu
Byuuwwwaga

9.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
9.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

21617.description: Have you heard of the Aster Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21617.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Shion Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.

56012.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56012.description: The Blast Mist Wyvern has appeared once more in the Ashen Gleam Sphere survey area. We want it driven off. This time we will collect more Starry Sky Coins than before. In exchange, we will give you more ore and other rewards. We thank you in advance.
56012.descriptionEn:
The Blast Mist Wyvern has appeared
again in the Kaiki Orb survey area.
We would like you to drive it off.
This time we will collect more
Starry Sky Coins than last time.
In exchange, we will hand over more
rewards such as raw ore.
Thank you for your help.

54676.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further their awareness and promotion. By breaking the wings of the Yian Garuga, we will also grant you a special food ingredient.
54676.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared this
quest to further their awareness
and promotion.
By breaking the wings of the
Yian Garuga, we will also grant
you a special food ingredient.

54862.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
54862.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54862.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

50776.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50776.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of an Azure Rathalos will also grant a special ingredient.
50776.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long carried out,
we have prepared this quest to
spread awareness and promote them
even further.
By destroying the Azure Rathalos'
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

50264.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
50264.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! My eternal rival, the champion of jealousy and heartbreak [Eve], does not give up easily! Now go, hunters! Mow down Eve's terror! To protect the holy night of lovers!
50264.descriptionEn:
The dashing hero who guards the
love and peace of lovers, Sasatto!
My eternal rival, the champion of
jealousy and ruin, [Eve], does
not know when to give up!
Now go, hunters!
Mow down Eve's terror!
To protect the lovers' holy night!

50364.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50364.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Berukyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
50364.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Duramboros' head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

50577.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
50577.description: You there! I hear you produced a Dyuragaua weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Dyuragaua. I am counting on you!
50577.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you crafted a weapon
from the Ice Fox Dragon.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about upgrade materials
as pay?
It's an easy job. Just run
over and slay a Duramboros.
I'm counting on you!

55401.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55401.description: Can we overcome the white wind that blows sharp and wild? The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Galloping Nargacuga. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55401.descriptionEn:
Can we overcome the white wind
that blows so fiercely?
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Dashing Nargacuga'.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

21877.description: A request for hunters who have crafted weapons of the Inity Series. Hunt Basarios and you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the High Rank weapon Ciprela Series.
21877.descriptionEn:
This request is for hunters who
have forged weapons of the
Inity Series.
Hunting a Basarios will get you
the materials needed to forge
and upgrade the High Rank
weapon line, the Siprela Series.

23647.description: The Variant Species Inagami appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Inagami. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23647.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Inagami≫ seems to
have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Inagami.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.

61841.description: Yo. Long time no see. Are you enjoying mining today too? I have prepared a job to show you how good mining is again. Gather three of the five kinds including Rusted Fragments. The reward is ready, so go with confidence!
61841.descriptionEn:
Yo. Long time no see.
Still enjoying your mining?
I've got a request for you,
to show off how good mining is.
Gather any 3 of 5 kinds,
rusted chunks and the like.
The reward is ready and waiting,
so off you go with confidence!

54480.description: A report has come from an investigator that the moon peering from the farthest land shortens day by day the cycle in which it turns crimson, and deepens that crimson. The Guild takes this as an omen of ill things to come and has decided to send outstanding hunters. Please depart for the site at once.
54480.descriptionEn:
The moon that peers from the far
ends of the earth reddens, its
crimson cycle growing shorter
day by day and its redness
deepening, a researcher reports.
The Guild takes this as an omen
that ill fortune will come, and
has decided to send skilled
hunters.
Depart for the site at once.

51048.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
51048.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed for F strengthening of
Secret Art Armor (Blademaster),
except for Weapon Souls.
The yield covers 5 pieces.
To accept the quest you need
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫, so please
take care.

61349.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
61349.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one, and it is just like a play!
Let me have you join in that
festival too. Oops, don't bring
anything dangerous in, all right.
Only the weapon that marks you a
hunter will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!

62184.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62184.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62184.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

21846.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21846.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

23243.description: I saw a Rajang leap into the crater. I had no idea a Rajang would be in a place like that, so I was very surprised. I am going to go and survey it now. Is there anyone who would guard me?
23243.descriptionEn:
I saw a Rajang dive straight
into the crater.
I had no idea a Rajang would
be in a place like that, so
it gave me quite a shock.
I am thinking of heading out
to survey it now. Is there
anyone who would escort me?

63025.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

50936.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! It has been a while! The marriage-seeking monster that hates June brides is on a rampage! And it has started saying love is not even necessary! Now, hunters! Protect the bright family plans of lovers!
50936.descriptionEn:
The dashing hero who guards the
love and peace of lovers, Sasatto!
It has been a while!
A marriage-hunting monster that
hates June brides is on a rampage!
And now it says love is not necessary!
Now, hunters!
Protect the bright family plans
of lovers!

63145.objectiveJp: ハンターカード白１０枚納品
63145.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
63145.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

55080.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
55080.description: They say a raw, wet sound of something devouring flesh and blood comes up from beneath Tide Island. When a hunter went down into the great pit to look, two red eyes came bursting out of the dust and the stench and charged him. Whoever discovers what this creature is will receive the materials to craft armor the guild has kept hidden.
55080.descriptionEn:
They say a raw, fleshy sound of
devouring meat can be heard from
beneath the Tidal Island.
When a hunter climbed down into
the great pit to look, two red
glowing eyes came lunging out of
the dust with a terrible stench.
Whoever uncovers what this thing
is will receive Guild armor materials.

21129.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21129.description: The Shogun Ceanataur is a creature that uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling. In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too. Mind the sharp claws of each one.
21129.descriptionEn:
The Carapaceon ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
is a creature that uses its strange
leg joints to climb even onto
ceilings.
In the Volcano this season, many
of its young ≪Gamisami≫ should
also be about. Beware the sharp
claws of each.

55481.description: A Variant Species Espinas with greatly developed horns has appeared. Its virulent poison has led many hunters to give up the hunt. The guild will expand the supplied items and, when you set out as 4, provide further support. Please go to the investigation with care.
55481.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Espinas with greatly
developed horns has appeared.
Many hunters have given up on
slaying it because of its venom.
The Guild is expanding supplies
and will provide further support
only when four depart together.
Please head out on the survey
with care.

54156.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

23272.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
23272.description: The survey team heading for the desert has been attacked by a yellow bird wyvern and cannot advance. Head for the desert and resolve the problem. The monster appears to be extremely quick and its claws highly dangerous. Take care.
23272.descriptionEn:
A survey team heading into the
Desert was attacked by a yellow
Bird Wyvern and is stuck, unable
to move on.
Head for the Desert and see to
resolving this problem.
It seems to be extremely fast and
its claws are highly dangerous.
Please be careful out there.

62002.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Pariapuria. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62002.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest, slaying
≪Pariapuria≫.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not polish
your skills together with fellow
hunters!

26656.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26656.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

50240.description: My first request, so I am nervous. There is a musician I simply must tell music lovers about. They are so cool, truly. But I am too shy, so I would be glad if you would film them for me instead. I will cheer from the shadows! Once you meet them, spread the word to everyone!
50240.descriptionEn:
This is my first request, so I'm
nervous. There's a musician I
really want music lovers to hear.
He's cool, seriously.
But I'm too shy, so I'd be glad
if you could take photos instead.
I'll be cheering from the shadows!
If you meet him, tell everyone!

21359.objectiveJp:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡかＢの狩猟
21359.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Forest and Hills, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Wind Cave, the Voice of Nature: Blossoms, or the Voice of Nature: Grassland. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21359.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target, or
sub-target A or B
21359.descriptionEn:
I hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request
set in the Forest and Hills,
you may obtain Voice of
Nature: Wind Cave, Voice of
Nature: Blooming, or Voice
of Nature: Grassland.
May your hunting life flourish.

21249.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21249.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

55910.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55910.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.

60628.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Wyvern Eggs. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
60628.descriptionEn:
From the popular tavern Guild comes
a large order for Flying Wyvern
Eggs. Eight is more than one
person can carry and deliver
alone, so we recommend at least
two people take this on.
Note that there are no supply
items for clearing sub-quests.

26504.description: Mining is good work. While you dig you can empty your mind. When I head to the hunting grounds, I always bring a pickaxe! So then, the next request. This time too I await a delivery of fine ore. Look forward to the reward!
26504.descriptionEn:
Mining is great, isn't it?
While you dig, your mind goes
blank. When I head out to
hunt, I always bring a
pickaxe along with me!
So, here's the next request.
I'm waiting on good ore again.
Expect a fine reward!

54622.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54622.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54622.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, show the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will gain even more reward than
what your daily efforts bring.

62778.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62778.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

54742.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54742.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

50152.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

64552.description:
Are you ready to suffer?
It's very dangerous to go
alone! You'll face a
freezing hell, I wish you
luck. I'll be kind enough
and give you a nice hint:
don't exploit it!

21864.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Stroma FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21864.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
upgrade materials for all five
parts of the ≪Zenith Armor≫
Stroma FX Series.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please be aware.

40196.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
40196.description: This quest is suited to gathering materials for the G Rank decoration Torai Sword Jewel GX4. It also makes it easier to raise your standing as a G Rank hunter (ＧＲ). During the quest, the skill Great Luck activates. Please make use of it.
40196.descriptionEn:
This quest is well suited to
gathering materials for the G Rank
decoration ≪Shining Thunder Sword
Jewel GX4≫.
It also makes it easier to raise
your standing (GR) as a G Rank
hunter.
During the quest, the ≪Good Luck≫
skill activates. Please make use of it.

56154.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
56154.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56154.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.

62541.objectiveJp: ハーフチケット白１枚の納品
62541.description: A quest reserved for hunters who have earned excellent results in official hunting tournaments! You can get your hands on handy items such as Dauntless Seeds and Disposable Earplugs. Once you have made your mark in an official tournament and obtained a Half Ticket White, come and see me!
62541.descriptionEn:
A quest only for hunters who
took excellent results in the
official hunting tournament!
You can obtain handy items such
as "Fearless Seed" and
"Disposable Super Earplugs".
If you took part in the official
tournament and got a "Half Ticket
White", come by all means!

12015.description: If you can hunt the Queen of the Land, Rathian, then you are a hunter who can hunt well enough even in this great hall. If you feel a difference in strength beyond compare, simply taking a Wyvern Egg from the nest would serve as proof of courage.
12015.descriptionEn:
If you can hunt the Queen of the
Land ≪Rathian≫, then you are a
hunter who can hunt well enough
even in this Great Elder Hall.
If you feel the gap in strength
is too great, then simply taking
a ≪Wyvern Egg≫ from her nest is
proof enough of courage.

21261.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１６頭の討伐
21261.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, the notorious Bulldrome that have raided many villages have been loosed into the arena! Their fury-filled tusks bear down on the hunters!
21261.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show off
their skill!
This time, the infamous great
boars that have raided many
villages have been released into
the Arena!
Fangs full of rage assail the
hunters!

50773.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50773.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
50773.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

54620.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54620.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against Tigrex in the desert! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
54620.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Lance, show the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will gain even more reward than
what your daily efforts bring.

62512.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the rock wyvern Basarios together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62512.descriptionEn:
It is I. The Instructor!
This time, how about hunting the
Rock Wyvern ≪Basarios≫ together
with a hunter who has climbed
all the way to holding a Secret Art
book? Learn their distinctive
movements, and if you clear the
request together, extra rewards await!

50536.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・四章１個の納品

26017.description: The solitary one-horned wyvern Monoblos may be called the king that pairs with Diablos in the Desert. To hunt it with 1 hunter is held to be proof of a first-rate hunter. There is nothing for it but to try.
26017.descriptionEn:
The solitary one-horned
dragon ≪Monoblos≫ could well
be called the king that pairs
with Diablos in the Desert.
To ≪hunt it alone≫ is said
to prove a Hunter is first-rate.
All that remains is to try.

62604.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
62604.description: On the way over the skies of the Snowy Mountains, that bewitching coloured one is in the way. Go ahead of it and do something about it on your end, would you? And while you are at it, it would help if you planted a flag so we can pass the summit safely. You will grant an old one's unreasonable request once a year, yes?
62604.descriptionEn:
When crossing the skies over the
Snowy Mountains, that bewitchingly
colored thing gets in the way.
Could you get ahead of it and
do something about it for me?
And while you are at it, it would
help if you planted a flag so we
can pass the summit safely.
You will humor an old man's once-
a-year recklessness, won't you?

50719.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
50719.description: We have received a report of encountering a dragon clad in red carapace in the decisive battlefield. It seems they were attacked the moment they tried to take home a cactus growing in that land. There may be some connection between this monster and the cactus. Please head to the site and investigate.
50719.descriptionEn:
We received a report of a dragon
clad in red carapace met at the
Battlefield. It attacked the
moment they tried to carry home
a cactus growing there.
There may be some connection
between this monster and the
cactus. Head to the site and
survey it.

12016.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

55045.description: It has been decided to select the legend Rasta who will go in search of a new prayer jewel to save the Songstress. We will give a Hunter Pass (Yellow) to hunters skilled enough to slay Kushala Daora, so please vote for the Rasta you think is most suitable among the 3 candidates.
55045.descriptionEn:
To save the songstress, we will
select a Legend Rasta to set out
in search of a new prayer orb.
To all hunters with the skill to
slay a Kushala Daora, we will hand
out the "Hunter Pass: Yellow,"
so please vote for the Rasta you
