consider best among the three
candidates.

21266.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time your opponents are the kings of the sky, 2 Rathalos! In a storm of fierce blows, who will raise the cry of victory here, the King of the Sky or the King of the Hunt? Challengers, come forth!
21266.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Today's opponents are two
≪Rathalos≫, the Kings of the Sky!
Amid the exchange of fierce
attacks, who will raise the cry
of victory here: the King of the
Sky, or the King of the Hunt?
Challengers, come forth!

63119.description: Word has it that White Star Iron has been found in the wasteland known as the Canyon. Anyone who wants White Star Iron, why not join the survey party? We supply the goods and the food. Once supplies run out you will be living off the land, so join only if you are prepared for that.
63119.descriptionEn:
There is a rumor that White Star Iron
has been found in the wasteland,
≪Canyon≫. Anyone who wants
White Star Iron, why not join the
survey team? We have prepared
goods and food on our side.
If need be you will live off the
land, so only those with resolve
should join.

26367.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26367.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

62757.description: We have prepared a request that issues the tickets needed for HC quests. A comparatively weak monster appears, so why not join? However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
62757.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a request
that issues the tickets
needed for ≪HC Quests≫.
Relatively weak monsters
will appear, so why not come
along and take part?
However, it cannot be taken
in succession, so please
keep that in mind.

51050.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
51050.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed for F strengthening of
Secret Art Armor (Gunner),
except for Weapon Souls.
The yield covers 5 pieces.
To accept the quest you need
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫, so please
take care.

12064.description: Gravios is known as the Tyrant of the Blaze; to challenge the outer shell it grew to absurd hardness by eating coal and ore, you need well-honed equipment. Slipping past the Armor Wyvern to deliver Blast Rock is fine as well, you know?
12064.descriptionEn:
≪Gravios≫ is known as the
Emperor of Blazing Heat. To
face the shell it grew from
eating coal and ore, you
need finely honed gear.
Slipping past the Armor
Wyvern to deliver ≪Blast Stone≫?

60534.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

55242.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55242.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.

11075.description: Hermitaur buried in the sand burst out suddenly. Running around is dangerous, so be careful! They faint when startled by loud noises, so do not forget to bring Sonic Bombs!
11075.descriptionEn:
The Yaozami that lurk in the
sand will burst out without
warning. Running around is
dangerous, so please be careful!
Loud noises stun them, so do not
forget to bring Sonic Bombs
along with you!

12028.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

62399.description: The Gravios seem to have grown more active in the volcano. Few people go there at the best of times, but a certain wealthy man has asked us to secure the area. A man who owns so many rare materials will surely pay an exceptional reward. Come, show us what a first-rate hunter can do!
62399.descriptionEn:
The ≪Gravios≫ in the Volcano
seem to have grown more active.
It is a place few usually enter,
but a wealthy man has asked us
to secure the area around it.
He owns many rare materials, so
the reward should be extraordinary.
Now, show us what a top hunter
can really do!

54848.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
54848.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
54848.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to call
these ones "the Starving
Deviljho."
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
Caged and given no meat, they
have been driven to the limit.
Brave hunter.
Should you succeed in slaying one,
we shall grant you materials for
Guild treasury armor.

62082.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62082.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Azure Rathalos in the arena. Clear the quest without mishap and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
62082.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Azure Rathalos≫
waiting in the Arena.
If you safely clear
the quest, your standing
as hunters will shoot
straight up!

21796.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

55588.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55588.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

21985.description: A Supremacy Doragyurosu, said to reduce all to ash, has appeared! Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
21985.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Doragyurosu, said to
reduce all things to ash, has
appeared!
This is a race against time, so
the request is to slay it in a
short time, but to keep the
damage minimal, a mere repel will
also be counted.
We seek hunters with Secret Arts
who will face this
unprecedented crisis!

60557.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
60557.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Odibatorasu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60557.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Odibatorasu≫!
Achieve the goal together with
your Guild companions.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest, so try to win a
place in the top ranks!
Also, this time it is Origin
weapons only! Choose with care!

58062.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58062.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58062.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

26655.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26655.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

63280.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
63280.description: Reading the lost map has revealed a new fact. The Orugaron seem to appear in the hidden area of the Ancient Tower. If you are lucky enough to encounter them, you should be able to obtain the Frozen Fang, an upgrade material for ice swords. Furthermore, if you hunt 2 Orugaron, I will give an extra reward!
63280.descriptionEn:
Deciphering the lost map revealed
a new fact.
Orugaron are said to appear in
the hidden reaches of the ≪Ancient Tower≫.
If you are lucky enough to meet
one, you should be able to obtain
the ice sword upgrade material
≪Freezing Fang≫.
What is more, hunt two Orugaron
and we will hand out extra rewards!

50363.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50363.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of a Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
50363.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

54709.description: A trial quest for the G8 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy the Sen'yu Species Zinogre a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54709.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
"G8 Early Access Trial."
Please enjoy the Transcendent
Zinogre ahead of everyone!
The time limit is 10 minutes.

51025.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
51025.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards. When accepting or
joining, please be sure to have
your Festival Proof with you.

26624.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26624.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

28034.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Rukodiora materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28034.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters.
Why not pass your hunting skill
down to the young hunters of
your Guild? This time we are
splurging on ≪Disufiroa≫
materials! Grow stronger together
and liven up the Guild.
Clearing it with one hunter who
holds a Secret Art book and one
who does not earns more Guild credit.

23598.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
23598.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.

54181.objectiveJp: 木彫りの人形・灰１個の納品
54181.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54181.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.

50868.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
50868.description: Reports say Brachydios are appearing in various regions. The Guild wants them hunted at once, but study of the Brachydios ecology has not progressed. For research, break its head and forelegs as far as you can. Your reward will be increased accordingly.
50868.descriptionEn:
There are reports that the
Crushing Wyvern, Brachydios, has
appeared in various regions.
The Guild wants it hunted at once,
but research into the Crushing
Wyvern's ecology has not advanced.
For study, please break its head
and forelegs as much as you can.
The reward will be all the
better for it.

23620.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
23620.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23620.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rukodiora≫ has
grown violently strong and keeps
rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as it
stands. Please prepare fully and
conduct the survey.

40225.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
40225.description: A great swarm of monsters wearing mechanical life-form masks has appeared in the Grand Arena. Our YoRHa unit alone cannot handle them, so we want to ask for rescue. We have prepared equipment to fight them.
40225.descriptionEn:
A great swarm of monsters
wearing the masks of machine
lifeforms has appeared in the
Great Arena.
Our YoRHa unit alone cannot
handle them all, so we ask for
reinforcements.
We have prepared equipment to
fight them.

54769.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54769.description: A peddler walking the desert reports sighting a Black Diablos moving under cover of darkness. It is violent in temper, and its jet-black body is feared as a messenger of death. Hunt with the utmost care.
54769.descriptionEn:
A traveling merchant walking
the Desert reported seeing a
≪Black Diablos≫ moving under
cover of darkness. It is
violent, and its jet-black
body is feared as a reaper.
Please hunt it with great care.

50246.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50246.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

26084.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
26084.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26084.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

21152.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
21152.description: The Barbarian Wyvern newly confirmed in the highlands. It is a dangerous flying wyvern to begin with, but among them an individual of outstanding strength was confirmed the other day. It will be a very dangerous request, but please investigate and hunt it!
21152.descriptionEn:
A ≪Taikun Zamuza≫ newly confirmed
in the Highlands. Even for an
already dangerous wyvern, an
exceptionally powerful individual
was sighted the other day.
This will be a very dangerous
request, but please survey and hunt it!

60927.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60927.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

26118.description: Zamite is a small carapaceon with a hard shell. It lurks underground and can cut you up badly if you get close, so watch for sand clouds rising from the ground. It's weak to sound, so a Sonic Bomb makes the fight easy!
26118.descriptionEn:
≪Yao Zami≫ are small
carapaceons with hard
shells. They lurk in the
ground, and can slash you
up if you get close, so
watch where sand puffs up.
They hate noise, so toss a
Sonic Bomb and it's easy!

50729.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50729.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Berukyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
50729.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Duramboros' head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

53091.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

62145.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
62145.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.

54425.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest in which rare gathering materials are guaranteed to appear. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54425.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for those in a Guild
on the winning side of the Hunters
Festival, we have prepared a quest
where rare materials from gathering
are guaranteed to appear.
When you accept or join, please
bring the Festival's ardor with you.

61409.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐

54297.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54297.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

26382.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26382.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

55348.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55348.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55348.descriptionEn:
Drive it off, and the beast will
come dancing back once more.
So the Guild has decided to call
that shining one "Guanzorumu,
Ruler of the Acme."
In the end, we must slay it.
To any hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild armor, and a title!

55331.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐

55644.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55644.description: A quest aimed at hunters who do not yet possess the Variant skill cuffs Poison Resistance Boost Cuff ＳＺ and Tremor Resistance Boost Cuff ＳＺ, intended to spread those cuffs. So that the guild can support you as well, the rewards lean toward cuff crafting. Please take the quest with vigour.
55644.descriptionEn:
This quest is aimed at those who
do not yet own the Supremacy Skill
Cuffs ≪Antipoison Cuff SZ≫ and
≪Tremor Res Cuff SZ≫, and its
purpose is to spread those cuffs.
So that the Guild can support you,
the rewards lean toward cuff
crafting, so please accept it
with enthusiasm.

21660.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
21660.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Lutetia Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21660.descriptionEn:
Notes said to have been lost,
recording the secret of weapon
crafting, are apparently being
found on monsters slain across
the land, I tell ya!
If you get a ≪Lutetia Memo≫,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work, I
will!

61257.description: 2 Gypceros are rampaging in the poisonous swamp, and Variants at that, it seems. It is a very dangerous situation, but if you hunt both, the Guild will give a special reward, so please. Getting close is dangerous, so respond with ranged weapons!
61257.descriptionEn:
Two Gypceros, and Variants at
that, are said to be rampaging in
the poison Swamp. It is a very
dangerous situation, but if you
hunt both, the Guild will pay
a special reward, so please help.
Getting close is dangerous, so
handle them with ranged weapons!

11042.description: If you're hit by the dung Congalala throws, you won't be able to use healing items! If hunting Congalala is difficult, please trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
11042.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Congalala≫'s
dung and you can't use
healing items!
If hunting the ≪Congalala≫
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver it, please!

62339.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐

63323.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63323.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63323.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

50132.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50132.description: Nyaa nyaa nyaa! I prepared a slightly difficult job, meow. Take it and I will give you a Dark Cat Pack Medal, meow! If you can clear it, that is, meow!!
50132.descriptionEn:
Nya nya nya!
I prepared a slightly hard request,
nya. If you take this request,
I will give you a ≪Dark Cat Guild
Medal≫, nya!
Only if you can clear it, though, nya!!

55144.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐

26283.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26283.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?

61050.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
61050.description: A great outbreak of the bird wyvern Yian Kut-Ku has been reported in the Jungle! Hunt them and more keep coming, their cries echoing through the Jungle! Reverse this situation, which amounts to a counterattack on hunters, and take the Jungle back from the bird wyverns!
61050.descriptionEn:
A great outbreak of the Yian
Kut-Ku has been reported in the
Jungle! Hunt them and still more
of their cries echo through the
woods! Turn this around, this
counterattack on hunters, and
take the Jungle back from them!

61024.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の狩猟
61024.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61024.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

62756.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
62756.description: A new species of Carapaceon has been discovered in the caves of Tide Island. The Hunters Guild has named it Taikun Zamuza. It seems to be a Carapaceon that evolved in its own way on the island, and it is said to be marked by two scythes of entirely different shapes. We ask for further study.
62756.descriptionEn:
A new Carapaceon has been found
in the caves of Tidal Island.
The Hunters Guild has named it
the Many-Shell Crab ≪Taikun
Zamuza≫.
It seems to be a Carapaceon that
evolved uniquely on Tidal Island,
and its two scythes of utterly
different shapes are its feature.
We ask for a further survey.

28049.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟

62241.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
62241.description: What, you just want hard Dual Blades? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62241.descriptionEn:
What, you want really hard Dual
Blades?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!

63024.description: The final decisive battle at last! The awakened Red Hunter and the Death God Emperor, who has revealed his true form. The Death God Emperor's weakness is said to be the two fine horns he grows when he transforms, so please recreate the scene up to destroying them. Cast off the curse and seize glory! Our Red Hunter!
63024.descriptionEn:
At last, the final battle!
The awakened Red Hunter against
the Death Emperor in his true form.
The Death Emperor's weak point is
apparently the fine pair of horns
it has when transformed, so please
re-enact the fight up to breaking them.
Shake off the curse and seize glory!
Our Red Hunter!

63173.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63173.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63173.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50945.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
50945.description: The survey party reports detecting charged erosion dragonbugs from monster footprints found in the Snowy Mountains. This may be a new subspecies! However, contact with the party has been cut off since! Head for the site at once!
50945.descriptionEn:
We have reports that charged
Erosion Dragonbugs were
detected in monster footprints
found by the survey team in the
≪Snowy Mountains≫.
It may be a new Subspecies
monster! But since then all
contact with the team has
ceased!
Head for the site at once!

55468.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55468.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora has appeared once more. Its wings and its magnetic power have grown stronger, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55468.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Rukodiora has
appeared again.
Its wings and magnetism have
grown stronger, and it seems
to have gained more power.
Survey with great care.

54511.description: We are continuing our survey of the Hypnocatrice. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54511.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey
of the Hypnocatrice.
Breaking parts is not
mandatory, but if you do it
we would be delighted!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid out there!

23212.description: There are reports that rocks suddenly attacked travelers on the road near the volcano. The area has not been fully surveyed, but there is no doubt it is a Basarios. Please deal with it before serious damage is done.
23212.descriptionEn:
We received a report that rocks
suddenly attacked along the road
close to the Volcano.
The area has not been surveyed
yet, but it must surely be a
Basarios.
Before serious damage occurs,
please deal with it.

54228.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
54228.description: While surveying the sea of trees, I witnessed a mysterious shadow flying through the sky. That must be a bizarre monster never seen before! If it can be found, it would be a very lucky event for our survey team!
54228.descriptionEn:
While surveying the Great Forest,
I saw a mysterious shape flying
through the sky.
That must be a bizarre monster
unlike anything I have ever seen!
If we could find it, it would be
a truly lucky event for our
survey team!

50734.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
50734.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the head of an Azure Rathalos will also grant a special ingredient.
50734.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Azure Rathalos's head,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.

62543.objectiveJp: ハーフチケット白１枚の納品
62543.description: A quest reserved for hunters who have earned excellent results in official hunting tournaments! You can get your hands on an HC Ticket. Once you have made your mark in an official tournament and obtained a Half Ticket White, come and see me!
62543.descriptionEn:
This quest is only for hunters
who scored well in the
official hunting tournament!
You can get an "HC Ticket."
If you did well in the
official tournament and got a
"Half Ticket White," come
and join us!

51006.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51006.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
51006.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, display the skill you
have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.

53124.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
53124.description: A request that lets hunters who reached HR 31 obtain the recommended decoration Gougo Jewel. Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur to obtain the decoration Gougo Jewel, which carries Attack, Expert and Earplug skill points. Please make use of it in your hunting life from now on.
53124.descriptionEn:
A request that lets hunters who
reached HR 31 obtain the
recommended decoration ≪Gougo Jewel≫.
Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur to obtain
the decoration ≪Gougo Jewel≫,
which carries Attack, Expert and
Earplug skill points.
Please make use of it in your
hunting life from now on.

61903.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石２個の納品
61903.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61903.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

54805.description: 2 unidentified monsters of great power are on a rampage together at the Ancient Tower. Head out to slay them at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Secret Art armor, in preparation for greater threats.
54805.descriptionEn:
Two unidentified monsters of
great power are on a rampage
at the Ancient Tower at once.
Please head out and slay them
as fast as you can!
If you save us from this crisis,
we will provide materials used
for some G Rank Secret Art
Armor, in preparation for worse.

28014.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
28014.description: Hey. Today I trained in the night desert, enduring the cold. I set my own goal and took it on, but I'm still no good. I can't kill it within this time. So I thought the hunting party members might manage, and sent this request. How about it?
28014.descriptionEn:
Yo! Today it is special training in
the night Desert, enduring the cold.
I set my own goal and took it on,
but I am still no good. I cannot
beat it within this time.
So I thought the Guild members
might manage it, and I filed this
request. How about it?

54560.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
54560.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54560.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

63290.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63290.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

62822.description: To chase a reward this far, what spirit! The materials everyone wants drop in plenty, but this Lao-Shan Lung is strong, so go at it as if it were a Hardcore quest! Ah, note that you need a Festival Proof to accept it.
62822.descriptionEn:
Getting this reward too shows
real guts, nyah! You'll get
all sorts of materials folks
crave, but this ≪Lao-Shan Lung≫
is strong, so go in thinking
it's a ≪Hardcore Quest≫, nyah!
Oh, you need a ≪Festival Proof≫
to accept, so be aware, nyah.

54382.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐

22013.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
22013.description: Hunt the 1 blue hunter, Velocidrome, that uses the Jungle as its feeding ground! It is just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt! In this season there are fewer Velociprey minions, so it is a good opportunity!
22013.descriptionEn:
Hunt 1 of the blue hunters,
≪Velocidrome≫, that feed in
the Jungle!
He is just the right foe to
test your skill as a hunter!
This season his Velociprey
lackeys are scarce, so go now!

26210.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ１個の納品
26210.description: Steady, patient gathering is the first step to success in the hunt. So that you never forget that beginner's spirit, the guild has prepared this quest. Like the Patience Seed you receive as a reward, keep at it quietly until the day your flower blooms.
26210.descriptionEn:
Hunting, too, starts with steady
and honest gathering.
So that you never forget that
beginner's spirit, our Guild
prepared this quest.
Following the reward ≪Seed of
Patience≫, let us work steadily
until the day the flower blooms.

60437.description: In the places I travel to trade, mushrooms are apparently more welcome than fish, nya. So I'd like to ask you to stock goods for me, nya. From the look of you, fish seem to be a problem, nya, so how about fish for the reward, nya?
60437.descriptionEn:
Where I am headed to trade, it
seems mushrooms are more welcome
than fish, meow.
So I would like you to stock up
on goods for me, meow.
You look like you are short on
fish, meow, so how about fish as
your reward, meow?

55128.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Baruragaru while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55128.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Baruragaru raises your
standing while letting you obtain
the materials needed to get
G Rank decorations at a good
value.
Please make the most of it.

26735.objectiveJp:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡの狩猟
26735.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target
or sub-target A

23599.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
23599.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.

55135.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
55135.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Gold Rathian while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55135.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Pink Rathian raises your
standing while letting you obtain
the materials needed to get
G Rank decorations at a good
value.
Please make the most of it.

60311.objectiveJp: チャチャブー３０匹の討伐

60412.description: Monsters vary as individuals. The Khezu is a particularly special case among them, so this sort of individual is comparatively easy to come across... Hunters who cannot quite follow all this, well, just hunt one for the sake of a story.
60412.descriptionEn:
Monsters vary from individual to
individual. Among them, the Khezu
belongs to a particularly special
category, so individuals like this
are relatively easy to find...
You hunters who cannot follow all
this, well, hunt one for the sake
of a good story.

11049.description: Khezu spends its larval stage underground, so they say its nose is better than its eyes. If hunting the parent is difficult, please trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
11049.descriptionEn:
≪Khezu≫ spend their larval
stage underground, so they
say their nose beats their
eyes. If hunting the parent
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver the result!

54207.description: We ask you to investigate the fire wyvern lurking in the Ancient Tower. Not only hunt it: if you skillfully break its parts, I will add to your reward!
54207.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Rathalos lurking
in the Ancient Tower.
Not only hunting it -- if you
handsomely break its parts as
well, we will add extra to
your reward!

62264.objectiveJp: キラビートル５０匹の納品
62264.description: What is this road to becoming a master insect catcher supposed to be? It surely does not mean walking down a road, I think. Anyway, I am still collecting Kirabeetles, so bring me some. What I use them for is a secret. Deliver about 50 and I will give you three Extreme Flame Jewels.
62264.descriptionEn:
The road to bug-catching fame?
What is that even supposed
to mean. I don't think it's
a road you walk, anyway.
Never mind that, I'm still
collecting ≪Killer Beetles≫,
so bring me some. What for?
That's a secret. Bring 50 and
you get 3 ≪Extreme Flame Jewels≫.

54832.description: Why did the Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, appear in the extreme cold sea? To ascertain the cause, we wish to conduct an ecological survey of the target. It is dangerous, but for the research, please break the spines on its forelegs and then hunt it.
54832.descriptionEn:
Why has the Ice Fang Wyvern,
Barioth, appeared in the Polar Sea?
To pin down the cause, we wish to
carry out an ecological survey of
the target.
It is dangerous, but for our research,
please break the spikes on its
forelegs and then hunt it.

26190.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
26190.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26190.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

61308.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61308.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21537.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21537.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50289.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
50289.description: I was mining in the caves of Tide Island when the rocks suddenly began to move on their own and came at me! What on earth was that? Please, hunter, go and find out what that rock really is.
50289.descriptionEn:
I was mining in a cave on the
Tidal Island when the rocks
suddenly started moving on their
own and came at me!
What in the world was that!!
Please, hunter, could you go and
find out what that rock really
is for me?

62798.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62798.description: You have come into your own, hunter. Is it not time to replace that armor? You will receive the materials for 1 of 4 kinds of armor. For this quest only, a certain upgrade material is also available! Note that it cannot be taken on consecutively, so be warned.
62798.descriptionEn:
You have become quite a hunter.
How about ordering some new
armor about now?
You will obtain the materials for
one of four kinds of armor.
Only in this quest, a certain
upgrade material can also be had!
However, you cannot accept it
consecutively, so please
be aware of that.

60662.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
60662.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a high difficulty Guanzorumu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60662.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is the high difficulty
≪Guanzorumu≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and try to
place in the top ranks!
This time it is held with
Supremacy weapons only!

58095.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58095.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58095.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

50656.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 31! In this quest you can obtain weapon crafting materials for Espinas and crafting materials for the original armor Korude F Series. Please give it a try!
50656.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 31!
In this quest you can obtain
weapon crafting materials for the
Thorny Wyvern ≪Espinas≫ and
crafting materials for the
original armor
≪Korude F Series≫.
Please give it a try!

21110.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
21110.description: 2 shadows crawling in the darkness have been sighted. The white shadow is Khezu. The red shadow seems to be its subspecies. Hunters willing to face this duet of lightning, please come to the quest counter.
21110.descriptionEn:
Two shadows were seen crawling
in the dark. The white shadow
is a ≪Khezu≫. The red shadow
seems to be its subspecies.
Hunters with the spirit to face
this duet of lightning, come to
the quest counter.

21699.objectiveJp:
撃退できずにタイムアップ
報酬金ゼロ　拠点の耐久値ゼロ
21699.description: The fortress guard reports that a grey, rock-like giant dragon is advancing. Hunters, head for the fortress at once and repel it. You may use the fortress's equipment freely. Make the most of it in battle.
21699.objectiveEn:
Time up without repelling
Zero reward money, zero Base durability
21699.descriptionEn:
The Fort's guards report that a
grey, rock-like giant dragon is
advancing on us.
All hunters, head to the Fort at
once and repel it.
You may use the Fort's facilities
freely.
Make the most of them and put
them to use in battle.

54366.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
54366.description: A miner was attacked by a Lavasioth deep in the volcano, according to reports. We ask for an urgent investigation. The witness says that Lavasioth looked different from the usual.
54366.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that a
miner was attacked by a ≪Volganos≫
deep in the Volcano.
Please survey the area at once.
According to eyewitnesses, that
≪Volganos≫ had a different
appearance than usual.

21524.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21524.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21524.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

21341.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

23234.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23234.description: We have confirmed the appearance of a Tigrex in an unsurveyed part of the desert. Reports say that food is scarce in that harsh environment and it is extremely agitated. We must deal with it before it comes near where people live.
23234.descriptionEn:
We have confirmed the appearance
of a Tigrex in an unsurveyed part
of the Desert.
Because the harsh environment leaves
little prey, we hear it is extremely
on edge.
It must be dealt with before it
comes near where people live.

61803.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61803.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62761.description: Among the newly discovered savage wyvern Abiorugu in the Jungle, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is a survey and hunting request limited to hunters we approve of. Face it fully prepared.
62761.descriptionEn:
Among the ≪Abiorugu≫ newly
found in the Jungle, an utterly
savage and powerful individual
has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey is limited to Hunters we
approve of. Please go in with
everything prepared.

23718.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
23718.description: A Bogabadorumu with greatly developed horns has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Bogabadorumu known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23718.descriptionEn:
A ≪Anorupatisu≫ with greatly
developed horns has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
developed parts and will survey
it.
There are reports it is more
dangerous than past ones.
Please survey it with care.

58118.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを討伐
58118.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58118.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

20027.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern Yama Tsukami has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20027.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Station!
The Floating Peak Dragon Yama
Tsukami has invaded Mezeporuta!
Mezeporuta now moves to Elder
Dragon interception status!
Use the interception equipment
set up at the Base to slay the
Elder Dragon completely! Please!

62475.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62475.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62475.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

58107.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58107.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58107.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

21475.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21475.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21475.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

20008.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
20008.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20008.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Station!
The Flame King Dragon Teostra has
invaded Dundorma!
Dundorma now moves to Elder
Dragon interception status!
Use the interception equipment in
the interception zone to slay the
Elder Dragon completely! Please!

55195.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退
55195.description: The Emperor-Conquering Dragon wrapped in light, ruling over Kumomi Fortress. The guild has decided to name it the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. Hunter of courage. When you drive it off, you will surely be granted the materials of guild-treasured armor.
55195.descriptionEn:
The Emperor Conquest Dragon who
holds court at Cloud Viewing
Fortress, wrapped in light.
The Guild has decided to name it
"Guanzorumu, Ruler of the Acme".
Hunters of courage —
drive it off, and I will surely
grant you materials for armor
the Guild has long treasured.

54761.description: As a result of the Great Hunt in the Depths of Solitude Island, the black Raviente seems to lie silent underground. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so please join.
54761.descriptionEn:
From the Great Hunt in the
≪Isolated Island Depths≫,
the black Raviente seems to
lie silent underground. We
are forming a survey team
limited to hunters who took
part. Please do join us.

62433.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62433.description: What, you just want a hard Gunlance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62433.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Gunlance?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!

50991.description: There are reports of 2 Variant Lavasioth in the volcano, both far stronger than usual. We want to study their ecology, so please slay both of them.
50991.descriptionEn:
In the Volcano, two ≪Volganos
Variants≫ stronger than usual have
been sighted. We wish to survey
their ecology, so please slay both
of them together.
Should some rare material happen
to drop, it is yours.

61521.description: Mining is good work. While you dig you can empty your mind. When I head to the hunting grounds, I always bring a pickaxe! So, the next request. This time too I await a delivery of fine ore. Look forward to the reward!
61521.descriptionEn:
Mining is great.
While digging you can empty your mind.
When I head to a hunting ground,
I always bring a pickaxe!
And so, here is the next request.
I am waiting for a delivery of good
quality ore again this time.
Look forward to the reward!

50535.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・一章１個の納品

40198.description: To all who aim for the heights of GR: we have prepared a quest where slaying a Rukodiora raises your standing while letting you obtain the materials needed for G Rank decorations at a good value. Please make the most of it.
40198.descriptionEn:
To all who aim for the heights of GR:
we have prepared a quest where
slaying a ≪Rukodiora≫ raises your
standing while letting you obtain
the materials needed for G Rank
decorations at a good
value.
Please make the most of it.

26573.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26573.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26573.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

62677.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
62677.description: Lao-Shan Lung is advancing on the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma, with unprecedented force! Please repel Lao-Shan Lung using the fortress interception equipment! If your strength is insufficient, deliver Dragon Drug Stones taken from Lao-Shan Lung's back.
62677.descriptionEn:
At the ≪Fortress≫ that serves
as the gateway to Dundorma,
Lao-Shan Lung is advancing
with unprecedented force!
Please repel it using the
fortress's interception gear!
If our strength falls short,
deliver the ≪Dragonstone≫
from its back.

23190.objectiveJp: 綺麗なガラクタ１個の納品
23190.description: When we went out to play in the highlands, my daughter's treasured keepsake was stolen by a Melynx. We searched to get it back somehow, but it is nowhere to be found. Could you find the Melynx and get the keepsake back for us?
23190.descriptionEn:
When we went out to play in the Highlands,
my daughter's treasured keepsake was
stolen by a Melynx.
I searched and searched to get it back,
but it's nowhere to be found.
Could you find that Melynx
and get the treasure back for us
somehow?

26563.description: On the way to the Canyon, a Basarios is blocking the road and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26563.descriptionEn:
On the way to the Canyon,
a Basarios is blocking the
road and I'm in trouble.
If you help me out, I'll give
you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ to trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫. Thanks!

54684.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

50803.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Conquest Weapon and hunt the Gold and Silver Piscine Wyvern. One who has come this far along the hunter's path should be able to bring them down. Do so, and a fitting reward shall be yours.
50803.descriptionEn:
You who would master the way of
the hunt. Take up a 『Zenith
Weapon』 and hunt the ≪Gold and
Silver Fish Wyverns≫.
One who has come this far in the
way of the hunt should be able to
bring them down.
Do it splendidly and I will give
you a fitting reward.

61221.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Bone! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61221.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association pays
rewards to hunters who capture
many variants and rare species.
The main reward is Wyvern Heavy
Bones!
When accepting and joining,
please deliver the guarantee
ticket, and hunt the specified
monster.
Note that the guarantee ticket
cannot be returned after
departure.

21627.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
21627.description: Do you know the orb called the Karecha Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21627.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called the Dried Tea Sphere?
Its material is indispensable
for making a certain costly
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I will hand over a precious
decoration material for you.

62670.description: We have reports that a mysterious monster is present in the jungle. Its species remains unidentified and much about it is still unknown, but it may be new. It is said to be extremely ferocious, so this will be a dangerous survey. We appreciate your help.
62670.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a
mysterious monster is now in
the Jungle.
Its species is still unidentified
and much remains unknown, but
it may be a new species.
It is said to be very savage,
so this is a dangerous survey,
but we ask for your help.

50065.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. Complete it and we will present you with Baruragaru materials, part-break materials included. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50065.descriptionEn:
This request is exclusively for
members of a winning guild in
the Hunting Festival.
Complete it and we will award
you «Taikun Zamuza» materials,
including rare part-break
materials.
Please have your Festival Proof on hand
when you accept or join.

62222.description: This is the final round of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from carving the monster or from clear rewards.
62222.descriptionEn:
This is the final round of the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Target monster materials cannot
be obtained from carving
the monster or from
clear rewards.

54104.description: I am thinking of investigating the Gypceros's splendid crest. This time it is a crest investigation, so be sure to destroy it before hunting. Hunting alone will not be accepted as complete. Such a dazzling crest! It will surely be a wonderful study!
54104.descriptionEn:
I think I'll look into the lovely
crest of a Gypceros.
This time the survey is about the
crest, so you must break it
before you hunt it.
If you only hunt it, I won't
count it as complete, you know.
A crest that gives off such a
dazzling light. I'm sure it will
be a wonderful survey!

61332.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61332.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

58046.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58046.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58046.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

61169.description: Hunter registrations have broken one million! The Hunters Guild thanks every hunter from the bottom of its heart and offers a gift! Eh? You say a hunter simply hunts whatever he wants? As expected! I knew you would say that, so I have it ready!
61169.descriptionEn:
Hunter registrations have now
surpassed one million!
With heartfelt thanks to every
hunter, the Hunters Guild sends
you a present!
Eh? A hunter gets what they want
by hunting it, you say?
As expected!
I knew you'd say that, so I have it ready!

53271.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟

61951.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
61951.description: This is a qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61951.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament qualifier quest.
In the finals, the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, from the monster's
carving and clear rewards,
the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained.

28077.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
28077.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28077.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!

40242.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟

51027.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51027.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
51027.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards. When accepting or
joining, please be sure to have
your Festival Proof with you.

50446.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61183.objectiveJp: メゼコイン・鋭剣１個の納品

54685.description: Of the materials needed to upgrade the Ganon G series armor to the GF stage, the especially rare ones come to you in one big heap! For further upgrades, please also consider joining the Extreme Subjugation Battle.
54685.descriptionEn:
You'll get a big bundle of the
rarest materials needed to upgrade
the “Ganon G Series” armor to
the GF stage!
For even further upgrades, please
also consider joining the
“Extreme Conquest Battle”.

62606.description: The Thorn Long Sword you hold still holds unknown power. Obtain the Extreme Hard Sharp Thorn, which can only be taken from a powerful Espinas, and release that unknown power.
62606.descriptionEn:
The Thorn Long Sword you hold
still has unknown power sleeping
within it.
Obtain ≪Extreme Hard Sharp
Thorns≫, which can only be taken
from a mighty Espinas, and
release that unknown power.

56027.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Hypnocatrice. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56027.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Hypnocatrice.
If you destroy the Supremacy's
developed parts in this quest, I
will add the developed part
materials to your Another rewards
specially.
Please note that slaying alone
will not grant them.

53189.description: I am that person's stand-in. With a half-hearted attitude you will never master that technique. This time your own capacity is being tested. There will not be a second chance. Are you ready? Now, go and meet it!
53189.descriptionEn:
I'm standing in for that person.
With half-hearted resolve you
won't master that technique.
This time, the size of your own
capacity will be tested.
There won't be a second chance.
You're ready, aren't you?
Now go and meet them!

40180.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40180.description: A very powerful Yian Garuga that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
40180.descriptionEn:
A ≪Yian Garuga≫ individual
that behaves unlike any other,
and is incredibly powerful,
is in the New Great Arena.
We want it hunted.
This request is only for
Hunters with Secret Art
scroll gear approved by the
guild. Clear it and earn
even greater renown.

22159.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
22159.description: It seems I dropped my collection of Guku room blueprints while out walking. Sorry, would you go and find them? In return I will give you a few blueprints of my own design.
22159.descriptionEn:
It seems I dropped my collection
of Gook room blueprints while out
walking.
Sorry, but could you go and find
them for me?
As thanks I will give you several
blueprints I designed myself.

26196.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
26196.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26196.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

54995.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54995.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Bow,
show us the skill you have honed
against the ≪Baruragaru≫ waiting
in the New Great Arena!
Should you hunt it magnificently,
you will earn an even greater
reward than what your daily
efforts bring.

61529.description: On the Snowy Mountains, under a heavy snowfall, large-scale lightning strikes were witnessed. The snow seems to have settled somewhat, but the lightning continues still. Please investigate, limited to hunters who can prove their skill, and if at all possible hunt down the cause!
61529.descriptionEn:
In the Snowy Mountains, amid
heavy snowfall, a large-scale
lightning strike was witnessed.
The snow seems to have calmed a
little, but the lightning still
keeps striking.
Please, a survey limited to
hunters who can prove their
skill, and if possible, slay the
cause as well!

23430.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61103.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins! Hunting without breaking anything? That's a withdrawal.
61103.descriptionEn:
Indeed! Today, by my own
arbitrary judgment, we hold a
weapon-restricted special
exercise!
Meet the conditions and you may
bring any equipment you like!
As it is closer to real combat,
carving is the same as Low Rank
quests, but the rewards are
≪Energy Drinks≫ and coins!
Hunt without breaking parts? That
is a retire.

58129.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58129.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58129.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

21425.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

54549.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
54549.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Anorupatisu, the Rampage Saw Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54549.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the raging saw
wyvern ≪Anorupatisu≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.

21912.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Tenran armor. By repeatedly driving off Arganos and Golganos, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
21912.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly repelling
Arganos and Gorganos, you
can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade
"Stroma FX Series"
≪Supremacy≫ armor to Lv7.

63238.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
63238.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Nono Orgaron, then slay the Nono Orgaron here in this arena!
63238.descriptionEn:
The Arena, where hunters show
off their skill!
If you're confident you can dance
around the female howling wolf,
slay «Non Orugaron» here in
this Arena!

55412.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55412.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

60718.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60718.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60718.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

55035.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55035.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

62635.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62635.description: I want to study the ecology of the Lavasioth, but the places it lives are extremely dangerous, so my research is not progressing. Could I ask you to hunt one for me?
62635.descriptionEn:
I would like to research the
ecology of the Volganos,
but the places it lives are
extremely dangerous,
so my research has stalled
and I'm at a loss.
I would very much like you to
hunt one for me?

22114.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
22114.description: A request that lets you craft the Inity Series, a weapon recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Velocidrome and you will obtain the crafting materials for 1 weapon type. May it serve you well in the hunts to come.
22114.descriptionEn:
This request lets you forge the
≪Initiative Series≫ weapons
recommended for new Hunters.
Hunt a Velocidrome to obtain
the materials for one weapon
type.
Please make good use of them
in future hunts.

1054.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

55688.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Rathalos. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55688.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
monster ≪Rathalos≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.

54736.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
54736.description: Great numbers of Daimyo Hermitaur seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Daimyo Hermitaur! If you do it splendidly, we will give you a slightly larger share of the materials for a Felyne comrade swimsuit!
54736.descriptionEn:
Shield Crabs seem to be swarming
around Mezeporuta!
Hunters, please lend us your
help in slaying them!
If you slay them for us, I'll give
you a little extra material for
a Partnyaa swimsuit!

21196.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21196.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21196.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50211.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の捕獲
50211.description: The Wyverian lady said the Guild is short of ingredients lately. At this rate she is worried whether they can properly entertain the hunters who visit Mezepolta Plaza. So she said that if you procure ingredients, she will give you a red gem as thanks!
50211.descriptionEn:
Lately the Guild is short on food,
the Wyverian lady said. At this
rate she worries they can't
properly serve the hunters who
visit Mezeporuta Square.
So she said if you gather some
ingredients for them, she'll give
you a red gem as thanks.
That's what she told me!

28062.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
28062.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28062.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

62461.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the sleeping bird Hypnocatrice together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62461.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, how about hunting the
sleeping bird «Hypnocatrice»
together with a hunter who has
risen high enough to hold a
Secret Art book?
Learn from their distinctive
movements, and if you both clear
the request, I'll prepare an extra reward!

51096.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51096.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Red Shadow will also grant a special ingredient.
51096.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the head and torso
of the Red Shadow, we will also
grant you special ingredients.

50237.description: My first request, so I am nervous. There is a musician I simply must tell music lovers about. They are so cool, truly. But I am too shy, so I would be glad if you would film them for me instead. I will cheer from the shadows! Once you meet them, spread the word to everyone!
50237.descriptionEn:
This is my first request, so I'm
nervous. There's a musician I
really want music lovers to hear.
He's cool, seriously.
But I'm too shy, so I'd be glad
if you could take photos instead.
I'll be cheering from the shadows!
If you meet him, tell everyone!

21418.objectiveJp: エールナッツ５０個の納品
21418.description: Are you gathering today as well? You do not need tools, but you do want to mind your equipment. Now then, a new gathering request. Hmm, it may be a little tough this time too, but do your best. Of course I will give you a reward.
21418.descriptionEn:
Are you gathering today as well?
Since you don't need tools, you
want to be careful with equipment.
Now then, a new gathering request.
Hmm, this one may be a bit hard
again, but please do your best.
Of course, I will hand over your
reward.

61526.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

23567.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
23567.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23567.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
