55484.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55484.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

61913.description: Hm, you have grown a great deal since I last saw you. You are now qualified to attempt my clan's trial! Namely, the secret of carrying! It might be good to split roles between carrier and support! If it goes badly, try slaying Ioprey and the like!
61913.descriptionEn:
Hmm, you've grown a lot since
I last saw you, meow.
You're now qualified to take on
our clan's trial, meow!
That is, the secret of carrying!
Splitting roles between a carrier
and a support might work well, meow!
If it doesn't go well, try slaying
some Genprey and the like, meow!

60727.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60727.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60727.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54261.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Plesioth for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the dorsal fin. The dorsal fin is extremely dangerous and gets in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break it!
54261.descriptionEn:
Could you hunt a Plesioth for
the survey?
Oh, right, I forgot something
important.
Make sure you break its dorsal fin.
That fin is extremely dangerous
and gets in the way of the survey.
Hunting alone won't count.
Be sure to break it!

26385.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
26385.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a High Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26385.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
high rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!

23701.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (chest), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23701.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(chest piece), excluding
weapon ribbons and weapon
merits. The yield is one
type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please take note.

54338.description: White and black wyverns have appeared at the summit of the Ancient Tower. These 2 are opposites by nature and could never appear in the same place. This must be called a reckless request. Yet I believe that you, with all your achievements, will find a way.
54338.descriptionEn:
White and black wyverns have
appeared at the top of the
Ancient Tower. These two are
opposites by nature, so they
could never appear in the same
place.
I must call this a reckless
request. But I believe that you,
with all your achievements,
will somehow see it through.

54292.description: The people who live around the volcano tell many tales of a black dragon like a mountain sleeping deep within. Our survey has identified the place where this dragon is thought to dwell. Head there at once and determine what this monster really is.
54292.descriptionEn:
Volcano folk say that deep
within the Volcano dwells a
black dragon like a mountain,
and many such tales remain.
Our survey has now pinned
down where this dragon is
thought to live. Hurry there
and uncover the truth of
this monster.

23423.description: This quest lets you obtain the convenient G-rank Rage Jewel and G-rank Guard Flash Jewel. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23423.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
handy ≪G Rank Fury Gem≫ and
≪G Rank Guard Gem≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.

55025.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55025.description: We ask for your help in the survey of the Teostra that inhabits the Tower! Not only slay it: if you break its head and sever its tail, we will add to your reward. For the safety of Mezeporuta as well, lend your strength to our research!
55025.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help surveying the
«Teostra» that dwells in the Tower!
Beyond slaying it, if you break its
head and sever its tail, we will
add extra reward.
For the safety of Mezeporuta too,
please lend our research your strength!

54877.description: We ask for your help in surveying the Black Piercing Wyvern that dwells on Tide Island! Break its horns and chest as well as slaying it, and we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54877.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help surveying the
«Black Piercing Wyvern» that
dwells on Tidal Island!
Beyond slaying it, if you break its
horns and chest, we will add
extra reward.
Please lend our research
your strength!

21015.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21015.description: The boss of the Genprey packs in the desert, Dos-Genprey, is marked by a body a size larger and by sharp claws! If hunting Dos-Genprey proves difficult, put a Cactus Flower in a Maka Pickling Jar and deliver a Hundred-Flower Cactus!
21015.descriptionEn:
The Ioprey that swarm the Desert
are led by the ≪Iodrome≫, known
for its larger body and sharp
claws! If hunting the Iodrome is
difficult, put a ≪Cactus Flower≫
into a ≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ and
deliver a ≪Hundred-Flower
Cactus≫ instead!

54824.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
54824.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54824.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

54528.description: There is a report that 2 jet-black wyverns were seen in a part of the Ancient Tower where few tread. This is a survey request, but if the report is true, ordinary hunters cannot handle them. We recommend only hunters confident in their skill go.
54528.descriptionEn:
There was a report that two jet-black
Flying Wyverns were seen in a part
of the Ancient Tower where people
rarely set foot. This is a survey
request, but if the report is true,
ordinary Hunters cannot handle them.
I recommend that only Hunters
confident in their own skill
make the trip.

55259.description: A Thunder Wolf Wyvern, Zinogre, has suddenly appeared! It is a monster never seen in these parts! Moreover, in its supercharged state with powerful discharge ability. Hunters confident in their skill, head for the site at once.
55259.descriptionEn:
A Thunder Wolf Wyvern《Zinogre》
has suddenly appeared!
It is a monster never seen in
these parts before!
And in its supercharged state,
with powerful discharge ability.
Hunters confident in their skill,
head to the site at once.

54917.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Yama Kurai, the Floating Peak Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54917.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Floating Peak
Dragon ≪Yama Kurai≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.

61319.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61319.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

62041.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

50321.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
50321.description: The annual team competition begins, nya! As cheer captain, I cannot overlook it, nya! What kind of competition? I don't know that, nya! Anyway, I am going to cheer for the navy team, nya!
50321.descriptionEn:
The yearly team showdown is
about to start, meow!
As cheer captain, I can't just
look the other way, meow!
What kind of showdown? I don't
know, meow! Anyway, I'm off to
cheer the navy blue team, meow!

61462.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
61462.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.

61013.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61013.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

55765.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55765.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55765.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

54647.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54647.description: We present a request that lets you obtain some of the materials needed to upgrade the Silver Sovereign Wyvern's Ｇ-rank gear, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
54647.descriptionEn:
The number you can accept per day
is limited, but here is a request
that yields some of the materials
needed to upgrade the Silver Ruling
Dragon's G Rank gear.
Please don't let this chance slip by.

63386.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
63386.description: The fortress guard reports that Lao-Shan Lung is advancing. Hunters, head for the fortress at once and repel it. You may use the fortress's equipment freely. Make the most of it in battle.
63386.descriptionEn:
Word has come from the fort's
guards that Lao-Shan Lung is
advancing on us. Hunters, go to
the fort at once and intercept it.
You may use the fort's facilities
freely. Make the fullest use of
them and turn them to your
advantage in battle.

23409.description: It has been a long time. When did I last forge your Green Thorn Blade? Now, obtain the material said to come from only one in thousands of Espinas, and release its true power.
23409.descriptionEn:
It has been a long while.
When did I last forge your
"Thorn Green Long Sword"?
Now, take the material said to
be obtainable from only one among
thousands of Espinas, and release
its true power.

60708.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60708.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50730.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
50730.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the ears of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku will also grant a special ingredient.
50730.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Blue Yian Kut-Ku's ears,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

58044.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58044.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58044.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

26214.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Daimyo Hermitaur will be judged by our Guild, so please concentrate on completing the main target!
26214.descriptionEn:
At the Elder Hall Guild's
request, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
We will judge the 'fixed
damage' dealt to
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ here, so
everyone please focus on
clearing the main target!

62946.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟

62955.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

26284.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26284.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?

11043.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
11043.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!

62132.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
62132.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62132.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

53161.description: Here again this year! Miyashita here! My challenge to you, a quiz. Question 1: The words that come out of my, Miyamoa's, gunlance shelling are Thank you for playing! Hunters who think the answer is false (B), take this quest!
53161.descriptionEn:
Here I am again this year!
Miyashita here!
A challenge from me (a quiz)!
[Question 1]
The text that comes out of my
(Miyamoa's) Gunlance shelling is
“Thanks for playing with me!”
Hunters who think the answer is
X (B), accept this quest!

23317.objectiveJp: イカリオオマグロ５０匹の納品
23317.description: A giant fish living in the freezing sea, the Anchor Tuna. I heard a rumor that a mysterious creature called Johnny, which loves that Anchor Tuna, has appeared. To investigate Johnny, we need Anchor Tuna in great quantity! Help with the investigation!
23317.descriptionEn:
A giant fish called “Ikario
Tuna” lives in the freezing sea.
I heard a rumor that “Johnny”,
a mysterious creature that
loves to eat Ikario Tuna, has
appeared.
To investigate “Johnny”, we need
a large amount of Ikario Tuna!
Help us with the survey!

26611.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26611.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

21032.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
21032.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon with claws so sharp and powerful that it's called the Sickle Crab! This season you can also mine raw Grey Crystal in the swamp. With luck, a Light Crystal might come as a reward, you know!
21032.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon with claws so
sharp it's called the Scythe
Crab! This season you can
mine ≪Grey Crystal Ore≫ in
the swamp too. With luck,
Light Crystals as reward!

21335.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての捕獲
21335.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land, and at last my ecological study is nearly complete. Once I finish surveying the Rathalos Variant recently discovered in the canyon, my book will be done, so I ask you to capture it. Help me and I will share a copy of the book.
21335.descriptionEn:
For years I have studied the
King of the Sky and the Queen
of the Land, and at last my
research on their ecology is
nearly finished.
Once I survey the Rathalos
Variant lately found in the
Canyon, my book is done, so
please capture it. You'll get a copy.

26187.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
26187.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26187.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

56114.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56114.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

60402.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の捕獲
60402.description: Lately a rare flying wyvern has been sighted, or so I hear. I heard it has a primitive flying wyvern shape... I would very much like one for myself, so though it is unusual for High Rank, I will provide minimal supplies. Capture it properly.
60402.descriptionEn:
Lately a rare wyvern has been
sighted, has it not?
I heard it has the form of a
primitive wyvern, or so...
I would very much like one for
myself, so though it is unusual
for High Rank, I will provide
minimal supplies.
Capture it properly.

61533.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, 2 black shapes rampage in the arena. You will be hunting that Rajang and a Yian Garuga, Variants both! Who will slay these 2 mighty Variants and take the fortune?
61533.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Today it is two black shadows
rampaging in the Arena. You will
be slaying that Rajang and the
black wolf bird, and variants at
that!
Who will slay these two mighty
variants and take the big money!?

55055.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55055.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Merit (Beginning) x５０, Lance Merit (Middle) x６０, Lance Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55055.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Lance Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Lance Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Lance Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you must be
GR500 or above, so please take
care.

55116.description: Slaying a Yian Kut-Ku Subspecies raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55116.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Yian Kut-Ku Subspecies
you can raise your own rating
while getting a bargain on the
materials needed for G Rank
decorations, so we've prepared
a quest for that.
Please make good use of it.

55225.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft the Cuff 'G Kouryuu Cuff SB1' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55225.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the top
prize in the “F Photo Contest 2016”,
we've prepared a quest where you
can obtain the materials to craft
the cuff “G Artisan Style Cuff SB1”
used in it.
Please make use of it.

23637.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23637.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23637.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will gain even more reward than
what your daily efforts bring.

21183.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21183.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

61426.description: Do you know the Moonlight Stone? It is a strange stone, said to be moonlight crystallized, and rumor has it that cooperation with companions is essential to obtain one. But cooperation with companions is the basics of a hunter. You will surely be able to gather some too.
61426.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Moonlight Stone?
It is a strange stone said to be
moonlight crystallized, and rumor
has it that allies' cooperation is
essential to obtain one.
But well, cooperating with allies is
the basics of a hunter.
I am sure you can mine some too.

63234.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63234.description: A fire wyvern, different in appearance from the usual and extremely powerful, is on a rampage in the tower, and word has come that the examiner for Secret Scroll hunters, who is on his way here, cannot get through and is in trouble. If the tower can be made safe, it seems you can be sure to be issued a Secret Proof [Rush].
63234.descriptionEn:
A Rathalos that looks different
from normal and is extremely
powerful is rampaging in the Tower,
and we've received a report that
the Secret Art book examiner
heading this way cannot get through.
If the Tower is made safe, they say
you're guaranteed a «Secret Proof [Urgent]».

23728.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Merit (Beginning) x５０, Hunting Horn Merit (Middle) x６０, Hunting Horn Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23728.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
following materials.
«Hunting Horn Merit - Intro» x50
«Hunting Horn Merit - Mid» x60
«Hunting Horn Merit - Extreme» x50
To accept the quest you need a
«Secret Merit Crystal» and
GR 500 or higher, so please note.

61039.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

53068.description: Beware the beastman species with black fur and round eyes. They approach without a sound and steal all manner of things. Get rid of them quickly and settle my worries! I will pay a reward, so sorry for the trouble, but please.
53068.descriptionEn:
Watch out for those beastfolk with
black fur and round eyes.
They sneak up without a sound and
steal all sorts of things.
Get rid of them quick and solve
our problem! I'll pay you, so I
know it's a pain, but please!

56125.description: Many Divergent species have been reported, their threat continues without end, and the Guild has been researching weapons against them. I very much hope promising hunters who can complete this quest will make use of the crafting materials for the weapons born of that research!
56125.descriptionEn:
Many Supremacy monsters have been
reported, and their threat never
ends, so the Guild has been
researching anti-Supremacy weapons.
We want promising hunters who can
clear this quest to make use of the
materials for the weapons born
from our research!

50701.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50701.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the ears of a Yian Kut-Ku will also grant a special ingredient.
50701.descriptionEn:
To further promote awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we've long
been running, we've prepared
this quest.
By breaking the Yian Kut-Ku's ears,
we'll also grant you a special ingredient.

56158.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
56158.description: Reports of resighting Elzelion that Burns and Freezes to the Extreme, a great threat, do not cease. Judging this an emergency, we have asked not only hunters but Poogies and Felynes to help with defense preparations at the Guild. Therefore this time we seek first-rate hunters who will slay it alone!
56158.descriptionEn:
Reports of the great threat
“Acme Scorching Frozen Eruzerion”
keep coming in.
Judging this an emergency, the Guild
has asked not only hunters but also
Poogies and Felynes to help with
defense preparations.
So this time we seek a top hunter
to slay it alone!

23233.description: We found large footprints in an unsurveyed part of the volcano. No monster was sighted, but from the size of the prints it is likely a Gravios. Find the monster and hunt it for our survey.
23233.descriptionEn:
We found large footprints in an
unsurveyed part of the Volcano.
No monster has been sighted, but
from the size of the prints, we
believe it is a Gravios.
Find the monster and hunt it
for the survey.

21037.description: Khezu spends its larval stage underground, so they say its nose is better than its eyes. If hunting the parent is difficult, please trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
21037.descriptionEn:
≪Khezu≫ spend their larval
stage underground, so they
say their nose beats their
eyes. If hunting the parent
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver the result!

61228.description: An unprecedented great lightning strike has been witnessed at the Ancient Tower. This is a survey request for hunters of skill only. It is too dangerous, so item supply is impossible. Conduct the survey with the utmost care.
61228.descriptionEn:
A lightning strike of unprecedented
scale was witnessed at the Ancient
Tower.
This survey request is for skilled
hunters only. It is far too
dangerous, so no items can be
supplied. Please conduct the
survey with the utmost caution.

53094.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
53094.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
53094.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

63113.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
63113.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63113.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

61035.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61035.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

54796.description: Nya! Hunter there aiming to master the light bowgun! Try taking my guidance, meow! Hunt the Blood Drinker Dragon beautifully and you should get more rewards than usual, meow! Take this chance to master the Light Bowgun, meow!
54796.descriptionEn:
Meow! Hey there, hunter trying to
master the Light Bowgun!
Why not try my trial, meow!
If you can hunt the «Blood-Eating Wyvern»,
you'll get more rewards than usual,
I think, meow! Take this chance to
master the Light Bowgun, meow!

58105.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58105.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58105.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

55749.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
55749.description: As the culmination of my research I have created a certain decoration jewel. I want it used properly, but I have been wondering whom to give it to. Just then I heard a rumor that poison is effective on the Anomalous Species known as the Rampaging Saw Wyvern. With a skilled hunter I can rest easy. I will give it to you as the reward for slaying the original Rampaging Saw Wyvern.
55749.descriptionEn:
As the culmination of my research,
I created a certain decoration jewel.
I want it used properly, but I was
unsure who to give it to.
Then I heard a rumor that poison
works well on the Supremacy
«Rampaging Saw Wyvern».
With a veteran hunter I'm at ease.
Take it as reward for
defeating the original species!

21806.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
21806.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21806.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

55199.description: Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing their surroundings red with rage. We will somehow drive them into the Arena, so we ask you hunters to slay them and keep the damage from spreading any further. Upon your success, we will give you armor materials long stored away by the Guild.
55199.descriptionEn:
Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing
their surroundings red with rage.
We will somehow drive them into
the Arena, so we ask you hunters
to slay them and keep the damage
from spreading any further.
Upon your success, we will give
you armor materials long stored
away by the Guild.

51075.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
51075.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Doragyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
51075.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Doragyurosu's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

28008.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
28008.description: Hey. I want to get stronger. But I've hit a wall. Gypceros and Khezu. I've tried many times to beat both, but no good. Please, I want the hunting party members to try too. It's tough.
28008.descriptionEn:
Yo. I want to get stronger.
But I've hit a wall.
«Gypceros» and «Khezu».
I've tried again and again to beat
both of them, but no luck.
I'd love the guild members to try too.
It's tough.

21852.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Stroma series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21852.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can get the
crafting and upgrade materials for
all five pieces of the «Hardcore Armor»
Stroma series.
A «Superior Ticket» is required
to accept the quest.
If you fail the quest, the ticket
is consumed, so please be careful.

26180.description: As support for everyone, we present the habitat of the Aptonoth, ideal for procuring meat. Those short of meat, this is your chance!
26180.descriptionEn:
This time, as support for
everyone, we introduce the
≪Aptonoth≫ habitat best
suited to procuring meat.
If you're short on meat,
this is your chance!

23184.description: I need wyvern eggs to cook something nourishing. For the sake of everyone waiting on my cooking, would someone bring me an egg from the canyon? If it is not too much trouble, I would also like some Kantharos slain at the same time. My cooking gear is wearing out, and I want their parts to maintain it.
23184.descriptionEn:
I need a wyvern egg to make a
nourishing dish.
For the sake of everyone waiting
for my cooking, could someone go
gather an egg from the Canyon?
If possible, I'd also like you to
slay some Kantharos at the same time.
My cooking tools are wearing out
and I want them for upkeep.

55736.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55736.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

55306.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55306.description: An Aberrant Blangonga with greatly developed arms has appeared. Many hunters have failed to slay it because of the attacks peculiar to Aberrant species. In response the Guild will provide firm support for the hunt. Go into the survey with care.
55306.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Blangonga with hugely
developed arms has appeared.
Its Supremacy attacks have made
many hunters fail to slay it.
In response, the Guild will provide
strong support for the slaying.
Please proceed to the survey
with caution.

26722.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
26722.description: What, you just want a hard Heavy Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26722.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Heavy Bowgun?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!

21179.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. Only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it, so please note.
21179.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Only hunters equipped with
the special anti-Variant
arms may accept or join, so
please take care.

54186.description: This is an emergency request. A black, mysterious shadow has reportedly appeared at the tower the survey team is heading for. The team is said to be hiding from the black shadow and waiting for help. Hurry to the tower and deal with the shadow.
54186.descriptionEn:
Emergency request.
A report says a mysterious black
shadow appeared at the Tower
where the survey team is headed.
The team is now hiding from the
black shadow and waiting for
help. Hurry to the Tower and deal
with the black shadow.

60235.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
60235.description: The qualifying quest for the Championship Tournament DMM Cup. Please read the participation rules on the tournament's special site carefully, and join after agreeing to them. Taking the qualifying quest counts as participation.
60235.descriptionEn:
This is a qualifier quest for the
“Championship Tournament DMM Cup”.
Please read the participation rules
on the event site and agree to them
before joining.
Accepting the qualifier quest
counts as participation.

55398.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55398.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

55373.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make armor from the Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth! If you complete the sub-target, you can obtain materials needed to upgrade Migration armor, so please try it!
55373.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to make
armor from the Ice Fang Wyvern
≪Barioth≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
Transcend Armor, so please give it
a try!

60132.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60132.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60132.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.

55924.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
55924.description: The Variant Species Taikun Zamuza has appeared once more. Its developed claws differ greatly in shape left and right, the left a three-pronged fork and the right a giant mallet, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55924.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy «Taikun Zamuza»
has appeared again.
Its developed claws differ greatly
left and right - the left a trident,
the right a giant hammer - and it
seems even stronger now.
Please conduct the survey with
great care.

23181.description: To complete my signature dish I need a superb egg. And not just any flying wyvern egg. I need you to gather the finest ingredients. I hear there is a flying wyvern nest in an unsurveyed part of the Sea of Trees. Go and fetch me a flying wyvern egg from there.
23181.descriptionEn:
To finish my signature dish,
I need a top-quality egg.
And not just any wyvern egg.
You'll have to gather the finest
ingredients for me.
Word is there's a wyvern nest in an
unsurveyed part of the Great Forest.
Go fetch me a wyvern egg from there.

21405.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

55488.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55488.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55488.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

23372.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

60543.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
60543.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blue Yian Kut-Ku! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60543.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill!
This time the target is the
«Yian Kut-Ku Subspecies»!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
alone is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take a top place!

53130.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
53130.description: I want to make a big odairi-sama that will not lose to last year's, nya! But! It is important to pursue not only scale but the artisan's spirit, nya! Dress up as the odairi-sama in beautiful navy equipment and hunt Azure Rathalos, nya! If you succeed, I'll present you with a lovely stiff paper as thanks, nya!
53130.descriptionEn:
I want to make a big hina doll
emperor that beats last year's, meow!
But it's not just about scale -
the artisan's soul matters, meow!
Dress up as the emperor in lovely
navy blue gear and hunt an Azure Rathalos, meow!
If you succeed, I'll give you a
wonderful stiff paper as thanks, meow!

55088.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55088.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55088.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

55301.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55301.description: The Variant Species Blangonga appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Blangonga. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55301.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Blangonga≫ seems
to have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Blangonga.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.

21105.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１０頭の討伐
21105.description: The swamp is the most suitable environment for Bulldrome to live in. If you are going to hunt the Bulldrome, try slaying as many Bulldrome as you can. Of course, we will pay both supply items and rewards.
21105.descriptionEn:
The Swamp is the environment
best suited for Bullfango to live
in.
If you take on hunting the
≪Bulldrome≫, try slaying as many
Bullfango as you can as well.
Of course, we pay both supplies
and rewards.

61512.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61512.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

55658.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55658.descriptionEn:
Hunter who seeks to master the
Long Sword, show before the
«Blood-Eating Wyvern» in the
New Great Arena the skill you
have honed!
If you manage to hunt it well,
you'll gain a reward far
beyond what daily effort
ever brings.

26477.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
26477.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Any monster's subspecies is a tough opponent, but basically the same as the original. Fight!
26477.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Subspecies are tough foes
for any monster, but at
heart they're the same. Fight!

50695.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50695.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50695.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

54789.description: This is one of the Anniversary 2015 Premium Goods early purchase campaign quests, 'Get a New Decoration!', which consumes an Anniversary Quest Ticket. Clear the main target to obtain one G rank Dogou Jewel.
54789.descriptionEn:
This is the “Get a New Decoration!”
quest, one of the Anniversary 2015
Premium Goods early purchase
campaign quests, and it consumes
an «Anniversary Quest Ticket».
Clear the main target to obtain
1 «G Rank: Furious Steel Orb».

61708.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

21594.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21594.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Leopard Paw Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21594.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called the Leopard Leg Sphere?
Its material is indispensable
for making a certain costly
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I will hand over a precious
decoration material for you.

53122.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
53122.description: Oh, what a disaster! This year I made all sorts of preparations to celebrate Congalala, but I accidentally let it escape! It seems it fled into a troublesome place where Yian Kut-Ku live. So, I'll ask a fine hunter to slay some bird wyverns! I'm counting on you!
53122.descriptionEn:
Oh, what a disaster!
This year I was preparing all sorts
of things to celebrate the
Congalala, but I accidentally let
it escape!
Worse, it seems to have fled into
a troublesome place where Yian
Kut-Ku live.
So I'll ask a fine hunter to
slay some bird wyverns! You're on!

26094.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26094.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

63086.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63086.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
63086.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

55861.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55861.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

28005.description: This time too we have prepared a quest for you hunting party members, meow. This time that one appears as 2 at once, meow. There are no sub-target clears prepared, so ready yourselves well and work together, meow. I wish you good hunting, meow.
28005.descriptionEn:
Once again I've prepared a quest
for all you guild members, meow.
This time that thing shows up
two at once, meow.
There's no sub-target to clear, so
prepare properly and work together
as guild members, meow.
I wish you luck, meow.

26342.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26342.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

55293.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55293.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55293.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.

53082.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53082.description: A hunter thinking of changing from the Hope series armor to another set. How about the Quoiz series, available from this request? It has a stylish look like the Kukubo series, so I think you will like it.
53082.descriptionEn:
To hunters thinking of trading
their Hope Series armor for
something else.
How about the Quoiz Series
armor you can obtain from
this request?
It looks as stylish as the
Kukubo Series, so I am sure
you will like it.

55685.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Hypnocatrice. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55685.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Hypnocatrice
materials. To accept it, a
Superior Ticket is required.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the Superior Ticket
will be consumed.

50383.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50383.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50383.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

54367.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
54367.description: While I was surveying the Yaozami ecology in the Jungle, a Bulldrome suddenly attacked. At this rate the survey cannot proceed! Would you hunt the Bulldrome for me?
54367.descriptionEn:
While we were surveying Yao Zami
ecology in the Jungle, a Bulldrome
suddenly attacked us.
At this rate the survey cannot go
on!
Could you please hunt that
Bulldrome for us?

53151.description: We have prepared a quest to craft the Rohok Series. Hunt Rathian and Brook and you can obtain production and strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
53151.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest for crafting
the “Rohokku Series”.
By hunting a Rathian and a Bullock,
you can obtain production and
upgrade materials for one piece.
Please make good use of it!

63317.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Congalala, then slay the Congalala here in this arena!
63317.descriptionEn:
The Arena, where hunters show
off their skill!
If you're confident you can handle
the pink-furred beast, slay
«Congalala» here in this Arena!

23281.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
23281.description: Reports say accidents happen often in the Desert at night. Merchants avoid the strong daylight and transport their loads at night, and a monster seems to leap out of the sand and attack them. The cause is likely a Cephadrome roaming there, so please hunt it.
23281.descriptionEn:
Reports say accidents happen
often in the Desert at night.
Merchants avoiding the strong
daytime sun transport their goods
at night, and it seems monsters
burst out of the sand and
attacked them.
The cause is likely a wandering
≪Cephadrome≫, so please hunt it.

54364.description: It is hopeless! That vicious monster has appeared at the tower too! Someone save us from this crisis! According to sightings, this time a Dyuragaua is on a rampage! What is this world coming to!
54364.descriptionEn:
It's hopeless! That vicious monster
has appeared in the Tower too!
Someone please save us from
this crisis!
According to sightings, this time
an «Ice Fox Wyvern» is on a rampage!
Just what is this world
coming to!?

54729.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54729.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

55269.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
55269.description: To those of you who have upgraded the Flogada GF series to LV7! We have prepared a quest that lets you obtain in one go the upgrade materials for 1 piece of the Flogada GX series armor! Clear the quest 5 times and upgrade every piece!
55269.descriptionEn:
To you who strengthened the
Frogada GF series to LV7!
We have prepared a quest where
you can obtain in one go the
upgrade materials for one piece
of the armor "Frogada GX Series"!
Clear the quest 5 times and
strengthen every piece!

26560.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26560.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Divine Consort] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
26560.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Divine Consort]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).

60603.description: The greatest weapon a hunter has. That is courage that nothing can break. Learn from the solitary figure of the Monoblos, which faces any foe alone, and that heart will follow of its own accord. Devote yourself to your training, nothing else.
60603.descriptionEn:
The most important weapon a hunter
has is courage that nothing can break.
Learn from the lone «Monoblos», who
faces any foe alone, and that heart
will follow naturally.
All you can do is keep honing yourself.

26128.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
26128.description: Now, into live combat! Go into the desert, find a Gendrome, and hunt it! Desert nights are cold: without a Hot Drink you will freeze and your maximum stamina will drop, so be careful.
26128.descriptionEn:
Now then, time for real combat!
Let's find and hunt an «Iodrome»
in the Desert!
Desert nights are cold, so if you
don't drink a «Hot Drink» you'll
freeze and your max stamina will
drop, so be careful.

50376.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50376.description: This time an extremely ferocious Tigrex seems to have appeared in the Desert. It is a Tigrex already ferocious enough, so there are concerns about the effect on the environment. Head out to slay it at once.
50376.descriptionEn:
This time a very ferocious «Tigrex»
seems to have appeared in the Desert.
It's already ferocious, so we fear
the impact on the environment.
Please head out to slay it at once.

54242.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54242.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

54108.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54108.description: I want to investigate the habits of Shogun Ceanataur and its shell. I would prefer an individual living in the volcano. Also, claws are not needed for this survey. They are in the way, so break them. It is dangerous, so be sure to break them.
54108.descriptionEn:
I want to survey the habits of the
Shogun Ceanataur and its shell.
I'd prefer one living in the Volcano.
Also, the claws aren't needed for
this survey.
They're in the way, so break them.
They're dangerous, so be sure
to break them!

60110.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the volcano lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60110.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Volcano
lie scattered all around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.

23589.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
23589.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.

55160.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
55160.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Uragaan armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55160.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to make
armor from the ≪Uragaan≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
Transcend Armor, so please give it
a try!

60630.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Slip through a duet of sleep breath and land a blow with all your might! Bring down 2 Hypnocatrice and an exceptional purse awaits! Challengers wanted!
60630.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Dodge the duet of sleep breaths
and land a blow with all your
might!
Bring down the two Hypnocatrice
and an exceptional prize awaits!
Challengers wanted!

54775.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54775.description: We are continuing our survey of the White Monoblos. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54775.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of the
Monoblos Subspecies.
Breaking parts isn't required, but
we'd be delighted if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your help!

50980.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Tenran armor. Drive off Arganos and Golganos and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
50980.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repelling Arganos
and Gorganos, you can get
the materials needed to
upgrade "Stroma FX
Series" ≪Supremacy≫ armor
up to Lv7.

50141.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50141.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

58081.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１６頭の討伐

62050.description: This is the final round of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from carving the monster or from clear rewards.
62050.descriptionEn:
This is the final round of the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Target monster materials cannot
be obtained from carving the
monster or from clear rewards.

23221.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

62240.description: I am a flower seller. But I am usually not in the plaza. Where I sell is a secret. Ah, right. I have a request for you, hunter. I want you to gather lots of Iwahime Grass in the highlands. Give it to me and I will give you one seed that flew here from far away.
62240.descriptionEn:
I'm a flower seller, you know.
But I'm not usually in the plaza.
Where I sell is a secret.
Ah, that's right. I have a favor to
ask of you, hunter.
I want you to gather lots of
Iwahime Grass from the Highlands.
If you give them to me, I'll give
you one seed that flew here from
far away.

54394.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Congalala, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54394.descriptionEn:
For the newly started G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we've prepared
this quest to raise awareness
and interest.
By breaking the Congalala's head,
we'll also grant you a special ingredient.

54096.description: Please help investigate Gravios. This time the targets are the chest and tail. Be sure to destroy or cut them. Note that hunting alone will count as a failure.
54096.descriptionEn:
Please help us survey a Gravios.
This time the targets are its chest
and tail. Be sure to break or
sever them.
If you only hunt it, it counts as a
failure, so please be careful.

55589.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55589.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

21066.description: For hunters who want to make ore weapons, mining is the very basics! First, start by learning where you can mine. If you find cracks in a cliff, try digging with a Pickaxe!
21066.descriptionEn:
For hunters who want to make ore
type weapons, mining is the very
basics of the basics!
First, let us start by learning where
you can mine.
If you find cracks in a cliff or
similar, try digging with a
≪Pickaxe≫!

60803.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60803.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54722.description: The survey team that headed for the Snowy Mountains reports finding the carcasses of many monsters near the summit. From their pitiful state, it is assumed to be the work of a very ferocious monster. Hunter confident in your skill, restore peace to the Snowy Mountains.
54722.descriptionEn:
The survey team that went to the
Snowy Mountains reports that many
monster carcasses were found near
the summit.
From that gruesome sight, it is
thought to be the work of a very
ferocious monster.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please restore peace to the
Snowy Mountains.

26029.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
26029.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26029.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

1078.description: Since long ago they have ruled this land: the King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian. Go and face them with resolve unto death! Do not forget that you may set only one Pitfall Trap or Shock Trap!
1078.descriptionEn:
The king of the sky «Rathalos» and
the queen of the land «Rathian»
have reigned here since ages past.
Face them with resolve to die!
And don't forget you can only set
one pitfall or shock trap!

51123.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
51123.description: Brawling is supreme! Long reach is unnecessary! The answer lies in hand to hand combat! Perhaps the wish to spread the charm of the Tonfa was heard, for we met just the right monster. Weapon and armor are ready, so hunt using these.
51123.descriptionEn:
Brawling is supreme! You don't need
long reach! The answer lies in
close-quarters combat!
Perhaps my wish to spread the charm
of the Tonfa was heard, for I've met
just the right monster.
I've prepared weapon and armor,
so hunt with them.

54099.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54099.description: I want you to hunt a Yian Kut-Ku so we can study it. Its ears are nothing but a hindrance to this survey, so break them during the hunt. If you slay it without breaking the ears, the quest will be treated as failed, so be careful.
54099.descriptionEn:
I'd like you to hunt a Yian Kut-Ku
that appeared on Tidal Island,
for a survey.
Its ears are only a nuisance for
this survey, so break them when
you hunt it.
If you hunt it without breaking
them, it counts as a failure,
so be careful.

53080.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
53080.description: Great numbers of Yian Kut-Ku seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Yian Kut-Ku! If you do it splendidly, we will give you a higher reward than usual and ingredients!
53080.descriptionEn:
Yian Kut-Ku seem to be swarming
around Mezeporuta!
Hunters, please help us slay them!
If you slay them for us, we'll pay
a higher fee than usual and
give you ingredients!

63101.description: I want to carry out research on the Leaping Scarlet Beast. Capture it, and break some of its parts so that it is easier to study. I have no interest in materials, so if anything interesting turns up, you may take it once the research is done. Capturing it without breaking any parts will count as a failure.
63101.descriptionEn:
I want to do research on the
leaping crimson beast.
Please capture it, and break some
parts so it's easier to study.
I'm not interested in materials, so
if you find something interesting,
you can keep it after the research.
Capture it without breaking parts
and it's a failure.

55491.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a horn break and a leg break in slaying Giaorugu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55491.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Giaorugu≫ and break its
horns and legs, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

63255.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
63255.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63255.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

60236.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Abiorugu! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60236.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill!
This time the target is «Abiorugu»!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
alone is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take a top place!
Also, this time only SP weapons are
allowed! Choose your weapon carefully!

21236.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21236.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

62632.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62632.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62632.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.

22010.description: The Congalala is a greedy fanged beast, and word is it has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course its minions the Conga love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, it might come out.
22010.descriptionEn:
The pink-furred beast «Congalala» is
a greedy fanged beast, and they say
it can't resist mushroom dishes!
Of course its minions the Conga
love mushrooms too!
If you carry plenty of specialty
mushrooms, it might show up.

50217.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
50217.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
50217.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!

55895.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55895.description: Thank you for saving my son and me the other day. The boy has taken quite a shine to you, hunter. So I have a request: would you let him watch you fight one more time? For my son's sake, please!
55895.descriptionEn:
Thank you for saving us father and
son earlier.
My son has completely come to look
up to you, hunter.
So I have a request - could you show
my son your fighting one more time?
For my son's sake, please!

55303.description: The Variant Species Rathalos has appeared once more. Its wings have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55303.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rathalos≫ has
appeared once more.
Its wings have grown more
powerful, and it seems to have
gained even more strength.
Please survey it with great care.

53103.description: Chachabu... ah, Chachabu, it was a chance to get close to you, but that chance is gone now. I feel not blue but dark. I could never hunt you, my friend, so I hired a hunter. Forgive me. I wanted to stay friends with you.
53103.descriptionEn:
Chachabu... ah, Chachabu, this was
my chance to get close to you, but
that chance is gone now.
I'm not blue, I'm more like dark.
Hunting you, my friend, is
unthinkable, but I put in a request
with a hunter.
Forgive me. I wanted to stay
friends with you.

55129.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
55129.description: Slaying a Dyuragaua raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55129.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Duramboros you can
raise your own rating while getting
a bargain on the materials needed
for G Rank decorations, so we've
prepared a quest for that.
Please make good use of it.

54750.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
54750.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
54750.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle!
We will also pay for the insects
that sometimes fly there,
Royal Beetles, if you deliver them!
Start by learning the Jungle and
getting used to it.

60804.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60804.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

58021.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58021.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58021.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

53204.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
53204.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Lukeze series, available from this request? It excels in resistance to status ailments and in evasion, so you can relax even when hunting tough monsters.
53204.descriptionEn:
Hunter, are you thinking of
changing out of the ≪Hope
Series≫ armor?
How about the ≪Luqueze Series≫
armor obtainable in this request?
It excels in status ailment
resistance and evasion, so you can
rest easy even when hunting
formidable monsters.

61508.description: A hunter is always either hunting or being hunted. To keep from being hunted, preparation beforehand is what matters. So, let us put it into practice at once. Hunt while watching out for the poison the monster spits!
61508.descriptionEn:
A hunter either hunts or is hunted.
To avoid being hunted, preparing
beforehand is what matters.
So let's put it into practice
right away.
Hunt while watching out for the
poison monsters spit!

55933.description: This quest yields the following materials. Magnet Spike Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Magnet Spike Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Magnet Spike Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
55933.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Intro≫ x100
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Mid≫ x165
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest you need a
≪Secret Medal Crystal≫, so please
take care.

53046.description: A Chameleos has appeared in the swamp. However, the swamp road seems to be blocked by someone. To undo the mechanism, a book hidden in the Old Tower is needed, they say. We will lend you a ward gunlance, so please investigate. As a reward we will give ward materials.
53046.descriptionEn:
A “Chameleos” has appeared in
the Swamp.
However, the swamp road seems to
have been blocked by someone.
To undo the mechanism, a “book”
hidden in the Ancient Tower is needed.
We'll lend you a ward Gunlance, so
please investigate.
We'll give you ward materials as reward.

54210.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
54210.description: We are seeking hunters to help investigate the black wolf bird that appeared in the Jungle. The black wolf bird basically acts alone, but that is thought to be because it is strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request unless you are a hunter with a solid record.
54210.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters to help
survey the Yian Garuga that
appeared in the Jungle.
Yian Garuga basically act alone,
likely because they're strong enough
not to need a pack.
This is a dangerous request that
requires a hunter with solid results.

21518.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21518.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21518.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

26222.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

53253.description: One does not become a hunter on half-hearted resolve. The craft of facing monsters and surviving, and a strong heart, are both essential. So I ask you this. With what resolve did you become a hunter? Show it to me. Show me that resolve and I will present you with a special reward!
53253.descriptionEn:
One cannot become a hunter with
half-hearted feelings.
The skills to survive facing a
monster and a strong heart are vital.
So I ask you: with what resolve did
you become a hunter? Show it to me.
If you show your resolve, I'll give
you a special reward!
