50765.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Baruragaru Gou armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the swamp, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
50765.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Swamp, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
"Stroma F Series" ≪Heavenly
Storm≫ armor up to Lv7.

54362.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
54362.description: This time there was a report that a Shogun Ceanataur is on the rampage in the Swamp. It seems to be an extremely vicious individual, and several hunters who went to survey it have been injured. Hunters confident in their skill who can slay this Shogun Ceanataur, please take this request.
54362.descriptionEn:
We've received reports that a
«Shogun Ceanataur» is rampaging
in the Swamp.
It seems to be an extremely vicious
one, and several hunters sent to
survey it have been injured.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please take this request.

50292.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
50292.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt an Akura Vashimu beautifully. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50292.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Hunt the «Tail Crystal Scorpion» well.
Clear the quest and your reputation
as a hunter will shoot up!

50243.description: You are looking for a new weapon, aren't you? I can tell, having provided weapons to all sorts of hunters. Then let me set you this trial. If you clear it splendidly, I'll acknowledge your ability and part with a special material.
50243.descriptionEn:
You're looking for a new weapon,
aren't you? I can tell - I've
provided weapons to all sorts
of hunters.
Then I'll give you this trial.
If you complete it well, I'll
recognize your skill and part with
special materials.

61666.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の狩猟
61666.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Snowy Mountains, hunt 2 Bulldrome and the Blangonga's underlings. Then raise the guild flag from the supply box at the summit. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
61666.descriptionEn:
This time we hold special
training limited to hunters who
still have little experience!
In the Snowy Mountains, hunt two
great boars and the Snow Lion's
minions. Then plant the Guild
Flag from the supply box at the
summit.
It is harsh training, but once you
see it through, your standing as a
hunter will rise sharply!

53132.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
53132.description: To those aiming for HR100! We have prepared a quest to strengthen the "Karais Series" into the "Karais F Series". By hunting Doragyurosu, you can obtain materials to strengthen one piece into High Rank armor and level it up. Please make good use of it.
53132.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for HR100!
We have prepared a quest to
strengthen the "Karais Series"
into the "Karais F Series".
By hunting Doragyurosu, you can
obtain materials to strengthen one
piece into High Rank armor and
level it up.
Please make good use of it.

22093.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
22093.description: A report has come in that one monster researcher has developed a condition called Frenzy Fever. It seems he was infected by the Frenzy Virus during a monster survey. The Gore Magala is very likely the source of infection. To curb the spread of the Frenzy Virus, investigate the site at once.
22093.descriptionEn:
A report has come that one
monster researcher has developed
a symptom called Frenzy.
It seems he was infected by the
Frenzy Virus during monster
research.
The Gore Magala is very likely the
cause of infection.
To stop the spread of the Frenzy
Virus, survey the site at once.

56145.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56145.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.

55761.description: With Uragaan materials, the strength of the barrel went up dramatically! We're one step from completion. But in exchange for that strength it's become absurdly heavy. The prototype used coal to fuel its drive unit, but we need a higher-output material. Go and slay the Ten'i Species Midogaron!
55761.descriptionEn:
The ≪Uragaan≫ parts sent the
barrel's strength way up!
One more step to done.
But the trade-off is it got
stupidly heavy on us.
The prototype used coal for
the drive's fuel, but we
need something with more
output. Slay the Tesshi
Midogaron and get back!

56128.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56128.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Bogabadorumu that Strikes to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin, needed to accept the next request!
56128.descriptionEn:
Reports keep pouring in of re-sightings
of the “Acme” monsters, each a
great threat.
Judging this an emergency, I want
each of them slain quickly.
This time: “Acme Strikes Bogabadorumu”.
As proof of the slaying, I'll give you
a special coin needed to accept
the next request!

58087.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58087.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58087.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

23373.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

50842.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50842.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
50842.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!

26235.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ１００ and above.
26235.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass discovered in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain regions,
we offer guidance only to those
of HR 100 or above.

26475.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
26475.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. The Sand Wyverns show themselves above ground when startled by loud noise, so that's your chance!
26475.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Sand wyverns surface when
startled by loud noise, so
that's your chance!

55143.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐

55983.description: Taking on a request from me, the boss of the Dark Cat Gang, shows good nerve, meow. If you pull it off splendidly, I will give you a Dark Cat Gang Pass (White) as proof of membership, meow!
55983.descriptionEn:
Taking on a request from me, the
boss of the Dark Cat Gang - you've
got guts, meow.
If you pull it off, I'll give you a
«Dark Cat Gang Pass: White» as
proof of membership, meow!

61330.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

60907.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60907.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

50863.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50863.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50863.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, display the skill
you have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.

60143.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
60143.description: The king of the skies, Rathalos, is said to make its lair in the mysterious hunting ground, the Ancient Tower. We are seeking brave hunters to confirm whether that is true! Your opponent this time is the Azure King. Do not let your guard down until he bows to the ground!
60143.descriptionEn:
The King of the Skies ≪Rathalos≫
is said to nest in the enigmatic
hunting ground ≪Ancient Tower≫.
We seek brave hunters to prove
whether that is true!
Your foe this time is the
≪Azure King≫. Never let your
guard down until he kneels!

53176.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
53176.description: Was that really a Chachabu? I want to dress up in the swamp to understand how a Chachabu feels! But a Nono Orugaron roams the swamp. Slay it so I can dress up in peace! I will give you my old costume as a reward!
53176.descriptionEn:
Was that really
a Chachabu?
I want to dress up in the Swamp
to understand how they feel!
But in the Swamp
a Non Orugaron
is prowling around.
So I can dress up in peace,
go beat it! As a reward
I'll give you my old costume!

50699.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50699.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Tigrex will also grant a special ingredient.
50699.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Tigrex's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

21968.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21968.description: Odibatorasu seems to be running wild in the desert. It will be dangerous, but please investigate it somehow. The reward is precious decoration material.
21968.descriptionEn:
Odibatorasu seems to be
rampaging in the Desert.
I know it is dangerous, but
please survey it somehow.
The reward is rare decoration
materials.

55001.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55001.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

62009.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62009.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

26035.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
26035.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26035.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

50348.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
50348.description: A quest for the GG Advance Trial Event. Enjoy MHF-GG a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
50348.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
“GG Early Trial Event”.
Enjoy MHF-GG a step ahead of
everyone!
The time limit is 10 minutes.

54315.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Basarios beautifully. Clear the quest and I will give you more rewards than usual!
54315.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Go and hunt ≪Basarios≫
for all to see.
Clear the quest and I'll
give you rewards more
generous than usual!

21165.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
21165.description: There was a report of sighting an extremely powerful individual Crystal Wyvern at the top of the sea of trees. The Crystal Wyvern has a constitution that absorbs and reflects lightning, so hunting it carries considerable danger. We therefore ask skilled hunters to hunt it, so please.
21165.descriptionEn:
A report has come in that an
extremely powerful individual
Crystal Wyvern was sighted at
the top of the Great Forest.
The Crystal Wyvern absorbs and
reflects lightning, so hunting
it carries considerable danger.
We ask our skilled Hunters to
take on the hunt. Thank you.

55012.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
55012.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55012.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

54122.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ８頭の討伐

50560.description: A monster that eats the moon seems to have appeared. I want to study it, so capture it. If, during the capture, you make the monster spit out the moon, you may keep it. What, it is easy. Place meat in the path of its charge and let it eat to the limit, then attack when its movements slow. It will surely spit it up.
50560.descriptionEn:
A monster that eats the moon
seems to have appeared.
I want to study it, so capture it.
If, during the capture, you make the
monster spit out the moon, you may
keep it for yourself.
It's easy! Set meat to match its
charge and let it eat to the limit;
when it slows, attack.
It'll surely spit it back up.

23355.description: A request for hunters who possess Zerureusu G Rank Haku weapons. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Retsu weapons.
23355.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪G-Rank Supremacy Weapon≫
of the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪Fierce Weapon≫.

1055.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

53168.description: This is Miyashita. I want to eat a hamburger. [Question 5] The Partnya drawn on the official wallpaper distributed in 2014 number 5. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53168.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here.
I want a hamburger!
[Question 5]
The “Partnyaa” wallpaper officially
distributed in 2014 depicts
five Partnyaas.
Hunters who think the answer is
O (A), accept this quest!

50928.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50928.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the switch axe, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
50928.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena I have
released a «Rathian» that is very
powerful and acts in ways normally
unthinkable.
Hunter who seeks to master the
Switch Axe, show your skill before me!
Hunt it well and you'll gain even
more than daily effort brings.

62779.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62779.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62779.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

21654.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
21654.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Chlor Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21654.descriptionEn:
Notes said to have been lost,
recording the secret of weapon
crafting, are apparently being
found on monsters slain across
the land, I tell ya!
If you get a ≪Chlor Memo≫, be a
man! Bring it to this workshop
master!
I will show you good work, I
will!

54754.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54754.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
54754.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

50052.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50052.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields the materials needed to craft white Secret Armor. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50052.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest just
for members of a winning
Hunter Festival Guild, where
you can get the materials
needed to craft white Secret
Art Armor. Please bring your
Festival Proof when joining.

23299.objectiveJp: ルロウスイセン９９個の納品
23299.description: What will guide us, who began with a small seed and have known harvest, abundance and prosperity, to yet greater heights is nothing other than the glory shown by hunters who have reached G-rank.
23299.descriptionEn:
We began as a small seed and have
known harvest, abundance and
prosperity. What will lead us to
even greater heights can only be
the glory shown by hunters who
have reached ≪G Rank≫.

56139.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
56139.description: The slashhh! feeling of Nargacuga's wings from its quick movements is so cool! I want to go slashhh! with a Slash Axe F too! Right!? You do too, right!?
56139.descriptionEn:
Nargacuga's quick moves
unleash a Slaaaash! Those
wings are just so cool!
It makes me want to go
Slaaaash! with a Switch
Axe F myself, just to
keep up!
Right!? You feel it
too, don't you!?

55480.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章１０個の納品
55480.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Tangus D Series, the layered armor of the Tangus G Series. Tangus Release Ticket D x5.
55480.descriptionEn:
By clearing this request you can
obtain the layered unlock tickets
for the ≪Tangus D Series≫,
the layered look of the
≪Tangus G Series≫.
- Tangus Unlock Ticket D x5

63385.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
63385.description: There is a report that Shen Gaoren has invaded the Fortress. All hunters, head out to intercept at once. You may freely use the fortress's interception equipment. Make the most of it and drive the creature back.
63385.descriptionEn:
We have reports that the
Fortress Crab Shen Gaoren
is invading the ≪Fortress≫.
All hunters, head out to
intercept at once. You may
freely use the fortress
defenses. Make full use of
them and drive it back.

55789.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐

60218.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟

26629.description: It seems Guku are gathering in some areas. Maybe you can find what Guku like nearby. Why not go and look? If you want to come back, just deliver a map.
26629.descriptionEn:
It seems Gook have been gathering
in some areas, nyah.
Maybe you'll find the things that
Gook like somewhere nearby,
nyah.
Why not go and take a look?
If you want to come back,
just deliver a map, nyah.

50426.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

60571.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Meraginasu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60571.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Meraginasu≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! Origin weapons only
this time, so choose well!

50131.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★１ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50131.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★1 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.

14.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
14.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

50424.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21446.description: Hi there. Flower seller here. I planted the Iwahime Grass I got from a hunter in the highlands and lots of flowers bloomed. Hooray! By the way, I found a spot in the highlands where strange water springs up. I will trade that water for seeds I give you.
21446.descriptionEn:
Yoo-hoo. It's the flower girl.
I planted the Iwahime grass
a hunter gave me in the
Highlands, and lots of flowers
bloomed. Yay!
By the way, I found a spot in
the Highlands where strange
water springs up. I'll trade
it for seeds I hand out, hey.

21479.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21479.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21479.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

205.description: This is the final drill in the arena! So I have prepared a special opponent! And that opponent is! The phantom beast Kirin! A fine choice, if I say so myself! Do it properly!
205.descriptionEn:
This is the last Arena
exercise! So I prepared a
special opponent for you!
That opponent is the
Phantom Beast Kirin! A fine
choice, if I say so myself!

23539.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23539.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Akura Vashimu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23539.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Akura Vashimu≫ appears
to have reached a strength that
stands at the very summit even
among Akura Vashimu.
Its strength is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill to
take on the summit, please go and
conduct the survey.

55042.description: I have got great news! Rocks sometimes contain good ore, it seems. You might get Gleaming Sandstone or Kurareamu Ore. I wanted to investigate in the volcano at once, but there are monsters nearby. Could you deal with them?
55042.descriptionEn:
Amazing news has come in!
Apparently rocks sometimes
contain good ore. You might
get ≪Gleaming Sandstone≫
or ≪Kuraream Ore≫ from
them. I meant to survey the
Volcano at once, but there
are monsters nearby. Could
you do something about it?

55110.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55110.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

54772.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54772.description: It's me! You all have the look of veteran hunters now! But! Only by mastering a range of weapons does one become a true veteran! This time I want you to face the White Monoblos with a blunt weapon. Remember the days we trained together!
54772.descriptionEn:
It is I! You all have the
faces of seasoned hunters
now! But! A true veteran
hunter masters many kinds
of weapons! This time,
take on the White Monoblos
with a [Blunt] weapon.
Remember the days we
trained together, side
by side!

61351.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
61351.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!

54505.description: We are recruiting hunters to hunt the Hypnocatrice that appeared in the sea of trees. If hunting is judged difficult, you may slay the Velociprey and return, no problem.
54505.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters
to hunt the Hypnocatrice
that appeared in the Great
Forest. If you judge the
hunt too difficult, you may
slay Velociprey and return
instead — that is fine.

60114.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60114.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60114.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.

62954.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62954.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62954.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

26230.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
26230.description: If I can just get the blue Hypnocatrice fur that is so hard to obtain, I can make a dress second to none! The party is soon! Get it for me right now!
26230.descriptionEn:
If only I could get the blue
feathers of a Hypnocatrice, so
rarely obtained, I could make a
dress that loses to none!
There is no time left before the
party!
Get them for me this instant!

55364.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
55364.description: In a region where entry has been forbidden for many years, incidents of monsters turning abnormally ferocious have occurred frequently of late. The Heaven-Circling Dragon, Shagaru Magala, must have appeared! There is no telling how much damage this will cause if it goes on. Head out to hunt it at once.
55364.descriptionEn:
In a region where entry has been
forbidden for many years, there have
been many cases of monsters turning
strangely vicious lately.
The Heavenly Revolving Dragon
≪Shagaru Magala≫ must be behind it!
There is no telling how much damage
this will cause if left alone.
Please head out and slay it at once.

61771.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61771.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21098.description: The watersides of the desert are highly likely to hide the ancient Piscine Wyvern, Plesioth, lying in wait for prey. When fishing a Plesioth out with a Frog, it is important that few people are around. If you have companions, have them leave the area and settle it one on one.
21098.descriptionEn:
At the Desert's waterside, there
is a high chance the ancient fish
wyvern ≪Plesioth≫ lurks,
waiting for prey.
When angling a Plesioth with a
≪Fishing Frog≫, it is important
that few people are around.
If you have companions, have them
leave the area and settle it one
on one.

55007.description: There was a report that a powerful Chameleos appeared in the Forest and Hills. It is said to differ in appearance from the individual of before, and an immediate investigation is needed. We have prepared fitting rewards for hunters aiming to produce and upgrade G-rank arms, so please investigate.
55007.descriptionEn:
Reports say a powerful
≪Chameleos≫ has appeared in
Forest and Hills. It differs
from earlier individuals, so
an urgent survey is needed.
We have suitable rewards for
hunters after G Rank gear,
so please take the survey.

54396.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
54396.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Gold Rathian, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54396.descriptionEn:
To further promote the newly
started G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the Gold Rathian's
head will also grant you
special ingredients as a
bonus.

63157.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
63157.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63157.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55311.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Harudomerugu, the Silver Ruler Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55311.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Shrouded Silver
Dragon ≪Dahren Mohran≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.

51053.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
51053.description: You can obtain the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Transcendent armor Shagaru series. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
51053.descriptionEn:
You can get the materials
needed to craft and upgrade
one piece of the Transcend
Armor "Shagaru Series".
A bargain — give it a try!

51004.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51004.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
51004.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Lance, show me the skill you
have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.

23530.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
23530.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Guanzorumu, the Imperial Conquest Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23530.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Emperor
Dragon ≪Guanzorumu≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.

26120.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ３頭の討伐
26120.description: Bullfango is a small fanged beast with large tusks. It's a somewhat troublesome foe: it does nothing but charge straight at its target. Draw its attack, dodge aside, then chase it down and finish it off.
26120.descriptionEn:
≪Bullfango≫ are small
fanged beasts with big
tusks. They just charge
straight at their target,
a rather troublesome foe.
Draw its attack, dodge it,
then chase it down and
finish it off.

61937.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟

23209.description: In one area of the Jungle, there is a report that the poison bird wyvern flying in at night is damaging the trees. If left alone, every tree in that area may wither. Action is needed at once.
23209.descriptionEn:
There are reports of damage
to the trees in a Jungle
area, caused by Gypceros
that fly in after nightfall.
If left alone, every tree
in that area may wither
away. We must deal with
this at once.

62720.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

11036.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
11036.description: A subspecies of Gypceros has appeared in the swamp! It seems to have an eerie appearance with a purple body color! It has a habit of collecting shiny things, so if you break its crest you may sometimes get a precious stone!
11036.descriptionEn:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the Swamp!
It has an eerie purple body!
It loves to hoard shiny things,
so breaking its crest may yield
precious stones!

55770.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55770.description: Hunters who polish their skill day after day! The time has come to show the fruits of your daily training! Hunt the Tigrex splendidly. Clear the quest and your standing as hunters will shoot up!
55770.descriptionEn:
Hunters who hone their
skill day after day! The
time has come to show the
fruits of your training!
Go and hunt the ≪Tigrex≫
with style. Clear this quest
and your standing as a
hunter will shoot straight
up!

50180.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
50180.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50180.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

54291.description: The survey of the deep swamp has begun, and many reports are now coming in. Among them is a report of a black mountain-like dragon that appears with a rumbling of the earth. Please ascertain the identity of this monster at once.
54291.descriptionEn:
Surveying of the deep Swamp has
begun, and many reports are now
coming in. Among them we have
received word of a black,
mountain-like dragon that appears
alongside rumbling tremors.
Please determine this monster's
identity as a matter of urgency.

62978.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62978.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62978.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!

54370.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
54370.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.

62626.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62626.description: This is the final quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from the quest clear rewards.
62626.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Target monster materials cannot
be obtained from the quest clear
rewards.

50314.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Gypceros of the swamp. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50314.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Gypceros≫ in the
Swamp for us. Clear the quest
in fine style, and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
straight up!

54198.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
54198.description: Please investigate the Blangonga lurking in the Snowy Mountains. If you not only hunt it but break its head and sever its tail, I will add to the reward!
54198.descriptionEn:
We ask you to survey the
Blangonga that lurks in the
Snowy Mountains. Not just
the hunt — if you break its
head and cut off its tail,
we will add a bonus to your
rewards!

54224.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
54224.description: We will continue the survey of the Akura Vashimu that appeared in the desert. Breaking its parts is not required, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, we thank you for your help!
54224.descriptionEn:
We are continuing the survey
of Akura Vashimu, which has
appeared in the Desert.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid!

62295.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62295.description: Reading the lost map has revealed a new fact. The Orugaron seem to appear in the hidden area of the Ancient Tower. If you are lucky enough to encounter them, you should be able to obtain the Frozen Fang, an upgrade material for ice swords. There is no reason to let this chance pass, so depart at once!
62295.descriptionEn:
Reading the lost map has
revealed new facts. The
Orugaron seem to appear in
the hidden reaches of the
≪Ancient Tower≫. With luck
you may obtain ≪Frozen
Fang≫, a material for
upgrading ice blades.
We cannot pass this up —
depart at once!

60652.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
60652.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Lunastra. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60652.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is a
Special Individual
≪Lunastra≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! This one is Supremacy
weapons only!

55003.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55003.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55003.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

53052.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐
53052.description: Did you take part in the first act? To join the play featuring this Hypnocatrice Rare Species and a new audience, you need Supreme Junk. Hunters who have it are lucky. I will lend you armor befitting this feast, so why not join the play. And entertain me!
53052.descriptionEn:
Did you join the first act?
To take part in the play
featuring this Hypnocatrice
Rare and a new audience, you
need ≪Supreme Junk≫.
Lucky hunters who have it —
I will lend you armor fit
for this feast, so why not
join the play?
And entertain me!

53252.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
53252.description: Please help with research on the customs of Eastern regions! I want you to bring the materials for something shaped like a fish that our documents describe as koinobori. A monster seen in the volcano seemed a good substitute. Take care!
53252.descriptionEn:
Please help with research on
the customs of the eastern
regions! My documents
describe something called a
"koinobori", shaped like a
fish — I want you to bring
materials for it. A monster
seen in the Volcano should
serve. Be careful!

50987.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
50987.description: The heavenly revolving dragon Shagaru Magala has never been observed in this region, and its ecology is wrapped in mystery. To clarify its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its tail or wing limbs in addition to slaying it, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
50987.descriptionEn:
Shagaru Magala has never
been observed in this region,
and its ecology is wrapped in
mystery. To clarify it, we
will pay extra if you break
its tail or wing-legs in
addition to slaying it.
We await the challenge of
brave hunters.

50367.description: Eager hunters with strong will are most welcome! The Hunters Guild will always support your activities too! To cheer on such hunters, I have prepared something splendid. Complete this request every day and show me that strong will!!
50367.descriptionEn:
Motivated hunters with a strong
will are most welcome!
The Hunters Guild will always
support your activities!
To cheer on such hunters, I
have prepared something fine.
Complete this request every day
and show me that strong will
of yours!!

23394.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
23394.description: From an investigator who headed to the top of the sea of trees, there was a sighting of a rare Pale Blue Hypnocatrice. It is also reported that it launches attacks gracefully as if dancing. Please prepare fully and investigate.
23394.descriptionEn:
A surveyor who went to the top
of the Great Forest reported a
rare ≪Hypnocatrice Rare≫
sighting. It is also said to
attack with the grace of a
dancing bird. Please prepare
thoroughly before you head
out on the survey.

53209.description: Always chasing us around! I'm angry, mya! I'll trouble you with a quiz popular in the Felyne Guild, mya! If you want to craft a special weapon, clear this quest, mya!
53209.descriptionEn:
You're always chasing us
around! I'm mad, meow!
I'll stump you with a quiz
that's all the rage in the
Felyne Union, meow!
If you want to craft a
special weapon, clear this
quest, meow!

12.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
12.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

63226.description: Rookie hunters! Are you worrying about which weapon to make? A request just right for you has come in! There are restrictions on accepting it, but word is you can make a very handy weapon. Won't you take it on?
63226.descriptionEn:
Rookie hunters! Are you
wondering which weapon to
craft? A request perfect
for you has just arrived!
There are limits on taking
it, but word is you can
make a very handy weapon.
It has a good reputation.
Why not give it a try?

1013.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
1013.description: Woooh! They say a Plesioth has appeared at the water's edge in the jungle! I heard it from the village chief! If it were true I would go and thrash it myself, but this time I leave it to you! Hunt it properly!!
1013.descriptionEn:
Whoa! Word is a ≪Plesioth≫
showed up at the Jungle
water's edge! Heard it from
the village chief! Normally
I'd go wallop it myself, but
this time I'll leave it to
you! Hunt it good!!

21156.description: An exceptionally powerful individual of the Tide Island Gogomoa has been found. The hunt will be harsh on an island we still know little about, so please carry out the survey with care!
21156.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful
individual of the leaping
Gogomoa has been found on
Tidal Island. Information is
scarce and the hunting harsh
— please survey with care!

1064.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

55866.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55866.description: Hey, do you know the rumor of the Fanged Beast Valentine? A hunter who reaches true solitude becomes a Fanged Beast Valentine, a being that loathes lovers' events! Scary, right? Christmas is a lovers' event too, so do not get in the way!
55866.descriptionEn:
Hey, know the rumor about
the Fanged Beast Valentine?
A hunter who masters being
alone becomes a Fanged Beast
Valentine and hates lovers'
events! So scary, right?
Christmas is a lovers' event
too, so don't ruin it!

26172.description: The far-off land of the Forest and Hills overflows with great bounty. For a fine hunter who has reached ＨＲ５１, surely you are qualified enough to enjoy the bounty of the Forest and Hills? I recommend you go and see for yourself.
26172.descriptionEn:
The far-off land of ≪Forest and
Hills≫ overflows with great bounty.
For a fine hunter who has reached
HR 51, surely you have more than
enough qualification to enjoy the
blessings of Forest and Hills?
I recommend you go there once.

62607.description: This is a practice qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving the monster or from the quest clear rewards.
62607.descriptionEn:
This is a practice qualifier
quest for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament. You cannot obtain
the target monster's materials
from carving the monster or
from the quest clear rewards.

204.description: In this arena, monster and hunter face off one on one! This time your opponent is a Shogun Ceanataur. Mind those long scythes on both arms!
204.descriptionEn:
In this Arena you will fight
a one-on-one showdown,
monster versus hunter!
This time it's Shogun
Ceanataur. Watch out for
those long scythes!

54463.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54463.description: Good news for G Rank hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot accept it past the set number of times, but one run is hugely effective! May it aid you!
54463.descriptionEn:
Good news for G Rank
hunters! A training method
that builds experience
efficiently has been
developed. You cannot accept
it past the set number of
times, but one run is hugely
effective! May it aid you!

62659.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Snowy Mountains, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Aurora, the Voice of Nature: Spring Water, or the Voice of Nature: Mountains. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62659.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Snowy Mountains≫, you may
obtain ≪Nature's Voice: Aurora≫,
≪Nature's Voice: Spring Water≫,
or ≪Nature's Voice: Mountains≫.
I pray that your hunting life
grows ever richer and more
fulfilling.

60582.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Rathian. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60582.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Rathian≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! Also, this is Origin
weapons only, so choose well!

50694.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
50694.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50694.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

50229.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
50229.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
50229.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

61301.description: A sudden order means I need a large quantity of Volcano specialties. Please gather them at once and hunt the nuisances! Right now I will specially add this rare stone to your reward, so please!
61301.descriptionEn:
A sudden order means I need
a lot of Volcano specialties!
Please gather them fast and
hunt the pests! Right now I
will throw in this rare
stone as a bonus — go on!

26698.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
26698.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Desert, hunt 2 bird wyverns and a school of fish wyverns, and to finish, bring back a Herbivore Egg from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
26698.descriptionEn:
This time, we hold special
training for Hunters with
little experience yet!
In the Desert, hunt a flock of
2 Bird Wyverns and a Piscine
Wyvern, then finish by bringing
back a herbivore egg from the
cave. Do it and your standing
will rise!

56122.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56122.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

26238.description: A new way to upgrade armor has come about, which is good, but I heard someone was in trouble, being asked for Armor Spheres, so I came running! Leave making Armor Spheres to me! There are several kinds of Armor Sphere, and this time it is the Great Armor Sphere. Bring me Sphere Fragments!
26238.descriptionEn:
New armor upgrade methods
are great, but I hear folks
are stuck needing Armor
Spheres — so here I am!
Leave sphere making to me!
There are several kinds, and
this time it's ≪Large Armor
Sphere≫. Bring Fragments!

54688.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. Breaking the Purple Gypceros' head will also grant special ingredients.
54688.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and promote them
further.
Breaking the Espinas
Subspecies' head will also
grant special ingredients.

55423.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ２匹の狩猟
55423.description: At the signs of a new Variant appearing, the Guild has prepared a new hammer for promising hunters to face the Variants. Obtain the production materials and prepare for the Variant hunt!
55423.descriptionEn:
With new Supremacy signs
appearing, the Guild has
prepared a new Hammer for
promising hunters to face
them. Gather the crafting
materials and ready yourself
for the Supremacy hunt!

23352.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
23352.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Daimyo Hermitaur in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
23352.descriptionEn:
To support hunters' hunting
lives, we have prepared a
request to hunt Daimyo
Hermitaur in the New Great
Arena. Clearing it earns you
a higher rating than usual.
Train efficiently and aim
even higher!

12004.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
12004.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, is tough and a brute. You must not let your guard down. Especially in this cold season, I think it is on edge from hunger. It is fine to play it safe and catch a Goldenfish instead, you know?
12004.descriptionEn:
The ≪Bulldrome≫, leader of the
Bullfango, is tough and wild.
You must not let your guard down.
In this cold season especially,
I bet he is hungry and on edge.
If it is too much, you could just
fish up a ≪Goldenfish≫ instead?

61216.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61216.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

26257.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26257.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26257.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

21125.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. By destroying its parts, you can sometimes get ore without mining. When that happens, it's two birds with one stone.
21125.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you can get ore
without mining, it seems.
That would be two birds
with one stone, wouldn't it.

21641.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21641.description: Thanks for playing MHF for six whole years! Equip Cursed Blade: Dancing Thunder and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude O as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude O forge Haunting Thorn (Sword & Shield).
21641.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for six whole years!
Equip ≪Cursed Blade:
Dancing Thunder≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude O≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude O≫ forge ≪Haunting
Thorn≫ (Sword & Shield).

60916.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60916.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60916.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

21844.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62705.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62705.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

40137.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
40137.description: The Yian Kut-Ku of this jungle is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40137.descriptionEn:
The ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ that lives in
this Jungle is said to sometimes
carry incredible treasure.
If that is true, I would love
for you to go hunt one for us.
We will split the reward
right down the middle.

60241.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Black Diablos. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60241.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Black Diablos≫! Facing a
monster alone shows spirit —
truly admirable! Overcome
yourself and place high!

50445.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26233.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

55959.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55959.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

63356.objectiveJp: 冥雷竜の焦鱗５個の納品
63356.description: Mezeporuta is currently under attack by Conquest monsters, and further attacks are expected. The guild has therefore decided to give high recognition to hunters who bring down many Conquest monsters, to encourage them further. This is a grave situation, but do not miss this opportunity!
63356.descriptionEn:
Mezepolta is currently under
attack by Zenith monsters,
and the assaults are expected
to continue. The Guild has
thus decided to highly commend
hunters who slay many Zeniths,
to encourage them further.
It is a grave situation, but
do not let this chance slip by!

54119.description: We are seeking hunters to help investigate the Gypceros that appeared in the Jungle! While you are at it, we also ask you to slay the quietly troublesome Gabras. For the sake of future surveys, please help!
54119.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters
to help survey the Gypceros
that appeared in the Jungle!
While you are at it, please
also slay the quietly
annoying Gabras. For the
sake of future research,
please lend a hand!

55908.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
55908.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55908.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.

26050.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26050.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

21874.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21874.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Yian Kut-Ku in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21874.descriptionEn:
To support hunters' hunting
life, we prepared a request
to hunt ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ in the
New Great Arena. Clearing
it earns a higher rating
than usual. Train
efficiently and aim even
higher!

1047.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon also called the Sickle Crab. If the Shield Crab is defense, the Sickle Crab is offense! Those sharp claws, swung down with force, slash through almost anything! If the hunt is too much, break the claws and come back!
1047.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon called the Scythe
Crab. If the Shield Crab
defends, this one attacks!
Its claws cut through most
anything! If the hunt is too
hard, break its claws and go.

21325.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21325.description: What, you just want a hard Great Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21325.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Great Sword
that is simply hard as rock?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and nasty
monsters are prowling around
the area on top of that.
So go find it with some spirit!

21023.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

55345.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55345.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

26347.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26347.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26347.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50904.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50904.description: We present a request that lets you obtain in one go the rare materials of Aberrant individuals needed to upgrade the Frost King Wyvern's Supremacy armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50904.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting it, but we present
a request that gives you all
the ≪rare Special Individual
materials≫ needed to upgrade
Disufiroa's ≪Zenith Armor≫.
Please take the chance and
try it!

53192.objectiveJp: コウザンダケ３個の納品

61501.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
61501.description: A request to hunt the giant Lunastra that has taken up residence at the very top of the Old Tower in the frontier. The tower is now extremely dangerous, but for one person alone it seems you can be carried to the summit by balloon. An extremely dangerous request, but we await a brave soul to take it on!
61501.descriptionEn:
A request to slay the giant Lunastra
that has settled at the very top
of the remote Ancient Tower.
The Ancient Tower is currently
very dangerous, but if you go alone
we should be able to send you to
the top by balloon. It is an extremely
dangerous request, but we await
a brave soul willing to try!

54195.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54195.description: We ask you to investigate the bird wyvern lurking in the Jungle. Not only hunt it: if you skillfully break the bird wyvern's ears, I will add to your reward!
54195.descriptionEn:
We ask you to survey the
Yian Kut-Ku hiding in the
Jungle. Not just the hunt —
if you break its ears nicely,
we will add a bonus to your
rewards!

40209.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
40209.description: You train all the time, but are you training the right way? I've prepared a quest where you can train very easily. However, it consumes Command Seals, so you can only take it three times no matter what.
40209.descriptionEn:
You train all the time, but
is it the right training?
I have prepared a quest that
trains you very easily. It
costs a Command Seal, and
you can take it only 3 times.

51104.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
51104.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Doragyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
51104.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Doragyurosu's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

62924.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Desert, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Fallen Tree or the Voice of Nature: Snowstorm. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62924.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. This request is set
in the ≪Desert≫, and by
clearing it you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Fallen Tree≫
or ≪Voice of Nature: Blizzard≫.
I pray your hunting life grows
ever more fulfilling.

54490.description: During the survey I ran into a Red Khezu. I tried to flee at once, but its unusual movements toyed with me and I nearly took a face full of electricity. At this rate the survey cannot proceed. I want you to hunt it.
54490.descriptionEn:
During the survey we ran into
a ≪Khezu Subspecies≫.
We tried to run right away, but
it toyed with us using movements
unlike its usual ones, and we
nearly got caught in its shock.
The survey cannot go on like this.
I want you to hunt that thing.

50463.description: Eager hunters with strong will are most welcome! The Hunters Guild will always support your activities too! To cheer on such hunters, I have prepared something splendid. Complete this request every day and show me that strong will!!
50463.descriptionEn:
Motivated hunters with a strong
will are most welcome!
The Hunters Guild will always
support your activities!
To cheer on such hunters, I
have prepared something fine.
Complete this request every day
and show me that strong will
of yours!!

22157.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
22157.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Lukeze series, available from this request? It excels in resistance to status ailments and in evasion, so you can relax even when hunting tough monsters.
22157.descriptionEn:
Hunter, are you thinking of
changing out of the ≪Hope
Series≫ armor?
How about the ≪Luqueze Series≫
armor obtainable in this request?
It excels in status ailment
resistance and evasion, so you can
rest easy even when hunting
formidable monsters.

55211.description: Slaying a Kirin raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55211.descriptionEn:
By slaying Kirin you can
raise your own rating and
cheaply obtain the materials
needed for G Rank
decorations. We have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

63189.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63189.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

50594.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50594.description: I hate Gravios Subspecies! Always in my way, not one good memory! You! Would you go and punish a Gravios Subspecies? I have weapons and armor ready! I am counting on you!
50594.descriptionEn:
I hate Black Gravios! It always,
always gets in my way, and I do
not have a single good memory of
it! You there! Would you go and
teach that Black Gravios a lesson
for me? I have weapons and armor
ready for you! I am counting on
you!

61336.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61336.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

50164.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

60232.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
60232.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gasurabazura! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60232.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Gasurabazura≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! This time it is SP
weapons only, so choose well!

23730.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Merit (Beginning) x５０, Gunlance Merit (Middle) x６０, Gunlance Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23730.descriptionEn:
This quest offers the
following materials.
≪Gunlance Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Gunlance Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Gunlance Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept it you need
≪Secret Art Merit Crystal≫
and GR 500 or above, so
please take note.

54904.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54904.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

50589.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50589.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

55192.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55192.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

21774.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
21774.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21774.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

20020.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
20020.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The wind wyvern Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20020.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
Kushala Daora has entered
Mezeporuta's territory!
Mezeporuta now moves to
intercept the Elder Dragon!
Use the interception gear at
the Base and slay it fully!

50708.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the ears of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku will also grant a special ingredient.
50708.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Blue Yian Kut-Ku's ears,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

26279.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26279.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

55432.description: The Variant Species Midogaron appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Midogaron. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55432.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ seems
to have reached a strength that
puts it at the very summit of
all Midogaron.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit, we ask
you to take on this survey.

54471.description: For the survey, would you hunt a White Espinas for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the abdomen and sever the tail. They are extremely dangerous and get in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break the parts!
54471.descriptionEn:
Could you hunt the ≪Espinas
Rare Species≫ for the survey?
Oh, I forgot something
important. Be sure to break
its belly and cut off its
tail. It is very dangerous
and gets in the way of the
survey. A hunt alone will
not count. Break the parts
for certain, got it!

12045.description: If you're hit by the dung Congalala throws, you won't be able to use healing items. If hunting Congalala is hard, trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver the item you get.
12045.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Congalala≫'s
thrown dung and you can't
use healing items.
If hunting the ≪Congalala≫
is too much, trade the
underground ≪Khezu Whelp≫ to
the Veggie Elder and hand
in what you get for it.

21208.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21208.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

21872.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
21872.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Iron Color Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21872.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the sphere
called the Iron-Colored
Sphere? Its material is
essential for crafting a
certain expensive decoration.
Clear this request and I
will give you a precious
decoration material.

54756.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54756.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
54756.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!

23729.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Merit (Beginning) x５０, Lance Merit (Middle) x６０, Lance Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23729.descriptionEn:
This quest offers the
following materials.
≪Lance Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Lance Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Lance Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept it you need
≪Secret Art Merit Crystal≫
and GR 500 or above, so
please take note.

23161.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト１匹の納品
23161.description: I went into the jungle, where I had never much ventured before, and made a very interesting discovery. Among the materials that can be gathered there were some I had never seen. The monsters living there were tough, but I think it is well worth going.
23161.descriptionEn:
I went into the Great Forest,
a place I had barely entered
before, and made a very
interesting find. Among the
gatherable materials was
something I had never seen.
The monsters living there
were tough, but it is well
worth the trip, I say.

23663.description: There are 2 beasts, red and blue, in the unsurveyed zone of the Canyon, meow! If you work with the old man and slay them, your understanding of magnetism will surely deepen, meow! When you complete the quest, do not forget to report to the old man, meow!
23663.descriptionEn:
Two beasts, one red and one
blue, are in the unsurveyed
Canyon, meow! Work with
uncle to slay them, and I
am sure your grasp of
magnetism will deepen!

When you clear it, do not
forget to report, meow!

40193.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
40193.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40193.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!

62060.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
