62060.description: G-go to the Forest. Go to the Forest and hunt an Espinas! Ah, that is no ordinary Espinas. It is not a subspecies or a rare species, but something was definitely different. I will give you the strange material I picked up there, so please!
62060.descriptionEn:
G-go to the Great Forest. Head
out and hunt an ≪Espinas≫ for
me! Ah, but that is no ordinary
≪Espinas≫. It is not a
subspecies or a rare species,
but something was absolutely
wrong with it. I will give you
the strange material I picked
up out there, so please go!

60725.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60725.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60725.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

60531.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟

55577.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55577.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

62641.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62641.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

23640.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23640.description: Hunter who would master the light gun, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23640.descriptionEn:
Hunters who seek to master the Light
Bowgun, show the skill you have honed
against the ≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you shall
obtain even more rewards than
what your daily efforts
would bring.
Now, display your technique!

50361.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
50361.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
50361.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

61732.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Volcano, hunt a Gravios and slay great numbers of Vespoid. Then carry back one red hot Firestone and deliver it. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
61732.descriptionEn:
This time, we hold special
training for Hunters with
little experience yet!
In the Volcano, hunt a Basarios
and slay a large number of
Vespoids, then carry 1 red-hot
blasting rock back and deliver
it. It's harsh, but success
will raise your standing!

21604.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21604.description: Do you know the orb called the Tortoise Shell Origin Orb? Its material is indispensable to the production of a certain expensive decoration. If you clear this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21604.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the sphere
called the Tortoise-Shell
Sphere? Its material is
essential for crafting a
certain expensive decoration.
Clear this request and I
will give you a precious
decoration material.

60561.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks!
60561.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Espinas≫! You will achieve
it together with your Guild
mates. Teamwork decides
this contest — place high
and show what you can do!

54883.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
54883.description: They say a raw, wet sound of something devouring flesh and blood comes up from beneath Tide Island. When a hunter went down into the great pit to look, two red eyes came bursting out of the dust and the stench and charged him. Whoever discovers what this creature is will receive armor the guild has kept hidden.
54883.descriptionEn:
You can hear fresh, raw
sounds of flesh being eaten
from beneath Tidal Island.
When a hunter went down
into the great pit to look,
red glowing eyes burst out
of the dust with a terrible
stench and attacked.
Whoever identifies this
thing gets Guild secret armor.

50189.objectiveJp: クアルセプス２頭の狩猟
50189.description: According to the surveyor's report, a dazzling light of unknown cause has repeatedly been seen in the desert. We would like you hunters to investigate that cause and deal with it. Please! Lend us your strength.
50189.descriptionEn:
According to surveyor
reports, blinding light of
unknown origin is often seen
in the Desert. We would like
hunters to investigate the
cause and deal with it.
Please! We ask for your
help!

26335.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26335.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62707.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

62988.description: G-go to the Forest. Go to the Forest and hunt an Espinas! Ah, that is no ordinary Espinas. It is not a subspecies or a rare species, but something was definitely different. I will give you the strange material I picked up there, so please!
62988.descriptionEn:
G-go to the Great Forest. Head
out and hunt an ≪Espinas≫ for
me! Ah, but that is no ordinary
≪Espinas≫. It is not a
subspecies or a rare species,
but something was absolutely
wrong with it. I will give you
the strange material I picked
up out there, so please go!

1062.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. If a Melynx steals an item, do not fuss, just take it back. You might even pick up their pouch, you know?
1062.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder
Dragons and is called the
≪Phantom Beast≫ for wielding
lightning freely. If a
≪Melynx≫ steals your item,
do not panic — take it back.
You might find their pouch!

54798.description: Please accompany us to the canyon to investigate the Toridcless. According to prior survey, it can finish its prey by discharging electricity from all over its body. We ask for your help in learning more of its ecology.
54798.descriptionEn:
We ask you to accompany us
to the Canyon to study the
≪Toridokuresu≫. Prior
surveys say it can finish
its prey by discharging
electricity from all over
its body. Please lend your
aid to learn more of it.

60535.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の狩猟
60535.description: A call for help has come from the party that set out for the Snowy Mountains to slay Tigrex! It seems they ran into two Tigrex! Every moment counts! Those confident in their skill, head for the Snowy Mountains now!
60535.descriptionEn:
A distress call has come
from the party that went to
the ≪Snowy Mountains≫ to
slay a Tigrex! Seems they
ran into two of them!
There is not a moment to
spare! Any hunter sure of
their skill, head there now!

50486.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１７. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Abiorugu. I am counting on you!
50486.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR17.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as your reward?
It is a simple job, really. Just
make one quick trip and slay
an Abiorugu for me.
I am counting on you!

62331.description: Perhaps because the invitations went out, hunters have been gathering. Some are assembling companions and setting off on quests, others are forming hunting parties and calling for members; it is lively and a joy to see. Would you take on this request together with such companions? On success, I shall give you a black jewel.
62331.descriptionEn:
Perhaps because we sent out
invitations, hunters have been
gathering. Some set off on
quests with friends, others form
Guilds and call for members; it
is lively and a joy to see.
Why not take this request on
together with such companions?
Upon success, I will give you
a black jewel.

55180.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55180.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Rukodiora while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55180.descriptionEn:
By slaying Rukodiora you can
raise your own rating and
cheaply obtain the materials
needed for G Rank
decorations. We have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

23639.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23639.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23639.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, show the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will gain even more reward than
what your daily efforts bring.

55681.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55681.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

62048.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

50278.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス２頭の討伐
50278.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50278.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

21543.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21543.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21543.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

23362.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Haku armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the desert, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma G Series G Rank Haku Armor up to LV7.
23362.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Supremacy≫ armor of the
≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Desert, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪G-Rank Supremacy≫
"Stroma G" armor to Lv7.

23489.description: The golden dragon we encountered before has, as a result of the survey, been identified as the Gold Dust Dragon, Garuba Daora. Sightings are extremely few, and it is uncertain whether we will meet it on this voyage, but to ensure safety we ask a G-rank hunter to accompany us.
23489.descriptionEn:
It is the golden dragon we met
before. Our survey showed it to
be the Gold Dust Dragon,
≪Garuba Daora≫.
Sightings are extremely few, so
we may not meet it on this
route, but to ensure safety we
ask G Rank hunters to
accompany us.

62440.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62440.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

21145.description: There is a report that a Berukyuros, thought to live only in the wasteland known as the Canyon, was sighted at a certain old tower. It appears to be a powerful individual and the area is extremely dangerous, so supplies cannot be delivered, but hunters confident in their skill are asked to hunt it.
21145.descriptionEn:
We have a report that a
≪Berukyurosu≫, thought to live
only in the ≪Canyon≫ of the
wastelands, was sighted at
a certain Ancient Tower.
It seems to be a powerful one,
and the area is very dangerous,
so no supplies can be sent in.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please take on this hunt.

60922.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟

62215.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
62215.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Diablos. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62215.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunt Technique Quest to slay
a ≪Diablos≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
other hunters here!

60560.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kirin. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60560.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Kirin≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! This time it is Origin
weapons only, so choose well!

21180.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
21180.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

62722.description: You say Guku are cute? You do not get it. I mean the burning soul you can see behind those round eyes! The smaller they are, the hotter! Once you ride one, no matter how it throws you, you will not let go! I will show you a small one with that kind of spirit.
62722.descriptionEn:
You say Gook are cute? You
do not get it at all. I mean
that burning soul you can
see behind those round eyes!
The little ones burn hotter!
Once you ride one, no
thrashing will throw you
off! I will show you a little
one with that much guts now!

50553.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ５１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Akura Vashimu. I am counting on you!
50553.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR51.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as your reward?
It is a simple job, really. Just
make one quick trip and slay
an Akura Vashimu for me.
I am counting on you!

50619.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50619.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Teostra will also grant a special ingredient.
50619.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
running, we have prepared this
quest to further raise awareness
and promote them.
By breaking the Teostra's head,
we will also grant you some
special ingredients.

1025.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
1025.description: Word is a Plesioth subspecies has been sighted in the desert this season. They say its hide is as beautiful as jade! Even so, hunting a Plesioth is no easy task. Do not push yourself too hard!
1025.descriptionEn:
In this season's Desert, a
Plesioth subspecies shows up
now and then, they say! Word
is its body color is as
lovely as jade! Still,
hunting Plesioth is no easy
job! Do not push yourself!

58123.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58123.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58123.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50256.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Soul (Beginning) x８５, Hunting Horn Soul (Middle) x１９５, Hunting Horn Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Hunting Horn Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50256.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest, you will
need a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please be aware of that.

54204.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54204.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

5002.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の撃退

21813.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, please plant our Guild Flag at the summit.
21813.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species, has no fixed habitat, and
because its numbers are so small is
a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
please plant our ≪Guild Flag≫
at the summit♪

53019.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
53019.description: Did you get chocolate in return from the male hunters? If you did, then you are only one push away! We have prepared a request to raise even higher the burning passion you all carry.
53019.descriptionEn:
Male hunters, did you get
any chocolate in return?
If you did, then you are
just one step from the
finish! We have prepared a
request to fire up that
burning passion of yours
even further.
Give it a try!

21967.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21967.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
21967.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

61246.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61246.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.

53211.description: I am that person's stand-in. With a half-hearted attitude you will never master that technique. This time your own capacity is being tested. There will not be a second chance. Are you ready? Now, go and meet it!
53211.descriptionEn:
I am standing in for that
person. With a half-hearted
heart you cannot master
that technique. This time
your own capacity is tested.
There will not be a second
chance. Are you ready?
Now go and meet them!

62008.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62008.description: This is an old story, but it seems our guild once held a festival in which male and female hunters competed. We could not reproduce it, but we have prepared a request that lets you experience the memories of those days, so won't you take it?
62008.descriptionEn:
This is an old story, but
our Guild once held a
festival where male and
female hunters competed. We
could not recreate it, but we
prepared a request that lets
you feel those days. Try it?

50453.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

60233.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
60233.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gasurabazura. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60233.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Gasurabazura≫! You will
achieve it together with
your Guild mates. Teamwork
decides this contest — place
high and show what you can
do! This time it is SP
weapons only, so choose well!

50549.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
50549.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Pale Hypnocatrice, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
50549.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner doing well,
meow? Time to treat your buddy
for a change, meow!
Now, to business, meow. This
request is to hunt 1 Hypnocatrice
Rare, meow. The reward is
materials to craft Palico gear,
meow! I am counting on you, meow!

21970.description: This quest gives production materials for the Dual Blades whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
21970.descriptionEn:
This quest provides the materials
to craft a pair of Dual Blades
whose performance was decided
by a survey held to commemorate
surpassing 700,000 Zinogre
hunted in the Zinogre hunting
unlock event, "Transcendent
Species Invasion! Hunt Zinogre."

60322.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
60322.description: This is a rush job. I want you to hunt the requested number of Gendrome and Genprey. Sorry to rush you, but for your sake I will carve at least three Paralysis Sacs. I will show you the secrets of a master carver.
60322.descriptionEn:
This is a bit of a rush job.
I want you to hunt the number
of ≪Iodrome≫ and ≪Ioprey≫
we asked for.
Sorry to demand speed like this,
but for your trouble I will carve
at least 3 ≪Paralysis Sacs≫
for you myself.
I will show you the art of carving!

11082.description: We are looking for people to slay 8 Genprey, the hunters of the desert! They are just the right opponents to measure your skill as a hunter!
11082.descriptionEn:
Recruiting hunters to slay 8
Desert Hunter ≪Ioprey≫!
They are just the right foe for
gauging a hunter's skill at
the hunt!

62673.description: An exceptionally powerful individual of the Tide Island Gogomoa has been found. The hunt will be harsh on an island we still know little about, so we ask that only hunters able to prove their skill take on the survey and hunt!
62673.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful individual
of the Tidal Island's leaping
beast ≪Gogomoa≫ has been found.
Info on the Tidal Island is
still scarce and the hunt is
harsh, so this is limited to
Hunters who can prove their skill!

63021.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
63021.description: The Blue Hunter, transformed into a terrifying monster. The Black Hunter, fighting without flinching. Please recreate this scene that suggests a falling out between heroes. As before, we have prepared the black suit. Go with all your might, Black Hunter!
63021.descriptionEn:
Blue Hunter, transformed
into a terrifying monster.
Black Hunter, fighting
without flinching. Please
recreate this scene that
hints at a falling-out
between heroes. As before,
we have prepared the black
suit. Go forth, Black Hunter!

54151.description: We are recruiting hunters to take on the armored wyvern that strides through the swamp! If the hunt proves too difficult, you may slay Kelbi instead and return.
54151.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters
to hunt the Gravios striding
through the Swamp! If the
hunt is too hard, you may
slay Kelbi and return — that
is no problem at all.

54266.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54266.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54266.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

50375.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50375.description: A Shogun Ceanataur never before sighted has been spotted in the swamp. Special monsters have been confirmed recently, so proceed to the hunt with the utmost care.
50375.descriptionEn:
A ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ never
before sighted has been seen
in the Swamp. Unusual
monsters have been confirmed
lately, so head out for the
hunt with the utmost care.

23487.description: A Prime Species monster has been found in the desert. It is a highly important research subject, but the powerful water jets it spews are destroying the desert ecosystem. It is a bitter decision, hunters, but lend us your strength to slay it before the damage spreads further!
23487.descriptionEn:
An Origin Species monster has
been discovered in the Desert.
It is a very important subject
for research, but the powerful
water jets it spews are steadily
destroying the Desert ecosystem.
This is a painful decision, but
hunters! To keep the damage
from spreading any further, lend
us your strength and slay it!

63345.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63345.description: A Plesioth has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the light bowgun, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63345.descriptionEn:
A very powerful ≪Plesioth≫
that acts in ways normally
unthinkable has been loosed
in the New Great Arena.
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show me your
skill before me! If you hunt
it well, you will gain far
more than daily effort alone
would bring you.

54865.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
54865.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54865.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

22098.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22098.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

50914.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
50914.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, we found an amazing monster in the volcano! Its name is the Crushing Wyvern, Brachydios! What sort of amazing creature it is, you can look forward to finding out in person!
50914.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent species
about, we pushed our surveys
across the land and found an
amazing monster in the Volcano!
Its name: Brachydios, the
Crushing Wyvern!
How amazing it is, you'll have to
see for yourself in person!

62338.description: Guku have increased, so I am thinking of inviting lots of them for a grand party. And I want to dress them to match. That one always having fun in the jungle might know something?
62338.descriptionEn:
Now that the Gook have grown
in number, I figure why not
invite a whole bunch and
throw a grand party? And I
want to dress them up to
match the occasion! That one
who is always having fun in
the Jungle might know
something, don't you think?

21636.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Rust Color Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21636.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the sphere
called the Rust-Colored
Sphere? Its material is
essential for crafting a
certain expensive decoration.
Clear this request and I
will give you a precious
decoration material.

55661.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Blood Devouring Wyvern in the new arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain rewards far beyond the fruits of your daily efforts.
55661.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
lance, show the skill you
have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New
Great Arena!
Hunt it well, and you will
gain rewards far beyond
what your daily effort
would bring you.

62813.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62813.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

60501.description: The season is the breeding season! The stage is the Desert at midday! Gather eggs and deliver them, and if you obtain gold or silver eggs as a reward, they can be sold for a high price! Hunters aiming to make a fortune at one stroke, do join us!
60501.descriptionEn:
The season is the breeding
season! The stage is the Desert
at high noon!
Gather eggs and deliver them;
if you get Gold or Silver Eggs
as rewards, they sell high!
Hunters after quick money, join!

21675.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
21675.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over six at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21675.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
If you want a ≪Pawprint Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand over six of them at once.
Bring exactly 3 ≪Quest
Completion Certificates≫ and
come alone, got it? Well then,
I'll be waiting in the Canyon.

61182.description: Gravios and a Bulldrome Variant were apparently sighted at the same time in the swamp. At times like this? Yes, blunt weapons! No other weapons allowed! Bash them with a good wallop!
61182.descriptionEn:
A Gravios and a Bulldrome
variant were seen together
in the Swamp, they say.
What does that mean? Right,
blunt weapons! No other
weapons allowed! Bash them
and bash them good!

1018.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21139.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
21139.description: A request to hunt the giant Lunastra that has taken up residence at the very top of the Old Tower in the frontier. The tower is now extremely dangerous, but for one person alone it seems you can be carried to the summit by balloon. An extremely dangerous request, but we await a brave soul to take it on!
21139.descriptionEn:
A request to slay the giant Lunastra
that has settled at the very top
of the remote Ancient Tower.
The Ancient Tower is currently
very dangerous, but if you go alone
we should be able to send you to
the top by balloon. It is an extremely
dangerous request, but we await
a brave soul willing to try!

54465.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
54465.description: There are reports that a Gypceros Subspecies has appeared in the area under survey. Many hunters are responding, but they are meeting fierce resistance and the situation is very dangerous. Other monsters are said to be gathering as well. Head to the site at once.
54465.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gypceros Subspecies≫ has
been reported in the area
under survey. Many hunters
are already responding, but
it is putting up fierce
resistance and the situation
is very dangerous. Other
monsters are said to be
gathering there as well.
Head out at once!

40229.description: This is a trial quest for the armor 'Rose Dance Dress ZP' series and the weapon 'Primordial Fire O', both obtainable from the Fate/EXTELLA Collaboration Lottery. Clearing it also earns you the Felyne Comrade gear 'Rose Dance Dress Felyne Series' and the status background image 'Fate/EXTELLA'.
40229.descriptionEn:
≪Fate/EXTELLA Collab Lottery≫
This is a trial quest for
the armor "Rose Dance Garb
ZP" series and the weapon
"Primordial Flame O". Clear
rewards also grant Palico
gear, the "Rose Dance Garb
Neko Series", and the
status background image
"Fate/EXTELLA" as well.

54737.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の狩猟
54737.description: Word has come that that terrifying dragon has appeared in the Snowy Mountains! It is extremely ferocious, on another level from the monsters around there. And this time, someone reports seeing two of them. A moment's carelessness can be fatal, so never overdo it!
54737.descriptionEn:
Word has come that that
dreadful dragon has appeared
in the ≪Snowy Mountains≫!
It is savage beyond measure,
a rank apart from ordinary
monsters. And this time,
someone saw two of them.
A moment's carelessness is
fatal — do not push your luck!

54963.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54963.description: Hunters who rose to G Rank and took up G Rank armor. Are you short of materials for upgrades? Clearing this quest may yield Radiant Pile Stone, Brilliant Pile Stone, and Extreme Conquest Certificate. Please give it a try!
54963.descriptionEn:
Hunters who rose to G Rank
and took up G Rank armor.
Are you short of materials
for upgrades? Clearing this
quest may yield ≪Radiant
Pile Stone≫, ≪Brilliant Pile
Stone≫, and ≪Extreme
Conquest Certificate≫.
Please give it a try!

53162.description: Good morning everyone! I am good at waking early! Question 2: The name of the Felyne who raised the songstress is 'Tosshie the Hard Worker'. If you think the answer is true (A), take this quest!
53162.descriptionEn:
Good morning, everyone!
I am great at waking early!
[Question 2]
The name of the cat who
raised the songstress is:
"Tosshie the Hard Worker".
True or false?
If you think the answer is
○ (A), accept this quest
right here!

55562.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55562.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against Tigrex in the desert! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain rewards far beyond the fruits of your daily efforts.
55562.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
lance, show the skill you
have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
Hunt it well, and you will
gain rewards far beyond
what your daily effort would
bring you.

16.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
16.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

54141.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Radiant Orb, as your reward.
54141.descriptionEn:
Inside monsters, you can
sometimes find things like
spheres. They can be used as
materials for all sorts of
weapons and armor, and demand
has risen lately. Clear this
request and I will give you
one such sphere, ≪Flower
Gem≫, as a reward.

62469.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
62469.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62469.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

63092.description: I want to carry out research on the Barbarian Wyvern. Capture it, and break some of its parts so that it is easier to study. I have no interest in materials, so if anything interesting turns up, you may take it once the research is done. Capturing it without breaking any parts will count as a failure.
63092.descriptionEn:
I want to study the Taikun Zamuza.
Please capture one, and break
some parts so it is easier to
study. I am not interested in
the materials, so if you find
anything fascinating, you may
keep it after the research.
If you capture it without any
part breaks, it counts as a failure.

21491.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

62529.description: An extremely powerful individual Gogomoa has appeared. Also, insect activity in Shiojima increases in the evening. The hunt will surely be harsh. Be careful.
62529.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Gogomoa
individual has appeared.
In addition, we have reports that
insects grow very active on the
Tidal Island in the evening.
There is no doubt this will be
a harsh hunt.
Please be careful out there.

23632.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23632.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23632.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.

15011.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
15011.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! This time you will hunt the desert monsters, beginning with the Diablos at its most violent!
15011.descriptionEn:
The official hunting exam
this time has four parts!
To confirm your skill once
more, you will hunt every
monster we designate!
This time, hunt Desert
monsters, starting with the
violently savage Diablos!

64554.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
64554.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.

61418.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
61418.description: A vicious Shogun Ceanataur is lying in wait at the delivery address for my goods and I am in trouble. At this rate the goods will never arrive. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
61418.descriptionEn:
A ferocious Shogun Ceanataur
is lying in wait at my delivery
address, and I'm stuck.
At this rate the goods won't
arrive. If you help me out,
I'll thank you with a Quest
Completion Certificate you can
trade for Pawprint Coins!

55251.description: The survey team that went to Prismatic Falls reports sighting the Water-Rending Wyvern. The parts called hanging blades that grow on both of its wings are sharp as swords and will cut through anything, it seems. Head there and investigate.
55251.descriptionEn:
The survey team at the Painted
Waterfall has sighted a
Mi Ru.
The 'hanging blades' on its
wings are sharp as swords and
can cut through anything.
Head to the site and conduct
a survey.

62617.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62617.description: 2 powerful Iodrome variants have appeared in the arena. They seem to be special individuals called Frenzy individuals. In any case, the arena cannot be used like this, so would you, a master hunter, go and get rid of them? The reward will be ample, so please.
62617.descriptionEn:
Two powerful Gendrome
variants have appeared in
the Arena. They seem to be
special individuals called
Fierce Individuals. Anyway,
the Arena is unusable like
this, so would you, a top
hunter, go finish them?
The pay will be generous.

26391.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス変種の狩猟

23390.objectiveJp: ホワイトワーム５０個の納品
23390.description: Oh, you've come. Even at G Rank, are you still catching bugs? My request is bug collecting! I want you to gather the bugs I'm about to name. I'm looking forward to it!
23390.descriptionEn:
Oh, welcome, welcome.
Still catching bugs now that you
are G Rank, are you?
My request is simple: gather
bugs for me!
I want you to collect the bugs
I am about to tell you about.
I am looking forward to it!

62551.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62551.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

51127.description: I am the one elucidating the ecology of the UNKNOWN, about which much remains a mystery. The road is endless and steep, but that is part of the appeal. Now then, this time I will lend you certain gear, and I want you to slay it with that. If you need help, try clearing the sub-target.
51127.descriptionEn:
I am the one unraveling the
ecology of the UNKNOWN,
which is still full of
mystery. The road is endless
and steep, but that is part
of the appeal. This time I
will lend you certain gear,
so slay it with that.
If you need help, try
clearing the sub-target.

26532.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26532.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26532.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

21224.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21224.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21224.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

62382.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62382.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62382.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!

23628.objectiveJp: 出現モンスターの討伐

26645.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

55578.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55578.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

58036.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58036.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58036.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50775.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50775.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of an Azure Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
50775.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Azure Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

26025.description: I saw Tigrex in the snowy mountains, land of bitter cold! Showing itself even in the snowy mountains, it seems that for that one, as long as there is prey, it does not care what kind of place it is.
26025.descriptionEn:
I saw the "Tigrex" in the freezing
Snowy Mountains!
Showing up as far as the snowy
peaks... As long as there's prey,
it doesn't seem to care what kind
of place it's in.

62016.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62016.description: I heard a rumor that rare materials can be found in the volcano, so I went to see for myself, and no, not a chance, you must be joking! What happened? There was a Rajang, and it was plainly no ordinary Rajang. What do you mean, what was wrong with it? If you are that curious, go and see for yourself!
62016.descriptionEn:
I heard a rumor that rare
materials can be mined in the
Volcano, so I went, but no way,
not a joke!
What happened, you ask? There's
a ≪Rajang≫ there, and it sure
didn't look like any plain Golden
Lion. What do you mean, what?
If you're that curious, go see!

62177.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
62177.description: A very ferocious Tigrex has appeared in the canyon nearby, has it not? I cannot hunt it myself, so I decided to ask the hunters of this land. If you come by a certain bone when this request is done, I would like you to whittle it down and use it as a great sword.
62177.descriptionEn:
A very fierce ≪Tigrex≫ has
shown up in the Canyon near
here, right? I cannot slay
it myself, so I decided to
ask the hunters of this land.
If you come by a certain bone
when this request is done, I
hope you will shave it down
and use it as a Great Sword.

26302.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26302.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26302.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

11051.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
11051.description: Blangonga rules the Snowy Mountains! It shows no mercy to those who trespass on its territory! Ah, and this season a rare species of Velociprey seems to come to raise its eggs. You'd best not touch the Carnivore Eggs!
11051.descriptionEn:
≪Blangonga≫ is the lord of
the Snowy Mountains! It has
no mercy for trespassers!
Oh, and rare Velociprey
seem to come raise eggs
this season. Better not
touch their ≪Carnivore Eggs≫!

50165.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★６ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50165.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★6 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.

62357.description: Lately Great Thunderbugs have been swarming in the sea of trees. At this rate the Mezepor Expedition cannot push into the interior. What? You want to help the expedition? Then hurry and hunt the bugs! As a reward I will give the production materials for an exceptionally cool bow!
62357.descriptionEn:
Lately, Great Thunderbugs have
been swarming all through the
Great Forest. At this rate the
Mezepolta Expedition can't push
deep inside. What? You want to
help them? Then hurry and
hunt those bugs! I'll reward
you with bow materials!

23435.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Merit (Beginning) x５０, Sword and Shield Merit (Middle) x６０, Sword and Shield Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23435.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Sword and Shield Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Sword and Shield Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Sword and Shield Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must
be GR500 or above, so please
be aware of that.

11063.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61225.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
61225.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61225.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

50220.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
50220.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!

51067.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
51067.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
51067.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Kushala Daora's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

21867.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の撃退
21867.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Diore FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21867.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for all five parts
of the ≪Zenith Armor≫ Diore
FX Series. Accepting it
requires a ≪Superior
Ticket≫. Note that the
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed if the quest
fails.

61158.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の討伐
61158.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. No Festival Certificate is required for this one. Simply completing the quest pays out a variety of rewards.
61158.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards for those
belonging to a winning guild
of the Hunter Festival.
No Festival Proof is required
here. Simply clearing the quest
will pay out a variety of
rewards.

55503.description: Hello everyone! Today's dressing session will be in a kimono with vivid purple! Or so I thought, but the roaring is too loud to concentrate. Whoever punishes it will receive the kimono used today. Break its parts to punish it further and I will give even more.
55503.descriptionEn:
Hello, everyone! Today's
dressing will be done in a
kimono with vivid purple!
...Or so I thought, but the
roaring is too loud to
concentrate. Whoever punishes
that beast gets the kimono
used today. Break its parts
to punish it further and I
will pay even more.

50671.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50671.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Odiba F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50671.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one part of
the ≪Storm Armor≫ Odiba F
Series. To accept this
quest, a ≪Superior Ticket≫
is required.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed, so be careful.

61340.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61340.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

61555.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61555.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62052.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

60068.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. Also, if a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back. You might even pick up their pouch instead.
60068.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder
Dragon species, and because it
wields thunder freely it is
called the ≪Phantom Beast≫.
Also, if a ≪Melynx≫ steals
your item, don't panic. Take it
back; you might get a pouch too.

55037.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
55037.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55037.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

28075.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Break the designated parts of a monster and slay it together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28075.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between you all,
I have prepared a difficult request
for you. You are to break the
specified parts of a monster and slay it
together with your Guild companions.
No supply items will be provided at all,
so discuss it with your companions
beforehand and then depart.
Your reward shall be a special ore!

62246.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62246.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62246.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55556.description: A Doragyurosu with greatly developed horns has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Doragyurosu known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55556.descriptionEn:
A ≪Dark Thunder Wyvern≫ with
greatly developed horns
has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
one as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
developed parts and surveys it.
There are also reports that it
is more dangerous than past
ones. Please survey with care.

54355.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
54355.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54355.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

63030.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Lunastra. If you succeed in repelling it, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63030.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request. We are
seeking someone to eliminate an
extremely powerful ≪Lunastra≫.
If you succeed in repelling it, we
will issue more slaying certificates
than usual!
We await your bold application.

53317.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の撃退
53317.description: Shall we settle which of us is the bigger eater? I will not move from the plaza, so I lend you a weapon modeled on me. I entrust this big title match for the big eater position to you, hunter!
53317.descriptionEn:
Shall we not settle, once
and for all, who the bigger
eater is? I cannot leave
the square, so I will lend
you a weapon modeled on me.
I entrust this big title
match over the big-eater
spot to you, hunter!

62179.description: Look at this hammer! With improvement upon improvement, it is shaping up to be a real monster. But it is one step short of something. That something is soul, and fighting spirit! I will lend you the finest equipment, so go and land a blow on something big!
62179.descriptionEn:
Look at this Hammer! After
improvement upon improvement,
it is shaping up into quite
a monster. But it is still
one step short. That step is
soul, and fighting spirit!
I will lend you the finest
equipment, so land one big
hit on something huge!

53218.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! I do not quite understand, but a ghost seems to appear! How summery! How scary! Now, hunters! To protect the summer memories of lovers, drive the ghost away!
53218.descriptionEn:
Guard the love and peace
of lovers! Here's Sasaht!
Can't say why, but ghosts
are said to appear here!
So summery! So scary!

Now, hunters, all of you!
To keep the summer memories
of lovers, drive the ghosts
away!

21354.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Desert, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Meteor, the Voice of Nature: Quicksand, or the Voice of Nature: Dunes. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21354.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Desert≫, you may obtain
≪Nature's Voice: Meteor≫,
≪Nature's Voice: Quicksand≫,
or ≪Nature's Voice: Dunes≫.
I pray that your hunting life
grows ever richer and more
fulfilling.

26604.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Titan Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26604.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secrets
of weapon and armor crafting have
apparently been found on monsters
slain all over the place!
If you get your hands on a
≪Titan Memo≫, be a man and
bring it to this workshop head!
I will show you some good work!

23170.description: The Snowy Mountains are a cold and harsh place, but they are also a place overflowing with nature's bounty. Popo meat in particular is highly nutritious. Would you hunt Popo for me to gather food? Yes. If possible, Ice Crystals as well. They are good ingredients for mixing.
23170.descriptionEn:
Cold and harsh the Snowy
Mountains are, yet they brim
with nature's blessings.
Popo meat is rich in food
value. Could you go hunt
some Popo to gather our
provisions? Aye, and if
you can, bring Ice Crystals
too. Fine blending stock.

50368.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
50368.description: Comrades! Special training! This time the hunt is that Doragyurosu! It is a particularly tough one even among flying wyverns, but for you who have spent your days in training, it should be no trouble! I pray for your valour!
50368.descriptionEn:
Listen up! Special training!
Today you hunt Dark Thunder
Wyvern! Even among flying
wyverns it's a tough one,
but you have drilled so hard
it should be no trouble. Go!

54316.description: We ask you to investigate the fighting beast lurking in the Canyon. Not only hunt it: if you skillfully break the fighting beast's parts, I will add to your reward!
54316.descriptionEn:
We ask you to survey the Gougarf
lurking in the Canyon.
Not only hunt it, but if you
break its parts in fine style,
we will add a bonus on top of
your reward!

40220.objectiveJp: フレイムタイラント１体の討伐

62615.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
62615.description: Happy New Year! This year too we have properly prepared New Year gifts! But before that, how about a little game? Drop something big and round, and if you splendidly gather a Royal Beetle, that is the grand prize! A gift from the heavens, the Otoshidama!
62615.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year to you all!
Once again this year we have
your New Year's gift ready!
But first, how about a little
game to warm things up?
Drop something big and round,
and if you gather a Royal
Beetle, that's a big win!
A gift from the heavens!

23501.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23501.description: A Yian Kut-Ku and a Yaozami appeared during the survey of the Jungle! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. Hunters who complete the request will receive the crafting materials for the weapon series Subdue the King of Magnetism.
23501.descriptionEn:
Yian Kut-Ku and Yaozami appeared
while we were surveying the
Jungle! The survey cannot be
completed like this. To hunters
who complete this request, we
will hand over the materials to
craft the "Subdue the Magnetic
King" weapon series.

62881.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62881.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62881.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

21928.description: The White Lake in the breeding season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
21928.descriptionEn:
The ≪White Lake≫ in breeding
season. It is an unexplored land
the Guild is still surveying, but
why not go have a look yourself
for gathering and survey work?
If you feel like coming home,
just deliver a map to finish
up!

62848.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? There is a strong theory that 2 books, recording a processing method we cannot fathom, sleep in the Desert. If only one could obtain them, the hidden power of a certain weapon could be drawn out.
62848.descriptionEn:
How much did the ancients of
old truly know, I wonder.
Two tomes that record forging
methods we cannot fathom are
said to sleep in the Desert.
If we could but obtain them,
we could draw out the hidden
power of certain weapons.

50763.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期３頭の狩猟

62302.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐

23450.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Dual Blades Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Dual Blades Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23450.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Dual Blades Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Dual Blades Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Dual Blades Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept it you need a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.

26193.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
26193.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26193.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

62516.description: My Gooc is in a bad mood. It says it wants to become a hunter! But that is impossible, no? Such a little one going to a hunting ground would be a disaster. I would like it to taste at least the atmosphere of being a hunter. A little one like that might understand the feeling?
62516.descriptionEn:
My Gook is in a foul mood.
Says he wants to be a hunter!
But come on, that's absurd?
A tiny thing like him out
on a hunting ground? No way.
I just want to let him taste
a hunter's life a little.
Maybe a small one like him
would understand the feeling?

55653.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (waist), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
55653.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the materials
needed to upgrade G Rank Secret
Art Armor (waist piece),
excluding weapon ribbons and
weapon merits.
The yield is one type's worth.
To accept this quest, you will
need a ≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫,
so please be aware
of that.

1038.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
1038.description: The Ioprey are loudly active, which means there is a high chance the leader, Iodrome, is around! Take that poison liquid head on and you could lose even your life! Do not forget antidote items!!
1038.descriptionEn:
If the Genprey are stirring
and making a fuss, chances
are their leader, a Gendrome,
is near! Take that venom
head-on and it could cost
you your life! Do not forget
your antidotes, you hear!!

53118.description: To all of you aiming for HR 100, we have prepared a quest to forge the Rukeze Series. By hunting a Rathalos you can obtain the crafting materials for one piece and materials to level it up. Please make good use of this quest!
53118.descriptionEn:
To all of you aiming for
HR 100, we have prepared a
quest to forge the Rukese
Series. By hunting a
Rathalos you can obtain
the crafting materials for
one piece and materials to
level it up. Please make
good use of this quest!

53238.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
53238.description: I have prepared the perfect situation for a confession. At night, if the two of you are drenched by rain, you will be a fine dripping-wet couple. And if those two hunt a monster together, the distance between you will close at once! After that you need only convey your feelings with chocolate. Perfect! I am praying for your success too!
53238.descriptionEn:
I have set up the perfect
scene for a confession.
At night, let the rain soak
you both and you'll look
simply stunning. Then hunt
a monster together and you
will be close in no time!
Just say how you feel with
chocolate. Perfect! Good luck!

55812.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55812.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55812.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

54816.objectiveJp: ホワイトワーム５０個の納品
54816.description: Oh, you've come. Even at G Rank, are you still catching bugs? My request is bug collecting! I want you to gather the bugs I'm about to name. I'm looking forward to it!
54816.descriptionEn:
Oh, welcome, welcome.
Still catching bugs now that you
are G Rank, are you?
My request is simple: gather
bugs for me!
I want you to collect the bugs
I am about to tell you about.
I am looking forward to it!

56102.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐

12035.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１０頭の討伐
12035.description: The swamp is the most suitable environment for Bulldrome to live in. If you are going to hunt the Bulldrome, try slaying as many Bulldrome as you can. Of course, we will pay both supply items and rewards.
12035.descriptionEn:
The Swamp is the environment
best suited for Bullfango to live
in.
If you take on hunting the
≪Bulldrome≫, try slaying as many
Bullfango as you can as well.
Of course, we pay both supplies
and rewards.

56159.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
56159.description: A G Rank hunter must stand against Supremacy and Migrant species and the monsters that grow ever fiercer. So I have ready materials for the G Rank armor Dunru GX Series, plus jewels to keep you safe. It is my own recommendation, so do try accepting it, hm?
56159.descriptionEn:
A G Rank hunter must stand
against Supremacy and Migrant
species and the monsters that
grow ever fiercer. So I have
ready materials for the G Rank
armor Dunru GX Series, plus
jewels to keep you safe.
It is my own recommendation,
so do try accepting it, hm?

56033.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Blast Wolf. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56033.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay a
Supremacy Midogaron.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will specially
add developed part materials to
your Another Reward.
Please note that slaying it alone
will not earn you those materials.

54295.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
54295.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54295.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

23466.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23466.description: To support all the hunters who have just been promoted to G Rank, we have prepared a special quest. Let us learn the basics of hunting G Rank monsters while obtaining new decorations!
23466.descriptionEn:
To support all the hunters who have
just been promoted to G Rank, we
have prepared a special quest.
Let us learn the basics of hunting
G Rank monsters while obtaining
new decorations!

61546.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61546.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

50832.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の狩猟
50832.client: A King with Time to Spare
50832.description: I heard a report that the dreadful Deviljho has appeared. The already dreadful Deviljho is apparently not alone. Such a thing has never appeared even in dreams. I simply must see this. Hunter, go!
50832.clientEn: A King with Time to Spare
50832.descriptionEn:
I have heard reports that a
truly fearsome Deviljho has
appeared. And not just one,
they say. Such a tale has
never graced even a dream.
I simply must see this.
Hunter, go forth!

26650.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

50098.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50098.description: Will you take on this Rukodiora hunt? It is a little unusual: you must wear the Gunner Magisa FX series on chest, arms, waist and legs. The reward is generous, so give it a try!
50098.descriptionEn:
How about taking this
Disufiroa slaying request?
It is a little unusual:
you must wear the Gunner
Magusia FX Series on your
chest, arms, waist and legs.
The pay is generous, so
give it a try!

54979.description: We ask for your help investigating the Floating Peak Wyvern that lives in the highlands! If you not only hunt it but break its tentacles, I will add to the reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54979.descriptionEn:
We ask your aid in the
survey of the Yamakurai
dwelling in the Highlands!
Slay it, and break its
tentacles too, and we will
add to your reward.
Please lend your strength
to our research!

62221.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62221.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained from carving or from the clear reward.
62221.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained from carving
or from the clear reward.

63367.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! The Rathian and the Khezu, representatives of the flying wyverns. Hunters who are confident they can face both at once and carry out this hunt without faltering, join this quest and display your nerve and skill!!
63367.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
their skill! Two flying
wyvern champions, Rathian
and White Fatalis.
Face both at once; the
hunter confident enough to
do it without faltering,
join and show your nerve!!

50604.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
50604.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50604.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

26685.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
26685.description: A team member surveying the caves of Tide Island reports that a rumbling can sometimes be heard from deep inside. Some of the team have also seen large rocks move, and unease is spreading. A monster unknown to us may be living there, so we ask for an investigation.
26685.descriptionEn:
From members surveying the caves of
the Tidal Island came a report that
rumbling can sometimes be heard
from deep within the caves.
Also, some members have seen
large rocks moving, and unease
is spreading among them.
An unknown monster may live there,
so please investigate.

56127.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Zerureusu that Shines to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin, needed to accept the next request!
56127.descriptionEn:
Sightings keep pouring in
of monsters bearing the name
"Acme", a great threat.
Deeming this an emergency,
I ask for swift slaying of
each. This time, Zerureusu
the Shining Acme. As proof
of the kill, take this coin;
you will need it next time!

54807.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54807.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

55469.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55469.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55469.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rukodiora≫ has
