that appeared at White Lake.
If possible, beyond hunting,
breaking the dorsal fin and
cutting the tail would help.
Hunters all, we thank you
for your help!

23525.description: To you who upgraded the Entra G series to LV7! I have prepared a quest that gets one piece's worth of upgrade materials for the Entra GF series armor all at once! Clear the quest five times and upgrade every part!
23525.descriptionEn:
To everyone who upgraded the
Entora G Series to LV7!
We have prepared a quest where
you can get upgrade materials
for 1 part of the "Entora GF
Series" armor all at once! Clear
it 5 times and upgrade every part!

62833.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
62833.description: Honestly! I really hate Gravios! Hunter, you understand, right? Teach that Gravios a lesson! Make me feel better and I will pay more! I am counting on you, hunter!
62833.descriptionEn:
Ugh! Really!
I hate Gravios so much!
Hunter, you understand, right?
We are going to punish that Gravios!
If you can make me feel better
about all this,
I will pay out a bigger reward!
I am counting on you, hunter!

1077.description: A blue subspecies of Rathalos has been confirmed in the Forest and Hills! Whoever overcomes its peerless vitality will hold power beyond that of a dragon. Young hunter, let us see whether such power lies hidden in you.
1077.descriptionEn:
An Azure ≪Rathalos≫ has
been sighted in the
≪Forest and Hills≫, aye!
Whoever overcomes that
unmatched vitality shall
hold power beyond a dragon.
Young hunter, prove yourself.

61914.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ４匹の捕獲

21756.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21756.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Yian Kut-Ku will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
21756.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Great Hall
Guild, we recommend trying a new
sub-target. The "set damage"
dealt to the ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ will
be judged by our Guild, so you
need only focus on clearing the
main target!

50840.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
50840.description: We present a request that lets you obtain in one go the rare materials of Aberrant individuals needed to upgrade the Floating Peak Wyvern's Supremacy armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50840.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit, but
may I present a request that
gives you bundles of the rare
special individual materials
needed to upgrade Yamakurai
Zenith armor.
Seize this chance and give it
a try!

61419.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
61419.description: 1 step short of the Canyon, a Yian Garuga is in the way and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
61419.descriptionEn:
I'm just one step from the
Canyon, but a Yian Garuga is
in my way and I'm stuck.
If you help me out,
I'll give you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ you can trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫ as thanks!

62348.objectiveJp: ハンターカード赤１０枚納品
62348.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62348.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

50373.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50373.description: A very dangerous individual Espinas has been found in the sea of trees. Behavior different from ordinary individuals has also been confirmed. Please proceed to the hunt with the utmost care.
50373.descriptionEn:
A highly dangerous Espinas
individual was found in the
Great Forest. Behavior unlike
the normal kind has also been
confirmed. Please proceed to
the hunt with utmost care.

54558.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
54558.description: We ask you to survey the Pink Rathian that appeared in the desert. If possible, we would appreciate not only the hunt but also the breaking of its wing claws and the severing of its tail. Hunters, we thank you in advance!
54558.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Pink
Rathian seen in the Desert.
If possible, beyond hunting,
breaking the wing talons and
cutting the tail would help.
Hunters all, we thank you
for your help!

62208.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62208.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.

26660.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26660.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

63183.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63183.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63183.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

19.description: Master! Are you doing your best? In a dream your stamina does not drop, so you can practice as your instincts lead. You have 15 minutes. When you tire of it, head for the Camp Mark. I will wake you right away.
19.descriptionEn:
Master~
Are you doing your best, meow?
Since it is a dream, your stamina
will not drop, so you can practice
all you want, meow~
You have 15 minutes, meow~
When you get bored, head for the
≪Camp Mark≫, meow~
I will wake you right up, meow~

21069.description: The breeding season is a precious season when monster eggs can be obtained. This time, please deliver a Carnivore Egg, which is relatively easy to carry. While carrying it, watch not only for monster attacks but also for your stamina draining!
21069.descriptionEn:
Breeding season is a precious
time when monster eggs can be
obtained. This time, please
deliver a ≪Carnivore Egg≫, which
is relatively easy to carry.
While carrying it, watch out for
monster attacks, of course, and
for your stamina draining too!

21019.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
21019.description: A Plesioth subspecies turns up in the desert now and then this season! I hear its hide is as beautiful as jade! Still, hunting a Plesioth is not easy at all. Never let your guard down!
21019.descriptionEn:
Green Plesioth sometimes shows up
in the Desert this season!
I hear it has a beautiful body
color like jade, of all things!
That said, hunting a Plesioth is
no easy task. Never let your
guard down!

21745.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern seems to have invaded Mezeporuta's territory! It is thought merely to be passing overhead, but if it attacks we have not a moment's chance! Please slay it!
21745.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Post!
A ≪Yama Tsukami≫ seems to
have invaded Mezepolta!
It may only pass overhead,
but if it attacks, we're done
for! Please slay it!

55842.description: The Variant Species Bogabadorumu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55842.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Bogabadorumu
seems to have reached strength
fit to stand at the summit.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their arm
at challenging the summit,
please take on the survey.

54966.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
54966.description: We continue the investigation of Guanzorumu. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54966.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
Guanzorumu.
Breaking parts is not
required, but if you do,
we would be delighted!
Hunters all, please lend
us your aid!

11047.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
11047.description: If you are going to hunt in the Snowy Mountains, please do not forget to bring a Hot Drink! It might be surer to hunt Popo and get used to the mountain environment to some degree, and then hunt a Bulldrome!
11047.descriptionEn:
When you head out to hunt in
the Snowy Mountains, don't
forget to bring ≪Hot Drinks≫!
Slaying ≪Popo≫ to get used to
the Snowy Mountains a bit
first, then hunting ≪Bulldrome≫
might be the safer bet!

62935.objectiveJp:
報酬金ゼロ／タイムアップ
タイクンザムザの捕獲
62935.description: Hey, listen to me for a moment. A lance's blade wears down with every attack, right? So I wondered whether the tip could be made of some substance other than metal. There's apparently a clue to that material on Tide Island. Would you go and look for it?
62935.objectiveEn:
Reward Money Zero / Time Up
Capture Taikun Zamuza
62935.descriptionEn:
Hey, listen to me for a moment.
With a Lance, the tip wears down
every time you attack, right?
So I got to thinking: could we
not build the tip from some
material other than metal?
There is apparently a lead on
that material in the Tidal Island.
Would you go and look
for it for me?

50432.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26334.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26334.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26334.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54664.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54664.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

63114.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63114.description: A truly excellent hunter must be versed in many things besides outstanding hunting skill. This time the guild has prepared the Difficult Book Red for hunters of ability. Keep striving for still greater heights.
63114.descriptionEn:
A truly excellent hunter
must, besides superb skill,
be well versed in many
different things.
So the Guild has prepared
for capable hunters a
difficult Tome [Red].
Keep striving for the heights
of the hunter's path!

20004.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
20004.description: Lao-Shan Lung seems to have invaded the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma! Use the fortress interception equipment to the fullest and repel Lao-Shan Lung! Those whose strength is insufficient should ride Lao-Shan Lung's back, obtain Dragon Drug Stones and put them in the delivery box!
20004.descriptionEn:
The Old Mountain Dragon Lao-
Shan Lung seems to be invading
the ≪Fortress≫, the gateway to
Dondruma! Make full use of the
fortress's intercept devices and
repel Lao-Shan Lung! Those
lacking strength should ride on
its back, obtain ≪Dragonite Ore≫
and put it in the delivery box!

58096.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58096.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58096.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50782.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50782.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wings of a Yian Garuga will also grant a special ingredient.
50782.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
running, we have prepared this
quest to further raise awareness
and promote them.
By breaking the Yian Garuga's
wings, we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

50011.description: Are you eating properly? Without good food you cannot summon strength when it counts! Right, would you take a job from me? For the reward I will prepare ingredients that never sit on shop shelves. Use them to cook something delicious!
50011.descriptionEn:
Are you eating properly?
If you do not eat good food,
you will have no strength when
it counts!
That's right, why not take on
one of my requests?
For the reward, I will prepare
ingredients not normally sold.
Use them and cook something tasty!

53105.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
53105.description: This is one of the Anniversary 2015 Premium Goods early purchase campaign quests, 'Get a New Decoration!', which consumes an Anniversary Quest Ticket. Clear the main target to obtain one Hardguard Jewel.
53105.descriptionEn:
Anniversary 2015
Premium Goods
early purchase campaign,
part one. This quest uses
an Anniversary Quest Ticket
to get you a new jewel!
Clear the main target
and you can obtain one
Protection Jewel.

21716.description: The other day I made a great discovery! Combine a certain ore with several of the frost that settles upon it, and one can produce that rarest of things, a Frozen Crystal. Help me gather these materials and I will share the product with you.
21716.descriptionEn:
The other day I made a great
discovery! If you combine a
certain ore with several of the
frost that settles on it, you can
create the rarest "Freezing
Crystal" in the world.
If you help me gather these
materials, I will share the
results with you!

62812.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62812.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62812.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

63099.description: I got so absorbed in 'muttering' that before I knew it my feet had carried me to a nostalgic place. When I strained my ears to the sounds around me, I felt I heard something, but I couldn't tell what it was. There must be some secret here. I want you to find out what it is.
63099.descriptionEn:
I got so absorbed in
the whispers that before
I knew it, my feet had
carried me somewhere dear.
When I strained my ears,
I felt I heard something,
but could not tell what.
There must be a secret here.
I want you to find out what.

61858.description: Hunting in an untrodden land, that is surely the true thrill of the hunter. You understand? So, a hunting request in the Highlands. The purpose is an ecological survey, so finish it quickly while no big game is about.
61858.descriptionEn:
Hunting in untrodden lands, that is
the true thrill of being a hunter.
You know what I mean?
So, here is a hunting request for
the ≪Highlands≫. The goal is an
ecology survey, so finish it quickly
while nothing big is around.

55553.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55553.description: The Variant Species Toridokuresu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55553.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Toridokuresu≫
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as it is.
Please prepare thoroughly before
you set out on the survey.

62794.description: Ladies and gentlemen, how about a little fishing for a change? Calming the mind, gazing at the water, and simply giving yourself to the moment is a fine thing. Some rather lively guests appear to have arrived as well, but do enjoy the banquet with gentlemanly courtesy.
62794.descriptionEn:
Ladies and gentlemen, how
about a little fishing?
To calm the heart and watch
the water, letting time just
pass you by, is a fine thing.
Some rather lively guests
seem to have arrived too,
but do enjoy the banquet
with the utmost courtesy.

28063.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
28063.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28063.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

60924.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60924.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

54393.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54393.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of the Dancing Thunder Wyvern, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54393.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest to raise awareness
and promote them further.
Break the Berukyurosu's
head and we will grant you a
special ingredient as well.

54752.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54752.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
54752.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

55971.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55971.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

50474.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50474.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest in which the materials to craft the Soundless Jewel G, Body Art Jewel G, Impatience Jewel G, and Dedication Jewel G are guaranteed to appear. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50474.descriptionEn:
For members of a winning
Hunter Festival guild only,
we have prepared a quest
where the crafting materials
for Silent Jewel G, Body
Jewel G, Impatience Jewel G
and Devotion Jewel G are sure
to drop. Bring Festival Proof!

55379.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
55379.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to craft Gore Magala armor! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade Transcendent armor, so please take it on!
55379.descriptionEn:
For hunters who want armor
made from the Gore Magala,
we have a special quest!
Clear the sub-target and you
can get materials needed to
upgrade Migrant armor, so
please give it a try!

26061.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
26061.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26061.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

62697.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. Only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it, so please note.
62697.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Only hunters equipped with
the special anti-Variant
arms may accept or join, so
please take care.

55241.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55241.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.

55758.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55758.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55758.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

21622.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21622.description: Do you know of the sphere called the Eggshell Sphere? Its material is essential to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request and I shall give you rare decoration material.
21622.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called
the Egg-Colored Orb?
Its material is essential to
crafting a certain expensive
jewel.
If you can clear this request,
I shall give you that precious
jewel material.

50575.description: You there! I hear you produced a Gogomoa weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
50575.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you crafted a weapon
from the Leaping Crimson
Beast. So I've got a favor
to ask. How about upgrade
materials as pay? It's an
easy job. Just run over
and slay a Gogomoa.
I'm counting on you!

23533.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Harudomerugu, the Silver Ruler Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23533.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Shrouded Silver
Dragon ≪Dahren Mohran≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.

50924.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
50924.description: We present a request that lets you efficiently obtain the Supremacy materials needed to upgrade the Black Piercing Wyvern into Supremacy weapons. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
50924.descriptionEn:
May I present a request that
efficiently yields the
Zenith materials needed
to upgrade Meraginasu gear
into a Zenith weapon.
It's a bargain quest, so
please give it a try!

62227.objectiveJp: 刻印された石・緑２個の納品
62227.description: You have a strange stone there. Would you not let me have it? In exchange I will give you something good.
62227.descriptionEn:
You've got a strange stone
there, don't you? Won't you
let me have it? I'll give
you something good in return.

54545.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54545.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Farnock, the Slanting Thunder Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54545.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Thunderbird ≪Farunokku≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.

26178.description: Small jobs rarely find anyone willing to take them. But odd jobs are honest work too. For hunters who have just risen to high rank, this quest, which combines groundwork with mining, is recommended. Fail to prepare a pickaxe, though, and retirement is certain.
26178.descriptionEn:
Odd jobs never seem to find
any takers….
But even chores are honest work.
For hunters who have just reached
High Rank, I recommend this quest:
it covers both groundwork and
mining.
Just don't neglect your pickaxe,
or you are certain to retire.

61542.description: Several Rajang attacked merchants in the Canyon. The damage was only to cargo, but this could become a future threat. Your task is to hunt them. I think this is a fitting request for hunters of skill like you, what say you?
61542.descriptionEn:
Several ≪Rajang≫ attacked
the merchants in the
Canyon.
Only the cargo was hit,
but this could become a
future threat.
This request is to hunt
them. It suits hunters of
your skill, I'd say.

26186.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26186.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

50733.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of a Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
50733.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

61051.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! When the lion clad in jet-black fur shines gold, its power, a match for the Elder Dragons, reaches the height of tyranny! Hunter who has mastered the hunt! Prove your strength against the Rajang loosed into the arena!
61051.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters
show their skill! When the
black-furred lion gleams
gold, its power rivals the
Elder Dragons! Masters of
the hunt, prove your worth
against the Arena Rajang!

55778.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55778.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them. Break the Kushala Daora's head and we will grant you a special ingredient as well.
55778.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and promote them.
Break the Kushala Daora's
head and we will grant you a
special ingredient as well.

62186.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62186.description: There are reports of a Lavasioth in the volcano far stronger than usual. We want to study its ecology, so bring back anything that might serve as a sample when you slay it. Should a rare material turn up, it is yours.
62186.descriptionEn:
There are reports of a
≪Volganos≫ stronger than usual
in the Volcano. I want to
survey its ecology, so while
you slay it, bring back
something we can sample.
If by chance you get a rare
material, it's yours.

55733.description: It is I, the Instructor! A wedding in progress and trouble leaves me no time! An Espinas in the flower field is in the way and the bouquet is late! So I entrust the hunt to you hunters! I wish you good fortune!
55733.descriptionEn:
It is I. Your Instructor!
A wedding-day mishap has
left me with no time!
An Espinas in the Flower
Field is in the way, and the
bouquet is running late!
So I ask you hunters to slay it!
I wish you good hunting!

54636.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54636.description: A trial quest for the G7 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy G7 monsters a step ahead of everyone! Take the challenge with G Rank Hunt Guard! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54636.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
G7 Preview Trial event.
Get an early taste of the
G7 monsters, enjoy!
Challenge it in G Rank
Hunting Guard! Time: 10 min.

50157.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50157.description: The other day I went to survey the Volcano and found strange scorch marks. Reason would say an armored wyvern left them, but they spread over a wide area and seem to have burned everything to ash. Take great care on this quest.
50157.descriptionEn:
The other day I went to
survey the Volcano and found
strange scorch marks.
Normally one would blame a
Gravios, but the marks spread
far and wide, as if they had
burned away everything.
Take great care on this quest.

63182.description: 2 Rathalos have come close to the warehouse where my work tools are kept. One will not come down from the sky, but if you hurt the one on the ground it should come down in a rage. If the flames they spit set the warehouse alight it will be a disaster! Drive them off quickly!
63182.descriptionEn:
Near the warehouse where
I keep my work tools,
two Rathalos have come close.
One won't come down from
the sky, but hurt the one on
the ground and it should
come down in a rage.
If their flames reach it, big
trouble! Drive them off, quick!

50703.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50703.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
50703.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
requests we have long been running,
we have prepared this quest in
order to raise awareness and
interest in them.
By breaking the Gravios's chest,
special ingredients will also be
granted to you as a reward.

55201.description: There was a report that white and brown Espinas appeared at the top of the sea of trees. There has never before been a case of these 2 appearing together, and they may bring tremendous damage. Please head out to slay them at once. On success, we will give you a piercing that the Guild has treasured since long ago.
55201.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a white
and a brown Espinas at the
Top of Great Forest. Never
have both appeared at once,
and they could bring vast
damage. Set out to slay
them at once. On success,
you will receive a piercing
long kept by the Guild.

21021.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21021.description: We have a report that a Rathian with a vivid cherry-blossom color has appeared in the desert! A rare subspecies of high scarcity! Any hunter who would take up the hunt, come to our guild counter!
21021.descriptionEn:
A report has come in of a
≪Rathian≫ with vivid cherry
blossom pink coloring in the
Desert! A highly rare and
precious subspecies! Any Hunter
who would take up the hunt,
come to our guild counter!

54442.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Rajang, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54442.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest to raise awareness
and promote them further.
Break the Rajang's head
and we will grant you a
special ingredient as well.

62154.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62154.description: This is a practice qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving the monster or from the quest clear rewards.
62154.descriptionEn:
This is a practice qualifier
quest for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament. You cannot obtain
the target monster's materials
from carving the monster or
from the quest clear rewards.

55309.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
55309.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Toridokuresu, the Shining Thunder Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55309.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Thunderbird ≪Toridokuresu≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.

61528.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61528.description: This is an emergency! Kushala Daora has invaded Dondorma at tremendous speed! There is no longer time to wait for many hunters. Head out alone to slay it! I know it is a lot to ask, but please bring it down!
61528.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency!
The Wind Dragon Kushala
Daora has charged in at
full speed and breached
Dondurma! There is no time
left to wait for a crowd
of hunters. Please head out
and slay it on your own!
I know it is a tall order,
but please bring it down!

54799.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
54799.description: A trial quest for the G9 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy G9 monsters a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54799.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
G9 Preview Trial event.
Get an early taste of the
G9 monsters, enjoy!
Time limit is 10 minutes.

63067.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

61628.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61628.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61628.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.

60631.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time your opponents are the kings of the sky, 2 Rathalos! In a storm of fierce blows, who will raise the cry of victory here, the King of the Sky or the King of the Hunt? Challengers, come forth!
60631.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Today's opponents are two
≪Rathalos≫, the Kings of the Sky!
Amid the exchange of fierce
attacks, who will raise the cry
of victory here: the King of the
Sky, or the King of the Hunt?
Challengers, come forth!

62342.description: Several Rajang attacked merchants in the Canyon. The damage was only to cargo, but this could become a future threat. Your task is to hunt them. I think this is a fitting request for hunters of skill like you, what say you?
62342.descriptionEn:
Several ≪Rajang≫ attacked
the merchants in the
Canyon.
Only the cargo was hit,
but this could become a
future threat.
This request is to hunt
them. It suits hunters of
your skill, I'd say.

11025.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
11025.description: We have a report that a Rathian with a vivid cherry-blossom color has appeared in the desert! A rare subspecies of high scarcity! Any hunter who would take up the hunt, come to our guild counter!
11025.descriptionEn:
A report has come in of a
≪Rathian≫ with vivid cherry
blossom pink coloring in the
Desert! A highly rare and
precious subspecies! Any Hunter
who would take up the hunt,
come to our guild counter!

61248.description: I heard there was such a thing as a Hypnocatrice Rare Species, so I went to the Jungle. And there was something amazing there. That must be the Rare Species. For how it looks it is timid, so if you carry a frightening weapon it may take fright and hide. If you are curious, go and see! Eh, the Rare Species is white?
61248.descriptionEn:
I heard a Hypnocatrice Kishu
was out there, so I went to
the Great Forest. And wow,
something amazing was there.
That must be the Kishu. It's
timid for how it looks, so a
scary weapon might make it
hide. Curious? Go see it!
Eh, is the Kishu white?

61940.description: Do you know, customer, that there is a rare ore in this world called Porta Shining Stone? They say rare arms can be crafted from it. Find me a Porta Shining Stone on my request and I will craft you weapons.
61940.descriptionEn:
Say, friend, ever heard of
the rare ore called
Porta Glowstone? Word is
you can craft rare gear
from that ore. Find me
some Porta Glowstone on
my request and I'll forge
the equipment for you.

21.description: Master! Are you doing your best? In a dream your stamina does not drop, so you can practice as your instincts lead. You have 15 minutes. When you tire of it, head for the Camp Mark. I will wake you right away.
21.descriptionEn:
Master~
Are you doing your best, meow?
Since it is a dream, your stamina
will not drop, so you can practice
all you want, meow~
You have 15 minutes, meow~
When you get bored, head for the
≪Camp Mark≫, meow~
I will wake you right up, meow~

1005.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
1005.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, is a tough and unmanageable brute! Especially in this cold season, it may be on edge from hunger! Catching and delivering a Goldenfish instead of pushing yourself is another option, you know!?
1005.descriptionEn:
Bulldrome, the Bullfango
leader, is one tough and
uncontrollable brute!
In this cold season he's
likely starving and on
edge! Or just fish up
Goldenfish and hand them in.

62929.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62929.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

54706.description: A Thunder Wolf Wyvern, Zinogre, has suddenly appeared! It is a monster never seen in these parts! Moreover, in its supercharged state with powerful discharge ability. Hunters confident in their skill, head for the site at once.
54706.descriptionEn:
A Thunder Wolf Wyvern《Zinogre》
has suddenly appeared!
It is a monster never seen in
these parts before!
And in its supercharged state,
with powerful discharge ability.
Hunters confident in their skill,
head to the site at once.

55713.description: This is an upgrade quest for the Transcendent armor Jin'O GX series. You can obtain more materials than usual. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
55713.descriptionEn:
A quest to upgrade the
Transcend Armor set,
Zinogre GX Series.
You can earn more
materials than usual.
It's a generous quest,
so give it a try!

23290.description: I have prepared a request for training with the Dragon Piercing Rod. Slaying 3 Aptonoth will complete it, but there should be a Rathian nest near here. If you are confident, you may hunt that as well.
23290.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a request
to train with the Tonfa.
Slay three Aptonoth and
the request is complete,
but a Rathian nests
nearby, I hear. If you
trust your skill, go
ahead and hunt her too.

21984.description: Reports have reached us of an unidentified monster on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
21984.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
an unidentified monster is
rampaging in the Ancient Tower.
As every moment counts, this is
a short-time slaying request,
but to keep the damage to a
minimum, we will accept a mere
repel as well.
We seek hunters with a Secret
Art Tome to face this crisis!

26709.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
26709.descriptionEn:
Reports say Rathians are
swooping into the Desert
one after another! Even
one queen is a handful,
so hunting them back to
back will be brutal!
Step up if you're skilled
or need Rathian parts!!

26156.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
26156.description: A rare combination, a Daimyo Hermitaur and a Piscine Wyvern, has been found in the jungle. It seems to be a welcome quest for advanced hunters, who can take on aquatic monsters all at once. Why not give it a try.
26156.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur and a
Plesioth, a rare pairing,
have been found in the
Jungle.
A quest where you can take
on aquatic monsters at once
seems a treat for High Rank
hunters. Why not try it?

54680.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54680.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

23343.description: Hey, you! Lend me a hand, would you? Lately the Highlands get suddenly noisy at night and I can't sleep at all! It must be Poborubarumu rampaging! Can't you do something to stop it? Come on, please!!
23343.descriptionEn:
Hey, you! Could you lend me
a hand? Lately the
Highlands get so loud at
night that I can't sleep at
all! It must be the Sound
Dragon on a rampage!
Can you stop it somehow?
Come on,
I'm begging you!!

54797.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
54797.description: Please hunt the Shining Thunder Bird that appeared in the highlands. It was long thought harmless, but having expanded its territory near human settlements it has become very aggressive. According to the last sighting, it seems to prefer moving through sunlit places.
54797.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the
≪Shining Thunder Bird≫
that appeared in the Highlands.
It was long thought harmless,
but as it spread its territory
near settlements it has grown
very aggressive.
The last sighting suggests
it prefers sunny spots.

26616.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26616.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

55216.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55216.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

50315.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Rajang in the Snowy Mountains. Clear this quest well and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50315.descriptionEn:
The time has come for
hunters to show their
skill! Hunt the ≪Rajang≫
of the Snowy Mountains.
Clear the quest and your
name as a hunter will
rise by leaps and bounds!

61140.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
61140.description: To pray for a bountiful year ahead, could you help us by hunting one Khezu and one Khezu subspecies this season? We have a small token of thanks ready for participants. Please join us!
61140.descriptionEn:
To pray for a year of
good hunting, could you
help us hunt one Khezu
and one Khezu Subspecies
at this time of year?
We've prepared a little
thank-you gift for all
who join. Please come!

26202.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
26202.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26202.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

60562.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60562.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Espinas!
Taking a monster on all
alone is truly a feat!
Overcome yourself and
claim a top placement!

63307.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
63307.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Kamu Orgaron, then slay the Kamu Orgaron here in this arena!
63307.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters
show their skill! If you
trust your footwork
against the Howling Wolf,
step in and slay
Kam Orugaron yourself!

55086.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55086.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

58089.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58089.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58089.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50585.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
50585.description: This is the practice final quest for the Idaten Cup Champion Tournament, PS Vita edition. The time limit is 50 minutes.
50585.descriptionEn:
Idaten Cup
Champion Tournament
@ PS Vita version
practice final quest.
Time limit: 50 minutes.

54661.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54661.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

56141.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
56141.description: The cactus that Valsaburos likes to eat is rare! And since much of its ecology is still unclear, it is extremely interesting as a subject of study. But the Valsaburos makes field surveys dangerous, so could I ask you to slay it?
56141.descriptionEn:
The cactus that Valsabros
loves to eat is rare! And
so much of its ecology is
unknown, which makes it
a fascinating subject.
But field work is too
dangerous with Valsabros
around. Please slay it?

60526.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
60526.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.

50459.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55061.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55061.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Merit (Beginning) x５０, Bow Merit (Middle) x６０, Bow Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55061.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Medal: Intro≫ x50
≪Bow Medal: Mid≫ x60
≪Bow Medal: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or above, so
please be careful.

22014.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22014.description: A request that lets you craft the Kukubo Series, armor recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and you will obtain the crafting materials for all 5 pieces of the Kukubo Series, plus upgrade materials up to LV7. May it serve you well in your hunting life.
22014.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you
craft the Kuku Series,
armor recommended for
new hunters. Hunt Yian
Kut-Ku to obtain parts
for all five pieces and
upgrade materials up to
LV7. Put it to good use
in your hunting life!

60648.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60648.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Daimyo Hermitaur. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60648.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Daimyo Hermitaur!
Taking a monster on all
alone is truly a feat!
Overcome yourself and
claim a top placement!
Supremacy weapons only!

50059.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50059.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

55657.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55657.descriptionEn:
Hunters who would master
the Great Sword, show
the skill you have honed
against the Baruragaru
in the New Great Arena!
Slay it and you will earn
rewards far beyond what
daily effort ever brings
you. Go and prove it!

28029.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟

55208.description: A phantom beast said to herald disaster, so rarely seen that its form is almost unknown, has appeared, and 2 of them together. They dance beautifully and command lightning, as if mocking us. This is expected to be a very dangerous survey.
55208.descriptionEn:
A phantom beast said to
herald disaster, rarely
ever seen, has appeared
twice at once. They dance
gracefully, command
lightning, and seem to
mock us. This survey
will be extremely dangerous.

62623.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の捕獲
62623.description: An Ice Fox Wyvern seems to have taken up residence in the highlands, and the people living nearby are beside themselves with worry, I hear. However, hunting it would be a pity, so they ask that it be captured. If you manage it, you might receive a rare material.
62623.descriptionEn:
An Ice Fox Wyvern seems
to have taken up in the
Highlands, and the folks
living nearby are beside
themselves with worry.
Still, slaying it seems
cruel, so capture it.
If you pull it off, rare
materials may be yours.

55262.description: To investigate the Rending Water Wyvern that has been appearing intermittently, I ask you to hunt it and sever its parts. The part to be investigated changes with the time of day it appears, so judge whether the tail, the right hanging blade or the left hanging blade is the target, and if you strike it true I will add to your reward!
55262.descriptionEn:
To survey the Zenaserisu that
appears on and off, please hunt
it and sever its parts. The
part to survey changes with
the time of day it appears,
so judge which part is the
target - tail, right hanging
blade or left hanging blade -
and nail it for a bonus!

55158.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Brachydios armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55158.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want
the armor of the Crushing
Wyvern ≪Brachydios≫! Clear
the sub targets to obtain
materials for Sen'yuu Armor
upgrades. Please try it!

11067.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
11067.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this cold season Royal Beetles decrease, but Special Mushrooms are plentiful! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11067.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the
Jungle! In the cold season
≪Royal Beetle≫ is scarce,
but ≪Specialty Mushroom≫ is
plentiful! Let's start by
getting used to the Jungle.

51003.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51003.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
51003.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, display the skill
you have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.

55819.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
55819.description: To take this quest you need a Hunter Ring (Red), nya. Take on the hunt for a Bulldrome holding more Song Gems than usual, nya. Choose a Prayer Gem, clear this quest and offer the Song Gems, nya!
55819.descriptionEn:
To take this quest you
need a Hunter Ring Red,
nya. Try hunting the
Bulldrome that hides
more Song Orbs than
usual, nya. Pick a
Prayer Bead, clear it,
and offer up the orbs!

21411.objectiveJp: カジキマグロ１０匹の納品
21411.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Hunting monsters is not all a hunter does. Fishing is a fine hunt as well. Why not aim to be an angler yourself? If you do, start by delivering 10 Marlin on your own.
21411.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. Hunting
monsters is not all a hunter does.
Fishing is a fine hunt in its own
right. Why not aim to be an angler?
If you do, start by delivering
10 Speartuna on your own.

23313.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

63045.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63045.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

61012.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61012.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

56097.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐

63244.description: Here, a fine present for you. Hm, the present is nowhere to be found. Did I drop it somewhere? Sorry, would you go and look for it instead?
63244.descriptionEn:
Here now, I have a
lovely gift for you.
Hm? The gift isn't
anywhere about. Did I
drop it somewhere?
Sorry, but would you go
and find it for me?

62524.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62524.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62524.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

50257.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Soul (Beginning) x８５, Lance Soul (Middle) x１９５, Lance Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Lance Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50257.descriptionEn:
In this quest, the following materials
can be obtained.
≪Lance Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Lance Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Lance Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Lance Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a ≪Secret Art
Soul Crystal≫ is required, so please
be aware of this.

61733.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61733.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

55831.description: This quest was prepared to raise awareness of the G Rank Guild Priority Requests. Breaking the Espinas Subspecies' horn also earns you special fare.
55831.descriptionEn:
This quest was prepared
to raise awareness of
the G Rank Guild
Priority Requests.
Breaking the Espinas
Subspecies' horn also
earns you special fare.

50344.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
50344.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
50344.descriptionEn:
Defeat a monster a tiny bit bigger
than usual and find a bracelet,
nyah!
I'll trade you my top pick for it,
nyah!
What do I want it for?
It's better not to pry any further
than that, nyah.

50940.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50940.description: For members of hunting parties that took part in the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50940.descriptionEn:
A special request and
rewards for members of
a guild that joined the
Hunter Festival. Bring
your Festival Proof.

28052.description: Lately there is a fellow running wild in the extreme cold sea, and everyone is troubled, nya. Apparently it has a huge body and runs at tremendous speed, nya. Hunters, this is where you show your skill, nya. Roll up your sleeves and go see what is happening, nya!!
28052.descriptionEn:
Something's been on a
rampage in the Polar Sea
and everyone's worried,
nya. It's huge and runs
at crazy speed, they say.
Time to show your worth,
hunters, nya. Go and have
a look for us, nya!!

21951.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21951.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ５１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Akura Vashimu. I am counting on you!
21951.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR51.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as your reward?
It is a simple job, really. Just
make one quick trip and slay
an Akura Vashimu for me.
I am counting on you!

26652.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26652.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

61629.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
61629.description: An ice wyvern has been confirmed in a hidden area of the Ancient Tower, one apart from those where the fire wyverns dwell. The Hunters Guild has named that wyvern the Ice Fox Wyvern, Dyuragaua, and is studying its ecology. It is a wyvern we still know little about, so we ask you to investigate.
61629.descriptionEn:
An ice dragon has been
confirmed in a hidden region
of the Ancient Tower, apart
from where the Rathalos
dwell. The Guild named it
the Ice Fox Dragon
≪Duramboros≫ and studies its
ecology. Please survey it.

63299.description: A Felyne's injuries are not healing well. For treatment I absolutely need a fish wyvern's liver. If I can get that cure-all, it should recover. To save my partner, sorry, but please help!
63299.descriptionEn:
My Felyne's wounds just
won't heal up right.
I need Plesioth guts to
treat them, no matter
what. They say it cures
any ailment, so it should
set my partner right.
I hate to ask, but please
lend me a hand!

56036.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Plesioth. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56036.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Water Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.

55448.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
55448.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55448.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

26578.description: Congratulations on reaching HR100! Deliver a Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26578.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on
reaching HR100! Deliver
a Map on your own, clear
the quest, and claim
your reward!

23697.description: I cannot resist rare things. Monster materials, ore, anything rare I want! This time I want you to slay a few Pokara to gather Pokara materials. Succeed and I will share a little of the rare materials I hold. Not a bad deal, is it?
23697.descriptionEn:
I just can't resist rare things.
Monster materials, ore, anything
rare — I want it all!
This time I want you to slay a few
Pokara to gather their materials.
If you pull it off,
I'll share a little of the rare
materials I have with you.
Not a bad deal, is it?

54695.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54695.description: So you've conquered the G Rank sea routes. This quest lets you trade a Caravan Secret Box for Parone's wisdom. You'll also earn piles of GRP and Gz! Monsters show up too, so stay sharp and hunt with care.
54695.descriptionEn:
So you've conquered the
G Rank sea routes. This
quest lets you trade a
Caravan Secret Box for
Parone's wisdom. You'll
also earn piles of GRP
and Gz! Monsters show up
too, so stay sharp and
hunt with care.

62166.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62166.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62166.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

50106.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
50106.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50106.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

55715.description: Please help with research on the customs of Eastern regions! I want you to find the ingredients for what our documents describe as kashiwa mochi. I heard from a reliable source that it is in the sea of trees, so search there!
55715.descriptionEn:
Please help with our
research on eastern
customs! We need the
ingredients for what our
records call kashiwa
mochi. A reliable source
says they're in the Great
Forest, so search there!

62871.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62871.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62871.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

11058.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. By destroying parts, it seems you can sometimes get ore without mining at all! That's two birds with one stone!
11058.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you may get ore
without mining at all, or so
they say! Two birds with
one stone, eh!

61885.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61885.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

54169.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
54169.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54169.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

26431.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26431.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26431.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

55466.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55466.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

61352.description: This is terrible, meow! With the Hunters Festa and all, Mezeporuta square is in an uproar, meow! Deliveries have piled up and I am run off my feet, meow! And on top of that, monsters are in the way and I cannot get through, so I want you to hunt them, meow! If you do, I will give you my treasure, meow!
61352.descriptionEn:
Big trouble, nya!
With Hunters Festa and
all, Mezeporta Square is
in an uproar, nya! The
deliveries piled up too,
so we're swamped, nya!
And monsters are in the
way, so go slay them for
us, nya! Do that and I'll
give you my treasure, nya!

50849.description: On the highlands where eerie monsters lie in wait, let us join forces and fill the Bruck Gauge! I pray you will clear it without difficulty! Once enough has been gathered I have prepared a reward to share the joy with everyone. Will you get it? For brave ones like you there is no problem.
50849.descriptionEn:
Take the stage in the
Highlands, where creepy
monsters lie in wait, and
pool your strength to
fill the Brook Gauge!
I'm praying you clear it
without trouble! Fill it
up and a reward awaits
to share with everyone.
Brave as you are, no problem?

1002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
1002.description: Velocidrome will run off to the next area when its stamina runs low and heal itself up! It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are lots of Velociprey minions, so watch yourself!
1002.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ bolts to the
next area when worn down
and heals right up!
A fine test of a hunter's
skill, but this season the
Velociprey underlings are
many, so watch yourself!

21512.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
21512.description: A Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporta, and an extremely powerful individual at that! Hunters, intercept it at the Interception Base and slay it.
21512.descriptionEn:
A Shantien, and an
extremely powerful one,
has invaded Mezeporta!
Hunters, intercept it at
the Base and slay it
without fail.

62439.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62439.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

55419.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
55419.description: There is a report that Espinas and Azure Rathalos have taken up residence in the recently discovered Old Tower. For our part, since there is little threat to the surroundings, we would like to watch and see, but we cannot simply ignore it, so hunters who are interested, please investigate.
55419.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in
that Espinas and Azure
Rathalos have taken up
residence in the newly
found Ancient Tower.
The threat to the area
is low, so we'd rather
just watch, but we can't
ignore it. Hunters who
are interested, survey it.

55879.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55879.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

40121.description: I have developed an extremely efficient special training method using Felynes and Melynx. The effect is so great it is a problem, so I can only teach it to selected people! Clear the conditions and take my lesson!
40121.descriptionEn:
I've developed one crazy
efficient training method
using Felynes and
Melynxes. It works TOO
well, see, so I can only
teach it to the chosen
few! Clear the conditions
and come take my lesson,
ya hear!

62187.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

61654.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Shell! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61654.descriptionEn:
The Guild rewards hunters who
break many parts of Variant
and Kishu monsters. The main
reward is a Wyvern's Heavy
Shell! Deliver the
certificate when you accept
or join, then hunt the
specified monster. It cannot
be returned after departure.

55417.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55417.description: We have received reports that a Tigrex and a Diablos have appeared in the desert at the same time. Of all the monsters living in the desert, these two are among the most violent, and the combination can only be called the worst. Head there at once and hunt them.
55417.descriptionEn:
We've received reports
that a Tigrex and a
Diablos have appeared in
the Desert at the same
time. Both are among the
fiercest monsters living
there, and that pairing
is the worst case. Head
out and hunt them at once.

51037.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
51037.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
51037.descriptionEn:
To promote the Guild
Priority Requests we have
long held, we prepared this
quest. Severing a Black
Diablos' tail also grants
you a special ingredient.

63091.description: At night in the Swamp, hunters are suddenly being attacked by something. What is more, every hunter attacked reports that they never saw it. Something is certainly lurking there. Please investigate to find the cause.
63091.descriptionEn:
At night in the Swamp,
hunters are suddenly
being attacked by
something. Worse, every
hunter attacked reports
never seeing it. There is
no doubt something is
lurking. Please survey
and find the cause.

50192.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
50192.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50192.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

40145.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
40145.description: A Pariapuria seems to have attacked merchants in the highlands. It shows no sign of moving from the spot, and the area has been closed off as dangerous. The content of this request is to secure the safety of the highlands. Master hunters, I am counting on you!
40145.descriptionEn:
A ≪Pariapuria≫ seems to have
attacked the merchants in
the Highlands. It shows no
sign of moving on, and the
area is sealed off as
dangerous. This request is
to secure the Highlands.
Skilled hunters, do it!

22005.description: Two Velocidrome have wandered into the arena where Felynes and Melynx await! The main target is slaying 20 Felynes, but complete the sub target of slaying 40 Melynx and a lavish reward awaits!?
22005.descriptionEn:
In the Arena where Felynes and
Melynxes lie in wait, 2
Velocidromes have wandered in!
The main target is slaying 20
Felynes, but if you complete
the sub-target of 40 Melynxes,
a lavish reward awaits!?

61235.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61235.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

21046.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21046.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too! Beware the sharp claws of each and every one!
21046.descriptionEn:
The sickle crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
uses its bizarre leg joints to
climb all the way to the
ceiling!
In this season's Volcano, many
young ≪Gamizami≫ should be about!
Watch out for their sharp claws!

40060.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
40060.description: The Yian Kut-Ku of this jungle is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40060.descriptionEn:
The ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ that lives in
this Jungle is said to sometimes
carry incredible treasure.
If that is true, I would love
for you to go hunt one for us.
We will split the reward
right down the middle.

63372.description: Elegant carnivorous ladies! The day your daily efforts pay off has come. Take candy from the easygoing herbivore hunters and clear the quest! Getting whatever you want, that is the law of the carnivorous lady!
63372.descriptionEn:
Carnivorous ladies, your
day has come! Get candy
from those easygoing
herbivore hunters and
clear the quest! Take
whatever you want, that's
the code of the meat-
eating lady!

62079.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

61718.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
61718.description: Have you heard about the Kinos Secret Stone from the master of the arms workshop? Hm, you don't know? Then this is a good chance, I will invite you on this quest. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special ore that lets you produce a certain armor. Gather lots and take them to the master!
61718.descriptionEn:
Has the smithy master
ever told you about the
Kinos Secret Stone? No?
Then here's your chance:
join this quest. The
Kinos Secret Stone is a
special ore for crafting
certain armor. Gather
plenty and take it to him!
