21591.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Whale Tide Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21591.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Whalestide Orb?
Its material is vital for
crafting a certain costly
talisman.
Complete this request and
I shall give you rare
talisman materials.

22161.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22161.description: Do you like Guku? In this job I am introducing today, an item that can transform Guku into a surprising form is being distributed. Interested now, right? However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
22161.descriptionEn:
Do you like Gooks? In the
request we present today, an
item that turns a Gook into
an amazing form is being
handed out. Curious now,
right? Note that you cannot
accept it twice in a row.

28055.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
28055.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28055.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

61442.description: Hypnocatrice and Cephadrome are breeding in great numbers! We have asked hunters from every region for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt with 2 hunters at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
61442.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and Cephadrome
are breeding out of control!
We asked hunters everywhere
for aid, but there are simply
too many. So we seek those
who can take this hunt with
two people. Fast rank-ups
are especially welcome.

53008.description: I've developed a new hammer, but the structure has become a bit complicated, so would you test its strength for me? I've chosen armor to match the weapon, so no worries! Full of skills, and it looks good too! Wear it without hesitation!
53008.descriptionEn:
I developed a new Hammer, but
the structure came out a bit
complex, so would you go test
its strength for me? I picked
armor to match the weapon, so
no worries!
Full of skills and good looking!
Wear it without holding back!

53318.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
53318.description: I am a collector of equipment. Weapons and armor shine only when used. A mere pretty piece has no meaning. Do you not think so? I will lend you arms from my collection that shaped an era, so slay with them. If you need a helping hand, try clearing the sub-target.
53318.descriptionEn:
I collect equipment.
Gear shines only in use.
A mere showpiece is void.
Don't you agree?
From my collection I
shall lend you gear that
defined an era, so use
it to slay the target.
If you need help, try
clearing the subquest.

55462.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
55462.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make armor from the heavenly revolving dragon Shagaru Magala! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain materials needed to upgrade Transcendence Armor, so please give it a try!
55462.descriptionEn:
A special quest for those
who want ≪Shagaru Magala≫
armor is now ready!
Clear the subquest to
get materials needed to
upgrade Migration armor!
Please give it a try!

63407.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
63407.description: A challenge from the Dark Felyne Guild to you hunters, nya! Find the boss of the pack in the Snowy Mountains in a short time and hunt it, nya! If you manage it splendidly, I'll give you the Dark Felyne Guild Badge, our very soul, nya!
63407.descriptionEn:
Hunters, we bring you
a challenge from us, nya!
Find the pack boss in the
Snowy Mountains fast,
then hunt it, nya!
If you pull it off,
we'll give you our soul,
the ≪Dark Cat Badge≫!
Take it, nya!

61168.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61168.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

63177.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63177.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63177.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

53262.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
53262.description: I love Raviente. Its sharp, tough scales fill me with longing, but my companions do not understand. They go so far as to say the shell of the fortress crab is tougher. Wear the armor I have prepared and repel Shen Gaoren. Show my companions how wonderful Raviente is!
53262.descriptionEn:
I adore Laviente.
Its sharp, stout scales fill me
with longing, but my comrades
don't understand. They even say
things like the Shen Gaoren's
shell is tougher.
Wear the armor I have prepared
and drive off the Shen Gaoren.
Show my comrades Laviente's glory!

54524.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟

21459.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
21459.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Diablos. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21459.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunt Technique Quest to slay
a ≪Diablos≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
other hunters here!

55336.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55336.description: An Akura Vashimu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. It is dangerous, so take the quest with 4 people and face it fully prepared. If you do go with 4, I promise the Crystal Resistance skill will activate.
55336.descriptionEn:
A ≪Taikun Zamuza≫ with
a huge tail has appeared.
It is dangerous, so
take the quest with four
and go fully prepared.
If you go with four, we
promise the ≪Crystal Res≫
skill will activate.

55634.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55634.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

26522.description: 1 pair of Rathalos was sighted in the Canyon. For an ecological survey, please hunt both. We will take most of the Rathalos materials, but we will pay out some unneeded parts and Canyon specialties as a reward.
26522.descriptionEn:
A pair of Rathalos was sighted
in the Canyon. To survey their
ecology, please hunt both.
We will take most of the
Rathalos materials, but we'll
offer some unneeded parts and
Canyon specialties as
your reward.

55986.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55986.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

53298.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
53298.description: Nngh! Build it up, build it up! And let it fly! This exhilaration! The hammer is the supreme weapon! One who can land attacks neatly even on small foes is a true hammer master. Now, let us try slaying the B rank Dyuragaua that appeared at the tower!
53298.descriptionEn:
Nngh! Charge it up, more!
Let it fly! What a rush!
The Hammer is the finest!
One who can hit even small
foes with precision is a
true Hammer Master.
Now, let's take on the
B-rank Duramboros that
showed up at the Tower!

54958.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54958.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54958.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert! Hunt
it well and you shall earn
even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

54497.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54497.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

23415.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Zerureusu, the Radiant World Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23415.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Radiant Dragon ≪Zerureusu≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.

55848.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru has appeared once more. The menace of its developed head is dreadful, and its blood drinking with the tongue seems to have grown more vicious. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55848.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Baruragaru≫ has
appeared again. The menace of
its developed head is
tremendous, and its
blood-draining tongue seems
more vicious. Survey with care.

26337.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26337.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26337.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62168.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62168.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

54243.description: That mischievous Jack who tried to kidnap me and failed! Scold him and scold him and he still misbehaves! He never learns, that Jack! Scold him again and again! And monsters are scary too! Hunt them for me!
54243.descriptionEn:
That cheeky Jack who tried
to kidnap me and failed!
No matter how often I
punish him, he misbehaves!
He never learns, Jack!
Punish him again and again!
Also, monsters are scary!
Slay them for me!

21643.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21643.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Blangonga and Congalala, the pride of the Fanged Beasts. Is there a hunter who can hunt two of these fanged beasts at once, when even one is utter hardship!? Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
21643.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! Here, the finest
Fanged Beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala. Does a hunter exist
who can hunt these two at once,
each a trial on its own!? Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose
their life to a moment's lapse!

50409.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61703.description: Hey, hunter. Lately the Hunters Guild is said to be recruiting hunters to capture a Gravios in the arena. The condition is to be equipped with a Light Bowgun or Heavy Bowgun. Of course you will join?
61703.descriptionEn:
Excuse me, hunter. I hear the
Hunters Guild is looking for
hunters to capture a
≪Gravios≫ in the Arena. The
condition is a Light or Heavy
Bowgun. Of course you'll
join, right?

53310.description: This is bad, this is bad! My Baretta collection has been stolen! That Rathalos took part of the collection! Give me a break! I will share a few materials with you at least! Get it back for me! Please!
53310.descriptionEn:
This is bad, so bad!
My Barretta collection
got stolen! That Rathalos
took a chunk of my
collection with him!
Please, have mercy!
I'll share some materials,
just a little!
Get it back! I'm begging!

63351.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63351.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the hammer, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63351.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena we
loosed a ≪Rathian≫ that
acts in unthinkable ways.
Hammer hunters striving
for mastery, show me your
skill here and now!
Hunt it well, and you
shall gain far more than
daily effort could ever
bring you.

51043.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51043.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Berukyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
51043.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Duramboros' head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

23308.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

55824.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55824.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

1034.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

26037.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
26037.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26037.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

53297.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の討伐
53297.description: Guk gwagg gwa! Gyaa gyaa guk gwa! Gugugwaa! Gwa gwa! (It seems to be saying: become one with the Guku, take the Gyaa Gyaa Guku, and try slaying an Iodrome.)
53297.descriptionEn:
Gook gwa ggwa!
Gyaa gyaa gook gwa!
Gugugwaa! Gwa gwa!
(I feel like the Gook is
asking you to take the
Gyaa Gyaa Gook and slay
a Gendrome... or so it
seems to me.)

50582.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and you will obtain food ingredients useful in the hunt.
50582.descriptionEn:
A special request and
rewards for members of a
winning Hunter Festival
guild. When accepting or
joining, bring a Festival
Proof. Clear this request
to obtain meal ingredients
useful for hunting.

56096.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56096.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

62151.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
62151.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62151.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

50454.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61765.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
61765.description: The Instructor here! It has been a while, you who endured my special training. This time I have prepared a trial for hunters who have gained some experience. A hunt in the desert for the Black Diablos and the Green Plesioth! A harsh trial, but if you achieve it your standing as hunters will rise even higher.
61765.descriptionEn:
It's the Instructor! Those
who survived my training,
long time no see. This
time I have a trial for
seasoned hunters. In the
Desert, hunt a Black
Diablos and a Green
Plesioth! It is harsh, but
your fame will rise!

55446.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55446.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

50889.description: An Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, seems to have appeared in the Snowy Mountains. The ecology of the Ice Fang Wyvern is not well surveyed. For the sake of research, please hunt one. If you can sever the tail as well, the reward will rise to match.
50889.descriptionEn:
A Barioth, the Ice Fang
Wyvern, appeared in the
Snowy Mountains. Its
ecology is still unknown.
For research, please
hunt it. Cut the tail too
if you can.
Rewards will swell for it.

26418.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26418.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!

53076.description: The final quest for the Championship Tournament DMM Cup. Please read the participation rules on the tournament's special site carefully, and join after agreeing to them. Taking the final quest counts as participation.
53076.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
"Championship Tournament DMM
Cup".
Please read the participation rules
on the event's special site, and
agree to them before joining.
Accepting the final quest is taken
as your entry into the tournament.

22042.description: A subspecies of Espinas has appeared at the top of the tower close to the sea of trees. According to the documents left by the Royal Paleontology Scriveners, there is a record that against the wholehearted blow it delivers after storing power, defense was of no use at all. Please take care.
22042.descriptionEn:
An Espinas Subspecies has
appeared at the top of the Tower
near the Great Forest. Documents
left by the Royal Paleontology
Scrivener Corps record that
against the all-out blow it
charges up, defense was of no
use at all.
Please be careful.

26360.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26360.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26360.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

50416.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

50010.description: Having Gypceros steal my valuables so many times, I can't do business. Go to the swamp and get them back for me. Lately they've grown bold and attack in groups. As a special exception, I'll give you a prize from one of the gallery tournaments!
50010.descriptionEn:
Having my valuables stolen by
≪Gypceros≫ so often, I can't
do business. Go to the Swamp
and get them back for me.
Lately they've grown bold and
attack in packs. As a special
case, I'll give you a prize
from a Gallery tournament!

60609.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
60609.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.

54996.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
54996.description: Word has come of a Teostra sighting at the Tower. It seems to unleash attacks different from those confirmed so far. Only G-rank hunters of proven skill will be asked to investigate, so G-rank hunters, please take up the survey.
54996.descriptionEn:
We have received reports of a
Teostra sighting at the Tower.
It seems to be unleashing
attacks different from those
confirmed up to now.
We will ask only G Rank hunters
of proven skill to investigate,
so G Rank hunters, please
take on this investigation.

55950.description: A crimson radiant dragon that appeared at the ancient ruins. The Guild has decided to call this one Zerureusu that Shines to the Extreme. Hunter of courage, drive this monster off and I will surely grant you materials for armor the Guild keeps in secret.
55950.descriptionEn:
A crimson Shining World
Dragon at the Ruins. The
Guild names this one
'Zerureusu the Radiant.'
Hunters of courage,
drive it off and the
Guild shall grant you its
hidden armor materials.

62120.description: There! There it is! A magnificent Monoblos is in the desert! Hunt that one alone and you're a first-rate hunter! Hurry there and hunt it! Right now you can apparently get rare materials too, so just go hunt it!
62120.descriptionEn:
There it is! There it is!
A fine ≪Monoblos≫ is in the
Desert!
Hunting that one alone is what
makes a first-rate hunter!
Hurry off and hunt it!
Right now you can get rare
materials too, so go on,
hunt it!

55406.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Giaorugu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55406.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Giaorugu≫
seems to have reached a strength
that puts it at the very top of
all Giaorugu. Its power is
beyond measure. Hunters sure of
their skill to challenge the
summit, please take on the
survey.

55706.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55706.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

26728.description: My master gave me a sudden order. A fully fledged carver can carve the tail bone from a Variant Gravios, so he told me to bring one back. It seems I may ask a hunter to capture it and sever its tail, so please do what you can. Once the tail bone is taken, I will give it to you after showing it to my master.
26728.descriptionEn:
My master gave me a sudden
order, see. A full-fledged carver
can carve the tailbone from a
Gravios Variant, so bring one
back and show him, he says.
Asking hunters for the capture
and the tail cut is fine, so
please, help me out. Once we
have the tailbone, it is yours
after he sees it.

61120.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61120.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

54454.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54454.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Tigrex, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54454.descriptionEn:
To boost awareness of the
new G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest for you. Break
the Tigrex's head and
we'll grant special
ingredients as a bonus.
Good luck!

22074.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
22074.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

62131.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
62131.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62131.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

26108.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62506.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
62506.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Do not let your guard down; approach it as though it were a Hardcore Quest. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62506.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for members
of winning Hunting Festival guilds.
Please face it as if it were a
≪Hardcore Quest≫, and do not let
your guard down.
Note that once you depart, the
Festival Proof cannot be returned
no matter what happens.

54774.description: Brachydios's ecology is a mystery. Just when we had reports of sightings in the volcano, now comes a report of it appearing in the polar sea. A creature whose whole body is like an explosive is extremely dangerous. Head there at once and hunt it.
54774.descriptionEn:
The ecology of the Brute Wyvern
Brachydios is a mystery. Right
after sightings in the Volcano,
reports came of one appearing
in the Polar Sea. A beast whose
whole body is like an explosive
is extremely dangerous.
Head there at once and hunt it.

54964.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
54964.description: A trial quest for the G10 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy the new action, the Slash Axe F, a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54964.descriptionEn:
This is the quest for the
'G10 Preview Event' trial.
New action!
Try the ≪Slash Axe F≫
a step ahead of everyone!
Time limit: 10 minutes.

54173.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
54173.description: Please help with the investigation of Anorupatisu. Anorupatisu tends to draw attention for the horn on its head, but the claws of its wings and its tail are also very dangerous parts. This time we investigate the wings and tail, so be sure to destroy them before hunting it.
54173.descriptionEn:
We ask for help surveying
the Anorupatisu.
People focus on its head
horns, but its wing claws
and tail are also very
dangerous parts.
This time we survey the
wings and tail, so break
them before you hunt it,
please.

62760.description: The savage wyvern confirmed in the Jungle has been found to be a beast wyvern species that never lived around Mezeporuta before. The Hunters Guild seems to have named it Abiorugu. Please investigate further.
62760.descriptionEn:
The ≪Tyrant Wyvern≫ confirmed
in the Jungle has been found to
be a Beast Wyvern species that
had never lived around
Mezepolta until now.
The Hunters Guild appears to
have named it ≪Abiorugu≫.
We ask for further surveys
of the area.

62068.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐

54740.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54740.description: A black-bodied subspecies of Diablos was sighted during the survey of White Lake. We ask you to hunt the creature before the surveyors come to harm. Beware the ferocious strike from underground delivered with those two horns.
54740.descriptionEn:
During a survey of White Lake,
a black-bodied subspecies of
≪Diablos≫ was sighted.
Before the surveyors come to
harm, please hunt the target.
Take great care against the
ferocious strike from underground
by its two horns.

55902.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55902.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55902.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

60043.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
60043.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!

50618.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. We will also grant special ingredients when the quest is cleared.
50618.descriptionEn:
To boost awareness of the
Guild Priority requests we
have long offered, we have
prepared this quest for
you all.
Clearing it also grants
special ingredients as a
bonus.

60207.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
60207.description: Lavasioth live in the sea of lava that spreads through the volcano. Their molten breath and attacks that use their massive bodies turn a moment of carelessness into death! The charge of that great body especially demands caution!
60207.descriptionEn:
In the sea of lava that spreads
through the Volcano lives the
lava wyvern ≪Volganos≫.
Its spewed lava and its huge
body's attacks turn a moment's
carelessness into death!
Especially its charge, watch out!

50357.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
50357.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the claws of a Shogun Ceanataur will also grant a special ingredient.
50357.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Shogun Ceanataur's
claws, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

22166.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
22166.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed for F strengthening of
Secret Art Armor (Gunner),
except for Weapon Souls.
The yield covers 5 pieces.
To accept the quest you need
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫, so please
take care.

26308.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26308.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26308.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62585.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
62585.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62585.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

62899.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
62899.description: When the monster the surveyor found was checked with the guild, it proved to be a relative of the sea wyverns, a Crystal Wyvern by the name of Kuarusepusu. Moreover, an extremely powerful individual seems to dwell in the highlands, and the surveyor's safety is feared for. Head for the highlands at once and hunt the Crystal Wyvern.
62899.descriptionEn:
When the Guild examined the
monster our surveyor found, it was
a kind of Leviathan named
Kuarlusepusu, the Crystal Dragon.
What is more, an extremely strong
individual seems to live up in the
Highlands, and the surveyor's
safety is feared for.
Hurry there and hunt it.

55829.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
55829.description: To boost awareness of the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest. Cutting the Revidiora's tail also grants special ingredients.
55829.descriptionEn:
To boost awareness of the
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest.
Cutting the Thunder Extreme
Dragon's tail also grants
special ingredients.

54801.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の討伐
54801.description: Iodrome and Ioprey have appeared in the Great Arena. The Guild has decided to pay a large reward to hunters who slay them. Please slay them quickly before damage occurs!
54801.descriptionEn:
A Gendrome and Genprey
appeared in the New Great
Arena. The Guild will pay
a large sum to hunters
who slay them.
Please slay them quickly,
before harm is done!

23504.description: To those of you who have upgraded the Flogada G series to LV7! We have prepared a quest that lets you obtain in one go the upgrade materials for 1 piece of the Flogada GF series armor! Clear the quest 5 times and upgrade every piece!
23504.descriptionEn:
To those who upgraded the
Frogada G series to Lv7! We
prepared a quest that gives
upgrade materials for one
piece of Frogada GF armor at
once! Clear it five times and
upgrade every piece!

62897.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62897.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

60528.description: Hunters. Raise the guild flag and let us celebrate the year gone by and the year to come. Besides setting the flag, deliver the required number of Secret Pouches and Carnivore Eggs and I will send you a celebratory gift. Do throw yourself into it.
60528.descriptionEn:
Hunters.
Raise the Guild Flag and
celebrate the old and new
year. Besides the flag,
deliver the set number of
≪Secret Pouches≫ and
≪Carnivore Eggs≫ and I
shall send a gift. Huzzah!

61665.description: It seems you gathered splendidly the materials the miner requested. According to the owner of the mixing shop, if you mix a large amount of Amber Rare Water and Jade Rare Water with Blast Rock, you get a rare ore that burns as if it were exploding. Won't you try it too?
61665.descriptionEn:
You've gathered all the
materials the miner asked for.
According to the owner of the
mixing shop, blending blasting
rocks into lots of Amber Fluid
and Jade Fluid makes a rare ore
that burns like an explosion.
Won't you try it too?

62371.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

54289.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の狩猟
54289.description: A report has come in that hunters who headed for the Snowy Mountains were beaten back by 2 Tigrex! Brave hunters confident in their skill, set out to rescue the injured and hunt the Tigrex! I will pay a hefty bounty!
54289.descriptionEn:
Hunters who went to the
Snowy Mountains were
beaten by two ≪Tigrex≫!
Brave hunters confident in
their skill, go rescue the
wounded and hunt them!
The bounty will be huge!

54704.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54704.description: To those aiming for GR500: hunting an Azure Rathalos greatly raises your fame and can also yield the 'Azure Rathalos Marrow,' a prime material for making attack-boost Sigils. We prepared it. Please make good use of it.
54704.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for GR500:
hunting an Azure Rathalos
greatly raises your fame
and can also yield the
'Azure Rathalos Marrow,'
a prime material for making
attack-boost Sigils. We
prepared it.
Please make good use of it.

63152.description: A Conquest monster said to invite calamity has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
63152.descriptionEn:
A Zenith monster said to bring
calamity has appeared! As this is
a race against time, the request
is for a short hunt, but to keep
the damage to a minimum, simply
repelling it will still be rated.
We seek hunters who hold the
Secret Art and will face this
unprecedented crisis!

58086.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58086.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58086.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

61820.description: A quest where delivering 5 Festival Certificates earns you Festival Memories as a reward. Be sure to carry your Festival Certificates when you depart, and deliver them after you arrive.
61820.descriptionEn:
Deliver 5 ≪Festival Proofs≫
and you will receive a
≪Festival Memory≫ as your
reward.

Be sure to carry the
≪Festival Proofs≫ with you
when you depart, then
deliver them on arrival.

61953.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
61953.description: This is a qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61953.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament qualifier quest.
In the finals, the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, from the monster's
carving and clear rewards,
the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained.

62292.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62292.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62292.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

55151.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Rajang while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55151.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying a Rajang
raises your fame while
cheaply granting materials
needed for G Rank
talismans.
Please make use of it.

23569.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
23569.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23569.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

61321.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
61321.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61321.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

55013.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55013.description: A surveyor who went to the Jungle reported sighting the steel dragon. Its attacks, delivered with the power of wind, are reported to be very dangerous. Prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55013.descriptionEn:
Surveyors who went to the Jungle
reported a sighting of the
≪Kushala Daora≫.
Its attacks, unleashed with the
power of wind, are said to be
very dangerous.
Prepare well before you
survey it.

55221.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft the Cuff 'G Gougeki Cuff SA6' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55221.descriptionEn:
We prepared a quest that
grants materials to craft
the cuff 'G Hard Strike
Cuff SA6' from the photo
that won the Grand Prize
at the F Photo Contest
2016.
Please enjoy.

62934.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

54828.description: This quest gives production and upgrade materials for the Tonfa, Great Sword and Dual Blades whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
54828.descriptionEn:
In the Zinogre hunting release
event "Transcendence Invasion!
Hunt the Zinogre", a survey was
held to mark 700,000 Zinogre
slain, and it decided the
performance of the Tonfa, Great
Sword and Dual Blades. This
quest lets you obtain their
crafting and upgrade materials.

60082.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

23681.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23681.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Sword and Shield, show the
skill you have honed against
the ≪Baruragaru≫ in the New
Great Arena! Hunt it well and
you shall earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts bring.

53265.description: Oh, if you haven't done Daydream yet, do that first! The sub-targets A and B in this request are hidden elements with no hints! Don't expect much of a reward, all right? Now, let's enjoy summer in style!
53265.descriptionEn:
Whoa, if you haven't done
Daydream yet, do that
one first!
The subquests A and B
in this request are
hidden, no-hint extras!
Don't expect rewards, eh?
Let's enjoy summer in style!

61357.description: Word has it that White Star Iron has been found in the wasteland known as the Canyon. Anyone who wants White Star Iron, why not join the survey party? We supply the goods and the food. Once supplies run out you will be living off the land, so join only if you are prepared for that.
61357.descriptionEn:
There is a rumor that White Star Iron
has been found in the wasteland,
≪Canyon≫. Anyone who wants
White Star Iron, why not join the
survey team? We have prepared
goods and food on our side.
If need be you will live off the
land, so only those with resolve
should join.

26454.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
26454.description: 1 step short of the Canyon, a Yian Garuga is in the way and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26454.descriptionEn:
I'm just one step from the
Canyon, but a Yian Garuga is
in my way and I'm stuck.
If you help me out,
I'll give you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ you can trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫ as thanks!

62592.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
62592.description: To draw out the hidden power of the famed Black Bow, it must be worked further with this Ancient Ink I hold, but I do not do it for free. Bring down the rumored Akantor somewhere with a bow and I will acknowledge your skill and give you this.
62592.descriptionEn:
To draw out the hidden power
of the famed bow Black Bow,
it must be worked further with
this ≪Ancient Ink≫ I hold, but
I won't do it for free.
If you bring down the rumored
≪Akantor≫ somewhere with a
bow, I'll acknowledge your skill
and give this to you.

21064.description: We're recruiting hunters to slay 8 Ioprey! Ioprey hits harder in a single blow than Velociprey or Genprey, so mind yourself out there!
21064.descriptionEn:
Seeking hunters to slay 8
≪Ioprey≫!
Compared to Velociprey or
Genprey, a single Ioprey hit
hits harder. Watch out!

55830.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
55830.description: To boost awareness of the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest. Breaking the Gasurabazura's head also grants special ingredients.
55830.descriptionEn:
To boost awareness of the
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest.
Breaking the Gasurabazura's
head also grants special
ingredients.

63245.description: The sky above the Snowy Mountains is so dazzling I cannot bear it. Like this I cannot go and hand out presents to the children. Could you do something about it with your strength? When the time is right, plant a flag as a marker. Then, I am counting on you.
63245.descriptionEn:
The sky over the Snowy
Mountains is too bright.
Like this I can't go hand
out presents to the kids.
Can't you fix it with your
power? When the time is
right, raise a flag marker.
Well then, it's up to you.

55253.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55253.description: The survey team that was separated still has not returned! I saw them being chased by a Stygian Zinogre toward the secret region of the tower, and red-black lightning was coiling high into the sky and resounding! Please! Go and save them quickly!
55253.descriptionEn:
The separated survey team has
still not returned! I saw them
being chased by a Stygian Zinogre
toward the hidden area of the
Tower, and red-black lightning
was coiling high into the sky and
roaring!
Please! Go and save them, quickly!

50399.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

50795.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50795.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50795.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55323.description: Slaying a Zenaserisu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55323.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying Zenaserisu
raises your fame while
cheaply granting materials
needed for G Rank
talismans.
Please make use of it.

22056.description: The depths of the Swamp are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22056.descriptionEn:
The depths of the ≪Swamp≫
are still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

55535.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55535.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

55437.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (legs), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
55437.descriptionEn:
This quest drops
materials needed to
upgrade G Rank Secret Art
Armor (legs), except Weapon
Ribbons and Merits.
One material type drops.
To accept this quest,
you need a ≪10th Anniv.
Ticket≫, so please note.

8.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
8.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

55204.description: 2 monsters suddenly appeared in the New Great Arena. Both are monsters the guild considers the most dangerous. We have somehow kept the damage from spreading, but the situation allows no complacency. Head there at once and slay the monsters.
55204.descriptionEn:
Suddenly, two monsters have
appeared in the New Great Arena.
Both are monsters the Guild ranks
as the most dangerous of all.
For now the damage has not spread,
but the situation allows no room
for complacency.
Go to the site at once and set
about slaying the monsters.

26549.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石２個の納品
26549.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Bird Wyvern Secret Stone! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26549.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who capture many Variants
and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Bird Wyvern
Secret Stone!
Deliver the guarantee when you
accept or join, and hunt the
specified monster.
Note that the guarantee cannot be
returned once you depart.

21353.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21353.description: To draw out the hidden power of the famed Black Bow, it must be worked further with this Ancient Ink I hold, but I do not do it for free. Bring down the rumored Akantor somewhere with a bow and I will acknowledge your skill and give you this.
21353.descriptionEn:
To draw out the hidden power
of the famed bow Black Bow,
it must be worked further with
this ≪Ancient Ink≫ I hold, but
I won't do it for free.
If you bring down the rumored
≪Akantor≫ somewhere with a
bow, I'll acknowledge your skill
and give this to you.

21109.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品

56083.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56083.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

63168.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63168.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63168.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

53032.description: To express our gratitude to everyone who has been enjoying MHF-G, we have prepared a place for exchange. We hope you will take this opportunity to visit. We await you all.
53032.descriptionEn:
To express our thanks to all
of you who enjoy MHF-G every
day, we have prepared a place
to gather and mingle. We hope
you will take this chance to
come and join us.
We look forward to seeing
you all there.

61664.objectiveJp: さびた板状の塊１個の納品
61664.description: Now for Part Two. From the five kinds including Rusted Fragments, turn in two different kinds than in Part One. The reward is something the alchemy shop master wants so badly his throat aches, for an experiment. What he will do with it, I do not know.
61664.descriptionEn:
Now, Part 2.
From the five kinds such as
rusted chunks, deliver the two
kinds that differ from Part 1.
The reward is an item the
apothecary's master wants so
badly his throat aches for it,
for some experiment of his.
What he'll do with it, I don't know.

55120.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退
55120.description: The Emperor-Conquering Dragon wrapped in light, ruling over Kumomi Fortress. The guild has decided to name it the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. Hunter of courage. When you drive it off, you will be granted the materials of guild-treasured armor.
55120.descriptionEn:
The Emperor Dragon
who rules Cloud Viewing
Fortress, wrapped in light.
The Guild will call it
'Guanzorumu the Supreme.'
Hunters of courage:
drive it off, and the
Guild's hidden armor
materials are yours.

54346.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54346.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

61157.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61157.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61157.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

11.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
11.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

62803.description: As long as you are a hunter, a thorny road awaits! How about taking on the trial I set? If you clear my trial splendidly, I'll give you one of the most precious materials that can be taken from Espinas.
62803.descriptionEn:
As long as you are a
hunter, a thorny road
awaits! Will you take
on my trial?
Clear the trial I
give you, and I shall
bestow rare materials
taken from the Espinas,
the finest of them.

62876.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
62876.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62876.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

60022.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! When the lion clad in jet-black fur shines gold, its power, a match for the Elder Dragons, reaches the height of tyranny! Hunter who has mastered the hunt! Prove your strength against the Rajang loosed into the arena!
60022.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters
show their skill! When the
black-furred lion gleams
gold, its power rivals the
Elder Dragons! Masters of
the hunt, prove your worth
against the Arena Rajang!

50722.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
50722.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
50722.descriptionEn:
To promote the Guild
Priority Requests we have
long held, we prepared this
quest. Severing a Black
Diablos' tail also grants
you a special ingredient.

60824.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60824.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60824.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.

56014.description: Because the Guild's stock of Zenith developed part materials is plentiful, we will give more developed part materials in some quests. The relevant quests require a Hunter Medal Sakura, so receive one from the rewards. Note that Hunter Medal Sakura are limited in number.
56014.descriptionEn:
The Guild's stock of
Supremacy developed-part
materials is plentiful,
so some quests now give
extra. Those quests need
a Hunter Medal Sakura,
so take one from your
rewards. Note that the
medals are limited.

53206.objectiveJp: ポルタキャンディ１個の納品
53206.description: Tenfold return is the norm for White Day! I have no use for fools who give back sweets. Shoes, bags, a lavish dinner are all fine, but here it really has to be accessories!
53206.descriptionEn:
On White Day, tenfold
return is the norm!
Fools who just return
sweets are useless.
Shoes, bags, fancy
dinners are fine, but
jewelry is the way!

50254.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Soul (Beginning) x８５, Long Sword Soul (Middle) x１９５, Long Sword Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Long Sword Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50254.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Long Sword Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Long Sword Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Long Sword Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.

50548.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
50548.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Tigrex, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
50548.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Palico doing well, meow?
Time to treat your partner right, meow!
Now, to business, meow. This
request is to hunt one Tigrex,
meow.
The reward is crafting materials
for Palico gear, meow!
I'm counting on you, meow!

21466.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
21466.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Yian Garuga. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21466.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the Hunting
Technique Quest: ≪Yian Garuga≫
Slaying.
The reward is slightly lower than a
normal hunt, but how about honing
your skills together with fellow
hunters!

61064.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
61064.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament finals. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards in this quest.
61064.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
finals.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from clear rewards
in this quest.

26049.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26049.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26049.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

60040.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

26209.description: It is a chore, but a request has come in through guild channels. As the reward, we have prepared a Vitality Drink, guild-approved, that restores stamina smartly with little delay, anytime and anywhere! If you have the time, please.
26209.descriptionEn:
It is a chore, but a quest
request has come from Guild
connections. The reward is
≪Energy Drink≫, the Guild-
approved bottle that restores
stamina in a flash, anytime,
anywhere. Come if you are free!

50522.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
50522.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50522.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

50746.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
50746.description: A mysterious monster has been confirmed in the snow mountains during a raging blizzard. When the master of the weapons workshop saw the sketch our surveyor drew, he went pale with disbelief and fled back to his shop. We will get the details out of him, so hunters, please handle the survey on site.
50746.descriptionEn:
A mysterious monster has been
confirmed in a Snowy
Mountains blizzard. When the
workshop master saw the
surveyor's sketch, he flew
back to the workshop in
disbelief. We will get the
story from him, so please
survey the site for us.

21721.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Soul (Beginning) x８５, Hammer Soul (Middle) x１９５, Hammer Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Hammer Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21721.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hammer Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Hammer Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Hammer Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Hammer Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest, you will
need a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please be aware of that.

23366.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
23366.description: A request for hunters who possess Flogada GF Series LV7. Hunt Gurenzeburu and you can obtain materials to strengthen the Flogada GX Series to LV7 for one part.
23366.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
own the 'Furogada GF
Series' at LV7.
Hunt a ≪Toa Tesukatora≫
to get materials to raise
the 'Furogada GX Series'
to LV7, for one part.

55942.description: This time we have prepared a little trial to confirm the bond of the bride and groom! Its name is the Crimson Trial! You are to slay an Espinas in the Flower Field! Of course, help from your friends is fine! Now go and enjoy it!
55942.descriptionEn:
This time, to test the
bond of the bride and
groom, we made a trial!
Its name: 'Crimson Trial'!
Slay an Espinas in the
Flower Field!
Help from friends is of
course allowed!
Now go and enjoy!

62817.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
62817.description: This is the practice qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
62817.descriptionEn:
This is the practice qualifying quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from the clear reward.

21583.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Rat Tail Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21583.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Rattail Orb?
Its material is vital for
crafting a certain costly
talisman.
Complete this request and
I shall give you rare
talisman materials.

56078.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for five materials, and break the specified part for five more!
56078.descriptionEn:
A chance to obtain Supremacy
weapons prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal a set amount of damage to
the target for 5 materials, and
break the specified parts for
5 more of each!

40090.description: Congratulations on reaching HR999! Deliver the Map on your own, then visit the special Event House after clearing the quest to receive a bonus. Please make use of this!
40090.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR999! Deliver the ≪Map≫
on your own, then visit
the special Event House
after clearing the quest
to receive a bonus. Please
make use of this!

21831.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21831.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Lavasioth will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
21831.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
The 'fixed damage' dealt to
≪Volganos≫ will be judged by
this Guild, so simply focus on
completing the main target,
everyone!

60637.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60637.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62213.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62213.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62175.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Plesioth and Green Plesioth of the jungle. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
62175.descriptionEn:
The time has come for
hunters to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Plesioth≫ and
≪Green Plesioth≫ of the
Jungle. Clear the quest
and your fame as hunters
will soar!

62773.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
62773.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!

54422.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
54422.description: We ask you to investigate the Gold Rathian lurking in the Tower. Not only hunt it: if you break its head and sever its tail, I will add to your reward!
54422.descriptionEn:
We ask you to survey the
Gold Rathian in the Tower.
Not just the hunt: break
its head and sever
its tail, and we will
add extra pay on
top!

55724.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55724.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55724.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

62648.description: This is a hunting request for Gogomoa, a Fanged Beast. Tide Island is a very beautiful place, but it is also a place where danger may hide anywhere. Do not let the beauty distract you and get caught by a Gogomoa!
62648.descriptionEn:
This is a request to hunt the
Fanged Beast ≪Gogomoa≫. Tidal
Island is a very beautiful
place, but also one where
danger can hide anywhere.
Mind you don't stare at the
scenery and get jumped by
the ≪Gogomoa≫!

61428.description: Do you know the Moonlight Stone? It is a strange stone, said to be moonlight crystallized, and rumor has it that cooperation with companions is essential to obtain one. But cooperation with companions is the basics of a hunter. You will surely be able to gather some too.
61428.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Moonlight Stone?
It is a strange stone said to be
moonlight crystallized, and rumor
has it that allies' cooperation is
essential to obtain one.
But well, cooperating with allies is
the basics of a hunter.
I am sure you can mine some too.

40197.description: To those aiming for high GR: we prepared a quest where slaying a Gogomoa raises your fame while cheaply granting materials needed for G Rank decorations. Please make use of it.
40197.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for high
GR: we prepared a quest
where slaying a ≪Gogomoa≫
raises your fame while
cheaply granting materials
needed for G Rank
talismans.
Please make use of it.

21153.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
21153.description: Our interception posture against the exceptionally powerful Rukodiora now closing on the interception base is ready. We have prepared ample supplies and interception weapons, so though this is an extremely dangerous request, please head out and slay it.
21153.descriptionEn:
We are now ready to meet
the extremely powerful
≪Rukodiora≫ closing on
the ≪Base≫. Supplies and
interception weapons are
ready. This request is very
dangerous, but go slay it.

54388.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54388.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Tigrex and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54388.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Tigrex≫ and prove
what you can do.
Clear this quest and your
standing as a hunter will rise
in a great leap!

50963.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50963.description: A request for hunters who reached HR5, letting you craft and upgrade the recommended Odiba Series Hardcore Armor. Repel Odibatorasu to obtain materials for one piece of the Odiba Series.
50963.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
reached HR5, letting you
craft and upgrade the
recommended Odiba Series
≪Hardcore Armor≫. Repel
Odibatorasu to obtain
materials for one piece of
the Odiba Series.

54734.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
54734.description: Great numbers of Bulldrome seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Bulldrome! If you do it splendidly, we will give you higher standing than usual, plus commemorative tickets that allow the production of sigils, and materials!
54734.descriptionEn:
Bulldrome are breaking out
in droves near Mezeporta!
Hunters, please lend a
hand in slaying the
boars!
Slay them well and you'll
get higher fame, plus
commemorative Sigil-craft
tickets and materials!

56001.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
56001.description: A Variant Species Harudomerugu with a greatly developed head has appeared, and its Variant-specific attacks have caused many hunters to fail in the hunt. To improve the situation, the guild will support the hunt with stronger supplies! When you hunt it, please take care!
56001.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Dahren Mohran
with a huge head appeared,
and its Supremacy attacks
have made many hunters
fail the hunt.
To improve things, the
Guild backs the slay with
better supplies! Please
be careful out there!

51049.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
51049.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials needed to FX
upgrade Secret Art Armor
(Blademaster), excluding
weapon souls. The yield
covers five pieces. To
accept, ≪Hunter Pass:
Sakura≫ is required, so
please note.

26526.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26526.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26526.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

21134.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

21060.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
21060.description: Find and deliver 6 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
21060.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 6 Special
Mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
If you also deliver the ≪Royal Beetle≫,
the insect that sometimes flies
through the Jungle, I'll still pay!
Start by getting to know the Jungle,
then get used to it.

63391.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Abiorugu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63391.descriptionEn:
Emergency request. We seek
someone to dispose of an
extremely powerful
≪Abiorugu≫. Hunt it well
and we shall issue more
Slay Proofs than usual!

26107.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

21213.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21213.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50966.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
50966.description: Reports of damage from the Gore Magala keep coming in. The erosion caused by the Frenzy Virus seems to be spreading. To curb the Frenzy Virus and for our survey, I want to request the hunt and the breaking of the head and antennae. Word has come in that it has appeared at the Rainbow Falls. Head out to hunt it at once.
50966.descriptionEn:
Reports of Gore Magala
damage keep coming. The
Frenzy Virus is spreading.
To contain and study the
virus, we request the hunt
and breaks of head and
antennae. It was sighted at
Prism Falls.
Hunt it at once, please.

60659.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a red and white monster of the zodiac. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60659.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
This time: a red-and-white
monster of the zodiac!
Achieve the goal with
your guildmates. Teamwork
decides this contest, so
place high! This round is
Supremacy weapons only!

23424.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
23424.description: Please hunt the Emperor-Conquering Dragon that dwells in Kumomi Fortress. The ecology of this monster is wrapped in mystery and information is scarce. According to the survey team, the flying wyverns that fly around the Emperor-Conquering Dragon also have a connection to it.
23424.descriptionEn:
We ask you to slay the
≪Guanzorumu≫ that dwells in
Cloud Viewing Fortress.
This monster's ecology is
shrouded in mystery, and
information is scarce. The
survey team says the Flying
Wyverns around it are linked to it.

26453.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
