63297.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63297.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63297.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.

28038.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
28038.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering materials from the Echoing Wolf, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28038.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters,
won't you pass your hunt
skills on to the young
hunters of the Guild?
This time, <<Orugaron>>
materials, a big splurge!
Grow strong together and
liven up the Guild. Clear
it with mixed Secret Art
holders for extra Guild rep!

21540.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21540.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21540.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

50970.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
50970.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Odibatorasu Gou armor. Slay the ferocious Berukyurosu that lives in the Old Tower and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
50970.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
Slay the ferocious
≪Dyuragaua≫ that dwells
in the Ancient Tower and
you will get the materials
to upgrade the ≪Heavenly
Storm≫ "Odiba F" to Lv7.

63308.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63308.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63308.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.

26373.description: Just when I thought those noisy ones were gone, now there is a swarm of Cantaro thick enough to cover the ground! I left my important baggage behind! Someone drive them off!
26373.descriptionEn:
Just when those noisy pests
were gone, now the ground is
crawling with a swarm of
Kantharos!
I left my important cargo
behind! Someone drive those
things off for me!

21862.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21862.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Gakou F (Elegance) and Gasen F (Elegance) series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21862.descriptionEn:
This quest gives upgrade
materials for 5 parts of
Tenran Armor Gakou F
[Grace] / Gasen F [Grace].
To accept the quest you
need a <<Superior Ticket>>
to be used up front.
If the quest is failed,
the <<Superior Ticket>> is
consumed, so please note.

50349.objectiveJp: モンスターのフン１個の納品
50349.description: Cherry trees are only cherry trees when they bloom beautifully. To make them bloom beautifully, I need a special fertilizer. It smells a bit, well, but its effect is outstanding! I heard it is lying about in the desert. Fetch it at once!!
50349.descriptionEn:
Cherry trees must bloom
beautifully to be trees.
For that, you need my
special fertilizer. It
smells a bit off, but
the effect is superb!
I hear it lies in the
Desert. Fetch it now!!

55193.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55193.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55193.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.

51124.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
51124.description: Brawling is supreme! Long reach is unnecessary! The answer lies in hand to hand combat! Perhaps the wish to spread the charm of the Tonfa was heard, for we met just the right monster. Weapon and armor are ready, so slay it using these.
51124.descriptionEn:
Fistfights are best!
You need no long reach!
The answer lies in brawls!
That Tonfa charm of yours
must have been heard, for
a perfect monster has
shown itself to you.
Weapons and armor ready,
so slay it with these.

61726.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

22096.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22096.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

54116.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54116.description: A Daimyo Hermitaur has taken up residence in the jungle where we carry our goods. Lately even great numbers of Yao-zami have appeared. At this rate my business is ruined! Drive those lot off at once!
54116.descriptionEn:
The Jungle we use to
haul our goods has
been taken over by a
Daimyo Hermitaur.
Now swarms of Hermitaur
show up too. At this rate
my trade is finished!
Go and drive those
pests off, quick!

23448.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23448.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Merit (Beginning) x５０, Bow Merit (Middle) x６０, Bow Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23448.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Medal: Intro≫ x50
≪Bow Medal: Mid≫ x60
≪Bow Medal: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or above, so
please be careful.

55324.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55324.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

22024.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
22024.description: The black dragon that was said to be a legend seems to have shown itself at Castle Schrade! In the tale of the Black Dragon legend it is told that the black dragon will bring calamity to the world! Repel it with all your might so that the legend does not become reality!
22024.descriptionEn:
The black dragon that was thought
a legend seems to have shown
itself at ≪Schrade Castle≫! In
the tales of the Black Dragon
legend, it is said to bring
disaster to the world! Repel it
with all your might so that the
legend does not come true!

61663.description: Yo. Long time no see. Are you enjoying mining today too? I have prepared a job to show you how good mining is again. Gather three of the five kinds including Rusted Fragments. The reward is ready, so go with confidence!
61663.descriptionEn:
Yo. Long time no see.
Still enjoying your mining?
I've got a request for you,
to show off how good mining is.
Gather any 3 of 5 kinds,
rusted chunks and the like.
The reward is ready and waiting,
so off you go with confidence!

56153.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
56153.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, do not cease. Treating this as an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Elzelion that Burns and Freezes to the Extreme, whose sightings have surged. As proof of the kill, I will give you Star Sand!
56153.descriptionEn:
Sightings of monsters
bearing the Extreme name,
a great threat, won't stop.
I ask for swift slaying
of each as an emergency.
This time, sightings of
the Extreme Scorching
Frozen Eruzerion soar.
As proof, take Star Sand!

22068.description: An unexplored land has been found at White Lake. The Guild is surveying it, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22068.descriptionEn:
Uncharted land has been
found at the ≪White Lake≫.
The Guild is still surveying
it, but hunters too might
like to go and take a look
for gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

26229.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
26229.description: In the breeding season, the Hypnocatrice's coat supposedly turns a vivid blue. Now is your chance to behold it. Hurry, or someone else will beat you to it!
26229.descriptionEn:
In the ≪Breeding Season≫
the Hypnocatrice's coat
turns a vivid blue, they say.
Now is your chance to see
it. Move fast or the others
will beat you to it!

54984.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54984.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!

53027.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
53027.description: Hunt the horned wyverns that appeared in the desert, on the road to the blossom viewing site! There isn't much time before the banquet begins, so please hunt them as quickly as you can.
53027.descriptionEn:
Hunt the Diablos that have
appeared in the Desert on
the way to the
blossom viewing site! We
have little time before
the feast, so be quick.

23446.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Light Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Light Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23446.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪L Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪L Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪L Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.

23562.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
23562.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23562.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

50418.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26523.objectiveJp: カジキマグロ１０匹の納品
26523.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Hunting monsters is not all a hunter does. Fishing is a fine hunt as well. Why not aim to be an angler yourself? If you do, start by delivering 10 Marlin on your own.
26523.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. Hunting
monsters is not all a hunter does.
Fishing is a fine hunt in its own
right. Why not aim to be an angler?
If you do, start by delivering
10 Speartuna on your own.

50104.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50104.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

21683.description: Surveys have shown that the caves of Tide Island go deeper still. A considerable space appears to open up within, but a black monster has been confirmed there as well. Until safety is secured, no survey can be carried out. Head for the site at once and secure it.
21683.descriptionEn:
Surveys show the caves of the
Tidal Island go even deeper.
A rather large space seems to
open within, but the form of a
black monster has been sighted
there as well.
Until safety is secured, no
survey can proceed.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.

62138.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62138.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

26249.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

26232.description: The Tigrex boasts overwhelming strength, but any creature must have a weak point! I say its weak point is the head! Aim for the head when it turns around!
26232.descriptionEn:
≪Tigrex≫ boasts overwhelming
strength, but every one of them
must have a ≪weak point≫!
I say its weak point is the
≪head≫! Aim for the head at the
moment it turns around!

50377.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
50377.description: A very active Ice Fox Wyvern seems to have appeared at the tower. The tower is a place of high academic value, so please hunt the Ice Fox Wyvern as soon as possible before it is destroyed!
50377.descriptionEn:
A very active
<<Doragyurosu>> has shown
up at the Tower. That
Tower holds great academic
value, so before it falls,
please slay the wyvern!

21193.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21193.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

54627.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54627.description: There was a report that a blue Hypnocatrice appeared in the sea of trees. However, it is wrapped in more allure than usual, and as if luring us, it attacks while dancing, they say. Without being swayed by this Hypnocatrice's allure, please investigate its ecology and hunt it.
54627.descriptionEn:
We have reports of an azure
Hypnocatrice in the Great
Forest. It is said to be
more alluring than usual,
dancing as it attacks as if
to lure us. Do not be
swayed; survey it and hunt it.

50267.description: Won't you help with an ecological survey of Abiorugu? This time the site is the Snowy Mountains. I'd like you to head there and hunt Abiorugu. Of course you'll be paid. Break the tail as well and I'll add a bonus. Well then, I leave it to you.
50267.descriptionEn:
Care to help me with an
ecology survey of ≪Abiorg≫?
The survey site is the
Snowy Mountains this time.
I'd like you to head out
and hunt ≪Abiorg≫ there.
Reward's a given, and I'll
add a bonus for a tail
break. Alright, off you go.

40223.objectiveJp: チャチャブー３４匹の討伐
40223.description: We have information that a monster wearing the mask of a machine life form is running wild in the desert. According to the report, there are many monsters beyond the blue rock. The clue to solving the rock's mechanism is in the supply box. Use it and slay them.
40223.descriptionEn:
We have word that a monster
wearing the mask of a machine
lifeform is on a rampage in the
Desert.
According to reports, a great
many monsters await beyond the
blue rock.
The clue to solving the rock's
trap lies inside the supply box.
Use it and slay them.

11089.description: The breeding season is a precious season when monster eggs can be obtained. This time, please deliver a Carnivore Egg, which is relatively easy to carry. While carrying it, watch not only for monster attacks but also for your stamina draining!
11089.descriptionEn:
Breeding season is a precious
time when monster eggs can be
obtained. This time, please
deliver a ≪Carnivore Egg≫, which
is relatively easy to carry.
While carrying it, watch out for
monster attacks, of course, and
for your stamina draining too!

21038.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

55203.description: White and black wyverns have appeared at the summit of the Ancient Tower. These 2 are opposites by nature and could never appear in the same place. This must be called a reckless request. Yet I believe that you, with all your achievements, will find a way.
55203.descriptionEn:
White and black wyverns have
appeared at the top of the
Ancient Tower. These two are
opposites by nature, so they
could never appear in the same
place.
I must call this a reckless
request. But I believe that you,
with all your achievements,
will somehow see it through.

54935.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Great Sword Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Great Sword Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54935.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

50245.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
50245.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!

26759.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
26759.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
26759.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.

53039.description: Do you feel confident in your manliness, or in your womanliness, as a hunter? All that remains is for the two of you to face hardship together at the end and overcome it, and then it is perfect! Deliver each other's Ring of Vows to prove your bond, then work together to hunt the Abiorugu for me! I am counting on you!
53039.descriptionEn:
Now you're sure of your
grace as man and woman?
All that's left is to face
hardship as a pair and
overcome it. Perfect!
Deliver each other's
<<Oath Ring>>, prove your
bond, then hunt an
<<Abiorugu>> together!

21287.description: I found a stone while digging, but I can see no value in it! So I want you, a hunter, to gather pinky-promise grass for me. Bundled together, that grass can polish the stone. Bring me some, and I will share the leftover stones with you.
21287.descriptionEn:
I found a stone while digging,
but as it is, it has no worth!
So I want you, a hunter, to
gather some Yubikiri Grass.
Bound into a bundle, the grass
can polish the stone right up.
Bring it to me and I will
share the spare stones with you.

26662.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26662.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Yian Garuga Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26662.descriptionEn:
This Hunting Skill quest
is to slay a <<Yian
Garuga Variant>>.
Why not sharpen your
skills against each other!

21448.description: You have done well to come this far. Your mushroom path is almost complete! Bring me every Aster Rare Bag you have collected! I will present you with proof of a true mushroom maniac!
21448.descriptionEn:
You have done well to come this
far. Your mushroom path is nearly
complete! Bring every Shion Rare
Pouch you have gathered so far
to me! I shall present you with
proof of a true mushroom maniac!

60593.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Aruganosu and Goruganosu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! The tournament is under way with Supremacy, Heavenly Storm and Conquest weapons only!
60593.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Targets: <<Arganos>> and
<<Golganos>>! Clear the
goal together with your
Guild mates. Teamwork
decides this event, so
take a top place! Open
to Hardcore/Tenran/Zenith!

21137.description: A mighty flame thought to belong to an Elder Dragon has been observed in the swamp. Please investigate at once. It is too dangerous to supply items, but please come back safely somehow.
21137.descriptionEn:
A powerful flame, believed to
belong to an Elder Dragon, has
been observed in the Swamp.
Please carry out an urgent survey.
It is so dangerous that we cannot
even supply items, but please,
come back safely no matter what.

63068.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63068.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

11062.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23368.description: It has been reported that a Silver Dragon attacked on a dark, deserted night. Much about this monster remains a mystery, but its intelligence, flowing control of metal, is thought to be very high even among elder dragons. There is a risk the damage will spread. Please lend your strength to slay it.
23368.descriptionEn:
We have a report that Rukodiora
attacked on a deserted dark
night. Much about this monster
is still a mystery, but the
intellect that commands metal
like flowing water is thought to
rank among the highest of all
Elder Dragons. Damage may well
spread. Please help us slay it!

26317.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26317.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26317.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54273.description: There is a report that a large dragon was seen deep in the Canyon, in an untrodden land where the survey team rarely goes. There is also a report that just before the monster vanished, thunder rang out violently. Please determine the identity of this monster at once.
54273.descriptionEn:
Deep in the Canyon, in an
untrodden land the survey team
has rarely reached, there was a
report of a great dragon seen.
There is also a report that
thunder rang out violently just
before the monster vanished.
At once,
uncover the identity of
this monster.

62408.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
62408.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62408.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

61115.description: The Dragon Smasher I always wanted is finished! You have done a lot for me! And I am glad you strengthened it so solidly! There is prey in the Arena that suits that hammer and carries a lavish reward, so hunt it and take it!
61115.descriptionEn:
Your dream Dragon Smasher
is done! You've done a lot
for me, and even maxed
out the upgrades. I'm
glad! A foe worthy of
that hammer waits in the
Arena with rich rewards, so
hunt it or just take them!

58029.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58029.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58029.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

60588.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Khezu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60588.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Target: <<Khezu>>!
That spirit to hunt a
monster all alone is
truly splendid! Beat
yourself and take a top
place! This time Origin
weapons only, choose well!

50284.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の撃退
50284.description: It is I, the Instructor! By the good graces of the Hunters Guild, you have been permitted to board the large survey ship! What beautiful scenery you will behold! Clearing the way when monsters attack the survey ship is, of course, a hunter's work! You will fight too!
50284.descriptionEn:
It's me! Instructor!
By grace of the Hunters
Guild, you are permitted
aboard the great airship!
What beautiful sights you
shall see!
When monsters attack the
ship, clearing them is
of course a hunter's job!
So you'll fight too!

60083.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

58048.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58048.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58048.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

12072.description: A blue subspecies of Rathalos has been confirmed in the Forest and Hills. Whoever overcomes its peerless vitality will hold power beyond that of a dragon. I should like to see which hunter harbors such ability.
12072.descriptionEn:
An Azure ≪Rathalos≫ has
been sighted in the
≪Forest and Hills≫, it
seems. Whoever bests its
unmatched vitality gains
power beyond a dragon. I
would love to see who.

62709.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
62709.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62709.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

21891.description: A quest for the HR400 breakthrough trial. Accept the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, then depart on the quest alone.
21891.descriptionEn:
A quest for the HR400
breakthrough trial. Accept
the trial from the Guild
Master or the HR Trial
board, then depart on the
quest alone.

54561.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54561.description: An Azure Rathalos has appeared at the Ancient Tower. It breathes a flame never seen before and is causing damage all around. To keep the damage from spreading further, we ask for your help in hunting it.
54561.descriptionEn:
An Azure Rathalos has appeared
at the Ancient Tower. It spits
a breath never seen before and
is bringing harm to the area.
To keep the damage from
spreading further, we ask for
your help in hunting it.

55255.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
55255.description: Uragaan has been found in the volcano! This is the first sighting in the region. Reports also speak of unusual movement. Skilled hunters, we ask for an ecological survey of the target.
55255.descriptionEn:
The Burst Hammer Wyvern,
Uragaan, has been found in the
Volcano! This is the first such
discovery in this region.
Reports also say it moves in
peculiar ways.
Skilled hunters, please carry
out an ecological survey of it.

21993.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
21993.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one White Espinas, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21993.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner well,
nya? Treat your partner right
once in a while, nya!
Now, to business, nya. This
request is to hunt 1 Espinas
Rare Species, nya. The reward
is materials to craft Felyne
gear, nya! I'm counting on you!

22152.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
22152.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!

50303.description: Controlling a monster exactly as you wish is impossible, but controlling one to some degree is possible, yes! What matters then is a sense of distance! To take it easy by making use of the monster's movements, shall we try a no touch approach?
50303.descriptionEn:
Making a monster do exactly what
you want is impossible, but
controlling it to some extent
is quite possible!
What matters there is distance!
To ride a monster's movements
and take it easy, why not go
all in? Shall we no-touch?

23597.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
23597.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.

26580.description: Congrats on reaching HR300! Deliver a Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26580.descriptionEn:
Congrats on reaching
HR300! Deliver a <<Map>>
on your own, clear the
quest, and claim your
reward!

26417.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26417.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!

55235.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55235.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.

50984.description: For hunters at HR5, a request to craft the top pick Ascension gear, Gore Series. Breaking Gore Magala's antennae and tail is required, but mats abound.
50984.descriptionEn:
For hunters at HR5, a
request to craft the
top pick Ascension
gear, Gore Series.
Breaking Gore Magala's
antennae and tail is
required, but mats abound.

54691.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
54691.description: As a G Rank Guild Priority request, we prepared this quest to raise awareness and interest. Cutting the Espinas Rare Species' tail also grants you a special food item.
54691.descriptionEn:
As a G Rank Guild Priority
request, we prepared this
quest to raise awareness
and interest.
Cutting the White Espinas
tail also grants you a
special food item.

61544.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
61544.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61544.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

55145.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55145.description: A powerful individual Rukodiora has attacked! Every day lately. The Guild is quite worn out, and the situation cannot wait. Only for skilled hunters to whom I have given the Rusted Metal Fittings, please lend us your strength!
55145.descriptionEn:
A powerful Rukodiora has
attacked! Lately it comes
every day. The Guild is
exhausted, and every
moment counts.
Only for skilled hunters I
gave a Rusted Fitting to:
please lend us your
strength!

1056.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
1056.description: If you are going to hunt in the Snowy Mountains, first do not forget your Hot Drink! It might be surer to hunt Popo and get used to the mountain environment to some degree, and then hunt a Bulldrome!
1056.descriptionEn:
If you hunt in the Snowy
Mountains, don't forget
your <<Hot Drink>> first!
Slay some <<Popo>> to get
used to the cold, then
hunt a <<Bulldrome>>.
That's the safer route!

55134.description: Information has come in that a Kirin was sighted in the decisive battlefield. According to the report from the hunter who saw it, it unleashed attacks never seen before. Since there is a high chance it is a more powerful individual than before, we are issuing an investigation request to veteran hunters.
55134.descriptionEn:
Word has come in that a Kirin
was sighted at the Battlefield.
According to the hunter who
saw it, it unleashed attacks
never seen before. As it is
likely a stronger individual
than any so far, we are issuing
this survey request to veteran
hunters.

55540.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55540.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55540.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

50961.description: A request for hunters who have crafted Zerureusu Gou weapons. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Tenran weapons.
50961.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have forged
the ≪Peerless Weapon≫ of
the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
materials to upgrade the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ weapon.

21104.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21104.description: Iodrome hits harder in a single blow than Velocidrome or Gendrome. If you feel your life is in danger, deliver Specialty Mushrooms growing in the swamp. Aging them in a Maka Pickling Jar is fine too, you know?
21104.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ hits harder per
blow than a Velocidrome or
Gendrome.
If your life feels at risk,
deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫
growing in the swamp. You
may age them in a ≪Maka Pot≫?

60908.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
60908.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60908.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

62862.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62862.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!

55797.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55797.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55797.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

63103.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
63103.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63103.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

54920.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
54920.description: Aiming for GR500? Slay a Toridcless to raise your rating and cheaply obtain popular G Rank decorations. We have prepared just the quest for you. Please enjoy!
54920.descriptionEn:
Aiming for GR500?
Slay a Toridcless to raise
your rating and cheaply
obtain popular G Rank
decorations. We have
prepared just the quest
for you. Please enjoy!

21408.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
21408.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
21408.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

61456.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
61456.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
61456.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

26336.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26336.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26336.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

60655.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60655.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Target: <<Espinas>>!
Clear the goal together
with your Guild mates.
Teamwork decides this
event, so take a top
place!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only!

50002.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
50002.description: The legendary black dragon, Fatalis, seems to be doing something sinister in the deepest reaches of the untrodden volcano! At this rate calamity may rain down on the world! Hurry to the volcano and repel the enraged Fatalis!
50002.descriptionEn:
The legendary Black Dragon, Fatalis,
appears to be up to something
sinister in the deepest reaches of
an untouched volcano!! If this
continues, calamity may rain down
upon the world! Hurry to the
Volcano and repel the angry Black Dragon!

21898.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Khezu in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21898.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting
life, we prepared a quest
to hunt a <<Khezu>> in the
New Great Arena.
Clear it and earn higher
rating than usual. Train
efficiently and aim for
even greater heights.

55354.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55354.description: An Anomalous Species Daimyo Hermitaur with greatly developed claws has appeared. Many hunters have abandoned the hunt in the face of its ferocious attacks. The guild will expand the supply items and, when 4 hunters set out together, provide further support. Head out with care.
55354.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Daimyo
Hermitaur with huge claws
has appeared. Its fierce
attacks make many hunters
give up the hunt.
The Guild expands supplies
and gives more support only
when four depart together.
Please head out to survey
with care.

23215.description: The other day I found a Rathian in the swamp. I hid and watched, but something about it seemed different from the Rathian I know. There may be a new discovery in it. If you are interested, go and see.
23215.descriptionEn:
The other day in Swamp
I found a Rathian.
I hid and watched it so
it wouldn't spot me,
but it seemed different
from the Rathian I know.
Maybe there's a new
discovery to be made.
If you're curious, go
take a look.

40086.description: Congrats on reaching HR600! Deliver a Map on your own, then after clearing, visit the Special Event House to receive a bonus. Please make the most of it!
40086.descriptionEn:
Congrats on reaching
HR600! Deliver a <<Map>>
on your own, then after
clearing, visit the
Special Event House to
receive a bonus. Please
make the most of it!

55980.description: A decoration has been completed to protect you from a monster's fierce attacks. With this new decoration you will find it enormously effective against Aberrant species that use thunder. We will hand it out as a reward for this quest, so do join us!
55980.descriptionEn:
A decoration to protect
you from fierce monster
attacks is done.
With this new gem you'll
see great effect against
Thunder-using Supremacy
foes! I'll hand it over as
this quest's reward, so
please join in!

60222.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
60222.description: A powerful Cephadrome has appeared. The Guild will pay a large reward to the hunter who slays it! In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware!
60222.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Cephadrome≫
has appeared.
The Guild will pay a large
sum to the hunter who slays
it! Other rewards, however,
are modest, so do be
careful!

62685.description: It is I! The Instructor! An unsettling shadow seems to have been sighted in the Jungle. I expect I will be asking for your help later, but before that, how about gathering ingredients? There is no victory without food! I am counting on you, hunters!
62685.descriptionEn:
It's me! Instructor!
An uneasy shadow was seen
in the Jungle. I'll ask
for your help soon, but
first, how about food?
No food, no victory!
I'm counting on you all!

62420.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Rathalos. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62420.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
≪Rathalos≫ slay.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
polish your skills against other
hunters!

55520.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55520.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

54110.description: Please help investigate Blangonga. I want to study various things, so be sure to destroy the head and cut the tail. Hunting alone will not advance the survey, so be sure to meet the conditions. It will be hard, but thanks.
54110.descriptionEn:
I need your help to study
the Blangonga, dear.
I want lots of data, so be
sure to break its head and
cut its tail. Just
hunting won't advance the
survey, so meet those
conditions. I know it's
tough. Thanks!

62621.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

58066.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58066.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58066.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

26362.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
26362.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26362.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

50312.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Baruragaru. Any hunter who succeeds in the hunt will receive more proof of slaying than usual!
50312.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We seek
someone to slay a most
powerful <<Baruragaru>>.
That's the job.
Those who hunt it well
shall receive more Slay
Proofs than usual!

60910.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60910.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

20.description: It is I, the Instructor! Without delay, I will instruct you on the Tonfa! To get used to the Tonfa quickly, I want you to accept this at least once. A Prototype Tonfa will be lent to you!
20.descriptionEn:
It's me. Instructor!
Right away, I'll teach you
the <<Tonfa>>!
To get used to the <<Tonfa>>
quickly, I want you to
accept this once.
A <<Prototype Tonfa>>
will be lent to you!

26076.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26076.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

61702.description: Hunters who set out with gunlances today as well. Listen to me a moment. Soon the Hunters Guild will loose a Basarios in the arena. And the entry condition is gunlance only. There is no way I could miss that!
61702.descriptionEn:
Hunters heading out with a
Gunlance again today, listen
to me. Soon the Hunters
Guild will release a
≪Basarios≫ in the Arena. And
the condition is Gunlance
only! There's no way I could
miss that!

55967.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
55967.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55967.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.

55922.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55922.description: Can we overcome the white wind that blows sharp and wild? The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Galloping Nargacuga. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55922.descriptionEn:
Can we overcome the white wind
that blows so fiercely?
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Dashing Nargacuga'.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

60566.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Gypceros and Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. This contest is decided by teamwork with your fellow guild hunters, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60566.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Targets: <<Gypceros>> and
<<Breeding Hypnocatrice>>!
Teamwork with your Guild
mates decides this event,
so take a top place!
This time Origin weapons
only, so choose with care!

55955.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55955.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

12020.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
12020.description: The boss of the Genprey packs in the desert, Dos-Genprey, is marked by a body a size larger and by sharp claws. If hunting Dos-Genprey feels difficult, put a Cactus Flower in a Maka Pickling Jar and deliver a Hundred-Flower Cactus.
12020.descriptionEn:
The Ioprey that swarm the Desert
are led by the ≪Iodrome≫, marked
by its larger body and sharp claws.
If hunting the Iodrome seems
hard, put a ≪Cactus Flower≫ into
a ≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ and
deliver a ≪Hundred-Flower Cactus≫.

56126.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
56126.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Guanzorumu that Rules to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin, needed to accept the next request!
56126.descriptionEn:
Sightings keep pouring in
of monsters bearing the
Extreme name, a great
threat. Deeming it an
emergency, I ask swift
slaying of each. This time:
the Extreme Ruling
Guanzorumu. As proof, take
the coin for the next quest!

62369.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
62369.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62369.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

56157.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56157.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.

61147.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50748.description: To express our gratitude to everyone who has been enjoying MHF-G, we have prepared a place for exchange. We hope you will take this opportunity to visit. We await you all.
50748.descriptionEn:
To express our thanks to all
of you who enjoy MHF-G every
day, we have prepared a place
to gather and mingle. We hope
you will take this chance to
come and join us.
We look forward to seeing
you all there.

23686.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23686.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!

50238.description: My first request, so I am nervous. There is a musician I simply must tell music lovers about. They are so cool, truly. But I am too shy, so I would be glad if you would film them for me instead. I will cheer from the shadows! Once you meet them, spread the word to everyone!
50238.descriptionEn:
This is my first request, so I'm
nervous. There's a musician I
really want music lovers to hear.
He's cool, seriously.
But I'm too shy, so I'd be glad
if you could take photos instead.
I'll be cheering from the shadows!
If you meet him, tell everyone!

53138.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

11013.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
11013.description: Rathian is said to have a subspecies! The queen clad in sakura pink is a troublesome queen with a fiercer temper than the original! Whether to slay or capture, it's important to judge the monster's state and your own situation!
11013.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ apparently has a
Subspecies, you know! This
queen wrapped in cherry
pink is a real handful,
wilder than the original!
Slay or capture, it's key
to judge both sides well!

60014.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Put an end to the feud between Conga and Daimyo Hermitaur with a plague on both their houses! The main target is the slaying of 4 Congas, but settle the quarrel and lavish rewards will follow for certain!?
60014.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters
show their skill! End the
feud between Conga and
Daimyo Hermitaur with a
double verdict! Main goal:
slay 4 Conga, but settle
the feud for great rewards!?

54943.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Light Bowgun Ribbon (Middle) x165, Light Bowgun Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54943.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept it you need a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.

54527.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
54527.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54527.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

60059.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

60045.description: The solitary one-horned wyvern Monoblos may be called the king that pairs with Diablos in the Desert. To hunt it with 1 hunter is held to be proof of a first-rate hunter. There is nothing for it but to try.
60045.descriptionEn:
The solitary one-horned
dragon ≪Monoblos≫ could well
be called the king that pairs
with Diablos in the Desert.
To ≪hunt it alone≫ is said
to prove a Hunter is first-rate.
All that remains is to try.

26010.description: Patients wounded and suffering from illness need nourishing food. But the reality is that such food reaches only the mouths of a few wealthy people. At least I want to give the patients in the square proper care. Hunters, I am counting on you.
26010.descriptionEn:
Patients wounded and suffering
from illness need nourishing
food. Yet the truth is that such
food reaches only the mouths of
a few wealthy folk.
At least for the patients in the
plaza, I want to give proper
care. Hunters, I leave it to you.

63325.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
63325.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63325.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

26496.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hard Tail! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26496.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who break many parts
on Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying
Wyvern's Hard Tail! When
accepting or joining, deliver
the guarantee slip, then hunt
the specified monster. The slip
is not returned once you depart.

21882.description: For hunters at HR100: a request to craft and upgrade the Odiba Series, a set of Hardcore Armor. Repel an Odibatorasu to obtain the crafting and upgrade mats for one part of the Odiba Series.
21882.descriptionEn:
For hunters at HR100:
a request to craft and
upgrade the Odiba Series,
a set of <<Hardcore
Armor>>. Repel an
Odibatorasu to obtain the
crafting and upgrade mats
for one part of the Odiba
Series.

50851.description: Your mushroom deliveries, hunters, were truly splendid! As a reward I have prepared a quest that earns you plenty of ＳＲＰ! Take it on and aim for a good rank up!
50851.descriptionEn:
Your mushroom delivery was
truly splendid, hunters!
As reward, I prepared a
quest that gives plenty
of SRP! Take this chance
to accept it and rank up
in a big way!

21814.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. If a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back! You might even pick up their pouch instead, you know?
21814.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, is called
the Phantom Beast for the way it
commands lightning at will.
If a Melynx steals an item, do
not panic, just take it back!
On the contrary, you might even
pick up its pouch, you know?

50184.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50184.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. Complete it and we will present you with a variety of materials. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50184.descriptionEn:
This request is only for those
belonging to a winning Hunter
Festival guild.
Clear the request and we will
present you with a variety of
materials. Please bring your
Festival Proof when accepting
or joining.

62517.description: I wanted to see the Canyon's fine views once, and when I set foot there I ran into vicious monsters. In your terms, I suppose they were a Yian Garuga and a Rajang. I could not face them alone, so I could go no further and had to turn back. Please get rid of them.
62517.descriptionEn:
I longed to see the Canyon's
grand view just once, but the
moment I stepped in I met with
vicious monsters. In your terms,
they would be the Yian Garuga
and the Rajang, I believe. I
could not fight them alone, so
I could go no further and came
back. Please, drive them off!

50196.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50196.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50196.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

56090.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
56090.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Fury-Faced Wyvern. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56090.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Rage-Faced Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will specially
add developed part materials to
your Another rewards. Note that
slaying alone grants no such
materials, so take care.

60017.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

54621.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54621.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54621.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will gain even more reward than
what your daily efforts bring.

50242.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50242.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time an Odibatorasu has been sighted in the Desert. It is an extremely powerful monster, but right now the hunters of skill are all deployed elsewhere. So I want to ask you to drive it off! As this is a difficult request again, it cannot be helped if you fail! I leave it to you!
50242.descriptionEn:
It's me! Instructor!
This time an Odibatorasu
was seen in the Desert. A
very powerful monster, but
our top hunters are all
away. So I want you to
repel it!
It's a hard request again,
so failing is forgivable!
I leave it to you!

21267.description: We have a report that a giant Plesioth was sighted in the desert. It is a fine catch, so reel it in once and then slay it. The reward will be generous. And if you slay it without fishing? You are out!
21267.descriptionEn:
A giant Plesioth was sighted in
the Desert, per the report.
It is a big catch, so reel it in
once first, then slay it.
The reward will be generous.
What if you slay it without fishing?
You retire!

54401.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
54401.description: We are surveying the Cephadrome, which lurks in the sand and swims at its ease, kicking up sand as it goes. Its ecology remains largely unknown. Please hunt it and lend your strength to our research!
54401.descriptionEn:
We survey the <<Cephadrome>>
that swims through Desert
sand, kicking it up.
Its ecology is unknown.
Please hunt it and lend
your strength to our study!

62039.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
62039.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62039.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!

54658.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54658.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

26438.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Put an end to the feud between Yao-zami and Blangonga with a plague on both their houses! The main target is the slaying of 20 Yao-zami, but settle the quarrel and lavish rewards will follow for certain!?
26438.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
off their skill! Put an end to
the feud between the Yaozami
and the Blangonga, punishing both!
The main target is to slay 20
Yaozami, but succeed in the
double punishment and a lavish
reward is yours for sure!?

15017.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

55668.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55668.descriptionEn:
You who would master
the Bow, show your skill
against the <<Baruragaru>>
in the New Great Arena!
Let us see it!
Hunt it well and you
shall earn rewards far
beyond what daily
effort brings.

11091.objectiveJp: 大食いマグロ４匹の納品
11091.description: The fish that live in the hunting grounds are essential materials for mixing bullets! So that you can respond calmly when the moment comes, train your sense for fishing until your body remembers it! The moment to reel in is when the float sinks deep!
11091.descriptionEn:
Fish living in the hunting grounds
are vital ingredients for
≪Bullet Combining≫!
Let's train your body to feel the
rhythm of fishing, so you can
react calmly when the moment comes!
When the float sinks deep, that's
your moment to reel it in!

63284.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63284.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63284.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

50449.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26197.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26197.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

60564.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Zenaserisu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60564.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Target: <<Zenaserisu>>!
Clear the goal together
with your Guild mates.
Teamwork decides this
event, so take a top
place!
This time Origin weapons
only, so choose with care!

21610.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Yellow Ochre Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21610.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Ochre Orb?
Its material is vital
for crafting a certain
costly gem.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
gem materials.

51070.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
51070.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Female Roaring Wolf will also grant a special ingredient.
51070.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the female Orugaron's
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

60577.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
60577.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Harudomerugu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60577.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Target: <<Dahren Mohran>>!
That spirit to hunt a
monster all alone is
truly splendid! Beat
yourself and take a top
place! This time Origin
weapons only, choose well!

50862.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50862.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50862.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice
Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.

26531.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26531.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26531.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

55427.description: A Blast Wolf with greatly developed legs has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Blast Wolf seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55427.descriptionEn:
A ≪Midogaron≫ whose legs have
grown greatly has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy with
developed parts and will survey
it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any Midogaron
before. Please survey it with
care.

21711.description: Do you know the orb called the Shinonome Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21711.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Dawn Orb?
Its material is vital
for crafting a certain
costly gem.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
gem materials.

60623.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60623.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60623.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

60615.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60615.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60615.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

55049.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Merit (Beginning) x５０, Sword and Shield Merit (Middle) x６０, Sword and Shield Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55049.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Sword and Shield Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Sword and Shield Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Sword and Shield Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must
be GR500 or above, so please
be aware of that.

21088.objectiveJp: なわばりのフン２個の納品

55845.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55845.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a dorsal fin break and a wing break in slaying Diorekkusu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55845.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Anorupatisu≫ and break its
dorsal fin and wings, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

54457.description: We ask you to investigate the Silver Rathalos lurking in the Tower. Not only hunt it: if you break its head and sever its tail, I will add to your reward!
54457.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Silver
Rathalos at the Tower.
Not only the hunt,
break its head and cut
its tail, and I'll add
extra reward on top
for you!

28033.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
28033.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Hyujikiki materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28033.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters,
won't you pass your hunt
skills on to the young
hunters of the Guild?
This time, <<Doragyurosu>>
materials, a big splurge!
Grow strong together and
liven up the Guild. Clear
it with mixed Secret Art
holders for extra Guild rep!

54771.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54771.description: It's me! You all have the look of veteran hunters now! But! Only by mastering a range of weapons does one become a true veteran! This time I want you to face the White Monoblos with a cutting weapon. Remember the days we trained together!
54771.descriptionEn:
It's me! You all have
the face of veteran
hunters now!
But!
Only by mastering many
weapons are you a true
veteran! This time, take
on the White Monoblos
with a cutting weapon.
Remember our training days!

55395.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55395.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55395.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.

61949.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been found! This may be a good chance to gather materials! Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! We have limited the number of participants, so you should be able to depart at once!
61949.descriptionEn:
A comparatively weak individual
monster has been discovered!
This may be a good chance to
gather materials! Before it
flees far away, please hurry
and get ready! We have limited
the number of participants, so
you should be able to depart at once!

54331.description: A quest for the New Weapon Type 'Tonfa' Trial Event. Enjoy MHF-GG a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 20 minutes.
54331.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the ≪new
