weapon trial: Tonfa≫.
Get an early taste of
MHF-GG ahead of release!
Time limit: 20 minutes.

62243.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の討伐
62243.description: What, you just want a hard Hammer? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62243.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Hammer
that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!

21969.description: This quest gives production materials for the Great Sword whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
21969.descriptionEn:
This is a quest to obtain the
crafting materials of a Great
Sword whose performance was
settled by a survey held to
commemorate 700,000 Zinogre
hunted in the Zinogre hunting
unlock event "Transcendent
Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre".

55585.description: I hear a Midogaron sometimes appears in the volcano, but it is so fast I have never seen one. For my sake, who has never once laid eyes on it, won't you hunt it and show me the materials? As thanks I will give you armor material that can charm the opposite sex.
55585.descriptionEn:
Sometimes a Midogaron appears
in the Volcano, but it is so
fast I have never seen one.
For my sake, who has never
seen it, hunt one and show me
its materials. In return I
will give you armor materials
that charm the opposite sex.

21588.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
21588.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Sparrow Dance Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21588.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Sparrow Dance Orb?
Its material is vital
for crafting a certain
costly gem.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
gem materials.

26608.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
26608.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Lutetia Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26608.descriptionEn:
Notes said to have been lost,
recording the secret of weapon
crafting, are apparently being
found on monsters slain across
the land, I tell ya!
If you get a ≪Lutetia Memo≫,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work, I
will!

60422.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
60422.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60422.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

21634.description: Have you heard of the Dark Violet Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21634.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Deep Purple Orb?
Its material is vital
for crafting a certain
costly gem.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
gem materials.

63046.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
63046.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63046.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

56155.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
56155.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56155.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.

56135.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の討伐
56135.description: Fever!! Have you been dancing lately? There is a world you can only see by dancing, you know? I will lend you a full set of armor, so try dancing in this! Ah, not just dancing, I am asking you to slay monsters too! Fever!!
56135.descriptionEn:
FEVER!!
Been dancing lately?
There's a world you can
only see by dancing!
I'll lend you a full set,
so dance in this for me!
Oh, not just dancing,
slay the monster too!
FEVER!!

55849.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55849.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Baruragaru≫ has grown
fiercely strong and continues to
rampage.
As things stand it is highly dangerous.
Please make full preparations before
you begin the survey.

23187.description: I've run out of salt, and I can't do without it for cooking! I'd like to go to the canyon to gather rock salt, but the Great Thunderbugs are in the way and I can't get there. Could you drive them off for me? And if you gather some rock salt while you're at it, I'd have my ingredient secured too, which would be a great help.
23187.descriptionEn:
I'm out of the salt
that cooking needs!
I'd go gather Rock Salt
in the Canyon, but Great
Thunderbugs block the way.
Could you drive them off?
And if you bring Rock Salt
too, I'd have my stock
and be saved. Thanks!

50595.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50595.description: Honestly! I really hate Gravios! Hunter, you understand, right? Teach that Gravios a lesson! Make me feel better and I will pay more! I am counting on you, hunter!
50595.descriptionEn:
Ugh! Really!
I hate Gravios so much!
Hunter, you understand, right?
We are going to punish that Gravios!
If you can make me feel better
about all this,
I will pay out a bigger reward!
I am counting on you, hunter!

50664.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50664.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Odiba series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50664.descriptionEn:
This quest gives <<Hardcore
Armor>> Odiba Series mats
for one part's crafting
and upgrade.
To accept the quest you
need a <<Superior Ticket>>
to be used up front.
If the quest is failed,
the <<Superior Ticket>> is
consumed, so please note.

62181.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
62181.description: A special job from the Guild to train hunters! Guild support is generous, and those who complete the quest are paid richly! Those with ambition should use this chance to rise!
62181.descriptionEn:
A special request from the Guild,
aimed at training up hunters!
The Guild's support is generous,
and those who complete the quest
are paid a handsome reward!
Let those with ambition take this
chance and rise higher!

21848.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21848.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

62718.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

63298.description: A client who was once a hunter asks that you hunt large monsters, so that the trek into the Deep Forest stays safe. There is no telling what monsters you will find until you get there, so please be very careful.
63298.descriptionEn:
Our client, a former hunter,
wants the Great Forest safe,
so please hunt the large
monsters there.
Until you reach the site
you won't know what
monsters wait,
so please take great care.

60658.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
60658.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Doragyurosu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60658.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's target is a
Zenith ≪Doragyurosu≫!
To hunt a monster all alone
shows true spirit, truly
admirable! Best yourself
and take a top placing!
Supremacy weapons only
this time!

55730.description: According to the survey team's report, the secret art of the Shakalaka appears to be a technique for gathering various poisons and forming a lump of deadly venom, meow. If it works, we should be able to strengthen even further that Switch Axe shaped after a beastman we obtained before, meow. At once, take that Switch Axe and hunt the poison monsters of the swamp, meow!
55730.descriptionEn:
The survey team says the
masked tribe's secret art
gathers many poisons into
a deadly venom mass, meow.
If it works, that beastman-
styled Switch Axe you got
before can be upgraded
even further, meow. Now go
slay Swamp poison monsters!

21726.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Soul (Beginning) x85, Light Bowgun Soul (Middle) x195, Light Bowgun Soul (Extreme) x275, Light Bowgun Soul (Heaven) x85. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21726.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪L Bowgun Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪L Bowgun Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪L Bowgun Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪L Bowgun Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.

26159.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26159.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

55050.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55050.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Merit (Beginning) x５０, Dual Blades Merit (Middle) x６０, Dual Blades Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55050.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪Dual Blades Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Dual Blades Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Dual Blades Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.

61003.description: An unprecedented great lightning strike has been witnessed at the Ancient Tower. This is a survey request for hunters of skill only. It is too dangerous, so item supply is impossible. Conduct the survey with the utmost care.
61003.descriptionEn:
A lightning strike of unprecedented
scale was witnessed at the Ancient
Tower.
This survey request is for skilled
hunters only. It is far too
dangerous, so no items can be
supplied. Please conduct the
survey with the utmost caution.

23386.description: A surveyor who went to White Lake reported sighting a White Monoblos, a beast with a single great horn and a silver-white body. Alongside that shining form, a ferocious nature was reported as well. Prepare fully before you investigate.
23386.descriptionEn:
A surveyor who went to White
Lake reports sighting a ≪White
Monoblos≫, a beast with a huge
single horn and a silver body.
Together with that shining hide,
its savage nature has also been
reported. Please prepare well
before you set out to survey it.

55499.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55499.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

26481.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26481.description: If you are going to hunt in the Snowy Mountains, please do not forget to bring a Hot Drink! It might be surer to hunt Popo and get used to the mountain environment to some degree, and then hunt a Bulldrome!
26481.descriptionEn:
When you head out to hunt in
the Snowy Mountains, don't
forget to bring ≪Hot Drinks≫!
Slaying ≪Popo≫ to get used to
the Snowy Mountains a bit
first, then hunting ≪Bulldrome≫
might be the safer bet!

55059.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Light Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Light Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55059.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪L Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪L Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪L Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.

61309.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61309.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

53042.description: To look absolutely cute, I want a stylish weapon too... But it seems the weapon materials were stolen by Felynes! Listen, the one holding the materials is a Felyne! For the sake of your cute and devoted partner, now, go! Hunters!
53042.descriptionEn:
To pull off the cutest
look, a stylish weapon
would be nice too...
But the weapon materials
seem stolen by Felynes!
Listen, the ones holding
the materials are Felynes!
For your cute, plucky pal,
go now, hunters!

62762.description: A mighty flame thought to belong to an Elder Dragon has been observed in the swamp. Please investigate at once. It is too dangerous to supply items, but please come back safely somehow.
62762.descriptionEn:
A powerful flame, believed to
belong to an Elder Dragon, has
been observed in the Swamp.
Please carry out an urgent survey.
It is so dangerous that we cannot
even supply items, but please,
come back safely no matter what.

62520.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐

50020.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
50020.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
50020.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

40216.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the shell crab Daimyo Hermitaur! Clear the quest and your standing will rise sharply!
40216.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the Shield Crab
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫!
Clear the quest safely and
your standing will shoot
right up!

54854.description: This request lets hunters who reached G Rank obtain the recommended jewel G Rank Rage Jewel. Hunt a Hypnocatrice and you can obtain the G Rank Rage Jewel, a jewel with the skills Might Strike, Protection of the Three Realms and Wrath. Please make good use of it.
54854.descriptionEn:
This request lets hunters who
reached G Rank obtain the
recommended jewel ≪G Rank
Rage Jewel≫. Hunt a Hypnocatrice
and you can obtain the ≪G Rank
Rage Jewel≫, a jewel with the
skills Might Strike, Protection
of the Three Realms and Wrath.
Please make good use of it.

50004.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐

60707.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60707.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

61874.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61874.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
61874.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

26324.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26324.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26324.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54090.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Pokaradon of the Polar Sea. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
54090.descriptionEn:
The time to show your
skill has come, hunters!
Hunt the ≪Frozen Sea Beast≫
of the Polar Sea. Clear it
in style and your name
as a hunter will rise
straight up!

61135.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の討伐
61135.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
61135.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.

4.description: It is I, the Instructor! Combining has something called a success rate. Even if it fails, do not give up, repeat it! The combination recipes are listed under Combination, then the Combination List, in the menu opened with {K010}!
4.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Combining has a success
rate, you know. Even if it
fails, retry without giving
up! In the menu opened with
{K010}, under Combine
then Combine List, recipes!

55065.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55065.description: It seems you could not fully upgrade the Teostra gear. I have prepared a fine quest for a hunter like you. The number you can accept per day is limited, but it should help. I wish you success.
55065.descriptionEn:
Seems you couldn't fully
upgrade the ≪Teostra≫ gear.
So I prepared a lovely
quest just for you.
There's a daily limit on
accepts, but it should
help. I wish you luck.

23396.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
23396.description: A Lavasioth has been found in the depths of the volcano. The report, however, describes not an ordinary Lavasioth but one whose whole body glows red as if clad in crimson ore. We very much want a survey of this Crimson Lavasioth. Materials gathered during the survey are yours.
23396.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a ≪Volganos≫
found deep in the Volcano.
But the report describes not a
mere ≪Volganos≫ but one whose
whole body is crimson, as if
clad in Red Lotus stones.
Please survey this ≪Lavasioth≫
for us. Materials found during
the survey are yours to keep.

54472.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
54472.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54472.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

22067.description: An unexplored land has been found on Tide Island. The Guild is surveying it, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22067.descriptionEn:
Uncharted land has been
found on the ≪Tidal Island≫.
The Guild is still surveying
it, but hunters too might
like to go and take a look
for gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

23376.objectiveJp: イーモンサーモン５０匹の納品
23376.description: A delicious fish living in the freezing sea, the Eemon Salmon. I heard a rumor that a mysterious creature called Smith, which loves that Eemon Salmon, has appeared. To investigate Smith, we need Eemon Salmon in great quantity! Help with the investigation!
23376.descriptionEn:
A delicious fish that lives in
the freezing sea: the "Eemon
Salmon." I heard a rumor that
"Smith," a mysterious creature
fond of that very fish, has
appeared. To survey "Smith" we
need Eemon Salmon in great
quantity! Please help with the
survey!

55783.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Request, to raise awareness and interest we have prepared this quest. Breaking Rukodiora's horn will also grant you special ingredients.
55783.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Request, to raise
awareness and interest we
have prepared this quest.
Breaking Guanzorumu's
horn will also grant you
special ingredients.

61504.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61504.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

28087.description: This quest gives production and upgrade materials for the Tonfa, Great Sword and Dual Blades whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
28087.descriptionEn:
In the Zinogre hunting release
event "Transcendence Invasion!
Hunt the Zinogre", a survey was
held to mark 700,000 Zinogre
slain, and it decided the
performance of the Tonfa, Great
Sword and Dual Blades. This
quest lets you obtain their
crafting and upgrade materials.

61323.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
61323.description: Lao-Shan Lung is advancing on the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma, with unprecedented force! Please repel Lao-Shan Lung using the fortress interception equipment! If your strength is insufficient, deliver Dragon Drug Stones taken from Lao-Shan Lung's back.
61323.descriptionEn:
At the ≪Fortress≫ that serves
as the gateway to Dundorma,
Lao-Shan Lung is advancing
with unprecedented force!
Please repel it using the
fortress's interception gear!
If our strength falls short,
deliver the ≪Dragonstone≫
from its back.

54618.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54618.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54618.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show me the skill you
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you.

55791.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐

61876.description: It is a chore, but a request has come in through guild channels. As the reward, we have prepared a Vitality Drink, guild-approved, that restores stamina smartly with little delay, anytime and anywhere! If you have the time, please.
61876.descriptionEn:
It is a chore, but a quest
request has come from Guild
connections. The reward is
≪Energy Drink≫, the Guild-
approved bottle that restores
stamina in a flash, anytime,
anywhere. Come if you are free!

23224.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
23224.description: The range of the Blangonga that claims regions not yet properly surveyed appears to be spreading close to the places where people live. Left alone, it could cause great damage. Before that happens, drive the Blangonga away.
23224.descriptionEn:
The Blangonga that claims
areas not yet fully surveyed
seems to be expanding its
territory close to where
people live. Left alone,
there could be serious
damage. Before that
happens, drive the
Blangonga away.

53195.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲
53195.description: I love birds! Especially Yian Kut-Ku! So catch one for me! Do not hurt it! Slaying is out of the question! Understand, slaying is absolutely forbidden!
53195.descriptionEn:
I love birds!
Yian Kut-Ku most of all!
So go capture one for me!
Don't hurt it, got it!
Slaying is out of the question!
Listen, slaying is absolutely
N O T  A L L O W E D!

60061.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

22108.description: Prism Falls by day in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
22108.descriptionEn:
The ≪Rainbow Waterfall≫ in the
temperate season, by day. The
Guild is still surveying this
unexplored land, but why don't
you go and take a look for
gathering and survey?
If you want to come home,
just deliver a map!

62887.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62887.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

60051.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

51024.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
51024.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
51024.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards. When accepting or
joining, please be sure to have
your Festival Proof with you.

1075.description: Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is an Elder Dragon said to be the incarnation of fire. In the volcano, every flame and every trace of heat is as good as fighting on her side. Do not waste thought on impossible things like capture; repel her again and again to wear down her strength, and slay her after a long battle.
1075.descriptionEn:
Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is
an Elder Dragon said to be the
very embodiment of flame.
In the Volcano, every flame and
heat may as well side with her.
Forget capture: repel her again
and again, then slay her after a long fight.

60417.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60417.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

21391.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

21977.description: A Supremacy Odibatorasu has appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monster. Act with your own safety first.
21977.descriptionEn:
Zenith Odibatorasu has
appeared. This request aims to
prevent the damage from
spreading until the slaying
unit arrives, so please
achieve it by repelling.
Put your own safety first.

60203.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
60203.description: A sudden material order from a good customer, so this is a race against time. Go and hunt a Pink Rathian right now. Sorry to ask the impossible, but in exchange, with these hands of mine I will strip 1 Rathian Spike for you for certain.
60203.descriptionEn:
A rush material order from
a top client. Speed is key.
Go hunt a Pink Rathian
right now.
Sorry to ask, but in return
these hands will carve you
one Rathian Spike for sure.

50125.description: To chase a reward this far, what spirit! The Melynx seem to be hoarding the workshop Master Felyne's favorite food. Take it back and mass produce Hardcore Cat weapons! Ah, note that you need a Festival Proof to accept it.
50125.descriptionEn:
Getting even this reward
shows real guts, meow!
The Master Felyne's favorite
food is stashed by the Melynx,
it seems, meow. Get it back
and mass-produce Felyne gear,
meow! Oh, accepting needs
a ≪Festival Proof≫, meow!

50584.description: This is the practice preliminary quest for the Idaten Cup Champion Tournament, PS Vita edition. The time limit is 10 minutes.
50584.descriptionEn:
Idaten Cup
Champion Tournament
PS Vita ver.
practice prelim quest.
Time limit: 10 minutes.

55554.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55554.description: The Variant Species Toridokuresu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Toridokuresu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55554.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Toridokuresu≫
seems to have reached a
strength that touches the very
summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their arm
who would challenge the summit
are asked to take the survey.

21911.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Baruragaru Gou armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the swamp, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
21911.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Swamp, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
"Stroma F Series" ≪Heavenly
Storm≫ armor up to Lv7.

56003.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
56003.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. We warmly welcome your participation.
56003.descriptionEn:
For the newly started UL
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest to boost
awareness and interest in
them.
Please join in!

23211.description: While surveying the unexplored reaches of the volcano, a Basarios that mistook us for disturbing its sleep went on a rampage. We cannot continue the survey like this. Head to the site and deal with it quickly.
23211.descriptionEn:
While surveying the Volcano's
unexplored zones, we got a
report that a Basarios,
woken and angered,
has started to rampage.
As it stands, the survey
cannot go on.
Head to the site and
deal with it at once.

50566.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
50566.description: A quest in which Poborubarumu, the Sound-Creating Wyvern debuting in G6, appears. Enjoy MHF-G6 a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
50566.descriptionEn:
This quest features
≪Poborubarumu≫, the
debut monster of 'G6'!
Enjoy MHF-G6 a step
ahead of time!
Time limit: 10 minutes.

62203.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Yama Tsukami. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62203.descriptionEn:
Urgent request. We seek
someone to deal with an
extremely powerful
≪Yama Tsukami≫. Slay it
in style and we shall issue
more Slay Proofs than usual!

55442.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a horn break and a tail cut in slaying Hyujikiki, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55442.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Hyujikiki≫ and break its
horns and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

40129.description: We present items to all rookie hunters with feelings of support. After you clear this quest, the items will be handed to you at the special event house. Please keep up your good work.
40129.descriptionEn:
To cheer on all you new
hunters, we have a gift
of items for you.
After clearing this quest,
come to the Special Event
House to receive your
items. Do your best out there!

58019.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58019.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58019.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50346.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
50346.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50346.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

26007.description: A forest has appeared at the very front line of development. If there is a new species whose ecology is unknown in this land so hard to enter, securing safety is the first step of research. Let us see what you hunters can do.
26007.descriptionEn:
A Great Forest has appeared at
the forefront of exploration.
If an unknown new species lives
in this land so hard to enter,
then securing safety is the
first step of research.
Let us see what you hunters can do.

61114.description: I've developed a new hammer, but the structure has become a bit complicated, so would you test its strength for me? I've chosen armor to match the weapon, so no worries! Full of skills, and it looks good too! Wear it without hesitation!
61114.descriptionEn:
I developed a new Hammer, but
the structure came out a bit
complex, so would you go test
its strength for me? I picked
armor to match the weapon, so
no worries!
Full of skills and good looking!
Wear it without holding back!

54733.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス２頭の討伐
54733.description: There was a report of a Lavasioth Subspecies in the G Rank Volcano, likely a mistake. But if several powerful Lavasioth have appeared, we cannot ignore it. Please survey just in case. Any rare material found will be yours.
54733.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a
≪Crimson Volganos≫ in the
G Rank Volcano, likely a
mistake. But if several
powerful ≪Volganos≫ have
appeared, we cannot ignore
it. Please survey just in
case. Any rare material
found will be yours.

50269.description: Hunting and capturing are not everything! You agree that breaking parts is the true thrill of the hunt, do you not? Your quarry this time is an Espinas. Break the specified parts in style and show off your skill.
50269.descriptionEn:
Slaying and capturing
aren't everything! Part
breaks are the real thrill,
right? Today's target is
the ≪Espinas≫. Break the
set parts and show your skill!

23534.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
23534.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Poborubarumu, the Sound Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23534.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Sound-Creating
Dragon ≪Poborubarumu≫.
To accept this quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

50045.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
50045.description: To obtain the Dragon Medicine Stone, I want to ask you to repel Lao-Shan Lung. The Dragon Medicine Stone is to be collected on our side after the hunt or the repulsion. Still, as long as we get the Dragon Medicine Stone, there is no need to force a hunt. Just deliver the Dragon Medicine Stone as it is. Sorry for the trouble, and thank you.
50045.descriptionEn:
I need a Dragon Medicine
Stone, so please repel the
Lao-Shan Lung. After the
slay or repel, we will
collect the stone here.
Still, if we get the stone
there's no need to slay it
forcibly. Just deliver the
stone. Sorry, and thanks.

55931.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55931.description: The Variant Species Harudomerugu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55931.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Harudomerugu≫
has grown fiercely strong
and keeps on rampaging.
This is extremely dangerous.
Prepare fully before you
conduct the survey.

23217.description: I heard there is a Rathian nest in a place deep in the Forest and Hills that has not yet been fully surveyed. If we examine it, I am sure there will be new discoveries. Would you lend me your strength for my research?
23217.descriptionEn:
I heard a Rathian's nest
sits in a spot deep in the
Forest and Hills that
hasn't been fully surveyed.
If we look there, I'm sure
we'll find something new.
For my research,
would you lend a hand?

60042.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50071.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
50071.description: The limited-time Golden Week Festival special quest is a bargain quest where you can get plenty of HRP and Porta Tickets (Sakura). Note that a Golden Week Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50071.descriptionEn:
This limited-time GW Festival
special quest is a great deal,
giving plenty of HRP and
Porta Ticket Sakura.
Note that accepting the quest
requires a ≪GW Ticket≫, so
please be careful.

55906.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
55906.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55906.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.

55460.description: With the Hunters Festa and all, Mezeporta Square is in a huge uproar, meow! Deliveries have piled up and we are run off our feet, meow! And on top of that, they tell me the Gougarf and the rest are running wild in the Deep Bamboo Forest, meow! If you go hunt them, I might give you a treasure, meow!
55460.descriptionEn:
With the Hunters Festa and
all, Mezeporuta Square is in
an uproar, meow! Deliveries
piled up and we're swamped,
meow! So don't tell me the
≪Gogomoa≫ are running wild
in ≪Deep Bamboo Grove≫,
meow! Hunt them and maybe
I'll give you a treasure,
meow!

21856.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Gakou (Elegance) and Gasen (Elegance) series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21856.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
≪Hardcore Armor≫ Gakou
[Taste] / Gasen [Taste]
series: materials to craft
and upgrade all 5 parts.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed, so be warned.

21092.description: If you can hunt the Queen of the Land, Rathian, then you are a hunter who can hunt well enough even in this great hall. If you feel a difference in strength beyond compare, simply taking a Wyvern Egg from the nest would serve as proof of courage.
21092.descriptionEn:
If you can hunt the Queen of the
Land ≪Rathian≫, then you are a
hunter who can hunt well enough
even in this Great Elder Hall.
If you feel the gap in strength
is too great, then simply taking
a ≪Wyvern Egg≫ from her nest is
proof enough of courage.

63291.description: There is a report of a Pariapuria sighted in the highlands. Perhaps because it has eaten all sorts of things, it seems to be a powerful individual. Unfortunately supplies cannot be delivered, but hunt it with care!
63291.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a
Pariapuria sighted in the
Highlands. Perhaps because it
has eaten all sorts of things,
it seems to be a powerful one.
Sadly we cannot deliver
supplies, but hunt with care!

50494.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gurenzeburu. I am counting on you!
50494.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
They say you hit HR22.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as the reward?
What, it's an easy one. Just run
out and slay a Gurenzeburu for
me.
I'm counting on you!

62902.description: Among the newly discovered savage wyvern Abiorugu in the Jungle, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is a survey and hunting request limited to hunters we approve of. Face it fully prepared.
62902.descriptionEn:
Among the ≪Abiorugu≫ newly
found in the Jungle, an utterly
savage and powerful individual
has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey is limited to Hunters we
approve of. Please go in with
everything prepared.

1066.description: If you're going after Basarios, search around the rocky areas! It often hides somewhere, mimicking the stone! Oh, and if you plan to do some mining, be sure to deliver Coal! It's prized as an energy source!
1066.descriptionEn:
If you're going after a
≪Basarios≫, search around the
rocks! It often mimics one
and hides away, you see!
Oh, and if you plan to mine,
then by all means deliver
≪Coal≫! It's prized as an
energy source, that's for sure!

54512.description: We are continuing our survey of the Monoblos. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54512.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey
of the Monoblos.
Part breaks aren't
required, but we'd be
glad if you did!
Hunters, thank you
for your support!

55358.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55358.description: The Variant Species Tigrex appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Tigrex. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55358.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Tigrex≫
seems to have reached a
strength that touches the very
summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their arm
who would challenge the summit
are asked to take the survey.

21329.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
21329.description: What, you just want a hard Lance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21329.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Lance, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!

63331.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
63331.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63331.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

63324.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63324.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63324.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

53112.description: This quest gives production materials for the Dual Blades whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
53112.descriptionEn:
This quest provides the materials
to craft a pair of Dual Blades
whose performance was decided
by a survey held to commemorate
surpassing 700,000 Zinogre
hunted in the Zinogre hunting
unlock event, "Transcendent
Species Invasion! Hunt Zinogre."

20026.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
20026.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the city! Make use of the interception base's weapons and slay the mysterious giant dragon completely! Please!
20026.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast Post
reports that a suspicious dragon
is approaching the town! Use the
weapons at the Base to slay the
mysterious giant dragon
completely! Please!

61826.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
61826.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Espinas rare species of the old tower. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
61826.descriptionEn:
The time to show your
skill has come, hunters!
Hunt the ≪Espinas
Subspecies≫ of the Ancient
Tower. Clear the quest
safely and your name as a
hunter will rise straight up!

11035.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
11035.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern! True to the name, it sprays poison everywhere and thrashes about, a nuisance of a bird wyvern! It has a cunning side too, playing dead when it senses danger, so do be careful!
11035.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: the Poison
Bird! Just as the name
says, it sprays poison and
runs wild, a real nuisance!
It also plays dead when it
senses danger, so take care!

61956.description: A great number of bird wyverns have appeared in the Grand Arena! Can you withstand their assault, splashing hunters with poison, paralyzing them in an instant, trying to tear them open with sharp claws!? Should you finish the hunt well, you will obtain rare materials.
61956.descriptionEn:
A swarm of Bird Wyverns has
appeared in the Great Arena!
They spray hunters with
venom, paralyze in an
instant, and try to slash
with sharp claws. Can you
endure their onslaught!?
Finish the hunt in style
and rare materials may be
yours.

26062.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
26062.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26062.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

54294.description: Please help investigate a Gravios Subspecies. This time we examine the inside of the chest and the cut surface of the tail. Be sure to destroy and cut. It is a very difficult job, but thank you.
54294.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help in
surveying a Black Gravios.
This time we want data on
the chest interior and the
tail's severed cross-section.
Be sure to break and sever.
This is a very hard request,
so thank you in advance.

54303.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
54303.description: The survey team that went deep into the Ancient Tower reports discovering a Gold Rathian. Encountering one at all is rare, and for one living in an unsurveyed region its research value is beyond measure. Head there at once and investigate.
54303.descriptionEn:
A survey team that went deep
into the Ancient Tower reports
finding a Gold Rathian.
Meeting a Gold Rathian at all is
rare, and one living in an
unsurveyed region is beyond
all measure in survey value.
Please head to the site at once
and carry out the survey.

56037.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
56037.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Shining Thunder Bird. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56037.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Supremacy
Forokururu.
If you break its developed
parts during this quest, I will
add the developed part
materials to your bonus
rewards as a special extra.
Note that slaying it alone
will not yield those materials.

51083.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51083.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Basarios will also grant a special ingredient.
51083.descriptionEn:
We have long been running the
Guild Priority Requests, and to
spread awareness and promote
them we have prepared this
quest for you.
By breaking the Basarios'
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

23338.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
23338.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Rebidiora, the Thunder Extreme Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23338.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Thunder
Extreme Dragon ≪Revidiora≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

54707.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54707.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54707.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

50201.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
50201.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50201.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

61258.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
61258.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
61258.descriptionEn:
I got my hands on an ancient tome
said to record how to make armor
that no one knows anymore,
but I was attacked by monsters
and dropped it.
As long as the writing can still
be read, it needn't be intact.
Please, go and find it for me!

23735.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23735.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials below.
≪H Bowgun Medal - Intro≫ x50
≪H Bowgun Medal - Mid≫ x60
≪H Bowgun Medal - Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you
need a ≪Secret Art Medal
Crystal≫ and GR500 or above,
so please take note.

21861.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21861.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Diore F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21861.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for all 5 parts of
the ≪Storm Armor≫ Diore F
series.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed, so be warned.

61809.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61809.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21199.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21199.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

54226.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54226.description: The survey of the Dyuragaua that appeared at the Tower continues. Breaking its parts is not required, but I would be delighted if you did! Hunters, I ask for your help!
54226.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey
of the Duramboros that
appeared in the Tower.
Part breaks aren't
required, but we'd be
glad if you did!
Hunters, thank you
for your support!

54344.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54344.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54344.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

61227.description: On the way to and from the Canyon I keep being attacked by Felynes and Melynx and I am in trouble. At this rate I cannot deliver my goods. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
61227.descriptionEn:
On the way to and from the
Canyon, I keep getting attacked
by Felynes and Melynxes.
At this rate I can't deliver my
goods. If you help me out, I'll
give you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ you can trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫ as thanks!

50034.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
50034.description: I seem to have dropped the blueprint for a Gook room I made on request while out walking. Sorry, but would you look for it? As thanks I will give you a Gook room blueprint of my own design.
50034.descriptionEn:
The Gook room blueprint I
drew up for your request
seems to have fallen out
of my pocket on a walk.
Sorry, could you go find
it? As thanks I'll give you
a Gook room plan I designed.

53172.description: This is Miyashita! A challenge from me (a quiz), answer check quest 1! 2016 Answer Ticket JB x1, 2016 Answer Ticket KB x1, 2016 Answer Ticket LB x1. You who hold the items above: correct! Congratulations! Take the items and depart on the quest! Receive your present!
53172.descriptionEn:
It's Miyashita!
My challenge to you (a quiz)
Answer-checking quest 1!
2016 Answer Ticket JB x1
2016 Answer Ticket KB x1
2016 Answer Ticket LB x1
You who hold the items above
are correct! Congratulations!
Bring the items and set out
on the quest! Claim your gift!

26705.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26705.description: Thanks for playing MHF for five whole years! Equip Akra Fia and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude N as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude N you can forge Dancing Thunder Claw (Long Sword).
26705.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for five whole years!
Equip ≪Akra Fia≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude N≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
N≫ you can forge ≪Dancing
Thunder Claw≫ (Long Sword).

54188.description: We continue the investigation of the Espinas that appeared in the sea of trees. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54188.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Espinas that appeared
in the Great Forest.
Part breaks aren't
required, but we would be
glad! Hunters, thank you
for your support!

54791.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
54791.description: Silver Rathalos and Gold Rathian have appeared together. The Guild will pay a large reward to the hunter who hunts both within 20 minutes. Hunt them quickly, before damage is done!
54791.descriptionEn:
A ≪Silver Rathalos≫ and a
≪Gold Rathian≫ appeared
together. The Guild has
decided to pay a hefty sum
to hunters who take both
down within 20 minutes.
Please hunt them quickly,
before anyone gets hurt!

22109.description: Prism Falls at night in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
22109.descriptionEn:
Temperate season, night, at the
Painted Waterfall. It is
unexplored land the Guild is
still surveying. Why not go
have a look for gathering and
survey? When you want to
return, just deliver the map!

51008.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51008.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
51008.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.

12011.objectiveJp: なわばりのフン２個の納品

55422.description: At the signs of a new Variant appearing, the Guild has prepared a new great sword for promising hunters to face the Variants. Obtain the production materials and prepare for the Variant hunt!
55422.descriptionEn:
With signs of a new
Supremacy appearing, the
Guild has forged a new
Great Sword for promising
hunters to face them.
Gather the materials and
prepare to slay Supremacies!

62495.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62495.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62495.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

50185.description: Reports have reached us of an unidentified monster on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
50185.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
an unidentified monster is
rampaging in the Ancient Tower.
As every moment counts, this is
a short-time slaying request,
but to keep the damage to a
minimum, we will accept a mere
repel as well.
We seek hunters with a Secret
Art Tome to face this crisis!

55869.description: Oh, comrade who loves black. This time I want you to survey and slay a ferocious black one. Of course, so that you may keep your manners, we have prepared the equipment. The long sword is already strengthened, so I'd like you to check how it handles as well. If you like it, I'll give you the materials you need.
55869.descriptionEn:
Ah, comrade who loves black.
This time I want you to survey
and slay a ferocious black one.
Of course, so that manners are
kept, we have prepared the gear
for you. The Long Sword is
already upgraded, so please
check how it handles as well.
If you like it, the materials are yours.

55524.description: That armor I loved the look of, and this one too, you never wear them anymore, meow! There are even hunters who say they have graduated from them, meow! No, meow! Put on that wonderful Lars armor once more and show me the hunter in all his glory, meow! I will reward you, meow!
55524.descriptionEn:
That armor I loved the
look of, and this one too,
you just won't wear, meow!
Some hunters even say
they've graduated, meow!
No, meow! Wear that
splendid Rath armor again
and show me your fine form,
meow! I'll make it worth it!

56015.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Hypnocatrice. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56015.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Hypnocatrice.
If you destroy the Supremacy's
developed parts in this quest, I
will add the developed part
materials to your Another rewards
specially.
Please note that slaying alone
will not grant them.

54643.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の討伐
54643.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54643.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

22030.description: There are reports that an Abiorugu has appeared in the swamp. Much about Abiorugu remains a mystery, but the investigation seems to be progressing little by little. We ask for your continued cooperation.
22030.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that
Abiorugu has appeared in the
Swamp. Much about Abiorugu still
remains a mystery, but our
survey seems to be advancing
little by little.
We ask for your continued help.

60812.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
60812.description: A subspecies of Espinas has appeared at the top of the tower close to the sea of trees. According to the documents left by the Royal Paleontology Scriveners, there is a record that against the wholehearted blow it delivers after storing power, defense was of no use at all. Please take care.
60812.descriptionEn:
An Espinas Subspecies has
appeared at the top of the Tower
near the Great Forest. Documents
left by the Royal Paleontology
Scrivener Corps record that
against the all-out blow it
charges up, defense was of no
use at all.
Please be careful.

55004.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55004.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55004.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

62170.objectiveJp: ハンターカード赤１０枚納品
62170.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62170.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

62423.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62423.description: Is there anyone who wants to experience the effect of the Master's Seal? The Master's Seal speeds up the motions of drawing and sheathing, so you get far more chances to attack and heal than before! There's no special reward, so enjoy it in moderation.
62423.descriptionEn:
Does anyone want to try
out the ≪Master's Mark≫?
The ≪Master's Mark≫ speeds
up your draw and sheathe
actions, so you get far more
chances to attack or heal
than before! No special
reward, so just enjoy it.

62525.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
62525.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62525.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

54371.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54371.description: Forokururu has appeared in the Flower Field. Reports describe a very rare monster that takes in nectar and changes its constitution. We ask for your help with the survey. We also have reports that the Beastmen in the Flower Field do not regard hunters as enemies and pose little danger.
54371.descriptionEn:
A ≪Forokururu≫ has appeared in
the Flower Field. Reports say it
takes in nectar and transforms
its constitution, a very rare
monster indeed. Please help us
survey it. As for the Beastmen
of the Flower Field, word is
they do not regard hunters as
enemies, so the danger is low.

60579.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Espinas and Hypnocatrice. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60579.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's targets are the
≪Espinas≫ and ≪Hypnocatrice≫!
Achieve the goal together
with your guildmates.
Teamwork decides this one,
so take a top placing!
Also, Origin weapons only
this time! Choose wisely!

54248.description: Thanks to you gathering Rurou Narcissus and mining the Amaterasu Stone, trade with every region is thriving. The Guild presents you with this coin as thanks for the blessings you have brought to Mezeporta.
54248.descriptionEn:
Thanks to you gathering ≪Lulou Suisen≫
and mining ≪Amaterasu Stone≫,
trade with every region is
flourishing.
The Guild presents you with this
coin as thanks for the blessings
you have brought to Mezepolta.

55979.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55979.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

55838.description: To promote the use of Variant Sigils, we have prepared a quest that reliably yields crafting materials. A Variant Sigil should prove a fine asset to the hunters who protect Mezepolta. Take this chance to try a Variant Sigil for yourself.
55838.descriptionEn:
To promote use of
Supremacy Sigils, we have
prepared a quest that
reliably yields craft
materials. Supremacy Sigils
will be fine allies to the
hunters who guard
Mezeporuta. Try one now!

60425.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
60425.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60425.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

60036.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

54594.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54594.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Dyuragaua and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54594.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Duramboros≫
and prove what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
right up!

60048.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

21921.description: A request to repel a Supremacy species has arrived. If you complete it, you can obtain Supremacy materials. Repel it though you may, a Supremacy is still a Supremacy. Please take care never to let your guard down.
21921.descriptionEn:
A Zenith repel request has arrived.
Complete it splendidly and you
can obtain Zenith materials.
Even for a repel, a Zenith is
still a Zenith.
Please be absolutely sure
not to let your guard down.

12059.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

26751.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

51032.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
51032.descriptionEn:
This quest yields
the materials needed for
F upgrades of Secret Art
Armor (Blademaster),
weapon souls excluded.
The yield covers 5 parts.
Accepting the quest needs
a ≪Hunter Die White≫,
so please take note.

62460.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62460.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

60675.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Khezu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60675.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's target is ≪Khezu≫!
To hunt a monster all alone
shows true spirit, truly
admirable! Best yourself
and take a top placing!
Supremacy weapons only
this time!

63305.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Tigrex, then slay the Tigrex here in this arena!
63305.descriptionEn:
An arena to show your
skill, hunters! If you're
confident you can handle
a Tigrex, come to this
arena and slay the
≪Tigrex≫!

50608.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１匹の討伐
50608.description: A letter with no sender arrived. It is an eerie letter bearing only the words: dress formally, carry no items, and accept my challenge. I have a guess as to the sender, but a problem is best solved. Please investigate at once. Whatever you do, do not let your guard down!
50608.descriptionEn:
A letter arrived with no
sender. Creepy words only:
'Dress formally, carry no
items, and accept my
challenge.' I have a guess
who sent it, but it's best
to settle this. Please look
into it at once. Do not
let your guard down!

58122.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58122.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58122.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50252.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Soul (Beginning) x８５, Dual Blades Soul (Middle) x１９５, Dual Blades Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Dual Blades Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50252.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Dual Blades Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Dual Blades Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Dual Blades Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Dual Blades Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

26436.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
26436.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.

55678.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐

23568.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23568.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

62968.description: Oh, it's you, good timing. Actually I was just about to put into practice what's written in this book, to strengthen that prototype from the other day. I don't know if the contents are right, but I might find a hint. Of course you'll help.
62968.descriptionEn:
Oh, it's you, good timing.
Actually, to upgrade that
prototype from before, I was
about to try out what's
written in this tome.
Not sure it's correct, but
it may hold a hint.
Of course you'll help me.

62329.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の捕獲
62329.description: The Wyverian lady said the Guild is short of ingredients lately. At this rate she is worried whether they can properly entertain the hunters who visit Mezepolta Plaza. So she said that if you procure ingredients, she will give you a red gem as thanks!
62329.descriptionEn:
Lately the Guild is short on food,
the Wyverian lady said. At this
rate she worries they can't
properly serve the hunters who
visit Mezeporuta Square.
So she said if you gather some
ingredients for them, she'll give
you a red gem as thanks.
That's what she told me!

62163.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62163.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62163.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.

61548.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61548.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21955.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
21955.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ８１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Berukyurosu. I am counting on you!
21955.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! You reached
HR81, I hear. So I have a
favor to ask. How about a full
set of weapon materials as
reward? Easy job, really.
Just run over and slay a
Berukyurosu. I am counting
on you!

62572.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62572.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

26691.description: There are reports that an Abiorugu has appeared in the swamp. Much about Abiorugu remains a mystery, but the investigation seems to be progressing little by little. We ask for your continued cooperation.
26691.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that
Abiorugu has appeared in the
Swamp. Much about Abiorugu still
remains a mystery, but our
survey seems to be advancing
little by little.
We ask for your continued help.

62401.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
62401.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Tigrex. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62401.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
≪Tigrex≫ slay.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
polish your skills against other
hunters!

22119.description: A request that yields 4 kinds of decorations recommended for beginning hunters. Deliver Special Mushrooms in the Jungle and you will receive 10 each of the Power Jewel, Muscle Jewel, Earplug Jewel and Vigor Jewel.
22119.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain 4
kinds of decorations recommended
for rookie hunters.
Deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫ in
the Jungle to receive ≪Power
Jewel≫, ≪Muscle Jewel≫,
≪Earplug Jewel≫ and ≪Vigor
Jewel≫, 10 of each.
