50675.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Diore F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50675.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of
the ≪Skystorm Armor≫ Diore F
series.
To accept this quest you
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed. Please beware.

55551.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55551.description: A Toridokuresu with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Toridokuresu seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55551.descriptionEn:
A ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫ whose
wings have grown greatly has
appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy with
developed parts and will survey
it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.

23426.description: A hunter has reported finding a Chameleos in the swamp. When they tried to slay it at once, it cloaked itself completely. The hunter felt their life in danger and fled. Go to the site and find out the true nature of the Chameleos!
23426.descriptionEn:
A hunter reported discovering
the ≪Chameleos≫ in the Swamp.
When they tried to slay it at
once, it cloaked its figure
and vanished completely.
Feeling their life in danger,
the hunter fled right away.
Head to the area and find out
the true nature of ≪Chameleos≫!

62001.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
62001.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Blangonga. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62001.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
to slay Blangonga.
The reward is a bit lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
sharpen your skills against
other hunters?

63266.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63266.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63266.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

50114.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50114.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.

53233.description: Yes yes! This is a quest for hunters who reached the seventh challenge of the mysterious sports festival! Clear it quickly and bring this festival to its goal!
53233.descriptionEn:
Hi, hi!
This quest is for hunters
who reached the seventh
challenge of the strange
athletic meet!
Clear it quick and let's
reach the goal of this
meet together!

26731.description: I obtained information that there are ruins from ancient times somewhere in the swamp, and stormed in to verify it, but Akura Vashimu lives at the destination and I am stuck. Could you slay that monster? In thanks I will present part of the excavated goods.
26731.descriptionEn:
I learned that ancient ruins
lie somewhere in the Swamp,
so I went in to confirm it,
but a Taikun Zamuza has
made its nest at the site,
and I am at a loss. Could
you please slay that monster
for me? As thanks, I will
present part of my finds.

50358.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50358.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wing claws of a Teostra will also grant a special ingredient.
50358.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking Teostra's wing
claws, special ingredients will
also be granted to you.

55102.description: Slaying a Guanzorumu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55102.descriptionEn:
By slaying Guanzorumu you
raise your own rating and
earn materials needed for
G Rank decorations at a
nice discount—I've set up
the quest for exactly
that. Do make use of it.

55124.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55124.description: I hear a monster called the Stygian Zinogre has been sighted lately. I have a weakness for materials from new monsters. I simply must have them. Would you get them for me? In return I will share Eroded Dragon Insects.
55124.descriptionEn:
Lately there've been
sightings of a monster
called the Stygian Zinogre,
or so I hear. I can't
resist new monster parts.
I simply must have them.
Would you fetch them for
me? I'll share ≪Erosion Dragonbug≫.

21706.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21706.description: Thanks for playing MHF for seven whole years! Equip Sol Oquvia Thorn and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude P as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude P you can forge Shan Luminare (Bow).
21706.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for seven whole years!
Equip ≪Sol Oquvia Thorn≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude P≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
P≫ you can forge ≪Shan
Luminare≫ (Bow).

62321.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62321.description: It is I, the Instructor! This is a quest for the Refined Monster trial! Today's target is the Variant Gendrome! I wish to hear how the feel of the fight changed before and after refining!
62321.descriptionEn:
It is I. The Instructor!
This quest is for the
Refine Monster trial!
Today's target is the
≪Iodrome Variant≫!
I want to hear how the
challenge changed before
and after refinement!

62631.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62631.description: I obtained information that there are ruins from ancient times somewhere in the swamp, and stormed in to verify it, but Akura Vashimu lives at the destination and I am stuck. Could you slay that monster? In thanks I will present part of the excavated goods.
62631.descriptionEn:
I learned that ancient ruins
lie somewhere in the Swamp,
so I went in to confirm it,
but a Taikun Zamuza has
made its nest at the site,
and I am at a loss. Could
you please slay that monster
for me? As thanks, I will
present part of my finds.

5003.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラの撃退

62728.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

54599.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54599.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54599.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you honed against the ≪Tigrex≫
in the Desert!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you.

61855.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
61855.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.

40174.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil GS Earring.
40174.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment.
Please accept the quest
while wearing the Bail GS
Earring.

61834.description: Oh, you've come. Hunting monsters is fine, but mining is fun too! So, how about testing your mining skill? I want you to gather the ore I'm about to request. The reward will be generous!
61834.descriptionEn:
Hey, glad you came.
Hunting monsters is fine, but
mining is a joy too!
So, how about a test of your
mining skill?
I want you to gather the ore I
am about to ask for.
The pay will be generous!

21055.description: Hermitaur buried in the sand burst out suddenly. Running around is dangerous, so be careful! They faint when startled by loud noises, so do not forget to bring Sonic Bombs!
21055.descriptionEn:
The Yaozami that lurk in the
sand will burst out without
warning. Running around is
dangerous, so please be careful!
Loud noises stun them, so do not
forget to bring Sonic Bombs
along with you!

53145.client: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy
53145.clientEn: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy

23710.description: The Variant Species Gravios has appeared once more. Its developed body not only stores and vents heat, it seems to generate enough to melt rock. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23710.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gravios≫ has
appeared once more.
Its developed body stores heat,
and not only vents it but seems
to grow hot enough to melt
rock.
Please take great care in your
survey.

62589.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62589.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62589.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

61607.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61607.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.

55497.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55497.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

54455.description: The Guild has granted permission to explore the nighttime bamboo forest, previously off limits. So please help with the ecology survey of the Elegant Elder Dragon. The relationship between Inagami and the bamboo forest remains unexplained. Head there with great care.
54455.descriptionEn:
The Guild has granted permission
to explore the nighttime bamboo
grove that was off-limits until now.
So we ask for your aid in a
survey of the ≪Inagami≫'s ecology.
The bond between Inagami and the
bamboo grove is still unexplained
even after all our past surveys.
Please head for the site with the
utmost caution.

26484.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

23523.description: The Variant Species Rathalos appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Rathalos. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23523.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rathalos≫ seems
to have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Rathalos.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.

26038.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26038.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

12001.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
12001.description: Velocidrome runs off to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there. It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are lots of Velociprey minions, so be careful.
12001.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ runs off to
the next area when worn
down and heals up.
A good measure of a
hunter's skill, but this
season the Velociprey
are many. So be careful.

63319.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Rajang, then slay the Rajang here in this arena!
63319.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! If you're
sure you can handle the
Golden Lion, come and slay
≪Rajang≫ right here!
Show us what you're made of!

61867.description: As you know, I am an explorer. I fear no hardship. And hunter, I sense the same scent on you. Even knowing that a difficult job is only the tip of the iceberg on the road to a great ambition, you keep walking without losing your passion! We are both troublesome sorts!
61867.descriptionEn:
As you know, I'm an explorer.
No hardship frightens me.
And Hunter, I smell that
same scent on you.
Even knowing hard work is
only the tip of the iceberg
on the road to a great wish,
we keep walking, passion
unbroken! We're a troublesome pair!

55779.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
55779.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Request, we've made this quest to spread the word and drum up support. Breaking the Doragyurosu's head will also earn you special ingredients.
55779.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Request, we've made
this quest to spread the word
and drum up support.
Breaking the Doragyurosu's
head will also earn you
special ingredients.

62856.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62856.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62856.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

60686.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Midogaron. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60686.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Midogaron≫!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go take a top placing!
This time it's held with
Supremacy weapons only!

60629.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Blaststone. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
60629.descriptionEn:
The Popular Tavern Guild has
placed a large order for
Firestones.
Eight is not a number that one
hunter can deliver alone,
so we recommend accepting it
with at least two people.
Note that sub-clears give no supplies.

21944.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
21944.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gurenzeburu. I am counting on you!
21944.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
They say you hit HR22.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as the reward?
What, it's an easy one. Just run
out and slay a Gurenzeburu for
me.
I'm counting on you!

54837.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
54837.description: There has been a sighting of an Espinas Subspecies in the Canyon. Please hunt the target before damage occurs. Take particular care of its especially fierce charging attack!
54837.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Espinas Subspecies≫ in the
Canyon. Please hunt the target
before harm is done.
Take special care against its
fierce charging attacks!

21494.description: This is an exchange post only hunters holding a Secret Scroll may enter. Deliver proof of distinguished results in official hunting tournaments and I'll give you materials to further strengthen the arms you won as prizes. You can't get them with half-hearted skill, you know?
21494.descriptionEn:
This is an exchange post only
hunters with a Secret Art book
may enter. Deliver proof of
outstanding results in an
official hunting tournament,
and as a prize I will give you
materials to further upgrade
the gear you have won.
Half-hearted skill will not earn them!

26483.description: Khezu spends its larval stage underground, so they say its nose is better than its eyes. If hunting the parent is difficult, please trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
26483.descriptionEn:
≪Khezu≫ spend their larval
stage underground, so they
say their nose beats their
eyes. If hunting the parent
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver the result!

63022.description: A white suit is the symbol of pure love! I want you to play the White Hunter infiltrating an evil organization's hideout and recreate the scene where he strikes down the gatekeeper. As always, the armor you need will be lent to you. Risk your life, lose to no one, we are the White Hunters! Strike down the evil organization!
63022.descriptionEn:
A white suit is the symbol
of pure love! Go infiltrate
the evil syndicate's base
as the White Hunter and
recreate that scene where
you strike down the guard.
As always, the gear you need
will be lent to you. Risk
your life! Crush the evil gang!

53114.objectiveJp: ハンターバッジ桜１個の納品
53114.description: VSphoenix and MHF-G collaboration memorial. From 11/19 (Thu) to 12/16 (Wed), get an event code at the in-store Paynetcafe of authorized internet cafes across Japan, and collect the four Hunter Badges: white, sakura, yellow and purple. Felyne armor commemorating each region and the national conquest is yours!
53114.descriptionEn:
VSphoenix x MHF-G collab!
From 11/19 (Thu) to 12/16 (Wed),
get an event code at the
Paynetcafe counter in any
official net cafe in Japan
and collect four hunter
badges: white, sakura,
yellow and purple. Get local
and Felyne armor gifts!

63347.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
63347.description: I found a mysterious navy-blue shining object in the Snowy Mountains, and when I was about to pick it up, the Blango came and interfered from behind, meow! I want you to get rid of them so I can collect it safely, meow! As thanks I will present you with my navy-blue collection, meow!
63347.descriptionEn:
I found a mysterious navy
glowing thing in the Snowy
Mountains, meow! When I tried
to pick it up, the Blango
came and got in my way, meow!
Please clear them out so I
can collect it safely, meow!
I'll gift you my navy set, meow!

23189.description: I thought I would make a warm fur coat so I can go out even when it is cold. I am looking for someone to gather the materials. Ordinary fur will not do. The fur of the Burukku that live in unsurveyed areas would be good. It is said to be of very fine quality. Could I ask you?
23189.descriptionEn:
I want to make a warm fur
coat you can wear outside
even in this cold. I'm
looking for someone to
gather the materials.
Plain fur just won't do.
Brook fur from unexplored
areas would be ideal—it's
said to be top quality. Please?

50447.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61762.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
61762.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
61762.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

21669.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
21669.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over six at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21669.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
If you want a ≪Pawprint Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand over six of them at once.
Bring exactly 3 ≪Quest
Completion Certificates≫ and
come alone, got it? Well then,
I'll be waiting in the Canyon.

26465.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku. The pink hide is its trademark, but this one is reported to be blue. A subspecies, no doubt.
26465.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫.
Speaking of Yian Kut-Ku, pink is
its signature color, but this one
is reported to have a blue body?
It must be a subspecies.

23670.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
23670.description: The Variant Species Gasurabazura has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23670.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gasurabazura≫
has grown ferociously strong
and keeps on rampaging.
As it stands this is very
dangerous. Please prepare
fully before the survey.

26121.description: Genprey is a small carnivorous bird wyvern similar to Velociprey that lives in the desert. Its attacks can paralyze you. If you are paralyzed you'll go down defenseless for a while, so watch out!
26121.descriptionEn:
≪Genprey≫ are small
carnivorous bird wyverns
like the desert ≪Velociprey≫.
Their attacks can paralyze
you. Once paralyzed you're
left wide open on the
ground for a while, so
watch yourselves!

54885.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54885.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

50473.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
50473.description: It is I! The Instructor! I am holding my friend's wedding, but there is a Diablos in the nearby Desert and it is noisy! I could hunt it myself, but I, famous as a cupid of love, am very busy! So I entrust the hunt to you hunters! I wish you good fortune!
50473.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
A friend of mine is holding
his wedding, but a Diablos
in the nearby Desert is
making an awful racket!
I could hunt it myself, but
as the renowned Cupid of
love I'm terribly busy!
So I ask you hunters—fight well!

63080.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
63080.description: A mighty flame has been observed in the swamp. From the report it is probably the Teostra that has appeared often before, but this appearance falls outside the Guild's predictions and can be called extremely rare. Please investigate at once.
63080.descriptionEn:
A mighty flame has been
observed in the Swamp.
Reports suggest it may be
the ≪Teostra≫ that has been
appearing more often lately,
but this appearance falls
outside Guild predictions and
is extremely rare. Survey it now!

50060.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
50060.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50060.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

54171.description: I requested a hunt with the chest destroyed and tail cut to investigate Espinas, but no completion report ever comes. I judge you a skilled hunter and want to ask you. Will you take my job?
54171.descriptionEn:
To survey Espinas I requested
a hunt with the chest broken
and the tail severed, but no
completion report ever came.
I judge you a capable hunter
and want to ask you.
Will you take my request?

61315.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61315.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

53098.objectiveJp: コナマキダケ１０個の納品
53098.description: I am short of autumn mushrooms, so gather Kona-makidake from Taikun Zamuza and deliver them! Depending on how many you deliver, I will release a mushroom-heavy quest later! Do not forget your Farcaster so you can get back to base camp!
53098.descriptionEn:
I'm short on autumn
mushrooms, so gather
Konamakidake from Taikun
Zamuza and deliver them!
Depending on the number,
I'll post a mushroom-packed
quest later on!
Don't forget a Farcaster so
you can get back to camp!

23436.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23436.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Merit (Beginning) x５０, Dual Blades Merit (Middle) x６０, Dual Blades Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23436.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪Dual Blades Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Dual Blades Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Dual Blades Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.

53160.description: Here again this year! Miyashita here! My challenge to you, a quiz. Question 1: The words that come out of my, Miyamoa's, gunlance shelling are Thank you for playing! Hunters who think the answer is true (A), take this quest!
53160.descriptionEn:
Here again this year!
It's Miyashita!
A challenge from me—a quiz!
[Question 1]
The letters that come out
of my (Miyamoa's) gunlance
blasts read:
"Thanks for playing!"
If you think the answer
is ○ (A), accept this quest!

63037.description: Try the training I developed myself! If you finish the preparations, you can grow a great deal with ease! It is meaningless with another's help, so this is for solo hunters only. Now, let us go!
63037.descriptionEn:
Try this training I
developed all by myself!
Finish the prep beforehand
and you'll grow a lot!
Borrowing another's help
defeats the purpose, so
it's for solo hunters only.
Now then—let's go!

62614.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
62614.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62614.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

21820.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21324.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
21324.description: What, you just want hard Dual Blades? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21324.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
pair of Dual Blades?
Then I'll refine some Argen Steel
for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
are prowling around the area
to top it off.
Go find it with all you've got!

61307.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61307.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61307.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

55768.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55768.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

62950.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
62950.description: Thanks for playing MHF for three whole years! Equip Akam Swoon and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude L as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude L you can forge Vol Impact (Hammer).
62950.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for three whole years!
Equip ≪Akam Swoon≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude L≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude L≫ you can forge
≪Vol Impact≫ (Hammer).

50354.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of an Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
50354.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Espinas's horn,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

62473.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
62473.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62473.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

62301.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐

60414.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
60414.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60414.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

62297.description: Summer means fishing. Summer means bug catching. Summer means fireworks! Go and play a little to take a break. The Jungle at night is beautiful. I will have a fine Heavy Bowgun ready for you.
62297.descriptionEn:
Summer means fishing.
Summer means bug catching.
Summer means fireworks!
Go out and play a while.
The Jungle at night is lovely.
I'll have a fine Heavy Bowgun
ready for you too.

26591.description: Oh, do me a favor. A Congalala attacked me in the swamp and stole my egg. Get it back somehow. A Guku egg? Ah, there was such a thing too. If the egg you bring back is that one, you can have it. Those things hide important stuff in their tails!
26591.descriptionEn:
Hey, do me one favor.
A ≪Congalala≫ in the Swamp
attacked me and stole my eggs.
Get them back somehow.
A ≪Gook≫ egg? Oh yeah, there
was one of those too. If the
egg you bring back happens
to be that one, I'll allow it.
They hide the prize in their tails!

201.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の討伐
201.description: In this arena, monster and hunter face off one on one! This time your opponent is a Velocidrome. Two of them, but with your skill that is nothing! Off you go!
201.descriptionEn:
In this arena, monster and
hunter face off one on one
in a no-holds-barred match!
Today's opponent is a
Velocidrome. Two of them or
not, that's nothing for you!

22054.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22054.description: This quest raises the standing of your Partner and Palico by a wide margin. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
22054.descriptionEn:
In this quest, the evaluation
of your partner and Palico
rises dramatically.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed. Please beware.

50281.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50281.description: This time you will head out for an ecological survey of the Pariapuria reported to have appeared in the Canyon. We have also prepared the supplied items you will likely need as the survey proceeds. Well then, I leave it to you.
50281.descriptionEn:
This time we ask you to
survey the ≪Pariapuria≫
reported in the Canyon.
We've also prepared the
supplies you'll likely need
as the survey goes on.
Well then, please see to it.

22032.description: A forest has appeared at the very front line of development. If there is a new species whose ecology is unknown in this land so hard to enter, securing safety is the first step of research. Let us see what you hunters can do.
22032.descriptionEn:
A Great Forest appeared at
the frontier of development.
If an unknown species lives
in this hard-to-enter land,
safety comes first in research.
Let's see what you hunters
can do.

50954.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
50954.description: The survey party reports detecting charged erosion dragonbugs from monster footprints found in the Snowy Mountains. This may be a new subspecies! However, contact with the party has been cut off since! Head for the site at once!
50954.descriptionEn:
We have reports that charged
Erosion Dragonbugs were
detected in monster footprints
found by the survey team in the
≪Snowy Mountains≫.
It may be a new Subspecies
monster! But since then all
contact with the team has
ceased!
Head for the site at once!

61519.description: Coming here means you got the thing safely. Now, a trade. Will you give me a lump of rust? Don't worry, there's a way for both of us to be happy. I won't do you wrong. And while you're at it, hunt an Espinas. With that thing around I can't go home.
61519.descriptionEn:
Coming here means you got
the goods safely, eh?
Now, let's make a deal.
How about giving me that
rusted lump? Don't worry—
there's a way for us both
to come out happy. I won't
do you wrong, you hear?
While you're at it, hunt an
Espinas too. Can't go home otherwise.

54872.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
54872.description: It has been a long time. When did I last forge your Pale Thorn Blade? Now, obtain the material said to come from only one in thousands of Espinas Rare Species, and release its true power.
54872.descriptionEn:
It has been a long while.
When did I last forge your
"White Thorn Long Sword"?
Now, go and take the material
said to come from only one
among thousands of Espinas
Rare Species, and unleash
the true power within it.

21252.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21252.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

23717.objectiveJp: 誰かの落し物１０個の納品
23717.description: This is terrible, meow! A hunter asked me to carry a big load, and there was a hole in the bag, so everything inside was gone, meow! I would feel awful about it, so I am looking for people to search with me, meow! Please help, meow!
23717.descriptionEn:
Big trouble, nya!
I was carrying a big load for a
hunter when a hole opened in the
bag and everything inside was
gone, nya!
I cannot face that hunter like
this, so I am looking for people
to search with me, nya!
Please lend a paw, nya!

50809.description: The White Lake in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
50809.descriptionEn:
White Lake in the Warm Season.
The guild is still surveying
this uncharted land even now,
but why not visit it yourself,
hunter, to gather and survey?
If you start missing home,
just deliver a map!

50047.description: Would you look for a rare old box, nya? Find one and bring it to me and I will trade you my top recommendation, nya. Hm? What is inside the box? There are some things in this world better left unknown, nya.
50047.descriptionEn:
Would you search for an old box that is
rarely found, meow? If you find one
and bring it to me, I will trade you
a recommended item, meow.
Hm? What is inside the box, you ask?
There are things in this world you
are better off not knowing, meow.

50796.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
50796.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Gureadomosu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50796.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We seek
someone to slay an
exceptionally powerful
≪Gureadomosu≫ individual.
Slay it and we'll issue
more slay proofs than
usual!

54998.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54998.description: A Daimyo Hermitaur and a Yaozami appeared during the survey of the Jungle! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. Hunters who complete the request will receive the crafting materials for the weapon series Phantom Mist Clearing, along with G-rank Gou Cancel Jewels and G-rank Sen Cancel Jewels.
54998.descriptionEn:
During the Jungle survey,
a Daimyo Hermitaur and
Yaozami appeared!
The survey cannot be
completed like this.
Hunters who clear this will
get materials for the 'Phantom
Mist Sweeper' series plus
G Rank Hardgem and Flashgem!

22052.description: The Highlands are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22052.descriptionEn:
The ≪Highlands≫ are a land
still under Guild survey,
but hunters too might like
to go and take a look for
gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

21476.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21476.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21476.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62452.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for a hunter to slay the Yama Tsukami that suddenly appeared at the Old Tower. If you complete this sudden request, we will throw in some bonus proof of slaying!
62452.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We seek
hunters to slay the
≪Yama Tsukami≫ that suddenly
appeared in the Ancient Tower.
Clear this sudden request and
we'll throw in a slay proof
or two as a bonus!

26482.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
26482.description: A red shadow crawling across the snowfield has been sighted! It is certainly a Khezu subspecies! In the Snowy Mountains this season, the Blango gather in herds seeking food! Take care not to face the Khezu and the Blango at the same time!
26482.descriptionEn:
A red shadow crawling over the
snowy fields has been sighted!
It is surely a ≪Khezu≫
subspecies! This season the
Snowy Mountains swarm with
Blango seeking food! Mind that
you do not face Khezu and Blango at once!

54592.description: There is a report that a monster wrapped in a red aura has appeared in the arena. We do not know how many there are, but if this goes on the damage may spread. Please hunt it at once. When you succeed, we will give you armor long treasured by the guild.
54592.descriptionEn:
There are reports of monsters
wrapped in a red aura appearing
in the Arena.
We do not know how many there are,
but if this continues the damage may
spread.
Please slay them at once.
Upon success, we will give you
armor long kept in the Guild's
vaults.

53070.description: The final quest for the Championship Tournament DMM Cup. Please read the participation rules on the tournament's special site carefully, and join after agreeing to them. Taking the final quest counts as participation.
53070.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
"Championship Tournament DMM
Cup".
Please read the participation rules
on the event's special site, and
agree to them before joining.
Accepting the final quest is taken
as your entry into the tournament.

50472.description: The Flower Field in the breeding season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
50472.descriptionEn:
The ≪Flower Field≫ in breeding
season. It is an unexplored land
the Guild is still surveying, but
why not go have a look yourself
for gathering and survey work?
If you feel like coming home,
just deliver a map to finish
up!

23593.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
23593.description: A giant fireball above Schrade Castle, and the investigation revealed a terrible fact. The Fatalis hailed as the black legend had mutated into something even more powerful! Unimaginable damage will occur. Please slay it swiftly.
23593.descriptionEn:
A giant fireball has appeared
above Schrade Castle, and our
investigation revealed a terrible
truth. Fatalis, hailed as the
black legend, had mutated into
a far more powerful form!
If left alone, damage beyond
imagination will surely follow.
We ask for a swift slaying.

60567.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
60567.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Forokururu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60567.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Forokururu≫!
To hunt a monster all alone—
that spirit is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only—choose well!

60594.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Midogaron. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin, Transcendent and Aberrant weapons only!
60594.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Midogaron≫!
To hunt a monster all alone—
that spirit is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Origin/Transcendent/Supremacy only!

26634.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26634.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?

58061.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58061.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58061.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

21667.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21667.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21667.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

60586.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Basarios. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60586.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Basarios≫!
To hunt a monster all alone—
that spirit is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only—choose well!

54416.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
54416.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Silver Rathalos for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the wing claws and sever the tail. They are extremely dangerous and get in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break the parts!
54416.descriptionEn:
Would you hunt the
≪Silver Rathalos≫ for
my survey? Oh, I nearly
forgot something vital.
Be sure to break its wing
claws and sever its tail.
They're extremely dangerous
and get in the way.
A plain hunt won't count—
break the parts, guaranteed!

60249.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
60249.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toa Tesukatora. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60249.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Toa Tesukatora≫!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go take a top placing!
This time SP weapons only—
choose your weapon wisely!

50507.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50507.description: It is I! The Instructor! This time the request is to explore the Highlands. The Guild reports sighting the Ice Fox Wyvern Dyuragaua. For safety I will lend you armor, but go carefully!
50507.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Today's request is a survey
of the Highlands. The Guild
reports a sighting of the
ice fox wyvern ≪Duramboros≫.
For safety I'll lend armor,
but do be careful out there!

61111.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Bone! This time we ask for joint delivery of certificates, the hunting of the specified monster, and the breaking of its parts. Do not forget to bring your certificates, and do not forget the part breaks!
61111.descriptionEn:
The Guild posts rewards for
hunters who capture many
variants and rare species.
The main reward: Wyvern Heavybone!
This time, deliver the
guarantee forms together,
hunt the specified monster
and break its parts. Don't
forget the forms or the breaks!

62450.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の捕獲
62450.description: All right, all right! Really, the potential of monsters is infinite. I want to know more and more about them, so would you catch my favorite Berukyurosu for me? From the field.
62450.descriptionEn:
All right, all right!
Monsters really do have
infinite potential, you know.
I want to know so much more
about them, so would you
catch my beloved Berukyurosu
for me?
                     From Hata

15006.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! If you can hunt a Rathian, you too will be recognised by all as a hunter!
15006.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam
has four parts in all!
To check your skill once
more, you'll hunt every
monster I specify!
Hunt a Rathian and you too
will be recognized as a
hunter by one and all!

55836.description: The Variant Species Gravios appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Gravios. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55836.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Gravios appears
to have reached a strength that
borders on the very summit of
its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters sure of their skill are
asked to take on this survey.

55598.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55598.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55598.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

54933.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Sword and Shield Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Sword and Shield Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54933.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
Sword and Shield Ribbon - Intro x100
Sword and Shield Ribbon - Mid x165
Sword and Shield Ribbon - Extreme x165
Note that accepting this quest
requires a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.

22063.description: An unexplored land has been found in the Flower Field. The Guild is surveying it, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22063.descriptionEn:
Uncharted land has been
found in the ≪Flower Field≫.
The Guild is still surveying
it, but hunters too might
like to go and take a look
for gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

62424.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62424.description: Is there anyone who wants to experience the effect of the Master's Seal? The Master's Seal speeds up the motions of drawing and sheathing, so you get far more chances to attack and heal than before! There's no special reward, so enjoy it in moderation.
62424.descriptionEn:
Does anyone want to try
out the ≪Master's Mark≫?
The ≪Master's Mark≫ speeds
up your draw and sheathe
actions, so you get far more
chances to attack or heal
than before! No special
reward, so just enjoy it.

23416.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Meraginasu, the Black Piercing Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23416.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the black-piercing
wyvern ≪Meraginasu≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.

54384.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐

50404.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

63029.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63029.description: A practice final for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Clearing it does not grant the target monster's materials.
63029.descriptionEn:
A practice final for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Clearing it does not grant
the target monster's materials.

26316.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26316.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26316.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

26432.description: On the way to and from the Canyon I keep being attacked by Felynes and Melynx and I am in trouble. At this rate I cannot deliver my goods. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26432.descriptionEn:
On the way to and from the
Canyon, I keep getting attacked
by Felynes and Melynxes.
At this rate I can't deliver my
goods. If you help me out, I'll
give you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ you can trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫ as thanks!

61659.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61659.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

56007.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Congalala, we will also grant a special item.
56007.descriptionEn:
For the newly started UL
Guild Priority Request, we've
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and support.
Breaking the Congalala's
head will also grant you
a special item as
a bonus.

51103.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
51103.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Teostra will also grant a special ingredient.
51103.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
running, we have prepared this
quest to further raise awareness
and promote them.
By breaking the Teostra's head,
we will also grant you some
special ingredients.

63401.description: Oh! Oh! Sorry to keep you waiting, meow! I came back for you, meow! This time I will beat you and become an executive, meow! If you happen to win, I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Badge, meow!
63401.descriptionEn:
Hey! Hey!
Sorry to keep you waiting, meow!
I came back for you all, meow!
This time I'll beat you
and make myself an executive, meow!
And if you lot happen
to win...
I might give you the
≪Dark Cat Gang Badge≫, meow!

21605.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
21605.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Crane Throat Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21605.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as the Crane Throat Orb?
Its material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
Clear this request and I'll
give you rare decoration
materials.

62665.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟

22009.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
22009.description: At the waterside this season, the Shield Crab Daimyo Hermitaur may show itself! Dealing damage to a body protected by a hard shell is not easy! It is also OK to carve Crab Miso from Zamite and deliver that!
22009.descriptionEn:
At the waterside this season,
the shield crab ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫
may appear! Its body is guarded
by a hard shell, so dealing
damage is no easy task! You can
also carve ≪Ceanataur Paste≫
from Hermitaurs and deliver it!

50707.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
50707.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wing claws of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
50707.descriptionEn:
We have prepared this quest
to further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
carrying out.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's
wing claws, special ingredients
will also be awarded to you.

23497.description: Brachydios's ecology is a mystery. Just when we had reports of sightings in the volcano, now comes a report of it appearing in the polar sea. A creature whose whole body is like an explosive is extremely dangerous. Head there at once and hunt it.
23497.descriptionEn:
The ecology of the Brute Wyvern
Brachydios is a mystery. Right
after sightings in the Volcano,
reports came of one appearing
in the Polar Sea. A beast whose
whole body is like an explosive
is extremely dangerous.
Head there at once and hunt it.

62880.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62880.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

21644.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲
21644.description: I want to ask you for urgent work. A bird wyvern has appeared in the Forest and Hills. Usually I would not mind, but unluckily a trade caravan is passing through, so I want it driven off at once. I do not want the smell of blood drawing other wyverns, so capture it, please. I am begging you!
21644.descriptionEn:
I have a rush job for you.
A Yian Kut-Ku has shown up in
the Forest and Hills. Usually I
would not care, but our caravan
passes through, so drive it off
quickly. The smell of blood
would draw other wyverns, so
capture it, please. I beg you!

23379.description: The survey of White Lake is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
23379.descriptionEn:
The survey of White Lake is
going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.

62674.description: An extremely powerful individual Gogomoa has appeared. Also, insect activity in Shiojima increases in the evening. The hunt will surely be harsh. Be careful.
62674.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Gogomoa
individual has appeared.
In addition, we have reports that
insects grow very active on the
Tidal Island in the evening.
There is no doubt this will be
a harsh hunt.
Please be careful out there.

63151.description: Odibatorasu the Conquest species, said to bring destruction, has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
63151.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Odibatorasu, said to
bring destruction, has appeared!
Every moment counts, so this is
a short slaying request, but to
keep the damage to a minimum,
simply repelling it will also be
counted.
We call for hunters who hold a
Secret Art and will face this
unprecedented crisis!

56013.description: Oh, comrade who loves black. This time I want you to survey and slay a ferocious black one. Of course, so that you may keep your manners, we have prepared the equipment. The long sword is already strengthened, so I'd like you to check how it handles as well. If you like it, I'll give you the materials you need.
56013.descriptionEn:
Ah, comrade who loves black.
This time I want you to survey
and slay a ferocious black one.
Of course, so that manners are
kept, we have prepared the gear
for you. The Long Sword is
already upgraded, so please
check how it handles as well.
If you like it, the materials are yours.

50567.objectiveJp:
報酬金ゼロ／タイムアップ
タイクンザムザの捕獲
50567.description: Hey, listen to me for a moment. A lance's blade wears down with every attack, right? So I wondered whether the tip could be made of some substance other than metal. There's apparently a clue to that material on Tide Island. Would you go and look for it?
50567.objectiveEn:
Reward Money Zero / Time Up
Capture Taikun Zamuza
50567.descriptionEn:
Hey, listen to me for a moment.
With a Lance, the tip wears down
every time you attack, right?
So I got to thinking: could we
not build the tip from some
material other than metal?
There is apparently a lead on
that material in the Tidal Island.
Would you go and look
for it for me?

63036.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63036.description: A monster that looks different from the usual, extremely powerful and acting in ways normally unthinkable, appears to have shown up. An examiner for hunters holding the Secret Scroll is staying here now, so prove your ability, and if you catch his eye, you can be sure to be issued many Secret Proof [Rush].
63036.descriptionEn:
A monster with a strange
appearance, incredibly
powerful and acting in ways
normally unthinkable,
seems to have appeared.
A certifier for Secret Art
holders is staying here now,
so prove your strength.
If it pleases his eye, he'll
issue many ≪Secret Proof [Urgent]≫.

21470.objectiveJp: 溶岩竜の上鱗３個の納品
21470.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Lavasioth's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21470.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon, but
I'm short on materials! At this
rate I can't go hunting.
Trade me the ≪Volganos Scale+≫
you have for this ≪Paw Pad
Medal≫! Please!

1050.description: If you're hit by the dung Congalala throws, you won't be able to use healing items! If hunting Congalala is difficult, trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
1050.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Congalala≫'s
dung and you can't use
healing items!
If hunting the ≪Congalala≫
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver the result!

23261.description: 2 beasts, red and blue, have been confirmed in the unsurveyed zone of the Canyon. According to the surveyor's report, the 2 are always fighting, and the violence of it keeps destroying nature. At this rate they may destroy the Canyon's ecosystem. Head there at once and deal with them.
23261.descriptionEn:
Two beasts, one red and one
blue, have been confirmed in
an unsurveyed part of the
Canyon. According to the
researchers, the two fight
constantly, and the sheer
violence keeps destroying
the land around them.
Left alone, the Canyon's
ecosystem may collapse. Hurry!

23183.description: I found a great spot for catching bugs! It is an old tower few people enter, and you can catch the bug said to be the strongest in the world! You should go too. Ah, when you go, I will take one of those bugs as a fee for the information.
23183.descriptionEn:
I found an amazing spot
for bug catching! It's
the Ancient Tower, where
people rarely go—and you
can catch the bug said to
be the strongest in the
world! You should really
go too. Oh, and as an
info fee, I'll take one of those bugs!

55763.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55763.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55763.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

55036.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
55036.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55036.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

55513.client: The Old Man with Gold Teeth
55513.clientEn: The Old Man with Gold Teeth

21575.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
21575.description: Have you heard of the Dragon Eye Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21575.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as the Dragon Eye Orb?
Its material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
Clear this request and I'll
give you rare decoration
materials.

61935.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の討伐

26122.description: Ioprey is a small carnivorous bird wyvern similar to Velociprey. It sometimes spits poison, and if that hits you, the poison steadily drains your health. If you are poisoned, use an Antidote to cure it.
26122.descriptionEn:
≪Ioprey≫ are small bird
wyverns, much like
≪Velociprey≫, but venomous.
They sometimes spit poison;
get hit and the venom will
slowly drain your health.
If poisoned, use an
≪Antidote≫ to cure it, okay?

26447.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
26447.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!

12025.description: The watersides of the desert are highly likely to hide the ancient Piscine Wyvern, Plesioth, lying in wait for prey. When fishing a Plesioth out with a Frog, it is important that few people are around. If you have companions, have them leave the area and settle it one on one.
12025.descriptionEn:
At the Desert's waterside, there
is a high chance the ancient fish
wyvern ≪Plesioth≫ lurks,
waiting for prey.
When angling a Plesioth with a
≪Fishing Frog≫, it is important
that few people are around.
If you have companions, have them
leave the area and settle it one
on one.

61850.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
61850.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
61850.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

12021.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
12021.description: I'm recruiting a hunter to hunt Gendrome. If you happen to have time to spare, I'd like you to deliver Herbivore Eggs gathered this season as well. They're an item popular with merchants and celebrities.
12021.descriptionEn:
I'm recruiting hunters to
hunt ≪Gendrome≫.
If you happen to have time,
I'd like ≪Herbivore Eggs≫
gathered this season too.
Merchants and socialites
adore them♪

60421.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
60421.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60421.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

40147.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
40147.description: A special request from the Hunters Guild, limited to N Course and internet cafe players. Clear the quest and get plenty of hunter rank points!
40147.descriptionEn:
A special request from the
Hunters Guild, limited to the
N Course and Net Cafes.
Clear the quest and earn
plenty of Hunter Rank
points for yourself!

23517.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
23517.description: The Variant Species Blangonga has appeared once more. Its arms have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23517.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Blangonga≫ has
appeared once again. Its arms
are stronger now, and it seems
to have grown even mightier.
Please take every care in your
survey.

62336.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

23652.description: A hunter has reported finding a Chameleos in the swamp. When they tried to slay it at once, it cloaked itself completely. The hunter felt their life in danger and fled. Go to the site and find out the true nature of the Chameleos!
23652.descriptionEn:
A hunter reported discovering
the ≪Chameleos≫ in the Swamp.
When they tried to slay it at
once, it cloaked its figure
and vanished completely.
Feeling their life in danger,
the hunter fled right away.
Head to the area and find out
the true nature of ≪Chameleos≫!

21801.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
21801.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21801.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

50558.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50558.description: You there! I hear you produced a Berukyurosu weapon. So I have a request: how about materials to upgrade to a Doragyurosu weapon as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Doragyurosu. I am counting on you!
50558.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a Berukyurosu
weapon.
So here is a request for you:
how about upgrade materials for
a Doragyurosu weapon as pay?
It is an easy job, honest.
Just run over there and slay a
Doragyurosu for me.
I am counting on you!

55918.description: A Thunder Wolf Wyvern wrapped in light, standing amid the ruins in the rain. The guild has decided to name it the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. Hunter of courage. When you drive it off, you will surely be granted the materials of guild-treasured armor.
55918.descriptionEn:
In the rain, amid ruins,
a Thunder Wolf Wyvern
wreathed in light.
The Guild has decided to
call it "Acme Roaring Zinogre".
Brave hunter,
once you drive it off,
you shall have materials
from the Guild's hidden armor.

62826.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

50848.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の討伐
50848.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50848.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

55286.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55286.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

55053.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55053.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Merit (Beginning) x５０, Hammer Merit (Middle) x６０, Hammer Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55053.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Hammer Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Hammer Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Hammer Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you must
be GR500 or higher, so please
keep that in mind.

55905.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
55905.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55905.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.

54182.objectiveJp: 木彫りの人形・茶１個の納品
54182.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54182.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.

50316.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
50316.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Yian Garuga of the jungle. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50316.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Hunt the Yian Garuga of the
Jungle and prove yourself.
Clear the quest in style and
your standing as a hunter will
jump right up!

21802.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21802.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

55856.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55856.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55856.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Magnet Spike, show us
the skill you forged against
the ≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly,
you'll earn rewards far
beyond what daily effort
would bring.

62270.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
62270.description: What, you just want a hard Heavy Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62270.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Heavy
Bowgun that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!

55547.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55547.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55547.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Hammer, show us
the skill you forged against
the ≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly,
you'll earn rewards far
beyond what daily effort
would bring.

50568.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50568.description: A hunter thinking of changing from the Hope series armor to another set. How about the Quoiz series, available from this request? It has a stylish look like the Kukubo series, so I think you will like it.
50568.descriptionEn:
To hunters thinking of trading
their Hope Series armor for
something else.
How about the Quoiz Series
armor you can obtain from
this request?
It looks as stylish as the
Kukubo Series, so I am sure
you will like it.

26402.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

55495.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55495.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

63097.description: Hunters! The hot spring town I once built is under attack by savage apes! They steal things, throw dung, and commit every outrage! Vile creatures! Unforgivable! I want you to wipe out those apes in one sweep! I wish you good hunting!
63097.descriptionEn:
Hunters! The hot spring town
I once built is under attack
by vicious monkeys!
They steal things, throw
filth, and commit every
outrage you can imagine!
Vulgar beasts! Unforgivable!
I want you to wipe out
those monkeys in one sweep!
I wish you good hunting!

62081.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐

21964.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
21964.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. Also, we have information from an attack victim that it uses lightning. Proceed with great care.
21964.descriptionEn:
The ≪Thunder Bird≫, sighted
only now and then, has spread
its territory as far as the
paths people travel.
To prevent further harm,
please hunt the target.
We also have information from
those attacked that it uses
lightning. Proceed with the
greatest caution.

21356.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Deep Forest, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Fresh Green, the Voice of Nature: Great Tree, or the Voice of Nature: Forest. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21356.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the Great Forest, you
may obtain Voice of Nature:
Verdant, Voice of Nature: Great
Tree or Voice of Nature: Forest.
I pray your hunting life grows
