splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

54162.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
54162.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54162.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

62328.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
62328.description: Have you heard from the workshop master about a special ore called the Kinos Secret Stone? If not, let me introduce this request. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special material needed to craft a certain armor. Gather enough and have the master craft it for you.
62328.descriptionEn:
Ever heard of the special
ore called ≪Kinos Gemstone≫
from the smithy master?
If not, then let me
recommend this job.
≪Kinos Gemstone≫ is a rare
material needed to forge
certain armor. Gather a few
and have the master craft it.

50892.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 8 Porta Tickets Sakura. Repel the mysterious monster that appeared at the Old Tower over and over and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade a Conquest weapon.
50892.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest
you can take in exchange for
8 Sakura Porta Tickets.
Repel the mysterious monster
that appeared at the Ancient
Tower again and again, and
you'll get materials to
upgrade ≪Zenith Weapons≫.

55117.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
55117.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Pink Rathian while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55117.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Rathian
Subspecies, you can raise your
rating while cheaply getting
the materials you need for
G Rank decorations. We've
prepared just such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

51072.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
51072.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wing claws of a Teostra will also grant a special ingredient.
51072.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking Teostra's wing
claws, special ingredients will
also be granted to you.

55327.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a shell break in slaying Daimyo Hermitaur, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55327.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ and
break its shell, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

53156.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

51028.description: In a mountain region known as the sacred peak, an elder dragon wreathed in storms has been confirmed. Many nearby villages have voiced their unease, and a swift response is needed. Hunters, head for the sacred peak at once.
51028.descriptionEn:
In a mountain region known as
the Sacred Peak, an Elder Dragon
wreathed in storms has been
confirmed. Many voices of worry
have come from nearby villages,
so a swift response is needed.
Hunters, head for the Sacred
Peak at once.

21909.description: A request that lets HR100 hunters craft and upgrade the recommended "Kirin SP Series" armor. Slay the Kirin at the Battlefield, and you'll get the crafting and upgrade materials for one piece of the "Kirin SP Series". Use them well in your hunts!
21909.descriptionEn:
A request that lets HR100
hunters craft and upgrade the
recommended "Kirin SP Series"
armor.
Slay the Kirin at the
Battlefield, and you'll get
the crafting and upgrade
materials for one piece of the
"Kirin SP Series".
Use them well in your hunts!

58070.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58070.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58070.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

54653.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54653.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

62017.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
62017.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62017.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor
obtain rewards of the official
hunting tournament, so take care.

63340.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63340.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63340.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

50679.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Artela FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50679.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of the
≪Zenith Armor≫ Arteria FX
series.
Accepting the quest requires
≪Superior Tickets≫.
Note that if you fail the
quest, your ≪Superior
Tickets≫ will be consumed.

62453.objectiveJp: ゲキレツ毒テング５個の納品
62453.description: I am developing a new accessory for Guku. This and that, the image will not settle. I want to see something, well, sharp. I want you to find reference materials in the swamp.
62453.descriptionEn:
I'm developing a new accessory
for the Gook.
This and that, nothing quite
settles into an image.
I want to see something, well,
striking.
Go find me reference materials
in the Swamp, would you?

61559.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン青３個の納品
61559.description: 1st Place server, congratulations. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Blue) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61559.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on taking 1st
place on your server!
We've readied a special reward
for hunters who cleared the
Guild Idaten Cup.
The more Blue Hunter Coins you
deliver, the better your odds
at rare materials.

23163.description: The Mosswine can sniff out the smell of mushrooms keenly and locate them precisely. I have been thinking whether we could do some business using that. First I want to know the Mosswine's ecology. Would you take a little job for me?
23163.descriptionEn:
Mosswine can sniff out the
smell of mushrooms keenly and
find the exact spot.
I've been wondering if I could
make a business of it.
First I want to know their
ecology. Would you take a
little job for me?

50503.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
50503.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR11.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon upgrades as pay?
Easy work - just run out and
slay a Gogomoa.
That's all!
I'm counting on ya!

60002.description: The season is the breeding season! The stage is the Jungle at night! Gather the monsters' eggs and deliver them! If you obtain gold or silver eggs as a reward, they can be sold for a high price! Hunters aiming to make a fortune at one stroke, do join us!
60002.descriptionEn:
The season is the breeding season!
Gather monster eggs in the Jungle
at night and deliver them!
If you get Gold or Silver Eggs in
your rewards, they sell for a high
price!
Hunters chasing a fortune, come
join us, every one of you!

26730.description: I wanted to see the Canyon's fine views once, and when I set foot there I ran into vicious monsters. In your terms, I suppose they were a Yian Garuga and a Rajang. I could not face them alone, so I could go no further and had to turn back. Please get rid of them.
26730.descriptionEn:
I longed to see the Canyon's
grand view just once, but the
moment I stepped in I met with
vicious monsters. In your terms,
they would be the Yian Garuga
and the Rajang, I believe. I
could not fight them alone, so
I could go no further and came
back. Please, drive them off!

11056.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
11056.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may be a little troublesome! A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast. The trick is not to let it escape!
11056.descriptionEn:
Hunting ≪Gendrome≫ in the volcano
region may be a bit of a bother!
A Gendrome that has spent its
stamina may flee into nasty spots
that drain a hunter's own stamina!
The trick is not to let it escape!

61171.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
61171.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!

26311.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26311.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26311.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

40210.description: You cannot run far. Fighting back will not do either. Once it begins, get close quickly. Even when things look bad, do not give up until the end. That intense light will deal unbelievable damage!
40210.descriptionEn:
You can't run far, and you
can't fight back. Close the
distance fast once it starts.
Even when it looks bad, never
give up. That intense light
deals unthinkable damage!

58115.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58115.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58115.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

62436.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
62436.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62436.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

26659.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26659.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

62587.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62587.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62587.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

26087.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26087.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

21495.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

61847.objectiveJp: キラビートル５０匹の納品
61847.description: There are all sorts of bugs in this world. Among them, I like Kira Beetles and collect lots of them. If you'll help too, bring me 50 at a time. Then I'll give you one Slash Hard Gem.
61847.descriptionEn:
There are all sorts of insects
in this world, you know.
Among them, I love the
≪Kira Beetle≫ and collect
heaps of them.
If you'll help me too, bring
them to me every 50 you
gather.
Then I'll give you one
≪Slash Hard Jade≫.

60549.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kushala Daora. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60549.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is ≪Kushala Daora≫!
You'll take on the target
together with your guildmates.
Teamwork is everything in this
contest - go take a place up
top!
Also, this one's Origin weapon
only! Choose your weapon well!

26719.description: What, you just want a hard Lance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26719.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Lance, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!

50276.description: A very ferocious Odd Species Akura Jebia is in the Desert at night, and the merchants cannot make camp. Supplies tend to run short in the cold season as it is. With your high skill you should be able to complete this request. I am counting on you!
50276.descriptionEn:
In the Desert at night, a very
savage ≪Akura Jebia Rare
Species≫ is around, and the
merchants can't make camp.
Supplies already run short in
the cold season as it is.
With your skill, you should be
able to handle this request.
I'm counting on you!

55370.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to craft Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade Transcendent armor, so please take it on!
55370.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to forge
Zinogre armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transit armor, so give
it a try!

54866.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54866.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

63334.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an Armorer's Soul: Harmony. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63334.descriptionEn:
For members of winning Hunter
Festival guilds only, we've
prepared a quest that reliably
grants ≪Smith's Soul [Wa]≫.
Please have your Festival Proof
when you accept and join.

26161.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26161.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

54975.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟

54404.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
54404.description: We are surveying the Black Gravios, the great beast that walks the volcano clad in heavy armor. Its ecology remains largely unknown. Please hunt it and lend your strength to our research!
54404.descriptionEn:
We're surveying the ≪Black
Gravios≫ in the Volcano, the
one clad in heavy armor.
Its ecology is still unknown.
Please hunt it and lend your
strength to our research!

50533.description: Hunter, this is serious! A request to slay a Meraginasu has come in! And it is a request that calls for Grable G Brave gear! Eh? You do not have any? For hunters like you I have prepared an extra Orb of Light! Just do a simple favour for me and it is yours!
50533.descriptionEn:
Hunter, we've got trouble!
A slaying request for
Meraginasu just came in!
And it needs Grable G Brave!
Eh? You don't have one?
Well, for hunters like you,
I've prepared extra "Orbs of
Light"! Just do a simple favor
for me and they're yours!

26268.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26268.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

54590.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

54552.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Baruragaru, the Blood Devouring Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54552.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Blood
Eating Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫. Accepting
the quest requires a
≪Superior Ticket≫. Note
that if the quest fails,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will
be consumed.

26328.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26328.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26328.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

60034.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
60034.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!

62603.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス２頭の狩猟

60931.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
60931.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
60931.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.

21870.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
21870.description: Lately an unexplained situation has arisen in the highlands. There was a report that herbivores are decreasing in one area. When we went to investigate, strange sounds rang out from nowhere, and the investigator fled in fear. Please investigate at once.
21870.descriptionEn:
Lately, unexplained events
have been happening in the
Highlands. Herbivores are
said to be declining in one
area. Our surveyors went,
heard a strange sound from
nowhere and fled in fear.
Please begin a survey at once.

40204.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟

50861.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50861.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50861.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Long
Sword, show us the skill you have
honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

55334.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55334.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55334.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Akura Vashimu
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous as it is.
Prepare thoroughly and carry
out the survey.

21773.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21773.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21773.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

63285.description: A Supremacy Doragyurosu, said to reduce all to ash, has appeared! Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
63285.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Doragyurosu, said to
reduce all things to ash, has
appeared!
This is a race against time, so
the request is to slay it in a
short time, but to keep the
damage minimal, a mere repel will
also be counted.
We seek hunters with Secret Arts
who will face this
unprecedented crisis!

60542.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
60542.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blue Yian Kut-Ku. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60542.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is ≪Yian Kut-Ku
Subspecies≫!
You'll take on the target
together with your guildmates.
Teamwork is everything in this
contest - go take a top spot!
Also, SP weapons only this
time! Choose your weapon well!

1031.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
1031.description: A Diablos with a blackened body colour and a dreadfully fearsome appearance has been sighted! It must be a subspecies. If you succeed in hunting this subspecies, your skill may exceed even my imagination!
1031.descriptionEn:
A Diablos with blackened hide
and a truly terrifying shape
has been sighted! It's got to
be the Subspecies. If you can
hunt it down, your skill might
be beyond what even I can
imagine!

26174.description: I am in trouble. In the cold season I cannot keep up with the supply of ingredients. Sorry, but would you help me with the purchasing? As thanks I will give you my wife's prized ingredients.
26174.descriptionEn:
I'm in trouble.
The cold season has me short
on ingredients.
Sorry, but would you help me
with the supply run?
As thanks, I'll give you my
wife's prized ingredients.

55703.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55703.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55703.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
to craft one Supremacy
weapon from the Supremacy
Daimyo Hermitaur and upgrade
it once, plus Porta Cards
Sakura worth Gz. Weapon
types: Dual Blades, Hunting
Horn, Switch Axe, Light
Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun or Bow.
Use it to craft your favorite.

62317.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Gravios. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62317.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
to slay Gravios.
The reward is a bit lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
sharpen your skills against
other hunters?

40190.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
40190.description: To all who aim for the heights of GR: we prepared a quest where slaying a Gasurabazura raises your standing and lets you cheaply obtain the materials needed for G Rank decorations. Please make good use of it.
40190.descriptionEn:
To all who aim for the
heights of GR: we prepared a
quest where slaying a
Gasurabazura raises your
standing and lets you cheaply
obtain the materials needed
for G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.

26371.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26371.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26371.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

12034.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
12034.description: Iodrome hits harder in a single blow than Velocidrome or Gendrome. If you feel your life is in danger, deliver Specialty Mushrooms growing in the swamp. Aging them in a Maka Pickling Jar is fine too, you know?
12034.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ hits harder per
blow than a Velocidrome or
Gendrome.
If your life feels at risk,
deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫
growing in the swamp. You
may age them in a ≪Maka Pot≫?

62816.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

55767.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55767.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

53228.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐

23553.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23553.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

54128.description: We are seeking hunters to help survey the Midogaron that appeared in the volcano. Midogaron generally act alone, and we believe that is because they are strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request, and only hunters with a solid record should apply.
54128.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to help
survey the Midogaron that appeared
in the Volcano.
Midogaron basically acts alone,
but that is thought to be because
it is strong enough that it has no
need to gather in packs.
This request is dangerous for any
hunter without a solid record.

21331.description: What, you just want a hard Light Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21331.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Light Bowgun? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!

53102.description: I gathered the supplies you collected where the Chacha were about to hold their feast, and a Gravios came around! At this rate my friends will be too frightened to come out. Hunt it in equipment that will not frighten them!
53102.descriptionEn:
I piled up the stuff you
gathered where the Chachabu
were about to throw a feast,
and then a Gravios came
wandering over!
At this rate my friends are
too scared to come out.
Go hunt it in gear that won't
startle them!

62391.description: This is a trial quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Enjoy all the new features of Forward.2 to the fullest!
62391.descriptionEn:
This is a trial quest for the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Enjoy all the new features of
Forward.2 to the fullest!

26339.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26339.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26339.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

26134.description: It is I, the Instructor! Good that you read this Quest Confirmation! Nice! Whatever the quest, important hints essential to clearing it are written here. Make sure you read them!
26134.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
You have done well to read
this ≪Quest Check≫! Nice!
Whatever the quest, the vital
hints you need to clear it are
written right here.
Make sure you always read them!

55670.description: To take this quest you need a Hunter Ring (Purple), nya. Take on the hunt for a Bulldrome holding more Song Gems than usual, nya. Choose a Prayer Gem, clear this quest and offer the Song Gems, nya!
55670.descriptionEn:
To take this quest you need a
"Hunter Ring Purple", meow.
You'll be hunting a Bulldrome
that holds more Song Orbs than
usual, meow.
Pick a Prayer Bead, clear this
quest, and offer up the Song
Orbs, meow!

61906.objectiveJp: リオレウス変種１頭の狩猟
61906.description: The King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian, who have reigned over the frontier since ages past. Their variant individuals are gathering in the Forest and Hills to breed. Do not forget that only one pitfall trap or shock trap may be set!
61906.descriptionEn:
Since ages past, the king of the
skies ≪Rathalos≫ and the queen
of the land ≪Rathian≫ have
ruled these frontier lands.
Their variants gather in the
Forest and Hills to breed.
Do not forget that you may set
only one pitfall or shock trap!

61412.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

55458.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55458.description: The scorching-zero dragon has shown itself again at the summit of the Tower. The Guild is looking for hunters willing to attempt part breaks for research. Those who report on the state of the breaks will receive a small token of thanks.
55458.descriptionEn:
The Eruzerion has shown itself
at the top of the Tower once
again.
The guild seeks hunters who
will attempt part breaks for our
research.
Those who report how the break
went will receive a small token
of thanks.

53276.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の捕獲
53276.description: My friend goes on about the twin gods of Alke, the Jet Black Darkness, the Sunshine Vice, but I do not understand. In short, it seems they want me to weaken the incomplete Jet Black Darkness and capture it before something terrible happens. I want to do something about it in many senses, so please.
53276.descriptionEn:
The Twin Gods of Arche, the
Pitch-Black Darkness, the Vice
of Sunlight - my friend keeps
going on about them, but I
don't follow. Before anything
awful happens, he wants the
incomplete Pitch-Black
Darkness weakened and caught.
Please, do something!

63318.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
63318.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Diablos, then slay the Diablos here in this arena!
63318.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill! Any who are sure
they can dance around a
horned wyvern, step into this
Arena and slay ≪Diablos≫!
Show us what you've got!

23557.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23557.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

54097.description: I ask you to hunt a Tigrex in the Snowy Mountains for a survey. This time we plan to examine thoroughly the tail and claws that are characteristic of a Tigrex. Be sure to break and sever these 2 before the hunt. I know it is hard work, but I ask your help.
54097.descriptionEn:
I'm asking you to hunt the
Tigrex in the Snowy Mountains
for a survey.
This time we'll thoroughly
study its tail and claws -
its defining features.
Be sure to break and sever
both before you finish it.
I know it's a handful. Thanks.

50498.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
50498.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Taikun Zamuza. I am counting on you!
50498.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR31.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon upgrades as pay?
Easy work - just run out and
slay a Taikun Zamuza.
That's all!
I'm counting on ya!

23302.description: I have made yet another new discovery! A lump of ice of high purity that will not melt, the Eternal Ice Block. Gather several and I can produce a beautiful blue block of ice. Help me gather the materials again and I will share the product.
23302.descriptionEn:
I've made yet another new
discovery! A chunk of ice of
high purity that hardly melts,
the "Eternal Ice Chunk." Gather
several and I can create a
beautiful azure ice chunk.
If you help me gather
materials again, I'll share
the results with you.

55067.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
55067.description: To support all the hunters who have just been promoted to G Rank, we have prepared a special quest. Let us learn the basics of hunting G Rank monsters while obtaining new decorations!
55067.descriptionEn:
To support all the hunters who have
just been promoted to G Rank, we
have prepared a special quest.
Let us learn the basics of hunting
G Rank monsters while obtaining
new decorations!

28042.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
28042.description: Looking back on the basics is very important. Let us recall our days as fresh hunters and hunt properly. Of course, I will pay a proper reward.
28042.descriptionEn:
Looking back on the basics is
so important.
Let's recall your rookie days
and do some solid hunting.
Of course, I'll pay you
properly for it.
That's a promise!

26603.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
26603.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Chlor Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26603.descriptionEn:
Notes said to have been lost,
recording the secret of weapon
crafting, are apparently being
found on monsters slain across
the land, I tell ya!
If you get a ≪Chlor Memo≫, be a
man! Bring it to this workshop
master!
I will show you good work, I
will!

63174.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63174.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63174.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

61910.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン白３個の納品
61910.description: For those hunters who have obtained White Hunter Coins, we have prepared a dedicated reward. The more White Hunter Coins you deliver, the better your chance of receiving rare materials.
61910.descriptionEn:
To all Hunters who obtained
White Hunter Coins, we have
prepared a special reward.
The more White Hunter Coins
you deliver, the better your
chance of getting rare
materials.

11005.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
11005.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, is tough and a brute, so take great care! Especially in this cold season, it will be on edge from hunger! Catching and delivering a Goldenfish instead of pushing yourself is another option, you know!?
11005.descriptionEn:
The Bulldrome, leader of the
Bullfango, is tough and wild, so
take care!
In this cold season especially,
it will be hungry and on edge!
Fishing up a Goldenfish and
delivering that is also an
option, you know!?

54875.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
54875.description: I have received a report that a Doragyurosu was found in the highlands. However, it apparently performs special behavior not recorded in any report to date. Please do investigate the Doragyurosu.
54875.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Dark Thunder Wyvern≫ was
found in the Highlands.
However, it apparently behaves
in special ways not recorded in
any report so far. We would very
much like you to survey ≪Diorex≫.

1082.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared. You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best out there.
1082.descriptionEn:
It seems the Kirin, an elder
dragon, has appeared in the
Ancient Tower, that unopened
land of many mysteries beyond
this place.
You cannot go to the Tower any
time; only while the weather and
every other condition is stable.
Do your best out there.

53260.description: I've built a prototype of a new light bowgun, and I want your help with a performance test. I won't ask anything difficult. Just hunt as you always do. Hunt 3 times and I'll make a prototype for you as well. Get the production materials from Mizuki.
53260.descriptionEn:
I've built a prototype Light
Bowgun, and I want your help
with a performance test.
Nothing difficult, I promise.
Just hunt like you always do.
Do three hunts and I'll make
a prototype for you too.
Get the crafting materials
from Mizuki.

63160.objectiveJp: 弩岩竜の崩鱗５個の納品
63160.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 5 Midogaron Shattered Scales and I will give you 6 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63160.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it down, meow! This
is a secret trade spot, meow.
Give me 5 ≪Rukodiora Shards≫,
and I'll give you 6 ≪Master
Cat's Favorite≫, meow.
Slip them to the Master Cat
quietly and he'll make you
≪Hardcore Cat Weapons≫ with no
materials, meow! Aim for the
dream jackpot, meow!

40212.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
40212.description: Monsters are approaching the square. Slaying elder dragons is our top priority. If we cannot slay them, there is no future. Hunters, I leave the rest to you.
40212.descriptionEn:
Monsters are closing in on the
square.
Slaying the elder dragon is our
highest priority.

If we fail to slay it, there is
no future.

Hunters, the rest is yours.

55799.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55799.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55799.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

50592.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50592.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

50581.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50581.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and you will obtain a variety of tools useful in the hunt.
50581.descriptionEn:
A special request and reward,
just for members of winning
Hunter Festival guilds.
Please have your Festival
Proof when you accept or join.
Clear this request and you'll
get all sorts of items useful
for hunting.

60596.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gravios. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin, Transcendent and Aberrant weapons only!
60596.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is ≪Gravios≫!
To hunt a monster all on your
own shows real spirit - truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a place up top!
This one is Origin, Transition
and Supremacy weapons only!

50127.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
50127.description: A child of a family visiting the resort wandered into a cave. We managed to rescue them safely, but a monster seems to have taken up residence deep in the cave. Once something happens it is too late. Hunt that thing at once!
50127.descriptionEn:
A child from a family visiting
the resort got lost inside a
cave.
We got them out safely, but
apparently a monster has taken
up residence deep inside.
Waiting is too late.
Hunt that thing, and hurry!

21132.description: A blue subspecies of Rathalos has been confirmed in the Forest and Hills. Whoever overcomes its peerless vitality will hold power beyond that of a dragon. I should like to see which hunter harbors such ability.
21132.descriptionEn:
An Azure ≪Rathalos≫ has
been sighted in the
≪Forest and Hills≫, it
seems. Whoever bests its
unmatched vitality gains
power beyond a dragon. I
would love to see who.

28003.description: This time it is a challenge to all you hunting party members, meow. For this quest we have prepared lovely rewards for the sub-targets, meow. But since the main target can be cleared easily, sometimes you may need to protect the Felynes, meow. I wish you good hunting, meow.
28003.descriptionEn:
This time it's a challenge to
all you guild members, meow.
This quest has a lovely reward
set up for the sub-target,
meow. But the main target is
easy to clear, so sometimes
you may need to protect the
Felyne too, meow.
Best of luck, meow!

60307.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

61112.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hardclaw! This time we ask for joint delivery of certificates, the hunting of the specified monster, and the breaking of its parts. Do not forget to bring your certificates, and do not forget the part breaks!
61112.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who capture many
Variants and Rare Species.
Main reward: Wyvern Hardclaws!
This time, deliver the
certificates together, hunt
the designated monster, and
break its parts. Don't forget
the certificates or breaks!

61166.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61166.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

54652.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54652.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

50606.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１０匹の討伐
50606.description: This time those lot seem to have fled into the Swamp. Disguise yourself as them and lure them out. If you cannot find them, anger a Rathian and give them a fright! Then they will come out whether they like it or not.
50606.descriptionEn:
This time the lot seem to
have fled into the Swamp.
Disguise yourself as one of
them and draw them out.
If you can't find them, rile
up a Rathian and give them a
scare! They'll come out then.

26712.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
26712.description: I was gathering and fishing in the Jungle when a Daimyo Hermitaur and a Plesioth suddenly came and ruined everything. I will give you the fish and gathered goods that are left, so please hunt the Daimyo Hermitaur, break its parts, and fish up the Plesioth. The Plesioth is my catch, so you need not slay it.
26712.descriptionEn:
I was gathering and fishing in the
Jungle when a Daimyo Hermitaur and a
Plesioth turned up and ruined the
whole thing for me.
You can have the fish and the
gathered goods, so hunt the
Daimyo Hermitaur, break its parts,
and reel in the Plesioth for me.
That Plesioth is my catch, so
you don't need to slay it.

61361.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
61361.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61361.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

62505.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62505.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

21070.description: For hunters who want to make ore weapons, mining is the very basics! First, start by learning where you can mine. If you find cracks in a cliff, try digging with a Pickaxe!
21070.descriptionEn:
For hunters who want to make ore
type weapons, mining is the very
basics of the basics!
First, let us start by learning where
you can mine.
If you find cracks in a cliff or
similar, try digging with a
≪Pickaxe≫!

55382.description: The nostalgic Variety Soul quest is back again! This time the subject is Baruragaru. Clear it quickly and earn plenty of souls! Rare materials also seem a little easier to obtain than usual.
55382.descriptionEn:
The nostalgic Variety Soul
event is back! This time the
task is a Taikun Zamuza hunt.
Clear it quick and earn lots
of souls! Rare materials seem
a little easier to get than
usual, too.

50624.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50624.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Khezu will also grant a special ingredient.
50624.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
running, we have prepared this
quest to further raise awareness
and promote them.
By breaking the Khezu's head and
body, we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

21062.description: We are looking for people to slay 8 Genprey, the hunters of the desert! They are just the right opponents to measure your skill as a hunter!
21062.descriptionEn:
Recruiting hunters to slay 8
Desert Hunter ≪Ioprey≫!
They are just the right foe for
gauging a hunter's skill at
the hunt!

63169.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２匹の討伐
63169.description: The Shakalaka seem to be plotting something amusing. Would you go and take a look? They will be on guard if you go as you are, so dress properly as a Shakalaka and go to investigate. Right then, I am counting on you!
63169.descriptionEn:
Looks like the Masked Folk are
plotting something fun.
Would you go take a look?
They'd get suspicious if you
just walked in, so go survey
them properly disguised as one
of them.
Right then, off you go!

21120.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

62395.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a Gunlance that fires powerful shells. Take the armor and Gunlance set prepared for you and hunt the sleeping bird Hypnocatrice in the New Grand Arena! Make good use of the weapon's strengths!
62395.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time you'll hunt with the
Gunlance and its heavy shells.
Take the armor and Gunlance
set prepared for you and hunt
the Sleeping Bird
≪Hypnocatrice≫ at the New
Great Arena! Use it well!

61930.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
61930.description: This is a practice qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61930.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament practice qualifier
quest. In the finals, the
time limit is 5 minutes.
Also, from the monster's
carving and clear rewards,
the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained.

58071.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58071.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58071.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

60508.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
60508.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Velocidrome will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
60508.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, it has been decided to
recommend trialing a new kind
of sub-target.
Our Guild will judge the set
amount of damage dealt to
≪Velocidrome≫, so please all
focus solely on the main target!

23494.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟

54360.description: There was a report of encountering a ferocious Espinas in the sea of trees. Once roused, it attacks the creatures around it, they say. At this rate, the ecosystem of the sea of trees will suffer. Before it is too late, please slay the target.
54360.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a ferocious
≪Espinas≫ in the Great Forest.
Once roused, it apparently
attacks every living thing
around it.
Left alone, it will upset the
forest's whole ecosystem.
Slay it before it's too late.

21048.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
21048.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this breeding season there are more herbivore monsters, so delivering Raw Meat is easy too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
21048.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 8 Special
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle
region! In this breeding season
there are more herbivores, so
≪Raw Meat≫ is easy to deliver
too! First learn the Jungle,
then get used to it.

60822.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60822.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60822.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.

55788.description: They have found the true hide-and-seek king and are waiting for challengers again with their new king, meow. According to my friends, if you slay a certain number of Shakalaka, the hide-and-seek king will appear, meow. Do your best, meow.
55788.descriptionEn:
They found the true Hide-and-
Seek King, and now they wait
for challengers again with
their new king, meow. My pals
say slaying a set number of
Masked Folk makes the
Hide-and-Seek King appear.

50662.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
50662.description: Thanks to everyone, a white Christmas arrived just as the legend said, but what actually appeared was not that red gentleman but a crimson Khezu subspecies! This will shatter the children's dreams! For the children's sake, please become that gentleman yourself and hunt it down!
50662.descriptionEn:
Thanks to you all, a "White
Christmas" came just as the
legend says - but what came
wasn't that red-clad fellow,
it was a crimson Khezu
Subspecies!
This will shatter the kids'
dreams! For their sake,
please dress up as that fellow
yourself and go slay it!

62594.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
62594.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62594.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

50642.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Leaping Scarlet Beast on Tide Island! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50642.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show the skill
you've honed against the
≪Hyujikiki≫ on Tidal Island!
Hunt it well, and you'll earn
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.

55172.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Hypnocatrice Rare Species while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55172.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Hypnocatrice Rare
Species, you can raise your
rating while cheaply getting
the materials you need for
G Rank decorations. We've
readied just such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

55372.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Brachydios armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55372.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want
the armor of the Crushing
Wyvern ≪Brachydios≫! Clear
the sub targets to obtain
materials for Sen'yuu Armor
upgrades. Please try it!

54314.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54314.description: We will continue the investigation of the Gurenzeburu that appeared in the highlands. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54314.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Gurenzeburu that appeared
in the Highlands.
Breaking parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you do!
Hunters, we ask for your
kind cooperation!

61819.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
61819.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 5 minutes. With some exceptions, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
61819.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 5 minutes.
With some exceptions, the target
monster's materials cannot be
obtained by carving or from the
clear reward.

60638.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
60638.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Dyuragaua. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin, Transcendent and Aberrant weapons only!
60638.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is ≪Duramboros≫!
To hunt a monster all on your
own shows real spirit - truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a place up top!
This one is Origin, Transition
and Supremacy weapons only!

63052.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
63052.description: This is a preliminary quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes.
63052.descriptionEn:
This is a preliminary quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.

21839.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62540.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62540.description: Reading the lost map has revealed a new fact. A Pariapuria more terrible than the usual sort seems to dwell on Tide Island. Hunt it and I will hand over the Guild's secret Heavenstorm Sanskrit Scroll. Will the ecological survey never end?
62540.descriptionEn:
Deciphering the lost map revealed
a new fact.
On the Tidal Island dwells a Gluttonous
Wyvern more terrible than any normal
individual, it seems.
If you hunt it for us, I will hand over
the guild's treasured ≪Heavenstorm
Sanskrit Tome≫.
Will the ecological surveys never end?

61836.objectiveJp: 七色たんぽぽ５０個の納品
61836.description: Greetings. We meet for the first time. Do you gather between hunts? I think this is a good opportunity, so would you show me the fruits of your gathering? Of course, I will pay.
61836.descriptionEn:
Good day to you.
How do you do.
Do you do any gathering
between your hunts now and then?
I think this is a good opportunity,
so would you show me
the results of your gathering?
Of course, I will give you
a reward for your trouble.

50653.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
50653.description: Congratulations on reaching HR5! This quest gives you materials to craft the Kukuboshi series and upgrade materials for the original Corude Series. Do give the Kukuboshi series to your partner as a present.
50653.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR5!
This quest gives you materials
to craft the Kukuboshi series
and upgrade materials for the
original ≪Corude Series≫.
Do give the Kukuboshi series
to your partner as a
present.

54522.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54522.description: Hey, you! Lend me a hand, would you? Lately the Highlands get suddenly noisy at night and I can't sleep at all! It must be Poborubarumu rampaging! Can't you do something to stop it? Come on, please!!
54522.descriptionEn:
Hey, you! Could you lend me
a hand? Lately the
Highlands get so loud at
night that I can't sleep at
all! It must be the Sound
Dragon on a rampage!
Can you stop it somehow?
Come on,
I'm begging you!!

61972.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
61972.description: Do you know? There is a game where you hunt monsters and, with luck, a huge amount of zenny comes back. Give me an Event Assistance Ticket and I will tell you where. How about it? Want to try?
61972.descriptionEn:
Hey, you know?
Hunt monsters, and if you're
lucky, a huge pile of zenny
comes right back to you!
Bring me an ≪Event
Assistance Ticket≫ and I'll
show you where. How about it?
Want to give it a try?

50018.description: What is that black shadow covering the Tower, you ask? That is the elder dragon Yama Tsukami. The materials from Yama Tsukami are valuable. Hunters flock up the Tower, but many come back down unable to beat it. If you are confident in your skill, why not try?
50018.descriptionEn:
What's that black shadow
covering the Tower? That is
the Elder Dragon Yama
Tsukami. Its materials are
valuable, you see. Hunters
flock up the Tower, but many
come back down beaten. If
you're confident in your
arm, why not try it too.

62406.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62406.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62406.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

62559.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62559.description: Next is the ice fox wyvern. Luring it to the arena went well as before, but a Bulldrome came in at the same time. On top of that, the trap was only half set! It is dangerous inside, but if you hunt it I will share some Beast Horns.
62559.descriptionEn:
Now then, next is the Ice Fox
Wyvern. Luring it into the
Arena went fine, same as last
time, but Bullfango came in
with it. Worse, the trap is
only half set!
It's dangerous in there, but
hunt it and I'll share ≪Beast
Horns≫ with you.

54349.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54349.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the claws of Daimyo Hermitaur, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54349.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly started
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we've prepared this
quest to raise awareness and
promote them further.
Breaking the Daimyo
Hermitaur's claws will also
grant you special ingredients.

54339.description: There is a report that 2 jet-black wyverns were seen in a part of the Ancient Tower where few tread. This is a survey request, but if the report is true, ordinary hunters cannot handle them. We recommend only hunters confident in their skill go.
54339.descriptionEn:
There was a report that two jet-black
Flying Wyverns were seen in a part
of the Ancient Tower where people
rarely set foot. This is a survey
request, but if the report is true,
ordinary Hunters cannot handle them.
I recommend that only Hunters
confident in their own skill
make the trip.

53079.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
53079.description: Great numbers of Bulldrome seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Bulldrome! If you do it splendidly, we will give you higher standing than usual and consumables!
53079.descriptionEn:
Great Boars seem to be
swarming in huge numbers
around Mezeporta!
Hunters, please lend a hand
in slaying them!
Slay them well and I'll give
you higher than usual rating
and consumables!

62926.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Jungle, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Crags or the Voice of Nature: Deep Sea. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62926.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the Jungle, you may
obtain Voice of Nature: Strange
Rock or Voice of Nature: Deep
Sea.
I pray your hunting life grows
all the richer for it.

61554.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61554.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21422.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

26548.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Shell! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26548.descriptionEn:
The Guild rewards hunters who
break many parts of Variant
and Kishu monsters. The main
reward is a Wyvern's Heavy
Shell! Deliver the
certificate when you accept
or join, then hunt the
specified monster. It cannot
be returned after departure.

61219.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61219.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.

12057.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, would you plant the Guild Flag at the summit for me?
12057.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, has no
fixed territory, and because
its numbers are so few it is
also called the Phantom Beast.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
could you plant a Guild Flag
at the summit for me?

53110.description: This quest gives production materials for the Great Sword whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
53110.descriptionEn:
This is a quest to obtain the
crafting materials of a Great
Sword whose performance was
settled by a survey held to
commemorate 700,000 Zinogre
hunted in the Zinogre hunting
unlock event "Transcendent
Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre".

62484.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
62484.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62484.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

23449.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Sword and Shield Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Sword and Shield Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23449.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
Sword and Shield Ribbon - Intro x100
Sword and Shield Ribbon - Mid x165
Sword and Shield Ribbon - Extreme x165
Note that accepting this quest
requires a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.

63055.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
63055.description: A Pariapuria seems to have attacked merchants in the highlands. It shows no sign of moving from the spot, and the area has been closed off as dangerous. The content of this request is to secure the safety of the highlands. Master hunters, I am counting on you!
63055.descriptionEn:
A ≪Pariapuria≫ seems to have
attacked the merchants in
the Highlands. It shows no
sign of moving on, and the
area is sealed off as
dangerous. This request is
to secure the Highlands.
Skilled hunters, do it!

63110.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
63110.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63110.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

21136.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
21136.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!

55683.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Espinas. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55683.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
monster ≪Espinas≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.

61722.description: Thank you for gathering so many ingredients. The Wyverian lady was pleased too. I am sorry to impose after inviting you, but could you take this job? A Rajang has appeared in the snowy mountains, and some people cannot get here. Please.
61722.descriptionEn:
Thanks for bringing in all
those ingredients. The
Wyverian lady was pleased too.
I know it's rude to ask after
inviting you here, but could
you take this request?
A ≪Rajang≫ has shown up in the
Snowy Mountains, and folks
can't get through. Please?

26242.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

54332.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
54332.description: A quest for the New Weapon Type 'Tonfa' Trial Event. Enjoy MHF-GG a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 20 minutes.
54332.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the ≪new
weapon trial: Tonfa≫.
Get an early taste of
MHF-GG ahead of release!
Time limit: 20 minutes.

26365.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26365.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

21231.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
21231.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21231.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

62309.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

26397.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品
26397.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26397.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!

61870.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の討伐
61870.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61870.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

54609.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章２個の納品
54609.description: By completing this request, you can obtain materials for the Tangus G Series and the Kobalt G Series. Guild Black Crystal Citation x2, Guild Black Radiance Citation x2, Guild Dark Vermilion Citation x2.
54609.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to obtain
the materials for the ≪Tangus
G Series≫ and the ≪Kobalt
G Series≫.
- Black Crystal Honors x2
- Black Radiance Honors x2
- Dark Crimson Honors x2
All for the taking!

26455.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26455.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26455.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

54710.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
54710.description: A trial quest for the G8 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy G8 monsters a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54710.descriptionEn:
A trial quest for the
"G8 Early Access Preview".
Get a head start on G8
monsters!
Time limit: 10 minutes.

60950.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書４枚の納品
60950.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hard Tail! Bring the specified number of Part Break Certificates yourself. You will also receive more rewards if you break the specified monster's parts and hunt it.
60950.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who break many parts
on Variants and Rare Species.
Main reward: Wyvern Hardtails!
Bring the required part-break
certificates all by yourself.
Also, breaking parts on or
hunting the designated monster
earns you even more rewards.

61635.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61635.description: A powerful storm has arisen in the Jungle. It seems to be the work of Kushala Daora, but it appears to be an extremely powerful individual, and witnesses report feeling an extraordinary power from its body unlike anything seen before. It is dangerous, but please investigate somehow.
61635.descriptionEn:
A mighty storm has broken out
in the Jungle. It looks like the
work of Kushala Daora, but an
extremely powerful individual,
judging by witnesses who say
they felt an uncanny force from
its body unlike anything before.
Dangerous, but please survey it.

53302.description: I hear a colossal Basarios has appeared in the volcano. I want its tail cut cleanly, so I have prepared a Long Sword. As a Basarios devotee, I simply must have the tail of that giant! I am counting on you!
53302.descriptionEn:
I heard a colossal Basarios
has appeared in the Volcano.
I want its tail cut off clean,
so I've readied a Long Sword.
As a Basarios maniac, I simply
must have that colossal
Basarios tail!
I'm counting on you!

60026.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

23407.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
23407.description: It has been a long time. When did I last forge your Pale Thorn Blade? Now, obtain the material said to come from only one in thousands of Espinas Rare Species, and release its true power.
23407.descriptionEn:
It has been a long while.
When did I last forge your
"White Thorn Long Sword"?
Now, go and take the material
said to come from only one
among thousands of Espinas
Rare Species, and unleash
the true power within it.

56051.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Giaorugu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Lance, Gunlance, Hammer, Tonfa, or Magnet Spike. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56051.descriptionEn:
From a Supremacy Giaorugu you
can get the materials to craft
one Supremacy weapon, upgrade
it two steps, plus Gz worth of
Sakura Porta Cards.
