50506.description: It is I! The Instructor! This time the request is to explore the Canyon. The Guild reports sighting the dancing thunder wyvern Berukyurosu. For safety I will lend you armor, but go carefully!
50506.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
This request is an exploration
of the Canyon.
The Guild reports a sighting
of the Thunder Wyvern
≪Berukyurosu≫, so I'll lend
armor. Mind yourself out there!

50057.objectiveJp: クレンザイト１個の納品

61454.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61454.description: A powerful storm has arisen in the Jungle. It seems to be the work of Kushala Daora, but it appears to be an extremely powerful individual, and witnesses report feeling an extraordinary power from its body unlike anything seen before. It is dangerous, but please investigate somehow.
61454.descriptionEn:
A mighty storm has broken out
in the Jungle. It looks like the
work of Kushala Daora, but an
extremely powerful individual,
judging by witnesses who say
they felt an uncanny force from
its body unlike anything before.
Dangerous, but please survey it.

54881.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
54881.description: Sightings are coming in from the Snowy Mountains of a Doragyurosu more powerful than any so far. The Hunters Guild has decided to ask you hunters to investigate. Hunters who can cooperate, head for the Snowy Mountains at once.
54881.descriptionEn:
Reports are coming in of a
Doragyurosu in the Snowy
Mountains, far stronger than any
seen before.
The Hunters Guild has decided to
ask all of you to carry out a
survey.
Hunters able to help, please
head for the Snowy Mountains at
once.

62234.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐

26255.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟

62511.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62511.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62511.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

60013.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
60013.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time your opponent is the scorching conqueror Gravios, hailed as the strongest class of flying wyvern! Is there a hunter who can slay two of these wyverns at once, when even one is utter hardship!?
60013.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
their skill! Today's foe is
the scorching ruler Gravios,
called the strongest of the
flying wyverns! Two at once!
Could any hunter truly hunt
two of these at the same time!?

26171.description: Patients wounded and suffering from illness need nourishing food. I want to give at least the patients in the square proper care, but there is still not enough... Hunters, I am counting on you.
26171.descriptionEn:
Wounded patients suffering from
illness need nourishing food.
At the very least I want to give
the patients in the plaza proper
care, but we still lack the numbers….
Hunters, I am counting on you.

58067.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58067.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58067.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

62037.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62037.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Teostra. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62037.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are seeking someone to
eliminate an extremely powerful
≪Teostra≫.
If you manage to slay it, we
shall issue more slaying
certificates than usual!

11031.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

21039.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21039.description: Blangonga rules the Snowy Mountains! It shows no mercy to those who trespass on its territory! Ah, and this season a rare species of Velociprey seems to come to raise its eggs. You'd best not touch the Carnivore Eggs!
21039.descriptionEn:
≪Blangonga≫ is the lord of
the Snowy Mountains! It has
no mercy for trespassers!
Oh, and rare Velociprey
seem to come raise eggs
this season. Better not
touch their ≪Carnivore Eggs≫!

60642.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gypceros. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60642.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Gypceros≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster
all alone is truly fine!
Overcome yourself and take
a splendid top placement!
Genesis Weapons only this time!

53125.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
53125.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
53125.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

21695.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
21695.description: We have reports that Kushala Daora is currently flying toward Mezeporuta. Hunters confident in their skill should meet it at the interception base and slay it, making use of the abundant supplies and interception weapons.
21695.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in that a
Kushala Daora is flying toward
Mezeporuta right now.
Hunters confident in their skill
should intercept it at the Base,
and use the plentiful supplies
and the interception weapons to slay it.

26325.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26325.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26325.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

61892.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退

62242.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62242.description: What, you just want a hard Great Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62242.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Great Sword? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!

50632.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50632.description: This is the PC version High Grade Edition trial quest. The time limit is 10 minutes.
50632.descriptionEn:
PC Version
High Grade Edition
Trial Quest.
The time limit is set
at 10 minutes.

54299.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Supreme Orb, as your reward.
54299.descriptionEn:
Inside monsters, you can
sometimes find things like
spheres. They can be used as
materials for all sorts of
weapons and armor, and demand
has risen lately. Clear this
request and I will give you
one such sphere, ≪Supreme
Gem≫, as a reward.

50894.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50894.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50894.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

50094.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
50094.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50094.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

23253.description: I am a man who does business with ships. Once I found a Pokaradon in the polar sea. With that warm-looking fur, I am sure good goods could be made. Could I ask you to hunt it?
23253.descriptionEn:
I'm a man who does business
with ships, you see. Once
I found a Pokaradon in
the Polar Sea.
With that warm-looking fur,
I'm sure I could make
good merchandise. Could
you hunt one for me?

21690.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21690.description: Have you heard of the White Porcelain Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21690.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere called
Hakuji Orb?
Its material is essential to
forging a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I shall give you a precious
decoration material.

61209.description: A mighty flame thought to belong to an Elder Dragon has been observed in the swamp. Please investigate at once. It is too dangerous to supply items, but please come back safely somehow.
61209.descriptionEn:
A powerful flame, believed to
belong to an Elder Dragon, has
been observed in the Swamp.
Please carry out an urgent survey.
It is so dangerous that we cannot
even supply items, but please,
come back safely no matter what.

63186.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63186.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

23631.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23631.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23631.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you honed against the ≪Tigrex≫
in the Desert!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you.

54945.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Bow Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Bow Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54945.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Bow Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Bow Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Bow Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

54534.description: Please investigate the Crystal Wyvern lurking in the highlands. If you not only hunt it but break its head and tail, I will add to the reward!
54534.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Kuarlusepusu
lurking in the Highlands.
Not only the hunt,
break its head and
cut its tail, and I'll add
extra reward on top
for you!

60573.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Inagami! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60573.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Inagami≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! Also, this is Origin
weapons only, so choose well!

22118.description: To all hunters who lose sight of monsters: have you ever missed with a paintball and lost track of one? For you we have prepared a decoration.
22118.descriptionEn:
To all hunters who keep losing
track of monsters

Have you ever thrown a Paintball
and missed, losing the monster
entirely?
For you, we have prepared
a decoration.

26329.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26329.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26329.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26329.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

55853.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a back break in slaying Bogabadorumu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55853.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Bogabadorumu≫ and break
its head and back, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

55712.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐

28091.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28091.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

23327.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
23327.description: Signs of burnt trees have been found in the swamp. It may be a monster feeding or a threat display toward rivals. The swamp is now one of our important survey targets, so please eliminate this threat.
23327.descriptionEn:
Signs of burnt trees have been
found in the Swamp.
It may be a monster feeding, or
threat displays toward rivals.
The Swamp is now one of our
most important survey sites, so
please remove this threat.

26448.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time we have prepared the volcano field, but the Volcano depths, the lava pool area, are still unexplored and not open. Please note.
26448.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time we have prepared
a Volcano field, but the Volcano
Depths and the lava pool area
are still unexplored and have not
been released. Please be aware.

63218.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
63218.description: We have information that Shen Gaoren is approaching the city. Hurry and slay it before the fortress crab disappears. By the way, this time part destruction alone will count as completing the job. Do your best!
63218.descriptionEn:
We have information that
a Shen Gaoren is nearing
the town.
Before the Shen Gaoren
vanishes, hurry and go slay it.
By the way, this time
breaking parts alone will be
accepted as clearing the request.
Do your best!

62152.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
62152.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

63206.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63206.description: It seems rare blue Hypnocatrice have been found in the sea of trees. Those things cry out during the day and are unbearably noisy. So, may I ask, would you go and slay them? My thanks will be blue feathers. If you break the beaks too, it will be even more refreshing.
63206.descriptionEn:
Rare azure Hypnocatrice have been
found in the Great Forest, it
seems.
Those things screech all through
the day and are unbearable.
So here is my proposal: would you
slay them for me?
My thanks will be "Blue Feathers".
Break their beaks as well and it
will feel even better.

54328.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
54328.descriptionEn:
Defeat a monster a tiny bit bigger
than usual and find a bracelet,
nyah!
I'll trade you my top pick for it,
nyah!
What do I want it for?
It's better not to pry any further
than that, nyah.

54743.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54743.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

62768.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62768.description: The Barbarian Wyvern newly confirmed in the highlands. It is a dangerous flying wyvern to begin with, but among them an individual of outstanding strength was confirmed the other day. It will be a very dangerous request requiring proof of skill, but please investigate and hunt it!
62768.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gurenzeburu≫ has been newly
confirmed in the Highlands.
Flying wyverns are dangerous
already, but an exceptionally
powerful individual was sighted
the other day. This is a very
dangerous request that proves
your skill, but please take on
the survey and the hunt!

21908.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21908.description: This is a job for hunters upgrading the Colde FY series armor received from the Guide. Slaying an Akantor gets you the materials needed to upgrade one piece of the Colde FY series. Please make use of it in your hunting life.
21908.descriptionEn:
This request is for hunters
upgrading the Corude FY Series
armor received from the guide.
Slay an Akantor and you will
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade about one piece of the
Corude FY Series.
Please make good use of it in
your hunts to come.

62314.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Talos R gunner armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62314.descriptionEn:
If you listen to the voice of
nature, you may gain ideas
beyond human wisdom.
This request should help you
upgrade your Taros R Gunner
armor. May your hunting life
stay fulfilling for all time,
hunters one and all.

55131.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55131.description: Information has come in that Rukodiora was encountered during the survey of the desert. It appears far more ferocious than previous individuals and to display movements not found in our research records. We ask for further investigation before danger reaches those nearby.
55131.descriptionEn:
Word has come in that a survey team
in the Desert encountered Rukodiora.
It seems to be far more ferocious than
previous individuals, and to show
movements not found in our research
data. Before danger can spread to the
surrounding area, we request a
further survey.

55605.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55605.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!

21545.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21545.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21545.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

23502.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
23502.description: A Velocidrome and a Conga appeared during the survey of the Jungle! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. Hunters who complete the request will receive the crafting materials for the weapon series Breaking the Illusion.
23502.descriptionEn:
While surveying the Jungle, a
Velocidrome and a Conga appeared!
At this rate the survey cannot be
completed. To the hunter who fulfills
this request, we will give the
production materials for the weapon
series ≪Illusion Breaker≫.
We are counting on you.

21533.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21533.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21533.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

61208.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品
61208.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61208.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!

50738.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
50738.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50738.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

21172.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての討伐
21172.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21172.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

12033.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
12033.description: The Ioprey are loudly active, which means there is a high chance the leader, Iodrome, is around. Take that poison liquid head on and you could lose your life. Do not forget to bring antidote items.
12033.descriptionEn:
If the Genprey are stirring
so actively, a ≪Gendrome≫ is
likely leading them. Taking
that venom head-on could cost
you your life. Don't forget
to bring antidote items.

62839.description: A hunter of skill hunts with the best plan, whatever the situation. This time you will slay a Tigrex within 20 minutes! You may bring one comrade you trust.
62839.descriptionEn:
A top hunter always hunts
monsters with the best plan,
whatever the situation.
This time, within 20 minutes,
you will slay a Tigrex!
You may bring one trusted
companion along with you.
Now go and show me your skill!

40237.objectiveJp: フレイムタイラント１体の討伐

26536.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, as exploration has confirmed it safe, we are opening the Volcano depths, the lava pool area! Gather to your heart's content!
26536.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time, as our survey confirmed
it is safe, we are opening the
Volcano Depths and the lava pool area!
Please go and gather to your
heart's content!

62104.description: As for the Great Hunt on Solitude Island, that gigantic monster called Raviente seems to lie silent on one of the islands. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so the survey will be brief, but please join.
62104.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Great Hunt on
the ≪Isolated Island≫: the
colossal monster known as
the ≪Raviente≫ appears to
lie silent on one island.
We are forming a survey
team open only to hunters
who took part, so please do
join us for a short survey.

54665.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Haku armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the desert, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma G Series G Rank Haku Armor up to LV7.
54665.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Supremacy≫ armor of the
≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Desert, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪G-Rank Supremacy≫
"Stroma G" armor to Lv7.

21361.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Jungle, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Blazing Sky, the Voice of Nature: Shore, or the Voice of Nature: Ocean. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21361.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request
set in the ≪Jungle≫,
you may come by
≪Voice of Nature: Blazing Sky≫,
≪Voice of Nature: Shoreline≫,
and ≪Voice of Nature: Open Sea≫.
I pray that your hunting life
becomes all the richer for it.

62959.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62959.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62959.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

50272.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
50272.description: Greetings, hunters. Do you not think the conduct of hunters lately is hard to overlook? To instill a little 'dignity' in you, I have prepared some special armor. I wish you success.
50272.descriptionEn:
Good day to you, hunters.
Don't you think the deeds
of hunters lately are
too much to overlook?
So that you may acquire
a little 'dignity', I have
prepared some special armor
for you.
I pray for your valour.

61727.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
61727.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
61727.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

54313.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Plesioth and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54313.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Hunt the Plesioth in style and
prove yourself.
Clear the quest and your
standing as a hunter will jump
right up!

63015.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63015.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63015.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

63063.description: Mm. It seems the warmed body hasn't cooled yet. Then let's proceed to the second of my devised novel training. The next objective is destruction by bombs! Bringing ranged weapons is fine. Practicing split-second evasion is fine. Think of it as a reward for your efforts so far and enjoy it to the full!
63063.descriptionEn:
Mm. It seems the body I
warmed up hasn't cooled yet.
Then let's do my second
brand-new training course.
The next goal is bomb breaking!
Bringing projectiles is fine.
Practicing instant dodges is fine.
Think of this as a reward for
your hard work, and enjoy it!

62753.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
62753.description: A team member surveying the caves of Tide Island reports that a rumbling can sometimes be heard from deep inside. Some of the team have also seen large rocks move, and unease is spreading. A monster unknown to us may be living there, so we ask for an investigation.
62753.descriptionEn:
From members surveying the caves of
the Tidal Island came a report that
rumbling can sometimes be heard
from deep within the caves.
Also, some members have seen
large rocks moving, and unease
is spreading among them.
An unknown monster may live there,
so please investigate.

63129.description: This is the practice qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
63129.descriptionEn:
This is the practice qualifying quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from the clear reward.

61543.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
61543.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61543.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

26761.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
26761.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.

22120.description: This request lets you obtain the Mighty Jewel decoration, recommended for hunters who reached HR3. Slay a Gypceros and you can get the Mighty Jewel that raises attack power. Please make good use of it.
22120.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain
the Mighty Jewel decoration,
recommended for hunters who
reached HR3.
Slay a Gypceros and you can get
the Mighty Jewel that raises
attack power.
Please make good use of it.

60519.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

62402.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62402.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62402.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

56057.description: A decoration has been completed to protect you from a monster's fierce attacks. With this new decoration you will find it enormously effective against Aberrant species that use fire. We will hand it out as a reward for this quest, so do join us!
56057.descriptionEn:
A decoration to protect you
from the fierce attacks of
monsters is complete.
With this new decoration you
will find immense effect
against fire-using Supremacy
monsters and the like!
It will be given as this quest's
reward, so do join us!

50398.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

50208.description: Lately Great Thunderbugs have been swarming in the sea of trees. At this rate the Mezepor Expedition cannot push into the interior. What? You want to help the expedition? Then hurry and hunt the bugs! As a reward I will give the production materials for an exceptionally cool bow!
50208.descriptionEn:
Lately, Great Thunderbugs have
been swarming all through the
Great Forest. At this rate the
Mezepolta Expedition can't push
deep inside. What? You want to
help them? Then hurry and
hunt those bugs! I'll reward
you with bow materials!

55610.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55610.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

15015.description: This official hunting exam has 3 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! Hunt two of the White Lion lords that reign over the land of bitter cold!
15015.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
three parts in all! To confirm
your skill once more, you'll
hunt every monster we specify!
Hunt two of the white lion
lords that rule the frozen
land! Show me what you can do!

60140.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
60140.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Blangonga and Congalala, the pride of the Fanged Beasts. Is there a hunter who can hunt two of these fanged beasts at once, when even one is utter hardship!? Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
60140.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! Here, the finest
Fanged Beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala. Does a hunter exist
who can hunt these two at once,
each a trial on its own!? Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose
their life to a moment's lapse!

1060.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
1060.description: Blangonga rules this Snowy Mountains. It shows no mercy to those who trespass on its territory! Also, this season a rare species of Velociprey seems to come here to raise eggs. Steal a Carnivore Egg and you might just meet one!
1060.descriptionEn:
≪Blangonga≫ rules this
Snowy Mountain. It shows no
mercy to trespassers!
Also, rare Velociprey come
here to raise eggs this
season. Steal a ≪Carnivore
Egg≫ and you might meet one!

23704.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (legs), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23704.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(leg piece), excluding
weapon ribbons and weapon
merits. The yield is one
type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please take note.

21473.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21473.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21473.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

23590.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
23590.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.

21828.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

54663.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54663.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54663.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

26468.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Hypnocatrice puts hunters to sleep. If someone starts nodding off, help wake them up!
26468.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Hypnocatrice puts hunters
right to sleep~
If someone starts dozing,
wake them up together, okay!

54160.description: We ask you to investigate the poison bird wyvern lurking in the Jungle. It has a very timid nature, and when it finds a hunter it runs about madly in its terror and charges at them. If you skillfully break the crest of the running poison bird wyvern, I will add to your reward.
54160.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Gypceros
lurking in the Jungle.
It is very timid, and when
it spots a hunter, fear
makes it run madly about
and charge at them.
Break that running Gypceros's
crest and I'll boost your reward.

23529.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
23529.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Vojan, the Crimson Lotus Lion. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23529.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Crimson
Lotus Lion ≪Vojan≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

62367.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62367.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62367.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

61873.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１６匹の討伐

61034.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61034.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62046.description: I want to see the feathers of the beautiful birds that live in the sea of trees, nya. If you bring them, I will give you what is needed to make a hunting party Poogie outfit as thanks, nya. Hurry and fetch them, nya!
62046.descriptionEn:
I want to see the feathers of
the beautiful birds of the
Great Forest, nya.
Bring them back and I will
give you what you need to
make Guild Poogie clothes
as thanks, nya.
Hurry and fetch them, nya!

21775.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
21775.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21775.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

11023.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
11023.description: A Plesioth subspecies turns up in the desert now and then this season! I hear its hide is as beautiful as jade! Still, hunting a Plesioth is not easy at all. Never let your guard down!
11023.descriptionEn:
Green Plesioth sometimes shows up
in the Desert this season!
I hear it has a beautiful body
color like jade, of all things!
That said, hunting a Plesioth is
no easy task. Never let your
guard down!

26756.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. Thanks to an adaptability that shrugs off harsh environments, elemental attacks seem to be of almost no use against it, so be careful.
26756.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species and has no fixed habitat;
because its numbers are so small it
is a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
Its adaptability shrugs off even harsh
environments, so elemental attacks
seem to hardly work on it.
Be careful.

26116.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
26116.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!

54670.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
54670.description: To boost awareness of the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest. Cutting the Akura Vashimu's tail also grants special ingredients.
54670.descriptionEn:
To boost awareness of the
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest.
Cutting the Akura Vashimu's
tail also grants
special ingredients.

50652.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 3! In this quest you can obtain weapon crafting materials for Gogomoa and crafting materials for the original armor Korude Series. Please give it a try!
50652.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 3!
In this quest you can obtain
weapon crafting materials for
the leaping beast ≪Gogomoa≫
and crafting materials for the
original armor
≪Korude Series≫.
Please give it a try!

62936.description: This is the practice qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
62936.descriptionEn:
This is the practice qualifying quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from the clear reward.

60551.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
60551.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Teostra. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60551.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Teostra≫!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go take a top placing!
This time Origin weapons only—
choose your weapon wisely!

55122.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55122.description: I hear a monster called the Stygian Zinogre has been sighted lately. I have a weakness for materials from new monsters. I simply must have them. Would you get them for me? In return I will share Stygian Zinogre Heavy Shells.
55122.descriptionEn:
Lately there've been
sightings of a monster
called the Stygian Zinogre,
or so I hear. New monster
parts are my weakness.
I simply must have them.
Fetch them for me instead?
I'll share its ≪Heavy Shell≫.

26625.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26625.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

60669.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
60669.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Gurenzeburu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60669.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is a
Unique Individual ≪Gurenzeburu≫!
To take on a monster all
by yourself - that spirit
is truly admirable!
Best yourself and take a
fine top ranking! Supremacy
weapons only this time!

22127.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22127.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
22127.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Dual
Blades, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

58103.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58103.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58103.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

62355.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62355.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62355.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.

60820.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60820.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60820.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.

26713.description: What, you just want a hard Sword and Shield? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26713.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Sword and Shield?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!

62129.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62129.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62129.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

23164.description: What a wretched time I had! I was exploring an unsurveyed part of the Swamp when I ran into a pack of Conga. I got away, but their stench has left me like this! If you have business in the Swamp, teach those beasts a lesson while you are at it.
23164.descriptionEn:
Man, what a time I had!
I was exploring an unsurveyed
part of the Swamp when I
ran into a pack of Conga.
I managed to get away, but
thanks to that awful stench,
look at me! If you happen
to head to the Swamp, give
those pests a thrashing for me.

61632.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟

50093.description: I am about to set out on a long journey. So I want new armor. I have my eye on the Kishin/Doji set, but the quarry is troublesome: I must hunt a Rajang and a Tigrex. Facing two is hard, but succeed and you get cool armor.
50093.descriptionEn:
I am about to set out on a long
journey. So I want new armor.
I am after the ≪Kishin/Douji Set≫,
but the quarry is troublesome:
I have to hunt a ≪Rajang≫ and
a ≪Tigrex≫.
Taking on two at once is very hard,
but if you pull it off, you get
some cool armor.

63378.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
63378.description: An especially sturdy Doragyurosu has been sighted. Rumor says that if you slay it splendidly, rare materials can be obtained. Hunters confident in their skill, confirm the truth of it.
63378.descriptionEn:
Especially tough ≪Nether
Thunder Dragon≫ specimens
have been sighted.
Rumor says that slaying one
may yield rare materials.
Hunters confident in their
skill, go confirm the truth.

63224.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
63224.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival, but you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are a little harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. Nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
63224.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival,
but you just have to have a
souvenir of the festivities!
That's you, isn't it! Why not
try accepting this quest?
But the conditions are a bit harsh,
so I don't recommend it to the
winning side.
If you fail, the item won't be
returned, so be careful!

61534.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Fanged Beast Hardclaw! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61534.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who break many parts of
Variants and rare species. The
main reward is Fanged Beast hard
claws! Deliver the guarantee when
you accept or join, then hunt the
specified monster. Note that the
guarantee cannot be returned once
you depart.

54219.description: Please investigate the Congalala lurking in the swamp. If you not only hunt it but also splendidly break its head and claws, I will add to the reward!
54219.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Congalala
lurking in the Swamp.
Not only hunt it —
break its head and claws and I
will add a bonus to your
reward!

61728.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61728.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

26446.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
26446.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!

62020.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62020.description: Oh? Noticing me makes you quite a hunter, mya. They're apparently handing out Porta Candy now, mya. I want to try some too, so give me one, mya. In return I'll give you lots of what looks like the raw ingredient, mya!
62020.descriptionEn:
Oh?
Noticing me makes you quite
a fine hunter, mya~.
They say ≪Porta Candy≫ is
being handed out, mya.
I want to try some too,
so give me one, mya~.
In return I'll give you lots
of its ingredients, mya~!

50204.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の討伐
50204.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50204.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

50725.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and the guild will present you with rare Conquest species materials.
50725.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards exclusively
for those in a guild on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival. Please bring your
proof of the festival when you
accept or join.
Clear this request and the guild
will present you with rare
Zenith materials.

50669.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
50669.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Diore series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50669.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the crafting and upgrade
materials for one part of
the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
Diore Series.
To accept the quest you will
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

61908.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

50188.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Gougarufu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50188.descriptionEn:
An emergency request! We
seek someone to slay a most
powerful ≪Gogomoa≫.
If you can hunt it well,
we will issue more slaying
proofs than usual. Please
answer the call!

60433.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種２頭の狩猟
60433.description: Monsters vary as individuals. The Khezu is a particularly special case among them, so this sort of individual is comparatively easy to come across... Hunters who cannot quite follow all this, well, hunt one anyway and you will have something to talk about.
60433.descriptionEn:
Monsters differ one from another.
Khezu are an especially peculiar
lot even among them, so
individuals like this turn up
rather often...
Hunters who can't follow all
this talk, well, just hunt one
for the sake of a story.

56088.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Elegant Elder Dragon. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56088.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay
the Supremacy Inagami.
If you destroy its developed
parts in this quest, I will
add developed part materials
to your Another rewards as
a special gift.
Note that slaying alone gives none.

21171.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21171.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

53203.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Kalais series, available from this request? It combines a vivid look with performance, truly a set that has both beauty and brains.
53203.descriptionEn:
Hunter, thinking of changing
out of your ≪Hope Series≫
armor?
How about the ≪Karais
Series≫ armor you can get
from this request?
It boasts both vivid looks and
solid performance, truly a
piece with beauty and brains.

60541.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
60541.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blue Yian Kut-Ku! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60541.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Blue Yian Kut-Ku!
Taking a monster on all
alone is truly a feat!
Overcome yourself and
claim a top placement!
SP weapons only this time!

62571.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62571.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

50056.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
50056.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50056.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

50433.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

23531.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
23531.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Toridokuresu, the Shining Thunder Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23531.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Thunderbird ≪Toridokuresu≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.

23682.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23682.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!

61348.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61348.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.

26594.objectiveJp: ぼろぼろの図面５枚の納品
26594.description: It has been stolen, nya! That drawing, that drawing was stolen, nya! I stayed up all night drawing it for Gooc, and it was stolen, nya! The culprit is a Melynx in the jungle. The drawing may be in pieces, nya, but I want you to get it back, nya. If you do, I will restore it somehow, nya!
26594.descriptionEn:
Stolen again, nya! My
blueprints, stolen, nya!
I wrote them all night for
Gook, and they were stolen!
The culprit is a Jungle
Melynx. The blueprints may
be torn to bits, nya, but
bring them back. Then I'll
restore them somehow, nya!

63412.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
63412.description: In gratitude to those who have contributed to the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. This request yields one item chosen from among all the Festival Echoes distributed in the past. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63412.descriptionEn:
In gratitude to all who
support the Hunter Festival,
we made a special request.
This request gives you one
of any ≪Festival Resonance≫
distributed in the past.
To accept or join it,
please bring a Festival
Proof with you.

54194.description: For the survey, I want you to hunt a Giaorugu. This time I want the hunt carried out with the horns and tail broken. Does it not thrill you, to think this brings the ecological survey of Giaorugu one step further? Then, I leave it to you.
54194.descriptionEn:
I want you to hunt a Giaorugu
for our survey. This time
I want the hunt done with
its horns and tail already
broken. Doesn't it excite you
to think this advances our
study of Giaorugu ecology?

55705.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55705.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Blangonga through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Switch Axe, Tonfa, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55705.descriptionEn:
From a Supremacy Blangonga you
can get the materials for one
Supremacy weapon's crafting
and first-stage upgrade, plus
Gz worth of Porta Card Sakura.
The weapon types you can
forge are Great Sword, Switch
Axe, Tonfa, Light Bowgun,
Heavy Bowgun and Bow.
Use this to forge and upgrade.

50887.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, an Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, was newly observed in the Snowy Mountains. According to hunters who faced it, it unleashes attacks using ice. Please take the greatest care not to neglect your preparations.
50887.descriptionEn:
With the appearance of the
Transcendent species, surveys
have been pushed across the land,
and a Barioth, the Ice Fang Wyvern,
has now been sighted in the
Snowy Mountains. Hunters who faced
it report it unleashes ice attacks.
Please do not neglect your preparations.

50021.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
50021.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
50021.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

62224.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62224.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62224.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.

1028.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
1028.description: So a subspecies of the already rare Monoblos has appeared, has it. For all its noble and beautiful looks, in ferocity it likely surpasses the original! Prepare yourself and take up the hunt!
1028.descriptionEn:
A white one-horned wyvern, and
a rare Monoblos subspecies at
that, has appeared.
For all its noble beauty,
its ferocity likely surpasses
the original species! Steel
yourself and take up the hunt!

21024.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21024.description: The Ioprey are loudly active, which means there is a high chance the leader, Iodrome, is around! Take that poison liquid head on and you could lose your life! Do not forget antidote items!
21024.descriptionEn:
The fact that the Genprey are
stirring so actively means there
is a very good chance their
leader, the Gendrome, is nearby!
Taking that poison head-on could
cost you your life! Do not forget
your antidote items!

21093.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
21093.description: The boss of the Genprey packs in the desert, Dos-Genprey, is marked by a body a size larger and by sharp claws. If hunting Dos-Genprey feels difficult, put a Cactus Flower in a Maka Pickling Jar and deliver a Hundred-Flower Cactus.
21093.descriptionEn:
The Ioprey that swarm the Desert
are led by the ≪Iodrome≫, marked
by its larger body and sharp claws.
If hunting the Iodrome seems
hard, put a ≪Cactus Flower≫ into
a ≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ and
deliver a ≪Hundred-Flower Cactus≫.

50181.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
50181.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50181.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

23360.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
23360.description: A request where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the torso armor of the Glen G Series and Glen GF Series. Clear this request, advance the Hunter Navi and collect rewards while aiming to obtain 10 Glen Sword Jewels GF.
23360.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain
the materials needed to craft
and upgrade the chest armor
of the Guren G and Guren GF
series. Clear this request,
advance Hunter Navi, and
collect your rewards as you
aim for 10 ≪Guren Sword
Jewel GF≫.

23398.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
23398.description: There has been a sighting of an Espinas Subspecies in the Canyon. Please hunt the target before damage occurs. Take particular care of its especially fierce charging attack!
23398.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Espinas Subspecies≫ in the
Canyon. Please hunt the target
before harm is done.
Take special care against its
fierce charging attacks!

50016.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

23602.description: A report has come from an investigator that the moon peering from the farthest land shortens day by day the cycle in which it turns crimson, and deepens that crimson. The Guild takes this as an omen of ill things to come and has decided to send outstanding hunters. Please depart for the site at once.
23602.descriptionEn:
The moon that peers from the far
ends of the earth reddens, its
crimson cycle growing shorter
day by day and its redness
deepening, a researcher reports.
The Guild takes this as an omen
that ill fortune will come, and
has decided to send skilled
hunters.
Depart for the site at once.

40175.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
40175.description: Reports are coming in one after another of a powerful storm arising in the distant southern sky. There are also reports that it is moving toward Mezepolta Plaza, so hunters, please investigate.
40175.descriptionEn:
Reports are coming in one after
another that a powerful storm has
arisen in the far southern skies.
There are also reports that it has
moved to Mezepolta Plaza, so all
hunters, please investigate.
Please take care out there.

60589.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
60589.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas Subspecies. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin and Transcendent weapons only!
60589.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Espinas Subspecies≫!
Work with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in
this contest, so aim for a
top placing!
Origin & Migrant weapons only!

21212.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21212.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21212.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

61757.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61757.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

61463.description: As for the Great Hunt on Solitude Island, that gigantic monster called Raviente seems to lie silent on one of the islands. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so the survey will be brief, but please join.
61463.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Great Hunt on
the ≪Isolated Island≫: the
colossal monster known as
the ≪Raviente≫ appears to
lie silent on one island.
We are forming a survey
team open only to hunters
who took part, so please do
join us for a short survey.

50792.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50792.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Brown Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
50792.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long carried
out, we have prepared this quest
to further spread awareness and
promote them.
Breaking the Espinas
Subspecies's horn will also grant
special ingredients.

54927.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54927.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

50144.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★５ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50144.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★5 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.

26169.description: Iron Ore is needed for one thing or another when preparing equipment. Have you ever found yourself saying, ah, not enough, at the worst possible moment? On this quest, those who complete the main target will receive at least 7 Iron Ore!
26169.descriptionEn:
Iron Ore is always needed for
putting your gear together.
Have you ever found yourself
short of it right when you
need it most?
In this quest, everyone who
clears the main target will
receive at least 7 Iron Ore
from us!

55852.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55852.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a wing break and a tail cut in slaying Doragyurosu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55852.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Doragyurosu≫ and break its
wings and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

50359.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50359.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Rajang will also grant a special ingredient.
50359.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Rajang's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

62412.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62412.description: Our interception posture against the exceptionally powerful Rukodiora now closing on the interception base is ready. We have prepared ample supplies and interception weapons, so though this is an extremely dangerous request, any hunter able to prove their skill should head out and slay it.
62412.descriptionEn:
Preparations are complete to
intercept the extremely strong
individual ≪Rukodiora≫ that is
now closing on the ≪Base≫.
We have prepared ample supplies
and interception weapons, so
anyone able to prove their skill
should head out and slay it.

62841.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
62841.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
62841.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!

56079.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for five materials, and break the specified part for five more!
56079.descriptionEn:
A chance to obtain Supremacy
weapons prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal a set amount of damage to
the target for 5 materials, and
break the specified parts for
5 more of each!

61142.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. The reward is a certain material that proves you an angler. Show me the fruits of all your work so far! Since fishing is the aim, absolutely do not hunt the Plesioth Subspecies this time either!
61142.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. The
reward is a certain material that
proves you are an angler.
Show me the sum of all your skill!
Fishing is the goal, so this time
you must not slay the Green Plesioth!

26357.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26357.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

62633.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62633.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62633.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

63051.description: It is getting dark and my Gook has not come back from its walk. I am worried, so go and check on it in my place. I have a good idea of the places the Gook likes to go. As thanks, I will give you the pattern for the clothes I meant to dress my Gook in.
63051.descriptionEn:
It's getting dark, and Gook
still hasn't come back from
its walk. I'm worried, so
please go and check on it
