for me. I have a good idea
of where Gook might go.
As thanks, I'll give you the
pattern for the clothes I
meant to dress my Gook in.

55738.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55738.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Gasurabazura. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55738.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Gasurabazura≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

55801.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55801.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55801.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

63191.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63191.description: As part of a monster survey, I ask you to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. It is extremely powerful and behaves in ways normally unthinkable, so this is a quite dangerous request, but if the surveyors obtain satisfactory results you should earn high standing from the Guild.
63191.descriptionEn:
As part of our monster survey, we
ask you to hunt the ≪Bulldrome≫
in the New Great Arena.
It is extremely powerful and acts
in ways normally unthinkable, so
this is a quite dangerous request,
but if you achieve a result that
satisfies the survey team, you
should earn high praise from
the Guild.

55794.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55794.description: If you can hunt Toridokuresu too, your aptitude is sufficient. But the next opponent is tough. Slay Gureadomosu and I will recognize you as full-fledged! Hunting a huge monster is where the Magnetic Slash Hammer shines. Leap in with magnetism and breaking high parts should be easy!
55794.descriptionEn:
If you could hunt Toridcless
too, your talent is ample.
But the next foe is tough.
Slay a Gureadomosu and I'll
acknowledge you as a full hunter!
Hunting giant monsters is
where Magnet Spike users shine.
Leap in with magnetism and
high part breaks come easy!

61817.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 5 minutes. With some exceptions, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
61817.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 5 minutes.
With some exceptions, the target
monster's materials cannot be
obtained by carving or from the
clear reward.

22117.description: A request for hunters who possess Zerureusu Tenran weapons. By repeatedly driving off the mysterious monster that appeared in the Old Tower, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Haku weapons.
22117.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ weapon of
the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly repelling the
mysterious monster in the
Ancient Tower, you obtain
≪Supremacy Weapon≫ material.

54256.description: This is a report from a surveyor who went to the unsurveyed part of the Jungle. When they went to the waterside at night, they felt a gaze from the bottom of the water and fled in a panic. Many creatures live in the area, so unease is spreading among the surveyors. Head there and begin the survey.
54256.descriptionEn:
This is a report from the
surveyors working the unexplored
part of the Jungle.
At night, by the water, they
felt a gaze from the bottom of
the water and fled in a panic.
Many creatures live in the area,
so unease is spreading.
Head to the site and begin
the survey.

62771.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

21736.description: The unidentified monster found deep in the bamboo grove is, according to old documents left in this region, highly likely to be an Elder Dragon called the Elegant Elder Wyvern. If it is an Elder Dragon, the survey will be dangerous. Prepare fully before heading there.
21736.descriptionEn:
The monster found deep in the
bamboo forest is unidentified,
but old documents left in this
region suggest it is very likely
an elder dragon called the
Venerable Elder Dragon.
If it is indeed an elder dragon,
the survey will be dangerous.
Prepare fully before you head
to the site.

1080.description: Chameleos is an existence considered heretical even among elder dragons. Its very existence is rarely confirmed. Do not think of impossible things like capture; repel it repeatedly to wear down its health! Slay it in the end!
1080.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
Its very existence is rarely
confirmed at all.
Do not think of impossible things
like capture — repel it again and
again to wear down its strength!
Slay it after a long, drawn-out
fight!

55416.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55416.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

26516.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種２頭の狩猟
26516.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
26516.descriptionEn:
An unusual report has come in:
Rathians are descending on the
Desert one after another!
Hunting these queens, each one
a formidable foe, back to back
will be quite a challenge!
Those confident in their skill, and
those needing Rathian parts, join in!!

62086.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
62086.description: The bond of a mated pair is truly precious. By each making up for what the other lacks, new value is born. Go and hunt the female monster I found. Let us take the female's tenacity and endurance as our reference and create a pink material.
62086.descriptionEn:
The bond of a mated pair is truly
precious. By covering each other's
shortcomings, new value is born.
Go and hunt the female monster
I have found. Let us use the
female's tenacity and patience to
create a pink material,
shall we.

54901.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種２頭の討伐

62672.description: Among the newly discovered savage wyvern Abiorugu in the Jungle, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is a survey and hunting request limited to hunters we approve of. Face it fully prepared.
62672.descriptionEn:
Among the ≪Abiorugu≫ newly
found in the Jungle, an utterly
savage and powerful individual
has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey is limited to Hunters we
approve of. Please go in with
everything prepared.

50108.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50108.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
50108.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.

23576.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23576.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

55212.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Monoblos while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55212.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest where
slaying a Monoblos
raises your standing while
letting you obtain, at a bargain,
the materials needed for G Rank
decorations.
Please make good use of it.

50434.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54533.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54533.description: We are continuing our survey of the Poborubarumu. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54533.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
Poborubarumu.
Breaking parts is not
required, but if you do,
we would be delighted!
Hunters all, please lend
us your aid!

54804.description: 2 unidentified monsters of great power are on a rampage together at the Ancient Tower. Head out to slay them at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Secret Art armor, in preparation for greater threats.
54804.descriptionEn:
Two unidentified monsters of
great power are on a rampage
at the Ancient Tower at once.
Please head out and slay them
as fast as you can!
If you save us from this crisis,
we will provide materials used
for some G Rank Secret Art
Armor, in preparation for worse.

54948.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
54948.description: We present a request that lets you obtain some of the materials needed to upgrade the Ballista Rock Wyvern's Ｇ-rank gear, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
54948.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
how many you can accept,
but this request yields some
of the materials needed to
upgrade Odibatorasu
G Rank gear. Don't miss out!

26537.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, as exploration has confirmed it safe, we are opening the Volcano depths, the lava pool area! Gather to your heart's content!
26537.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time, as our survey confirmed
it is safe, we are opening the
Volcano Depths and the lava pool area!
Please go and gather to your
heart's content!

21933.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
21933.description: Have you heard of the Coral Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21933.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Sango Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.

50405.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21658.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Achimo Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21658.descriptionEn:
The lost memos that record the
secret of forging weapons are
apparently turning up on
monsters slain all over!
Once you get the Achimo Memo,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work!

20022.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
20022.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the city! Make use of the interception base's weapons and slay the mysterious giant dragon completely! Please!
20022.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast Post
reports that a suspicious dragon
is approaching the town! Use the
weapons at the Base to slay the
mysterious giant dragon
completely! Please!

53267.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53267.description: The Snow Memory prototype is complete, they say! They are holding a trial event for it, so let us go! I wonder how it looks. I am so excited! The center? Is it doing a cute pose? Hehe!
53267.descriptionEn:
The Snow Memory prototype
is finished, they say!
To mark it, they're holding
a trial session, so let's
go and join in!
I wonder how it turned out.
I'm so looking forward to it!
Is it center? Is it doing
a cute pose? Hehehe♪

60936.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種３頭の狩猟
60936.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
60936.descriptionEn:
An unusual report has come in:
Rathians are descending on the
Desert one after another!
Hunting these queens, each one
a formidable foe, back to back
will be quite a challenge!
Those confident in their skill, and
those needing Rathian parts, join in!!

54494.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
54494.description: Signs of burnt trees have been found in the swamp. It may be a monster feeding or a threat display toward rivals. The swamp is now one of our important survey targets, so please eliminate this threat.
54494.descriptionEn:
Signs of burnt trees have been
found in the Swamp.
It may be a monster feeding, or
threat displays toward rivals.
The Swamp is now one of our
most important survey sites, so
please remove this threat.

21407.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
21407.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
21407.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

21535.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21535.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

51101.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
51101.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Female Roaring Wolf will also grant a special ingredient.
51101.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the female Orugaron's
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

21954.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
21954.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Kuarusepusu. I am counting on you!
21954.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon materials as pay?
It's an easy job. Just run
over and slay a Kuarlusepusu
for me. That's all.
I'm counting on you!

50583.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and you will obtain rare materials useful in the hunt.
50583.descriptionEn:
A special request and
rewards for members of a
winning Hunter Festival
guild. When accepting or
joining, bring a Festival
Proof. Clear this request
to obtain rare materials
useful for hunting.

50534.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
50534.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50534.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

60448.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ１個の納品
60448.description: Steady, patient gathering is the first step to success in the hunt. So that you never forget that beginner's spirit, the guild has prepared this quest. Like the Patience Seed you receive as a reward, keep at it quietly until the day your flower blooms.
60448.descriptionEn:
Hunting, too, starts with steady
and honest gathering.
So that you never forget that
beginner's spirit, our Guild
prepared this quest.
Following the reward ≪Seed of
Patience≫, let us work steadily
until the day the flower blooms.

50150.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50150.description: Black lightning has been observed over a wide area in the skies above the Snowy Mountains. It may be the influence of the phantom Doragyurosu that is a rumour among the guild. To eliminate this danger, a hunt request has been issued to master hunters. Head for the site at once!
50150.descriptionEn:
Black lightning has been seen
over a wide stretch of the
Snowy Mountains sky.
It may be the work of the
phantom Doragyurosu the guild
speaks of in whispers.
To remove this danger, a slaying
request has gone out to top
hunters. Depart for the site at
once!

60942.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
60942.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60942.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

55202.description: There is a report that 2 jet-black wyverns were seen in a part of the Ancient Tower where few tread. This is a survey request, but if the report is true, ordinary hunters cannot handle them. We recommend only hunters confident in their skill go.
55202.descriptionEn:
There was a report that two jet-black
Flying Wyverns were seen in a part
of the Ancient Tower where people
rarely set foot. This is a survey
request, but if the report is true,
ordinary Hunters cannot handle them.
I recommend that only Hunters
confident in their own skill
make the trip.

10006.description: Here it comes at last. This is the 100-head hunt exercise, the gateway to a hunter's career! Clear this and you'll grow a size too! Do your best! Right?
10006.descriptionEn:
Here it comes. The 100-kill
exercise, the gateway every
hunter must pass!
Clear this and you'll grow
a whole size as a hunter!
Do your best! Got it?

1071.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
1071.description: The strange leg joints of the Shogun Ceanataur extend its range even to the ceiling! In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too! We pay for hunting them as well!
1071.descriptionEn:
The sickle crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
uses its bizarre leg joints to
climb all the way to the
ceiling!
In this season's Volcano, many
young ≪Gamizami≫ should be about!
Watch out for their sharp claws!

53001.description: Happy New Year! We have prepared a warm-up for this year's first hunt! Run up to the top of the tower to greet the first sunrise! To ensure a healthy hunting life this year too, we have prepared splendid rewards!
53001.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
To warm up for your first
hunt of the year, we have
prepared something for you!
Run up to the top of the
Tower to greet the sunrise!
So that your hunting life
stays healthy this year too,
we have fine rewards ready!

54836.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
54836.description: An Espinas Subspecies appeared during the survey of the Ancient Tower. Reports say it attacks with a dangerous poison breath. Conduct the survey with great care.
54836.descriptionEn:
During a survey of the Ancient
Tower, an Espinas Subspecies
appeared. Reports say it
attacks with a dangerous
poisonous breath.
Survey with great care.

50347.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の捕獲
50347.description: Comrades! Special training! This time, return to your roots and reconfirm the basics of the hunt! The basics of hunting are to predict the movements around you and act! Observe not only the monster but the movements of other hunters, and match them well!
50347.descriptionEn:
Listen up! Special training!
This time, return to basics
and reconfirm the hunt!
The basics: predict the
movement around you and move!
Observe not only monsters
but other hunters, and match
your timing to theirs well!

26552.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, thanks to the survey team's efforts, the whole canyon has been confirmed safe, so the entire canyon is open! Gather to your heart's content!
26552.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The Extra Quest is brought to
you by the Public Tavern Guild.
This time, thanks to the survey
team, the whole Canyon has been
confirmed safe, so the entire
Canyon is now open! Gather as
much as you like!

26182.description: We discovered a vast sea of trees in an unexplored land. The moment we stepped in, a great swarm of Vespoid! We fled for our lives and left our baggage behind. It is important baggage! Will someone drive off that swarm!
26182.descriptionEn:
I discovered a vast Great Forest
in an unexplored land. The moment
I stepped in, a swarm of Vespoids!
I ran for my life and left my
cargo behind. It's important
cargo! Won't someone drive off
that swarm for me!

21332.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21332.description: What, you just want a hard Heavy Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21332.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Heavy Bowgun?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!

22104.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22104.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

62601.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62601.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62601.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

40079.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Gothic Piercing.
40079.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment. Accept the quest
while wearing a Gothic
Pierce.

62828.description: A hunter of skill hunts with the best plan, whatever the situation. This time you will slay a Diablos within 15 minutes! You may bring one comrade you trust.
62828.descriptionEn:
A top hunter always hunts
monsters with the best plan,
whatever the situation.
This time, within 15 minutes,
you will slay a Diablos!
You may bring one trusted
companion along with you.
Now go and show me your skill!

62111.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

54105.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54105.description: What I want to ask of you is the hunt for the newly discovered Slanting Thunder Bird. There are many things I want to investigate, you see. Break its parts and then hand it over. It would take me many times as long as you. Time is limited. One must use it well.
54105.descriptionEn:
What I want to ask is a hunt
of the recently discovered
Farnock. There's a lot I'd
like to look into, you see.
Hand it over after breaking
its parts. For me, it would
take many times as long as
it takes you. Time is limited.
We must use it well.

60016.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

54419.description: We are recruiting hunters to help investigate the Akura Jebia that appeared in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. Investigations of Akura Jebia always produce many casualties, and many are expected this time too. Please join only after making thorough preparations.
54419.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to
help survey the Akra Jebia
that appeared in the uncharted
Swamp.
Surveys of Akra Jebia always
produce many casualties, and
many are expected this time
as well.
Please prepare fully before
you take part.

21966.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
21966.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55166.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
55166.description: Slaying a Kuarusepus raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55166.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying a Kuarlusepusu
raises your standing
while letting you obtain, at
a bargain, the materials
needed for G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.

61734.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61734.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62930.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62930.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

54745.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54745.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

26389.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26389.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

63373.description: Omnivores who will do anything for their goal! At the height of this contest, there is a Hypnocatrice sleeping soundly! Unforgivable! This is no time to sleep! Teach it that fortune and love do not come to those who sleep! While you are at it, try breaking a Cephadrome's fin too!
63373.descriptionEn:
Omnivore friends who'll do
anything for the goal! This
season, a Hypnocatrice is
snoring away! Unforgivable!
No time to sleep! Teach it
that fortune and love won't
come while you sleep! Right,
break a Cephadrome's fin too!

50336.description: There is a report that an unidentified monster suddenly appeared at the top of the tower. It came out of the light leaking through a gap in the clouds, they say, and from the report it is presumed to be Zerureusu, the Glittering World Wyvern. If true, this is a very dangerous situation. Head there at once and investigate.
50336.descriptionEn:
There is a report that an
unidentified monster suddenly
appeared atop the Tower.
It is said to have emerged from
the light leaking through the
gaps in the clouds, and from
that report we surmise it is
the Radiant Wyvern ≪Zerureusu≫.
If true, this is a very dangerous
situation. Head out and survey it!

11053.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. If a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back! You might even pick up their pouch instead, you know?
11053.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, is called
the Phantom Beast for the way it
commands lightning at will.
If a Melynx steals an item, do
not panic, just take it back!
On the contrary, you might even
pick up its pouch, you know?

60618.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60618.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60618.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50515.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
50515.description: You have gathered a full set of red armor? Crafting it alone does not bring out its true performance. If you can cleanly dispel the strong feelings that cling to the armor, the Red Cat will surely become your ally.
50515.descriptionEn:
You've gathered a full set
of red armor, have you?
Crafting alone won't show
its true performance.
If you can cleanse the strong
feelings clinging to it,
Akaneko will surely side with you.

23309.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
23309.description: Forokururu has appeared in the Flower Field. Reports describe a very rare monster that takes in nectar and changes its constitution. We ask for your help with the survey. We also have reports that the Beastmen in the Flower Field do not regard hunters as enemies and pose little danger.
23309.descriptionEn:
A ≪Forokururu≫ has appeared in
the Flower Field. Reports say it
takes in nectar and transforms
its constitution, a very rare
monster indeed. Please help us
survey it. As for the Beastmen
of the Flower Field, word is
they do not regard hunters as
enemies, so the danger is low.

63393.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Taikun Zamuza. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63393.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We seek someone to slay an
extremely powerful
≪Taikun Zamuza≫.
If you hunt it well, we will
issue more proofs of slay
than usual!

62530.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
62530.description: Word is a Lunastra has appeared in the desert lately. As it is a hunt in a harsh place, we can only send 1 hunter, but apparently it is still young and comparatively weak. Brave hunters, why not give it a try?
62530.descriptionEn:
Word is that a Lunastra has
been appearing in the Desert.
The hunt will be in harsh
terrain, so I can only send
one hunter, but apparently
this Lunastra is still
young and rather weak.
Brave hunters out there,
won't you give it a try?
I await your answer.

61402.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61402.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61402.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

50225.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
50225.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one, and it is just like a play!
Let me have you join in that
festival too. Oops, don't bring
anything dangerous in, all right.
Only the weapon that marks you a
hunter will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!

54815.description: Greetings. Are you still gathering now that you are G rank? My job is plant collection. Gather the plants I name. Thank you.
54815.descriptionEn:
Greetings.
Even at G Rank, are you still
gathering?
My request is plant collecting.
Please gather the plants I am
about to describe and bring
them to me.
Thank you.

50621.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
50621.description: This is the final quest for the Idaten Cup Champion Tournament, PS Vita edition. The time limit is 50 minutes.
50621.descriptionEn:
Idaten Cup
Champion Tournament
@ PS Vita version
final quest.
Time limit: 50 minutes.

55663.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55663.descriptionEn:
Hunters who would master
the Switch Axe, show
the skill you have honed
against the Baruragaru
in the New Great Arena!
Slay it and you will earn
rewards far beyond what
daily effort ever brings
you. Go and prove it!

50640.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Gogomoa on Tide Island! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50640.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Pariapuria≫ on Tidal Island!
If you can hunt it with skill,
you shall earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts would bring you.

50142.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★２ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50142.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★2 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.

21626.description: Do you know the orb called the Flax Origin Orb? Its material is indispensable to the production of a certain expensive decoration. If you clear this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21626.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Ama Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.

60808.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
60808.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60808.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

60688.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
60688.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Purple Gypceros. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60688.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Gypceros Subspecies!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time Supremacy weapons
only - that's the rule!

50799.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50799.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon and repel the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50799.descriptionEn:
You who would master the way of
the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon
and repel the Odibatorasu.
Only one who succeeds under such
limited conditions can be called
a true hunter. Succeed, and a
fitting reward shall await you.

23377.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
23377.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land. My research had once reached completion, but then I heard a rumor of an even more ferocious individual. So would you hunt the Rathalos living in the Old Tower? I will give you a copy of the book recording that survey report.
23377.descriptionEn:
For many years I have studied
the King of the Sky and the
Queen of the Land.
My research once reached
completion, but I heard a
rumor that an even more
savage individual appeared.
So, would you hunt the Rathalos
living in the Ancient Tower? I'll
give you a copy of that book.

53308.description: KYOGUWAAAAA! TEEG! GUWAWA NGUWAWAWA DEEG UAGUWAWA HAWAA UWAWAWA NAGGA GAAAGOO BYUUWAWAWA GAA!
53308.descriptionEn:
Kyogwaaaa!
Teeg! Gwawa
Ngu gwawawa
Deeg aguwawa
Hawaa uwwawa
Naagagwaagu
Byuuwwwaga

54550.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54550.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Rebidiora, the Thunder Extreme Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54550.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Thunder
Extreme Dragon ≪Revidiora≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

55005.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55005.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55005.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

62890.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62890.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

21673.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21673.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21673.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

11044.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
11044.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!

61924.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61924.description: White letters on white paper cannot be read. Black letters on black paper are just the same. Only when white and black combine does new value come into being. To accept both of two opposing things, and so create still greater value: that is sublation.
61924.descriptionEn:
White letters on white paper
cannot be read, can they?
Black letters on black paper
are just the same. Only when
white and black combine does
a new value come to be.
Accepting both opposites
creates even greater worth.
That is sublation, you see.

12009.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟

60503.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
60503.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60503.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

23617.description: The Variant Species Midogaron appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Midogaron. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23617.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ seems
to have reached a strength that
puts it at the very summit of
all Midogaron.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit, we ask
you to take on this survey.

50798.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50798.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

1049.description: Conga seem to live in great numbers in the swamp this season! They live without joining the boss Congalala's herd. Conversely, that's proof each one is strong enough not to need a herd. Be careful!
1049.descriptionEn:
Conga seem to be thriving
in the Swamp this season!
They don't live in packs with
the big Congalala, you see.
Which means each one is so
strong it needs no pack -
that's proof. So be careful!

40063.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
40063.description: The Gypceros of this swamp is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40063.descriptionEn:
The Poison Bird Wyvern ≪Gypceros≫
that lives in this Swamp is said
to rarely carry some incredible
treasure.
If it's true, I'd very much like
you to go and hunt one.
We'll split the reward.

61525.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・３を１０個納品

56005.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
56005.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Farnock, the Slanting Thunder Bird, we will also grant a special item.
56005.descriptionEn:
To promote the newly begun
UL Guild Priority Requests,
we have prepared this quest
for you all.
Destroy the head of the
Farnock and we will grant
a special item as a bonus.
We thank you for your help!

50471.description: The Flower Field in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
50471.descriptionEn:
Flower Field in the Warm Season.
The guild is still surveying
this uncharted land even now,
but why not visit it yourself,
hunter, to gather and survey?
If you start missing home,
just deliver a map!

23484.description: A new monster has been discovered in the volcano. The guild has named the creature Voljang, the Crimson Lion, and classified it as a Prime Species. Every blow it lands is terribly heavy, and when enraged it is said to wrap its whole body in searing flame. Please lend us your strength and bring it down!
23484.descriptionEn:
A new monster has been found in
the Volcano.
The guild names it the Crimson
Lion, Vojan, and classes it as
an Origin Species.
Each of its blows is terribly
heavy, and when enraged it
wraps its body in searing flame.
Lend us your strength to slay it!

21728.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Soul (Beginning) x８５, Bow Soul (Middle) x１９５, Bow Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Bow Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21728.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Bow Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Bow Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Bow Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.

23349.description: There's a great tremor in the Forest and Hills. A Rathalos Subspecies should be there, but something feels different from usual. The folk nearby are troubled. Won't you please hunt it for us?
23349.descriptionEn:
A tremendous tremor has been
coming from Forest and Hills.
An Azure Rathalos should be
there, but something feels
different from usual. The
neighbors are troubled.
Please, could you hunt it
for us?

60554.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Chameleos! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60554.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is Chameleos!
Going after a monster all on
your own - truly admirable!
Best yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only!
Choose your weapon wisely!

50668.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
50668.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Flor series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50668.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials to craft or
upgrade one piece of the
Hardcore Flor series.
Accepting this quest
requires a Superior
Ticket.
If the quest fails, the
Superior Ticket is
consumed - please beware.

60494.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60494.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks!
60494.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
This time the target is
Breeding Hypnocatrice!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here,
so aim for the top ranks!

50876.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50876.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50876.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.

58139.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター３頭の狩猟
58139.description: This is the final interception battle. I will never forget the sight of you all. Thank you truly for fighting with us for so long. Let us part brightly with a 'bye-bye'. Now everyone, together. 'Bye-bye.'
58139.descriptionEn:
This is the final defense.
I will never forget how
gallant you all looked.
Thank you for joining us
for so very long.
Let us part with a bright
"bye-bye" at the end.
Now then, all together.
"Bye-bye!"

26361.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26361.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

55776.description: To promote the new G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we prepared this quest for you. Cut off Chameleos's tail to receive a special ingredient as a bonus. We thank you for your help!
55776.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest for you.
Cut off the Chameleos tail
to receive a special
ingredient as a bonus.
We thank you for your help!

61322.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61322.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival, but you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are a little harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. Nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
61322.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival,
but you just have to have a
souvenir of the festivities!
That's you, isn't it! Why not
try accepting this quest?
But the conditions are a bit harsh,
so I don't recommend it to the
winning side.
If you fail, the item won't be
returned, so be careful!

63232.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
63232.description: A great boar, different in appearance from the usual and extremely powerful, is on a rampage in the swamp, and word has come that the examiner for Secret Scroll hunters, who is on his way here, cannot get through and is in trouble. If the swamp can be made safe, it seems you can be sure to be issued a Secret Proof [Prologue].
63232.descriptionEn:
A great boar unlike any
seen before, terribly
strong, is on a rampage
in the Swamp, and the
Secret Art examiner
heading this way cannot
get through. So we hear.
Make the Swamp safe and
the Secret Art Proof
[Intro] is yours for sure.

55880.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55880.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55880.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

55832.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
55832.description: To promote the new G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we prepared this quest for you. Destroy the head of the Anorupatisu to receive a special ingredient too. We thank you for your help!
55832.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest for you.
Destroy the head of the
Anorupatisu to receive a
special ingredient too.
We thank you for your help!

62714.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. I believe I gave you blueprints before and you had the workshop master make a hammer, but it can actually be strengthened further! If you want it improved, bring me 33 Silver Secret Pots.
62714.descriptionEn:
"Fishing"
It is a lonely hunt, one that
faces the fish in silence.
I believe you took the blueprints
I gave you to the workshop master
and made a Hammer, but the truth
is it can be strengthened even
further!
If you wish to improve it, bring
me 33 Silver Secret Pots.

50097.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50097.description: Will you take on this Rukodiora hunt? It is a little unusual: you must wear the Blademaster Magisa FX series on chest, arms, waist and legs. The reward is generous, so give it a try!
50097.descriptionEn:
How about taking this
Disufiroa hunt?
It's a bit unusual - you
must wear the Blademaster
Magusia FX series on your
chest, arms, waist and legs.
The reward is rich, so give
it a try!

21026.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１０頭の討伐
21026.description: The swamp is the most suitable environment for Bulldrome to live in. Hunters facing the Bulldrome hunt, please slay as many Bulldrome as you can! Of course, we will pay rewards!
21026.descriptionEn:
The Swamp is the most fitting
home for Bullfango.
Hunters taking on the Bulldrome
hunt are asked to slay as many
Bullfango as they can as well!
Of course, we will pay for it!

21482.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21482.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21482.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

61334.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61334.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62233.description: That Gravios has been sighted near the Swamp. This time we can say our preparations are perfect. Go to the Swamp at once and hunt that monster. If it goes well, I will provide my treasured materials.
62233.descriptionEn:
That Gravios was sighted
near the Swamp, it seems.
This time we'll be fully
prepared, I'd say. Go now
to the Swamp and hunt
that monster. Do well and
I'll share my secret hoard.

21664.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21664.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21664.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

63328.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
63328.description: Hey there! I, a person with a wealth of experience in the past and nothing else, have come again! I want you to experience memories like mine! Take each other's hands, men and women, and enjoy a splendid hunt!
63328.descriptionEn:
Heeey!
The one with a wealth of
experience - in the past -
is back again! I want you
all to make memories like
mine! Men and women, hand
in hand, enjoy the hunt!

53159.description: A Kirin has appeared in the Snowy Mountains. However, the road up the mountain seems to have been blocked by someone mischievous! To undo the mechanism, a book hidden in the flower field is needed. I will lend you a cute lance, so please investigate.
53159.descriptionEn:
A Kirin has appeared in
the Snowy Mountains. But
someone mean has blocked
the mountain path!
To undo the trap, a Book
hidden in the Flower Field
is needed, they say. We'll
lend you a cute Lance, so
please go and investigate.

53210.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
53210.description: As a warrior, I must vanquish Kushala Daora. As a warrior! Kushala Daora! As a warrior! Having been born a man, I must vanquish Kusha with all my warrior spirit!
53210.descriptionEn:
I, as a warrior,
must vanquish
Kushala Daora.
As a warrior!
Kushala Daora!
As a warrior!
Born a man, I must
with gusto smite
Kushala - it must be so!

55725.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55725.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55725.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

54593.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
54593.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Silver Rathalos and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54593.descriptionEn:
The time has come to show
what you hunters can do!
Go and hunt the mighty
Silver Rathalos!
Clear this quest and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up, I promise!

23318.description: The ecology of Inagami is gradually being revealed. It is a very interesting monster with high intelligence that has adapted splendidly to the special environment of the bamboo forest. In particular, many reports concern its tail, so caution is needed. We ask for your cooperation in further investigation.
23318.descriptionEn:
The ecology of Inagami is gradually
coming to light.
It possesses high intelligence and
has adapted splendidly to the
special environment of the bamboo
grove — a most fascinating monster.
Many reports concern its tail in
particular, so caution is needed.
We ask for your help to push the
survey further.

51109.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51109.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
51109.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Magnet
Spike, show the skill you have
honed against the Diamolde of
the Arena!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.

61974.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61974.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
61974.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!

50439.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54681.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
54681.description: This is an emergency! A princess touring the desert and her party have reportedly been attacked by the Water Fortress Wyvern, Gureadomosu! We will prepare a special reward for the hunter who saves the princess. Slay the Water Fortress Wyvern at once!
54681.descriptionEn:
Emergency! We have reports
that the princess and her
retinue, touring the Desert,
are under attack by the
Water Fortress Wyvern,
Gureadomosu!
Hunters who rescue her will
receive a special reward -
we are preparing it now.
Slay it at once, please!

62180.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
62180.description: A special job from the Guild to train hunters! Guild support is generous, and those who complete the quest are paid richly! Those with ambition should use this chance to rise!
62180.descriptionEn:
A special request from the Guild,
aimed at training up hunters!
The Guild's support is generous,
and those who complete the quest
are paid a handsome reward!
Let those with ambition take this
chance and rise higher!

63154.description: Among the fierce wyverns Abiorugu confirmed in the Snowy Mountains, an extremely violent and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is an investigation and hunt request limited to hunters we approve. Take it on fully prepared.
63154.descriptionEn:
Reports say an extremely violent
and powerful individual of the
Abiorugu has appeared in the
Snowy Mountains.
It is so dangerous that this
survey and hunt is limited to
hunters we have approved.
Go in fully prepared.

62030.description: There! There it is! A magnificent Monoblos is in the desert! Hunt that one alone and you're a first-rate hunter! Hurry there and hunt it! Right now you can apparently get rare materials too, so just go hunt it!
62030.descriptionEn:
There it is! There it is!
A fine ≪Monoblos≫ is in the
Desert!
Hunting that one alone is what
makes a first-rate hunter!
Hurry off and hunt it!
Right now you can get rare
materials too, so go on,
hunt it!

54645.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54645.description: It has been reported that a Silver Dragon attacked on a dark, deserted night. Much about this monster remains a mystery, but its intelligence, flowing control of metal, is thought to be very high even among elder dragons. There is a risk the damage will spread. Please lend your strength to slay it.
54645.descriptionEn:
We have a report that Rukodiora
attacked on a deserted dark
night. Much about this monster
is still a mystery, but the
intellect that commands metal
like flowing water is thought to
rank among the highest of all
Elder Dragons. Damage may well
spread. Please help us slay it!

26527.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26527.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26527.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

26456.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26456.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26456.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

61709.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟

61329.description: A powerful Daimyo Hermitaur seems to be running wild in the desert. It appears to be a rare individual, so I want it captured with a close-range weapon and its parts broken. Since I am asking a lot, I will add to the reward and lend you some reassuring equipment.
61329.descriptionEn:
A powerful shield crab is
on a rampage in the Desert.
It's a rare specimen, so
capture it with a melee
weapon and break its parts.
It's a tall order, so I'll
add to the reward and lend
you some sturdy gear.

55084.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス２頭の狩猟
55084.description: While surveying an undiscovered monster in the volcano, we were set upon by a pair of vicious Iodrome and forced to withdraw. Hunters who put those brothers down will receive the materials to craft the Hellfire Quelling Switch Axe, along with G-rank Hardcore Element Jewels and G-rank Hardcore Partner Jewels.
55084.descriptionEn:
While surveying unknown
monsters at the Volcano,
fierce Gendrome brothers
attacked us and forced
our retreat.
The hunter who slays them
receives crafting parts for
the "Kalpa-Quelling Axe"
and G Rank orbs.

62995.objectiveJp: カクサンデメキン３匹の納品
62995.description: I am designing clothes for Guku, but I cannot find the materials I want to use as reference. Please, would you gather them for me? Of course I will pay. Well then, thanks.
62995.descriptionEn:
I'm designing clothes for
my Gook, but I can't find
the material I want to use
as a reference. I'm stuck.
Please, won't you gather
it for me instead?
I'll pay you well, of course.
Well then, thanks a lot!

60673.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
60673.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Pariapuria. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60673.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Pariapuria!
Going after a monster all
on your own - admirable!
Best yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
Supremacy weapons only
this time - good luck!

21044.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21044.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke! They say its appearance makes onlookers tremble! But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? What do you suppose happens if the armor is broken?
21044.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of ≪Gravios≫
seems to have appeared amid the
Volcano's smoke!
They say its looks send shivers
through all who see it!
But it's called the Armor Wyvern
for its armor, so what if you break it?

61004.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
61004.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!

55993.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

54298.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
54298.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54298.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

26403.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

54214.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
54214.description: For the survey, please hunt a Yian Garuga. I want to record its behavior when parts are broken as well, so be sure to break the wings and sever the tail. I have prepared plenty of rewards. Do give it your best!
54214.descriptionEn:
For our survey, please hunt
a Yian Garuga.
We want to record part-break
behavior, so be sure to break
the wings and sever the tail.
The rewards are plentiful.
Please give it your all!

62758.description: A new report has arrived. Amid the dusk of the jungle, the Violent Wyvern Abiorugu appeared without warning. Another investigator testifies to countless footprints and roars from many directions, so it seems there are several of them. Please prepare carefully and conduct the investigation.
62758.descriptionEn:
A new report has come in.
A Violent Wyvern ≪Abiorugu≫ is
said to have appeared suddenly,
hidden in the Jungle's dusk.
Another surveyor testifies to
countless footprints and to
roars from many directions, so
it seems several of them are
about. Please make thorough
preparations before you survey.

54988.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54988.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!

54451.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Lolo Gougarf, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54451.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests,
we have prepared this
quest for you all.
Destroy the head of the
Roro Gougarf to receive
a special ingredient as
a bonus. Thank you!

23577.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23577.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23577.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

60238.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Abiorugu! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60238.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is Abiorugu!
Going after a monster all
on your own - admirable!
Best yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!

26356.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26356.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

58092.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58092.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58092.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

53174.description: Do you know the Eastern proverb, a lantern on a moonlit night? It is used for excessive luxury or things one does not need. Though this is no lantern on a moonlit night, this request lends you a gunlance powerful to the point of extravagance. Would you go and hunt Espinas while viewing the moon?
53174.descriptionEn:
Do you know the eastern
saying, "a lantern on a
moonlit night"? It's used
for needless extravagance.
Not that this is needless,
but this request lends you
a Gunlance far too strong
for the job. Hunt an Espinas
while you view the moon?

23543.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
23543.description: The Variant Species Tigrex appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Tigrex. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23543.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Tigrex≫
seems to have reached a
strength that touches the very
summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their arm
who would challenge the summit
are asked to take the survey.

20023.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern Yama Tsukami has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20023.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Station!
The Floating Peak Dragon Yama
Tsukami has invaded Mezeporuta!
Mezeporuta now moves to Elder
Dragon interception status!
Use the interception equipment
set up at the Base to slay the
Elder Dragon completely! Please!

62267.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62267.description: What, you just want a hard Long Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62267.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Long Sword, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!

54413.description: I'm studying the body structure and workings of Nono Orugaron, but I'm short on samples. Bring back the materials that can be taken from Nono Orugaron's fangs and tail. Bring back both, properly.
54413.descriptionEn:
I'm studying the body
structure of the
≪Nono Orgaron≫, but I'm
short on samples.
Bring back materials from
its fangs and its tail.
Both of them, mind you.
Don't come back with just
one, understand?

55614.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55614.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

26725.description: You want my horn? Hmm, I cannot give it for money or goods. It seems there are folk in the desert just now who have a feud with this horn and with the scar on my face, so if you hunt them and show me your strength I might give it to you.
26725.descriptionEn:
So you want my Horn?
Hmm, I cannot hand it over for
money or goods. Seems there are
folk in the Desert right now
with a grudge tied to this Horn
and the scar on my face, so if
you hunt them and show me your
strength, I might give it to you.

54930.description: Doragyurosu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees! For the investigation, please hunt it and sever its tail! There is only a short window to accept, but if you complete it, this request makes it easy to obtain the Nether Thunder Dragon's Hermit Shell and Nether Thunder Dragon's Hermit Scale!
54930.descriptionEn:
A Doragyurosu has appeared
at the Top of Great Forest!
Please hunt it and sever
its tail for our survey!
The chance to accept this
is brief, but if you clear
it you can easily obtain
the Dark Thunder Wyvern's
Mystic Shell and Scale!

63118.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
63118.description: At last the ice fox wyvern has settled in the canyon. With its range spreading to the old tower, the highlands and the canyon, it must be highly adaptable. There are reports of powerful individuals too. Prepare well and go hunt it!
63118.descriptionEn:
At last, the Ice Fox Wyvern has
come to live in the Canyon.
Its range now spreads from the
Ancient Tower to the Highlands
and the Canyon, so it must be
highly adaptable.
There are reports of powerful
individuals too. Prepare well
and head out to hunt!

60668.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Gurenzeburu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60668.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Gurenzeburu!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time Supremacy weapons
only - that's the rule!

55734.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55734.description: It is I, the Instructor! No sooner do I catch my breath than I get word of honeymoon trouble! It seems a Toridokuresu is on a rampage at Prismatic Falls, the honeymoon spot, and it has become a great problem! I would deal with it at once, but that is difficult! So I entrust the hunt to you hunters! I wish you good fortune!
55734.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
No rest for me - word of
honeymoon trouble came in!
At the Painted Waterfall
where they're honeymooning,
a Toridcless is on a spree!
I'd go myself, but I can't!
So hunters, I ask you to
slay it! Fight well!

21790.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21790.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

54692.description: To promote the new G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we prepared this quest for you. Cut off the tail of the Akura Jebia to receive a special ingredient too. We thank you for your help!
54692.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest for you.
Cut off the tail of the
Akura Jebia to receive a
special ingredient too.
We thank you for your help!

53321.description: This time, please clear the quest in the outfit I have chosen! You should be moved by an artistic quest! Also, I have already spoken with the Felynes helping us this time, so rest easy!
53321.descriptionEn:
This time, clear the quest
wearing the outfit
that I have chosen!
Prepare to be moved by
this artistic quest!
Also, I've already spoken
with the Felynes helping
you this time, so rest
easy, all right~!

26395.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26395.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
