prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!

50846.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
50846.description: Hello, hunter! Today I have a quest that earns you a coin for a lovely lottery! You can accept it if you have a Hunter Bag (White), so share one with friends who lack it and try it together!
50846.descriptionEn:
Hello there, hunter!
Today I have a quest that
gives you a coin for a
wonderful lottery draw!
You need a Hunter Bag
(White) to accept it, so
trade one to friends who
lack it, and take on the
challenge together, okay?

21507.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21507.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

50976.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50976.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. The reward is rare decoration materials.
50976.descriptionEn:
The ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫, which
had only been sighted now and then,
has expanded its territory to the
areas where people travel. To
prevent further damage, please
hunt the target.
The reward is a rare decoration
material.

62192.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62192.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55576.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
55576.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55576.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

54491.description: An unprecedented disaster is about to befall that land. It gives off an ominous aura that keeps all at bay, and even the surveyors cannot approach. If left as it is, it could seriously affect the surrounding ecosystem. Hunters of outstanding skill, hurry to the site.
54491.descriptionEn:
An unprecedented disaster is
about to befall that land.
It radiates a sinister aura
that lets no one near; even
surveyors cannot approach.
Left as it is, it could badly
harm the surrounding
ecosystem.
Hunters of outstanding skill,
make haste for the site.

55313.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Inagami, the Elegant Elder Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55313.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Elegant Sire
Wyvern ≪Inagami≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

23381.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
23381.description: The ecology of Gasurabazura is gradually being revealed. It seems gentle normally, but anger brings out its hidden savage nature. A rare monster with a very dangerous dual nature. Please investigate with care.
23381.descriptionEn:
The ecology of Gasurabazura
is gradually coming to light.
Normally it seems docile, but
anger brings out the savage
nature it keeps hidden away.
A rare monster with a truly
dangerous two-sided nature.
Please take every care when
you conduct the survey.

54227.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
54227.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.

55764.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55764.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55764.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

11094.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
11094.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
11094.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!

54434.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
54434.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54434.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

21116.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

58114.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58114.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58114.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

60102.objectiveJp: 毒テングダケ４個の納品
60102.description: I found a little known spot in the swamp where materials unique to it lie all about. By all means, go. If you come back with a full pouch, it should be worth the information fee.
60102.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
Swamp-only materials lie all
over the ground.
Go and have a look.
Come back with a full pouch and
it will be worth the price of
the information.

61016.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の捕獲
61016.description: I want to ask you for urgent work. A bird wyvern has appeared in the Forest and Hills. Usually I would not mind, but unluckily a trade caravan is passing through, so I want it driven off at once. I do not want the smell of blood drawing other wyverns, so capture it, please. I am begging you!
61016.descriptionEn:
I have a rush job for you.
A Yian Kut-Ku has shown up in
the Forest and Hills. Usually I
would not care, but our caravan
passes through, so drive it off
quickly. The smell of blood
would draw other wyverns, so
capture it, please. I beg you!

21263.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21263.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Blangonga and Congalala, the pride of the Fanged Beasts. Is there a hunter who can hunt two of these fanged beasts at once, when even one is utter hardship!? Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
21263.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! Here, the finest
Fanged Beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala. Does a hunter exist
who can hunt these two at once,
each a trial on its own!? Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose
their life to a moment's lapse!

50754.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50754.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50754.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55594.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55594.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Stygian Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55594.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want to
craft Stygian Zinogre
≪Zinogre Subspecies≫ armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transcendence Armor, so
please give it a try!

1029.description: The solitary one-horned wyvern Monoblos may be called the king that pairs with Diablos in the Desert. Yet if you dodge its charge and make it drive its noble horn into a wall, sealing its movement, you should be able to hunt it from advantage!
1029.descriptionEn:
The solitary one-horned
dragon ≪Monoblos≫ could well
be called the king that pairs
with Diablos in the Desert.
But dodge its charge and let
that noble horn lodge in a wall,
and you should gain the upper hand!

26553.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, thanks to the survey team's efforts, the whole canyon has been confirmed safe, so the entire canyon is open! Gather to your heart's content!
26553.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The Extra Quest is brought to
you by the Public Tavern Guild.
This time, thanks to the survey
team, the whole Canyon has been
confirmed safe, so the entire
Canyon is now open! Gather as
much as you like!

23216.description: Around the sea of trees, reports of damage by flying wyverns come one after another. Hurry to the site and hunt the flying wyverns. As the hunt will be in a poorly surveyed area, there is no telling what the wyvern will do. Do not neglect preparations before departure.
23216.descriptionEn:
Reports of flying wyvern
damage keep coming in
near the Great Forest.
Head there at once and
hunt the wyvern down.
The area is unsurveyed,
so we don't know how it
will behave. Prep well.

62838.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62983.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の捕獲
62983.description: Have you heard from the workshop master about a special ore called the Kinos Secret Stone? If not, let me introduce this request. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special material needed to craft a certain armor. Gather enough and have the master craft it for you.
62983.descriptionEn:
Ever heard of the special
ore called ≪Kinos Gemstone≫
from the smithy master?
If not, then let me
recommend this job.
≪Kinos Gemstone≫ is a rare
material needed to forge
certain armor. Gather a few
and have the master craft it.

65001.description: The time has come for SephV hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Hypnocatrice and prove it. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
65001.descriptionEn:
SephV hunters, the time has
come to show what you can do!
Hunt the splendid
Hypnocatrice and prove it.
Clear this quest and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!

62504.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62504.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

63090.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
63090.description: A request to hunt the Lunastra that dwells at the very top of the Old Tower in the frontier. It is a request issued from time to time, but this appearance falls outside the guild's predictions and can be called rare. The summit is extremely dangerous, and only one person can be sent. Depart in perfect condition.
63090.descriptionEn:
A request to slay the
Lunastra dwelling at the
top of the frontier's
Ancient Tower. Such requests
come often, but this sighting
falls outside the Guild's
predictions - truly rare.
The summit is deadly; only
one hunter may be sent.
Depart fully prepared.

62067.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐

26272.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26272.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26272.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62397.description: When enough coincidences pile up, it may fairly be called fate. In this quest, please do your best to cooperate, to trust, and to recognize one another. Carve the bond between you, which will never fade, into your hearts.
62397.descriptionEn:
When many coincidences pile up,
it would no longer be wrong to
call it fate.
In this quest, please do your best
to cooperate, to trust, and to
acknowledge one another.
Carve the bond between you, one that
will never fade, into your hearts.

62291.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62291.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62291.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

56099.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56099.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

55261.description: To investigate the Rending Water Wyvern that has been appearing intermittently, I ask you to hunt it and sever its parts. The part to be investigated changes with the time of day it appears, so judge whether the tail, the right hanging blade or the left hanging blade is the target, and if you strike it true I will add to your reward!
55261.descriptionEn:
To survey the Zenaserisu that
appears on and off, please hunt
it and sever its parts. The
part to survey changes with
the time of day it appears,
so judge which part is the
target - tail, right hanging
blade or left hanging blade -
and nail it for a bonus!

50650.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Conquest Weapon and hunt the Gold and Silver Piscine Wyvern. One who has come this far along the hunter's path should be able to bring them down. Do so, and a splendid reward shall be yours.
50650.descriptionEn:
You who would master the
hunting road: take up
Zenith weapons and hunt
the Gold and Silver
Plesioth. One as skilled
as you can surely bring
them down. Do so, and a
splendid reward awaits.

60495.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60495.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60495.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is the
≪Hypnocatrice (Breeding Season)≫!
Hunting all alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and reach the top ranks!

61044.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の討伐
61044.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
61044.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.

26223.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

55121.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55121.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55121.descriptionEn:
Drive it off, and the beast will
come dancing back once more.
So the Guild has decided to call
that shining one "Guanzorumu,
Ruler of the Acme."
In the end, we must slay it.
To any hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild armor, and a title!

55329.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55329.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a tail cut in slaying Blangonga, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55329.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Blangonga≫ and break its
head and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

53033.objectiveJp: マカライト鉱石１個の納品
53033.description: In this trial you are to deliver Machalite Ore. However, we deliberately will not give you the Picks needed to mine it! How you obtain them is for you to think out! Combine mining tools, carve them from monsters, the answer is not just one!
53033.descriptionEn:
For this trial, you must
deliver Machalite Ore.
However, I will not give
you the Pickaxe you need!
How you obtain one is for
you all to figure out!
Combine gathering tools,
or carve it from monsters
- there is more than one
answer! Now go!

23485.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
23485.description: An unfamiliar monster has been discovered in the extreme cold sea. The Guild has designated the target as the Frozen King Wyvern, Toa Tesukatora, and classified it as a First Species. A blizzard constantly surrounds Toa Tesukatora, and capture is thought impossible. Please slay it carefully and surely.
23485.descriptionEn:
An unfamiliar monster has been
discovered in the Polar Sea.
The Guild has named it the
Frozen King Dragon,
≪Toa Tesukatora≫, and classed
it as an ≪Origin Species≫.
A blizzard always rages around
it, so capture is thought
impossible. Please slay it
carefully and for certain.

60919.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60919.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

63167.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63167.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63167.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

21662.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
21662.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Broac Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21662.descriptionEn:
The lost memos that record the
secret of forging weapons are
apparently turning up on
monsters slain all over!
Once you get the Buroaku Memo,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work!

50658.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
50658.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 71! This quest yields materials for crafting weapons from Akantor, and upgrade materials for the original Corude F armor series. Do give it a try!
50658.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 71!
This quest yields materials
for crafting weapons from
the Zenith Wyvern Akantor,
and upgrade materials for
the original Corude F
armor series.
Do give it a try!

54428.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
54428.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
54428.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.

21713.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
21713.description: Have you heard of the Celadon Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21713.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Secret Hue Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decorative charm.
If you complete this
request, I shall give you
precious charm materials.

55969.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55969.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

54513.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
54513.description: We are continuing our survey of the Red Khezu. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54513.descriptionEn:
Our survey of the Red Khezu
continues.
Breaking parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, thank you very much
for your cooperation!

23353.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
23353.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's hunting life,
we have prepared a request to hunt
≪Bulldrome≫ in the New Great Arena.
If you complete this request you
will earn more reward money than
usual, so please take it on and
complete it.

26632.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26632.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?

54728.description: The Snowy Mountains are harsh land to begin with. With the arrival of a violent dragon that never existed in Mezepolta, conditions have grown harsher still. I have never seen such a ferocious monster. Please! Stop it.
54728.descriptionEn:
The Snowy Mountains are harsh
land to begin with. And now a
raging dragon that never lived
in Mezepolta has come, making
things even worse than before.
I've never seen a monster so
savage. Please! You have to
stop it for us.

26717.description: What, you just want a hard Hammer? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26717.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Hammer? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!

23535.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Inagami, the Elegant Elder Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23535.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Elegant Sire
Wyvern ≪Inagami≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

62272.description: Hey, look at this. A fine weapon, no? This is one of the special weapons suited to Variants, and wearing it is a condition for some jobs. Will you make one too? Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share the leftover materials.
62272.descriptionEn:
Hey, take a look at this.
Nice weapon, huh? It's a kind of
special weapon suited for fighting
Variants. What's more, I hear
equipping it is a requirement for
certain requests.
Want to make one yourself?
Clear the requests I introduce
to you, and I'll share spare parts.

63392.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of 2 extremely powerful Abiorugu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63392.descriptionEn:
An urgent request! We seek
someone to slay two
extremely powerful
Abiorugu specimens.
Hunt them well and we will
issue more Slay Proofs
than usual, we promise!

23406.description: There was a report of a Lavasioth Subspecies found in the G Rank Volcano. It was no mistake. We cannot overlook the fact that several powerful Lavasioth have appeared. We want a survey just to be sure. Materials found during it should be taken home. They will serve you well.
23406.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a ≪crimson
Volganos≫ found in the G Rank
Volcano. It was no mistake.
We cannot overlook the fact
that several powerful
≪Lavasioth≫ have appeared.
We want a survey just to be
sure. Materials found during it
should be taken home.
They will serve you well.

21767.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61760.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
61760.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
61760.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

63141.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
63141.description: There was a report of sighting an extremely powerful individual Crystal Wyvern at the top of the sea of trees. The Crystal Wyvern has a constitution that absorbs and reflects lightning, so hunting it carries considerable danger. We therefore ask skilled hunters to hunt it, so please.
63141.descriptionEn:
A report has come in that an
extremely powerful individual
Crystal Wyvern was sighted at
the top of the Great Forest.
The Crystal Wyvern absorbs and
reflects lightning, so hunting
it carries considerable danger.
We ask our skilled Hunters to
take on the hunt. Thank you.

54276.description: I sighted Berukyurosu at the top of the Tower, but it is far too dangerous to approach. If you break its head and sever its tail before hunting it, we should be able to survey safely. It is very rare for the dancing thunder wyvern to fly to the Ancient Tower, so I am counting on you!
54276.descriptionEn:
We sighted a Berukyurosu
at the top of the Tower, but
it is far too dangerous to
approach. If you break its
head, sever its tail and
then hunt it, we can survey
in safety. A Thunder Wyvern
flying to the Ancient Tower
is rare. We count on you!

63220.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee! I wish you good fortune!
63220.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Use all of your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
Complete this request splendidly
and you will earn an exceptional
reward! I wish you good fortune!

55868.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐

50043.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
50043.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50043.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

21783.description: A Diablos with a blackened body colour and a dreadfully fearsome appearance has been sighted. Since it was sighted alone, a high-rank hunter is unlikely to be outmatched, but do not take it lightly and get badly hurt.
21783.descriptionEn:
A Diablos with a darkened body
and an especially fearsome
appearance has been sighted.
Since it was seen alone, a top
hunter should hardly fall behind,
but do not underestimate it and
get badly hurt.

60493.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60493.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60493.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is the
≪Hypnocatrice (Breeding Season)≫!
Hunting all alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and reach the top ranks!

62437.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62437.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

21739.description: Have you heard of the Ultramarine Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21739.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Ultramarine Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decorative charm.
If you complete this
request, I shall give you
precious charm materials.

63349.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63349.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the great sword, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63349.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena we
have loosed a Rathian of
terrible strength, one that
moves in ways unthinkable.
Hunter who would master
the Great Sword - show me
your skill before me!
Hunt it well, and you shall
gain far more than daily
effort alone could give.

26204.description: Hunting is not only about slaying monsters. Hunting is a broad-hearted thing that brings light even to a mere courier. Come, will you not sweat over a delivery too?
26204.descriptionEn:
Hunting is not just about slaying
monsters.
Hunting is broad-minded enough to
bring light even to a mere courier.
Come now, why not sweat a little
over some transport work
yourself?

62466.description: This is a hunting request for Gogomoa, a Fanged Beast. Tide Island is a very beautiful place, but it is also a place where danger may hide anywhere. Do not let the beauty distract you and get caught by a Gogomoa!
62466.descriptionEn:
This is a request to hunt the
Fanged Beast ≪Gogomoa≫. Tidal
Island is a very beautiful
place, but also one where
danger can hide anywhere.
Mind you don't stare at the
scenery and get jumped by
the ≪Gogomoa≫!

60906.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60906.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

56035.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Plesioth. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56035.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Water Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.

63143.objectiveJp: ハンターカード赤１０枚納品
63143.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
63143.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

58076.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58076.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58076.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

11009.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
11009.description: At the waterside this season, the Shield Crab Daimyo Hermitaur may show itself! Dealing damage to a body protected by a hard shell is not easy! It is also OK to carve Crab Miso from Zamite and deliver that!
11009.descriptionEn:
At the waterside this season,
the shield crab ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫
may appear! Its body is guarded
by a hard shell, so dealing
damage is no easy task! You can
also carve ≪Ceanataur Paste≫
from Hermitaurs and deliver it!

23356.description: A request for hunters who possess Odibatorasu Haku armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the desert, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba G Series G Rank Haku Armor up to LV7.
23356.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Supremacy≫ armor of the
≪Odibatorasu≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Desert, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪G-Rank Supremacy≫
"Odiba G" armor to Lv7.

61604.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
61604.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61604.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

61149.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

62058.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
62058.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Desert, hunt 2 bird wyverns and a school of fish wyverns, and to finish, bring back a Herbivore Egg from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
62058.descriptionEn:
This time, we hold special
training for Hunters with
little experience yet!
In the Desert, hunt a flock of
2 Bird Wyverns and a Piscine
Wyvern, then finish by bringing
back a herbivore egg from the
cave. Do it and your standing
will rise!

12054.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

54827.description: You may accept this only so many times a day, but this request yields some of the materials needed to upgrade G Rank Pale Hypnocatrice gear. Don't miss out!
54827.descriptionEn:
You may accept this only so
many times a day, but this
request yields some of the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Pale Hypnocatrice
gear. Don't miss out!

55130.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
55130.description: A Yian Kut-Ku and a Yaozami appeared during the survey of the Jungle! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. Hunters who complete the request will receive the crafting materials for the weapon series Subdue the King of Magnetism.
55130.descriptionEn:
Yian Kut-Ku and Yaozami appeared
while we were surveying the
Jungle! The survey cannot be
completed like this. To hunters
who complete this request, we
will hand over the materials to
craft the "Subdue the Magnetic
King" weapon series.

54257.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
54257.description: The sky-soaring dragon has been confirmed near the course of the large survey ship. Even with interception equipment, we cannot survey if it attacks again and again. Board the survey ship and slay the sky-soaring dragon.
54257.descriptionEn:
Near the route of the large survey
ship, the Sky-Soaring Dragon was
sighted. Even with interception
equipment, we cannot carry out
our survey if it keeps attacking.
Please board the large survey ship
and slay the Sky-Soaring Dragon.

21623.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
21623.description: Have you heard of the Pale Brown Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21623.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Pale Brown Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decorative charm.
If you complete this
request, I shall give you
precious charm materials.

62845.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
62845.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!

26466.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
26466.description: A Rathian with a vivid cherry-blossom color seems to have appeared in the desert. A rare subspecies of high scarcity. Those with the courage to hunt the cherry blossoms blooming across the desert, please come to the quest counter.
26466.descriptionEn:
A ≪Rathian≫ with vivid cherry
blossom coloring seems to have
appeared in the Desert.
It is a highly rare subspecies.
Those with the courage to hunt
the cherry blossoms that bloom
wild in the Desert, come to the counter.

58030.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58030.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58030.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

51054.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
51054.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
51054.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

21229.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
21229.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21229.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

55133.description: Word has come that a Kirin was sighted at the Tower. According to the hunter who saw it, it unleashed attacks never seen before. A stronger individual is highly likely, so we will issue this survey request to veteran hunters only.
55133.descriptionEn:
We have word of a Kirin
sighted at the Tower. The
hunter who saw it reports
attacks never seen before.
It is likely a stronger
individual than usual, so we
are issuing a survey request
to veteran hunters.

22134.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22134.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
22134.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.

50146.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★４ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50146.descriptionEn:
Clear this request and you
can get materials needed to
upgrade G Rank armor from
G Rank 4 monsters! But the
G Rank parts won't drop,
so gather those elsewhere.

21486.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
21486.description: The one named Rukodiora, the Extreme Dragon, is closing on the Interception Base. We have readied ample supplies, interception weapons and carving artisans, so please slay it!
21486.descriptionEn:
The one named ≪Rukodiora≫,
the ≪Extreme Dragon≫, is
closing on the
≪Interception Base≫.
We've readied ample supplies,
anti-air weapons and even
carving artisans, so please
slay it!

54144.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ３匹の狩猟

56110.description: This is terrible! Help me! I have to deliver Espinas materials right now, but the materials are late arriving! Would you break the parts that yield the materials I need within 3 minutes! Then I can just make it! There is plenty of reward for you, so please!
56110.descriptionEn:
This is bad! Help me out!
I have to deliver Espinas
materials right now, but
the shipment is late!
Break the parts that give
the materials within three
minutes, would you? Then
we can just make it! I'll
pay plenty, so please do!

26363.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26363.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26363.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

26064.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26064.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26064.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

62598.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62598.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

54668.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54668.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

26437.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
26437.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.

22136.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22136.description: Hunter who would master the light bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
22136.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.

54409.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
54409.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54409.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

21927.description: The White Lake in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
21927.descriptionEn:
White Lake in the Warm Season.
The guild is still surveying
this uncharted land even now,
but why not visit it yourself,
hunter, to gather and survey?
If you start missing home,
just deliver a map!

54311.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54311.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

63069.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63069.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

54098.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
54098.description: I want your help with a survey of the Pariapuria. This time the survey concerns the workings of its back and its tail. For a body that huge to move so fast, the back and the tail must be involved. I am absolutely going to pin it down! So please, lend me your strength.
54098.descriptionEn:
I need your help with a
study of Pariapuria.
This time it's about the
workings of its back and
tail. Moving that huge body
so fast must involve them -
it has to!
I will pin down the secret,
so please lend me a hand.

61531.description: Happy New Year. Praying for a bountiful hunt this year, let us go with 4 to plant a Guild Flag at the snowy mountain summit. Do not forget to slay the Blango and Popo along the way. Oh, something seems to be prowling on the route, so take care.
61531.descriptionEn:
A happy New Year to
you all!
To pray for good hunting,
let us four raise a Guild
Flag on the Snowy Mountains
summit. Don't forget to slay
Blango and Popo on the way.
Oh, something seems to roam
the path - do take care!

23204.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
23204.description: This is a request from the survey team working in the unsurveyed part of the Jungle. According to the report, a large moving shadow is sighted at night and unease is spreading. It is certainly some monster. Please investigate before the surveyors come to harm.
23204.descriptionEn:
A request from the survey
team in the Jungle's
uncharted reaches.
They report that at night
a large moving shadow is
sighted, spreading unease.
A monster it surely is.
Before the surveyors come
to harm, please investigate.

21168.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21168.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21168.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or complete the sub-target
21168.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

60606.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
60606.description: It will be a most rare report even in the long history of observation. 2 rare species, of which it was whispered that they never travel together, resting in one place: we have confirmed it with our own eyes. I pray this good fortune reaches you hunters as well.
60606.descriptionEn:
This will be a most rare
report in our long history.
Two Rare Species, said to
never even travel together,
resting in one place - we
have seen it with our eyes.
May that same fortune come
to you hunters as well.

21091.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21091.description: When you hear 'a riot of flowers', what comes to mind? Here in the Elder Hall, unfortunately, it means two queens descended on the jungle. One dragon clad in clear green, one clad in crimson sakura. Who will take them on, I wonder?
21091.descriptionEn:
When you hear 'a riot of
blossoms,' what comes to mind?
Here at the Grand Hall, it
means two queens descending
upon the Jungle. A wyvern
clad in clear green, and one
wrapped in crimson cherry
blossoms. Who will face them?

62228.objectiveJp: 刻印された石・赤２個の納品
62228.description: You have a strange stone there. Would you not let me have it? In exchange I will give you something good.
62228.descriptionEn:
You've got a strange stone
there, don't you? Won't you
let me have it? I'll give
you something good in return.

54925.description: A Zinogre wrapped in light, standing at the top of the sea of trees. The Guild has decided to call it Zinogre that Roars to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you drive it off, you shall be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
54925.descriptionEn:
At the top of the Great
Forest stands a Thunder
Wyvern wreathed in light.
The Guild has named it
"the Acme-Roaring Zinogre."
Hunter of courage: drive it
off, and the materials for
the Guild's hidden armor
shall be yours.

60912.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. This time the reward is a Fanged Beast Tail L! Bring the specified number of Capture Certificates yourself.
60912.descriptionEn:
The Hunting Guild offers rewards
to hunters who capture many
Variants and Kishu.
This time: Fanged Beast Tail L!
Bring the required number of
Capture Certificates alone.

54259.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
54259.description: For the survey, I want you to hunt a Dosgaleos. There is one condition: I want the hunt carried out with the fin broken. It is a difficult request, I know, but it is for the survey. Then, I leave it to you.
54259.descriptionEn:
I want a Cephadrome hunted
for our survey. One thing:
I'd like it hunted with its
fin destroyed. A hard order,
I know, but it's for the
survey.
Well then, I count on you.

58072.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58072.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58072.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50855.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50855.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50855.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Sword
and Shield, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

51125.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
51125.description: This quest is an experiment on hunter activity while under the effects of a powerful drug. When you reach the base camp, please use there the extremely foul tasting drug we have prepared. There are 2 kinds of drug, so take care not to use the wrong one.
51125.descriptionEn:
This quest is an experiment
on hunter activity while
under a potent drug.
Once at the base camp, use
the ultimate foul potion we
have prepared on the spot.
There are two kinds, so be
sure not to use the wrong
one. That is all - beware.

55601.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55601.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55601.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

54283.description: Good news for all you G Rank hunters! A training method to efficiently build up experience has been developed. You cannot accept it consecutively, but the effect of a single run is immense! May your daily training become great strength for you!
54283.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you G Rank
hunters!
A training method to efficiently
build up experience has been
developed.
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
immense!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!

61705.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival. But you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. One person only, and nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
61705.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival.
But you just have to have a
memory of the festivities!
Yes, you there! Why not take
this quest? Mind you, the terms
are strict, so I do not recommend
it to the winning side.
One person only, and if you fail
the goods are not returned, so
be careful!

12022.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟

50055.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50055.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

62366.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62366.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

28043.description: The Odd Species Espinas, lord of the Deep Forest, has appeared in the Canyon, and the miners are in trouble. I would like it dealt with while it sleeps, but unluckily there is also a Tigrex sighting! Hurry to the Canyon and, if you can, hunt both!
28043.descriptionEn:
In the Canyon, the master of
the Great Forest, an Espinas
Rare Species, has appeared,
and the miners are stuck.
I'd like it settled while it
sleeps, but bad luck - we
also have Tigrex sightings!
Head to the Canyon at once
and hunt both if you can!

22039.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

61878.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ３頭の討伐
61878.description: This is terrible! Bulldrome seem to be breeding in great numbers in the Swamp. That is a bit dangerous if they breed there in such numbers, so slay as many as you can. There is no time to capture them, slay them for certain! Eh, reward? If Great Boar Hide will do, I will give you as much as you like!
61878.descriptionEn:
Bad news! Bulldrome seem to
be breeding en masse in the
Swamp. If they multiply
there it gets dangerous, so
slay as many as you can.
There's no time to capture -
slay them, all of them!
Huh, the reward? Boar hides
aplenty, as many as you like!

26129.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
26129.description: Iodrome is the boss of a pack of Ioprey, with a body a size larger than theirs and a purple crest. With what you've learned so far it's an opponent you can fight well enough, but it spits potent poison, so watch for that.
26129.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ is the boss of
the ≪Ioprey≫ pack, bigger
than its kin by a size, and
marked by a purple crest.
You can beat it with what
you already know, but it
spits powerful poison, so
watch for that part.

40176.description: There is a report that that Elder Dragon is active in the farthest land. Please head out to slay it at once. A difficult situation is expected, so steel yourself fully and head for the site.
40176.descriptionEn:
There is a report that the
elder dragon is active in the
far reaches of the land.
Please head out to slay it at
once.
Difficult conditions are
expected, so go to the site
with your guard fully up.

53305.description: I heard a colossal Abiorugu appeared in the new arena. As an Abiorugu maniac, I simply must have a piece of that colossal Abiorugu's body! I leave the hunt to you!
53305.descriptionEn:
I hear a colossal Abiorugu
has appeared in the New
Great Arena. As an Abiorugu
maniac, I simply must have
a piece of that giant!
Please hunt it for me!

22065.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
22065.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Tigrex. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
22065.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
≪Tigrex≫ slay.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
polish your skills against other
hunters!

54630.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54630.description: Hunter who would master the heavy gun, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54630.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show me the
skill you have honed against
the Tigrex in the Desert!
If you hunt it well, you shall
earn even more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.

62818.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62818.description: The VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice final quest. Clearing it will not give you the target monster's materials. Hunter Card White, Hunter Card Red or Hunter Card Blue may be obtained.
62818.descriptionEn:
The VS. Quest Champion
Tournament practice final
quest.
Clearing it will not give you
the target monster's materials.
≪Hunter Card White≫
≪Hunter Card Red≫
≪Hunter Card Blue≫
may be obtained.

50297.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
50297.description: We have received sighting information of a rare Hypnocatrice species at the top of the sea of trees. We want to press the investigation without missing this chance. Hunting of course, but this time please also break its beak, though it may be somewhat difficult.
50297.descriptionEn:
We have sightings of a
Hypnocatrice Rare at the
Top of Great Forest.
We mean to survey it
without missing this chance.
Hunt it, of course, and -
it may be hard - but be sure
to break its beak this time.

50968.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50968.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

55142.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐

62318.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62318.description: It is I, the Instructor! This is a quest for the Refined Monster trial! Today's target is the Variant Yian Garuga! I wish to hear how the feel of the fight changed before and after refining!
62318.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This quest is for the
Refinement Monster trial!
Today's target is a
Yian Garuga Variant!
Tell me how the fight felt
before and after refinement
- I want to hear it all!

26151.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
26151.description: It is I, the Instructor! The battle with the Velocidrome begins! Make full use of the items supplied and hunt with all your strength! Once you are used to slaying, practice capturing too. Knowing capture widens your range of hunts!
26151.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Your fight with ≪Velocidrome≫
begins! Use your supply
items and hunt at full power!
Once you're used to slaying,
practice ≪Capture≫ too. It
broadens your hunting range!

61774.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61774.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

50003.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
50003.description: In the mysterious unexplored Old Tower, an unobserved creature with no record at all in the authorities' documents has been confirmed. Surely the White Dragon spoken of in only one book has not appeared...?
50003.descriptionEn:
In the mysterious, unexplored
≪Ancient Tower≫, an unobserved
≪creature≫ with no record at all
in official documents has been
confirmed. Could it be that the
≪White Dragon≫ written of in
only one book has appeared...?

58128.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58128.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58128.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

22069.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退
22069.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to handle the Slash Axe F, which cannot be used unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22069.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR 5!
I hope you will strive
toward G Rank, which only
truly excellent hunters
may attain.
This time I have arranged
a chance to wield the
Switch Axe F, which none
may touch before G Rank.
Why not give it a try?

62480.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62480.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62480.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

61761.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
61761.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
61761.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

40211.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
40211.description: Monsters are approaching the square. Slaying elder dragons is our top priority. If we cannot slay them, there is no future. Hunters, I leave the rest to you.
40211.descriptionEn:
Monsters are closing in on the
square.
Slaying the elder dragon is our
highest priority.

If we fail to slay it, there is
no future.

Hunters, the rest is yours.

22155.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22155.description: A hunter thinking of changing from the Hope series armor to another set. How about the Quoiz series, available from this request? It has a stylish look like the Kukubo series, so I think you will like it.
22155.descriptionEn:
To hunters thinking of trading
their Hope Series armor for
something else.
How about the Quoiz Series
armor you can obtain from
this request?
It looks as stylish as the
Kukubo Series, so I am sure
you will like it.

55759.description: So you helped test the prototype. Thank you! You of all people know from using it that against powerful monsters, the current performance is not enough. Please, help me improve it! Before anything else, firepower. Gather Firestone for the explosives!
55759.descriptionEn:
So you helped test the
prototype. Thanks a lot!
You used it, so you know
best - against powerful
monsters, the current
performance just won't do.
Please help me improve it!
Firepower comes first.
Gather Firestone for powder!

55639.description: For hunters struggling to hunt Variant Species, the guild will provide support on this quest. Even if hunting the Variant Species Tigrex is difficult, you should still be able to take its material, Tigrex Hard Scale. Craft Variant weapons from the materials you obtain, and aim for the hunt next time.
55639.descriptionEn:
For hunters struggling to
slay Supremacy monsters,
the Guild offers support
with this quest.
Slaying the Supremacy
Tigrex is hard, but you can
still take its Hard Scales.
Craft a Supremacy weapon
from them and aim to slay it.

56045.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Espinas through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Lance, Gunlance, or Magnet Spike. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56045.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the
materials to craft one
Supremacy Espinas weapon
and upgrade it two stages,
plus Gz worth of Polta
Cards (Sakura). Weapon types:
Sword and Shield, Dual
Blades, Long Sword, Hunting
Horn, Lance, Gunlance or
Magnet Spike. Enjoy!

61884.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
61884.description: I found a good vein of ore in the Jungle, but a Blue Yian Kut-Ku is clinging to it and in the way. While I go to dig, I want you to drive it off nicely. I will pay your reward from the ore we dig.
61884.descriptionEn:
I found a fine ore vein in the
Jungle, but a Blue Yian Kut-Ku
is hanging around and in the way.
While I go to dig, I'd like you to
drive it off for me, nicely.
I'll pay you from the ore we
dig up.

62653.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
62653.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62653.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

61890.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61890.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

50570.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

61026.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス２頭の狩猟

23655.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
23655.description: A Toridokuresu with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Toridokuresu seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23655.descriptionEn:
A ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫ whose
wings have grown greatly has
appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy with
developed parts and will survey
it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.

60315.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
60315.description: This is urgent work! I want you to hunt the requested number of Iodrome and Ioprey at once. It is a bit of a tough request, but when you finish, I will carve you at least 2 Iodrome Hides!
60315.descriptionEn:
This job is urgent!
I need Gendrome and Genprey
hunted, the full count,
and fast as you can.
It's a bit of a grind, but
clear it and I'll carve you
at least two Gendrome
Hides, guaranteed!

55405.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55405.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Giaorugu has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous.
Prepare fully and survey.

28040.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Kuarusepusu materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28040.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters, why not
pass your skill on to the
guild's younger hunters?
This time, Kuarlusepusu
materials, generously!
Grow strong together and
liven up the guild. Clear
it with a Secret Art book
holder and a non-holder
for extra Guild credit!

21467.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
21467.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Tigrex. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21467.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
≪Tigrex≫ slay.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
polish your skills against other
hunters!

50350.description: I spread the fertilizer you gathered on the cherry trees. But the cherries will not bloom at all! If the cherries do not bloom, my wish will not come true. Why will they not bloom? Go and see how they are doing! There must be a cause!
50350.descriptionEn:
I spread the fertilizer you
brought on the cherry tree.
But it hasn't bloomed at all!
And if it doesn't bloom, my
wish won't come true.
Why won't it bloom?
Go and take a look for me!
There must be a reason!!

62686.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の捕獲
62686.description: The festival that has become a yearly custom will be held again this year. That is right. The festival where women give Porta Chocolate to men! A perfect chance to advance a relationship that always ends at greetings! Add a message that will leave that special someone tingling and give it to them!
62686.descriptionEn:
The festival that's becoming
a tradition is on again
this year. Yes - the one
where you give Polta Choco
to a man! A perfect chance
to move past a mere
greeting! Add a message
that'll make his heart
tingle, and give it to him!

50105.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50105.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

62212.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62212.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Rathalos L blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62212.descriptionEn:
Lend an ear to nature's
voice, and you may gain
ideas beyond human wit.
This request will help you
upgrade the Blademaster
Rathalos L armor. May your
hunting days stay rich and
full, now and always.

21409.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
21409.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
21409.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

50465.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50465.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the Tonfa, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
50465.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena we
have loosed a Rathian of
terrible strength, one that
moves in ways unthinkable.
Hunter who would master
the Tonfa - show me your
skill before me!
Hunt it well, and you shall
gain far more than daily
effort alone could give.

21807.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
21807.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21807.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

62280.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62280.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

60657.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Doragyurosu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60657.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Doragyurosu!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here
so aim for the top ranks!
This time Supremacy weapons
only - that's the rule!

63278.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
