63278.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Dyuragaua. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63278.descriptionEn:
An urgent request! We are
looking for someone to
slay an extremely powerful
Dyuragaua specimen.
Hunt it well and we will
issue more Slay Proofs
than usual for you!

63032.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63032.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Fermi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
63032.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secret
art of forging equipment have been
found on monsters slain all over
the land, or so I hear!
Once you get the "Fermi Memo",
come alone, like a man! Bring it
to this workshop master!
I'll show you some good work!

56129.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
56129.description: Do you remember? That death struggle with the fish. That legendary armor. The fish that wants another bout with you has come to the volcano. When things get hard, do not forget to use items such as a Source of Vigor. I send you hot memories.
56129.descriptionEn:
Do you remember? That duel
to the death with a fish.
That Legend armor. A fish
that wants another bout with
you has come to the Volcano.
When things get rough, don't
forget your items, like a
Stamina Drink. I send you
hot memories of battle.

55718.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55718.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

21950.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
21950.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Pariapuria. I am counting on you!
21950.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! You reached
HR31, I hear. So I have a
favor to ask. How about a full
set of weapon materials as
reward? Easy job, really.
Just run over and slay a
Pariapuria. I am counting
on you!

61354.description: Thanks to the Hunters Festa, more people than ever are forming hunting parties, which is a joy. But lately more and more party members use their weapons only to attack. Would you hunt the monsters nesting in the swamp and show them an example of defense? On success I will give you a black jewel.
61354.descriptionEn:
Thanks to Hunters Festa,
more hunters than ever
are forming guilds.
But lately, more members
use weapons only to
attack. Hunt a monster
nesting in the Swamp and
show them how to guard.
Succeed, and I shall give
you a black jewel.

62144.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
62144.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.

63020.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
63020.description: Please recreate the scene where the hero, Red Hunter, stands against a member of the evil organization. We have prepared the armor for you to become the Red Hunter, so do use it. A bright red suit is proof of courage! For everyone's hopes and future, go, Red Hunter!
63020.descriptionEn:
Recreate the scene where
the hero Red Hunter faces
a member of the evil org.
We have prepared armor
so you can become the Red
Hunter yourself. Use it!
A bright red suit is proof
of courage! For everyone's
hopes, go, Red Hunter!

23001.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の撃退
23001.description: The Guild requests a job from you, who have achieved so much. During the maiden voyage of a newly developed large survey ship, a giant shadow was reported between the clouds. It may be the legendary elder dragon from the records. Prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23001.descriptionEn:
For one with so many
deeds to your name, the
Guild has a request.
During the maiden voyage
of a new survey vessel,
a huge shadow was seen
between the clouds. It may
be the legendary Elder
Dragon. Prepare fully.

62322.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62322.description: It is I, the Instructor! This is a quest for the Refined Monster trial! Today's target is the Variant Iodrome! I wish to hear how the feel of the fight changed before and after refining!
62322.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This is a quest for the
Refine Monster trial!
Today's target is...
the Gendrome Variant!
Before and after Refine,
I want to hear how the
challenge has changed!

63230.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63230.description: A very powerful Yian Garuga that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63230.descriptionEn:
A ≪Yian Garuga≫ individual
that behaves unlike any other,
and is incredibly powerful,
is in the New Great Arena.
We want it hunted.
This request is only for
Hunters with Secret Art
scroll gear approved by the
guild. Clear it and earn
even greater renown.

58014.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58014.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58014.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

21187.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21187.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21187.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

28057.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. You are to slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28057.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between
you all, I have prepared a hard
request. Slay several monsters
together with your guildmates.
I am supplying nothing at all,
so talk it over with your
comrades before you depart.
The reward is a special ore!

23499.description: A Thunder Wolf Wyvern, Zinogre, has suddenly appeared! It is a monster never seen in these parts! Moreover, in its supercharged state with powerful discharge ability. Hunters confident in their skill, head for the site at once.
23499.descriptionEn:
The Thunder Wolf Wyvern
Zinogre has appeared! It is
a monster never seen in
these parts! And it is in
its supercharged state,
crackling with power.
Confident hunters, go now!

50244.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50244.description: Lately, when transporting goods in the jungle, we have often been attacked by monsters. I want it dealt with before great damage is done. The goods being transported are armor materials for rookie hunters like you. If you complete the request, I will share a little with you.
50244.descriptionEn:
Lately, whenever we haul supplies
through the Jungle, monsters
attack us so often.
Before real damage is done,
I want it dealt with.
What we carry is equipment
material for rookie hunters
like you. If you clear this
request, I'll share a little
with you.

55708.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
55708.description: Bulldrome and Bullfango are always in the way, meow. I just want to eat a tasty hot pot, meow. Working with my friends, I finally shut the nuisances in the Arena, meow. If you complete this request, I will give you my Hunting Party Ticket, meow. Do your best, meow.
55708.descriptionEn:
The big boar and Bullfango
always get in my way, nya.
I just want to eat a tasty
hot pot, nya.
With my friends, I finally
trapped them in the Arena,
nya. Clear this request and
I'll give you my Guild
Ticket, nya. Do your best!

61606.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
61606.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
61606.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.

21426.objectiveJp: きれいな貝殻１０個の納品
21426.description: One request, a hunt. I love it. Not hunting beasts, but shell gathering! My dream is to spend my future buried in shells. Would you gather lots of shells for me? Of course the reward is generous.
21426.descriptionEn:
One hunt, if you please.
I absolutely love it.
Not just any hunt — shell gathering!
My dream is to spend my future
buried in shells.
Would you gather a whole lot of
shells for me?
Of course, the reward will be good.

51099.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51099.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wings of a Yian Garuga will also grant a special ingredient.
51099.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
running, we have prepared this
quest to further raise awareness
and promote them.
By breaking the Yian Garuga's
wings, we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

61251.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61251.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
61251.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!

26621.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26621.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

62149.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐

62121.objectiveJp: 氷狐竜の上鱗３個の納品
62121.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Ice Fox Wyvern's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
62121.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon
but I'm short of parts!
I can't hunt like this.
Trade me the Giaorugu Fine
Scale you hold for this
Pawprint Medal! Please!

55919.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55919.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!

23172.description: While carrying out a survey I learned of a place in the Forest and Hills where a very rare material can be gathered. I mean to head there at once, but while I gather, I would like you to guard me. If we return safely, I will share the materials I gathered as thanks!
23172.descriptionEn:
While pressing my survey,
I found a spot in Forest
and Hills with rare parts.
I mean to head there now,
but while I gather, I want
you to escort me. If we
make it back safely, I'll
share the materials I
gathered as thanks!

11021.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
11021.description: Cephalos swim freely through the sand, and hunting them is hard work at the best of times. As for the boss, Cephadrome, it is no exaggeration to call it a battle of patience! It is important to force it above ground with loud noises and impacts!
11021.descriptionEn:
The Cephalos that swim freely
through the sand are a real pain
to hunt, and as for the boss,
"Cephadrome", it's no exaggeration
to call it a battle of patience!
It's important to force it above
ground with loud noise or impact!

50537.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? There is a strong theory that 4 volumes of books, recording a processing method unknown to us, sleep in the Desert. If only one could obtain them, the hidden power of a certain weapon could be drawn out.
50537.descriptionEn:
How much did the ancients
truly know? It is widely
held that four volumes
recording a forging method
we do not know sleep in the
Desert. With them in hand,
one could draw out the
hidden power of a weapon.

60691.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
60691.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Bogabadorumu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60691.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament
where hunters test skill!
This time's target is
Bogabadorumu! Going alone
after a monster - what
spirit! Best yourself and
claim a top rank! This one
is Supremacy weapons only,
so be ready!

55851.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a tail cut in slaying Gravios, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55851.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Gravios≫ and break its
head and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

55265.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
55265.description: To you who upgraded the Entra G series to LV7! I have prepared a quest that gets one piece's worth of upgrade materials for the Entra GF series armor all at once! Clear the quest five times and upgrade every part!
55265.descriptionEn:
To everyone who upgraded the
Entora G Series to LV7!
We have prepared a quest where
you can get upgrade materials
for 1 part of the "Entora GF
Series" armor all at once! Clear
it 5 times and upgrade every part!

11032.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
11032.description: The Ioprey are loudly active, which means there is a high chance the leader, Iodrome, is around! Take that poison liquid head on and you could lose your life! Do not forget antidote items!
11032.descriptionEn:
The fact that the Genprey are
stirring so actively means there
is a very good chance their
leader, the Gendrome, is nearby!
Taking that poison head-on could
cost you your life! Do not forget
your antidote items!

55659.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55659.descriptionEn:
Hammer master,
show your skill in the
New Great Arena against
the Blood-Drinking Wyvern
Baruragaru!
Hunt it well, and you shall
earn rewards far beyond
what daily effort brings
you.

63155.objectiveJp: 弩岩竜の崩鱗２個の納品
63155.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 2 Midogaron Shattered Scales and I will give you 2 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63155.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it down, nya!
This is a secret exchange.
Give me 2 Odibatorasu
Shattered Scales and I'll
give you 2 Boss Cat's
Favorites, nya. Slip them to
the Boss Cat and he'll make
Hardcore Cat weapons free!
Aim for the dream, nya!

61187.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

61755.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61755.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

23412.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
23412.description: This is a request that lets hunters who reached G Rank obtain the recommended jewel G Rank Guardian Flash Jewel. Hunt a Hypnocatrice Rare and you can obtain the G Rank Guardian Flash Jewel, a jewel with the skills Flash, Protection of the Three Realms and Wrath. Please make good use of it in your future hunting life.
23412.descriptionEn:
This is a request that lets hunters
who reached G Rank obtain the
recommended jewel ≪G Rank
Guardian Flash Jewel≫.
Hunt a Hypnocatrice Rare and you
can obtain the ≪G Rank Guardian
Flash Jewel≫, a jewel with the
skills Flash, Protection of the
Three Realms and Wrath.
Please make good use of it in your
future hunting life.

26260.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26260.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26260.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

50212.description: Hey hey! I was invited by a Guild person to come to Mezeporta, but monsters are in the way and I cannot get through! You skilled hunter there, do something! I will give you my treasure as thanks.
50212.descriptionEn:
Hey, hey!
The Guild folks invited me to
come to Mezepolta, but some
monsters are in the way and I
simply cannot get through!
You there, skilled hunter,
do something about it!
I'll give you my treasure as a
reward, so come on!

60672.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Pariapuria. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60672.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament
where hunters test skill!
This time's target is a
Special Individual
Pariapuria! Bring your
guild mates and clear it
together. Teamwork wins
this contest, so take a
top rank! Supremacy
weapons only this time!

50024.description: The restoration of the sheet music found in Mezeporta has finally reached its last stage! To make the chemicals used for the restoration, 3 materials are needed. I am dying to hear the rest of the story too, so gather them in the Canyon and get it done quickly!
50024.descriptionEn:
The sheet music found
in Mezeporuta is at last
nearing full repair!
To brew the reagent we
need, three materials are
required. I'm eager for the
rest of the tale, so let's
gather them in the Canyon!

63158.objectiveJp: チャチャブー６匹の討伐
63158.description: The season when the Shakalaka start making noise has come again this year! I want you to go and investigate them, but we must prepare clothes so they do not suspect us. So first, please complete this request.
63158.descriptionEn:
The season when the Masked
Tribe stirs has come again!
I want you to investigate,
but first we must prepare
clothes that won't make
them suspicious.
So please, start by
handling this request.

1081.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared. You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best out there.
1081.descriptionEn:
It seems the Kirin, an elder
dragon, has appeared in the
Ancient Tower, that unopened
land of many mysteries beyond
this place.
You cannot go to the Tower any
time; only while the weather and
every other condition is stable.
Do your best out there.

62987.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

26086.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26086.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

26047.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26047.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

54407.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
54407.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54407.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

13.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
13.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

50920.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to upgrade 1 piece of the Toa F Series, Heavenstorm Armor of Toa Tesukatora. It is a generous quest, so please give it a try!
50920.descriptionEn:
Toa Tesukatora's Tenran
Armor, the Toa F Series -
I present a request that
yields the materials to
upgrade one piece.
It's a bargain quest, so
please give it a try!

1008.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
1008.description: If you can hunt Yian Kut-Ku, your skill as a hunter is quite something! If you have room to spare, try making aged mushrooms too. Put specialty mushrooms in a Maka Pickling Jar and bury it. Simple!
1008.descriptionEn:
≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ down and I'd
say your hunting arm is
solid, mate! If you've got
time to spare, try aging
some mushrooms as well.
Special Mushrooms in a
≪Maka Pot≫, buried. Easy!

55058.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55058.description: This quest yields the following materials. Tonfa Merit (Beginning) x５０, Tonfa Merit (Middle) x６０, Tonfa Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55058.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Tonfa Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Tonfa Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Tonfa Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, GR500
or higher is required, so
please be aware.

62895.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62895.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

23210.description: This is from when I was heading deep into the swamp to survey. I found a fierce light flashing many times in the distance. A monster that gives off light in a place like this can only be Gypceros. I do not want the survey interrupted. Could you lend a hand?
23210.descriptionEn:
On my way deep into
the Swamp to survey,
I saw fierce flashes
of light blinking afar.
A monster that shines
in such a place could
only be a Gypceros.
I won't have my work
spoiled. Lend a hand?

21102.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

21586.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
21586.description: Have you heard of the Lion Mane Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21586.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Lion Mane?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Clear this request and
I'll hand you precious
decoration material.

50783.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50783.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of an Akura Vashimu will also grant a special ingredient.
50783.descriptionEn:
For the Guild Priority
requests we have long held,
we have prepared this quest
to spread word and boost
interest.
Sever the Akura Vashimu's
tail and we will grant you
special ingredients too.

50155.description: Have you ever tasted true despair? I won't mince words: never take this request out of mere curiosity. I've warned you. Even so, if you go, I won't stop you. But let me say one thing: come back safely.
50155.descriptionEn:
Have you ever tasted
true despair?
I won't mince words:
never take this request
out of mere curiosity.
I've warned you. Still, if
you go, I won't stop you.
Just let me say one thing:
come back alive.

21832.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

63403.description: Hmph, can you clear the trial we prepared, meow? The Albino's elasticity is no joke, so go and experience it for yourself, meow. If you manage it splendidly I will give you a treasured Dark Cat Gang Badge, meow!
63403.descriptionEn:
Heh, can you clear the
trial we prepared, nya?
Albino's stretch is no
joke, so go see for
yourself, nya. Succeed,
and you get my treasured
Dark Cat Gang badge, nya!

21063.description: We are looking for people to slay 8 Genprey, the hunters of the desert! They are just the right opponents to measure your skill as a hunter!
21063.descriptionEn:
Recruiting hunters to slay 8
Desert Hunter ≪Ioprey≫!
They are just the right foe for
gauging a hunter's skill at
the hunt!

55533.description: Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing their surroundings red with rage. We will somehow drive them into the Arena, so we ask you hunters to slay them and keep the damage from spreading any further. Upon your success, we will give you armor materials long stored away by the Guild.
55533.descriptionEn:
Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing
their surroundings red with rage.
We will somehow drive them into
the Arena, so we ask you hunters
to slay them and keep the damage
from spreading any further.
Upon your success, we will give
you armor materials long stored
away by the Guild.

61859.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
61859.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the newly discovered Highlands. At the summit, no less than the savage wyvern Gurenzeburu has been confirmed. Slaying it will be difficult, but go and experience the ecology and environment of this new land together!
61859.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
I want you all to explore the newly
discovered Highlands.
At the summit, would you believe it,
that Barbarian Wyvern, Gurenzeburu,
has been confirmed as well. Slaying it
will be difficult, but go and experience
the life and land of this new world!

23322.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
23322.description: The Espinas Rare Species we were seeking for our ecological survey has been found at the top of the forest. To carry out a more detailed study, hunters, head out at once and hunt the Espinas Rare Species.
23322.descriptionEn:
The ≪Espinas Rare Species≫ we
were seeking for an ecological
survey has been found at the
top of the Great Forest.
For a more detailed study, all
Hunters are asked to head out
and hunt it at once.

55152.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55152.description: Slaying an Anorupatisu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55152.descriptionEn:
By slaying Anorupatisu
you raise your standing
and can cheaply obtain
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations. I have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

53036.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス２頭の討伐
53036.description: It seems an ordinary Lavasioth will not do for praying for success in life. Right now a 'not ordinary' one has appeared! Two of them! Sorry, would you take it on once more? I will lend you an auspicious sword and armor, so do not forget to wear them!
53036.descriptionEn:
It seems a plain Volganos
won't get you very far
in the world.
And right now, some
not plain ones have
shown up! Two of them!
Sorry, will you take it on
again? I'll lend you a lucky
blade and armor. Wear them!

54147.description: We continue the investigation of Farnock, the Dancing King of the sea of trees. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54147.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of
Farnok, dancing king of
the Great Forest.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd love it!
Hunters all, we ask for
your kind assistance!

62558.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set on Tide Island, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Shore or the Voice of Nature: Ocean. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62558.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Tidal Island≫,
you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Shore≫ or
≪Voice of Nature: Ocean≫.
We wish you an even richer
life of hunting.

54632.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
54632.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54632.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

62780.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62780.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62780.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.

60505.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60505.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

63354.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63354.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the gunlance, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63354.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena
I have loosed a Rathian
of immense, unthinkable
strength. Gunlance master,
come before me and
show me your skill!
Hunt it well and you shall
gain far more than daily
effort ever brings
you.

53095.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
53095.description: For all who aim at HR100, I have prepared a quest to craft the Karais Series. Hunt a Dyuragaua to get the parts for one piece and the materials to level it up. Please make use of it.
53095.descriptionEn:
For all who aim at HR100,
I have prepared a quest
to craft the Kalais
Series.
Hunt a Duramboros to get
the parts for one piece
and the materials to
level it up.
Please make use of it.

54452.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Gougarf, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54452.descriptionEn:
For the newly launched
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest to spread word
and boost interest.
Break the Baruragaru's
head and we will grant you
special ingredients too.

61353.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
61353.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament preliminaries. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials by carving or clear rewards.
61353.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament preliminaries.
In the main round the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, you cannot obtain the
target monster's materials
by carving or clear rewards.

62343.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
62343.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62343.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

12066.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ２匹の狩猟
12066.description: The Shogun Ceanataur is a creature that uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling. If the hunt proves difficult, hunting the Gabras that flit about the crater this season and then heading home is not a bad idea either.
12066.descriptionEn:
The Sickle Crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
is a creature that uses its strange
leg joints to climb all the way to
the ceiling.
If hunting it proves difficult,
slaying the ≪Gabras≫ that flit
around the Volcano crater this
season and heading home is not a
bad option either.

55119.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
55119.description: For members of hunting parties that took part in the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward that allow you to craft armor from past festivals. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55119.descriptionEn:
Only for members of a Guild that
joined the Hunter Festival: a
special request and rewards that
let you craft past Hunter Festival
armor. When accepting or joining,
please bring ≪Festival Fervor≫.

50591.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50591.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

53309.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐

60310.description: Machalite Ore is needed for one thing or another when preparing equipment. But when you actually go digging, it often does not turn up. Still, if you defeat a Velocidrome on this quest, the guild will certainly present you with 2 or more Machalite Ore!
60310.descriptionEn:
Machalite Ore is always needed
to put equipment together.
But head out to mine and it
often refuses to show up...
Still, slay a ≪Velocidrome≫ in
this quest and the Guild will
guarantee you two or more
Machalite Ores!

26078.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26078.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

55840.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
55840.description: The Variant Species Bogabadorumu has appeared once more. Please take every care against its more powerful attacks and the explosions that accompany them, and conduct the investigation.
55840.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Bogabadorumu
has appeared once more.
Mind its far stronger
attacks and the blasts
they set off as you
carry out the survey.

11038.description: If you can hunt a Rathian, it means you stand on your own as a hunter. It's a famous saying among hunters, but making the queen cry would be even more impressive, wouldn't it? Maybe she cries if she drinks a lot of water?
11038.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means you stand on your own
as a hunter. It's a famous
saying among hunters, but
making the queen cry would
be even more amazing, no?
Does lots of water do it?

62337.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62337.description: To have cleared every request so far, you must be a hunter of some renown. This request is to hunt the ferocious Tigrex that appeared in the desert. It may be a somewhat unsatisfying opponent, but I ask you. As a reward, I shall give you a black secret jewel.
62337.descriptionEn:
To have cleared every
request so far, you must be
a hunter of renown.
This request is to hunt the
ferocious Tigrex that has
appeared in the Desert.
It may prove a light
challenge, but I ask it.
As reward, I shall give
you a black secret jewel.

23205.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
23205.description: A flustered adventurer reports seeing a Monoblos beyond the heat haze, moving with only its head. A head moving on its own is impossible. The natural conclusion is a Daimyo Hermitaur. Please investigate.
23205.descriptionEn:
In an unsurveyed part of
the Desert, an adventurer
reported seeing a Monoblos
moving as a head alone
beyond the heat haze.
A head cannot move alone.
It must be a Daimyo
Hermitaur. Please survey.

21322.description: The Thorn Long Sword you hold still holds unknown power. Obtain the Extreme Hard Sharp Thorn, which can only be taken from a powerful Espinas, and release that unknown power.
21322.descriptionEn:
The Thorn Long Sword you hold
still has unknown power sleeping
within it.
Obtain ≪Extreme Hard Sharp
Thorns≫, which can only be taken
from a mighty Espinas, and
release that unknown power.

21005.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21005.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, is tough and a brute, so take great care! Especially in this cold season, it will be on edge from hunger! Catching and delivering a Goldenfish instead of pushing yourself is another option, you know!?
21005.descriptionEn:
The Bulldrome, leader of the
Bullfango, is tough and wild, so
take care!
In this cold season especially,
it will be hungry and on edge!
Fishing up a Goldenfish and
delivering that is also an
option, you know!?

21635.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
21635.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Realgar Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21635.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Realgar Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Clear this request and
I'll hand you precious
decoration material.

23571.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23571.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

63420.description: Nyahaha! An executive of the Dark Cat Pack slaps a quest right at you, meow! I brought two special individual monsters, so slay them quickly, meow! Then I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Badge, meow!
63420.descriptionEn:
Nyahaha! A quest straight
from a Dark Cat Gang exec!
I've brought two Special
Individual monsters along,
so slay them quick, nya!
Do that, and I might
just give you a Dark Cat
Gang badge, nya!

62917.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
62917.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one, and it is just like a play!
Let me have you join in that
festival too. Oops, don't bring
anything dangerous in, all right.
Only the weapon that marks you a
hunter will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!

61712.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
61712.description: Hello. Thank you for playing MHF for a year! Turn in one Annual Bonus Production Ticket and we will give you eleven Proofs of Gratitude. From a Proof of Gratitude you can produce the Nana Blade [Empress] (Great Sword).
61712.descriptionEn:
Hello there.
Thank you for playing MHF for a year!
If you deliver 1 ≪Yearly Bonus
Production Ticket≫, we will present
you with 11 ≪Proofs of Gratitude≫.
From the ≪Proofs of Gratitude≫, the
≪Nana Blade [Empress]≫ (Great Sword)
can be crafted.
We hope you continue to enjoy the game.

55420.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
55420.description: Word has come that Shogun Ceanataur and Basarios appeared in the volcano, and at the same time. As it is a distant land, the extent of the local impact is unknown, but G Rank hunters, head for the site.
55420.descriptionEn:
We have word that a ≪Shogun
Ceanataur≫ and a ≪Basarios≫
appeared in the Volcano at
the same time. It is far
away, so the local impact is
unclear, but all G-Rank
hunters are to head there.

11083.description: We are looking for people to slay 8 Genprey, the hunters of the desert! They are just the right opponents to measure your skill as a hunter!
11083.descriptionEn:
Recruiting hunters to slay 8
Desert Hunter ≪Ioprey≫!
They are just the right foe for
gauging a hunter's skill at
the hunt!

55183.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Congalala while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55183.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Congalala
you raise your standing
and can cheaply obtain
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations. I have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

50607.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１０匹の討伐
50607.description: They are lurking in the Deep Forest. To loosen their guard even a little, disguise yourself with all your might and go slay them. However, a Hypnocatrice has appeared in the Deep Forest lately and they cannot easily leave their burrow. Hunt the Hypnocatrice and they may come out at ease.
50607.descriptionEn:
They're holed up in the
Great Forest. To ease their
guard, go in full disguise
and slay them. But lately
a Hypnocatrice has appeared
and they won't leave the
den. Hunt it, and they may
come out easy.

55916.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55916.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55916.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.

54874.description: It has been a long time. When did I last forge your Green Thorn Blade? Now, obtain the material said to come from only one in thousands of Espinas, and release its true power.
54874.descriptionEn:
It has been a long while.
When did I last forge your
"Thorn Green Long Sword"?
Now, take the material said to
be obtainable from only one among
thousands of Espinas, and release
its true power.

50931.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退
50931.description: This is a quest for skilled hunters who have reached ＨＲ５. We will lend you armor that activates skills recommended for driving off Guanzorumu. Please take on the challenge of driving it off!
50931.descriptionEn:
This quest is for skilled
hunters who have reached
HR5.
We lend you armor whose
skills suit repelling
Guanzorumu.
Please take on the
repel of Guanzorumu!

22033.description: Rathian's other name is the Queen of the Land! That title is no lie: many a hunter has bowed before her! Hunt a Rathian and it will mean you stand on your own as a hunter!
22033.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ is also known as
the Queen of the Land! That
name is no lie; many hunters
have bowed before her!
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and you
stand on your own as a
hunter!

21981.description: Golden and silver Supremacy species have appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monsters. Act with your own safety first.
21981.descriptionEn:
The gold and silver
Zeniths have appeared.
This request aims to stop
the damage spreading
until the slaying unit
arrives. So clear it by
repelling them.
Put your own safety first.

21743.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
21743.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
21743.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!

21198.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21198.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21198.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

60237.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Abiorugu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60237.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament
where hunters test skill!
This time's target is
Abiorugu! Bring your guild
mates and clear it
together. Teamwork wins
this contest, so take a
top rank!
Also, SP weapons only!
Choose your weapon wisely!

50856.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50856.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50856.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Dual
Blades, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

23306.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

54936.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Long Sword Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Long Sword Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54936.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Long Sword Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Long Sword Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.

62340.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐

62682.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62682.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
62682.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.

50747.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
50747.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50747.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

63214.description: I have prepared a somewhat unusual request so that everyone can enjoy themselves. Do run around the field with your companions and complete it! To liven things up, I have set traps! Watch your surroundings when you move!
63214.descriptionEn:
To show everyone a good
time, I've readied a rather
odd request. Grab your
friends, race around the
field and clear it!
To spice things up, I set
traps! Watch your step
as you move!

23339.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
23339.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gurenzeburu, the Barbarian Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23339.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Brute
Wyvern ≪Gurenzeburu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

20016.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
20016.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the city! Make use of the city's interception weapons and slay the mysterious giant dragon completely! Please!
20016.descriptionEn:
Word from the Elder Dragon
Forecast Office: a sinister
dragon nears the town!
Use the town's intercept
weapons and fully slay
the giant mystery dragon!

55707.client: Man Who Lives in the Tower
55707.clientEn: Man Who Lives in the Tower

1022.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
1022.description: So you'll hunt Gendrome for us? With your skill I can leave it to you with confidence! If you have time to spare, deliver Herbivore Eggs gathered this season! They're a popular item, packed with nourishment!
1022.descriptionEn:
So you'll hunt the
≪Gendrome≫ for me? With your
skill I can rest easy!
If you have room to spare,
deliver some ≪Herbivore
Eggs≫ gathered this season!
Nutritious and popular!

55944.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の捕獲
55944.description: This time we have prepared a special trial to confirm the true bond of the bride and groom! Its name is the Trial of Love! This trial is to be taken by the bride and groom alone! Through this trial the two of you will swear eternal love! I wish you every happiness!
55944.descriptionEn:
This time, to test the
true bond of the bride and
groom, we prepared a
special trial! Its name:
Trial of Love!
Only the bride and groom
may take it on!
With this trial, swear
eternal love! Be happy!

54649.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54649.description: There is a daily limit on orders, but here is a quest for some of the materials needed to upgrade Azure Hypnocatrice G Rank gear. Don't miss this chance.
54649.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
orders, but here is a quest
for some of the materials
needed to upgrade Azure
Hypnocatrice G Rank gear.
Don't miss this chance.

26133.description: Most egg-type items, Herbivore Eggs included, can be found in corners where bones are scattered or up on ledges. When you find a Carnivore Egg, carry it to the red box at camp and deliver it.
26133.descriptionEn:
Many egg-type items like
the ≪Carnivore Egg≫ can be
found in corners where bones
are scattered, or on ledges.
When you find a ≪Carnivore
Egg≫, carry it to the red
box at camp and deliver it.

26227.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

50622.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50622.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
50622.descriptionEn:
For the Guild Priority
requests we have long held,
we have prepared this quest
to spread word and boost
interest.
Break the Kushala Daora's
head and we will grant you
special ingredients too.

50298.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
50298.description: Sighting report of an Espinas rare species. Hunters, head for the Forest summit at once and hunt it. For the ecology survey, be sure to destroy its horn before hunting.
50298.descriptionEn:
We have a sighting of the
Espinas Rare Species.
Hunters, hurry to the Top
of Great Forest and hunt it.
For the ecology survey,
please be sure to break
its horn during the hunt.

50964.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
50964.description: For hunters at HR5, a recommended quest: craft the Senyu armor Kyuurou Series. Breaking the Stygian Zinogre's head and tail is required, but parts abound.
50964.descriptionEn:
For hunters at HR5, a
recommended quest: craft
the Senyu armor Kyuurou
Series.
Breaking the Stygian
Zinogre's head and tail is
required, but parts abound.

60449.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60449.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

23536.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23536.description: An Akura Vashimu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Akura Vashimu known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23536.descriptionEn:
An Akura Vashimu with a greatly
developed tail has appeared.
The guild classes this one as a
Supremacy with developed parts,
and will survey it.
Reports say it is more dangerous
than past Akura Vashimu.
Please survey it with care.

58057.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58057.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58057.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

23283.description: This is a report from a surveyor who went to the unsurveyed part of the Jungle. When they went to the waterside at night, they felt a gaze from the bottom of the water and fled in a panic. Many creatures live in the area, so unease is spreading among the surveyors. Head there and begin the survey.
23283.descriptionEn:
This is a report from the
surveyors working the unexplored
part of the Jungle.
At night, by the water, they
felt a gaze from the bottom of
the water and fled in a panic.
Many creatures live in the area,
so unease is spreading.
Head to the site and begin
the survey.

61832.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Next you will prove the accumulation of your daily discipline. On your own, land a Plesioth with a single rod and deliver 10 Fish Print [Small]. You must reel in the Plesioth without hunting it, absolutely.
61832.descriptionEn:
Fishing: a lonely hunt where you
face the fish in silence. Next,
prove the results of your daily
training. Alone, land one Plesioth
by rod and deliver 10 Fish Prints
[Small]. You must reel in the
Plesioth without ever hunting it.

26369.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26369.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

26366.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26366.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26366.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

55604.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55604.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!

61963.description: Happy New Year! This year too we have properly prepared New Year gifts! But before that, how about a little game? If by some means you come by a Crimson Lotus Stone, that is the grand prize! A Dragon Tear is a small prize! A test of luck at the year's start!
61963.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
This year too, I have a
New Year's gift ready!
But first, how about a
little game?
Get a Firecell Stone by
any means: jackpot!
A Dragon Tear is a small
win! Test your luck!

55557.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55557.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu has appeared once more. Its developed horns seem able to command a more powerful dark thunder. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55557.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Doragyurosu≫
has appeared once more.
Its developed horns seem able
to command a more powerful
dark thunder than before.
Please take great care in
your survey.

62116.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Deep Forest. The thorn wyvern Espinas has also been confirmed in the depths, it seems. Hunt that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62116.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time I want you all to explore
the Great Forest. An Espinas
has been confirmed in the
depths as well. Hunt that one
while you're at it! I even
prepared armor for you in advance!
Now go and do your best!

58063.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58063.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58063.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

50417.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

53075.description: The final quest for the Championship Tournament DMM Cup. Please read the participation rules on the tournament's special site carefully, and join after agreeing to them. Taking the final quest counts as participation.
53075.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
"Championship Tournament DMM
Cup".
Please read the participation rules
on the event's special site, and
agree to them before joining.
Accepting the final quest is taken
as your entry into the tournament.

51046.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the crest of a Congalala will also grant a special ingredient.
51046.descriptionEn:
To spread word of the Guild
Priority requests we have long
run, we have prepared this
quest for you.
Break the crest of the
Congalala, and a special
ingredient will be granted to
you as well.

21195.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21195.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

53072.description: The final quest for the Championship Tournament DMM Cup. Please read the participation rules on the tournament's special site carefully, and join after agreeing to them. Taking the final quest counts as participation.
53072.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
"Championship Tournament DMM
Cup".
Please read the participation rules
on the event's special site, and
agree to them before joining.
Accepting the final quest is taken
as your entry into the tournament.

62668.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
62668.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62668.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

55892.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55892.description: They say there is a tree at a place called the Colored Falls that blooms in vivid colors never seen around here. This year I thought I would do something a little different and view the blossoms there. Hunter, would you go and scout it out for me? And while you are at it, I would like you to procure some ingredients.
55892.descriptionEn:
At a spot called the
Painted Falls, a tree
blooms in colors never seen
around here, they say.
This year I fancied a
change, so we'll view them
there. Hunter, would you
scout it for me? And while
you're there, gather food.

61637.description: I give you a trial! Go to the jungle and gather ice crystals with a pickaxe! A hunter must become used to handling ice! If you have strength left, taking on monsters with claws and fangs would be good too. I wish you success!
61637.descriptionEn:
I now give you a trial!
Go to the Jungle and use a
pickaxe to gather Ice
Crystals! A hunter must
get used to handling ice!
If you have strength left,
facing monsters with claws
is fine too. Fight well!

63098.description: Hunters! This is my last request! There is a fine hot spring source in the volcano region to the north. But a filthy flying wyvern is there, spreading a vile stench. No hot spring can be built in such a place. So I want you to give that wyvern a thorough washing! I wish you good hunting!
63098.descriptionEn:
Hunters! This is my final
request! In the northern
volcanic region lies a fine
hot spring. But a filthy
wyvern squats there,
spreading a foul stench.
No bath can be built there.
So I want you to scrub that
wyvern clean! Fight well!

23611.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu has appeared once more. Its tail has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23611.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Giaorugu has
appeared once more.
Its tail has grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
more power still.
Survey with great care.

15021.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐

55882.description: For members of hunting parties that took part in the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward that allow you to craft armor from past festivals. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55882.descriptionEn:
Only for members of a Guild that
joined the Hunter Festival: a
special request and rewards that
let you craft past Hunter Festival
armor. When accepting or joining,
please bring ≪Festival Fervor≫.

55472.description: The Variant Species Plesioth has appeared once more. Its head has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55472.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Plesioth≫ has
appeared once more.
Its head has grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
still more power. Please take
great care in your survey.

62539.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62539.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62539.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

50706.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
50706.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the fangs of an Akantor will also grant a special ingredient.
50706.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the fangs of the
Akantor also grants you
special ingredients.

62741.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の捕獲

55608.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55608.description: There has been a sighting of the scorching-zero dragon at the summit of the Tower. Investigate the source of that power wreathed in ice and flame. It is likely that the Scorching-Zero Dragon's Twin Sac is involved. G-rank hunters confident in their skill should head for the Tower.
55608.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting
of Eruzerion atop the Tower.
Please survey the source of
the ice and flame it wears.
The Eruzerion Twin Sac
is likely involved.
Confident G Rank hunters,
head for the Tower.

55498.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55498.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

54477.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! A Super Golden Experience request has appeared, a further boost to the rewards of the Golden Experience, which lets you build experience efficiently and obtain large amounts of Ｇｚ. Do take the chance to try it!
54477.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice, hunters!
A quest for the Super
Golden Experience is up,
boosting the rewards of the
Golden Experience that
piles up EXP fast and
hands out tons of Gz.
Take up the challenge
while you can!

51090.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51090.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
51090.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
requests we have long been running,
we have prepared this quest in
order to raise awareness and
interest in them.
By breaking the Gravios's chest,
special ingredients will also be
granted to you as a reward.

20019.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
20019.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and drive the elder dragon off, we beg of you!
20019.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast
Office! Teostra has invaded
Mezeporuta's lands! The town
now moves to intercept!
Use the intercept gear set
at the Base and repel the
Elder Dragon, we beg you!

63162.objectiveJp: 弩岩竜の崩鱗２０個の納品
63162.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 20 Midogaron Shattered Scales and I will give you 30 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63162.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it down, nya!
This is a secret exchange.
Give me 20 Odibatorasu
Shattered Scales and I'll
give you 30 Boss Cat's
Favorites, nya. Slip them to
the Boss Cat and he'll make
Hardcore Cat weapons free!
Aim for the dream
jackpot, nya!

23527.objectiveJp: 出現モンスターの討伐

23565.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23565.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

54234.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54234.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

54337.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
54337.description: A quest for the MHF-GG Advance Trial Event. Enjoy GG a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54337.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
≪MHF-GG Preview Event≫.
Get an early taste of GG
ahead of everyone else!
Time limit: 10 minutes.

60447.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60447.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

60212.description: When the breeding season comes, the orange-furred Hypnocatrice always vanish. I want to know what that means. To clarify the ecology of the breeding-season Hypnocatrice, capture 1 Hypnocatrice.
60212.descriptionEn:
Every breeding season,
the orange-plumed
Hypnocatrice vanishes.
I mean to learn what that
means. To study its
breeding ecology, capture
one Hypnocatrice for me.

54716.description: Oh! You've come! Look at this Tonfa overflowing with 'romance'! For these iron fists, the spirit of a man who trades blows head-on is what suits them! Among monsters too, there seems to be one overflowing with the 'romance' of speaking with fists! Go and speak with him, fist to fist, head on!
54716.descriptionEn:
Hey! Glad you came!
Look at this Tonfa,
overflowing with romance!
Only a man's spirit,
fist against fist, suits it!
Seems some monster out
there speaks with fists
and romance too! Go face
it, fist to fist!

54282.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Plesioth and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54282.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Hunt the Plesioth in style and
prove yourself.
Clear the quest and your
standing as a hunter will jump
right up!

62747.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Gogomoa of Shiojima. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
62747.descriptionEn:
The time has come for
hunters to show their skill!
Hunt the Gogomoa of the
Tidal Island. Clear the
quest safely, and your
standing as a hunter
will shoot right up!

50435.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21362.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Volcano, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Plateau or the Voice of Nature: Tornado. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21362.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the Volcano, you may
obtain Voice of Nature: Plateau
or Voice of Nature: Tornado.
I pray your hunting life grows
all the richer for it.

54484.description: VS. Quest Champion Tournament at Thanks Fest 2014: practice qualifier. The time limit is 10 min. Also, from carving and clear rewards you cannot obtain the target monster's materials.
54484.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament at Thanks Fest
2014: practice qualifier.
The time limit is 10 min.
Also, from carving and
clear rewards you cannot
obtain the target
monster's materials.

21892.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
21892.description: This quest is for the HR500 breakthrough trial. Accept the trial from the Guild Master or the HR trial board, then depart on the quest alone.
21892.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the
HR500 breakthrough trial.
Accept the trial from the
Guild Master or the HR
trial board, then depart
on the quest alone.

23636.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23636.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against Tigrex in the desert! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
23636.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Lance, show the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will gain even more reward than
what your daily efforts bring.

60055.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61959.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
61959.description: The savage Gurenzeburu has attacked merchants, it seems. It shows no sign of leaving the Highlands, and the region has been closed off as dangerous. Your task is to secure the Highlands. Hunters of skill, I leave it to you!
61959.descriptionEn:
A ferocious Gurenzeburu has
apparently attacked merchants.
It shows no sign of leaving the
Highlands, and the area has been
sealed off as dangerous.
This request is to secure the
safety of the Highlands.
Top hunters, I leave it to you!

11077.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ４頭の討伐
11077.description: We ask you to slay the Jungle's troublemaker, the Bullfango. At this time of year their numbers grow, damage is reported across the land every year, and the Guild is at a loss. Hunters, your help please!
11077.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Bullfango, the
troublemakers of the Jungle.
In this season their numbers
swell, and every year the damage
piles up everywhere, leaving the
guild at a loss.
Hunters, we ask for your help!

61886.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61886.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

26486.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
26486.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may be a little troublesome! A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast. The trick is not to let it escape!
26486.descriptionEn:
Hunting ≪Gendrome≫ in the volcano
region may be a bit of a bother!
A Gendrome that has spent its
stamina may flee into nasty spots
that drain a hunter's own stamina!
The trick is not to let it escape!

50017.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50017.description: We have now identified the monster approaching the desert. It is Rukodiora, an Elder Dragon with shining wings. It is closing on the desert at tremendous speed. Head for the desert at once and slay it!
50017.descriptionEn:
We have determined what the monster
that is currently flying toward the
Desert actually is.
It is the Elder Dragon species with
shining wings, ≪Rukodiora≫.
It is closing on the Desert at
fierce speed.
Head for the Desert at once
and slay it!
