55492.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55492.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

23408.description: It has been a long time. When did I last forge your Brown Thorn Blade? Now, obtain the material said to come from only one in thousands of Espinas Subspecies, and release its true power.
23408.descriptionEn:
It has been a long while.
When did I last forge your
"Brown Thorn Long Sword"?
Now, go and take the material
said to come from only one
among thousands of Espinas
Subspecies, and unleash
the true power within it.

55650.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (head), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
55650.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(head), excluding weapon
ribbons and weapon merits.
The yield is one type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫
is required, so please
take note.

23325.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
23325.description: During the survey I ran into a Red Khezu. I tried to flee at once, but its unusual movements toyed with me and I nearly took a face full of electricity. At this rate the survey cannot proceed. I want you to hunt it.
23325.descriptionEn:
During the survey we ran into
a ≪Khezu Subspecies≫.
We tried to run right away, but
it toyed with us using movements
unlike its usual ones, and we
nearly got caught in its shock.
The survey cannot go on like this.
I want you to hunt that thing.

53041.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
53041.description: Fellow Felyne comrades, was your begging answered? What, you want armor in a different color too!! Hahaha! You are good at begging! Hunters, it is for your cute partner! For the partner who still wants to look cute and stylish, go! Go now!
53041.descriptionEn:
Partner Nyas, did you get
your wishes granted?
...What, you want a
different-colored armor too!?
Hahaha! You beg so well!
Hunters, it's for your dear
partner! She still wants to
look cute and stylish, so
go, for your partner!

50096.description: A quest for the G2 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy MHF-G2 a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
50096.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
G2 Early Trial event.
Enjoy MHF-G2 a step
ahead of everyone!
The time limit is 10 min.

54582.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟

55185.description: Slaying a Gypceros raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55185.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Gypceros
you raise your standing
and can cheaply obtain
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations. I have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

61250.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
61250.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61250.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

55299.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55299.description: The Variant Species Blangonga has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55299.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Blangonga has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous
as things stand.
Prepare fully and survey.

50859.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50859.description: Hunter who would master the heavy bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50859.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.

50721.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of a Chameleos will also grant a special ingredient.
50721.descriptionEn:
For the Guild Priority
requests we have long held,
we have prepared this quest
to spread word and boost
interest.
Sever the Chameleos' tail
and we will grant you
special ingredients too.

62443.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62443.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62443.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

21416.description: Mining is good work. While you dig you can empty your mind. When I head to the hunting grounds, I always bring a pickaxe! So then, the next request. This time too I await a delivery of fine ore. Look forward to the reward!
21416.descriptionEn:
Mining is great, isn't it?
While you dig, your mind goes
blank. When I head out to
hunt, I always bring a
pickaxe along with me!
So, here's the next request.
I'm waiting on good ore again.
Expect a fine reward!

23689.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23689.descriptionEn:
Hunters who seek to master the Switch
Axe, show the skill you have honed
against the ≪Baruragaru≫ in the New
Great Arena!
If you hunt it splendidly, you shall
obtain even more rewards than
what your daily efforts
would bring.
Now, display your technique!

61125.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
61125.description: A Rajang variant seems to be on a rampage in the Snowy Mountains. This is exactly when you want a melee weapon that can guard. No other equipment is permitted! Take the attacks squarely and hit back hard. Find an opening and break some parts too!
61125.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
61125.descriptionEn:
A Variant Rajang is on a
rampage in the Snowy
Mountains. This is the time
for a guard-capable melee
weapon. No other gear is
allowed! Block its attacks
solid, then hit back hard.
Find an opening and break
its parts too!

23671.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
23671.description: The Variant Species Gasurabazura appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Gasurabazura. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23671.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Gasurabazura≫
seems to have reached a strength
that puts it at the very top of
all Gasurabazura. Its power is
beyond measure. Hunters sure of
their skill to challenge the
summit, please take on the
survey.

11505.description: It is I, the Instructor! The fish at the fishing points differ by place. It is good to remember where the fish you need can be caught. Also, the kinds of fish change with the season. The mystery of nature!
11505.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
The fish at ≪fishing points≫
differ by location. Make sure
to remember where the fish you
need bite.
The kinds of fish also change
with the season. Nature's mystery!

55643.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55643.description: A Variant Species Doragyurosu with greatly developed horns has appeared. It displays the fierce might peculiar to Variant Species, and hunters are withdrawing one after another. In response, the guild will provide firm support for the hunt. Go to the investigation fully prepared.
55643.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Doragyurosu
with greatly grown horns has
appeared. Wielding a
Supremacy's ferocity, it has
hunters retreating one after
another. The Guild will
back the slaying strongly.
Survey with all caution.

23712.description: The Variant Species Gravios appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Gravios. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23712.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Gravios appears
to have reached a strength that
borders on the very summit of
its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters sure of their skill are
asked to take on this survey.

63329.description: Reports have reached us of an unidentified monster on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
63329.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
an unidentified monster is
rampaging in the Ancient Tower.
As every moment counts, this is
a short-time slaying request,
but to keep the damage to a
minimum, we will accept a mere
repel as well.
We seek hunters with a Secret
Art Tome to face this crisis!

28084.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
28084.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
28084.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.

58073.description: This is an emergency. A gigantic monster is reported to be closing on the interception base. Because it is urgent, we are asking only hunters with achievements. Prepare fully and head there at once to slay the gigantic monster.
58073.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency. We have received
a report that a gigantic monster is
closing in on the Base.
Because it is urgent, this request is
extended only to hunters of merit.
After making full preparations,
head to the site at once and
slay the gigantic monster.
Do not underestimate it.

55976.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55976.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55976.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

21232.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
21232.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21232.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

54892.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54892.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

61411.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

62260.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退

62390.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62390.description: This is the final quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from the quest clear rewards.
62390.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Target monster materials cannot
be obtained from the quest clear
rewards.

55698.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55698.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Doragyurosu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55698.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials of the Supremacy
Doragyurosu.
To accept the quest,
a Superior Ticket is
required.
If the quest is failed,
the Superior Ticket is
consumed, so take care.

50933.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of the Mighty Armor Sphere and Heaven Armor Sphere used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
50933.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough armor
upgrade materials?
In today's request, you can
obtain large amounts of the
≪Hard Armor Sphere≫ and
≪Heavenly Armor Sphere≫ used
to upgrade armor. Note that
the number you can accept per
day is limited, so be careful.

60202.description: Hypnocatrice have multiplied in great numbers. Crops and village buildings are being damaged all over, it seems. I want to act before the damage reaches us here. I am counting on you.
60202.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice have swarmed.
Crops and village buildings
are being damaged all over.
I want to act before
the damage reaches us.
I'm counting on you.

54961.description: I have caught all kinds of fish. Sometimes I went to the Polar Sea or the White Lake. But there is one I could never catch. The water wyvern Plesioth! I will hand my fish to a hunter skilled enough to catch it!
54961.descriptionEn:
I have fished for all
kinds of fish.
Sometimes I went to the
Polar Sea and White Lake.
But there's one I never
could land.
The water wyvern Plesioth!
To a hunter with the skill
to fish that one up, I'll
give my fish!

55684.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Khezu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55684.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the materials of the Supremacy
≪Khezu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

56042.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
56042.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56042.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials to craft one
Supremacy weapon from a
Supremacy Daimyo Hermitaur
and upgrade it two steps,
plus Porta Card Sakura.
Weapon types: Dual Blades,
Hunting Horn, Switch Axe,
Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun
or Bow. Use it well!

62312.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Khezu L blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62312.descriptionEn:
If you listen to the voice
of nature, you may gain
ideas beyond human wit.
This request will help you
upgrade the Khezu L armor
for blademasters. May your
hunting life stay rich
and full, always.

56018.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Rathalos. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56018.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Rathalos for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.

23295.description: Thanks to your gathering in unexplored lands and delivering to the Guild, Mezepolta has grown richer. As a token of our gratitude, we present this coin.
23295.descriptionEn:
Thanks to your gathering in
unexplored lands and your
deliveries to the Guild,
Mezeporuta has grown wealthy.
As a token of our gratitude,
please accept this coin.

55051.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55051.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Great Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Great Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55051.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
the following materials.
≪Great Sword Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Great Sword Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Great Sword Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you must
be GR 500 or higher, so
please take note.

55436.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (waist), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
55436.descriptionEn:
This quest
drops the materials needed
to upgrade G Rank Secret
Art Armor (waist), except
weapon cords and honors.
It drops one type only.
To accept the quest,
a 10th Anniversary Ticket
is required, so take care.

26020.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26020.description: A hunting encouragement notice for novice hunters. Lately, please hunt the Bulldrome that ravage the crops nearby. Since it is meant to encourage novices, the reward is said to be generous as a form of support!
26020.descriptionEn:
An announcement to encourage
all you rookie hunters.
Lately a ≪Bulldrome≫ has been
ravaging the nearby crops, and
we ask you to slay it.
It is meant to encourage rookies,
so the reward is said to be
generous as support too!

60504.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
60504.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60504.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

61053.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61053.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! The Hypnocatrice and the Yian Kut-Ku, representatives of the bird wyverns. Their strength alone may not match the flying wyverns, but facing 2 at once is another matter! Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
61053.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show off
their skill! The ≪Hypnocatrice≫
and ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫, pride of the
Bird Wyverns.
Their individual strength may not
match the Flying Wyverns, but two
at once is another story! Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose his
life to a moment's carelessness!

22.description: It is I, the Instructor! Without delay, I will instruct you on the Switch Axe! To get used to the Switch Axe quickly, I want you to accept this at least once.
22.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Let me instruct you on the
Switch Axe!
To get used to it quickly,
I want you to take this
quest at least once.

55413.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55413.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55413.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

40215.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟

26183.description: Just when I thought those noisy ones were gone, now there is a swarm of Cantaro thick enough to cover the ground! I left my important baggage behind! Someone drive them off!
26183.descriptionEn:
Just when those noisy pests were
gone, now there is a swarm of
Hornetaurs that looks ready to
cover the ground!
I left my important cargo behind!
Someone go and drive them off!

60439.description: Traps, you see, are the fruit of quiet, unglamorous work. So first you cannot neglect steady gathering. The Forest is a good place where you can procure traps on site, so start with gathering.
60439.descriptionEn:
Y'see, traps are the fruit of
quiet, unglamorous work.
So first off, a hunter can't
neglect plain old gathering.
The Great Forest is a fine spot
where traps can be sourced on
site, so start out by going
gathering, you hear.

21355.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Snowy Mountains, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Aurora, the Voice of Nature: Spring Water, or the Voice of Nature: Mountains. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21355.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Snowy Mountains≫, you may
obtain ≪Nature's Voice: Aurora≫,
≪Nature's Voice: Spring Water≫,
or ≪Nature's Voice: Mountains≫.
I pray that your hunting life
grows ever richer and more
fulfilling.

23284.description: A peddler reports that a Diablos is running wild in the desert. No notable damage has occurred yet, but please go and deal with it to keep the people traveling the nearby road safe.
23284.descriptionEn:
A traveling merchant has reported
that ≪Diablos≫ is rampaging in the
Desert. There seem to be no notable
casualties at present, but for the
safety of those using the nearby
highway, please head out and
deal with it.

21041.description: If you're going after Basarios, it's best to search the rocky areas! It often hides by blending in with the rocks! If you plan to do some mining, by all means deliver Coal! It's a prized energy source!
21041.descriptionEn:
If you're going after a
≪Basarios≫, try searching the
rocky areas! It often hides
among the rocks, you see.
If you plan to mine, then by
all means deliver ≪Coal≫!
It's a prized energy source,
that stuff!

58052.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58052.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58052.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

60323.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
60323.description: I want it! I want it! I want it no matter what! The cute furniture of the Kut-Ku! Kind hunter! Hunt lots for me! I will give you plenty of the materials for Blast Powder I filched from the house storehouse! Please!
60323.descriptionEn:
I want it! I want it!
I just have to have it!
The cute Yian Kut-Ku furniture!
Kind hunter! Go hunt lots and
lots of them for me!
I will give you loads of
≪Gunpowder≫ ingredients I
swiped from our storehouse!
Please!

61962.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been found! This may be a good chance to gather materials! Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! We have limited the number of participants, so you should be able to depart at once!
61962.descriptionEn:
A comparatively weak individual
monster has been discovered!
This may be a good chance to
gather materials! Before it
flees far away, please hurry
and get ready! We have limited
the number of participants, so
you should be able to depart at once!

21226.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21226.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21226.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

55530.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55530.description: What on earth is happening to them!? Did we push them too far? The Guild has decided to call those shining ones the Deviljho that Devours Extremes. Anyone who succeeds in slaying one will receive the materials for a full set of the Guild's treasured armor and a title! Someone, please!
55530.descriptionEn:
What on earth is happening
to them!? Did we push them too far?
The Guild has decided to call
these shining ones the
'Acme Devouring Deviljho'.
If anyone succeeds in slaying one,
we shall present the materials for
a full set of Guild-hidden armor
and a title! Someone, please!

21885.description: A request that yields 4 kinds of decorations recommended for beginning hunters. Deliver Special Mushrooms in the Jungle and you will receive 10 each of the Power Jewel, Muscle Jewel, Earplug Jewel and Vigor Jewel.
21885.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain 4
kinds of decorations recommended
for rookie hunters.
Deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫ in
the Jungle to receive ≪Power
Jewel≫, ≪Muscle Jewel≫,
≪Earplug Jewel≫ and ≪Vigor
Jewel≫, 10 of each.

60558.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
60558.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Odibatorasu! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60558.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament
where hunters test skill!
This time's target is
Odibatorasu! Going alone
after a monster - what
spirit! Best yourself and
claim a top rank!
Also, Origin weapons only!
Choose your weapon wisely!

55356.description: The Variant Species Tigrex has appeared once more. Its claws have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55356.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Tigrex≫ has
appeared once more.
Its claws have grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
even more power. Please take
great care in your survey.

50540.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? A book recording a special processing method unknown to us seems to sleep in the Deep Forest. Hunter who holds the Hypno Cutter, go there and find it.
50540.descriptionEn:
How much did the ancients
truly know? A tome
recording a special forging
method we don't know is
said to sleep in the Great
Forest. Hunter who holds
the Hypno Cutter, go there
and find it for us.

26630.description: It seems Guku are gathering in some areas. Maybe you can find what Guku like nearby. Why not go and look? If you want to come back, just deliver a map.
26630.descriptionEn:
It seems Gook have been gathering
in some areas, nyah.
Maybe you'll find the things that
Gook like somewhere nearby,
nyah.
Why not go and take a look?
If you want to come back,
just deliver a map, nyah.

63353.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63353.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the lance, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63353.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena
I have loosed a Rathian
of immense, unthinkable
strength. Lance master,
come before me and
show me your skill!
Hunt it well and you shall
gain far more than daily
effort ever brings
you.

63247.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
63247.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!

53272.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の捕獲
53272.description: I want you to capture a Cephadrome, meow! That one must know the monster that stole the bundle of invitations, meow! It has run around a lot and must be weakened, meow. I want it caught for certain, so I will give maximum support, meow.
53272.descriptionEn:
I want you to capture a
Cephadrome, nya!
That one must know the
monster that stole the
bundle of invites, nya!
It's run a long way, so
it should be weak, nya.
I want it caught for sure,
so I'll give full support!

62299.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. You are to slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62299.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between
you all, I have prepared a hard
request. Slay several monsters
together with your guildmates.
I am supplying nothing at all,
so talk it over with your
comrades before you depart.
The reward is a special ore!

62805.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
62805.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62805.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

26344.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26344.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

50564.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

21365.objectiveJp:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡの狩猟
21365.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Jungle, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Crags or the Voice of Nature: Deep Sea. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21365.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target
or sub-target A
21365.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the Jungle, you may
obtain Voice of Nature: Strange
Rock or Voice of Nature: Deep
Sea.
I pray your hunting life grows
all the richer for it.

50280.description: Violent tremors are frequently reported in the highlands. It seems a Gurenzeburu is on a rampage. The hunt is expected to be quite dangerous. Go fully prepared.
50280.descriptionEn:
Violent tremors are being
reported frequently in the
Highlands.
It seems a Gurenzeburu is on a
rampage.
The hunt is expected to be quite
dangerous. Prepare fully before
you head out.

21691.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
21691.description: Do you know of the sphere called the Sky Color Sphere? Its material is essential to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request and I shall give you rare decoration material.
21691.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Sky-Blue Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Clear this request and
I'll hand you precious
decoration material.

1048.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石１個の納品
1048.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon with claws so sharp and powerful that it's called the Sickle Crab! This season you can also mine raw Grey Crystal in the swamp. With luck, a Light Crystal might come as a reward!
1048.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon with claws so
sharp it's called the Scythe
Crab! This season you can
also mine ≪Grey Crystal Ore≫
in the swamp. Lucky hunters
may get Light Crystals!

21547.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21547.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21547.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

21253.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
21253.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21253.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

26123.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
26123.description: Velocidrome is the boss of a pack of Velociprey, with a body a size larger than theirs and a fine crest. Think of it as a big, tough Velociprey and hit it hard until it's finished!
26123.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ is the boss of
the ≪Velociprey≫ pack, and
it's a size bigger than
them, with a fine crest.
Think of it as one big,
tough ≪Velociprey≫ and
just hammer it until it
drops!

21618.description: Do you know of the sphere called the Flesh Color Sphere? Its material is essential to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request and I shall give you rare decoration material.
21618.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Flesh Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Clear this request and
I'll hand you precious
decoration material.

50850.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
50850.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, we found an amazing monster in the volcano! Its name is the Crushing Wyvern, Brachydios! What sort of amazing creature it is, you can look forward to finding out in person!
50850.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent species
about, we pushed our surveys
across the land and found an
amazing monster in the Volcano!
Its name: Brachydios, the
Crushing Wyvern!
How amazing it is, you'll have to
see for yourself in person!

61621.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
61621.description: A quest in which a rookie hunter and a hunter who has just equipped a Secret Tome hunt Cephadrome together. Only rookie hunters can obtain a Rookie's Proof on clearing the quest. The Rookie's Proof is used in the Second Part quests.
61621.descriptionEn:
A quest where a rookie
hunter and one fresh in
Secret Art gear team up to
hunt a Cephadrome.
Only the rookie hunter can
obtain the Rookie's Proof
on clearing the quest.
The Rookie's Proof is used
in the Part 2 quest.

61452.objectiveJp: フルベビアイス３個の納品
61452.description: You want a medallion? Let me see, I like folk with patience, so if you show me your patience in the Snowy Mountains I might give you one. Whether you are frozen by a Blangonga, whether the guild flag is hot, whether a Khezu Baby bites you, endure it and see it through!
61452.descriptionEn:
You want a medallion?
Well, I like folks who can
endure. Show me that in the
Snowy Mountains and I'll
hand one over.
Even if a Blangonga freezes
you, the Guild flag burns
you, or a Khezu Baby bites,
endure it and see it through!

62415.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62415.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Swamp. The Roaring Wolf Kamu Orugaron has also been confirmed near the Swamp. Hunt that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62415.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, I want you to
explore the Swamp. Near it,
the Echoing Wolf Wyvern
Kam Orugaron was sighted.
Slay that one as well!
I've readied armor for it
in advance! Now get out
there and do your best!

23532.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
23532.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gasurabazura, the Raging Visage Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23532.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Wrath
Wyvern ≪Gasurabazura≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

54571.description: We ask for your help in surveying the Gogomoa that dwells on Tide Island! Beyond the hunt itself, break its head and sever its tail and we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54571.descriptionEn:
We ask your help surveying
the Gogomoa of the Tidal
Island! Beyond hunting it,
break its head and tail and
we will add extra pay.
Please lend your strength
to our research!

55168.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
55168.description: Slaying a Gravios Subspecies raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55168.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Black Gravios
you raise your standing
and can cheaply obtain
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations. I have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.

54432.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54432.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

26252.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26252.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Lavasioth will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
26252.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
The 'fixed damage' dealt to
≪Volganos≫ will be judged by
this Guild, so simply focus on
completing the main target,
everyone!

61018.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61018.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61018.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

26517.description: There is something I need done urgently. I want you to plant the Guild Flag at the summit of the Snowy Mountains. There is no room for such heavy-looking equipment! I have prepared the supplies, so you need not bring any items.
26517.descriptionEn:
I have something urgent for you.
Plant a ≪Guild Flag≫ at the
summit of the Snowy Mountains.
There is no time to be wearing
such heavy-looking gear!
I have readied supplies, so you
need not bring any items.

22018.description: A request recommended for hunters who have come into their own, allowing the production and upgrading of the Odiba Series, Hardcore Armor. Drive off the Odibatorasu and you will obtain the materials to craft or upgrade 1 piece of the Odiba Series.
22018.descriptionEn:
For hunters who've grown
skilled, a recommended
quest: the Odiba Series,
Hardcore Armor, can be
crafted and upgraded.
Repel Odibatorasu to get
the craft and upgrade parts
for one Odiba Series
piece.

6.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
6.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

54578.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54578.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Akura Jebia, the Ash Crystal Scorpion. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54578.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the ≪Akra Jebia≫,
the Ash Crystal Scorpion.
To accept this quest, you
need a ≪Speria Ticket≫.
Please keep that in mind.
If the quest is failed,
the ≪Speria Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

60684.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
60684.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Kuarusepusu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60684.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is a Special
Individual — the ≪Kuarlusepusu≫!
Join your Guild comrades
and bring the hunt home.
This contest is won by
teamwork, so aim for the
top! This time, Supremacy
weapons only — good luck!

54564.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54564.description: We are seeking hunters to hunt the Azure Rathalos that has appeared at the Ancient Tower. Should you judge the hunt too difficult, you may slay the nearby Giaprey and return, no problem.
54564.descriptionEn:
We seek hunters to hunt the
Azure Rathalos that appeared
at the Ancient Tower.
If you judge the hunt too
difficult, you may slay the
nearby Giaprey and return
home instead — that is fine.

60687.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Midogaron. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60687.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Midogaron≫!
To hunt a monster all alone —
what spirit! Truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a well-earned top rank!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only, so be ready!

54814.objectiveJp: マーブル鉱石５０個の納品
54814.description: Ossu! Long time no see! Are you enjoying mining even at G rank? My job is ore collection! Gather the ore I name. Counting on you!
54814.descriptionEn:
Hey! Long time no see!
Are you still enjoying mining
now that you are G Rank?
My request is ore collecting!
Gather the ores I am about to
tell you about and bring them
here.
I am counting on you!

54330.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that rewards hard-to-collect monster materials. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54330.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival, we have prepared a
quest that rewards hard-to-
collect monster materials.
When accepting or joining,
please bring ≪Festival Fervor≫.

23722.description: This quest yields the following materials. Magnet Spike Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Magnet Spike Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Magnet Spike Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23722.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Intro≫ x100
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Mid≫ x165
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest you need a
≪Secret Medal Crystal≫, so please
take care.

55191.description: A Zinogre wrapped in light, standing at the top of the sea of trees. The Guild has decided to call it Zinogre that Roars to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you drive it off, you shall surely be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
55191.descriptionEn:
At the summit of the Great Forest
stands a Thunder Wolf Wyvern
wrapped in light.
The Guild has decided to call it
the ≪Acme Roaring Zinogre≫.
Brave hunter.
Once you drive it off, we will
surely grant you materials for
the Guild's treasured armor.

60940.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60940.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.

58078.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58078.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58078.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

54851.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
54851.description: There is a daily limit on accepting this, but here is a request that yields some of the materials needed to upgrade Lavasioth Subspecies G Rank gear. Don't miss this chance!
54851.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields some of
the materials needed to
upgrade Lavasioth G Rank
gear. Don't miss this chance!

54488.description: While conducting an ecological survey in the sea of trees, I heard strange voices. That must be the voice of a Hypnocatrice, but no sighting report has come from that area yet. So I want you to investigate on site.
54488.descriptionEn:
While surveying in the Great
Forest, I heard a strange
cry. It must have been a
≪Hypnocatrice≫, but no
sightings have come from
that area yet. So I ask you
to survey the site for us.

55341.description: It seems multiple Giaorugu have appeared in the extreme cold sea. There are no such reports in the past and it is unclear why this happened, but could you depart for the site and investigate that as well?
55341.descriptionEn:
Multiple Giaorugu have
appeared in the Polar Sea.
There are no past reports
of this, and why it happened
now is unknown. Would you
head out and look into it
while you're at it?

50877.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50877.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Shining Thunder Bird's Hard Species armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50877.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields more
Toridcless materials than
usual for crafting Hardcore
Armor. Please take this
chance and give it a try!

61776.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
61776.description: This is a practice quest for the preliminaries of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is five minutes or less. Except for a few cases, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards.
61776.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
preliminaries of the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament. In the
real event the time limit is
five minutes or less. Except for
a few cases, the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained by
carving or from clear rewards.

54357.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54357.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54357.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

62669.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62669.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

54161.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54161.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

26452.description: On the way to the Canyon, a Basarios is blocking the road and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26452.descriptionEn:
On the way to the Canyon,
a Basarios is blocking the
road and I'm in trouble.
If you help me out, I'll give
you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ to trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫. Thanks!

26352.description: A request for hunters who have come into their own only. Several Variant Gendrome have been confirmed in the Desert. They are vicious, so take care and hunt 2. If that proves too much, you may return after 1. Do your best!
26352.descriptionEn:
A request limited to skilled hunters.
Multiple Iodrome Variants have been
confirmed in the Desert.
They are vicious, so hunt 2 of them
with care.
If that proves too difficult,
returning after 1 is fine.
Do your best out there!

55775.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
55775.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them. Break the Akantor's fang and we will also grant you some special ingredients.
55775.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and promote them.
Break the Akantor's fang
and we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

11015.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

23542.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
23542.description: The Variant Species Tigrex has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23542.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Tigrex≫ has
become ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
As it stands this is very dangerous.
Make thorough preparations
before you survey it.

40238.objectiveJp: フレイムタイラント１体の討伐

23537.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23537.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu has appeared once more. Its tail has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23537.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Akura Vashimu≫
has appeared once more.
Its tail has grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
still more power. Please take
great care in your survey.

54140.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Grand Orb, as your reward.
54140.descriptionEn:
Inside a monster's body,
something like an orb
can sometimes be found.
It can be used as material
for all kinds of gear,
and demand is rising.
Clear this request, and
I'll give you one such orb,
a ≪Grand Orb≫, as reward.

61767.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

12010.description: The Congalala is a greedy beast, and it seems to have a special weakness for mushroom dishes. The Conga that serve it seem just as weak for mushrooms. If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, you might meet one.
12010.descriptionEn:
The Congalala is a greedy beast,
and it seems helpless before
anything mushroom-like.
Its Conga underlings are just as
mad for mushrooms.
Carry plenty of Special
Mushrooms and you may meet one?

53123.description: I thought the festival preparations would be done with this, but I let it escape again! The Congalala is stubborn too! Hunter, this time please capture a Congalala. To welcome a most auspicious New Year, bring it in with as few wounds as possible!
53123.descriptionEn:
I thought the festival
preparations were done...
but it got away again!
That Congalala is stubborn!
Hunter, this time I need you
to capture a Congalala.
To welcome a joyous New Year,
bring it back with as few
wounds as you can manage!

54310.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54310.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

22066.description: An unexplored land has been found in the Volcano. The Guild is surveying it, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22066.descriptionEn:
Uncharted land has been
found in the ≪Volcano≫.
The Guild is still surveying
it, but hunters too might
like to go and take a look
for gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

62360.description: Dreams of men swirl in the arms workshop. Among them, the thunder element great sword that applies a machine saw is so packed with dreams that it is even said to harbor the power of sleep! It was lost once at the prototype stage, but a hot dream revives any number of times!
62360.descriptionEn:
The workshop swirls with
men's dreams. The Thunder
Great Sword built on a
machine saw is so full of
dreams it even gained the
power of sleep, or so they
say! It was lost once as a
prototype, but a burning
dream can rise any time!

56136.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
56136.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62831.description: I love Gooc! We are going on an outing with the Gooc soon, but I had no ingredients for the lunch box and was at a loss. Please! Go and procure the ingredients. In return I will give you the cutest Gooc clothes!
62831.descriptionEn:
I absolutely love Gooks!
I'm going on a hike with
them soon, but I don't have
ingredients for the lunches
and I'm stuck. Please help!
Bring me some ingredients.
As thanks, I'll give you a
totally cute Gook outfit!

51085.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51085.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of a Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
51085.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

53240.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
53240.description: I wonder what he will give back this year? Last year I let my face show it so plainly that surely even he caught on? At this point anything but sweets is fine. I will not ask for tenfold return. Anything but sweets I will gladly accept.
53240.descriptionEn:
What will you give me back
this year? Last year I was
so obvious about it, surely
you've caught on by now?
At this point, anything but
sweets is fine. I won't ask
for tenfold returns. Anything
but sweets, I'll gladly take!

23653.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
23653.description: Word has come of a Teostra sighting at the Tower. It seems to unleash attacks different from those confirmed so far. Only G-rank hunters of proven skill will be asked to investigate, so G-rank hunters, please take up the survey.
23653.descriptionEn:
We have received reports of a
Teostra sighting at the Tower.
It seems to be unleashing
attacks different from those
confirmed up to now.
We will ask only G Rank hunters
of proven skill to investigate,
so G Rank hunters, please
take on this investigation.

54689.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
54689.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. Break the head and body and we will also grant you some special ingredients.
54689.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and promote
them further.
Break the head and body
and we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

23231.description: Please find and hunt the fire wyvern that is the source of the roar echoing through the highlands. The roar is heard from the unsurveyed regions of the highlands, so this must be called a very dangerous request. Take care.
23231.descriptionEn:
Please find and hunt the
Rathalos behind the roars
echoing through the Highlands.
The roars come from unsurveyed
parts of the Highlands, so this
is a very dangerous request.
Please be careful out there.

53116.description: Thanks to you the Christmas tree is done, meow! All it needs now is pretty decorations and it will be perfect, meow! I want to make it cute in red and white, meow! When this is finished I will bring you a present too, meow! Look forward to it, meow!
53116.descriptionEn:
Thanks to you, hunter, the
Christmas tree is done, meow!
Add pretty decorations and
it'll be perfect, meow!
I want it cute in red and
white! Once this is done, I'll
deliver a present to you too,
hunter! Look forward to it!

62889.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62889.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

63095.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
63095.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63095.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

60634.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60634.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60634.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.

60641.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gypceros. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60641.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Gypceros≫!
Join your Guild comrades
and achieve the objective.
This contest is won by
teamwork, so aim for the top!
This time the contest is
Origin Species weapons only,
so pick your weapon wisely!

62819.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62819.description: The VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice final quest. Clearing it will not give you the target monster's materials. Hunter Card White, Hunter Card Red or Hunter Card Blue may be obtained.
62819.descriptionEn:
The VS. Quest Champion
Tournament practice final
quest.
Clearing it will not give you
the target monster's materials.
≪Hunter Card White≫
≪Hunter Card Red≫
≪Hunter Card Blue≫
may be obtained.

23455.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Lance Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Lance Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23455.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Lance Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Lance Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Lance Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept this quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please be aware.

61181.description: A Diablos and a Hypnocatrice Variant are said to be running wild in the desert. For quick monsters? Yes, bring them down with a light Sword and Shield or a Long Sword with long reach! Other weapons are forbidden this time. Cut them down!
61181.descriptionEn:
A Diablos and a Hypnocatrice
Variant are on a rampage in
the Desert, apparently.
What beats a fast monster?
Right — a light Sword and
Shield, or a long Long Sword!
No other weapons allowed
this time, so get out there
and cut them down!

62789.objectiveJp: ハンターカード白１０枚納品
62789.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62789.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

26424.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
26424.description: The black dragon that was said to be a legend seems to have shown itself at Castle Schrade! In the tale of the Black Dragon legend it is told that the black dragon will bring calamity to the world! Repel it with all your might so that the legend does not become reality!
26424.descriptionEn:
The black dragon that was thought
a legend seems to have shown
itself at ≪Schrade Castle≫! In
the tales of the Black Dragon
legend, it is said to bring
disaster to the world! Repel it
with all your might so that the
legend does not come true!

62470.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
62470.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62470.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

55695.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Plesioth. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55695.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Plesioth≫.
To accept this quest, you
need a ≪Speria Ticket≫.
Please keep that in mind.
If the quest is failed,
the ≪Speria Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

55543.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55543.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

50263.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
50263.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! My eternal rival, the champion of jealousy and heartbreak [Eve], has finally made her move! Slay the monster filled with grudges, bitterness, envy, jealousy and spite! Now go, hunters! To protect the holy night of lovers!
50263.descriptionEn:
I am Sasatto, champion of
lovers' love and peace!
My eternal rival,
the ruler of jealousy and ruin,
[Eve], has finally made a move!
Slay the monster filled with
grudges, spite and envy!
Now go, hunters!
Protect the lovers' holy night!

61965.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Rathian. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
61965.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunting Skill Quest: Slay
≪Rathian≫. The reward is a
little lower than a normal
hunt, but why not polish
your skills with other hunters!

50438.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

50793.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
50793.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of a Silver Rathalos will also grant a special ingredient.
50793.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have
run Guild Priority Requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them we have prepared
this quest.
Sever the Silver Rathalos's
tail and we will also grant
you some special ingredients.

62736.description: If I told you Hardcore weapons could be made even stronger, would you believe me? Word is the material comes from a Doragyurosu, but this one seems unlike the usual sort, and a nasty piece of work besides. Wave it off as an old man's rambling if you like, but if you are curious, go and see.
62736.descriptionEn:
If I told you Hardcore weapons
could get stronger, believe it?
Word is the materials come
from a Dark Thunder Wyvern,
but it seems it's not the
usual one — a nasty one,
by all accounts.
Dismiss it as an old man's
ramble if you like, but if
curious, go see for yourself.

54863.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
54863.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54863.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

63003.description: I heard a rumor that rare materials can be found in the volcano, so I went to see for myself, and no, not a chance, you must be joking! What happened? There was a Rajang, and it was plainly no ordinary Rajang. What do you mean, what was wrong with it? If you are that curious, go and see for yourself!
63003.descriptionEn:
I heard a rumor that rare
materials can be mined in the
Volcano, so I went, but no way,
not a joke!
What happened, you ask? There's
a ≪Rajang≫ there, and it sure
didn't look like any plain Golden
Lion. What do you mean, what?
If you're that curious, go see!

50814.objectiveJp:
主目標１頭の討伐
及び、各指定部位の破壊
50814.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50814.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target
and break each specified part
50814.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.

62356.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival. But you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. One person only, and nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
62356.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival.
But you just have to have a
memory of the festivities!
Yes, you there! Why not take
this quest? Mind you, the terms
are strict, so I do not recommend
it to the winning side.
One person only, and if you fail
the goods are not returned, so
be careful!

63088.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
63088.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63088.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

1017.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

53186.description: This request lets you obtain the Mighty Jewel decoration, recommended for hunters who reached HR3. Slay a Gypceros and you can get the Mighty Jewel that raises attack power. Please make good use of it.
53186.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain
the Mighty Jewel decoration,
recommended for hunters who
reached HR3.
Slay a Gypceros and you can get
the Mighty Jewel that raises
attack power.
Please make good use of it.

50014.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50014.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
50014.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.

23594.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
23594.description: A giant fireball above Schrade Castle, and the investigation revealed a terrible fact. The Fatalis hailed as the black legend had mutated into something even more powerful! Unimaginable damage will occur. Please slay it swiftly.
23594.descriptionEn:
A giant fireball has appeared
above Schrade Castle, and our
investigation revealed a terrible
truth. Fatalis, hailed as the
black legend, had mutated into
a far more powerful form!
If left alone, damage beyond
imagination will surely follow.
We ask for a swift slaying.

56019.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Espinas. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56019.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Espinas.
If you break its developed
parts during this quest, we
will add the developed part
materials to your Another
rewards. Note that slaying
it alone won't give you any.

63339.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63339.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63339.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

50029.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
50029.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Hypnocatrice of the Forest. The blue Hypnocatrice of the breeding season, that is. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50029.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Hypnocatrice≫ of
the Great Forest.
But it must be the azure one
in breeding season. Clear it
in style and your standing
as a hunter will soar!

53127.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

53050.description: In this trial you are to capture 1 Congalala. But the Pitfall Trap needed for the capture must be prepared on site. What you need to combine a Pitfall Trap is a flexible herb, insect thread and a Trap Tool. The materials can be had from the supplied items and from gathering in the jungle. I wish you good hunting!
53050.descriptionEn:
For this trial, capture 1
Congalala. However, the Pitfall
Trap you need must be made
on site. To combine a Pitfall
Trap you need a very flexible
herb, insect thread, and a
Trap Tool.
The materials come from your
supplies and Jungle gathering.

21989.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one enraged Rathian, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21989.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner well,
nya? Treat your partner right
once in a while, nya!
Now, to business, nya. This
request is to hunt 1 enraged
Rathian, nya.
The reward is materials for
Felyne gear, nya!
I'm counting on you, nya!

61317.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61317.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

50696.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50696.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50696.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

55625.description: You should know, meow, that we the Dark Cat Pack are a group of capable fellows, meow! Will you take my job, meow? If you complete it, I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Seal, Red, meow.
55625.descriptionEn:
You should know this, meow —
we of the Dark Cat Gang are
a group of capable cats!
So you'll take on my request?
If you can clear it,
I might even give you a
≪Dark Cat Gang Seal · Red≫
for your trouble, meow!

55177.description: Slaying a Plesioth raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55177.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Plesioth you
raise your own standing and
also get G Rank decorations.
We have prepared a quest
that gives you the needed
materials cheaply.
Please make good use of it.

50546.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
50546.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Gold Rathian, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
50546.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner well,
nyah? Treat your partner
right once in a while, nyah!
Now, the point, nyah. This
request is to hunt 1 Gold
Rathian, nyah. The reward is
materials to craft partner
gear, nyah! I'm counting on you!

5004.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21744.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21744.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
21744.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!

60223.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
60223.description: A powerful Velocidrome has appeared. The Guild will pay a large reward to the hunter who slays it! In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware!
60223.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Velocidrome≫
has appeared.
The Guild will pay a large
sum to the hunter who slays
it. Other rewards are
modest in return, so do
take note!

1073.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

55473.description: The Variant Species Plesioth has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55473.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Plesioth has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous.
Prepare fully and survey.

63231.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63231.description: A very powerful Basarios that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63231.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Gravios≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.

54329.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
