54329.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that rewards hard-to-collect monster materials. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54329.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival, we have prepared a
quest that rewards hard-to-
collect monster materials.
When accepting or joining,
please bring ≪Festival Fervor≫.

21410.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
21410.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.

28046.description: Take a look at these beautiful feathers. The feel of the plumage is beyond compare, no? To keep this beauty, they must be worked right after the hunt. Now, I am ready! After that, I leave it to you!
28046.descriptionEn:
Look at this beautiful feather.
The softness of the plumage
is beyond compare, no?
To keep this beauty intact,
it has to be worked right
after the hunt.
Now then, I'm all set!
The rest is up to you!

54176.description: This is about when I chased Ioprey into the volcano. Suddenly I heard a great roar echoing through the volcano, so I hid at once. Then a yellow beast came down from the sky and vanished. Would you find out what that shadow was?
54176.descriptionEn:
This is from when I went to
the Volcano chasing Genprey.
Suddenly a huge roar echoed
across the whole Volcano, so
I hid behind cover at once.
Then a yellow beast came down
from the sky and vanished
right away. Would you find
out what that shadow was?

28045.description: I, in my kindness, caught some monsters for you lot and turned them loose in the Grand Arena. It would be simple if you could slay the Hypnocatrice without waking the sleeping Espinas, eh? Well, just move well in tight quarters.
28045.descriptionEn:
Kind old me caught a monster
for you lot and let it loose
in the Great Arena.
If you could down the
≪Hypnocatrice≫ without waking
the sleeping ≪Espinas≫, it'd
be easy, huh? Well then,
move well in that tight space!

55618.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55618.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

58098.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58098.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58098.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

62332.description: Thank you for gathering so many ingredients. The Wyverian lady was pleased too. I am sorry to impose after inviting you, but could you take this job? A Rajang has appeared in the volcano, and some people cannot get here. Please.
62332.descriptionEn:
Thanks for gathering all those
ingredients. The Wyverian lady
was delighted too.
I know I invited you here, so
sorry to ask, but could you
take on this request for me?
A ≪Rajang≫ has shown up in
the Volcano and someone can't
get here. Please, I'm begging!

53285.description: A spy we have on the inside obtained the recipe for the chocolate said never to melt, the so-called Unmelting Chocolate. I want you to gather the ingredients that recipe requires. Once the Unmelting Chocolate is finished, I will share some with you. Well then, I am counting on you.
53285.descriptionEn:
I got the recipe for "Insoluble
Chocolate", rumored to never melt
even on a spy's person.
I want you to gather the
materials this recipe needs.
Once the chocolate is finished,
I will share some with you.
Well then, I am counting on you.

50628.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
50628.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50628.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

26069.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
26069.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26069.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

55368.description: The Variant Species Hyujikiki appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Hyujikiki. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55368.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Hyujikiki≫ seems
to have reached the strength
of the pinnacle among
Hyujikiki. Its power is
immeasurable. Hunters
confident in their skill,
please take on this survey.

54253.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
54253.description: Until now, Daimyo Hermitaur and Rathian were often sighted in the desert around here, but lately Cephalos have been migrating in schools. Their boss, the Cephadrome, likely appeared nearby. So we ask an experienced hunter to investigate.
54253.descriptionEn:
Until now we often sighted
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ and ≪Rathian≫
in the Desert around here, but
lately Cephalos have been
schooling and roaming about.
Most likely their boss, the
≪Cephadrome≫, has appeared
nearby. So we ask a seasoned
hunter to survey the area.

26592.description: A Gook egg? I took some in with other eggs the other day, but it seems that shipment went missing in the desert. I've given up on the cargo, so if you find it, it's yours. If a Daimyo Hermitaur has it, it likely dropped it while on the move.
26592.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gook≫ egg? It came in
with the other eggs the
other day, but that cargo
seems to have gone missing
out in the desert. I've
given up on the lot, so if
you find one, it's yours.
A ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ likely
drops it when it moves.

62724.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Swamp, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Wetland, the Voice of Nature: Downpour, or the Voice of Nature: Lakeside. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62724.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. By completing this
request set in the ≪Swamp≫,
you may obtain ≪Voice of
Nature: Marsh≫, ≪Voice of
Nature: Downpour≫ or ≪Voice
of Nature: Lakeside≫. May
your hunting life be fuller.

60568.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
60568.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Garuba Daora. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60568.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Garuba Daora≫!
Join your Guild comrades
and achieve the objective.
This contest is won by
teamwork, so aim for a top
rank! Also, Origin Species
weapons only this time!
Choose your weapon carefully!

11073.description: If you're hit by a Conga's flatulence you won't be able to use healing items! If you get smelly, use a Deodorant to take the stench off your body!
11073.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Conga≫ fart
and you can't use healing
items! If you get smelly,
use a ≪Deodorant≫ to clear
the stink off yourself!

63016.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63016.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63016.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

26631.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26631.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?

62077.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の討伐
62077.description: Before we knew it, a pack of Velocidrome and Velociprey had gotten into the Great Arena. And an Ioprey seems to have slipped in too. We'll investigate the cause here, so won't you slay them?
62077.descriptionEn:
Before anyone noticed, a pack
of Velocidrome and Velociprey
got into the Great Arena.
It seems even some Genprey
have mixed in. We'll look into
the cause on our side, so
would you slay the lot of them?

62588.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62588.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62588.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

26683.description: We have reports that a mysterious monster is present in the jungle. Its species remains unidentified and much about it is still unknown, but it may be new. It is said to be extremely ferocious, so this will be a dangerous survey. We appreciate your help.
26683.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a
mysterious monster is now in
the Jungle.
Its species is still unidentified
and much remains unknown, but
it may be a new species.
It is said to be very savage,
so this is a dangerous survey,
but we ask for your help.

60667.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
60667.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Tigrex. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60667.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Tigrex≫!
To hunt a monster all alone —
what spirit! Truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a well-earned top rank!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only, so be ready!

60420.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
60420.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60420.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

50502.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
50502.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gurenzeburu. I am counting on you!
50502.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask —
how about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
It's an easy one: just make a
quick run and slay a
Gurenzeburu for me.
I'm counting on you!

54115.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54115.description: Look at this ruined land! When the Kut-Ku gets excited it tears up the ground wherever it pleases. Its pecking is so fierce that just being nearby leaves you badly hurt. We cannot live here safely like this! Do something, quickly!
54115.descriptionEn:
Look at this ruined land!
Those Yian Kut-Ku, when riled,
dig up the ground everywhere
they please.
Their pecks are so fierce that
just being nearby gets you
badly hurt. At this rate it's
too dangerous to live here!
Hurry up and do something!

26667.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26667.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Tigrex Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26667.descriptionEn:
This Hunting Skill Quest is
for slaying the
≪Tigrex Variant≫.
Why not hone your skills
against fellow hunters!

54175.description: This is a story from when I wandered deep into the sea of trees. I tripped over something like a rock. Looking closely, a monster was sleeping there. I held my breath and barely escaped, but if it had been awake I might have been badly hurt. If you are interested, you should go.
54175.descriptionEn:
This is from when I wandered
deep into the Great Forest.
I tripped over something
like a rock. Looking closer,
a monster was sleeping there.
I held my breath and somehow
got away, but if it had been
awake I might have been badly
hurt. If you're curious,
go take a look.

61264.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・四章１個の納品

63239.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
63239.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Black Gravios, then slay the Gravios Subspecies here in this arena!
63239.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
their skill! Face the Black
Gravios. Those confident they
can dance around it should
come to this arena and slay
the ≪Black Gravios≫!

54340.description: 2 monsters suddenly appeared in the snow mountains. Both are monsters the guild considers the most dangerous. We have somehow kept the damage from spreading, but the situation allows no complacency. Head there at once and slay the monsters.
54340.descriptionEn:
Suddenly, two monsters have
appeared in the Snowy Mountains.
Both are rated by the Guild as
the most dangerous around.
So far no damage has spread,
but the situation allows no
room for optimism.
Please head to the site at once
and slay the monsters.

26505.objectiveJp: 七色たんぽぽ５０個の納品
26505.description: Greetings. We meet for the first time. Do you gather between hunts? I think this is a good opportunity, so would you show me the fruits of your gathering? Of course, I will pay.
26505.descriptionEn:
Good day to you.
How do you do.
Do you do any gathering
between your hunts now and then?
I think this is a good opportunity,
so would you show me
the results of your gathering?
Of course, I will give you
a reward for your trouble.

61638.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61638.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

62590.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62590.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62590.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

62971.description: I cannot stand it anymore, meow! Is chasing us around every day fun, meow? Because of you we soak our pillows every night, meow! It is a duel, meow! Revenge, meow! Do not think we are the usual us, meow! We are scary when angry, meow!
62971.descriptionEn:
I've had it, meow!
Is chasing us around all the
time really so fun, meow?
Because of you we soak our
pillows every night, meow!
A duel, meow! Revenge, meow!
Don't think we're the same
old us, meow! When we're mad,
we're scary, meow!

50784.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
50784.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Gold Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
50784.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have
run Guild Priority Requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them we have prepared
this quest.
Break the Gold Rathian's head
and we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

23348.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
23348.description: An Azure Rathalos has appeared at the Ancient Tower. It breathes a flame never seen before and is causing damage all around. To keep the damage from spreading further, we ask for your help in hunting it.
23348.descriptionEn:
An Azure Rathalos has appeared
at the Ancient Tower. It spits
a breath never seen before and
is bringing harm to the area.
To keep the damage from
spreading further, we ask for
your help in hunting it.

50571.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50571.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

40214.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
40214.description: A monster has appeared at the interception base! I need you to hunt it at once. Let me explain the plan. This time we have prepared more supplies than usual. Use them in the hunt. The basis for this plan? A woman's intuition!
40214.descriptionEn:
A monster has appeared at the
Base! I need you to slay it
right away.
Let me explain the operation.
This time we've prepared
extra supplies.
Use them in the hunt.

My basis for this plan?
A woman's intuition!

62533.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Snowy Mountains, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Spring Water or the Voice of Nature: Mountains. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62533.descriptionEn:
I can hear it — the voice
of nature.
By completing this request
set in the ≪Snowy Mountains≫,
you may obtain ≪Voice of
Nature: Spring≫ or ≪Voice of
Nature: Mountains≫. I wish you
a richer hunting life.

21462.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Rathalos. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21462.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
≪Rathalos≫ slay.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
polish your skills against other
hunters!

62941.objectiveJp: ハンターカード白１０枚納品
62941.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62941.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

62602.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62602.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

21947.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
21947.description: You there! I hear you produced a Rukodiora weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rukodiora. I am counting on you!
21947.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a weapon
from the Extreme Dragon.
So I've got a favor to ask,
how about weapon upgrade mats?
Easy job, really—
just run out there
and slay a Rukodiora
for me. I'm counting on you!

50891.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 5 Porta Tickets Sakura. Slay a Zerureusu over and over and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade a Heavenly Storm weapon.
50891.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest
you can accept in exchange for
5 Sakura Porta Tickets.
Slay Zerureusu over and over
and you'll get the materials
needed to upgrade a
≪Tenran Weapon≫.

50727.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
50727.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Red Shadow will also grant a special ingredient.
50727.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the head and torso
of the Red Shadow, we will also
grant you special ingredients.

21655.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Titan Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21655.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secrets
of weapon and armor crafting have
apparently been found on monsters
slain all over the place!
If you get your hands on a
≪Titan Memo≫, be a man and
bring it to this workshop head!
I will show you some good work!

60201.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
60201.description: A sudden material order from a good customer, so this is a race against time. Go and hunt a Purple Gypceros right now. Sorry to ask the impossible, but in exchange, with these hands of mine I will strip 1 Dash Extract for you for certain.
60201.descriptionEn:
A sudden material order from
a good customer — a race!
Go hunt a Purple Gypceros
right now.
Sorry to push, but in return
these hands will carve you
one Dash Extract for sure!

62404.objectiveJp: ハンターダイス赤１個の納品
62404.description: Thanks for the other day! Bring me a Hunter Die Red and I will trade you something lovely for it. Count on me from now on!
62404.descriptionEn:
Thanks for the other day!
Bring me a ≪Red Hunter Die≫
and I'll trade it for
something lovely.
Stick with me from now on too!

54414.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Forokururu for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the head and the wings. They are extremely dangerous and get in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break the parts!
54414.descriptionEn:
For a survey, would you go
hunt a Forokururu for me?
Oh right, I nearly forgot
something important. Be sure
to break its head and wings.
They're extremely dangerous and
get in the way of the survey.
Hunting alone won't be accepted,
so make sure you break its
parts, got it?

60665.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
60665.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Tigrex. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60665.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Tigrex≫!
Join your Guild comrades
and achieve the objective.
This contest is won by
teamwork, so aim for the top!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only, and it's on
right now — be ready!

54220.description: We ask you to investigate the fighting beast lurking in the Canyon. Not only hunt it: if you skillfully break the fighting beast's parts, I will add to your reward!
54220.descriptionEn:
We ask you to survey the Gougarf
lurking in the Canyon.
Not only hunt it, but if you
break its parts in fine style,
we will add a bonus on top of
your reward!

62141.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62141.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62141.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

54190.description: We continue the investigation of the Anorupatisu that appeared in the extreme cold sea. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54190.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of the
Anorupatisu that appeared in
the Polar Sea.
Breaking its parts isn't
required, but we'd be glad
if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
cooperation!

22016.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
22016.description: This is a job for hunters upgrading the Colde FY series armor received from the Guide. Slaying an Akantor gets you the materials needed to upgrade one piece of the Colde FY series. Please make use of it in your hunting life.
22016.descriptionEn:
This request is for hunters
upgrading the Corude FY Series
armor received from the guide.
Slay an Akantor and you will
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade about one piece of the
Corude FY Series.
Please make good use of it in
your hunts to come.

55349.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55349.description: A white swift wyvern that races like the wind howling at the top of the sea of trees, giving off light. The Guild has decided to call it Nargacuga that Runs to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you slay it, you shall surely be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
55349.descriptionEn:
A white Nargacuga that races
like the wind howling over
the Top of Great Forest,
giving off light.
The Guild has decided to call
it "Nargacuga, the Acme Runner."
Brave hunter. When you slay
it, the Guild will surely grant
you materials from its secret
armor.

58027.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58027.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58027.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

55798.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55798.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55798.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

54439.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the crest of Gypceros, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54439.descriptionEn:
The newly launched G Rank
Guild Priority Requests — to
raise awareness and promote
them further, we have prepared
this quest.
Break the Gypceros's crest
and we will also grant you
some special ingredients.

62851.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of zenny! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62851.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to all hunters!
Along with a training method to
efficiently build up experience,
right now you can also get a huge
amount of zenny!
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
immense!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!

55970.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55970.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

55936.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55936.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the black-bodied one the Extreme Scorching Frozen Elzelion. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55936.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it comes
fluttering back again. The Guild
has decided to call that black
form "Eruzerion, the Acme that
Burns and Freezes". To hunters who
slay it, we shall present the
materials for a full set of Guild
secret armor and a title!

62973.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
62973.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62973.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

61721.description: Perhaps because the invitations went out, hunters have been gathering. Some are assembling companions and setting off on quests, others are forming hunting parties and calling for members; it is lively and a joy to see. Would you take on this request together with such companions? On success, I shall give you a black jewel.
61721.descriptionEn:
Perhaps because we sent out
invitations, hunters have been
gathering. Some set off on
quests with friends, others form
Guilds and call for members; it
is lively and a joy to see.
Why not take this request on
together with such companions?
Upon success, I will give you
a black jewel.

62368.description: Hey, look at this. A fine weapon, no? This is one of the special weapons suited to Variants, and wearing it is a condition for some jobs. Will you make one too? Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share the leftover materials.
62368.descriptionEn:
Hey, take a look at this.
Nice weapon, huh? It's a kind of
special weapon suited for fighting
Variants. What's more, I hear
equipping it is a requirement for
certain requests.
Want to make one yourself?
Clear the requests I introduce
to you, and I'll share spare parts.

63253.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
63253.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!

61506.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
61506.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61506.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

60575.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
60575.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Anorupatisu! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60575.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Anorupatisu≫!
To hunt a monster all alone —
what spirit! Truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a well-earned top rank!
Origin Species weapons only
this time — choose carefully!

62238.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62238.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62238.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.

62627.objectiveJp:
撃退できずにタイムアップ
報酬金ゼロ　拠点の耐久値ゼロ
62627.description: Lao-Shan Lung is advancing on the Fortress that serves as the gateway to the city, with a force never seen before. Use the interception equipment of the fortress and drive it off! As this is an emergency request, if you succeed in repelling it, more proofs of hunt than usual will be issued!
62627.objectiveEn:
Time up without repelling
Zero reward money, zero Base durability
62627.descriptionEn:
At the ≪Fortress≫, gateway to
the town, Lao-Shan Lung is
advancing with unheard fury.
Use the Fortress's defenses and
repel it, please!
As this is an emergency request,
a successful repel earns you
more Slay Proofs than usual!

26495.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26495.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hardclaw! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26495.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26495.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who capture many Variants
and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying Wyvern
Hardclaw!
Deliver the guarantee when you
accept or join, and hunt the
specified monster.
Note that the guarantee cannot be
returned once you depart.

21573.description: I see it! I see it plainly! Your love of mushrooms has reached its peak! You must take the next step. Bring me 6 Aster Rare Sacks and you will come one step closer to the true essence of a mushroom maniac!
21573.descriptionEn:
I see it! I do see it!
Your love of mushrooms has
reached its peak!
I truly want you to take the
next step forward.
Bring me 6 Shion Rare Pouches,
and you too will come one step
closer to the true essence
of a mushroom maniac!

54655.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54655.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

20025.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
20025.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20025.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Post!
Teostra has invaded
Mezepolta's territory!
Mezepolta now moves to
intercept it! Use the gear at
the Base to slay the Elder
Dragon completely! Please!

55263.description: There is a daily limit on accepting this, but here is a request that yields some of the materials needed to upgrade Zenaserisu's G Rank gear. It comes recommended for new G Rank hunters too. Be sure not to let this chance slip by.
55263.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields some of
the materials needed to
upgrade Zenaserisu's G Rank
gear. It comes recommended
for new G Rank hunters too.
Be sure not to let this
chance slip by.

26679.description: Tide Island in the tropics. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
26679.descriptionEn:
The tropical ≪Tidal Island≫.
It is an uncharted land the Guild
is still surveying, but hunter,
why not go and see it once
for gathering and survey
work yourself?
When you feel like coming back,
just deliver a map!

61104.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61104.description: I have learned where the Shakalaka hide their treasure. It seems you cannot reach it without specific equipment related to them. They have saved up quite a lot of money, so why not give it a try?
61104.descriptionEn:
I've found where those
Shakalaka are hiding treasure.
Seems you can't get there
unless you wear specific gear
tied to them. Word is they've
stashed quite a pile of money,
so why not give it a
try?

50402.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55103.description: Slaying a Chameleos raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55103.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Chameleos you
raise your own standing and
also get G Rank decorations.
We have prepared a quest
that gives you the needed
materials cheaply.
Please make good use of it.

62904.description: There are reports that Abiorugu has appeared in the forest. Some of the surveyors heard several roars, and testimony suggests they were calling to one another. Bear in mind that there may be more than one, and conduct the survey fully prepared.
62904.descriptionEn:
We received a report that the
Fierce Wyvern ≪Abiorugu≫ has
appeared in the Great Forest.
Some of the surveyors heard
multiple roars, and we have
testimony saying it sounded
as if they were communicating
with one another.
Bearing in mind there may be
several, we advise a full survey.

55552.description: The Variant Species Toridokuresu has appeared once more. Its developed wings not only convert gathered light into electricity more efficiently, they seem to have gained the means to discharge it as well. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55552.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Toridcless≫ has appeared
once again.
Its developed wings not only convert
gathered light into electricity more
efficiently, but also seem to possess
the means to discharge it.
Please take great care
in your survey.

53311.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の撃退
53311.description: It seems to be saying: 'I want you to fight together with me, kii. We Uruki were living in peace in the flower field, kii, when a legendary Elder Dragon came, kii. It's all a mess now, kii. Be my hands and feet and drive it away, kii.'
53311.descriptionEn:
'I want you to fight with us,
kii. We Uruki were living in
peace in the flower field,
kii, when a legendary Elder
Dragon came, kii. Everything
is a mess now, kii. Become my
arms and legs and drive it
off, kii.'
So it seems to say.

40089.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 900! Deliver the Map on your own, and after clearing the quest visit the Special Event House to receive your bonus. Please make good use of this!
40089.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 900! Deliver the ≪Map≫
on your own, and after
clearing the quest visit the
Special Event House to receive
your bonus. Please make good
use of this!

21396.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

51017.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
51017.description: The storm dragon Amatsu, by its nature of bringing floods, is dangerous even to approach, and its ecology is wrapped in mystery. To clarify its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its head or left foreleg in addition to slaying it, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
51017.descriptionEn:
The Storm Dragon Amatsu brings
flood and ruin, so even getting
close is dangerous and its
ecology is wrapped in mystery.
To shed light on it, we will
give extra rewards if you also
break its head or left foreleg
in addition to slaying it.
We await the challenge of
brave hunters.

22051.description: The Highlands are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22051.descriptionEn:
The ≪Highlands≫ are a land
still under Guild survey,
but hunters too might like
to go and take a look for
gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

50477.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
50477.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50477.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!

62977.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62977.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

51102.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
51102.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
51102.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Kushala Daora's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

26530.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26530.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26530.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

23375.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
23375.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Silver Rathalos at the Old Tower. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
23375.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have prepared a request to
hunt a Silver Rathalos at the
Ancient Tower.
Clearing it earns you higher
standing than usual.
Train efficiently and aim
for even greater heights.

55960.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55960.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

26081.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26081.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26081.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

61626.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
61626.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61626.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.

61514.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61514.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

54192.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54192.description: We ask you to survey the Shogun Ceanataur lurking in the volcano. Beyond the hunt itself, if you break its parts, we will add to your reward!
54192.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Shogun
Ceanataur in the Volcano.
Not just hunting — if you
break its parts as well, I'll
add a little extra to your
reward!

54537.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
54537.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54537.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

60242.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
60242.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toridokuresu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60242.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Toridcless≫!
To hunt a monster all alone —
what spirit! Truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a well-earned top rank!
SP weapons only this time!
Choose your weapon carefully!

50390.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21016.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21016.description: We are looking for people to hunt Gendrome! If you seem to have time to spare, please deliver Herbivore Eggs that can be gathered this season. They're an item hugely popular with merchants and gourmets!
21016.descriptionEn:
We're looking for hunters to
hunt ≪Gendrome≫!
If you seem to have time to
spare, please deliver
≪Herbivore Eggs≫ gathered
this season. Merchants and
gourmets can't get enough!

61048.description: Supply item test quest. Every supply item is stocked to the maximum you can carry. The shortfall comes after the map is delivered.
61048.descriptionEn:
Supply Item Test Quest
All supplies at max
capacity included

Shortfall after Map delivery

62810.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
62810.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62810.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

54924.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54924.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54924.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

55689.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55689.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Akura Vashimu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55689.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Akura Vashimu
materials. To accept it, a
Superior Ticket is required.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the Superior Ticket
will be consumed.

62859.description: There is aesthetics in the sub target. Put the specialty mushroom you took into a Maca Pickling Jar and aim for more rewards, or deliver it as is: follow your aesthetics. Cannot find the specialty mushroom at all? Then retire. I accept nothing but a sub clear.
62859.descriptionEn:
There is aesthetics in sub-targets alone.
Whether you put the Specialty Mushrooms
you gather into the Maca Pickling Jar
to aim for more rewards, or simply
deliver them as they are, is up to
your own aesthetics.
You cannot find the Specialty
Mushrooms at all?
Then you retire.
Nothing but a sub-clear will I accept.

50345.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50345.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

55597.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55597.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55597.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!

50874.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50874.description: Nya! Hunter there aiming to master the light bowgun! Try taking my guidance, meow! Hunt a Dyuragaua beautifully and you should get more rewards than usual, meow! Take this chance to master the Light Bowgun, meow!
50874.descriptionEn:
Meow! Hunter aiming to
master the light bowgun!
Try taking on my guidance,
meow! If you hunt the
≪Dyuragaua≫ in style,
you'll get more rewards than
usual, I think, meow!
Take this chance to master
the light bowgun, meow!

50253.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Soul (Beginning) x８５, Great Sword Soul (Middle) x１９５, Great Sword Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Great Sword Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50253.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Great Sword Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Great Sword Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Great Sword Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.

54822.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
54822.description: There is a daily limit on accepting this, but here is a request that yields some of the materials needed to upgrade Toridcless G Rank gear. Don't miss this chance!
54822.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields some of
the materials needed to
upgrade Toridcless G Rank
gear. Don't miss this chance!

62413.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
62413.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt the dancing thunder wyvern Berukyurosu in the Arena. I have prepared armor for it as well! It is a formidable monster, so do not forget to heal often, understood? Now off you go!
62413.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time you will hunt the Dancing
Thunder Wyvern in the Arena,
the ≪Berukyurosu≫. I've even
prepared armor for it!
It's a tough monster, so don't
forget to heal often, got it?
Now go and give it your all!

55592.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55592.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

21217.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21217.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21217.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

62202.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Chameleos. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62202.descriptionEn:
An emergency request. We seek
someone to dispose of an
extremely powerful ≪Chameleos≫.
If you slay it in style, we
will issue more Slay Proofs
than usual!

54986.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54986.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, show me the skill
you have honed against the
Baruragaru in the New Great
Arena! If you hunt it well,
you shall earn even more
reward than your daily efforts
would bring.

61567.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61567.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

26068.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
26068.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26068.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

1063.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

62814.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

23726.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Long Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Long Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23726.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Long Sword Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Long Sword Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you need
a ≪Secret Art Merit Crystal≫
and GR 500 or higher, so
please keep that in mind.

63192.description: An extremely powerful individual Gogomoa has appeared. Also, insect activity in Shiojima increases in the evening. The hunt will surely be harsh. Be careful.
63192.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Gogomoa
individual has appeared.
In addition, we have reports that
insects grow very active on the
Tidal Island in the evening.
There is no doubt this will be
a harsh hunt.
Please be careful out there.

61851.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
61851.description: The highlands, an untrodden land. In this newly discovered place, a new flying wyvern seems to have been discovered at last. From its powerful form it was named Gurenzeburu. This time the request is to hunt it. Why not experience a hunt in a new world?
61851.descriptionEn:
An untrodden land, the Highlands.
In this newly discovered place,
a new Flying Wyvern has finally
been found, it seems. For its
powerful form the wyvern was
named ≪Taikun Zamuza≫.
This time the request is to hunt
it. Why not try a hunt in a new land?

63134.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐

54857.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
54857.description: An unfamiliar monster has been discovered in the extreme cold sea. The Guild has designated the target as the Frozen King Wyvern, Toa Tesukatora, and classified it as a First Species. A blizzard constantly surrounds Toa Tesukatora, and capture is thought impossible. Please slay it carefully and surely.
54857.descriptionEn:
An unfamiliar monster has been
discovered in the Polar Sea.
The Guild has named it the
Frozen King Dragon,
≪Toa Tesukatora≫, and classed
it as an ≪Origin Species≫.
A blizzard always rages around
it, so capture is thought
impossible. Please slay it
carefully and for certain.

56034.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Blast Wolf. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56034.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay a
Supremacy Midogaron.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will specially
add developed part materials to
your Another Reward.
Please note that slaying it alone
will not earn you those materials.

23266.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau reports that a Thunder Zenith Dragon will soon appear at the interception base. The battle will be fought in the dark of night, so prepare thoroughly and use the interception facilities to slay it.
23266.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast
Bureau reports that the Thunder
Extreme Dragon will soon appear
at the Base. The fight will be
in the dark of night, so
prepare fully and use the
defense facilities to slay it.

54184.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54184.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.

60079.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

50130.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50130.description: A report has arrived that Kushala Daora has appeared in the Snowy Mountains. We have sent hunters there several times so far, but without result. For that reason, we have set several conditions on this request. It is a difficult request, but we have prepared a reward to match. I ask your help.
50130.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
a Kushala Daora appeared in
the Snowy Mountains.
We have sent hunters several
times so far, but with no
results.
So this request comes with a
few conditions. It is a hard
one, but the reward matches it.
We appreciate your help.

62394.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62394.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a long-range weapon. Take the armor and Bow prepared for you and hunt the devouring wyvern Pariapuria in the New Grand Arena! Dodge the monster's attacks, put some distance between you, and then shoot!
62394.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time you'll hunt with ranged
weapons.
Take the armor and Bow prepared
for you and hunt the Gluttonous
Wyvern ≪Pariapuria≫ in the New
Great Arena! Dodge its attacks,
keep your distance, then fire!

21755.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21755.description: I want it! I want it! I want it no matter what! The cute furniture of the Kut-Ku! Kind hunter! Hunt lots for me! I will give you plenty of the materials for Blast Powder I filched from the house storehouse! Please!
21755.descriptionEn:
I want it! I want it!
I just have to have it!
The cute Yian Kut-Ku furniture!
Kind hunter! Go hunt lots and
lots of them for me!
I will give you loads of
≪Gunpowder≫ ingredients I
swiped from our storehouse!
Please!

21894.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
21894.description: This quest is for the HR 700 breakthrough trial. After you accept the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, please depart on the quest on your own.
21894.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the HR 700
breakthrough trial. After you
accept the trial from the Guild
Master or the HR Trial board,
please depart on the quest
on your own.

62125.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

55729.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２０匹の討伐

63124.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63124.description: A very powerful Basarios that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63124.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Gravios≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.

55044.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
55044.description: Gathering is fine work. You can get Setuna Visin and Tawara Cactus there. Lovely names, every one, no? Today I meant to gather at the usual spot, but a monster got in the way. Do something about it. I'll have rare gathering materials ready as thanks.
55044.descriptionEn:
Gathering is the best.
You can get ≪Setsuna Bijin≫
and ≪Tawara Cactus≫ there.
Great names, aren't they? Today
I meant to gather at my usual
spot, but a monster got in
the way. Do something about
that thing for me. I'll have
rare gathering mats for you.

60095.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. Thanks to an adaptability that shrugs off harsh environments, elemental attacks seem to be of almost no use against it, so be careful.
60095.descriptionEn:
The ≪Kirin≫ is classed as an
Elder Dragon, and because it
wields lightning at will it is
called the ≪Phantom Beast≫.
Its adaptability shrugs off
harsh environments, and elements
barely work on it — be careful.

50597.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50597.description: A vicious Basarios and a Purple Gypceros have appeared. I want the stones they are said to carry, to display in my home! What say you? Will you hunt them for me?
50597.descriptionEn:
A ferocious Black Gravios and a
Purple Gypceros have shown up.
I want to get the stone they
say those two carry
and display it in my house!
How about it? Would you go
hunt them for me?

51086.description: You can obtain the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Transcendent armor Jin'O series. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
51086.descriptionEn:
Migrant Armor 'Zinogre Series'
— materials for crafting or
upgrading one piece are here.
It's a bargain quest, so
please give it a try!

55310.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
55310.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gasurabazura, the Raging Visage Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55310.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Wrath
Wyvern ≪Gasurabazura≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

26723.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
26723.description: What, you just want a hard Bow? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26723.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really
tough bow? Then I'll refine
some Argen Steel for you!
But the ore is hard to find,
and nasty monsters prowl
around. Go find it with spirit!

50838.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Floating Peak Wyvern's Hard Species armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50838.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields more
Yamakurai materials than usual
for crafting Hardcore Armor.
Please take this chance and
give it a try!

61255.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61255.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!

54562.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54562.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54562.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

23404.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
23404.description: Sightings are coming in from the Snowy Mountains of a Doragyurosu more powerful than any so far. The Hunters Guild has decided to ask you hunters to investigate. Hunters who can cooperate, head for the Snowy Mountains at once.
23404.descriptionEn:
Reports are coming in of a
Doragyurosu in the Snowy
Mountains, far stronger than any
seen before.
The Hunters Guild has decided to
ask all of you to carry out a
survey.
Hunters able to help, please
head for the Snowy Mountains at
once.

51011.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
51011.description: Hunter's Festa, is it! Right! Let me recall those days and recreate it with layered armor. Hunt the Toridcless making trouble in the Deep Bamboo Forest and I might just share the materials. If it doesn't drop, try as many times as it takes!
51011.descriptionEn:
The ≪Hunters Festa≫, eh!
Alright! Let's recall those
days and recreate it with
some layered armor.
Hunt the ≪Toridcless≫ causing
trouble in the ≪Deep Bamboo
Forest≫ and I might just
share the materials.
If you don't get them, try
as many times as it takes!

50420.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

53136.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53136.description: A hunter thinking of changing from the Hope series armor to another set. How about the Quoiz series, available from this request? It has a stylish look like the Kukubo series, so I think you will like it.
53136.descriptionEn:
To hunters thinking of trading
their Hope Series armor for
something else.
How about the Quoiz Series
armor you can obtain from
this request?
It looks as stylish as the
Kukubo Series, so I am sure
you will like it.

62165.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62165.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Desert. The tail crystal scorpion Akura Vashimu has also been confirmed in the very middle of the Desert. Slay that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62165.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor! This
time you will explore the Desert
for me. In the very middle of
the Desert, the Tail Crystal
Scorpion ≪Akura Vashimu≫ has
been confirmed as well.
Slay that one too while you are
at it! I even prepared armor for
that purpose! Now go and do it!

61445.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン赤３個の納品
61445.description: 1st Place server, congratulations. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Red) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61445.descriptionEn:
[1st Place] Server,
congratulations.
We have prepared an exclusive
reward for hunters who cleared
the Guild Idaten Cup.
The more Red Hunter Coins you
deliver, the better your
chance at rare materials.

26541.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26541.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!

53180.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53180.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
53180.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's hunting life,
we have prepared a request to hunt
≪Bulldrome≫ in the New Great Arena.
If you complete this request you
will earn more reward money than
usual, so please take it on and
complete it.

61570.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61570.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

23176.description: The Firestone I use for work is gone! Without that I cannot do business. Would you get me some? And while you are at it, it would help if you could slay the Bullfango too. If they were gone I could go and fetch it myself!
23176.descriptionEn:
The Gunpowder Rocks I use
for work have run out!
Without them I can't work.
Would you go get me some?
While you're at it — sorry to
ask — I'd be glad if you'd
also slay some Bullfango.
If those brutes were gone,
I could go get them myself!

51061.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, a Thousand Blade Wyvern, Seregios, was newly found in the desert. According to the surveyor who encountered it, it performs behavior never observed before. Take the greatest care with the monster's movements!
51061.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent Species
about, we pushed surveys across
the land, and in the Desert the
Thousand Blade Wyvern
≪Seregios≫ has been newly found.
Reports from the surveyor who
met it say it performs behavior
never observed before. Take the
greatest care around it!

62625.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained from carving or from the clear reward.
62625.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained from carving
or from the clear reward.

62732.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62732.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

63406.description: Nyahaha! An executive of the Dark Cat Pack slaps a quest right at you, meow! The pride of those mocked as the weakest is terrifying, meow. If you complete it, in praise of your courage I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Badge, meow!
63406.descriptionEn:
Nyahaha! A request straight
from a Dark Cat Gang executive!
The pride of those mocked as
the weakest is a terrifying
thing, meow. If you manage to
clear this request, I might
praise your courage with a
≪Dark Cat Gang Badge≫, meow!

54470.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
54470.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Purple Gypceros for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the crest. It is extremely dangerous and gets in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break the parts!
54470.descriptionEn:
For a survey, would you go
hunt a ≪Purple Gypceros≫?
Oh right, I nearly forgot
something important. Be sure
to break its crest.
It's extremely dangerous and
gets in the way of the survey.
Hunting alone won't be accepted,
so make sure you break the
parts, got it?

23554.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
23554.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23554.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

23685.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23685.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!

50239.description: My first request, so I am nervous. There is a musician I simply must tell music lovers about. They are so cool, truly. But I am too shy, so I would be glad if you would film them for me instead. I will cheer from the shadows! Once you meet them, spread the word to everyone!
50239.descriptionEn:
This is my first request, so I'm
nervous. There's a musician I
really want music lovers to hear.
He's cool, seriously.
But I'm too shy, so I'd be glad
if you could take photos instead.
I'll be cheering from the shadows!
If you meet him, tell everyone!

51005.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51005.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
51005.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.

26661.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26661.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Hypnocatrice Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26661.descriptionEn:
This Hunting Skill Quest is
for slaying the
≪Hypnocatrice Variant≫.
Why not hone your skills
against fellow hunters!

28036.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
28036.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering materials from the Dancing Thunder Wyvern, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28036.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters,
why not pass your hunting
technique on to the young
hunters of your Guild? This
time we're splashing out on
≪Berukyurosu≫ materials! Get
strong together and liven up
your Guild. Clearing it with a
Secret Art book holder and a
non-holder earns more standing.

12070.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23559.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
23559.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23559.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

26375.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ１個の納品

61001.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の討伐

50041.description: Reports have reached us of an unidentified monster on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
50041.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
an unidentified monster is
rampaging in the Ancient Tower.
As every moment counts, this is
a short-time slaying request,
but to keep the damage to a
minimum, we will accept a mere
repel as well.
We seek hunters with a Secret
Art Tome to face this crisis!

54496.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor.
