Reports have come in that a
Kushala Daora is flying toward
Mezeporuta right now.
Hunters confident in their skill
should intercept it at the Base,
and use the plentiful supplies
and the interception weapons to slay it.

26321.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26321.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?

53197.objectiveJp: ポルタチョコ１個の納品

23310.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
23310.description: The survey team that set out for the flower field reports hearing cries that appear to belong to a Forokururu. Sightings are still few, which makes it a precious subject of study. Head for the site at once and begin the investigation.
23310.descriptionEn:
We have a report from the survey team
that set out for the Flower Field: they
heard what sounded like the cry of
Forokururu.
Sightings are still few, which makes it
a precious subject for study.
Please head to the site at once and
begin your survey.

21419.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・１を１０個納品

23616.description: The Variant Species Midogaron has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23616.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps rampaging.
Left as it is, this is very dangerous.
Please prepare thoroughly and
carry out the survey.

50307.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の捕獲
50307.description: The season of sweet festivals has come again this year. Those of you who want to convey faint feelings, are you ready? You there, too busy to prepare yet! How about clearing this request, obtaining a Porta Chocolate, and telling the man on your mind how you feel!?
50307.descriptionEn:
The season of the sweet
festival is here again. Are
you ready to convey your
tender feelings?
Too busy to prepare yet?
Then you! Complete this
request, get Porta Chocolate,
and tell the man you fancy
how you feel!?

55256.description: That gliding as if sliding through the air, the blizzard from its mouth... No doubt about it! It's him! A Barioth has appeared in the polar sea! I want it hunted before the damage grows! Don't neglect your cold protection!
55256.descriptionEn:
That gliding as if it slid through
the air, the blizzard from its
mouth... No doubt! It's him!
An Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth,
has shown up in the Polar Sea!
Hunt it before the damage grows!
Don't neglect your ice protection!

55590.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55590.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55590.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

50827.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50827.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50827.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

26095.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26095.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

53188.description: To all hunters who lose sight of monsters: have you ever missed with a paintball and lost track of one? For you we have prepared a decoration.
53188.descriptionEn:
To all hunters who keep losing
track of monsters

Have you ever thrown a Paintball
and missed, losing the monster
entirely?
For you, we have prepared
a decoration.

63188.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
63188.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63188.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

50709.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
50709.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the back of a Brown Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
50709.descriptionEn:
To further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild
Priority requests we have
long conducted, we have
prepared this quest for you.
Break the back of the Espinas
Subspecies, and we shall grant
a special ingredient as well.

21256.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21256.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

55981.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
55981.description: An Anomalous Species Taikun Zamuza with greatly developed claws has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to the Anomalous Species, have defeated many hunters. In response the guild will provide strong support for the hunt. Head out with care.
55981.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Taikun Zamuza
with greatly developed claws
has appeared. Many hunters
have failed to slay it due to
its Supremacy attacks.
The Guild will provide strong
slaying support in response.
Please proceed to survey it,
and take care.

62435.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
62435.description: What, you just want a hard Bow? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62435.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Bow, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!

56094.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56094.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

55273.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55273.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

63202.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての狩猟

23304.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
23304.description: While I was surveying the Yaozami ecology in the Jungle, a Bulldrome suddenly attacked. At this rate the survey cannot proceed! Would you hunt the Bulldrome for me?
23304.descriptionEn:
While we were surveying Yao Zami
ecology in the Jungle, a Bulldrome
suddenly attacked us.
At this rate the survey cannot go
on!
Could you please hunt that
Bulldrome for us?

21826.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の狩猟
21826.description: A report has come in that hunters who headed for the Snowy Mountains were beaten back by 2 Tigrex! Brave hunters confident in their skill, set out to rescue the injured and hunt the Tigrex!
21826.descriptionEn:
We have a report that hunters who
headed to the Snowy Mountains were
beaten back by 2 ≪Tigrex≫!
Brave hunters confident in their
skill, set out to rescue the wounded
and hunt the Tigrex!

50787.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
50787.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a White Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
50787.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority requests we
have long offered, we have
prepared this quest for you.
Break the Espinas's horn and
we will also grant you a
special food ingredient as
a bonus.

61825.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Black Gravios of the volcano. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
61825.descriptionEn:
The time to show your skill
has come!
Hunt the Black Gravios of
the Volcano. Clear the quest
safely and your standing as
a hunter will shoot right
up!

26684.description: The savage wyvern confirmed in the Jungle has been found to be a beast wyvern species that never lived around Mezeporuta before. The Hunters Guild seems to have named it Abiorugu. Please investigate further.
26684.descriptionEn:
The ≪Tyrant Wyvern≫ confirmed
in the Jungle has been found to
be a Beast Wyvern species that
had never lived around
Mezepolta until now.
The Hunters Guild appears to
have named it ≪Abiorugu≫.
We ask for further surveys
of the area.

55132.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55132.description: Information has come in that Rukodiora was encountered during the survey of White Lake. It appears far more ferocious than previous individuals and to display movements not found in our research records. We ask for further investigation before danger reaches those nearby.
55132.descriptionEn:
Information has come in that a
Rukodiora was encountered during
the survey of White Lake.
This one seems far more vicious
than past individuals, and even
showed movements not found in
our records. Before the danger
spreads, we ask for a further
survey.

60683.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Hyujikiki. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60683.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is
Hyujikiki!
Taking on a monster all
alone, what splendid spirit!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Supremacy weapons only!

50195.description: That bungling Jack has failed to kidnap me, the noble Count Kabochaka Botchan! His whereabouts are known! Go and thrash Jack at once! And hunt some monsters while you are at it! Because I am scared!
50195.descriptionEn:
I, the noble Count
Kabochaka Botchan, know
where that clumsy Jack who
failed to kidnap me is!
Found his hideout!
Go and rough Jack up,
and quickly!
Slay some monsters too, and
hurry! I'm scared!

28007.description: The other day I suddenly got sleepy, thought something was odd, and looked around: it was Hypnocatrice's doing. Honestly, it got me. And a Remobra was there too, so with sleep and poison I was afraid I wouldn't get out alive. If you go there, be careful.
28007.descriptionEn:
The other day I suddenly got
sleepy, looked around and
found it was Hypnocatrice's
doing. It really got me.
And Remobra were there too,
so with sleep and poison I
feared I wouldn't get back.
If you head there, you'd
better be careful.

53078.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53078.description: Oh! Welcome, nya! Welcome to MHF-G, nya! Sorry to be so sudden, but a Bulldrome seems to have appeared in the jungle, nya! Treat it as practice, and I'd like a beginner hunter to hunt it, nya! I wish you well, nya!
53078.descriptionEn:
Oh! Good to see you, meow!
Welcome to MHF-G, meow!
Sorry to rush you, meow, but a
Bulldrome seems to have shown up
in the Jungle, meow!
Think of it as practice and hunt
it for the rookie hunters, meow!
Best of luck, meow!

22124.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
22124.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. The reward is rare decoration materials.
22124.descriptionEn:
The ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫, which
had only been sighted now and then,
has expanded its territory to the
areas where people travel. To
prevent further damage, please
hunt the target.
The reward is a rare decoration
material.

54304.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
54304.description: I ask for your help with a monster survey. This time the subject is the Gold Rathian. As it is an extremely valuable subject, I want to carry out as many surveys as possible. Be sure to break the wing claws and sever the tail before you hunt it. I am counting on you.
54304.descriptionEn:
I request your help with a
monster survey. This time it
is the Pink Rathian.
She is an extremely valuable
subject, so I want as much
data as possible.
Be sure to break the wing
claws and sever the tail
before you slay her. Thanks.

21613.description: Have you heard of the Whetstone Powder Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21613.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the spheres
called Tonoko Spheres?
Their materials are vital
to crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you complete this
request, I'll give you
precious decoration parts.

50934.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
50934.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, a Nargacuga was newly observed in the jungle. According to the surveyor who encountered it, it performs behavior never observed before. Take the greatest care with the monster's movements!
50934.descriptionEn:
As the Transcendence Species
appeared, surveys across the land
newly observed the Swift Wyvern
Nargacuga in the Jungle.
According to the researchers who
encountered it, it displays
behavior never observed before.
Please be extremely careful of
the monster's actions!

60530.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
60530.description: If I can just get the blue Hypnocatrice fur that is so hard to obtain, I can make a dress second to none! The party is soon! Get it for me right now!
60530.descriptionEn:
If only I could get the blue
feathers of a Hypnocatrice, so
rarely obtained, I could make a
dress that loses to none!
There is no time left before the
party!
Get them for me this instant!

62156.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
62156.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62156.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

60650.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Pokaradon. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Transcendent weapons only!
60650.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is
Pokaradon!
Taking on a monster all
alone, what splendid spirit!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Transcendent weapons only!

60681.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Gougarf. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60681.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is a
Special Individual
Gougarf!
Taking on a monster all
alone, what splendid spirit!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Supremacy weapons only!

54778.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54778.description: We continue the investigation of the Diablos Subspecies. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54778.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Black Diablos.
Breaking parts isn't
required, but I'd be glad
if you did!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid once again!

22058.description: The depths of the Volcano are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22058.descriptionEn:
The depths of the ≪Volcano≫
are still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!

12049.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

55326.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a tail break in slaying Hypnocatrice, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55326.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Hypnocatrice≫ and break
its tail, we will grant an
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

21194.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21194.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21194.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

55289.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for one material, and break the specified part for one more!
55289.descriptionEn:
A chance to get a Supremacy
weapon prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal fixed damage to the target
for 1 material, and break the
specified part for one more
as a gift!

21073.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21073.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
21073.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!

50728.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the crest of a Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
50728.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the Gypceros's
crest, special ingredients will
also be granted to you.

61844.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. A hunter does more than slay monsters. Fishing is a fine hunt in its own right. Why not aim for the path of the angler, and even of the artisan? If you do, deliver 50 Spring Night Carp on your own!
61844.descriptionEn:
"Fishing"
It is a solitary hunt, in which
you quietly face the fish.
A hunter does not only slay
monsters. Fishing is a fine
hunt in its own right.
Why not aim for the path of the
angler, and even a master?
If you do, deliver 50 Springnight
Carp all on your own!

58045.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58045.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58045.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

62035.description: Hey, got a moment? The other day I was gathering in the swamp when a Gypceros stole my valuables. It was strangely strong, so I had no choice but to run. Sorry, would you get them back for me? As a special case I will give you a prize from one of the Gallery tournaments!
62035.descriptionEn:
Hey, got a moment?
While I was gathering in the
Swamp, a Gypceros stole
something valuable of mine.
It was oddly strong, so I
had no choice but to flee.
Sorry, but could you go and
get it back? I'll give you a
Gallery Tournament prize!

61443.description: I want to ask you to capture a Rathian, but the Melynx are taking the chance to get in the way! We can only supply limited goods, but please work with the other hunters and somehow complete the request!
61443.descriptionEn:
I want to ask for a Rathian
capture, but the Melynx keep
getting in the way at every
chance!
I can only supply limited
goods, but I hope you'll work
with other hunters and
somehow complete the request!

55904.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55904.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55904.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

26139.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26139.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!

53226.description: To take this request you need one Hunter Pass (Purple), myan. This time you can obtain a special 10th Anniversary reward, myan. From those materials you can craft the dual blades 'Soul Sword of the Red and Blue Dragons', myan. You should tell your hunting party members, myan.
53226.descriptionEn:
To take this request, you
need 1 Hunter Pass: Purple,
nyan.
This time a special 10th
Anniversary reward awaits,
nyan. From its materials
you can forge the dual
blades named "Crimson and
Azure Dragon Soul Blade,"
nyan. Tell your Guild mates!

61766.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61766.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

62854.description: Man, that was a scare! I ran into an Espinas in the Sea of Trees. And on top of that, it's different from the usual sort. I'll make it worth your while, so go hunt it! Oh, that reminds me, it knocked a new item out of me with its tail. If you don't mind, bring that back too. Please!
62854.descriptionEn:
Man, what a day!
I ran into an Espinas in the
Great Forest. And it looked
different from a normal one.
I'll pay you, so hunt it!
Oh, right, its tail knocked
a new item out of me.
If you like, bring that back
too. Thanks!

50355.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50355.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Basarios will also grant a special ingredient.
50355.descriptionEn:
We have long been running the
Guild Priority Requests, and to
spread awareness and promote
them we have prepared this
quest for you.
By breaking the Basarios'
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

23651.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
23651.description: From an investigator who headed to the top of the sea of trees, there was a sighting of a rare Pale Blue Hypnocatrice. It is also reported that it launches attacks gracefully as if dancing. Please prepare fully and investigate.
23651.descriptionEn:
A surveyor who went to the top
of the Great Forest reported a
rare ≪Hypnocatrice Rare≫
sighting. It is also said to
attack with the grace of a
dancing bird. Please prepare
thoroughly before you head
out on the survey.

21787.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61312.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
61312.description: In the Snowy Mountains, many monsters are breeding in great numbers! We are requesting hunting cooperation from hunters everywhere, but the reality is that there are too many. So we want to recruit those who can set out on this hunt with up to 2 people. I especially recommend it to those aiming for a quick rank up.
61312.descriptionEn:
Monsters are breeding out of
control in the Snowy Mountains!
We are asking hunters from all
over to help hunt them, but the
plain truth is there are too many.
So we want volunteers who can
set out in parties of up to two.
I especially recommend it to
those after a quick rank-up.

21940.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１７. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Abiorugu. I am counting on you!
21940.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR17.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as your reward?
It is a simple job, really. Just
make one quick trip and slay
an Abiorugu for me.
I am counting on you!

62656.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

23363.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru G Rank Haku armor. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma GF Series Retsu Armor up to LV7.
23363.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪G-Rank Supremacy≫ armor
of the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
the materials needed to
upgrade the ≪Fierce≫ armor
"Stroma GF Series" up to
Lv7.

53092.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53092.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 1 Porta Ticket Sakura. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
53092.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest
you can take in exchange for
1 Porta Ticket: Sakura.
Clear this request and you
earn more evaluation than
usual. Train efficiently and
aim for even greater heights.

62908.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
62908.description: This is a request limited to those who hold a Secret Scroll. It cannot be taken repeatedly, but you can reliably obtain 4 kinds of SR Ingredients. It is recommended for those who want to try the effect once, or who want to steadily collect them in preparation for a crucial hunt.
62908.descriptionEn:
This request is limited to
holders of a Secret Art Tome.
You cannot take it repeatedly
in a row, but it reliably
yields 4 kinds of SR
Ingredients. Recommended for
those who want to try their
effect once, or to steadily
stock up for a big hunt.

63054.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
63054.description: A quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament trial event. Enjoy Forward.5 a little ahead of everyone else!
63054.descriptionEn:
A quest for the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament trial
event.
Enjoy Forward.5 a little
ahead of everyone else!

60050.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

63304.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around an Espinas, then slay the Espinas here in this arena!
63304.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill! If you're sure
you can handle an Espinas,
then step into this Arena
and slay it to prove
your worth!

50764.description: A request recommended for hunters who reached HR100, letting you forge and upgrade the Hardcore Armor "Stroma Series." Hunt a Baruragaru to obtain forge and upgrade materials for one "Stroma Series" piece.
50764.descriptionEn:
A request recommended for
hunters who reached HR100,
letting you forge and upgrade
the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
"Stroma Series."
Hunt a Baruragaru to obtain
forge and upgrade materials
for one "Stroma Series"
piece.

26073.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26073.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

61714.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
61714.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Divine Consort] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
61714.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Divine Consort]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).

50265.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50265.description: This is an urgent call! Rukodiora has appeared at the base and is raging. Hunters, head out to slay it at once. You may use the base's facilities and supplies freely. Good luck!
50265.descriptionEn:
Emergency request!
Rukodiora has appeared at
the Base and is on a rampage.
All hunters, head out to
slay it immediately.
You may freely use the
Base's facilities and
supplies.
Good luck out there!

62712.description: Ah, so busy, so busy! Every year at this time, how busy it gets! Hey, you there. If you have time to watch, won't you lend a hand? I'll treat you to Peach materials as thanks!
62712.descriptionEn:
Oh, so busy, so busy!
Every year at this time,
it's just so hectic!
Hey, you over there.
If you have time to stare,
how about helping me out?
I'll splurge on Peach
materials as thanks!

11097.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
11097.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
11097.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!

55748.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
55748.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55748.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

62057.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62057.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62057.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!

55784.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
55784.description: To further raise awareness of G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest for you. Break the Pale Hypnocatrice's beak and we will grant you a special food ingredient too.
55784.descriptionEn:
To further raise awareness of
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest for you.
Break the Pale Hypnocatrice's
beak and we will grant you a
special food ingredient too.

61160.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61160.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!

23585.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
23585.description: The sky-soaring dragon has been confirmed near the course of the large survey ship. Even with interception equipment, we cannot survey if it attacks again and again. Board the survey ship and slay the sky-soaring dragon.
23585.descriptionEn:
Near the route of the large survey
ship, the Sky-Soaring Dragon was
sighted. Even with interception
equipment, we cannot carry out
our survey if it keeps attacking.
Please board the large survey ship
and slay the Sky-Soaring Dragon.

51129.objectiveJp: ババコンガ変種１頭の討伐

26680.objectiveJp: ハーフチケット白１枚の納品
26680.description: A quest reserved for hunters who have earned excellent results in official hunting tournaments! You can get your hands on handy items such as Dauntless Seeds and Disposable Earplugs. Once you have made your mark in an official tournament and obtained a Half Ticket White, come and see me!
26680.descriptionEn:
A quest only for hunters who
took excellent results in the
official hunting tournament!
You can obtain handy items such
as "Fearless Seed" and
"Disposable Super Earplugs".
If you took part in the official
tournament and got a "Half Ticket
White", come by all means!

26130.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
26130.description: Now, into live combat! Go into the swamp, find an Iodrome, and hunt it! At night the swamp has places where poison rises from the ground, so this time we will train in daylight. Good luck!
26130.descriptionEn:
Now then, real combat!
Let's find and hunt a
Gendrome in the Swamp!
At night some spots in the
Swamp give off poison from
the ground, so this time
we'll fight in daylight.
Do your best out there!

54715.description: Gasurabazura has appeared at White Lake. Reports describe it as a highly dangerous monster with a talent for poison attacks. We ask for your help with the survey. The Carapaceon found at White Lake as well appears to launch poison attacks of its own. Take great care!
54715.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gasurabazura≫ has
appeared at White Lake.
Reports say it is a very
dangerous monster skilled
in poison attacks. Please
help us survey it. The
Carapaceon at White Lake
also uses poison, it seems.
Take great care!

54749.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54749.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

55943.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55943.description: This time we have prepared a little trial to confirm the bond of the bride and groom! Its name is the Azure Trial! You are to slay a Doragyurosu at the top of the Sea of Trees! Of course, help from your friends is fine! Now go and enjoy it!
55943.descriptionEn:
To test the bond of the
bride and groom, we have
prepared a little trial!
Its name: the "Azure Trial"!
You'll slay a Doragyurosu
at the Top of the Great
Forest! Of course, help from
friends is fine too!
Now go and enjoy yourselves!

54817.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン１Ｇ２０個の納品
54817.description: To all hunters who cleared the requests from three Guild members and obtained several of each of the three coins, we praise your effort and talent, and grant a special coin needed to craft certain gear. The requests are all hard, but the satisfaction is unmatched!
54817.descriptionEn:
To all hunters who cleared
the requests from three Guild
members and obtained several
of each of the three coins,
we praise your effort and
talent, and grant a special
coin needed to craft certain gear.
The requests are all hard, but
the satisfaction is unmatched!

55988.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55988.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

11093.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
11093.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
11093.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!

63366.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
63366.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! The Hypnocatrice and the Yian Kut-Ku, representatives of the bird wyverns. Their strength alone may not match the flying wyverns, but facing 2 at once is another matter! Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
63366.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show off
their skill! The ≪Hypnocatrice≫
and ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫, pride of the
Bird Wyverns.
Their individual strength may not
match the Flying Wyverns, but two
at once is another story! Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose his
life to a moment's carelessness!

50115.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の撃退
50115.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50115.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.

63073.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
63073.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63073.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

21166.description: There was a report that 2 Crystal Wyverns, Kuarusepusu, appeared in the desert. Some investigators testify that the ground suddenly began to shake greatly, and though the details are unclear, the situation seems quite dangerous. Please investigate with every precaution.
21166.descriptionEn:
We have reports that 2 Crystal
Wyverns, ≪Kuarlusepusu≫, have
appeared in the Desert. Some of
our surveyors even testify that
the ground suddenly shook hard,
and though details are unclear,
the situation seems quite
dangerous. Please survey with
every precaution taken.

50760.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Storm Crystal Dragon will also grant a special ingredient.
50760.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority requests we
have long offered, we have
prepared this quest for you.
Break the Kuarlusepusu's head
and we will grant you a
special food ingredient as
a bonus.

56150.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56150.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.

21508.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21508.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

54577.objectiveJp: ディスフィロア１体の討伐

54305.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
54305.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54305.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

61070.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
61070.description: Locking the Blangonga in the arena was fine, but it is rampaging so wildly I cannot handle it! Hey, you. Can you do something about it? I am counting on you!
61070.descriptionEn:
Locking the Blangonga in the
Arena was fine and all,
but now it's rampaging so
bad we can't touch it!
Hey, you. Think you could
deal with that thing?
I'm counting on you!

51047.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of a Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
51047.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

1015.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
1015.description: It seems the Rathian has a subspecies. The queen clad in cherry pink is said to be a troublesome lady with a fiercer temper than the original! To slay or capture, judging the foe's state and your own is what matters!
1015.descriptionEn:
Seems Rathian has a
subspecies. A queen wrapped
in cherry blossom pink, with
a worse temper than the
original, a real handful!
Slay or capture, judging
both her state and yours!

60581.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Rathian. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60581.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is Rathian!
You'll be achieving the goal
together with your Guild
mates. This contest is all
about teamwork, so win a
place in the top ranks!
Also, Origin Species weapons
only this time! Choose wisely!

21670.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
21670.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over six at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21670.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
If you want a ≪Pawprint Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand over six of them at once.
Bring exactly 3 ≪Quest
Completion Certificates≫ and
come alone, got it? Well then,
I'll be waiting in the Canyon.

26718.description: What, you just want a hard Hunting Horn? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26718.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Hunting Horn, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!

26554.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
26554.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.

62441.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62441.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!

63166.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63166.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63166.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

21639.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
21639.description: There are reports of a Lavasioth Subspecies in the volcano far stronger than usual. We want to study its ecology, so bring back anything that might serve as a sample when you slay it. Should a rare material turn up, it is yours.
21639.descriptionEn:
There are reports of a Lavasioth
stronger than usual in the
Volcano. We want to study its
ecology, so while you slay it,
please bring back anything that
could serve as a sample.
If something rare turns up, it
is yours to keep.

61439.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61439.description: An extremely powerful individual of the wind dragon Kushala Daora has invaded Dundorma! Either slay it using the interception weapons, or at least destroy parts to buy time! Failure is absolutely unforgivable, so present proof of sufficient skill.
61439.descriptionEn:
A Kushala Daora has invaded
Dundorma, and an extremely
powerful one at that!
Either slay it using the
interception weapons, or at
least break parts to buy
time! Failure is absolutely
not permitted, so present
proof of sufficient skill.

23460.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Heavy Bowgun Ribbon (Middle) x165, Heavy Bowgun Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23460.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪H Bowgun Cord: Intro≫ x100
≪H Bowgun Cord: Mid≫ x165
≪H Bowgun Cord: Extreme≫ x165
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Cord Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.

54810.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54810.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

23646.description: The Variant Species Inagami has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23646.descriptionEn:
Supremacy Inagami
has grown fiercely strong and
continues to rampage.
As things stand it is highly dangerous.
Please make full preparations before
you begin the survey.

26065.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26065.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

28047.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
28047.description: There is talk that the Kamu Orgaron and the Nono Orgaron were seen in the Swamp this morning. I want to try making a new medicine from their fangs. The reward will be generous, so go and hunt them at once.
28047.descriptionEn:
This morning in the Swamp,
someone reported seeing
Kam Orugaron and
Non Orugaron.
I want to make a new
medicine from their fangs.
I'll pay well, so go hunt
them at once.

28048.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟

26012.description: It seems a great many Gabras have gathered at the tower. They are said to be an omen of calamity, so the Guild cannot ignore it either. Slay 8 Gabras and confirm the situation.
26012.descriptionEn:
It seems a great many Remobra
have gathered at the tower.
They are said to herald disaster,
so the Guild cannot simply
ignore them.
Slay 8 Remobra and check on
the situation for us.

21883.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Odibatorasu Gou armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the swamp, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
21883.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Swamp, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor
"Odiba F" to Lv7.

50718.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Rajang will also grant a special ingredient.
50718.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Rajang's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

54548.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Giaorugu, the Ice Violent Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54548.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Ice Tyrant
Wyvern ≪Giaorugu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.

61194.description: The last trial of the Hunting Companion Festival is for a man and a woman to face a monster together. Go with someone you have your eye on, or whoever happens to be around. They say the point is to overcome the trial together. Do your best.
61194.descriptionEn:
The Hunting Festival's final task
pairs up a man and a woman to
challenge a monster. Go with
the one you fancy, or anyone
handy. They say clearing the
trial together is what really
matters. So go on, do your best.

53169.description: This is Miyashita. I want to eat a hamburger. [Question 5] The Partnya drawn on the official wallpaper distributed in 2014 number 5. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53169.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here.
I want a hamburger♪
[Question 5]
The 2014 official wallpaper
'Partnyaa' features exactly
five Partnyaas in total.
If you think the answer is X (B),
hunters should take
this quest instead!

63267.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63267.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63267.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

62022.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

63148.description: There is a report that a Berukyuros, thought to live only in the wasteland known as the Canyon, was sighted at a certain old tower. It appears to be a powerful individual and the area is extremely dangerous, so supplies cannot be delivered, but hunters confident in their skill are asked to hunt it.
63148.descriptionEn:
We have a report that a
≪Berukyurosu≫, thought to live
only in the ≪Canyon≫ of the
wastelands, was sighted at
a certain Ancient Tower.
It seems to be a powerful one,
and the area is very dangerous,
so no supplies can be sent in.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please take on this hunt.

50475.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
50475.description: Thanks for playing MHF for seven whole years! Equip Sol Oquvia Thorn and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude P as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude P you can forge Shan Luminare (Bow).
50475.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for seven whole years!
Equip ≪Sol Oquvia Thorn≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude P≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
P≫ you can forge ≪Shan
Luminare≫ (Bow).

62855.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62855.description: A monster attacked me again! I ran into a Pariapuria in the highlands, and it was in a foul mood. I will pay, so hunt it for me! By the way, its tail knocked a new item out of my hands. If you like, retrieve that too. Please!
62855.descriptionEn:
Attacked by a monster again!
Ran into a Pariapuria up in the
Highlands, and it was in a foul
mood. I'll make it worth your
while, so go hunt the thing!
Oh, right, it smacked me with
its tail and I dropped some new
goods. Grab those for me too if
you don't mind. Thanks!

54254.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
54254.description: Reports say accidents happen often in the Desert at night. Merchants avoid the strong daylight and transport their loads at night, and a monster seems to leap out of the sand and attack them. The cause is likely a Cephadrome roaming there, so please hunt it.
54254.descriptionEn:
Reports say accidents happen
often in the Desert at night.
Merchants avoiding the strong
daytime sun transport their goods
at night, and it seems monsters
burst out of the sand and
attacked them.
The cause is likely a wandering
≪Cephadrome≫, so please hunt it.

50206.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
50206.description: A special job from the Guild to train hunters! Guild support is generous, and those who complete the quest are paid richly! Those with ambition should use this chance to rise!
50206.descriptionEn:
A special request from the Guild,
aimed at training up hunters!
The Guild's support is generous,
and those who complete the quest
are paid a handsome reward!
Let those with ambition take this
chance and rise higher!

56103.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
56103.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a back break and a leg break in slaying Taikun Zamuza, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
56103.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Taikun Zamuza≫ and break
its back and legs, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

55189.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
55189.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55189.descriptionEn:
Slaying a Hypnocatrice in its
breeding season raises your
reputation and earns you the
materials needed for G Rank
decorations, all in one handy
quest we've prepared for you.
Please make good use of it.

11048.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
11048.description: A red shadow crawling across the snowfield has been sighted! It is certainly a Khezu subspecies! In the Snowy Mountains this season, the Blango gather in herds seeking food! Take care not to face the Khezu and the Blango at the same time!
11048.descriptionEn:
A red shadow crawling over the
snowy fields has been sighted!
It is surely a ≪Khezu≫
subspecies! This season the
Snowy Mountains swarm with
Blango seeking food! Mind that
you do not face Khezu and Blango at once!

61571.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61571.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

54717.description: The survey of White Lake is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
54717.descriptionEn:
The survey of White Lake is
going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.

50519.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
50519.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to slay an extremely powerful Diorekkusu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50519.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We're after
hunters to slay an extremely
powerful ≪Diorex≫ specimen.
Complete the hunt and we
will issue a larger number
of slay proofs than usual
as your reward. Good luck!

53181.description: Prism Falls by day in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
53181.descriptionEn:
The ≪Rainbow Waterfall≫ in the
temperate season, by day. The
Guild is still surveying this
unexplored land, but why don't
you go and take a look for
gathering and survey?
If you want to come home,
just deliver a map!

21893.description: This is the quest for the HR600 breakthrough trial. Take the trial from the Guildmaster or the HR Trial board, then set out on this quest on your own. Good luck, hunter.
21893.descriptionEn:
This is the quest for the HR600
breakthrough trial. Take the
trial from the Guildmaster or
the HR Trial board, then set
out on this quest on your own.
Good luck, hunter.

5001.description: A big carapace creature called Daimyo Hermitaur has been sighted in the desert, they say! Hunt it so it does not get in the way of people visiting Jumbo Village! I am counting on you!!
5001.descriptionEn:
Word is a huge carapace beast
called ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ was
sighted out in the Desert!?
Hunt it down so it won't get in
the way of folks visiting Jumbo
Village! I'm counting on you!!

61764.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
61764.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.

23453.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Hammer Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Hammer Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23453.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hammer Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Hammer Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Hammer Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.

63295.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63295.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63295.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.

62245.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62245.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

50821.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50821.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Berukyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
50821.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Duramboros' head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

23731.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Merit (Beginning) x５０, Switch Axe Merit (Middle) x６０, Switch Axe Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23731.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials:
≪Switch Axe Honor - Intro≫ x50
≪Switch Axe Honor - Mid≫ x60
≪Switch Axe Honor - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you need
≪Secret Art Honor Crystal≫ and
GR500 or higher, so please
keep that in mind.

63260.description: The final stage of training. This time you will face a tough monster! Ah, tough as it is, this individual is easier to hunt than one encountered elsewhere. Do not tense up, fight as usual!
63260.descriptionEn:
The final round of training.
This time you'll be facing a
truly tough monster!
Ah, but tough as it is, this
one's tuned to be easier to
hunt than the ones you'd meet
elsewhere.
Don't psyche yourself out, just
fight like you always do!

55692.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Giaorugu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55692.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Giaorugu≫.
Accepting this quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest ends in failure,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please keep that
in mind.

61342.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61342.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21207.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21207.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

54544.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Pokaradon, the Frozen Sea Beast. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54544.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the frozen sea
beast ≪Pokaradon≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.

62310.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟

53146.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
53146.client: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy
53146.clientEn: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy

26136.description: It is I, the Instructor! Mm. Good that you looked here. Whatever quest you go on, check this section carefully. Now, this time the quest is to find Honey. If you find a bee hive, you can take the honey!
26136.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
Mm. Good that you looked here.
No matter which quest you take,
always check this section well.
Now, this time it is a quest to
find ≪Honey≫. Find a bee nest
and you can take the honey!

54374.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54374.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of Ｇｚ and Porta Cards! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
54374.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to all hunters!
In addition to a training method that
efficiently builds up experience, right
now you can obtain a large amount of
Gz and Porta Cards!
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
enormous!
May your daily training become a
great strength for you, hunters!

53289.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53289.description: I had the most amazing dream! Among a herd of Bullfango there was a huge Bulldrome! It was a sight worth sharing, so I recreated it in the Great Arena! Go and see it!
53289.descriptionEn:
I had the wildest dream the
other day! Right in the middle
of a herd of Bullfango was
this huge Bulldrome!
It was a sight worth sharing,
so I recreated it in the New
Great Arena! Go take a look!

50598.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50598.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

26378.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Low Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26378.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
low rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!

62860.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62860.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!

55270.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
55270.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55270.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

55956.description: A decoration has been completed to protect you from a monster's fierce attacks. With this new decoration you will find it enormously effective against Aberrant species that use water. We will hand it out as a reward for this quest, so do join us!
55956.descriptionEn:
A decoration that shields you
from a monster's fierce attacks
has been completed.
With this new decoration, you'll
see immense effect against
water-using Supremacy monsters!
We'll hand it over as this
quest's reward, so please join
in with enthusiasm.

26034.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
26034.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26034.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

53190.objectiveJp: ハンターメダル赤１個の納品
53190.description: We present a great many items to those who have just started! By all means clear this every day and make use of it in your hunting life.
53190.descriptionEn:
For all you hunters just
starting out, we're giving
away a pile of items!
Clear it every day and put
them to use in your hunts.

61955.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

55539.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55539.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55539.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

63122.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63122.description: A very powerful Daimyo Hermitaur that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63122.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur that acts
unlike the norm and is very
powerful is in the New Great
Arena. I want you to hunt it.
This request is only for hunters
with Secret Art equipment
recognized by the Guild.
Succeed, and you will earn
even more acclaim as a
top hunter.

58051.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58051.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58051.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

60211.description: For cold weather gear, decorations, and weapons, Hypnocatrice materials are in constant demand, and the guild regularly encourages hunters to hunt them. Head for the forest and hunt one Hypnocatrice.
60211.descriptionEn:
For cold weather gear, trinkets
and weapons alike, Hypnocatrice
materials are in constant demand,
and the Guild encourages all
hunters to hunt them regularly.
Head for the Great Forest and
hunt 1 Hypnocatrice, please.

26104.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50957.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, an Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, was newly observed in the Snowy Mountains. According to hunters who faced it, it unleashes attacks using ice. Please take the greatest care not to neglect your preparations.
50957.descriptionEn:
With the appearance of the
Transcendent species, surveys
have been pushed across the land,
and a Barioth, the Ice Fang Wyvern,
has now been sighted in the
Snowy Mountains. Hunters who faced
it report it unleashes ice attacks.
Please do not neglect your preparations.

61539.description: Those infamous great boars have appeared in the Great Arena leading a great herd! How will you face those sharp tusks and that impact!?
61539.descriptionEn:
Those infamous great boars
have brought a whole herd
into the Great Arena!
Against those tusks and that
charge, how will you fight!?

63072.description: Hello. I am the master of bouquets of love and miracles. Hmm, is there someone you want to pierce right through the heart? Then leave it to me! Gather the plants I name and I will make you a wonderful bouquet. To celebrate the fate that brought us together, I will pour my heart into it!
63072.descriptionEn:
Hello there. I am the Bouquet Master
of love and miracles. Hmm hmm,
is there someone special whose heart
you want to strike dead-on?
Then leave it to me!
Gather the plants I specify and I
will make you a wonderful bouquet.
To celebrate the fate that brought
us together, I will put my heart
into it!

62701.description: This is a hunting request for the Abiorugu confirmed in the swamp. The swamp is a place many novice hunters also visit to hunt, so they want its safety secured. This is just where hunters should show their skill, no?
62701.descriptionEn:
This is a request to hunt the
Abiorugu confirmed in the Swamp.
Many rookie hunters visit the
Swamp to hunt, so we have been
asked to secure their safety.
This is just the time for you
hunters to show what you can do,
is it not?

60613.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60613.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

61359.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

63131.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
63131.description: This is the practice finals quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or from clear rewards.
63131.descriptionEn:
This is the practice finals quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or from clear rewards.

23345.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟

62047.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62047.description: A big eater living in the Canyon is causing trouble for my friends, meow. I want you to get rid of him, meow! As thanks I will give you what you need to make a rare Hunting Party Poogie outfit, meow. I am counting on you, meow!
62047.descriptionEn:
A glutton living in the Canyon is
causing trouble for its fellows,
ya!
I want you to get rid of it, nya!
As thanks I will give you what
you need to make a rare Guild
Poogie outfit, nya. Please do it,
yaa!

50677.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50677.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Odiba FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50677.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of the
≪Zenith Armor≫ Odiba FX series.
Accepting this quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest ends in failure,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please keep that
in mind.

61144.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Next you will prove the accumulation of your daily discipline. On your own, land a Plesioth with a single rod and deliver 10 Fish Print [Small]. You must reel in the Plesioth without hunting it, absolutely.
61144.descriptionEn:
Fishing: a lonely hunt where you
face the fish in silence. Next,
prove the results of your daily
training. Alone, land one Plesioth
by rod and deliver 10 Fish Prints
[Small]. You must reel in the
Plesioth without ever hunting it.

53234.description: I heard there was such a thing as a Hypnocatrice Rare Species, so I went to the Jungle. And there was something amazing there. That must be the Rare Species. For how it looks it is timid, so if you carry a frightening weapon it may take fright and hide. If you are curious, go and see! Eh, the Rare Species is white?
53234.descriptionEn:
I heard a Hypnocatrice Kishu
was out there, so I went to
the Great Forest. And wow,
something amazing was there.
That must be the Kishu. It's
timid for how it looks, so a
scary weapon might make it
hide. Curious? Go see it!
Eh, is the Kishu white?
