match-up couldn't be worse.
Set out for the site at once
and hunt them down.

23699.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (head), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23699.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(head), excluding weapon
ribbons and weapon merits.
The yield is one type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫
is required, so please
take note.

40133.description: The Gypceros of this swamp is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40133.descriptionEn:
The Poison Bird Wyvern ≪Gypceros≫
that lives in this Swamp is said
to rarely carry some incredible
treasure.
If it's true, I'd very much like
you to go and hunt one.
We'll split the reward.

54541.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
54541.description: This quest raises your standing as a hunter by a wide margin. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54541.descriptionEn:
This quest will raise your
standing as a hunter by a
remarkable margin.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫
is required.
Should you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

50042.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50042.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

61808.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61808.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

62282.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This will help upgrade the Rath Soul R blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62282.descriptionEn:
Lend an ear to the voice of
nature, and you may gain new
ideas beyond human wisdom.
This will help you upgrade the
≪Rath Soul R≫ blademaster
armor.
May your hunting life stay
fulfilling for years to come.

26003.description: I found a little-known spot in the Snowy Mountains where materials unique to the area lie all about. Do go and have a look. If you come back with a pouch full, it will be worth the price of the information.
26003.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Snowy
Mountains lie scattered around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.

50767.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
50767.description: At last the Hunters Guild has discovered a species thought to be the origin of evolution! We tried to capture it to uncover the mystery of evolution, but it will not even approach a trap. Worse, its blasts of water are destroying the desert ecosystem. Slay it!
50767.descriptionEn:
At last, the Hunters Guild
has found a species thought
to be the origin of
evolution! We tried to
capture it to solve the
mystery, but it ignores our
traps. Worse, its blasts of
water are destroying the
Desert ecosystem. Slay it!

50909.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50909.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.

26188.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26188.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

50339.description: Well then, have you two confirmed your feelings for each other? If you need one more push, why not go hunting together? The sight of a hunter hunting beautifully is a hunter's true charm. Even those doing poorly may find a great reversal.
50339.descriptionEn:
Well now, have the two of you
sorted out your feelings?
If you just need one more
little push, why not go on a
hunt together?
A hunter in fine form is
truly at their most charming.
Even if it's not going well,
a big turnaround may be coming.

60107.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
60107.description: Please hunt the Velocidrome prowling the sea of trees! We also have a large order for mushrooms, so for deliveries of specialty mushrooms and aged mushrooms we will respond with a high reward! Off you go with spirit!
60107.descriptionEn:
We'd like you to hunt the
Velocidrome prowling the Great
Forest!
We've also got a big order for
mushrooms, so we'll pay top
rates for Specialty Mushrooms
and Aged Mushrooms!
Now off you go, and good luck!

61601.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
61601.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament preliminaries. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials by carving or clear rewards.
61601.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament preliminaries.
In the main round the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, you cannot obtain the
target monster's materials
by carving or clear rewards.

50893.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 20 Porta Tickets Sakura. Slay a Zerureusu and you can obtain the materials needed to produce 1 Supremacy weapon.
50893.descriptionEn:
A lovely quest is ready: take
it in exchange for 20 Sakura
Porta Tickets.
Slay a Zerureusu and you'll
get the materials needed to
craft one ≪Hardcore Weapon≫.
Won't you give it a go?

53128.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の捕獲
53128.description: 'He' finally accepted my chocolate! He says he is happy just to hear me grumble! Oh! I will share this happiness with all of you! Everyone, go and catch the Khezu Subspecies that can only be heard, never seen!
53128.descriptionEn:
He finally accepted my
chocolate!
He says just hearing me
nag is enough to make him happy!
Oh, stop it!
I'll share this happiness with
all of you! Everyone, go catch
the Red Khezu you can only
hear, all right!?

51093.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51093.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
51093.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

56040.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
56040.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Doragyurosu. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56040.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Dark Thunder Wyvern
for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.

60677.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
60677.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Rebidiora. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60677.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! The
target this time is ≪Rebidiora≫!
Going after a monster all on
your own - what spirit! Truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a top placement!
This one is Supremacy weapons
only!

56048.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
56048.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Akura Vashimu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Lance, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56048.descriptionEn:
Here you can get the materials
to craft one Supremacy weapon
from the Supremacy Akura
Vashimu and upgrade it two
steps, plus Porta Cards Sakura
worth the Gz.
Craftable types: Sword and
Shield, Long Sword, Hunting
Horn, Lance, Gunlance and
Switch Axe. Make good use of it!

60945.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60945.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60945.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.

60533.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60533.description: The Tigrex boasts overwhelming strength, but any creature must have a weak point! I say its weak point is the head! Aim for the head when it turns around!
60533.descriptionEn:
≪Tigrex≫ boasts overwhelming
strength, but every one of them
must have a ≪weak point≫!
I say its weak point is the
≪head≫! Aim for the head at the
moment it turns around!

28071.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28071.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!

63104.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
63104.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63104.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

55575.description: The Variant Species Inagami appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Inagami. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55575.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Inagami≫ seems to
have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Inagami.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.

55410.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55410.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

61417.description: On the way to the Canyon, a Basarios is blocking the road and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
61417.descriptionEn:
On the way to the Canyon,
a Basarios is blocking the
road and I'm in trouble.
If you help me out, I'll give
you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ to trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫. Thanks!

1011.description: The Congalala is a greedy fellow, and I hear he has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course his minions the Conga must love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, he might come out.
1011.descriptionEn:
The ≪Congalala≫ is a stubborn
glutton, and word has it that
mushroom dishes are its
weakness! And its underlings
the Conga surely love them too!
Carry plenty of Specialty
Mushrooms and it might appear?

53062.description: This is Miyashita. I love curry and rice. [Question 5] Miyamoa has FRONTIER written on its forehead. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53062.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here.
I love curry and rice♪
[Question 5]
Miyamoa's forehead has
"FRONTIER" written
on it.
If you think the answer is X (B),
hunters should take
this quest!

60245.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
60245.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Greadmos. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60245.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! The
target is ≪Gureadomosu≫!
Going after a monster all on
your own - what spirit! Truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a top placement!
Also, this one is SP weapons
only! Choose your weapon well!

56106.description: This is bad, this is bad! My Baretta collection has been stolen! That Zerureusu took the whole collection! Give me a break! I will share the materials with you at least! Get it back for me! Please!
56106.descriptionEn:
This is bad, bad, bad!
My collected Balletta Collection
got stolen!
That Zerureusu bastard made off
with the whole collection!
Give me a break!
I'll share the materials with
you, so go take it back!
Please!

23673.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Khezu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23673.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the materials of the Supremacy
≪Khezu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

50163.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

55207.description: Thank you for helping slay Kirin. If you deliver the Beautiful Mirror that regained its true form through Kirin's strange lightning, I will present you with materials for precious armor owned by the Guild as thanks.
55207.descriptionEn:
Thank you for your help in slaying
Kirin.
If you deliver the ≪Beautiful Mirror≫
that regained its true form through
Kirin's wondrous lightning, we will
present you with rare armor materials
owned by the Guild as a token of
our gratitude.

62124.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62124.description: Please hunt the Velocidrome lurking in the Jungle. On the way, we also ask you to gather Special Mushrooms and slay Bullfango. The theme of this request is the dandy hunt! I will lend you a fitting costume, so show me something cool!
62124.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the ≪Velocidrome≫
lurking in the Jungle.
Along the way, also gather
Specialty Mushrooms and slay
some Bullfango.
The theme of this request is
"Dandy Hunting"!
We'll lend you a fitting
outfit, so show us your
coolest side!

50450.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55814.description: Was the bizarre tale born from the bizarre? Or was the bizarre born from the bizarre tale? The bizarre is truly fascinating. I want you to slay the Chameleos, which closely resembles a bizarre phenomenon, with the Paper Umbrella Sword [Apparition]. It may draw something strange to us. As a reward I will prepare my treasured tale of the bizarre.
55814.descriptionEn:
Did the strange spawn the tale?
Or did the tale spawn the strange?
The bizarre truly fascinates.
I want you to slay the Chameleos
that resembles those anomalies
using the Karakasa Sword [Yokai].
It may draw something strange
to it. As a reward, I'll prepare
a tale from my own collection.

61860.description: This time you are to hunt the Espinas in the Sea of Trees. Supplied items are ready. It should be quite possible for you. It is a drill, so there is no reward, but do your best!
61860.descriptionEn:
This time, I'll have you go
hunt an ≪Espinas≫ in the
Great Forest.
Supplies are already prepared.
You lot should handle it fine.
It's only an exercise, so no
reward, but do your best!

50939.description: Hi! I am the ally of girls in love, Miracle Love Hunter! A request from a girl in love! Khezu are said to be a devoted couple! The ultimate form of a girl who wants to be with her boyfriend always! I want to study them, so catch one for me!
50939.descriptionEn:
Hi there!
Ally of girls in love,
Miracle★Love Hunter here!
A request from a girl in love!
Apparently Khezu are
hermaphrodites!
The ultimate form of a girl
who wants to be with him always!
I want to study it, so catch one★

50309.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
50309.description: Many men and women are taking part in this festival too. And the festival is only just beginning. Not only hearts in love, faint feelings and blazing love, but jealousy, bitterness and sheer irritation! Throw all of those feelings into this request! Participation by men alone is also possible!
50309.descriptionEn:
Many men and women are taking
part in this year's festival.
But the festival has only just
begun. Hearts in love, faint
yearnings, blazing passion,
and jealousy, regret, spite!
Pour every one of those
feelings into this request!
Men-only entry is fine too!

62931.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62931.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.

54937.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Hammer Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Hammer Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54937.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hammer Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Hammer Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Hammer Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.

50223.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・一章１個の納品

55171.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
55171.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Azure Rathalos while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55171.descriptionEn:
Slaying an Azure Rathalos
raises your reputation while
also earning you the materials
needed to get G Rank
decorations, all in one handy
quest we've prepared for you.
Please make good use of it.

21661.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
21661.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21661.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!

62045.description: Hey, thanks as always! Honestly, all these hard jobs must be tough. But relax. This one is a gathering quest playing with cute bugs, so it is not hard. Enjoy yourself.
62045.descriptionEn:
Hi there, thanks as always for
your hard work! It must be rough
always getting the harder requests.
But relax. This job is a gathering
quest where you play with cute
little bugs, so it is not hard.
Please take it easy and enjoy!

53225.description: I declare, meow! 2018 is the Year of the Cat, meow! Year one of the Cat Era, meow! Established by the Cat Union, meow! Obey what cats say, meow! I want to eat fish, meow! I want to eat, meow! Bring me some, meow!
53225.descriptionEn:
I declare, nya!
2018 is the Year of the Cat, nya!
The first Year of the Cat, nya!
Decreed by the Cat Union, nya!
Obey the cat, nya!
I want fish, nya!
I want to eat, nya!
Go catch some, nya!

51081.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51081.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of an Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
51081.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Espinas's horn,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.

55063.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55063.description: It seems you could not fully upgrade the Odibatorasu gear. I have prepared a fine quest for a hunter like you. The number you can accept per day is limited, but it should help. I wish you success.
55063.descriptionEn:
Seems you couldn't fully
upgrade the ≪Emperor Dragon≫
equipment. For hunters like
you, I've prepared a fine quest.
There's a daily limit on how
many times you can take it,
but it should help. Good luck.

50942.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and the guild will present you with rare Conquest species materials.
50942.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards exclusively
for those in a guild on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival. Please bring your
proof of the festival when you
accept or join.
Clear this request and the guild
will present you with rare
Zenith materials.

61661.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

63077.description: A quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament trial session. The time limit is 10 minutes.
63077.descriptionEn:
A quest for the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament trial
session.
The time limit is 10 minutes.

55486.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55486.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55486.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

26581.description: Congratulations on reaching HR400! Deliver the Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26581.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR400!
Deliver the ≪Map≫ on your own,
clear the quest, and claim
your reward!

26004.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the volcano lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
26004.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Volcano
lie scattered all around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.

26559.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26559.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Imperial Consort] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
26559.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Imperial Consort]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).

61447.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン赤３個の納品
61447.description: A quest reserved for the 3rd Place server. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Red) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61447.descriptionEn:
[3rd Place] This quest is
exclusive to this server.
We've prepared a special
reward for hunters who cleared
the Guild Idaten Cup.
The more Hunter Coins (Red)
you deliver, the better your
chance at rare materials.

54120.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54120.description: Look at this yellow feather! I found it near the Forest, and it shines with such a bright color! I simply must add this monster's materials to my collection! I will pay. Hunt the monster with the yellow feather and bring it back!
54120.descriptionEn:
Look at this yellow feather!
I found it near the Great
Forest, and it shines with
such a bright, vivid color!
I simply must add this
monster's materials to my
collection! I will pay well.
Hunt down the monster with
the yellow feathers for me!

21074.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21074.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
21074.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!

55820.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55820.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55820.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

54911.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Zerureusu, the Radiant World Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54911.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Radiant Dragon ≪Zerureusu≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.

50419.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

62112.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

21681.description: There was a report that an unidentified monster appeared in the swamp. As a result of the investigation, it was determined to be the Blood Devouring Wyvern, Baruragaru, never before confirmed around Mezepolta. The survey continues. Please head to the site at once and secure safety.
21681.descriptionEn:
We have reports that an
unidentified monster appeared in
the Swamp. As a result of our
survey, it was determined to be
the Blood-Eating Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫, never before
confirmed around Mezepolta.
The survey is still ongoing.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.

55881.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55881.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55881.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

54823.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ５０頭の討伐
54823.description: Meat! I do not have enough meat! At this rate I cannot hold a hot pot party! I do not want that! Bullfango meat is delicious and perfect for hot pot, so go and slay plenty! The parts unsuited to the pot I will give to you as a present! Let us have a wonderful hot pot party!
54823.descriptionEn:
Meat! We do not have enough
meat! We cannot have a hot pot
party like this! I cannot
stand it! Bullfango meat is
delicious and perfect for hot
pot, so slay plenty! The parts
unfit for the pot I will give
to you as a present, hunter!
Let us have a wonderful party!

22041.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟

56064.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Harudomerugu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Great Sword, Lance, Gunlance, Hunting Horn, or Magnet Spike. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56064.descriptionEn:
From one Supremacy Harudomerugu
weapon's creation up to two
upgrades, you can get the
materials and Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura. Weapon types:
Sword and Shield, Dual Blades,
Great Sword, Lance, Gunlance,
Hunting Horn or Magnet Spike.
Please make good use of it.

51057.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
51057.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the chest of a Black Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
51057.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Black Gravios's
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.

62351.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

50069.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival, but you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are a little harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. Nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
50069.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival,
but you just have to have a
souvenir of the festivities!
That's you, isn't it! Why not
try accepting this quest?
But the conditions are a bit harsh,
so I don't recommend it to the
winning side.
If you fail, the item won't be
returned, so be careful!

50509.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
50509.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to hunt an extremely powerful Forokururu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50509.descriptionEn:
Emergency request! We are
looking for hunters to
hunt an extremely powerful
≪Forokururu≫ specimen.
If you succeed, you'll receive
more Slay Proofs than usual
from us!

50178.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス２頭の狩猟
50178.description: It is I, the Instructor! What is the most reliable partner for you lot! Yes! Powerful, sturdy arms and armor! This time I have prepared some quite powerful and quirky partners! Complete the request I set and craft them!!
50178.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
What is the most reliable
partner for you all?
Yes! Strong, sturdy gear!
This time I've prepared
partners that are quite
powerful and quirky!
Clear my request and craft them!!

28069.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
28069.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28069.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!

26742.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26742.description: Have you been to the sea of trees lately? There was a blue Hypnocatrice there, was there not. Won't you bring me its feathers? What? It is the cold season now, so there are only orange Hypnocatrice!? Oh, enough of your noise. Do not think too hard and just go!
26742.descriptionEn:
Been to the Great Forest lately?
There's a blue Hypnocatrice
out there, isn't there. Bring me
its wings, would you?
What? It's the cold season, so
there's only orange ones!
Bah, enough of your noise.
Don't think too hard, just get
out there and do it!

61545.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
61545.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61545.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.

50026.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50026.description: A man hunts Rathalos without a word. That is what I taught my son. If you want to become a stronger hunter, Rathalos is a road you cannot avoid. Hunters! Hunt Rathalos without a word!
50026.descriptionEn:
A man hunts Rathalos. No words.
That is what I taught my son.
To become a stronger hunter,
Rathalos is a path you cannot
avoid walking.
Hunters! Say nothing and
hunt Rathalos!

54660.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
54660.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54660.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

55057.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55057.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Merit (Beginning) x５０, Switch Axe Merit (Middle) x６０, Switch Axe Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55057.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Switch Axe Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Switch Axe Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Switch Axe Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR 500 or above, so please
be aware.

26256.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26256.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26256.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26256.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

21188.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21188.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!

21881.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Kukubo Series armor. Hunt Hypnocatrice and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Low Rank armor Kukubo Series and Kukubo F Series.
21881.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
have made or upgraded
Kukubo Series armor.
Hunt a Hypnocatrice to get
the materials needed for
Low Rank Kukubo Series and
Kukubo F Series upgrades.

63150.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
63150.description: This is a request to slay the Odibatorasu found in the desert. Surveys so far have confirmed powerful attacks that use the sand, and many hunters have been harmed. Information is still scarce and this is an extremely dangerous request, but we ask for your continued investigation!
63150.descriptionEn:
This is a request to slay the
Odibatorasu found in the Desert.
Surveys so far confirm powerful
sand-based attacks, and many
hunters have been hurt.
There is little information yet
and the request is very
perilous, but please continue
the survey!

61002.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ４頭の捕獲
61002.description: This is terrible! Bulldrome seem to have bred in great numbers in the Jungle. To find the cause, I want you to capture a Bulldrome. Do not slay it, whatever you do! I expect good results. I am counting on you!
61002.descriptionEn:
This is bad! Bulldrome are
breeding out of control in
the Jungle. To find out why,
I need you to capture some.
Don't slay them, got it?!
I'm expecting good results.
I'm counting on you!

53097.objectiveJp: オニマツタケ１０個の納品
53097.description: I am short of autumn mushrooms! Hunter, gather Oni Matsutake and deliver them! Depending on how many you deliver, I will release a mushroom-heavy quest later! Oni Matsutake are rare, so it is good to deliver ones found in other quests as well.
53097.descriptionEn:
The mushrooms of autumn are
running low! Hunter, gather
Ogre Matsutake and deliver
them! Depending on how many
you deliver, I'll post a very
mushroomy quest later on!
Ogre Matsutake are rare, so
deliver any you find during
other quests too.

54914.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
54914.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Garubadaora, the Gold Dust Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54914.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Gold Dust
Dragon Garubadaora.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
If you fail the quest, the
Superior Ticket will be
consumed, so be warned.

55126.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
55126.description: Slaying a Yian Garuga raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55126.descriptionEn:
Slay a Yian Garuga to raise
your own reputation while
getting G Rank decorations
and the materials you need
for them at a good price.
We have prepared this quest
for you. Please make use of it.

63163.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
63163.description: When the monster the surveyor found was checked with the guild, it proved to be a relative of the sea wyverns, a Crystal Wyvern by the name of Kuarusepusu. Moreover, an extremely powerful individual seems to dwell in the highlands, and the surveyor's safety is feared for. Head for the highlands at once and hunt the Crystal Wyvern.
63163.descriptionEn:
When the Guild examined the
monster our surveyor found, it was
a kind of Leviathan named
Kuarlusepusu, the Crystal Dragon.
What is more, an extremely strong
individual seems to live up in the
Highlands, and the surveyor's
safety is feared for.
Hurry there and hunt it.

62549.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62549.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62549.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

40136.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40136.description: The Bulldrome of this swamp is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40136.descriptionEn:
The great boar ≪Bulldrome≫
living in this Swamp is said
to occasionally carry some
incredible treasure.
If that is true, I'd love for
you to go and hunt one.
We split the reward.

50829.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
50829.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50829.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.

55359.description: It is here, it is here, finally here! The season when you can drink for any flower reason has come! Everyone knows it by now, but that Espinas is drinking and sleeping, right? I understand! We could be friends! Though I will hunt it!
55359.descriptionEn:
It's here! Finally here!
Any excuse will do as long
as flowers are the reason!

Everyone knows it by now, but
that Espinas fellow,
he drinks and passes out, right?
I get how he feels!
We could be friends!
Though I'm hunting him!

61215.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61215.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.

23566.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23566.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

63185.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63185.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

22040.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

63225.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
63225.description: Do you like Guku? In this job I am introducing today, an item that can transform Guku into a surprising form is being distributed. Interested now, right? However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
63225.descriptionEn:
Do you like Gooks? In the
request we present today, an
item that turns a Gook into
an amazing form is being
handed out. Curious now,
right? Note that you cannot
accept it twice in a row.

55963.description: By completing this request, you can consume 5 Rafan D Series layered armor release tickets to obtain 1 Rafan C Series layered armor release ticket.
55963.descriptionEn:
By clearing this request, you
can consume 5 ≪Rafan D
Series≫ layered unlock tickets
(the layered armor of the
≪Rafan G Series≫) to obtain
1 ≪Rafan C Series≫ layered
unlock ticket.

55414.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55414.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55414.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

28035.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
28035.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Baruragaru materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28035.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters, a word.
Won't you pass your hunting
skills on to the young
hunters of the Guild? This
time, ≪Taikun Zamuza≫ parts
in abundance! Get stronger
together and liven up the
Guild. Clear it with both
Secret Art Tome holders and
non-holders for more renown.

21364.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Swamp, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Spring or the Voice of Nature: Thick Fog. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21364.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the ≪Swamp≫, you may
obtain ≪Voice of Nature:
Spring≫ or ≪Voice of Nature:
Dense Fog≫.
I wish you all a richer hunting life.

50091.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
50091.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Yian Garuga of the jungle. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50091.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Hunt the Yian Garuga of the
Jungle and prove yourself.
Clear the quest in style and
your standing as a hunter will
jump right up!

54713.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
54713.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54713.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.

54158.description: We continue the investigation of Gravios, the boulder of the swamp. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54158.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of
the Swamp's boulder, Gravios.
Part breaks aren't required,
but we'd be delighted if
you did it!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid!

21147.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

23643.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
23643.description: The Storm Dragon, Amatsu, has appeared in the mountain range called the sacred peaks. The storm is so powerful it defies imagination, and the surveyors cannot even approach. Considering the damage to the surroundings, a response is needed as soon as possible. Head out to hunt it at once.
23643.descriptionEn:
In the mountain range called the
Sacred Peak, the Storm Dragon
≪Amatsu≫ has appeared.
Its storms are beyond imagining,
and our surveyors cannot even
approach. Given the harm to
surroundings, a response is
needed at once.
Head out to slay it immediately.

62171.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
62171.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62171.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

55997.description: A decoration has been completed to protect you from a monster's fierce attacks. With this new decoration you will find it enormously effective against Aberrant species that use dragon element attacks. We will hand it out as a reward for this quest, so do join us!
55997.descriptionEn:
A decoration to protect you
from the ferocious attacks of
monsters is complete.
With this new decoration, you
will show immense effect on
Supremacy foes with Dragon
attacks! We shall give it as
this quest's reward, so please
join us with vigor.

62257.objectiveJp: 冥雷竜の堅殻３個の納品
62257.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Nether Thunder Dragon's Hard Shell you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
62257.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon but
I lack the materials! Like this
I can't go out hunting. Trade me
the ≪Dark Thunder Wyvern Shell≫
you have for this
≪Pawprint Medal≫! Please!

62765.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

56017.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Blangonga. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56017.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay the
Supremacy Snow Lion.
If you break its developed parts
during this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
reward as a special bonus.
Note that slaying alone will not
grant you those materials.

62595.objectiveJp: ハンターカード白１０枚納品
62595.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62595.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.

61327.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟

21255.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石２個の納品
21255.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21255.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

26607.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Achimo Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26607.descriptionEn:
The lost memos that record the
secret of forging weapons are
apparently turning up on
monsters slain all over!
Once you get the Achimo Memo,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work!

50191.description: Hunting and capturing are not everything! You agree that breaking parts is the true thrill of the hunt, do you not? Your quarry this time is a Kuarusepusu. Break the specified parts in style and show off your skill.
50191.descriptionEn:
Slaying is not everything!
Part breaking is the real
thrill of the hunt. Right?
Today's quarry is ≪Dyuragaua≫.
Break the specified parts with
flair and show me your skill!

55278.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
55278.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55278.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

50001.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
50001.description: The black dragon that was said to be a legend seems to have shown itself at Castle Schrade! In the tale of the Black Dragon legend it is told that the black dragon will bring calamity to the world! Slay it with all your might so that the legend does not become reality!
50001.descriptionEn:
The black dragon of legend
seems to have shown itself at
≪Schrade Castle≫! The tale of
the Black Dragon says it will
bring ruin to the world! Slay
it with all your might so the
legend never comes true!

55813.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55813.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55813.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

21602.description: Do you know the orb called the Owl Eye Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21602.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Owl Eye Sphere?
Its material is essential to
the crafting of a certain
costly decoration.
If you can clear this request,
I'll give you a valuable
decoration material.

50005.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with monsters in Hardcore quests! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. Use them to enrich your equipment further. I wish you good fortune!
50005.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
with Hardcore Quest monsters!
Clear this request and I'll
hand over more monster
materials than usual.
Put them to good use in
beefing up your equipment.
I wish you a fine hunt!

26265.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26265.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

23395.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
23395.description: A Crimson Lavasioth that moves unlike any other has been discovered in the volcano. According to the finder, it unleashed attacks never seen before. Please take the greatest care during the hunt.
23395.descriptionEn:
In the Volcano, a ≪Lavasioth≫
that moves unlike any normal
one has been found.
According to the finder, it
unleashed attacks never seen
before.
Please take the utmost care
when you hunt it.

54467.description: Zerureusu has appeared at the summit of the Tower. It is a monster of many mysteries, with few reports, but because legends of it as sacred or as an ill omen differ by region, it is a most valuable subject for study. Which legend this radiant dragon belongs to is unknown, but please investigate at once.
54467.descriptionEn:
≪Zerureusu≫ has appeared atop
the Tower. Reports are few and
the monster is full of mystery,
but since legends differ by
region, sacred here and an ill
omen there, it is a most valuable
subject of survey. Which legend
the Radiant Wyvern belongs to is
unclear, so please survey it at once.

21897.description: This quest is for the HR 999 Breakthrough Trial. After accepting the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, please depart on the quest alone.
21897.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the HR 999
Breakthrough Trial. After
accepting the trial from the
Guild Master or the HR Trial
board, please depart on the
quest alone.

55565.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55565.description: Hunter who would master the light gun, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55565.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
light bowgun, show me the
skill you've honed against
the ≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you hunt it splendidly,
you'll earn rewards far beyond
what daily effort brings.
That is my promise to you.

55871.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55871.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55871.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

22076.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
22076.description: Kushala Daora seems to be running wild in the Flower Field. It will be dangerous, but please investigate it somehow. The reward is precious decoration material.
22076.descriptionEn:
Kushala Daora seems to be
rampaging in the Flower Field.
I know it is dangerous, but
please see the survey through.
The reward is rare decoration material.

58024.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58024.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58024.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

55048.objectiveJp: ハンターパス・黄１個の納品
55048.description: Hunters who believe that Leila is the most suitable legend Rasta to go in search of a new prayer jewel, please deliver a Hunter Pass (Yellow) through this request and cast your vote. As thanks for voting, we will give you materials such as the Steel Dragon Mad Shell.
55048.descriptionEn:
For the journey to find a new
Prayer Orb, hunters who think
(Layla) is the most suited
Legend Rasta should deliver
a "Hunter Pass: Yellow"
through this request and
cast your vote. As thanks,
you'll receive materials like
"Kushala Daora Mad Shell".

23469.description: The Variant Species Hypnocatrice has appeared once more. Its beak has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23469.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Hypnocatrice≫
has appeared once more.
Its beak has grown stronger,
and it seems even more
powerful. Please take great
care during the survey.

61075.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Gypceros, then slay the Gypceros here in this arena!
61075.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
their skill! If you're sure of
handling the Poison Bird, come
to this Arena and slay
≪Gypceros≫ before the crowd!

60087.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

40061.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟

21515.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
21515.description: Word has come that an Orugaron has appeared at the Ancient Tower. The surveyor says it seems to be a powerful individual, but for now it is staying in one place. Yet if they move in search of prey, great damage will spread through the area. Hunt them before that happens.
21515.descriptionEn:
Reports say a ≪Hyujikiki≫
showed up in the Ancient
Tower. The researcher says
it is a powerful specimen,
but for now it seems to be
staying in one place. But if
it moves in search of prey,
it will cause great damage
all around. Before that,
please hunt it down.

62289.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62289.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!

50335.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
50335.description: This is sudden, but I want your help with an ecological survey of Berukyurosu. If possible I would also like parts broken during this survey. I am sorry for the many requests, but for the sake of future research I would be most grateful.
50335.descriptionEn:
This is sudden, but I need help
with an ecological survey of
≪Berukyurosu≫. If possible,
I'd like part breaks as well.
Sorry for all the requests,
but for the sake of future
research, please help.

21998.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the volcano lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
21998.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Volcano
lie scattered all around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.

60625.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60625.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62134.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62134.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62134.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

22004.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２０匹の討伐

21115.description: If you're hit by the dung Congalala throws, you won't be able to use healing items. If hunting Congalala is hard, trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver the item you get.
21115.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Congalala≫'s
thrown dung and you can't
use healing items.
If hunting the ≪Congalala≫
is too much, trade the
underground ≪Khezu Whelp≫ to
the Veggie Elder and hand
in what you get for it.

50032.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50032.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
50032.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!

50304.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
50304.description: Greetings, hunters. Understand that acquiring 'dignity' means bearing a corresponding 'duty'. So I will have you complete this job. Those who fulfill their 'duty' will be led to greater heights.
50304.descriptionEn:
Greetings, hunters.
Understand that to acquire
"dignity" is to bear a
matching "duty".
So I would like you to
handle this request.
Those who fulfill their duty
shall be led to greater heights.

26746.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26746.description: Thanks for playing MHF for four whole years! Equip Vol Grand and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude M as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude M you can forge Akra Ain (Dual Blades).
26746.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for four whole years!
Equip ≪Vol Grand≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude M≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude M≫ you can forge
≪Akra Ain≫ (Dual Blades).

54782.description: Reports say powerful Brachydios are appearing in various regions. The Guild wants them hunted at once, but study of the Brachydios ecology has not progressed. For research, hunt it after breaking its forelegs. Your reward will be increased accordingly.
54782.descriptionEn:
Powerful Crushing Wyvern
Brachydios have been
reported all over.
The Guild wants them hunted
at once, but the ecology of
the Crushing Wyvern is still
unclear. For research, break
its forelegs before slaying.
Rewards will be bumped up.

54241.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54241.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54241.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.

21389.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

60053.description: The King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian, who have reigned over the frontier since ages past. Charge in with resolve unto death! Do not forget that only one pitfall trap or shock trap may be set!
60053.descriptionEn:
Since ages past, the king of the
skies ≪Rathalos≫ and the queen
of the land ≪Rathian≫ have ruled
these frontier lands. Go forth
resolved to face death! And do
not forget that you may set only
one pitfall trap or shock trap!

28012.description: This time too we have prepared a quest so that you may lead a cheerful hunting party life, meow. Two monsters from different worlds share the stage in the Great Arena, meow. Hunting party members, please work together and do your best, meow. I wish you good hunting, meow.
28012.descriptionEn:
To keep your Guild life bright,
I've prepared a quest for you,
meow.
Two beasts from different worlds
share the Great Arena, meow.
Guild members, please work
together and do your best, meow.
I wish you luck, meow.

28058.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
28058.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28058.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!

21876.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21876.description: A request that lets you craft the Inity Series, a weapon recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Velocidrome and you will obtain the crafting materials for 1 weapon type. May it serve you well in the hunts to come.
21876.descriptionEn:
This request lets you forge the
≪Initiative Series≫ weapons
recommended for new Hunters.
Hunt a Velocidrome to obtain
the materials for one weapon
type.
Please make good use of them
in future hunts.

50724.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and the guild will present you with rare Elder Dragon materials.
50724.descriptionEn:
A special request and reward
for members of winning
Hunter Festival Guilds.
Please bring your Festival
Proof when accepting or
joining. If you clear this
request, the Guild will gift
you rare Elder Dragon parts.

54746.description: This is terrible! The Origin Species Yamakurai has appeared in the Highlands! There is no time to gather hunters over the usual period. I will pay more material rewards than usual, so hunters who are ready should depart at once!
54746.descriptionEn:
This is terrible!
An Origin Species ≪Yama Kurai≫
has appeared in the Highlands!
We don't have the time to
gather hunters like we
usually do.
We'll pay out more material
rewards than usual, so
hunters who are ready should
depart immediately!

50305.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50305.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

50958.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
50958.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, we found an amazing monster in the volcano! Its name is the Crushing Wyvern, Brachydios! What sort of amazing creature it is, you can look forward to finding out in person!
50958.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent species
about, we pushed our surveys
across the land and found an
amazing monster in the Volcano!
Its name: Brachydios, the
Crushing Wyvern!
How amazing it is, you'll have to
see for yourself in person!

54092.description: I was surveying the extreme cold sea when I found cracked holes all over the ice. That was probably Giaorugu's doing. It seems that one sometimes hunts quite violently to catch prey. Take care not to be eaten yourself.
54092.descriptionEn:
I was surveying the Polar Sea
when I found holes cracked
open all over the ice.
That is likely Giaorugu's work.
It seems to hunt in a rather
violent way to catch prey.
Watch yourself, so you do not
end up eaten instead.

21581.description: Have you heard of the Wool Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21581.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Wool Orb?
Its material is essential to
the crafting of a certain
costly decoration.
If you can clear this request,
I'll give you a valuable
decoration material.

55525.description: That armor I loved the look of, and this one too, you never wear them anymore, meow! There are even hunters who say they have graduated from them, meow! No, meow! Put on that wonderful Dunru armor once more and show me the hunter in all his glory, meow! I will reward you, meow!
55525.descriptionEn:
That armor you loved the look
of, this armor and that,
you just won't wear, meow!
Some hunters even say
they've moved on, meow!
No, meow! Wear that wonderful
Dunru armor once more and
let me see your gallant
figure, meow! I'll reward you!

62126.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62126.description: An Elder Dragon is attacking Mezeporuta. The one named Rukodiora, the Ultimate Dragon, is closing on the interception base at tremendous speed! Slay it at once, before the new cornerstone of our defense is destroyed!
62126.descriptionEn:
An Elder Dragon is attacking
Mezepolta right now. The one
named ≪Rukodiora, the Extreme
Dragon≫ is racing toward the
≪Base≫ at great speed! Before
our new bulwark is destroyed,
slay it at once!

21420.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・３を１０個納品

26654.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26654.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.

55396.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55396.description: What on earth is happening to them!? Did we push them too far? The Guild has decided to call those shining ones the Deviljho that Devours Extremes. Anyone who succeeds in slaying one will receive the materials for a full set of the Guild's treasured armor and a title! Someone, please!
55396.descriptionEn:
What on earth is happening
to them!? Did we push them too far?
The Guild has decided to call
these shining ones the
'Acme Devouring Deviljho'.
If anyone succeeds in slaying one,
we shall present the materials for
a full set of Guild-hidden armor
and a title! Someone, please!

50078.description: Good news for novice hunters! We will help you upgrade Kukubo armor, which is tremendously effective for low-rank hunters! Obtain Gogomoa claws and horns on this quest and use them to upgrade your Kukubo!
50078.descriptionEn:
Good news for rookie hunters!
You've caught a lucky break!
We'll help you upgrade
"Kukubo", the armor that
shows great effect for Low Rank!
Get Gogomoa claws and horns
in this quest and use them
to upgrade your "Kukubo"!

60802.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60802.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

62072.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟

61046.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

15024.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
15024.description: This official hunting exam has 3 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! The Flame King Dragon Teostra is a being called the incarnation of flame! I believe in your strength!
15024.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam
has three parts! To gauge
your skill once more, you'll
hunt every monster I name!
That is the deal!
The Flame King Dragon Teostra
is the incarnation of fire!
I believe in your strength!

54245.description: Thanks to your gathering in unexplored lands and delivering to the Guild, Mezepolta has grown richer. As a token of our gratitude, we present this coin.
54245.descriptionEn:
Thanks to your gathering in
unexplored lands and your
deliveries to the Guild,
Mezeporuta has grown wealthy.
As a token of our gratitude,
please accept this coin.

54526.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
54526.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54526.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

55635.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55635.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55635.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.

23314.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
23314.description: A surveyor reports encountering a male and female pair of Gasurabazura in the swamp. Their appearance differs from the usual, with developed muscles and sharp fangs and claws confirmed. To secure the safety of the survey, please hunt the Gasurabazura.
23314.descriptionEn:
We received a report from a
surveyor who encountered a male
and female Orugaron in the Swamp.
Their appearance was not normal:
developed muscles and sharp fangs
and claws were confirmed.
To ensure the survey stays safe,
we ask you to hunt
these Orugaron.

22160.description: I have opened the Gook Gallery I always dreamed of! But it is noisy around here and customers do not come. Would someone hunt the poison bird wyvern in the Swamp near the gallery? If you help, I will give you my treasured Gook Collection.
22160.descriptionEn:
I have finally opened the Gook
Gallery I always dreamed of!
But it is noisy around here and
customers just will not come.
Would someone hunt the Gypceros
in the Swamp near the gallery
for me?
If you help me out, I will give
you a piece of my treasured
Gook collection.

62269.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
62269.description: What, you just want a hard Lance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62269.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Lance?
Then I'll refine some Argen Steel
for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
are prowling around the area
to top it off.
Go find it with all you've got!

21360.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Canyon, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Glacier, the Voice of Nature: Cavern, or the Voice of Nature: Cliff. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21360.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. This request is set
in the ≪Canyon≫, and by
clearing it you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Glacier≫,
≪Voice of Nature: Cavern≫,
or ≪Voice of Nature: Cliff≫.
I pray your hunting life grows
ever more fulfilling.

55609.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55609.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

23324.description: A Monoblos has appeared in the unexplored desert. It seems a lone investigator happened to encounter it while surveying, and there had been no sighting reports until now.
