There seems to be no danger as long as the survey is done by several people, but to be safe, please hunt the target.
23324.descriptionEn:
A ≪Monoblos≫ has appeared in
the unexplored Desert.
It seems a surveyor happened
to run into it while working
alone, and there had been no
sightings until now.
Surveying in a group is said to
be safe enough, but to be sure,
please hunt the target.

50524.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of armor upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Hypnocatrice and a Diablos. I am counting on you!
50524.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 22.
So I've got a favor to ask.
Payment is a full set of
armor upgrade materials. Deal?
It's an easy one. Just make
a quick trip and slay a
Hypnocatrice and a Diablos
for me. I'm counting on you!

53088.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
53088.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!

54216.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54216.description: Please help investigate Gurenzeburu. This time it is the missing part of the left wing and the cut surface of the tail, so be sure to destroy and cut. A dangerous job, but please.
54216.descriptionEn:
We ask for your aid in the
survey of Gurenzeburu.
This time we're studying the
left wing's chips and the
tail's cut surface, so be
sure to break and sever them.
It is a dangerous request,
but please see it through.

54646.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
54646.description: There are reports that a Green Plesioth has appeared in the desert. Unlike the usual, the color of its fins shines like a jewel sunk in a desert oasis, and hunters have been harmed by mistake. There is danger in it, so hunt with great care.
54646.descriptionEn:
A Green Plesioth has been
reported in the Desert.
Unlike normal ones, its fins
shine like a jewel sunk in
a desert oasis, and hunters
have been harmed by mistake,
they say. It holds danger,
so please hunt with the
greatest care.

61161.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61161.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!

56063.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
56063.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Taikun Zamuza through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Long Sword, Hammer, Tonfa, Switch Axe, Magnet Spike, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56063.descriptionEn:
From one Supremacy Taikun
Zamuza weapon's creation to
two upgrades, you can get the
materials and Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura. Weapon types:
Long Sword, Hammer, Tonfa,
Switch Axe, Magnet Spike,
Heavy Bowgun or Bow. Please
use this to craft your favorite.

23675.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
23675.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Daimyo Hermitaur. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23675.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫.
To accept this quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.

21722.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Soul (Beginning) x８５, Hunting Horn Soul (Middle) x１９５, Hunting Horn Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Hunting Horn Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21722.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Hunting Horn Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest, you will
need a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please be aware of that.

63365.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
63365.description: I found a good vein of ore in the Jungle, but a Blue Yian Kut-Ku is clinging to it and in the way. While I go to dig, I want you to drive it off nicely. I will pay your reward from the ore we dig.
63365.descriptionEn:
I found a fine ore vein in the
Jungle, but a Blue Yian Kut-Ku
is hanging around and in the way.
While I go to dig, I'd like you to
drive it off for me, nicely.
I'll pay you from the ore we
dig up.

50833.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
50833.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Gasurabazura. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50833.descriptionEn:
Emergency request! We are
looking for hunters to
slay an extremely powerful
≪Gasurabazura≫ specimen.
If you succeed, you'll receive
more Slay Proofs than usual
from us!

50437.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26044.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26044.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!

58099.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58099.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58099.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.

54607.description: There was a report that white and brown Espinas appeared at the top of the sea of trees. There has never before been a case of these 2 appearing together, and they may bring tremendous damage. Please head out to slay them at once. On success, we will give you a piercing that the Guild has treasured since long ago.
54607.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a white
and a brown Espinas at the
Top of Great Forest. Never
have both appeared at once,
and they could bring vast
damage. Set out to slay
them at once. On success,
you will receive a piercing
long kept by the Guild.

21609.description: Do you know the orb called Tokusa Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21609.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Horsetail Orb?
Its material is essential to
the crafting of a certain
costly decoration.
If you can clear this request,
I'll give you a valuable
decoration material.

26041.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26041.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

55929.description: A Silver Sovereign Wyvern with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Silver Sovereign Wyvern known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55929.descriptionEn:
A ≪Silver Lord Wyvern≫ with a
greatly developed head has
appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts and
surveys it. Reports say it is
more dangerous than before.
Please take care in the survey.

63204.objectiveJp: ドラグライト鉱石２５個の納品
63204.description: Ho, so you will take my job. The road to Mining Master is steep. Then gather large amounts of two rare ores. Do that and I will trade you my secret ore. The more secret ore you collect, the closer you come to Mining Master.
63204.descriptionEn:
Oh, so you will accept
my request, will you?
The road to Master Miner is steep.
Then gather two kinds of precious
ore in great quantity for me.
Do so, and I shall trade you
ore from my secret hoard.
The more of that hoard you gather,
the closer you will come
to Master Miner.

21899.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21899.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Rathian in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21899.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's life,
we've prepared a request to
hunt ≪Rathian≫ in the New
Great Arena.
Clear this request and you'll
earn higher evaluation than
usual. Train efficiently and
aim for even greater heights.

62454.description: What, you just want a hard Sword and Shield? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62454.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Sword and Shield, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!

26561.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26561.description: Thanks for playing MHF for three whole years! Equip Akam Superb and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude L as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude L you can forge Vol Impact (Hammer).
26561.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for three whole years!
Equip ≪Akam Superb≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude L≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude L≫ you can forge
≪Vol Impact≫ (Hammer).

53229.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
53229.description: A corrupt daimyo who crushes the people under his tyranny has taken up position in the Desert with a ruffian bodyguard and his henchmen. The guard is strict, but there must be a gap. Make use of ninja garb and tools suited to stealth, seize the one moment of weakness, and slay the daimyo!
53229.descriptionEn:
A corrupt Daimyo who crushes the
people under his tyranny has taken
position in the Desert with
ruffian bodyguards and henchmen.
The guard is strict, but there
must be an opening somewhere.
Use ninja garb and tools made for
stealth, seize a moment's gap,
and strike down the Daimyo!

11059.description: Gravios is called the Tyrant of the Blaze, and its outer shell, grown to absurd hardness by eating coal and ore, calls for well-honed equipment! You could also slip past the Armor Wyvern and deliver Blast Rock!
11059.descriptionEn:
≪Gravios≫ is called the
Emperor of Blazing Heat. It
eats coal and ore, growing a
shell so hard you'll need
well-honed gear! You may
also sneak past the Armor
Wyvern to deliver ≪Blast Stone≫!

54317.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
54317.descriptionEn:
Defeat a monster a tiny bit bigger
than usual and find a bracelet,
nyah!
I'll trade you my top pick for it,
nyah!
What do I want it for?
It's better not to pry any further
than that, nyah.

62586.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart as 1 hunter. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62586.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare quickly and
accept and depart on it
alone.
This is especially recommended
for those new to hunting!

63082.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
63082.description: There is a report that a Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporta. Kushala Daora intrusions have happened often enough before, but this appearance falls far outside the Guild's predictions and can be called extremely rare. At once, intercept it at the Interception Base and slay it.
63082.descriptionEn:
A Kushala Daora has broken
into Mezepolta, per reports.
≪Kushala Daora≫ intrusions
have happened often before,
but this appearance falls far
outside the Guild's predictions
and can be called very rare.
Intercept it at the Base at once
and slay it.

21725.description: This quest yields the following materials. Tonfa Soul (Beginning) x８５, Tonfa Soul (Middle) x１９５, Tonfa Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Tonfa Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21725.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Tonfa Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Tonfa Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Tonfa Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Tonfa Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.

58084.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58084.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58084.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.

50015.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. Thanks to an adaptability that shrugs off harsh environments, elemental attacks seem to be of almost no use against it, so be careful.
50015.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species and has no fixed habitat;
because its numbers are so small it
is a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
Its adaptability shrugs off even harsh
environments, so elemental attacks
seem to hardly work on it.
Be careful.

26619.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26619.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?

63147.description: It's me! The Instructor! Do you know that great sandstorms have been breaking out all over the desert? Lately the sand has been blowing all the way into this town. We are covered in it everywhere and at our wit's end. So I want to stock cleaning tools to clear the sand away. Gather the materials for me!
63147.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Do you know that huge sandstorms
keep hitting the Desert?
Lately sand has even blown
into this town. Everything's
covered and I'm at my wit's end.
So I want to gather cleaning
tools to clear the sand away.
Go collect the materials for me!

21976.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21976.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21976.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

55076.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
55076.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

11055.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61811.description: Lately Great Thunderbugs have been swarming in the sea of trees. At this rate the Mezepor Expedition cannot push into the interior. What? You want to help the expedition? Then hurry and hunt the bugs! As a reward I will give the production materials for an exceptionally cool bow!
61811.descriptionEn:
Lately, Great Thunderbugs have
been swarming all through the
Great Forest. At this rate the
Mezepolta Expedition can't push
deep inside. What? You want to
help them? Then hurry and
hunt those bugs! I'll reward
you with bow materials!

51074.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
51074.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Red Shadow will also grant a special ingredient.
51074.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the head and torso
of the Red Shadow, we will also
grant you special ingredients.

61651.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
61651.description: I have a request, trusting in the sturdy bodies and spirits of you hunters. It is my firm belief that people begin to decline the moment they are satisfied. Hunger is what gives people vigor and makes them grow, I believe. Would you prove it for me?
61651.descriptionEn:
I have a request for you hunters,
whose tough bodies and wills
I have taken a liking to.
This is only my own theory, but
people begin to weaken the very
moment they grow satisfied.
I believe hunger is what gives
people vitality and growth.
Could you prove that for me?

62992.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
62992.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62992.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

63395.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Kuarusepusu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63395.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are seeking someone to
exterminate an extremely
powerful ≪Kuarlusepusu≫.
Hunt it well, and we shall issue
more proofs of slay than usual!

53044.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53044.description: Thank you for helping him. Thanks to you, the two of us could meet again! But the Bullfango we drove off seem to have come back. Hunter, now it is our turn to grant your wish. Come, in the place closest to the stars, wish for love!
53044.descriptionEn:
Thank you for saving him.
Thanks to you, we could meet
again!
But the Bullfango we drove off
seem to have come back.
Hunter, this time it's our turn
to grant your wish.
Now, at the place closest to
the stars, "wish" for love!

23561.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
23561.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23561.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.

21961.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21961.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Congalala in the Flower Field. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21961.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's life,
we've prepared a request to
hunt ≪Congalala≫ in the Flower
Field. Clear this request and
you'll earn higher evaluation
than usual. Train hard and
aim for even greater heights.

50759.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50759.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Roaring Wolf will also grant a special ingredient.
50759.descriptionEn:
We have prepared this quest
to further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
carrying out.
By breaking the Roaring Wolf's
head, special ingredients will
also be awarded to you.

23463.description: Pokaradon and Pokara appeared during the survey of the extreme cold sea! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. To hunters who complete the request, we will give production materials for the weapon series Fierce Flame Welcomed and Struck.
23463.descriptionEn:
During the Polar Sea survey,
Pokaradon and Pokara appeared!
We can't finish the survey
like this. Hunters who clear
this request will receive
materials to craft the
"Blazing Flame Repulse"
weapon series.

54835.description: A Lavasioth has been found in the depths of the volcano. The report, however, describes not an ordinary Lavasioth but one whose whole body glows red as if clad in crimson ore. We very much want a survey of this Crimson Lavasioth. Materials gathered during the survey are yours.
54835.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a ≪Volganos≫
found deep in the Volcano.
But the report describes not a
mere ≪Volganos≫ but one whose
whole body is crimson, as if
clad in Red Lotus stones.
Please survey this ≪Lavasioth≫
for us. Materials found during
the survey are yours to keep.

23538.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23538.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23538.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Akura Vashimu
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous as it is.
Prepare thoroughly and carry
out the survey.

61618.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61618.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! Hunt the packs of Daimyo Hermitaur and Congalala on the beaches and islands of the Jungle, and to finish, bring back a Carnivore Egg from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
61618.descriptionEn:
This time the training is for
hunters with little experience
only! Hunt packs of Shogun
Ceanataur and Congalala on the
beaches and islands of the Jungle,
and to finish, bring back a
carnivore egg from the cave.
It is harsh training, but if you
complete it your standing soars!

62985.description: Hey hey! I was invited by a Guild person to come to Mezeporta, but monsters are in the way and I cannot get through! You skilled hunter there, do something! I will give you my treasure as thanks.
62985.descriptionEn:
Hey, hey!
The Guild folks invited me to
come to Mezepolta, but some
monsters are in the way and I
simply cannot get through!
You there, skilled hunter,
do something about it!
I'll give you my treasure as a
reward, so come on!

56044.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Hypnocatrice through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Great Sword, Hammer, Hunting Horn, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56044.descriptionEn:
From one Supremacy Hypnocatrice
weapon's creation up to
two upgrades, you can get the
materials and Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura.
Weapon types you can craft:
Sword and Shield, Great Sword,
Hammer, Hunting Horn, Gunlance
or Switch Axe.
Please make good use of it.

23482.description: The Variant Species Espinas has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23482.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Espinas≫ has
grown ferocious and keeps
rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as is.
Prepare thoroughly for the
survey.

12060.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

50323.description: Everyone is back! Now the contest continues! Or so I thought, but a nuisance has appeared! Clear the nuisance quickly and cheer on the contest! That is the mission of the cheer captain!
50323.descriptionEn:
Everyone's back, meow!
Now the contest goes on, meow!
Or so I thought,
but a nuisance showed up, meow!
Hurry up and deal with
the nuisance, and cheer on
the contest, meow!
That is,
the Cheer Captain's duty, meow!!

50467.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50467.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50467.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.

61852.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
61852.description: The Gurenzeburu confirmed on the highlands, which is the target of this request, has been given the name Gurenzeburu by the Hunters Guild. It is an extremely fierce and powerful flying wyvern suited to the peculiar environment of the highlands, so face it fully prepared!
61852.descriptionEn:
The target of this request is
the ≪Barbarian Wyvern≫ found in
the Highlands, which the Hunters
Guild has named ≪Gurenzeburu≫.
It is an extremely wild and
powerful flying wyvern suited to
the Highlands' unique climate,
so challenge it fully prepared!

54903.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
54903.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54903.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

55792.description: So you wish to receive the teachings of one who has mastered the Magnetic Slash Hammer. The path is steep, but if I judge you worthy, I will give you a splendid weapon. First, show me your strength against a Gogomoa. For a wielder of the Magnetic Slash Hammer, distance to the foe is as good as nothing. Toy with it using magnetism!
55792.descriptionEn:
So you want to learn from me,
the Magnet Spike master. The
path is steep, but if I deem
you worthy, you get a fine
weapon. First, show your
strength against a Gogomoa.
To a Magnet Spike wielder,
distance means nothing. Play
with the foe using magnetism!

61527.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

23473.description: The Variant Species Khezu has appeared once more. Its head has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23473.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Khezu≫ has
appeared once more.
Its head has grown stronger,
and it seems even more powerful.
Please take great care during
the survey.

55803.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55803.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55803.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!

50801.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50801.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Hardcore Weapon and hunt the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50801.descriptionEn:
Thou who would master the way
of the hunt. Bear the 'Hardcore
Weapon' and hunt ≪Gasurabazura≫.
Only one who succeeds under
limited conditions can be
called a true hunter.
Success will bring a fitting reward.

62581.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
62581.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62581.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.

203.description: In this arena, monster and hunter face off one on one! This time your opponent is that Rathian. It will be a harsh drill, but clear it and you are a full-fledged hunter!
203.descriptionEn:
In this Arena, we pit monster
against hunter in a one-on-one
showdown! Today's opponent is
none other than Rathian.
It will be a harsh exercise, but
get past this and you're a pro!

55074.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
55074.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.

62919.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62919.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

23719.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
23719.description: The Variant Species Anorupatisu has appeared once more. Its developed horns have grown firmer still, and hold the destructive power to split the thick ice of the polar sea with ease. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23719.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Anorupatisu has
appeared once more.
Its developed horns have grown
far tougher, and hold power
enough to split the thick ice of
the Polar Sea with ease.
Please take every care in your
survey.

54657.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54657.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.

50343.description: Surveys have shown that the caves of Tide Island go deeper still. A considerable space appears to open up within, but a black monster has been confirmed there as well. Until safety is secured, no survey can be carried out. Head for the site at once and secure it.
50343.descriptionEn:
Surveys show the caves of the
Tidal Island go even deeper.
A rather large space seems to
open within, but the form of a
black monster has been sighted
there as well.
Until safety is secured, no
survey can proceed.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.

50293.description: This is sudden, but I want your help with an ecological survey of Kuarusepusu. If possible I would also like parts broken during this survey. I am sorry for the many requests, but for the sake of future research I would be most grateful.
50293.descriptionEn:
This is sudden, but I want help
surveying the ecology of
≪Kuarlusepusu≫.
For this survey I would like part
breaks too, if possible. Sorry for
all the demands, but for future
research, please lend a hand.

56142.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
56142.description: Ah, Lady Leila! Beauty and talent both, that is exactly Lady Leila! But it is only when hunters follow in her wake that the greatness of the original Lady stands out! If I can be of service to that, there is no greater joy. Let us begin by shouldering a part of her splendor.
56142.descriptionEn:
Ah, Lady Layla!
Beauty and talent, that is
exactly Lady Layla!
But only when rivals appear
does the true Lady's splendor
stand out!
If I can be of service to that,
nothing would please me more.
First, let me shoulder a part
of that elegance.

21705.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21705.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Empress] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
21705.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Empress]≫ and deliver
1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).

21615.description: Have you heard of the Slate Blue Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21615.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Storeroom Orb?
Its material is essential to
the crafting of a certain
costly decoration.
If you can clear this request,
I'll give you a valuable
decoration material.

60111.description: Patients wounded and suffering from illness need nourishing food. But the reality is that such food reaches only the mouths of a few wealthy people. At least I want to give the patients in the square proper care. Hunters, I am counting on you.
60111.descriptionEn:
Patients wounded and suffering
from illness need nourishing
food. Yet the truth is that such
food reaches only the mouths of
a few wealthy folk.
At least for the patients in the
plaza, I want to give proper
care. Hunters, I leave it to you.

23202.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23202.description: A Yian Kut-Ku has been attacking travelers through the swamp, and the losses are severe. We hired hunters as escorts, but they seem to be struggling badly. Something about this one is different from the Yian Kut-Ku we know. If the damage continues, we cannot keep our work going. Please deal with it urgently.
23202.descriptionEn:
Travelers through the Swamp
are being raided by a Yian
Kut-Ku, causing huge losses.
We hired escort hunters, but
they're struggling badly.
Something seems different
about this Kut-Ku. If the
damage continues, we can't
keep working. Please hurry!

61645.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61645.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.

21243.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の討伐
21243.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21243.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.

22087.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Blaststone. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
22087.descriptionEn:
The Popular Tavern Guild has
placed a large order for
Firestones.
Eight is not a number that one
hunter can deliver alone,
so we recommend accepting it
with at least two people.
Note that sub-clears give no supplies.

55026.description: An unidentified black monster is rampaging in the Old Tower. Who is it? It changes its form, changes its movement, changes its voice, changes its eye color. To whoever ascertains its true identity, I will give Guild hidden armor.
55026.descriptionEn:
An unidentified black monster
is running wild in the
Ancient Tower. What is it?
It changes shape, movement,
voice, and the color of
its eyes. Whoever uncovers
its true identity gets armor
from the Guild's vault.

26067.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26067.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!

54312.description: Greetings, hunter. Have you ever crafted a piece of armor only to find yourself short of materials and unable to upgrade it? Then I have good news for you. Clear this quest and upgrading that armor may become an easy matter. I pray the materials you want are among what you find.
54312.descriptionEn:
Hunter, good day to you.
Have you crafted armor only to find
you lack the materials to upgrade it?
Then we have good news for you.
If you complete this quest, you may
be able to upgrade your armor
with ease.
I pray you obtain the materials
you are hoping for.

63133.description: This is a preliminary quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes.
63133.descriptionEn:
This is a preliminary quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.

55353.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55353.description: We have received a report of the shadow of a wyvern with enormous claws in an unsurveyed part of the desert. With signs of new Anomalous Species appearing, the guild has prepared new weapons for promising hunters to face them. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare to hunt the Anomalous Species!
55353.descriptionEn:
A report has come in of a
flying wyvern with giant claws
sighted in an unsurveyed part
of the Desert. At this sign of
a new Supremacy, the Guild has
prepared new weapons for
promising hunters to face
them.
Gather the materials and
prepare to slay a Supremacy!

62723.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
62723.description: How about this hammer! But with it I should be able to unleash even greater, colossal power! If I smash that Doragyurosu's head with this iron mallet, I might hit on something! Land a blow and tell me what you learn!
62723.descriptionEn:
How about this hammer?!
But this one should unleash
an even greater dreadnought
power!!
Smash that Dark Thunder
Dragon's head with it and
you might get some ideas!
Tell me what you learn!!

61507.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
61507.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61507.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.

63359.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
63359.description: We have received reports that Teostra has appeared in the volcano. Several hunters have been sent before, but none have produced results. For that reason this request comes with a number of conditions. It is a difficult task, and we have prepared a reward to match. We thank you in advance.
63359.descriptionEn:
A report has arrived that Teostra
has appeared in the Volcano.
We have sent hunters there several
times already, but no results have
been achieved.
For that reason, we have set several
conditions on this request.
It is a difficult request, but we have
prepared a reward to match.
Thank you for your cooperation.

63388.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン亜種１体の撃退
63388.description: The fortress guard reports that a grey, rock-like giant dragon is advancing. Hunters, head for the fortress at once and repel it. You may use the fortress's equipment freely. Make the most of it in battle.
63388.descriptionEn:
The Fort's guards report that a
grey, rock-like giant dragon is
advancing on us.
All hunters, head to the Fort at
once and repel it.
You may use the Fort's facilities
freely.
Make the most of them and put
them to use in battle.

61008.description: A powerful Daimyo Hermitaur Variant is said to have been found in the desert. Capture it for our research. If you prepare it in a way that makes study easier, we will prepare more rewards!
61008.descriptionEn:
A powerful Daimyo Hermitaur
variant was found in the
Desert. Capture it for our
research. If you soften it
up for study, we'll prepare
a bigger reward for you!

55174.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
55174.description: Slaying a Gypceros Subspecies raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55174.descriptionEn:
Slay a Purple Gypceros to raise
your own reputation while
getting G Rank decorations
and the materials you need
for them at a good price.
We have prepared this quest
for you. Please make use of it.

55613.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55613.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

55928.description: A Basarios with a greatly developed body has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to Variant Species, have caused many hunters to fail in the hunt. The guild will provide support as well, so please form a party of 4 and see the hunt through.
55928.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gravios≫ with a greatly
developed body has appeared.
Its Supremacy-specific attacks
have made many hunters fail
the hunt.
The Guild will provide support,
so form a party of four and
ensure the slay is done.

54180.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54180.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.

54714.description: The survey of White Lake is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
54714.descriptionEn:
The survey of White Lake is
going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.

55752.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55752.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

61238.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の討伐
61238.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. No Festival Certificate is required for this one. Simply completing the quest pays out a variety of rewards.
61238.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards for those
belonging to a winning guild
of the Hunter Festival.
No Festival Proof is required
here. Simply clearing the quest
will pay out a variety of
rewards.

56038.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
56038.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Doragyurosu. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56038.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Dark Thunder Wyvern
for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.

23614.description: A Blast Wolf with greatly developed legs has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Blast Wolf seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23614.descriptionEn:
A ≪Midogaron≫ whose legs have
grown greatly has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy with
developed parts and will survey
it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any Midogaron
before. Please survey it with
care.

53053.description: Everyone, how are you! Miyashita here! My challenge to you (a quiz). Question 1: The spiked organ on a Rathian's jaw is poisonous. If you think the answer is true (A), take this quest!
53053.descriptionEn:
Is everyone doing well?!
This is Miyashita!
My challenge to you (a quiz)
[Question 1]
The spike-like organ growing
on Rathian's jaw is poisonous.
If you think the answer is
A (yes), then accept
this quest!

26463.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

23236.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
23236.description: A Pariapuria has appeared in a part of the Canyon the survey has not reached. For now it is quiet, but it is near a road many people travel, so action is needed as soon as possible. We are seeking hunters who can head out to hunt it.
23236.descriptionEn:
In a part of the Canyon we
haven't surveyed, a Pariapuria
has appeared. For now it is
quiet, but it's near a
well-traveled road, so we
believe a response is needed
as soon as possible.
We are looking for hunters
who can head out to hunt it.

60661.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
60661.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a high difficulty Guanzorumu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60661.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete! Today's target
is the high-difficulty
≪Guanzorumu≫!
Achieve the goal together
with your Guild mates.
In this contest where teamwork
is everything, try to take
a top place! This one is
Supremacy weapons only!

53270.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐

55719.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55719.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.

60105.description: Thank you for waiting. Here is the hunting ground information. This time's hunting ground is the Sea of Trees, with its dense trees and somehow mysterious air. Along with an ecological survey, please deliver 12 Specialty Mushrooms.
60105.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Here's the hunting ground
info. This time it's the Great
Forest, dense with trees and
strangely mystical air. Along
with the ecology survey,
please deliver 12 Special Mushrooms.

54430.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
54430.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54430.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.

28039.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Abiorugu materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28039.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters, a word.
Won't you pass your hunting
skills on to the young
hunters of the Guild? This
time, ≪Gasurabazura≫ parts
in abundance! Get stronger
together and liven up the
Guild. Clear it with both
Secret Art Tome holders and
non-holders for more renown.

26295.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

55930.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55930.description: The Variant Species Harudomerugu has appeared once more. Its power to command metal has grown more potent, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55930.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Harudomerugu≫
has appeared once more.
Its power to control metal has
grown stronger, and it seems
even more powerful. Please take
great care during the survey.

60435.objectiveJp: 秘密のポーチ４個の納品
60435.description: You who call yourselves treasure hunters. Will you join one of my amusements? It is simple. Deliver four Secret Pouches and I will give you some of the jewels I prepared by lottery. How about it?
60435.descriptionEn:
You who call yourselves
Treasure Hunters. Won't you
join a little diversion of mine?
It's simple. Deliver 4
≪Secret Pouch≫ and I'll give
you a few of my gems by
lottery. How about it?
So, will you take the job?

56101.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
56101.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56101.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.

21135.description: An unprecedented great lightning strike has been witnessed at the Ancient Tower. This is a survey request for hunters of skill only. It is too dangerous, so item supply is impossible. Conduct the survey with the utmost care.
21135.descriptionEn:
A lightning strike of unprecedented
scale was witnessed at the Ancient
Tower.
This survey request is for skilled
hunters only. It is far too
dangerous, so no items can be
supplied. Please conduct the
survey with the utmost caution.

1052.description: Chameleos is an existence considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. Do not think of impossible things like capture; repel it repeatedly to wear down its health! Slay it in the end!
1052.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is looked on as a
heretic even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from nowhere at all;
even a veteran cannot best it.
Forget capture, impossible as it
is. Repel it again and again to
wear it down, and slay it at last!

26264.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26264.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26264.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.

55693.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Midogaron. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55693.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Midogaron≫.
A ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required to accept the quest.
Please keep that in mind.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please be careful.

65003.description:
Achieve Main ObjecFaint ３ Times
Time out

61883.description: The season is the breeding season! The stage is the Desert at midday! Gather eggs and deliver them, and if you obtain gold or silver eggs as a reward, they can be sold for a high price! Hunters aiming to make a fortune at one stroke, do join us!
61883.descriptionEn:
The season is the breeding
season! The stage is the Desert
at high noon!
Gather eggs and deliver them;
if you get Gold or Silver Eggs
as rewards, they sell high!
Hunters after quick money, join!

50455.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55691.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Hyujikiki. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55691.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Hyujikiki≫.
A ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required to accept the quest.
Please keep that in mind.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please be careful.

62770.description: I found a stone while digging, but I can see no value in it! So I want you, a hunter, to gather pinky-promise grass for me. Bundled together, that grass can polish the stone. Bring me some, and I will share the leftover stones with you.
62770.descriptionEn:
I found a stone while digging,
but as it is, it has no worth!
So I want you, a hunter, to
gather some Yubikiri Grass.
Bound into a bundle, the grass
can polish the stone right up.
Bring it to me and I will
share the spare stones with you.

54859.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
54859.description: We received a report of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku found in the swamp. However, it seems to perform special behavior not recorded in reports to date. Please investigate the Blue Yian Kut-Ku.
54859.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that a
≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ has been
found in the Swamp.
However, it apparently behaves in
ways not recorded in any report so
far.
We would very much like you to
survey the ≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫.

55823.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55823.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55823.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!

26565.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
26565.description: 1 step short of the Canyon, a Yian Garuga is in the way and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26565.descriptionEn:
I'm just one step from the
Canyon, but a Yian Garuga is
in my way and I'm stuck.
If you help me out,
I'll give you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ you can trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫ as thanks!

21913.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21913.description: Thanks for playing MHF for eight whole years! Equip Shan Mishoal and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude Q as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude Q you can forge Galba Sophi (Hunting Horn).
21913.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for eight whole years!
Equip ≪Shan Mishoal≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude Q≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
Q≫ you can forge ≪Galba
Sophi≫ (Hunting Horn).

26493.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26493.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Fang! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26493.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26493.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who break many parts
on Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying
Wyvern's Heavy Fang! When
accepting or joining, deliver
the guarantee slip, then hunt
the specified monster. The slip
is not returned once you depart.

12003.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
12003.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, often shows itself in the Jungle. It is quite a tough opponent, so rather than slaying it, capturing it with a Shock Trap is also an effective approach, you know?
12003.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, the Bullfango
leader ≪Bulldrome≫ often shows
itself.
It is a fairly tough foe, so
rather than slaying it, using a
≪Shock Trap≫ and capturing it
is also an effective option!

65002.description: The Gore Magala has been sighted at the tower. According to the report, it appeared to be in a Frenzy state, but far more ominous in form than any Frenzy state reported so far. At this rate the Frenzy Virus will spread. Hunt the Gore Magala.
65002.descriptionEn:
A Gore Magala was sighted at
the Tower.
According to reports, the Gore
Magala had been Frenzied,
but its form was said to be far
more sinister than any
Frenzy reported until now.
At this rate the Frenzy Virus
will spread. Hunt the Gore Magala.

23695.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23695.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of Ｇｚ and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
23695.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A request is now available that
lets you earn a huge amount of Gz
and gain plenty of experience.
Please take this chance and
give it a try!

54187.description: We will continue the survey of the Lavasioth that appeared in the volcano. Breaking its parts is not required, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, we thank you for your help!
54187.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of
the Volganos in the Volcano.
Part breaks aren't required,
but we'd be delighted if
you did it!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid!

21580.description: Do you know of the sphere called the Rabbit Ear Sphere? Its material is essential to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request and I shall give you rare decoration material.
21580.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Rabbit Ear Orb?
Its material is essential to
the crafting of a certain
costly decoration.
If you can clear this request,
I'll give you a valuable
decoration material.

60081.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

60086.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

63089.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
63089.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63089.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.

65000.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
65000.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
65000.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.
